title: 東京灣跨海公路隧道
summary: 東京灣跨海公路結合海底隧道、人工島與橋梁，大林組工程史列整體道路15.1公里及1997年施工標竣工。本課把整體走廊與承包商施工範圍分開，聚焦人工島支承、地下接合、環片與止水、通風和鹽害；不把某一標段紀錄泛化為整個工程所有部位的參數。
summaryEn: The Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line combines a subsea tunnel, artificial islands and a bridge. Obayashi records a 15.1 km road corridor and completion of its contract in 1997. The course separates corridor and contract scope, focusing on island support, underground connections, segments, sealing, ventilation and marine deterioration without generalising one contract to every structure.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創綜合審查：先計算「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」，再獨立計算「接頭壓縮與水密包絡」。原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=67 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=657.27 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為722.997 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：初始壓縮=19 mm；張開量=4 mm；幾何公差=2 mm。c_res=c0−opening−tolerance=13 mm。僅把張開量增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為12.6 mm。邊界：單向幾何餘量，不是接觸壓或水密合格證明；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated review: first calculate piezometric head and lining pressure, then independently calculate joint compression and sealing envelope. Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=67 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=657.27 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 722.997 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: initial compression=19 mm; opening=4 mm; tolerance=2 mm. c_res=c0−opening−tolerance=13 mm. Increasing only opening by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 12.6 mm. Boundary: One-direction geometric reserve, not contact pressure or proof of watertightness. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「服務邊界與路線代價」與「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Service boundaries and alignment cost" and "Piezometric head and lining pressure": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「路線里程與端點」如何影響東京灣跨海公路隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Alignment chainage and endpoints” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 東京灣跨海公路的橋、島和隧道服務不同功能，教學路線比較保留人工島轉接與整條道路端點。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「路線里程與端點」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Bridge, island and tunnel serve different functions; retain island transitions and whole-road endpoints when comparing the crossing. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk. Compare options between identical endpoints and distinguish running bores, approaches and service galleries. Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Alignment chainage and endpoints” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：長度=15.6 km；速度=60 km/h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: length=15.6 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=15.6 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「路線里程與端點」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Alignment chainage and endpoints”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 服務邊界與路線代價
knowledge.text: 東京灣跨海公路的橋、島和隧道服務不同功能，教學路線比較保留人工島轉接與整條道路端點。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。
knowledge.textEn: Bridge, island and tunnel serve different functions; retain island transitions and whole-road endpoints when comparing the crossing. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「服務邊界與路線代價」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Service boundaries and alignment cost" is correct?
options: 最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
東京灣跨海公路的橋、島和隧道服務不同功能，教學路線比較保留人工島轉接與整條道路端點。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
optionsEn: The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
Bridge, island and tunnel serve different functions; retain island transitions and whole-road endpoints when comparing the crossing.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
quiz.explanation: 東京灣跨海公路的橋、島和隧道服務不同功能，教學路線比較保留人工島轉接與整條道路端點。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Bridge, island and tunnel serve different functions; retain island transitions and whole-road endpoints when comparing the crossing. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「路線里程與端點」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Alignment chainage and endpoints” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：長度=15.6 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=15.6 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為17.16 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: length=15.6 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=15.6 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 17.16 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將橋長、隧道長與道路連接範圍分欄核對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconcile bridge, tunnel and connecting-road scope in separate columns.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：長度=15.6 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=15.6 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為17.16 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: length=15.6 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=15.6 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 17.16 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「服務邊界與路線代價」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Service boundaries and alignment cost", which statement holds?
options: 灌入體積等於理論空隙就能證明襯砌背後全部填滿。
接縫平均寬度合格就不必量測局部錯台及扭轉。
原創教學假設：長度=15.6 km；速度=60 km/h。
optionsEn: Injected volume equal to the theoretical annulus proves complete filling behind the lining.
An acceptable average joint width makes local offset and twist measurements unnecessary.
Original teaching assumptions: length=15.6 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=15.6 min.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：長度=15.6 km；速度=60 km/h。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: length=15.6 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=15.6 min. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「路線里程與端點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Alignment chainage and endpoints” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將橋長、隧道長與道路連接範圍分欄核對。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconcile bridge, tunnel and connecting-road scope in separate columns. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：將橋長、隧道長與道路連接範圍分欄核對。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Reconcile bridge, tunnel and connecting-road scope in separate columns. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把整條道路長度當盾構掘進長度會誤估設備需求。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating road length as shield-drive length misstates equipment requirements. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將橋長、隧道長與道路連接範圍分欄核對。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Reconcile bridge, tunnel and connecting-road scope in separate columns. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：將橋長、隧道長與道路連接範圍分欄核對。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。
knowledge.textEn: For Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Reconcile bridge, tunnel and connecting-road scope in separate columns. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.

quiz.question: 要驗證「服務邊界與路線代價」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Service boundaries and alignment cost"?
options: 將橋長、隧道長與道路連接範圍分欄核對。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
各管節平均高程接近就能排除接頭差異變形。
optionsEn: Reconcile bridge, tunnel and connecting-road scope in separate columns.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Similar mean element elevations exclude differential movement at joints.
quiz.explanation: 將橋長、隧道長與道路連接範圍分欄核對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconcile bridge, tunnel and connecting-road scope in separate columns. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「路線里程與端點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Alignment chainage and endpoints” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把整條道路長度當盾構掘進長度會誤估設備需求。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating road length as shield-drive length misstates equipment requirements. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把整條道路長度當盾構掘進長度會誤估設備需求。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。
knowledge.textEn: Treating road length as shield-drive length misstates equipment requirements. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「服務邊界與路線代價」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Service boundaries and alignment cost" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把整條道路長度當盾構掘進長度會誤估設備需求。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Treating road length as shield-drive length misstates equipment requirements.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
quiz.explanation: 把整條道路長度當盾構掘進長度會誤估設備需求。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating road length as shield-drive length misstates equipment requirements. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「測壓水頭」如何影響東京灣跨海公路隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Piezometric head” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 人工島與海底孔的水頭邊界不同，研究島內降水和海床補注如何影響接合區壓力。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「測壓水頭」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Artificial-island and subsea heads differ; examine how island drainage and seabed recharge affect connection-zone pressure. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level. Drainage reduces pressure but can increase effective stress and settlement. Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Piezometric head” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=67 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=67 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=657.27 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「測壓水頭」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Piezometric head”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓
knowledge.text: 人工島與海底孔的水頭邊界不同，研究島內降水和海床補注如何影響接合區壓力。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。
knowledge.textEn: Artificial-island and subsea heads differ; examine how island drainage and seabed recharge affect connection-zone pressure. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Piezometric head and lining pressure" is correct?
options: 目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。
人工島與海底孔的水頭邊界不同，研究島內降水和海床補注如何影響接合區壓力。
optionsEn: No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance.
Artificial-island and subsea heads differ; examine how island drainage and seabed recharge affect connection-zone pressure.
quiz.explanation: 人工島與海底孔的水頭邊界不同，研究島內降水和海床補注如何影響接合區壓力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Artificial-island and subsea heads differ; examine how island drainage and seabed recharge affect connection-zone pressure. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「測壓水頭」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Piezometric head” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=67 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=657.27 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為722.997 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=67 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=657.27 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 722.997 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較島內外測壓管與潮位反應的幅度和延遲。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare amplitudes and lags of piezometer and tide responses inside and outside the island.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=67 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=657.27 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為722.997 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=67 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=657.27 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 722.997 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Piezometric head and lining pressure", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=67 m。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=67 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=657.27 kPa.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=67 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=67 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=657.27 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「測壓水頭」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Piezometric head” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較島內外測壓管與潮位反應的幅度和延遲。使用分層測壓管及流量計，配合降雨或潮位序列分辨補注與設備影響，將讀值統一換算至同一高程基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare amplitudes and lags of piezometer and tide responses inside and outside the island. Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：比較島內外測壓管與潮位反應的幅度和延遲。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Compare amplitudes and lags of piezometer and tide responses inside and outside the island. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：島內低水頭不代表接合外圍海床同樣卸壓。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Low island head does not establish relief in the surrounding seabed. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較島內外測壓管與潮位反應的幅度和延遲。使用分層測壓管及流量計，配合降雨或潮位序列分辨補注與設備影響，將讀值統一換算至同一高程基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Compare amplitudes and lags of piezometer and tide responses inside and outside the island. Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：比較島內外測壓管與潮位反應的幅度和延遲。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。
knowledge.textEn: For Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Compare amplitudes and lags of piezometer and tide responses inside and outside the island. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.

quiz.question: 要驗證「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Piezometric head and lining pressure"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
比較島內外測壓管與潮位反應的幅度和延遲。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Compare amplitudes and lags of piezometer and tide responses inside and outside the island.
Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 比較島內外測壓管與潮位反應的幅度和延遲。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare amplitudes and lags of piezometer and tide responses inside and outside the island. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「測壓水頭」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Piezometric head” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 島內低水頭不代表接合外圍海床同樣卸壓。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Low island head does not establish relief in the surrounding seabed. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 島內低水頭不代表接合外圍海床同樣卸壓。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。
knowledge.textEn: Low island head does not establish relief in the surrounding seabed. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Piezometric head and lining pressure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。
島內低水頭不代表接合外圍海床同樣卸壓。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance.
Low island head does not establish relief in the surrounding seabed.
quiz.explanation: 島內低水頭不代表接合外圍海床同樣卸壓。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Low island head does not establish relief in the surrounding seabed. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「掘進利用率與設備停時」與「背填連續性與體積帳」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Boring utilisation and equipment downtime" and "Backfill continuity and volume balance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 掘進利用率與設備停時：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Boring utilisation and equipment downtime: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「有效掘進利用率」如何影響東京灣跨海公路隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Effective boring utilisation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大直徑海底盾構的切削與環片物流互相制約，教材以Aqua-Line背景區分單次高進尺與整班利用率。TBM瞬時貫入率只描述刀盤切削的一段時間，拼裝、換刀、出渣與維修決定每天真正進尺。岩石強度與磨蝕性對刀具的影響不同，混合掌子面又產生不對稱作用；比較機器績效須按地質分區和停時原因分類，不能只排序最高進尺。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「有效掘進利用率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Large-diameter cutting and segment logistics interact; distinguish high short-duration advance from whole-shift utilisation in the Aqua-Line setting. Instantaneous penetration describes only active cutting; erection, cutter changes, muck handling and repairs determine daily advance. Strength and abrasivity affect cutters differently, while mixed faces impose asymmetric loading. Compare performance by ground domain and downtime cause, because the highest short-duration penetration rate can coexist with poor daily production and increased maintenance demand. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Effective boring utilisation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：切削速率=1.77 m/h；有效利用率=0.28 無因次。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: active penetration=1.77 m/h; utilisation=0.28 dimensionless.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：切削速率=1.77 m/h；有效利用率=0.28 無因次。D=24vu=11.8944 m/day。僅把有效利用率增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為13.0838 m/day。邊界：平均循環模型，未表示地質轉換及停機分布；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.instructionEn: Align segment delivery, erection and cutting times to identify the bottleneck. steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel, the effective boring utilisation handover must address the following evidence: Align segment delivery, erection and cutting times to identify the bottleneck. Use traceable downtime codes, separating geological change from equipment faults; parameter changes stay within procedures approved by equipment and construction teams.

steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Faster cutting with inadequate segment supply merely increases waiting. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：開挖外徑=8.36 m；襯砌外徑=8.06 m；環長=1.5 m。V=π(De²−Dl²)L/4=5.80331 m³。僅把環長增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為6.38364 m³。邊界：同心幾何空隙，不等於實際灌漿需求或完成證明；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: excavated diameter=8.36 m; lining diameter=8.06 m; ring length=1.5 m. V=π(De²−Dl²)L/4=5.80331 m³. Increasing only ring length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 6.38364 m³. Boundary: Concentric geometric void, not actual grout demand or proof of completion. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將注入量、壓力和環片位移同步檢查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check injected volume, pressure and segment movement together.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: excavated diameter=8.36 m; lining diameter=8.06 m; ring length=1.5 m. V=π(De²−Dl²)L/4=5.80331 m³. Increasing only ring length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 6.38364 m³. Boundary: Concentric geometric void, not actual grout demand or proof of completion. quiz.question: 依「背填連續性與體積帳」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Backfill continuity and volume balance", which statement holds?
options: 兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
原創教學假設：開挖外徑=8.36 m；襯砌外徑=8.06 m；環長=1.5 m。
optionsEn: Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
Original teaching assumptions: excavated diameter=8.36 m; lining diameter=8.06 m; ring length=1.5 m.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：開挖外徑=8.36 m；襯砌外徑=8.06 m；環長=1.5 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: excavated diameter=8.36 m; lining diameter=8.06 m; ring length=1.5 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 背填連續性與體積帳：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Backfill continuity and volume balance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「襯砌背後幾何空隙」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Geometric lining annulus” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將注入量、壓力和環片位移同步檢查。用環片及開挖尺寸計算幾何空隙，核對注入回流質量與時間戳，再以適當無損檢測及變形資料查局部缺填。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check injected volume, pressure and segment movement together. Calculate the annulus from lining and excavation dimensions, reconcile injected/returned mass and timing, then use suitable nondestructive and deformation evidence for local gaps. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「襯砌背後幾何空隙」的交付需回答：將注入量、壓力和環片位移同步檢查。將每環幾何、材料批次及注入回流紀錄綁定，缺填診斷由土建及地工共同確認，後續處置不只追求增加總注量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel, the geometric lining annulus handover must address the following evidence: Check injected volume, pressure and segment movement together. Link each ring to geometry, material batch and injection/return records; structural and ground teams diagnose gaps together rather than merely increasing volume.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：注入量大於理論空隙可能表示流失而不是更好填充。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Injection above theoretical void volume may indicate loss rather than better filling. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

knowledge.textEn: Check injected volume, pressure and segment movement together. Calculate the annulus from lining and excavation dimensions, reconcile injected/returned mass and timing, then use suitable nondestructive and deformation evidence for local gaps. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「襯砌背後幾何空隙」的交付需回答：將注入量、壓力和環片位移同步檢查。將每環幾何、材料批次及注入回流紀錄綁定，缺填診斷由土建及地工共同確認，後續處置不只追求增加總注量。
knowledge.textEn: For Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel, the geometric lining annulus handover must address the following evidence: Check injected volume, pressure and segment movement together. Link each ring to geometry, material batch and injection/return records; structural and ground teams diagnose gaps together rather than merely increasing volume.

quiz.question: 要驗證「背填連續性與體積帳」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Backfill continuity and volume balance"?
options: 將注入量、壓力和環片位移同步檢查。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Check injected volume, pressure and segment movement together.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 將注入量、壓力和環片位移同步檢查。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check injected volume, pressure and segment movement together. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 背填連續性與體積帳：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Backfill continuity and volume balance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「襯砌背後幾何空隙」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Geometric lining annulus” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 注入量大於理論空隙可能表示流失而不是更好填充。局部通道讓材料回流時，總注量可能正常但背後仍有空洞，環片變形與接頭滲漏可能延後出現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Injection above theoretical void volume may indicate loss rather than better filling. Preferential return paths can give normal total injection while leaving voids, with delayed segment distortion and leakage. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：超挖、地層吸收、回流和材料體積變化都會改變收支；注入量達到目標仍不代表每個位置填滿，需要把壓力、時間與後續變形一起判讀。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Meeting a volume target does not prove complete spatial filling; pressure, timing and later deformation must be interpreted together rather than using a single total.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「灌入體積等於理論空隙就能證明襯砌背後全部填滿。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Injected volume equal to the theoretical annulus proves complete filling behind the lining." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 注入量大於理論空隙可能表示流失而不是更好填充。局部通道讓材料回流時，總注量可能正常但背後仍有空洞，環片變形與接頭滲漏可能延後出現。
knowledge.textEn: Injection above theoretical void volume may indicate loss rather than better filling. Preferential return paths can give normal total injection while leaving voids, with delayed segment distortion and leakage.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「背填連續性與體積帳」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Backfill continuity and volume balance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
注入量大於理論空隙可能表示流失而不是更好填充。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Injection above theoretical void volume may indicate loss rather than better filling.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
quiz.explanation: 注入量大於理論空隙可能表示流失而不是更好填充。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Injection above theoretical void volume may indicate loss rather than better filling. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「環向受力與接縫柔度」與「接頭壓縮與水密包絡」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ring force and joint flexibility" and "Joint compression and sealing envelope": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ring force and joint flexibility: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「襯砌環向壓縮」如何影響東京灣跨海公路隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lining hoop compression” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 人工島接合和海底均勻段具有不同拘束，Aqua-Line環片教材比較均勻環向力與接合局部反力。圓形襯砌對均勻外壓可主要以環向壓縮抵抗，但接頭轉動、偏壓與背填空隙會引起彎矩。薄環膜應力只說明其中一條受力路徑；脫模、運輸、頂推及永久狀態的荷載不同，環片局部接觸與止水條件必須另外檢核。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「襯砌環向壓縮」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Island connections and uniform subsea reaches have different restraints; compare hoop force with local interface reactions. A circular lining resists uniform external pressure largely through hoop compression, but joint rotation, uneven load and backfill voids generate bending. Thin-ring membrane stress describes only one load path. Demoulding, transport, jacking and permanent states impose different actions, requiring separate checks of local segment contact and sealing rather than one permanent-load calculation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Lining hoop compression” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.48 MPa；半徑=3.4 m；厚度=0.35 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.48 MPa; radius=3.4 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=4.66286 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「襯砌環向壓縮」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Lining hoop compression”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度
knowledge.text: 人工島接合和海底均勻段具有不同拘束，Aqua-Line環片教材比較均勻環向力與接合局部反力。圓形襯砌對均勻外壓可主要以環向壓縮抵抗，但接頭轉動、偏壓與背填空隙會引起彎矩。
knowledge.textEn: Island connections and uniform subsea reaches have different restraints; compare hoop force with local interface reactions. A circular lining resists uniform external pressure largely through hoop compression, but joint rotation, uneven load and backfill voids generate bending.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「環向受力與接縫柔度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ring force and joint flexibility" is correct?
options: 混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
接縫平均寬度合格就不必量測局部錯台及扭轉。
人工島接合和海底均勻段具有不同拘束，Aqua-Line環片教材比較均勻環向力與接合局部反力。
optionsEn: Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
An acceptable average joint width makes local offset and twist measurements unnecessary.
Island connections and uniform subsea reaches have different restraints; compare hoop force with local interface reactions.
quiz.explanation: 人工島接合和海底均勻段具有不同拘束，Aqua-Line環片教材比較均勻環向力與接合局部反力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Island connections and uniform subsea reaches have different restraints; compare hoop force with local interface reactions. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ring force and joint flexibility: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「襯砌環向壓縮」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lining hoop compression” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.48 MPa；半徑=3.4 m；厚度=0.35 m。σθ=pr/t=4.66286 MPa。僅把均勻外壓增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為5.12914 MPa。邊界：薄圓環膜應力，不是接縫、偏壓或矩形框架解；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.48 MPa; radius=3.4 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=4.66286 MPa. Increasing only uniform external pressure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 5.12914 MPa. Boundary: Thin circular-ring membrane stress, not a joint, uneven-load or rectangular-frame solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：沿接合區與一般區量測環形變形，核對支承模型。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure distortion at interfaces and ordinary reaches to check support assumptions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.48 MPa；半徑=3.4 m；厚度=0.35 m。σθ=pr/t=4.66286 MPa。僅把均勻外壓增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為5.12914 MPa。邊界：薄圓環膜應力，不是接縫、偏壓或矩形框架解；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.48 MPa; radius=3.4 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=4.66286 MPa. Increasing only uniform external pressure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 5.12914 MPa. Boundary: Thin circular-ring membrane stress, not a joint, uneven-load or rectangular-frame solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ring force and joint flexibility: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「襯砌環向壓縮」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lining hoop compression” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 沿接合區與一般區量測環形變形，核對支承模型。將環形變形、接縫張開與應變和含接頭彈簧的模型比較，分開安裝後、背填後及水頭回升後的基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure distortion at interfaces and ordinary reaches to check support assumptions. Compare ring distortion, joint opening and strain with a joint-spring model, separating baselines after installation, grouting and head recovery. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「襯砌環向壓縮」的交付需回答：沿接合區與一般區量測環形變形，核對支承模型。設計圖應分開標註各施工階段、接頭剛度及背填條件，構件驗收同時核對幾何、材料批次與止水試驗適用包絡。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel, the lining hoop compression handover must address the following evidence: Measure distortion at interfaces and ordinary reaches to check support assumptions. Drawings distinguish stages, joint stiffness and backfill conditions; component acceptance reconciles geometry, material batches and the applicable sealing-test envelope.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：套用一般環段模型會漏掉島體沉陷造成的局部作用。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A standard ring model misses local actions from island settlement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ring force and joint flexibility: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「襯砌環向壓縮」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lining hoop compression” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 套用一般環段模型會漏掉島體沉陷造成的局部作用。局部脫空增加環片彎曲，裂縫未必代表混凝土平均強度不足；忽略接縫接觸會把補強方向導向錯誤位置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A standard ring model misses local actions from island settlement. Local voids increase bending, so cracks need not indicate inadequate mean concrete strength; neglecting joint contact can misdirect strengthening. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：薄環膜應力只說明其中一條受力路徑；脫模、運輸、頂推及永久狀態的荷載不同，環片局部接觸與止水條件必須另外檢核。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Demoulding, transport, jacking and permanent states impose different actions, requiring separate checks of local segment contact and sealing rather than one permanent-load calculation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 套用一般環段模型會漏掉島體沉陷造成的局部作用。局部脫空增加環片彎曲，裂縫未必代表混凝土平均強度不足；忽略接縫接觸會把補強方向導向錯誤位置。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「環向受力與接縫柔度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ring force and joint flexibility" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
接縫平均寬度合格就不必量測局部錯台及扭轉。
套用一般環段模型會漏掉島體沉陷造成的局部作用。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
An acceptable average joint width makes local offset and twist measurements unnecessary.
A standard ring model misses local actions from island settlement.
quiz.explanation: 套用一般環段模型會漏掉島體沉陷造成的局部作用。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A standard ring model misses local actions from island settlement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 接頭壓縮與水密包絡：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Joint compression and sealing envelope: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「止水壓縮餘量」如何影響東京灣跨海公路隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gasket compression reserve” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大林組記載接合與防水措施，本課以假想接縫研究幾何容許與實際水密試驗的差別。止水條依受控壓縮維持連續接觸，接縫轉角、錯台、污染與材料鬆弛都會降低最不利點的接觸能力。平均壓縮量不能掩蓋局部脫離；全尺寸試驗的結果只對測試過的幾何、水壓及荷載歷程有效，幾何餘量本身並不是接觸壓力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「止水壓縮餘量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Using documented connection and waterproofing context, a hypothetical joint distinguishes geometric allowance from actual pressure-test performance. A gasket seals through controlled continuous compression; rotation, offset, contamination and relaxation reduce contact at the weakest point. Average compression cannot compensate for local separation. Full-size test results apply only to their tested geometry, head and load history, while a calculated geometric reserve is neither contact pressure nor evidence of watertightness. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Gasket compression reserve” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：初始壓縮=19 mm；張開量=4 mm；幾何公差=2 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: initial compression=19 mm; opening=4 mm; tolerance=2 mm. c_res=c0−opening−tolerance=13 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「接縫平均寬度合格就不必量測局部錯台及扭轉。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An acceptable average joint width makes local offset and twist measurements unnecessary." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「止水壓縮餘量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Gasket compression reserve”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

A gasket seals through controlled continuous compression; rotation, offset, contamination and relaxation reduce contact at the weakest point.

knowledge.text: 誤解：接縫平均寬度合格就不必量測局部錯台及扭轉。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「接頭壓縮與水密包絡」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 大林組記載接合與防水措施，本課以假想接縫研究幾何容許與實際水密試驗的差別。

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「止水壓縮餘量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Gasket compression reserve” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：初始壓縮=19 mm；張開量=4 mm；幾何公差=2 mm。c_res=c0−opening−tolerance=13 mm。僅把張開量增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為12.6 mm。邊界：單向幾何餘量，不是接觸壓或水密合格證明；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: initial compression=19 mm; opening=4 mm; tolerance=2 mm. c_res=c0−opening−tolerance=13 mm. Increasing only opening by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 12.6 mm. Boundary: One-direction geometric reserve, not contact pressure or proof of watertightness. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將錯台、張開和水壓組合試驗與現場幾何配對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Match combined offset, opening and pressure tests with field geometry.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「止水壓縮餘量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Gasket compression reserve” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將錯台、張開和水壓組合試驗與現場幾何配對。全尺寸接頭試驗分別改變張開、錯台與外水壓，記錄漏水起點與卸載後殘餘位移，對照材料批次及溫度。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Match combined offset, opening and pressure tests with field geometry. Vary opening, offset and pressure in full-size joint tests, recording leakage onset and residual movement against material batch and temperature. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「止水壓縮餘量」的交付需回答：將錯台、張開和水壓組合試驗與現場幾何配對。保存接縫幾何與試驗壓力的配對紀錄，由設計者核定允收包絡；驗收時不能把課堂的幾何餘量當產品認證數字。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel, the gasket compression reserve handover must address the following evidence: Match combined offset, opening and pressure tests with field geometry. Retain paired joint geometry and test pressure, with the designer approving the acceptance envelope; classroom geometric reserves are not product certification values.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只查止水材料證明未必涵蓋現場接合位移組合。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Material certification alone may not cover the installed displacement combination. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「接頭壓縮與水密包絡」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Joint compression and sealing envelope"?
