knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「通風網路與壓力損失」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ventilation network and pressure loss" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 風量下降若只歸於風機老化會漏掉外風邊界改變。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
擴散長度就是鋼筋開始腐蝕的位置和精確時間。
optionsEn: Attributing reduced flow only to ageing fans misses changed external-wind boundaries.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Diffusion length gives the exact location and time of corrosion initiation.
quiz.explanation: 風量下降若只歸於風機老化會漏掉外風邊界改變。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Attributing reduced flow only to ageing fans misses changed external-wind boundaries. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Chloride transport and durability interpretation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「擴散特徵長度」如何影響東京灣跨海公路隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Diffusion characteristic length” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 海上人工島與孔內環片暴露環境不同，Aqua-Line耐久教學分開鹽霧、海水與乾燥設備區。海水或除冰鹽可提供氯離子，材料孔隙與裂縫控制其傳輸；鋼筋腐蝕還需要局部電化學條件。平方根擴散長度僅顯示時間尺度，並不是腐蝕門檻深度；表面濃度變化、乾濕循環、結合效應及施工裂縫須另行辨識。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「擴散特徵長度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate salt spray, seawater and dry equipment zones because artificial islands and tunnel segments have different exposure environments. Seawater or deicing salt supplies chloride, while pores and cracks govern transport; reinforcement corrosion also depends on local electrochemical conditions. A square-root diffusion length indicates a time scale, not a corrosion-threshold depth. Surface concentration, wetting cycles, binding and construction cracks must be distinguished rather than hidden in one fitted diffusivity. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Diffusion characteristic length” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：擴散係數=2e-12 m²/s；暴露時間=19 year。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: diffusivity=2e-12 m²/s; exposure=19 year. ℓ=√(Dt); 1 year=365.25×86400 s; m→mm ×1000=34.6293 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「擴散長度就是鋼筋開始腐蝕的位置和精確時間。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Diffusion length gives the exact location and time of corrosion initiation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「擴散特徵長度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Diffusion characteristic length”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀
knowledge.text: 海上人工島與孔內環片暴露環境不同，Aqua-Line耐久教學分開鹽霧、海水與乾燥設備區。海水或除冰鹽可提供氯離子，材料孔隙與裂縫控制其傳輸；鋼筋腐蝕還需要局部電化學條件。
knowledge.textEn: Separate salt spray, seawater and dry equipment zones because artificial islands and tunnel segments have different exposure environments. Seawater or deicing salt supplies chloride, while pores and cracks govern transport; reinforcement corrosion also depends on local electrochemical conditions.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：擴散長度就是鋼筋開始腐蝕的位置和精確時間。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Diffusion length gives the exact location and time of corrosion initiation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Chloride transport and durability interpretation" is correct?
options: 擴散長度就是鋼筋開始腐蝕的位置和精確時間。
海上人工島與孔內環片暴露環境不同，Aqua-Line耐久教學分開鹽霧、海水與乾燥設備區。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Diffusion length gives the exact location and time of corrosion initiation.
Separate salt spray, seawater and dry equipment zones because artificial islands and tunnel segments have different exposure environments.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 海上人工島與孔內環片暴露環境不同，Aqua-Line耐久教學分開鹽霧、海水與乾燥設備區。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Separate salt spray, seawater and dry equipment zones because artificial islands and tunnel segments have different exposure environments. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Chloride transport and durability interpretation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「擴散特徵長度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Diffusion characteristic length” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：擴散係數=2e-12 m²/s；暴露時間=19 year。ℓ=√(Dt); 1 year=365.25×86400 s; m→mm ×1000=34.6293 mm。僅把暴露時間增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為36.3195 mm。邊界：特徵長度，不是腐蝕起始壽命或氯鹽門檻深度；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: diffusivity=2e-12 m²/s; exposure=19 year. ℓ=√(Dt); 1 year=365.25×86400 s; m→mm ×1000=34.6293 mm. Increasing only exposure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 36.3195 mm. Boundary: Characteristic length, not corrosion-initiation life or chloride-threshold depth. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：按暴露區取樣，核對材料、裂縫及保護層深度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Sample by exposure zone and check material, cracking and cover depth.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：擴散係數=2e-12 m²/s；暴露時間=19 year。ℓ=√(Dt); 1 year=365.25×86400 s; m→mm ×1000=34.6293 mm。僅把暴露時間增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為36.3195 mm。邊界：特徵長度，不是腐蝕起始壽命或氯鹽門檻深度；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: diffusivity=2e-12 m²/s; exposure=19 year. ℓ=√(Dt); 1 year=365.25×86400 s; m→mm ×1000=34.6293 mm. Increasing only exposure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 36.3195 mm. Boundary: Characteristic length, not corrosion-initiation life or chloride-threshold depth. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Chloride transport and durability interpretation", which statement holds?
options: 刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
原創教學假設：擴散係數=2e-12 m²/s；暴露時間=19 year。
optionsEn: A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
Original teaching assumptions: diffusivity=2e-12 m²/s; exposure=19 year. ℓ=√(Dt); 1 year=365.25×86400 s; m→mm ×1000=34.6293 mm.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：擴散係數=2e-12 m²/s；暴露時間=19 year。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: diffusivity=2e-12 m²/s; exposure=19 year. ℓ=√(Dt); 1 year=365.25×86400 s; m→mm ×1000=34.6293 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Chloride transport and durability interpretation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「擴散特徵長度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Diffusion characteristic length” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 按暴露區取樣，核對材料、裂縫及保護層深度。以分層取樣的氯鹽剖面配合裂縫圖與電位量測，檢查擴散模型是否只適用未開裂材料。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Sample by exposure zone and check material, cracking and cover depth. Combine depth-resolved chloride samples with crack maps and potential measurements, checking whether the diffusion model applies only to uncracked material. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「擴散特徵長度」的交付需回答：按暴露區取樣，核對材料、裂縫及保護層深度。保留取樣深度、含水狀態及材料批次，用多種證據解釋劣化；維修優先序依構件功能與實際病害制定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel, the diffusion characteristic length handover must address the following evidence: Sample by exposure zone and check material, cracking and cover depth. Retain sample depth, moisture and material batches and interpret deterioration using multiple evidence types; prioritise repairs by function and observed defects.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：混合取樣平均值會掩蓋高鹽濕區的局部劣化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A mixed-sample average conceals local deterioration in wet saline zones. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 按暴露區取樣，核對材料、裂縫及保護層深度。以分層取樣的氯鹽剖面配合裂縫圖與電位量測，檢查擴散模型是否只適用未開裂材料。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Sample by exposure zone and check material, cracking and cover depth. Combine depth-resolved chloride samples with crack maps and potential measurements, checking whether the diffusion model applies only to uncracked material. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「擴散特徵長度」的交付需回答：按暴露區取樣，核對材料、裂縫及保護層深度。保留取樣深度、含水狀態及材料批次，用多種證據解釋劣化；維修優先序依構件功能與實際病害制定。
knowledge.textEn: For Tokyo Bay Aqua-Line tunnel, the diffusion characteristic length handover must address the following evidence: Sample by exposure zone and check material, cracking and cover depth. Retain sample depth, moisture and material batches and interpret deterioration using multiple evidence types; prioritise repairs by function and observed defects.

quiz.question: 要驗證「氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Chloride transport and durability interpretation"?
options: 按暴露區取樣，核對材料、裂縫及保護層深度。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
optionsEn: Sample by exposure zone and check material, cracking and cover depth.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
quiz.explanation: 按暴露區取樣，核對材料、裂縫及保護層深度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Sample by exposure zone and check material, cracking and cover depth. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Chloride transport and durability interpretation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「擴散特徵長度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Diffusion characteristic length” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 混合取樣平均值會掩蓋高鹽濕區的局部劣化。把一次電位讀值當腐蝕速率會誤判剩餘壽命，裂縫快速傳輸也可能被平均材料係數掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A mixed-sample average conceals local deterioration in wet saline zones. Treating one potential reading as corrosion rate misjudges remaining life, while averaged material coefficients conceal rapid crack transport. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：平方根擴散長度僅顯示時間尺度，並不是腐蝕門檻深度；表面濃度變化、乾濕循環、結合效應及施工裂縫須另行辨識。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Surface concentration, wetting cycles, binding and construction cracks must be distinguished rather than hidden in one fitted diffusivity.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「擴散長度就是鋼筋開始腐蝕的位置和精確時間。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Diffusion length gives the exact location and time of corrosion initiation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 混合取樣平均值會掩蓋高鹽濕區的局部劣化。把一次電位讀值當腐蝕速率會誤判剩餘壽命，裂縫快速傳輸也可能被平均材料係數掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: A mixed-sample average conceals local deterioration in wet saline zones. Treating one potential reading as corrosion rate misjudges remaining life, while averaged material coefficients conceal rapid crack transport.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Chloride transport and durability interpretation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
混合取樣平均值會掩蓋高鹽濕區的局部劣化。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A mixed-sample average conceals local deterioration in wet saline zones.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 混合取樣平均值會掩蓋高鹽濕區的局部劣化。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A mixed-sample average conceals local deterioration in wet saline zones. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 拉爾達隧道
summary: 拉爾達隧道官方列長24.5公里，於2000年11月開通；同一官方頁也說明後續更新工程。本課將原始營運與更新情境分開，從長距離行車視覺、岩體應力、通風及水量出發，追蹤夜間工程窗口和恢復營運的證據需求，避免以景觀照明取代完整系統評估。
summaryEn: The road authority reports Laerdal as 24.5 km long and opened in November 2000, while also describing later upgrades. This course separates original service from renewal scenarios, following driver vision, rock stress, ventilation and water into night-work windows and evidence for restoring service. Decorative lighting is not treated as a substitute for system assessment.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創綜合審查：先計算「覆土應力與洞壁重分配」，再獨立計算「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」。原創教學假設：覆土深度=800 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。σθ,max=3γH/1000=62.4 MPa。僅把覆土深度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為68.64 MPa。邊界：無支承彈性圓孔，僅垂直遠場壓縮且水平遠場應力為零時，側壁最大環向壓應力；不是任意位置應力或完整三維原位解；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=75 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=735.75 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為809.325 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated review: first calculate cover stress and wall redistribution, then independently calculate piezometric head and lining pressure. Original teaching assumptions: cover=800 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=62.4 MPa. Increasing only cover by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 68.64 MPa. Boundary: Maximum tangential compression at the sidewalls of an unsupported elastic circular hole under vertical uniaxial remote loading with zero horizontal remote stress; not stress at any point or the complete three-dimensional in-situ state. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=75 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=735.75 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 809.325 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「服務邊界與路線代價」與「覆土應力與洞壁重分配」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Service boundaries and alignment cost" and "Cover stress and wall redistribution": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「路線里程與端點」如何影響拉爾達隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Alignment chainage and endpoints” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Laerdal Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 拉爾達長距離道路的需求包含冬季連通與維修繞行，不能只以自由車流穿越時間代表整體服務。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「路線里程與端點」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A long road crossing serves continuity and maintenance diversion as well as free-flow travel; journey time alone does not capture the service. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk. Compare options between identical endpoints and distinguish running bores, approaches and service galleries. Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Alignment chainage and endpoints” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：長度=16 km；速度=60 km/h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: length=16 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=16 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「路線里程與端點」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Alignment chainage and endpoints”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 服務邊界與路線代價
knowledge.text: 拉爾達長距離道路的需求包含冬季連通與維修繞行，不能只以自由車流穿越時間代表整體服務。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。
knowledge.textEn: A long road crossing serves continuity and maintenance diversion as well as free-flow travel; journey time alone does not capture the service. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「服務邊界與路線代價」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Service boundaries and alignment cost" is correct?
options: 最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
拉爾達長距離道路的需求包含冬季連通與維修繞行，不能只以自由車流穿越時間代表整體服務。
知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。
optionsEn: The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
A long road crossing serves continuity and maintenance diversion as well as free-flow travel; journey time alone does not capture the service.
Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction.
quiz.explanation: 拉爾達長距離道路的需求包含冬季連通與維修繞行，不能只以自由車流穿越時間代表整體服務。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A long road crossing serves continuity and maintenance diversion as well as free-flow travel; journey time alone does not capture the service. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「路線里程與端點」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Alignment chainage and endpoints” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：長度=16 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=16 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為17.6 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: length=16 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=16 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 17.6 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較相同端點的正常、封閉及替代路線假設。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare normal, closed and diversion cases between identical endpoints.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：長度=16 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=16 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為17.6 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: length=16 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=16 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 17.6 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「服務邊界與路線代價」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Service boundaries and alignment cost", which statement holds?
options: 照度越高就必然使隧道內所有物體更容易辨識。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
原創教學假設：長度=16 km；速度=60 km/h。
optionsEn: Higher illuminance necessarily makes every tunnel object easier to detect.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Original teaching assumptions: length=16 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=16 min.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：長度=16 km；速度=60 km/h。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: length=16 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=16 min. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「路線里程與端點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Alignment chainage and endpoints” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較相同端點的正常、封閉及替代路線假設。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare normal, closed and diversion cases between identical endpoints. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：比較相同端點的正常、封閉及替代路線假設。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Laerdal Tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Compare normal, closed and diversion cases between identical endpoints. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略封閉時替代路線會低估更新工程對使用者的影響。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitting the diversion understates the user impact of renewal closures. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較相同端點的正常、封閉及替代路線假設。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Compare normal, closed and diversion cases between identical endpoints. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：比較相同端點的正常、封閉及替代路線假設。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。
knowledge.textEn: For Laerdal Tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Compare normal, closed and diversion cases between identical endpoints. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.

quiz.question: 要驗證「服務邊界與路線代價」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Service boundaries and alignment cost"?
options: 比較相同端點的正常、封閉及替代路線假設。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
optionsEn: Compare normal, closed and diversion cases between identical endpoints.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
quiz.explanation: 比較相同端點的正常、封閉及替代路線假設。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare normal, closed and diversion cases between identical endpoints. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「路線里程與端點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Alignment chainage and endpoints” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略封閉時替代路線會低估更新工程對使用者的影響。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitting the diversion understates the user impact of renewal closures. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忽略封閉時替代路線會低估更新工程對使用者的影響。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。
knowledge.textEn: Omitting the diversion understates the user impact of renewal closures. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「服務邊界與路線代價」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Service boundaries and alignment cost" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
忽略封閉時替代路線會低估更新工程對使用者的影響。
知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Omitting the diversion understates the user impact of renewal closures.
Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction.
quiz.explanation: 忽略封閉時替代路線會低估更新工程對使用者的影響。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Omitting the diversion understates the user impact of renewal closures. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 覆土應力與洞壁重分配：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cover stress and wall redistribution: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「洞壁切向應力」如何影響拉爾達隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tangential wall stress” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Laerdal Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 官方更新頁指出岩體高應力使施工具挑戰，本課研究既有洞壁再擾動與新開挖的應力差異。開挖使岩體洞壁失去徑向拘束，遠場荷載轉移到周圍岩體，局部切向應力可能升高。圓孔彈性解可辨識量級，但節理、非圓斷面、塑性區與原位應力比會改變峰值位置，不能只用覆土重量推定全部三維應力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「洞壁切向應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The authority identifies high rock stress as a renewal challenge; examine differences between disturbing an existing wall and making a new opening. Excavation removes radial confinement at the wall and transfers load through the surrounding rock, potentially raising local tangential stress. An elastic circular-hole solution identifies scale, but joints, noncircular geometry, yielding and the in-situ stress ratio alter the peak location. Cover weight alone cannot establish the complete three-dimensional stress state or support demand. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Tangential wall stress” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：覆土深度=800 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: cover=800 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=62.4 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「洞壁切向應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Tangential wall stress”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 覆土應力與洞壁重分配
knowledge.text: 官方更新頁指出岩體高應力使施工具挑戰，本課研究既有洞壁再擾動與新開挖的應力差異。開挖使岩體洞壁失去徑向拘束，遠場荷載轉移到周圍岩體，局部切向應力可能升高。
knowledge.textEn: The authority identifies high rock stress as a renewal challenge; examine differences between disturbing an existing wall and making a new opening. Excavation removes radial confinement at the wall and transfers load through the surrounding rock, potentially raising local tangential stress.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「覆土應力與洞壁重分配」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cover stress and wall redistribution" is correct?
options: 知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
官方更新頁指出岩體高應力使施工具挑戰，本課研究既有洞壁再擾動與新開挖的應力差異。
optionsEn: Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction.
Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
The authority identifies high rock stress as a renewal challenge; examine differences between disturbing an existing wall and making a new opening.
quiz.explanation: 官方更新頁指出岩體高應力使施工具挑戰，本課研究既有洞壁再擾動與新開挖的應力差異。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The authority identifies high rock stress as a renewal challenge; examine differences between disturbing an existing wall and making a new opening. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 覆土應力與洞壁重分配：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cover stress and wall redistribution: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「洞壁切向應力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tangential wall stress” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：覆土深度=800 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。σθ,max=3γH/1000=62.4 MPa。僅把覆土深度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為68.64 MPa。邊界：無支承彈性圓孔，僅垂直遠場壓縮且水平遠場應力為零時，側壁最大環向壓應力；不是任意位置應力或完整三維原位解；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: cover=800 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=62.4 MPa. Increasing only cover by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 68.64 MPa. Boundary: Maximum tangential compression at the sidewalls of an unsupported elastic circular hole under vertical uniaxial remote loading with zero horizontal remote stress; not stress at any point or the complete three-dimensional in-situ state. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將舊剝落圖與新施工位移對齊，辨識局部擾動範圍。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align old spalling maps and new movement to identify local disturbance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：覆土深度=800 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。σθ,max=3γH/1000=62.4 MPa。僅把覆土深度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為68.64 MPa。邊界：無支承彈性圓孔，僅垂直遠場壓縮且水平遠場應力為零時，側壁最大環向壓應力；不是任意位置應力或完整三維原位解；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: cover=800 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=62.4 MPa. Increasing only cover by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 68.64 MPa. Boundary: Maximum tangential compression at the sidewalls of an unsupported elastic circular hole under vertical uniaxial remote loading with zero horizontal remote stress; not stress at any point or the complete three-dimensional in-situ state. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「覆土應力與洞壁重分配」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cover stress and wall redistribution", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：覆土深度=800 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: cover=800 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=62.4 MPa.
Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：覆土深度=800 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: cover=800 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=62.4 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 覆土應力與洞壁重分配：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cover stress and wall redistribution: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「洞壁切向應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tangential wall stress” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將舊剝落圖與新施工位移對齊，辨識局部擾動範圍。將原位應力量測、岩石試驗及洞壁破壞方位相互比較，再用多點伸長計檢查變形是否與所假設應力方向一致。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align old spalling maps and new movement to identify local disturbance. Compare in-situ stress measurements, rock tests and wall-damage orientation, then use multipoint extensometers to test consistency with the assumed stress directions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「洞壁切向應力」的交付需回答：將舊剝落圖與新施工位移對齊，辨識局部擾動範圍。保留應力模型的座標、邊界和材料假設，量測與預測不符時先核對代表性，再由岩力設計者選擇非線性或節理模型。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Laerdal Tunnel, the tangential wall stress handover must address the following evidence: Align old spalling maps and new movement to identify local disturbance. Record stress-model coordinates, boundaries and material assumptions; when observations disagree, check representativeness before the rock designer selects nonlinear or jointed models.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：舊洞已存在多年不代表局部再開挖不會重分配應力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Long-standing excavation does not prevent stress redistribution from local new work. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將舊剝落圖與新施工位移對齊，辨識局部擾動範圍。將原位應力量測、岩石試驗及洞壁破壞方位相互比較，再用多點伸長計檢查變形是否與所假設應力方向一致。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Align old spalling maps and new movement to identify local disturbance. Compare in-situ stress measurements, rock tests and wall-damage orientation, then use multipoint extensometers to test consistency with the assumed stress directions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「洞壁切向應力」的交付需回答：將舊剝落圖與新施工位移對齊，辨識局部擾動範圍。保留應力模型的座標、邊界和材料假設，量測與預測不符時先核對代表性，再由岩力設計者選擇非線性或節理模型。
knowledge.textEn: For Laerdal Tunnel, the tangential wall stress handover must address the following evidence: Align old spalling maps and new movement to identify local disturbance. Record stress-model coordinates, boundaries and material assumptions; when observations disagree, check representativeness before the rock designer selects nonlinear or jointed models.

quiz.question: 要驗證「覆土應力與洞壁重分配」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cover stress and wall redistribution"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
將舊剝落圖與新施工位移對齊，辨識局部擾動範圍。
設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Align old spalling maps and new movement to identify local disturbance.
Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
quiz.explanation: 將舊剝落圖與新施工位移對齊，辨識局部擾動範圍。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Align old spalling maps and new movement to identify local disturbance. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 覆土應力與洞壁重分配：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cover stress and wall redistribution: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「洞壁切向應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tangential wall stress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 舊洞已存在多年不代表局部再開挖不會重分配應力。把彈性峰值直接當岩體強度可能誤判支護需求；相反地忽略剝落或擠壓也會讓局部破壞逐步侵入淨空。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Long-standing excavation does not prevent stress redistribution from local new work. Equating an elastic peak with rock-mass strength misjudges support demand; overlooking spalling or squeezing lets damage progressively consume clearance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：圓孔彈性解可辨識量級，但節理、非圓斷面、塑性區與原位應力比會改變峰值位置，不能只用覆土重量推定全部三維應力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Cover weight alone cannot establish the complete three-dimensional stress state or support demand.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 舊洞已存在多年不代表局部再開挖不會重分配應力。把彈性峰值直接當岩體強度可能誤判支護需求；相反地忽略剝落或擠壓也會讓局部破壞逐步侵入淨空。
knowledge.textEn: Long-standing excavation does not prevent stress redistribution from local new work. Equating an elastic peak with rock-mass strength misjudges support demand; overlooking spalling or squeezing lets damage progressively consume clearance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「覆土應力與洞壁重分配」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cover stress and wall redistribution" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
舊洞已存在多年不代表局部再開挖不會重分配應力。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
Long-standing excavation does not prevent stress redistribution from local new work.
quiz.explanation: 舊洞已存在多年不代表局部再開挖不會重分配應力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Long-standing excavation does not prevent stress redistribution from local new work. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「支護啟動與變形容量」與「視覺適應與路面亮度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Support activation and deformation capacity" and "Visual adaptation and pavement luminance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「支護安裝時點」如何影響拉爾達隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Support activation time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Laerdal Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在營運多年後更新支護的教學情境中，分開原支護劣化、新錨固啟動和施工卸載。支護荷載由開挖釋放量和支護啟動時間共同決定，越早安裝不一定讓構件受力越小。地盤反力與支護曲線必須連同掌子面距離及封閉順序理解；擠壓性地層還需保留變形容量，不能只追求高剛度與高材料強度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「支護安裝時點」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate deterioration of old support, activation of new anchors and construction unloading during hypothetical renewal. Support load depends on stress release and activation time, so earlier installation does not necessarily reduce member forces. Interpret ground-reaction and support curves together with distance from the face and closure sequence. Squeezing ground also needs deformation capacity; high stiffness and material strength alone do not guarantee a compatible support response. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Support activation time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：局部剛度=40 kN/mm；位移=7 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=40 kN/mm; movement=7 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「支護安裝時點」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Support activation time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 支護啟動與變形容量
knowledge.text: 在營運多年後更新支護的教學情境中，分開原支護劣化、新錨固啟動和施工卸載。支護荷載由開挖釋放量和支護啟動時間共同決定，越早安裝不一定讓構件受力越小。
knowledge.textEn: Separate deterioration of old support, activation of new anchors and construction unloading during hypothetical renewal. Support load depends on stress release and activation time, so earlier installation does not necessarily reduce member forces.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「支護啟動與變形容量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Support activation and deformation capacity" is correct?
options: 在營運多年後更新支護的教學情境中，分開原支護劣化、新錨固啟動和施工卸載。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
照度越高就必然使隧道內所有物體更容易辨識。
optionsEn: Separate deterioration of old support, activation of new anchors and construction unloading during hypothetical renewal.
Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
Higher illuminance necessarily makes every tunnel object easier to detect.
quiz.explanation: 在營運多年後更新支護的教學情境中，分開原支護劣化、新錨固啟動和施工卸載。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Separate deterioration of old support, activation of new anchors and construction unloading during hypothetical renewal. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「支護安裝時點」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Support activation time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：局部剛度=40 kN/mm；位移=7 mm。F=ku=280 kN。僅把位移增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為308 kN。邊界：線性局部彈簧，不含屈服或時間效應；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=40 kN/mm; movement=7 mm. F=ku=280 kN. Increasing only movement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 308 kN. Boundary: Local linear spring without yielding or time effects. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測基線先於拆換建立，並記錄每一支護改動。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Establish the baseline before replacement and record every support change.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：局部剛度=40 kN/mm；位移=7 mm。F=ku=280 kN。僅把位移增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為308 kN。邊界：線性局部彈簧，不含屈服或時間效應；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=40 kN/mm; movement=7 mm. F=ku=280 kN. Increasing only movement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 308 kN. Boundary: Local linear spring without yielding or time effects. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「支護啟動與變形容量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Support activation and deformation capacity", which statement holds?
options: 目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
原創教學假設：局部剛度=40 kN/mm；位移=7 mm。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
optionsEn: No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=40 kN/mm; movement=7 mm.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：局部剛度=40 kN/mm；位移=7 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=40 kN/mm; movement=7 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「支護安裝時點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Support activation time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測基線先於拆換建立，並記錄每一支護改動。同步記錄收斂、支護荷重與安裝里程，比較同一地質分區內的速率及荷載，不將不同開挖齡期讀值直接混合。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Establish the baseline before replacement and record every support change. Synchronise convergence, support loads and installation chainage; compare rates and loads within one ground domain without mixing readings at different excavation ages. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「支護安裝時點」的交付需回答：量測基線先於拆換建立，並記錄每一支護改動。把安裝時間和量測資料一起交付支護設計者，任何級別變更都需地質及位移證據，不能憑單一瞬間讀值自行改支護。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Laerdal Tunnel, the support activation time handover must address the following evidence: Establish the baseline before replacement and record every support change. Submit installation times with measurements to the support designer; class changes need both ground and movement evidence, not an isolated instantaneous reading.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：拆換造成的位移若誤歸自然岩體變形會影響後續選型。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Misattributing replacement movement to natural ground response misdirects later support selection. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Synchronise convergence, support loads and installation chainage; compare rates and loads within one ground domain without mixing readings at different excavation ages. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

quiz.question: 要驗證「支護啟動與變形容量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Support activation and deformation capacity"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
量測基線先於拆換建立，並記錄每一支護改動。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
Establish the baseline before replacement and record every support change.

quiz.explanationEn: Establish the baseline before replacement and record every support change. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「支護安裝時點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Support activation time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 拆換造成的位移若誤歸自然岩體變形會影響後續選型。過晚封閉會讓不可回復變形增加，過硬且行程不足的支護也可能脆裂，兩者都可能表現為裂縫而需不同處理。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Misattributing replacement movement to natural ground response misdirects later support selection. Late closure increases irreversible movement, while excessively stiff support with little travel can fail brittly; both produce cracks but require different diagnoses. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：地盤反力與支護曲線必須連同掌子面距離及封閉順序理解；擠壓性地層還需保留變形容量，不能只追求高剛度與高材料強度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Squeezing ground also needs deformation capacity; high stiffness and material strength alone do not guarantee a compatible support response.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 拆換造成的位移若誤歸自然岩體變形會影響後續選型。過晚封閉會讓不可回復變形增加，過硬且行程不足的支護也可能脆裂，兩者都可能表現為裂縫而需不同處理。
knowledge.textEn: Misattributing replacement movement to natural ground response misdirects later support selection. Late closure increases irreversible movement, while excessively stiff support with little travel can fail brittly; both produce cracks but require different diagnoses.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「支護啟動與變形容量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Support activation and deformation capacity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 拆換造成的位移若誤歸自然岩體變形會影響後續選型。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
照度越高就必然使隧道內所有物體更容易辨識。
optionsEn: Misattributing replacement movement to natural ground response misdirects later support selection.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Higher illuminance necessarily makes every tunnel object easier to detect.
quiz.explanation: 拆換造成的位移若誤歸自然岩體變形會影響後續選型。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Misattributing replacement movement to natural ground response misdirects later support selection. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 視覺適應與路面亮度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Visual adaptation and pavement luminance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「漫反射亮度」如何影響拉爾達隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Diffuse luminance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Laerdal Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 長隧道的視覺節奏與障礙辨識是不同任務，拉爾達教材檢查照明變化是否改變路面對比。駕駛從洞外進入洞內時視覺適應需要時間，照度並不等同從駕駛視角看到的亮度。路面反射、濕度、燈具配光及背景對比共同影響辨識；朗伯模型只示範理想漫反射，不能直接制定入口段燈具間距或真實道路安全值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「漫反射亮度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Visual rhythm and obstacle detection are distinct tasks; examine how lighting transitions affect pavement contrast over a long drive. Driver adaptation takes time when entering a tunnel, and illuminance is not the luminance seen from the driving position. Pavement reflection, wetness, luminaire distribution and background contrast affect detection. A Lambertian model illustrates ideal diffuse reflection only; it cannot establish entrance-zone spacing or actual road-safety limits without photometric and operational assessment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Diffuse luminance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：照度=100 lx；反射率=0.23 無因次。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: illuminance=100 lx; reflectance=0.23 dimensionless.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「照度越高就必然使隧道內所有物體更容易辨識。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Higher illuminance necessarily makes every tunnel object easier to detect." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「漫反射亮度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Diffuse luminance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Visual rhythm and obstacle detection are distinct tasks; examine how lighting transitions affect pavement contrast over a long drive. Driver adaptation takes time when entering a tunnel, and illuminance is not the luminance seen from the driving position.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：照度越高就必然使隧道內所有物體更容易辨識。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Higher illuminance necessarily makes every tunnel object easier to detect. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「視覺適應與路面亮度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Visual adaptation and pavement luminance" is correct?
options: 照度越高就必然使隧道內所有物體更容易辨識。
長隧道的視覺節奏與障礙辨識是不同任務，拉爾達教材檢查照明變化是否改變路面對比。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
optionsEn: Higher illuminance necessarily makes every tunnel object easier to detect.
Visual rhythm and obstacle detection are distinct tasks; examine how lighting transitions affect pavement contrast over a long drive.
Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 長隧道的視覺節奏與障礙辨識是不同任務，拉爾達教材檢查照明變化是否改變路面對比。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Visual rhythm and obstacle detection are distinct tasks; examine how lighting transitions affect pavement contrast over a long drive. The other options are common misconceptions.

設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。
原創教學假設：照度=100 lx；反射率=0.23 無因次。
