Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
Original teaching assumptions: illuminance=100 lx; reflectance=0.23 dimensionless.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：照度=100 lx；反射率=0.23 無因次。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: illuminance=100 lx; reflectance=0.23 dimensionless. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 視覺適應與路面亮度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Visual adaptation and pavement luminance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「漫反射亮度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Diffuse luminance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 從駕駛視角比較過渡區、一般區與濕路面。以駕駛視角的亮度量測配合照度網格，分別檢查乾濕路面與燈具衰減，保留外部天空條件。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare transition zones, ordinary reaches and wet surfaces from the driver viewpoint. Combine driver-view luminance with illuminance grids, checking dry and wet pavement and lamp depreciation while preserving exterior sky conditions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「漫反射亮度」的交付需回答：從駕駛視角比較過渡區、一般區與濕路面。將視角、路面狀態和光度校正連同量測交付，照明調整需按核准場景測試，不把理想反射公式當驗收標準。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Laerdal Tunnel, the diffuse luminance handover must address the following evidence: Compare transition zones, ordinary reaches and wet surfaces from the driver viewpoint. Hand over viewing geometry, pavement state and photometric calibration; test changes against approved scenarios rather than treating ideal reflection as an acceptance criterion.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：覺得明亮舒適不能證明所有障礙在不利背景可辨識。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Perceived brightness and comfort do not prove detection against adverse backgrounds. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 從駕駛視角比較過渡區、一般區與濕路面。以駕駛視角的亮度量測配合照度網格，分別檢查乾濕路面與燈具衰減，保留外部天空條件。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Compare transition zones, ordinary reaches and wet surfaces from the driver viewpoint. Combine driver-view luminance with illuminance grids, checking dry and wet pavement and lamp depreciation while preserving exterior sky conditions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「漫反射亮度」的交付需回答：從駕駛視角比較過渡區、一般區與濕路面。將視角、路面狀態和光度校正連同量測交付，照明調整需按核准場景測試，不把理想反射公式當驗收標準。
knowledge.textEn: For Laerdal Tunnel, the diffuse luminance handover must address the following evidence: Compare transition zones, ordinary reaches and wet surfaces from the driver viewpoint. Hand over viewing geometry, pavement state and photometric calibration; test changes against approved scenarios rather than treating ideal reflection as an acceptance criterion.

quiz.question: 要驗證「視覺適應與路面亮度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Visual adaptation and pavement luminance"?
options: 從駕駛視角比較過渡區、一般區與濕路面。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Compare transition zones, ordinary reaches and wet surfaces from the driver viewpoint.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 從駕駛視角比較過渡區、一般區與濕路面。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare transition zones, ordinary reaches and wet surfaces from the driver viewpoint. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 視覺適應與路面亮度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Visual adaptation and pavement luminance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「漫反射亮度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Diffuse luminance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 覺得明亮舒適不能證明所有障礙在不利背景可辨識。照度平均值合格仍可能存在低亮度障礙區或眩光，感測器沾污也會使調光系統低估外界亮度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Perceived brightness and comfort do not prove detection against adverse backgrounds. Acceptable average illuminance can coexist with dark obstacles or glare, while sensor contamination may bias adaptive lighting controls. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：路面反射、濕度、燈具配光及背景對比共同影響辨識；朗伯模型只示範理想漫反射，不能直接制定入口段燈具間距或真實道路安全值。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A Lambertian model illustrates ideal diffuse reflection only; it cannot establish entrance-zone spacing or actual road-safety limits without photometric and operational assessment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「照度越高就必然使隧道內所有物體更容易辨識。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Higher illuminance necessarily makes every tunnel object easier to detect." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 覺得明亮舒適不能證明所有障礙在不利背景可辨識。照度平均值合格仍可能存在低亮度障礙區或眩光，感測器沾污也會使調光系統低估外界亮度。
knowledge.textEn: Perceived brightness and comfort do not prove detection against adverse backgrounds. Acceptable average illuminance can coexist with dark obstacles or glare, while sensor contamination may bias adaptive lighting controls.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「視覺適應與路面亮度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Visual adaptation and pavement luminance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
覺得明亮舒適不能證明所有障礙在不利背景可辨識。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Perceived brightness and comfort do not prove detection against adverse backgrounds.
Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 覺得明亮舒適不能證明所有障礙在不利背景可辨識。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Perceived brightness and comfort do not prove detection against adverse backgrounds. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「通風網路與壓力損失」與「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ventilation network and pressure loss" and "Piezometric head and lining pressure": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「風道摩擦壓損」如何影響拉爾達隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Duct friction loss” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Laerdal Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 長道路通風需保留車流活塞效應與外風，研究夜間低車流時原有風量假設是否仍適用。風機提供壓差，實際風量由風道摩阻、局部損失、外風與其他風機共同決定。支路開關會重新分配整個網路，不能把額定風量直接加總；正常污染稀釋與火災控煙也有不同目標，需要分別建立受控邊界和故障情境。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「風道摩擦壓損」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Retain traffic piston effects and external wind, testing whether assumptions remain valid during low-traffic night work. Fans supply pressure, but actual flow follows friction, local losses, external wind and interactions with other fans. Switching a branch redistributes the network rather than simply adding rated flows. Routine dilution and fire smoke control have different objectives, so each needs explicit boundaries, operating states and failure cases rather than one universal flow target. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Duct friction loss” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=900 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.4 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=900 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.4 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=39.015 Pa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「風道摩擦壓損」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Duct friction loss”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 通風網路與壓力損失
knowledge.text: 長道路通風需保留車流活塞效應與外風，研究夜間低車流時原有風量假設是否仍適用。風機提供壓差，實際風量由風道摩阻、局部損失、外風與其他風機共同決定。
knowledge.textEn: Retain traffic piston effects and external wind, testing whether assumptions remain valid during low-traffic night work. Fans supply pressure, but actual flow follows friction, local losses, external wind and interactions with other fans.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「通風網路與壓力損失」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ventilation network and pressure loss" is correct?
options: 風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
長道路通風需保留車流活塞效應與外風，研究夜間低車流時原有風量假設是否仍適用。
optionsEn: Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Retain traffic piston effects and external wind, testing whether assumptions remain valid during low-traffic night work.
quiz.explanation: 長道路通風需保留車流活塞效應與外風，研究夜間低車流時原有風量假設是否仍適用。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Retain traffic piston effects and external wind, testing whether assumptions remain valid during low-traffic night work. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「風道摩擦壓損」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Duct friction loss” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=900 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.4 m/s。Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=39.015 Pa。僅把平均風速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為47.2082 Pa。邊界：定密度直管摩阻，局部損失及外風另計；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=900 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.4 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=39.015 Pa. Increasing only mean velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 47.2082 Pa. Boundary: Constant-density straight-duct friction; local loss and external wind are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較車流高低時段同風機設定下的風速與壓差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare flow and pressure at the same fan setting under high and low traffic.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=900 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.4 m/s。Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=39.015 Pa。僅把平均風速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為47.2082 Pa。邊界：定密度直管摩阻，局部損失及外風另計；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=900 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.4 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=39.015 Pa. Increasing only mean velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 47.2082 Pa. Boundary: Constant-density straight-duct friction; local loss and external wind are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「通風網路與壓力損失」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ventilation network and pressure loss", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=900 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.4 m/s。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=900 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.4 m/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=900 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.4 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=39.015 Pa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「風道摩擦壓損」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Duct friction loss” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較車流高低時段同風機設定下的風速與壓差。沿線同步量測靜壓與風速，記錄風門及其他風機狀態，再把實測工作點和風機曲線、網路壓損比較。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare flow and pressure at the same fan setting under high and low traffic. Measure pressure and velocity synchronously, record dampers and other fans, and compare the measured duty point with fan curves and network resistance. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「風道摩擦壓損」的交付需回答：比較車流高低時段同風機設定下的風速與壓差。驗收採明確風門和車流邊界，維修改線後重新核對網路工作點，火災模式由防災責任工程師簽認而非沿用正常模式。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Laerdal Tunnel, the duct friction loss handover must address the following evidence: Compare flow and pressure at the same fan setting under high and low traffic. Commission with specified damper and traffic boundaries, recheck duty points after rerouting, and have the fire-safety engineer approve emergency modes independently.

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「風道摩擦壓損」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Duct friction loss” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將白天交通助流套到夜間會高估施工區換氣。只看風機轉速會漏掉風門誤位或短路漏風，可能在總耗電增加時，真正需要的區段反而風量不足。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Transferring daytime traffic-assisted flow to night work overstates ventilation. Fan speed alone misses a misplaced damper or leakage shortcut; total power may rise while the critical section receives less air. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：支路開關會重新分配整個網路，不能把額定風量直接加總；正常污染稀釋與火災控煙也有不同目標，需要分別建立受控邊界和故障情境。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Routine dilution and fire smoke control have different objectives, so each needs explicit boundaries, operating states and failure cases rather than one universal flow target.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「測壓水頭」如何影響拉爾達隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Piezometric head” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Laerdal Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 拉爾達山區裂隙補注與道路排水在教學模型中分開，研究季節水量變化對設備更新安排的影響。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「測壓水頭」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate fracture recharge from road drainage and examine seasonal water effects on renewal planning. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level. Drainage reduces pressure but can increase effective stress and settlement. Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Piezometric head” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=75 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=75 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=735.75 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「測壓水頭」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Piezometric head”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「測壓水頭」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Piezometric head” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=75 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=735.75 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為809.325 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=75 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=735.75 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 809.325 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：按降雨與季節對照排水、水頭及堵塞紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare drainage, head and blockage records against rainfall and season.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「測壓水頭」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Piezometric head” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 融雪期增流若當設備故障，可能無效更換正常泵組。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating snowmelt inflow as equipment failure can prompt needless pump replacement. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 融雪期增流若當設備故障，可能無效更換正常泵組。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。
knowledge.textEn: Treating snowmelt inflow as equipment failure can prompt needless pump replacement. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Piezometric head and lining pressure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 融雪期增流若當設備故障，可能無效更換正常泵組。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
optionsEn: Treating snowmelt inflow as equipment failure can prompt needless pump replacement.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
quiz.explanation: 融雪期增流若當設備故障，可能無效更換正常泵組。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating snowmelt inflow as equipment failure can prompt needless pump replacement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」與「疏散時間與分區可用性」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Shared access and transport bottlenecks" and "Evacuation time and zone availability": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「出渣運輸節拍」如何影響拉爾達隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Muck-transport cycle” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Laerdal Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 官方描述夜間更新與通行安排，本課將施工準備、出渣及恢復檢查從可用窗口逐項扣除。多工作面只有在供電、通風、出渣與材料供應同步充足時才增加總產量。共用豎井或軌道形成串聯瓶頸，排隊和維修窗口會降低名目容量；緩衝區太大又可能侵占通行與救援空間，因此不能單純把各面產能相加。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「出渣運輸節拍」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: For night renewal, deduct preparation, spoil handling and restoration checks from the available access window. Multiple headings increase output only when power, air, muck transport and materials support them together. Shared shafts or railways become serial bottlenecks, while queues and maintenance reduce nominal capacity. Large buffers may obstruct personnel and rescue access, so face capacities cannot simply be added without a network-level transport and storage check. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Muck-transport cycle” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=30 t；往返週期=36 min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=30 t; cycle=36 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「出渣運輸節拍」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Muck-transport cycle”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸
knowledge.text: 官方描述夜間更新與通行安排，本課將施工準備、出渣及恢復檢查從可用窗口逐項扣除。多工作面只有在供電、通風、出渣與材料供應同步充足時才增加總產量。
knowledge.textEn: For night renewal, deduct preparation, spoil handling and restoration checks from the available access window. Multiple headings increase output only when power, air, muck transport and materials support them together.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Shared access and transport bottlenecks" is correct?
options: 增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
官方描述夜間更新與通行安排，本課將施工準備、出渣及恢復檢查從可用窗口逐項扣除。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
optionsEn: Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
For night renewal, deduct preparation, spoil handling and restoration checks from the available access window.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
quiz.explanation: 官方描述夜間更新與通行安排，本課將施工準備、出渣及恢復檢查從可用窗口逐項扣除。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: For night renewal, deduct preparation, spoil handling and restoration checks from the available access window. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「出渣運輸節拍」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Muck-transport cycle” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=30 t；往返週期=36 min。C=N payload 60/T=200 t/h。僅把往返週期增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為181.818 t/h。邊界：無排隊理想循環，並非共享路段實際產能；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=30 t; cycle=36 min. C=N payload 60/T=200 t/h. Increasing only cycle by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 181.818 t/h. Boundary: Ideal cycle without queues, not actual shared-route production. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：記錄首個工作面開始與最後恢復確認的時間戳。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record first productive work and final restoration sign-off timestamps.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=30 t；往返週期=36 min。C=N payload 60/T=200 t/h。僅把往返週期增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為181.818 t/h。邊界：無排隊理想循環，並非共享路段實際產能；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=30 t; cycle=36 min. C=N payload 60/T=200 t/h. Increasing only cycle by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 181.818 t/h. Boundary: Ideal cycle without queues, not actual shared-route production. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Shared access and transport bottlenecks", which statement holds?
options: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。
原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=30 t；往返週期=36 min。
optionsEn: Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction.
Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=30 t; cycle=36 min.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=30 t；往返週期=36 min。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=30 t; cycle=36 min. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「出渣運輸節拍」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Muck-transport cycle” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 記錄首個工作面開始與最後恢復確認的時間戳。以裝載質量、往返時間及排隊時間重建物流曲線，再核對緩衝占用、共用通道優先權與維修時段。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record first productive work and final restoration sign-off timestamps. Reconstruct flow from payload, round-trip and queue times, then check buffer occupancy, shared-route priorities and maintenance periods. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「出渣運輸節拍」的交付需回答：記錄首個工作面開始與最後恢復確認的時間戳。每日排程同時標示人員、材料和維修的占用時段，任何物流改線先檢查通風與應變通道，不能只看運量提升。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Laerdal Tunnel, the muck-transport cycle handover must address the following evidence: Record first productive work and final restoration sign-off timestamps. Schedules show personnel, materials and maintenance occupancy together; rerouting first checks ventilation and emergency access rather than only throughput gains.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以封閉總時長當有效施工時間會持續低估工期。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating full closure duration as productive time repeatedly understates programme length. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 記錄首個工作面開始與最後恢復確認的時間戳。以裝載質量、往返時間及排隊時間重建物流曲線，再核對緩衝占用、共用通道優先權與維修時段。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Record first productive work and final restoration sign-off timestamps. Reconstruct flow from payload, round-trip and queue times, then check buffer occupancy, shared-route priorities and maintenance periods. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「出渣運輸節拍」的交付需回答：記錄首個工作面開始與最後恢復確認的時間戳。每日排程同時標示人員、材料和維修的占用時段，任何物流改線先檢查通風與應變通道，不能只看運量提升。
knowledge.textEn: For Laerdal Tunnel, the muck-transport cycle handover must address the following evidence: Record first productive work and final restoration sign-off timestamps. Schedules show personnel, materials and maintenance occupancy together; rerouting first checks ventilation and emergency access rather than only throughput gains.

quiz.question: 要驗證「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Shared access and transport bottlenecks"?
options: 記錄首個工作面開始與最後恢復確認的時間戳。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
照度越高就必然使隧道內所有物體更容易辨識。
optionsEn: Record first productive work and final restoration sign-off timestamps.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Higher illuminance necessarily makes every tunnel object easier to detect.
quiz.explanation: 記錄首個工作面開始與最後恢復確認的時間戳。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record first productive work and final restoration sign-off timestamps. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「出渣運輸節拍」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

Treating an ideal cycle as constant all day misses passing delays and unloading blockages, stopping headings or pushing material into essential access space. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 以封閉總時長當有效施工時間會持續低估工期。把理想往返時間當全天常數會忽略交會等待與卸料堵塞，導致工作面停工或把材料堆入必要通道。

quiz.question: 在「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Shared access and transport bottlenecks" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
以封閉總時長當有效施工時間會持續低估工期。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Treating full closure duration as productive time repeatedly understates programme length.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
quiz.explanation: 以封閉總時長當有效施工時間會持續低估工期。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating full closure duration as productive time repeatedly understates programme length. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Evacuation time and zone availability: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「所需疏散時間」如何影響拉爾達隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Required evacuation time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Laerdal Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 長距離公路事故需要辨認行車者反應延遲與路線可用性，更新區域還會改變原有標示。疏散時間包含辨識、反應、移動及排隊，不只由出口距離決定。人員速度會受煙熱、能見度及行動能力影響，安全判斷還要比較可用安全時間；橫通道存在但門或鄰孔不可用時，圖上的最短路線不一定能作實際選擇。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「所需疏散時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Incident travel includes user response delay and route availability, while renewal zones can alter familiar signs. Evacuation includes detection, response, travel and queues, not merely distance to an exit. Smoke, visibility and mobility alter walking speed, while safety requires comparison with available safe time. A passage shown on a plan may be unusable because its door or receiving bore is unavailable, invalidating the nominal shortest route. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Required evacuation time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：前置時間=100 s；行走距離=340 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=100 s; travel distance=340 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「所需疏散時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Required evacuation time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性
knowledge.text: 長距離公路事故需要辨認行車者反應延遲與路線可用性，更新區域還會改變原有標示。疏散時間包含辨識、反應、移動及排隊，不只由出口距離決定。
knowledge.textEn: Incident travel includes user response delay and route availability, while renewal zones can alter familiar signs. Evacuation includes detection, response, travel and queues, not merely distance to an exit.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「疏散時間與分區可用性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Evacuation time and zone availability" is correct?
options: 只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。
長距離公路事故需要辨認行車者反應延遲與路線可用性，更新區域還會改變原有標示。
optionsEn: Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
Incident travel includes user response delay and route availability, while renewal zones can alter familiar signs.
quiz.explanation: 長距離公路事故需要辨認行車者反應延遲與路線可用性，更新區域還會改變原有標示。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Incident travel includes user response delay and route availability, while renewal zones can alter familiar signs. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Evacuation time and zone availability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「所需疏散時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Required evacuation time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：前置時間=100 s；行走距離=340 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。RSET=tpre+d/v=525 s。僅把行走距離增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為567.5 s。邊界：單群體固定速度，不含排隊煙熱及能力差異，不能單獨判安全；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=100 s; travel distance=340 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. RSET=tpre+d/v=525 s. Increasing only travel distance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 567.5 s. Boundary: One group at fixed speed without queues, smoke or mobility differences; not a safety conclusion. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：沿現行施工階段路徑走查，分列辨識和移動時間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Walk the current stage route and separate recognition from movement time.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：前置時間=100 s；行走距離=340 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。RSET=tpre+d/v=525 s。僅把行走距離增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為567.5 s。邊界：單群體固定速度，不含排隊煙熱及能力差異，不能單獨判安全；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=100 s; travel distance=340 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. RSET=tpre+d/v=525 s. Increasing only travel distance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 567.5 s. Boundary: One group at fixed speed without queues, smoke or mobility differences; not a safety conclusion. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「疏散時間與分區可用性」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Evacuation time and zone availability", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：前置時間=100 s；行走距離=340 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=100 s; travel distance=340 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：前置時間=100 s；行走距離=340 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=100 s; travel distance=340 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Evacuation time and zone availability: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「所需疏散時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Required evacuation time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 沿現行施工階段路徑走查，分列辨識和移動時間。以人流模擬或受控演練分辨前置時間、行走與門口排隊，核對每個出口接收區的可用狀態及通訊紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Walk the current stage route and separate recognition from movement time. Separate pre-movement, travel and doorway queues through simulation or controlled drills, checking receiving-zone availability and communication records for each exit. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「所需疏散時間」的交付需回答：沿現行施工階段路徑走查，分列辨識和移動時間。疏散模型保留人口、速度分布及出口狀態，演練改動由營運與防災責任者批准，教材算例不得當作現場指揮程序。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Laerdal Tunnel, the required evacuation time handover must address the following evidence: Walk the current stage route and separate recognition from movement time. Retain population, speed distribution and exit states; operations and fire-safety owners approve drill changes, and classroom calculations are not incident-command procedures.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只使用完工後地圖可能把人引入尚未恢復的區段。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A final-layout map can direct users into an unrestored section. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 沿現行施工階段路徑走查，分列辨識和移動時間。以人流模擬或受控演練分辨前置時間、行走與門口排隊，核對每個出口接收區的可用狀態及通訊紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Walk the current stage route and separate recognition from movement time. Separate pre-movement, travel and doorway queues through simulation or controlled drills, checking receiving-zone availability and communication records for each exit. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「所需疏散時間」的交付需回答：沿現行施工階段路徑走查，分列辨識和移動時間。疏散模型保留人口、速度分布及出口狀態，演練改動由營運與防災責任者批准，教材算例不得當作現場指揮程序。
knowledge.textEn: For Laerdal Tunnel, the required evacuation time handover must address the following evidence: Walk the current stage route and separate recognition from movement time. Retain population, speed distribution and exit states; operations and fire-safety owners approve drill changes, and classroom calculations are not incident-command procedures.

quiz.question: 要驗證「疏散時間與分區可用性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Evacuation time and zone availability"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
沿現行施工階段路徑走查，分列辨識和移動時間。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Walk the current stage route and separate recognition from movement time.
Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 沿現行施工階段路徑走查，分列辨識和移動時間。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Walk the current stage route and separate recognition from movement time. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Evacuation time and zone availability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「所需疏散時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Required evacuation time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只使用完工後地圖可能把人引入尚未恢復的區段。以最快成人速度套全部旅客會低估需求，若忽略接收孔受煙或車流影響，疏散可能移到另一個危險邊界。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A final-layout map can direct users into an unrestored section. Applying the fastest adult speed to everyone understates demand; overlooking smoke or traffic in the receiving bore can transfer evacuees into another hazard. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：人員速度會受煙熱、能見度及行動能力影響，安全判斷還要比較可用安全時間；橫通道存在但門或鄰孔不可用時，圖上的最短路線不一定能作實際選擇。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A passage shown on a plan may be unusable because its door or receiving bore is unavailable, invalidating the nominal shortest route.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只使用完工後地圖可能把人引入尚未恢復的區段。以最快成人速度套全部旅客會低估需求，若忽略接收孔受煙或車流影響，疏散可能移到另一個危險邊界。
knowledge.textEn: A final-layout map can direct users into an unrestored section. Applying the fastest adult speed to everyone understates demand; overlooking smoke or traffic in the receiving bore can transfer evacuees into another hazard.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「疏散時間與分區可用性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Evacuation time and zone availability" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。
只使用完工後地圖可能把人引入尚未恢復的區段。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
A final-layout map can direct users into an unrestored section.
quiz.explanation: 只使用完工後地圖可能把人引入尚未恢復的區段。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A final-layout map can direct users into an unrestored section. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「設備備援與共同失效」與「資產編碼與可追溯交接」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Equipment redundancy and common failure" and "Asset identity and traceable handover": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 設備備援與共同失效：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Equipment redundancy and common failure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「系統不可用率」如何影響拉爾達隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “System unavailability” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Laerdal Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 更新期間臨時電源與永久控制可能共用上游供電，研究切換成功與真正冗餘的差別。兩套設備只有在故障近似獨立且切換可靠時，並聯才顯著降低不可用率。共用配電、控制軟體、冷卻或受淹位置會把獨立假設破壞；維修停用也改變當下配置，因此可靠度模型必須明列共有資源和設備狀態，不能只數備用台數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「系統不可用率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Temporary power and permanent controls may share an upstream source; distinguish successful transfer from genuine redundancy. Parallel equipment sharply reduces unavailability only when failures are approximately independent and transfer works. Shared power, software, cooling or flood exposure breaks that assumption. Planned maintenance also changes the available configuration, so reliability models must identify shared resources and states rather than count spare units or multiply unsupported independent probabilities. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “System unavailability” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：單機不可用率=0.02 無因次。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: single-unit unavailability=0.02 dimensionless.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「系統不可用率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “System unavailability”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 設備備援與共同失效
knowledge.text: 更新期間臨時電源與永久控制可能共用上游供電，研究切換成功與真正冗餘的差別。兩套設備只有在故障近似獨立且切換可靠時，並聯才顯著降低不可用率。
knowledge.textEn: Temporary power and permanent controls may share an upstream source; distinguish successful transfer from genuine redundancy. Parallel equipment sharply reduces unavailability only when failures are approximately independent and transfer works.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「設備備援與共同失效」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Equipment redundancy and common failure" is correct?
options: 更新期間臨時電源與永久控制可能共用上游供電，研究切換成功與真正冗餘的差別。
設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
optionsEn: Temporary power and permanent controls may share an upstream source; distinguish successful transfer from genuine redundancy.
Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
quiz.explanation: 更新期間臨時電源與永久控制可能共用上游供電，研究切換成功與真正冗餘的差別。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Temporary power and permanent controls may share an upstream source; distinguish successful transfer from genuine redundancy. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 設備備援與共同失效：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Equipment redundancy and common failure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「系統不可用率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “System unavailability” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：單機不可用率=0.02 無因次。Uparallel=U²=0.0004 probability。僅把單機不可用率增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.000484 probability。邊界：完全獨立並聯與完美切換，不含共同失效；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: single-unit unavailability=0.02 dimensionless. Uparallel=U²=0.0004 probability. Increasing only single-unit unavailability by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.000484 probability. Boundary: Independent parallel units with perfect transfer, excluding common failures. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：追查每條電源到上游共同點並核對失電測試。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Trace feeds to shared upstream points and check outage tests.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：單機不可用率=0.02 無因次。Uparallel=U²=0.0004 probability。僅把單機不可用率增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.000484 probability。邊界：完全獨立並聯與完美切換，不含共同失效；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: single-unit unavailability=0.02 dimensionless. Uparallel=U²=0.0004 probability. Increasing only single-unit unavailability by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.000484 probability. Boundary: Independent parallel units with perfect transfer, excluding common failures. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「設備備援與共同失效」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Equipment redundancy and common failure", which statement holds?
options: 知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。
原創教學假設：單機不可用率=0.02 無因次。
照度越高就必然使隧道內所有物體更容易辨識。
optionsEn: Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction.
Original teaching assumptions: single-unit unavailability=0.02 dimensionless.
Higher illuminance necessarily makes every tunnel object easier to detect.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：單機不可用率=0.02 無因次。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: single-unit unavailability=0.02 dimensionless. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 設備備援與共同失效：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Equipment redundancy and common failure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「系統不可用率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “System unavailability” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 追查每條電源到上游共同點並核對失電測試。由設備清單畫出故障樹，將電源、控制及實體位置追到共同節點，並用事件及維修紀錄檢查獨立假設。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Trace feeds to shared upstream points and check outage tests. Build a fault tree from the asset list, trace power, control and location to shared nodes, and test independence against incident and maintenance records. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「系統不可用率」的交付需回答：追查每條電源到上游共同點並核對失電測試。維修計畫附當日可用配置與剩餘備援，任何共同資源更動同步更新故障樹，切換試驗由設備及營運團隊共同見證。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Laerdal Tunnel, the system unavailability handover must address the following evidence: Trace feeds to shared upstream points and check outage tests. Attach the actual configuration and remaining redundancy to maintenance plans, update fault trees after shared-resource changes, and witness transfer tests jointly.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：兩條電纜共用同一配電盤不能假設失效獨立。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Two cables on one board do not justify independent-failure assumptions. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 追查每條電源到上游共同點並核對失電測試。由設備清單畫出故障樹，將電源、控制及實體位置追到共同節點，並用事件及維修紀錄檢查獨立假設。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Trace feeds to shared upstream points and check outage tests. Build a fault tree from the asset list, trace power, control and location to shared nodes, and test independence against incident and maintenance records. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「系統不可用率」的交付需回答：追查每條電源到上游共同點並核對失電測試。維修計畫附當日可用配置與剩餘備援，任何共同資源更動同步更新故障樹，切換試驗由設備及營運團隊共同見證。
knowledge.textEn: For Laerdal Tunnel, the system unavailability handover must address the following evidence: Trace feeds to shared upstream points and check outage tests. Attach the actual configuration and remaining redundancy to maintenance plans, update fault trees after shared-resource changes, and witness transfer tests jointly.

quiz.question: 要驗證「設備備援與共同失效」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Equipment redundancy and common failure"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
追查每條電源到上游共同點並核對失電測試。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Trace feeds to shared upstream points and check outage tests.
quiz.explanation: 追查每條電源到上游共同點並核對失電測試。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Trace feeds to shared upstream points and check outage tests. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 設備備援與共同失效：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Equipment redundancy and common failure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「系統不可用率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “System unavailability” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 兩條電纜共用同一配電盤不能假設失效獨立。重複安裝卻共用單一供電可能在一次故障中全部停機，帳面可靠度很高但實際不可用時間沒有降低。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Two cables on one board do not justify independent-failure assumptions. Duplicated equipment on one supply can fail together in a single event, leaving actual downtime unchanged despite optimistic calculated reliability. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：共用配電、控制軟體、冷卻或受淹位置會把獨立假設破壞；維修停用也改變當下配置，因此可靠度模型必須明列共有資源和設備狀態，不能只數備用台數。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Planned maintenance also changes the available configuration, so reliability models must identify shared resources and states rather than count spare units or multiply unsupported independent probabilities.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 兩條電纜共用同一配電盤不能假設失效獨立。重複安裝卻共用單一供電可能在一次故障中全部停機，帳面可靠度很高但實際不可用時間沒有降低。
knowledge.textEn: Two cables on one board do not justify independent-failure assumptions. Duplicated equipment on one supply can fail together in a single event, leaving actual downtime unchanged despite optimistic calculated reliability.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「設備備援與共同失效」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Equipment redundancy and common failure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 兩條電纜共用同一配電盤不能假設失效獨立。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
optionsEn: Two cables on one board do not justify independent-failure assumptions.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
quiz.explanation: 兩條電纜共用同一配電盤不能假設失效獨立。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Two cables on one board do not justify independent-failure assumptions. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「資產資料完整度」如何影響拉爾達隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Asset-record completeness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Laerdal Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 拉爾達更新資料需保留舊新設備並存期間的狀態，避免竣工資料提前覆蓋仍在服務的舊系統。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「資產資料完整度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Maintain coexistence states during renewal so new as-built records do not overwrite still-operating legacy systems prematurely. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision. Drawings without change history cannot distinguish replacement from deterioration. Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Asset-record completeness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：設備總數=110 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=110 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=85.4545 %.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「資產資料完整度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Asset-record completeness”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接
knowledge.text: 拉爾達更新資料需保留舊新設備並存期間的狀態，避免竣工資料提前覆蓋仍在服務的舊系統。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。
knowledge.textEn: Maintain coexistence states during renewal so new as-built records do not overwrite still-operating legacy systems prematurely. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「資產編碼與可追溯交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Asset identity and traceable handover" is correct?
options: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
拉爾達更新資料需保留舊新設備並存期間的狀態，避免竣工資料提前覆蓋仍在服務的舊系統。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
Maintain coexistence states during renewal so new as-built records do not overwrite still-operating legacy systems prematurely.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 拉爾達更新資料需保留舊新設備並存期間的狀態，避免竣工資料提前覆蓋仍在服務的舊系統。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Maintain coexistence states during renewal so new as-built records do not overwrite still-operating legacy systems prematurely. The other options are common misconceptions.
