Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：抽查切換清單與現場實際在線設備一一對應。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。
knowledge.textEn: For Gotthard Road Tunnel, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Match the transfer register one-to-one with field assets actually online. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.

quiz.question: 要驗證「資產編碼與可追溯交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Asset identity and traceable handover"?
options: 抽查切換清單與現場實際在線設備一一對應。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
optionsEn: Match the transfer register one-to-one with field assets actually online.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
quiz.explanation: 抽查切換清單與現場實際在線設備一一對應。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Match the transfer register one-to-one with field assets actually online. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「資產資料完整度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Asset-record completeness” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 複製舊位址而未更新位置會造成告警定位錯孔。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Copied addresses with unchanged location data identify the wrong bore. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 複製舊位址而未更新位置會造成告警定位錯孔。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。
knowledge.textEn: Copied addresses with unchanged location data identify the wrong bore. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「資產編碼與可追溯交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Asset identity and traceable handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
複製舊位址而未更新位置會造成告警定位錯孔。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Copied addresses with unchanged location data identify the wrong bore.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 複製舊位址而未更新位置會造成告警定位錯孔。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Copied addresses with unchanged location data identify the wrong bore. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 聖伯納山隧道
summary: 聖伯納山隧道營運者列長5798公尺，並說明兩端高山入口與全天有人值守的控制室。1964年開通的背景使其適合學習既有公路隧道長期更新。本課將洞口氣候、雙向車流、通風、耐久及跨境資訊交接串成完整工程問題，避免把洞內性能與引道服務切割。
summaryEn: The operator describes a 5798 m tunnel with high-altitude portals and continuously staffed control rooms at both ends. Its 1964 opening provides a setting for long-term renewal of an existing road tunnel. The course connects portal climate, bidirectional traffic, ventilation, durability and cross-border information handover rather than isolating tunnel performance from approach service.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創綜合審查：先計算「通風網路與壓力損失」，再獨立計算「氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀」。原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=980 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.1 m/s。Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=35.3168 Pa。僅把平均風速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為42.7333 Pa。邊界：定密度直管摩阻，局部損失及外風另計；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：擴散係數=1e-12 m²/s；暴露時間=15 year。ℓ=√(Dt); 1 year=365.25×86400 s; m→mm ×1000=21.7569 mm。僅把暴露時間增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為22.8189 mm。邊界：特徵長度，不是腐蝕起始壽命或氯鹽門檻深度；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated review: first calculate ventilation network and pressure loss, then independently calculate chloride transport and durability interpretation. Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=980 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.1 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=35.3168 Pa. Increasing only mean velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 42.7333 Pa. Boundary: Constant-density straight-duct friction; local loss and external wind are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: diffusivity=1e-12 m²/s; exposure=15 year. ℓ=√(Dt); 1 year=365.25×86400 s; m→mm ×1000=21.7569 mm. Increasing only exposure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 22.8189 mm. Boundary: Characteristic length, not corrosion-initiation life or chloride-threshold depth. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「服務邊界與路線代價」與「通風網路與壓力損失」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Service boundaries and alignment cost" and "Ventilation network and pressure loss": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「路線里程與端點」如何影響聖伯納山隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Alignment chainage and endpoints” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Great St Bernard Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 聖伯納山洞口和覆蓋引道共同提供高山通行，教材將隧道長度與雪季接近路段分開比較。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「路線里程與端點」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Portals and covered approaches jointly provide alpine access; distinguish tunnel length from winter approach sections. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk. Compare options between identical endpoints and distinguish running bores, approaches and service galleries. Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Alignment chainage and endpoints” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：長度=16.8 km；速度=60 km/h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: length=16.8 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=16.8 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「路線里程與端點」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Alignment chainage and endpoints”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 服務邊界與路線代價
knowledge.text: 聖伯納山洞口和覆蓋引道共同提供高山通行，教材將隧道長度與雪季接近路段分開比較。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。
knowledge.textEn: Portals and covered approaches jointly provide alpine access; distinguish tunnel length from winter approach sections. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「服務邊界與路線代價」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Service boundaries and alignment cost" is correct?
options: 最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
聖伯納山洞口和覆蓋引道共同提供高山通行，教材將隧道長度與雪季接近路段分開比較。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
optionsEn: The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
Portals and covered approaches jointly provide alpine access; distinguish tunnel length from winter approach sections.
Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 聖伯納山洞口和覆蓋引道共同提供高山通行，教材將隧道長度與雪季接近路段分開比較。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Portals and covered approaches jointly provide alpine access; distinguish tunnel length from winter approach sections. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「路線里程與端點」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Alignment chainage and endpoints” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：長度=16.8 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=16.8 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為18.48 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: length=16.8 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=16.8 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 18.48 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對相同端點下的洞內、引道和等待時間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check tunnel, approach and waiting time between equal endpoints.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：長度=16.8 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=16.8 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為18.48 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: length=16.8 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=16.8 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 18.48 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「服務邊界與路線代價」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Service boundaries and alignment cost", which statement holds?
options: 混凝土抗壓強度合格就代表厚壁構件不會產生熱裂縫。
擴散長度就是鋼筋開始腐蝕的位置和精確時間。
原創教學假設：長度=16.8 km；速度=60 km/h。
optionsEn: Adequate compressive strength proves that thick concrete cannot develop thermal cracks.
Diffusion length gives the exact location and time of corrosion initiation.
Original teaching assumptions: length=16.8 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=16.8 min.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：長度=16.8 km；速度=60 km/h。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: length=16.8 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=16.8 min. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「路線里程與端點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Alignment chainage and endpoints” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對相同端點下的洞內、引道和等待時間。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check tunnel, approach and waiting time between equal endpoints. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：核對相同端點下的洞內、引道和等待時間。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Great St Bernard Tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Check tunnel, approach and waiting time between equal endpoints. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只評洞內時間會漏掉入口管制或引道封閉的服務中斷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: In-tunnel time omits service interruption at approach closures or entrance controls. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對相同端點下的洞內、引道和等待時間。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Check tunnel, approach and waiting time between equal endpoints. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：核對相同端點下的洞內、引道和等待時間。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。
knowledge.textEn: For Great St Bernard Tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Check tunnel, approach and waiting time between equal endpoints. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.

quiz.question: 要驗證「服務邊界與路線代價」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Service boundaries and alignment cost"?
options: 核對相同端點下的洞內、引道和等待時間。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
optionsEn: Check tunnel, approach and waiting time between equal endpoints.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
quiz.explanation: 核對相同端點下的洞內、引道和等待時間。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check tunnel, approach and waiting time between equal endpoints. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「路線里程與端點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Alignment chainage and endpoints” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只評洞內時間會漏掉入口管制或引道封閉的服務中斷。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: In-tunnel time omits service interruption at approach closures or entrance controls. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只評洞內時間會漏掉入口管制或引道封閉的服務中斷。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。
knowledge.textEn: In-tunnel time omits service interruption at approach closures or entrance controls. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「服務邊界與路線代價」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Service boundaries and alignment cost" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
只評洞內時間會漏掉入口管制或引道封閉的服務中斷。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
In-tunnel time omits service interruption at approach closures or entrance controls.
Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 只評洞內時間會漏掉入口管制或引道封閉的服務中斷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: In-tunnel time omits service interruption at approach closures or entrance controls. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「風道摩擦壓損」如何影響聖伯納山隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Duct friction loss” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Great St Bernard Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 兩端高程與氣象不同使自然壓差影響雙向隧道風流，研究相同風機設定下季節變化。風機提供壓差，實際風量由風道摩阻、局部損失、外風與其他風機共同決定。支路開關會重新分配整個網路，不能把額定風量直接加總；正常污染稀釋與火災控煙也有不同目標，需要分別建立受控邊界和故障情境。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「風道摩擦壓損」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Different portal elevations and weather create natural pressure differences in bidirectional operation, even with unchanged fan settings. Fans supply pressure, but actual flow follows friction, local losses, external wind and interactions with other fans. Switching a branch redistributes the network rather than simply adding rated flows. Routine dilution and fire smoke control have different objectives, so each needs explicit boundaries, operating states and failure cases rather than one universal flow target. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Duct friction loss” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=980 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.1 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=980 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.1 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=35.3168 Pa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「風道摩擦壓損」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Duct friction loss”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 通風網路與壓力損失
knowledge.text: 兩端高程與氣象不同使自然壓差影響雙向隧道風流，研究相同風機設定下季節變化。風機提供壓差，實際風量由風道摩阻、局部損失、外風與其他風機共同決定。
knowledge.textEn: Different portal elevations and weather create natural pressure differences in bidirectional operation, even with unchanged fan settings. Fans supply pressure, but actual flow follows friction, local losses, external wind and interactions with other fans.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「通風網路與壓力損失」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ventilation network and pressure loss" is correct?
options: 風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
照度越高就必然使隧道內所有物體更容易辨識。
兩端高程與氣象不同使自然壓差影響雙向隧道風流，研究相同風機設定下季節變化。
optionsEn: Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
Higher illuminance necessarily makes every tunnel object easier to detect.
Different portal elevations and weather create natural pressure differences in bidirectional operation, even with unchanged fan settings.
quiz.explanation: 兩端高程與氣象不同使自然壓差影響雙向隧道風流，研究相同風機設定下季節變化。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Different portal elevations and weather create natural pressure differences in bidirectional operation, even with unchanged fan settings. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「風道摩擦壓損」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Duct friction loss” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=980 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.1 m/s。Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=35.3168 Pa。僅把平均風速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為42.7333 Pa。邊界：定密度直管摩阻，局部損失及外風另計；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=980 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.1 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=35.3168 Pa. Increasing only mean velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 42.7333 Pa. Boundary: Constant-density straight-duct friction; local loss and external wind are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步量測兩端氣壓溫度與洞內風向。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronise portal pressure and temperature with internal airflow direction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=980 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.1 m/s。Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=35.3168 Pa。僅把平均風速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為42.7333 Pa。邊界：定密度直管摩阻，局部損失及外風另計；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=980 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.1 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=35.3168 Pa. Increasing only mean velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 42.7333 Pa. Boundary: Constant-density straight-duct friction; local loss and external wind are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「通風網路與壓力損失」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ventilation network and pressure loss", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=980 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.1 m/s。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=980 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.1 m/s。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「風道摩擦壓損」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Duct friction loss” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步量測兩端氣壓溫度與洞內風向。沿線同步量測靜壓與風速，記錄風門及其他風機狀態，再把實測工作點和風機曲線、網路壓損比較。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronise portal pressure and temperature with internal airflow direction. Measure pressure and velocity synchronously, record dampers and other fans, and compare the measured duty point with fan curves and network resistance. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「風道摩擦壓損」的交付需回答：同步量測兩端氣壓溫度與洞內風向。驗收採明確風門和車流邊界，維修改線後重新核對網路工作點，火災模式由防災責任工程師簽認而非沿用正常模式。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Great St Bernard Tunnel, the duct friction loss handover must address the following evidence: Synchronise portal pressure and temperature with internal airflow direction. Commission with specified damper and traffic boundaries, recheck duty points after rerouting, and have the fire-safety engineer approve emergency modes independently.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：季節反向風若當感測器故障，會漏掉真實邊界變化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Seasonally reversed flow mistaken for sensor failure hides real boundary change. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Measure pressure and velocity synchronously, record dampers and other fans, and compare the measured duty point with fan curves and network resistance. knowledge.text: 本案「風道摩擦壓損」的交付需回答：同步量測兩端氣壓溫度與洞內風向。驗收採明確風門和車流邊界，維修改線後重新核對網路工作點，火災模式由防災責任工程師簽認而非沿用正常模式。

quiz.question: 要驗證「通風網路與壓力損失」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ventilation network and pressure loss"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
同步量測兩端氣壓溫度與洞內風向。
設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Synchronise portal pressure and temperature with internal airflow direction.
Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
quiz.explanation: 同步量測兩端氣壓溫度與洞內風向。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「風道摩擦壓損」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Duct friction loss” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 季節反向風若當感測器故障，會漏掉真實邊界變化。只看風機轉速會漏掉風門誤位或短路漏風，可能在總耗電增加時，真正需要的區段反而風量不足。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Seasonally reversed flow mistaken for sensor failure hides real boundary change. Fan speed alone misses a misplaced damper or leakage shortcut; total power may rise while the critical section receives less air. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：支路開關會重新分配整個網路，不能把額定風量直接加總；正常污染稀釋與火災控煙也有不同目標，需要分別建立受控邊界和故障情境。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Routine dilution and fire smoke control have different objectives, so each needs explicit boundaries, operating states and failure cases rather than one universal flow target.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 季節反向風若當感測器故障，會漏掉真實邊界變化。只看風機轉速會漏掉風門誤位或短路漏風，可能在總耗電增加時，真正需要的區段反而風量不足。
knowledge.textEn: Seasonally reversed flow mistaken for sensor failure hides real boundary change. Fan speed alone misses a misplaced damper or leakage shortcut; total power may rise while the critical section receives less air.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「通風網路與壓力損失」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ventilation network and pressure loss" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
照度越高就必然使隧道內所有物體更容易辨識。
季節反向風若當感測器故障，會漏掉真實邊界變化。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Higher illuminance necessarily makes every tunnel object easier to detect.
Seasonally reversed flow mistaken for sensor failure hides real boundary change.
quiz.explanation: 季節反向風若當感測器故障，會漏掉真實邊界變化。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Seasonally reversed flow mistaken for sensor failure hides real boundary change. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「視覺適應與路面亮度」與「溫度拘束與構件裂縫」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Visual adaptation and pavement luminance" and "Thermal restraint and component cracking": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 視覺適應與路面亮度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Visual adaptation and pavement luminance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「漫反射亮度」如何影響聖伯納山隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Diffuse luminance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Great St Bernard Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 高山洞口明暗背景可快速改變，聖伯納山教學檢查積雪反射與路面亮度的不同角色。駕駛從洞外進入洞內時視覺適應需要時間，照度並不等同從駕駛視角看到的亮度。路面反射、濕度、燈具配光及背景對比共同影響辨識；朗伯模型只示範理想漫反射，不能直接制定入口段燈具間距或真實道路安全值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「漫反射亮度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Bright alpine portal backgrounds can change quickly; distinguish snow reflection from pavement luminance. Driver adaptation takes time when entering a tunnel, and illuminance is not the luminance seen from the driving position. Pavement reflection, wetness, luminaire distribution and background contrast affect detection. A Lambertian model illustrates ideal diffuse reflection only; it cannot establish entrance-zone spacing or actual road-safety limits without photometric and operational assessment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Diffuse luminance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：照度=104 lx；反射率=0.22 無因次。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: illuminance=104 lx; reflectance=0.22 dimensionless.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「照度越高就必然使隧道內所有物體更容易辨識。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Higher illuminance necessarily makes every tunnel object easier to detect." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「漫反射亮度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Diffuse luminance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 視覺適應與路面亮度
knowledge.text: 高山洞口明暗背景可快速改變，聖伯納山教學檢查積雪反射與路面亮度的不同角色。駕駛從洞外進入洞內時視覺適應需要時間，照度並不等同從駕駛視角看到的亮度。
knowledge.textEn: Bright alpine portal backgrounds can change quickly; distinguish snow reflection from pavement luminance. Driver adaptation takes time when entering a tunnel, and illuminance is not the luminance seen from the driving position.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：照度越高就必然使隧道內所有物體更容易辨識。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Higher illuminance necessarily makes every tunnel object easier to detect. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「視覺適應與路面亮度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Visual adaptation and pavement luminance" is correct?
options: 高山洞口明暗背景可快速改變，聖伯納山教學檢查積雪反射與路面亮度的不同角色。
照度越高就必然使隧道內所有物體更容易辨識。
混凝土抗壓強度合格就代表厚壁構件不會產生熱裂縫。
optionsEn: Bright alpine portal backgrounds can change quickly; distinguish snow reflection from pavement luminance.
Higher illuminance necessarily makes every tunnel object easier to detect.
Adequate compressive strength proves that thick concrete cannot develop thermal cracks.
quiz.explanation: 高山洞口明暗背景可快速改變，聖伯納山教學檢查積雪反射與路面亮度的不同角色。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Bright alpine portal backgrounds can change quickly; distinguish snow reflection from pavement luminance. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 視覺適應與路面亮度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Visual adaptation and pavement luminance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「漫反射亮度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Diffuse luminance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：照度=104 lx；反射率=0.22 無因次。L=ρE/π=7.28293 cd/m²。僅把照度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為8.01122 cd/m²。邊界：理想朗伯漫反射，不是真實濕路面亮度；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: illuminance=104 lx; reflectance=0.22 dimensionless. L=ρE/π=7.28293 cd/m². Increasing only illuminance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 8.01122 cd/m². Boundary: Ideal Lambertian reflection, not actual wet-road luminance. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在不同天空與積雪背景下量測入口視角亮度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure entrance-view luminance under different sky and snow backgrounds.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：照度=104 lx；反射率=0.22 無因次。L=ρE/π=7.28293 cd/m²。僅把照度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為8.01122 cd/m²。邊界：理想朗伯漫反射，不是真實濕路面亮度；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: illuminance=104 lx; reflectance=0.22 dimensionless. L=ρE/π=7.28293 cd/m². Increasing only illuminance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 8.01122 cd/m². Boundary: Ideal Lambertian reflection, not actual wet-road luminance. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「視覺適應與路面亮度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Visual adaptation and pavement luminance", which statement holds?
options: 擴散長度就是鋼筋開始腐蝕的位置和精確時間。
原創教學假設：照度=104 lx；反射率=0.22 無因次。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
optionsEn: Diffusion length gives the exact location and time of corrosion initiation.
Original teaching assumptions: illuminance=104 lx; reflectance=0.22 dimensionless.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：照度=104 lx；反射率=0.22 無因次。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: illuminance=104 lx; reflectance=0.22 dimensionless. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 視覺適應與路面亮度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Visual adaptation and pavement luminance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「漫反射亮度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Diffuse luminance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在不同天空與積雪背景下量測入口視角亮度。以駕駛視角的亮度量測配合照度網格，分別檢查乾濕路面與燈具衰減，保留外部天空條件。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure entrance-view luminance under different sky and snow backgrounds. Combine driver-view luminance with illuminance grids, checking dry and wet pavement and lamp depreciation while preserving exterior sky conditions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「漫反射亮度」的交付需回答：在不同天空與積雪背景下量測入口視角亮度。將視角、路面狀態和光度校正連同量測交付，照明調整需按核准場景測試，不把理想反射公式當驗收標準。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Great St Bernard Tunnel, the diffuse luminance handover must address the following evidence: Measure entrance-view luminance under different sky and snow backgrounds. Hand over viewing geometry, pavement state and photometric calibration; test changes against approved scenarios rather than treating ideal reflection as an acceptance criterion.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：僅按洞內照度設定可能漏掉洞外高亮背景的適應需求。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Interior illuminance alone misses adaptation to a bright external background. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在不同天空與積雪背景下量測入口視角亮度。以駕駛視角的亮度量測配合照度網格，分別檢查乾濕路面與燈具衰減，保留外部天空條件。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Measure entrance-view luminance under different sky and snow backgrounds. Combine driver-view luminance with illuminance grids, checking dry and wet pavement and lamp depreciation while preserving exterior sky conditions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「漫反射亮度」的交付需回答：在不同天空與積雪背景下量測入口視角亮度。將視角、路面狀態和光度校正連同量測交付，照明調整需按核准場景測試，不把理想反射公式當驗收標準。
knowledge.textEn: For Great St Bernard Tunnel, the diffuse luminance handover must address the following evidence: Measure entrance-view luminance under different sky and snow backgrounds. Hand over viewing geometry, pavement state and photometric calibration; test changes against approved scenarios rather than treating ideal reflection as an acceptance criterion.

quiz.question: 要驗證「視覺適應與路面亮度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Visual adaptation and pavement luminance"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
在不同天空與積雪背景下量測入口視角亮度。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
Measure entrance-view luminance under different sky and snow backgrounds.
quiz.explanation: 在不同天空與積雪背景下量測入口視角亮度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure entrance-view luminance under different sky and snow backgrounds. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 視覺適應與路面亮度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Visual adaptation and pavement luminance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「漫反射亮度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Diffuse luminance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 僅按洞內照度設定可能漏掉洞外高亮背景的適應需求。照度平均值合格仍可能存在低亮度障礙區或眩光，感測器沾污也會使調光系統低估外界亮度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Interior illuminance alone misses adaptation to a bright external background. Acceptable average illuminance can coexist with dark obstacles or glare, while sensor contamination may bias adaptive lighting controls. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：路面反射、濕度、燈具配光及背景對比共同影響辨識；朗伯模型只示範理想漫反射，不能直接制定入口段燈具間距或真實道路安全值。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「照度越高就必然使隧道內所有物體更容易辨識。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Higher illuminance necessarily makes every tunnel object easier to detect." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 僅按洞內照度設定可能漏掉洞外高亮背景的適應需求。照度平均值合格仍可能存在低亮度障礙區或眩光，感測器沾污也會使調光系統低估外界亮度。
knowledge.textEn: Interior illuminance alone misses adaptation to a bright external background. Acceptable average illuminance can coexist with dark obstacles or glare, while sensor contamination may bias adaptive lighting controls.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「視覺適應與路面亮度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Visual adaptation and pavement luminance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 僅按洞內照度設定可能漏掉洞外高亮背景的適應需求。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
混凝土抗壓強度合格就代表厚壁構件不會產生熱裂縫。
optionsEn: Interior illuminance alone misses adaptation to a bright external background.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Adequate compressive strength proves that thick concrete cannot develop thermal cracks.
quiz.explanation: 僅按洞內照度設定可能漏掉洞外高亮背景的適應需求。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Interior illuminance alone misses adaptation to a bright external background. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 溫度拘束與構件裂縫：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Thermal restraint and component cracking: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「拘束溫度應變」如何影響聖伯納山隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Restrained thermal strain” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Great St Bernard Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 高山入口溫度循環影響混凝土與接縫，教材分開線膨脹拘束和凍融含水條件。厚壁構件在水化升溫後冷卻，若相鄰構件或基座限制收縮，熱應變會轉為拉應力。抗壓強度達標不等於抗裂合格，因為彈性模數成熟、徐變、溫度梯度與澆置順序都影響實際拘束；完全拘束彈性估算只能當量級上限比較。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「拘束溫度應變」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Portal temperature cycles affect concrete and joints; separate restrained expansion from moisture-dependent freeze-thaw behaviour. A thick element cools after hydration, and restraint from adjacent pours or its base converts contraction into tension. Compressive-strength compliance does not establish crack resistance because modulus development, creep, gradients and pour sequence influence restraint. A fully restrained elastic estimate is therefore a scale bound, not a prediction of actual cracking or residual stress. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Restrained thermal strain” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：線膨脹係數=1e-05 K⁻¹；溫差=22 K；彈性模數=25 GPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: expansion coefficient=1e-05 K⁻¹; temperature difference=22 K; elastic modulus=25 GPa. σ=EαΔT, GPa→MPa ×1000=5.5 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土抗壓強度合格就代表厚壁構件不會產生熱裂縫。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adequate compressive strength proves that thick concrete cannot develop thermal cracks." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「拘束溫度應變」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Restrained thermal strain”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 溫度拘束與構件裂縫
knowledge.text: 高山入口溫度循環影響混凝土與接縫，教材分開線膨脹拘束和凍融含水條件。厚壁構件在水化升溫後冷卻，若相鄰構件或基座限制收縮，熱應變會轉為拉應力。
knowledge.textEn: Portal temperature cycles affect concrete and joints; separate restrained expansion from moisture-dependent freeze-thaw behaviour. A thick element cools after hydration, and restraint from adjacent pours or its base converts contraction into tension.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：混凝土抗壓強度合格就代表厚壁構件不會產生熱裂縫。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adequate compressive strength proves that thick concrete cannot develop thermal cracks. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「溫度拘束與構件裂縫」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Thermal restraint and component cracking" is correct?
options: 混凝土抗壓強度合格就代表厚壁構件不會產生熱裂縫。
高山入口溫度循環影響混凝土與接縫，教材分開線膨脹拘束和凍融含水條件。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
optionsEn: Adequate compressive strength proves that thick concrete cannot develop thermal cracks.
Portal temperature cycles affect concrete and joints; separate restrained expansion from moisture-dependent freeze-thaw behaviour.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
quiz.explanation: 高山入口溫度循環影響混凝土與接縫，教材分開線膨脹拘束和凍融含水條件。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Portal temperature cycles affect concrete and joints; separate restrained expansion from moisture-dependent freeze-thaw behaviour. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 溫度拘束與構件裂縫：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Thermal restraint and component cracking: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「拘束溫度應變」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Restrained thermal strain” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：線膨脹係數=1e-05 K⁻¹；溫差=22 K；彈性模數=25 GPa。σ=EαΔT, GPa→MPa ×1000=5.5 MPa。僅把溫差增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為6.05 MPa。邊界：完全拘束線彈性量級，未含徐變開裂和拘束鬆弛；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: expansion coefficient=1e-05 K⁻¹; temperature difference=22 K; elastic modulus=25 GPa. σ=EαΔT, GPa→MPa ×1000=5.5 MPa. Increasing only temperature difference by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 6.05 MPa. Boundary: Fully restrained linear-elastic scale without creep, cracking or restraint relaxation. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將表面與內部溫度配對裂縫及滲水紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Pair surface and internal temperatures with cracking and leakage records.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：線膨脹係數=1e-05 K⁻¹；溫差=22 K；彈性模數=25 GPa。σ=EαΔT, GPa→MPa ×1000=5.5 MPa。僅把溫差增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為6.05 MPa。邊界：完全拘束線彈性量級，未含徐變開裂和拘束鬆弛；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: expansion coefficient=1e-05 K⁻¹; temperature difference=22 K; elastic modulus=25 GPa. σ=EαΔT, GPa→MPa ×1000=5.5 MPa. Increasing only temperature difference by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 6.05 MPa. Boundary: Fully restrained linear-elastic scale without creep, cracking or restraint relaxation. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「溫度拘束與構件裂縫」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Thermal restraint and component cracking", which statement holds?
options: 混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。
原創教學假設：線膨脹係數=1e-05 K⁻¹；溫差=22 K；彈性模數=25 GPa。
optionsEn: Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
Original teaching assumptions: expansion coefficient=1e-05 K⁻¹; temperature difference=22 K; elastic modulus=25 GPa. σ=EαΔT, GPa→MPa ×1000=5.5 MPa.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：線膨脹係數=1e-05 K⁻¹；溫差=22 K；彈性模數=25 GPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: expansion coefficient=1e-05 K⁻¹; temperature difference=22 K; elastic modulus=25 GPa. σ=EαΔT, GPa→MPa ×1000=5.5 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 溫度拘束與構件裂縫：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Thermal restraint and component cracking: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「拘束溫度應變」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Restrained thermal strain” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將表面與內部溫度配對裂縫及滲水紀錄。記錄核心表面溫度及同條件試體成熟度，將裂縫位置與溫差、拆模及鄰段澆置時間配對，檢查熱歷程是否被遺漏。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Pair surface and internal temperatures with cracking and leakage records. Record core/surface temperature and matched-cured maturity, pairing cracks with temperature differences, formwork removal and adjacent pours to identify missing thermal history. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「拘束溫度應變」的交付需回答：將表面與內部溫度配對裂縫及滲水紀錄。澆置前核准溫度監測及養護方案，變更材料、拆模或澆置順序時重新檢查熱分析，將裂縫與接縫止水的責任一併交付。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Great St Bernard Tunnel, the restrained thermal strain handover must address the following evidence: Pair surface and internal temperatures with cracking and leakage records. Approve monitoring and curing before pours, revisit thermal analysis after material or sequence changes, and hand over crack and waterstop responsibilities together.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：熱應力式不能單獨預測凍融剝落，兩機制不可混用。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Thermal-stress equations alone cannot predict freeze-thaw scaling. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將表面與內部溫度配對裂縫及滲水紀錄。記錄核心表面溫度及同條件試體成熟度，將裂縫位置與溫差、拆模及鄰段澆置時間配對，檢查熱歷程是否被遺漏。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Pair surface and internal temperatures with cracking and leakage records. Record core/surface temperature and matched-cured maturity, pairing cracks with temperature differences, formwork removal and adjacent pours to identify missing thermal history. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「拘束溫度應變」的交付需回答：將表面與內部溫度配對裂縫及滲水紀錄。澆置前核准溫度監測及養護方案，變更材料、拆模或澆置順序時重新檢查熱分析，將裂縫與接縫止水的責任一併交付。
knowledge.textEn: For Great St Bernard Tunnel, the restrained thermal strain handover must address the following evidence: Pair surface and internal temperatures with cracking and leakage records. Approve monitoring and curing before pours, revisit thermal analysis after material or sequence changes, and hand over crack and waterstop responsibilities together.

quiz.question: 要驗證「溫度拘束與構件裂縫」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Thermal restraint and component cracking"?
options: 將表面與內部溫度配對裂縫及滲水紀錄。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Pair surface and internal temperatures with cracking and leakage records.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 將表面與內部溫度配對裂縫及滲水紀錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Pair surface and internal temperatures with cracking and leakage records. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 溫度拘束與構件裂縫：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Thermal restraint and component cracking: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「拘束溫度應變」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Restrained thermal strain” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 熱應力式不能單獨預測凍融剝落，兩機制不可混用。標準養護試體合格而現場過早冷卻，仍可能形成貫穿裂縫並影響止水；僅增加後續抗壓試驗無法重建失去的養護。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Thermal-stress equations alone cannot predict freeze-thaw scaling. Passing standard-cured specimens does not prevent through-cracking after rapid cooling, and more later strength tests cannot reconstruct inadequate curing. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：抗壓強度達標不等於抗裂合格，因為彈性模數成熟、徐變、溫度梯度與澆置順序都影響實際拘束；完全拘束彈性估算只能當量級上限比較。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A fully restrained elastic estimate is therefore a scale bound, not a prediction of actual cracking or residual stress.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土抗壓強度合格就代表厚壁構件不會產生熱裂縫。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adequate compressive strength proves that thick concrete cannot develop thermal cracks." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 熱應力式不能單獨預測凍融剝落，兩機制不可混用。標準養護試體合格而現場過早冷卻，仍可能形成貫穿裂縫並影響止水；僅增加後續抗壓試驗無法重建失去的養護。
knowledge.textEn: Thermal-stress equations alone cannot predict freeze-thaw scaling. Passing standard-cured specimens does not prevent through-cracking after rapid cooling, and more later strength tests cannot reconstruct inadequate curing.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「溫度拘束與構件裂縫」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Thermal restraint and component cracking" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
熱應力式不能單獨預測凍融剝落，兩機制不可混用。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Thermal-stress equations alone cannot predict freeze-thaw scaling.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
quiz.explanation: 熱應力式不能單獨預測凍融剝落，兩機制不可混用。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Thermal-stress equations alone cannot predict freeze-thaw scaling. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」與「氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Piezometric head and lining pressure" and "Chloride transport and durability interpretation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「測壓水頭」如何影響聖伯納山隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Piezometric head” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Great St Bernard Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 高山融雪補注和道路帶入水需分流判讀，研究聖伯納山背景下排水增量是否跟隨季節或車流。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「測壓水頭」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate snowmelt recharge and road-carried water, checking whether drainage changes follow season or traffic. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level. Drainage reduces pressure but can increase effective stress and settlement. Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Piezometric head” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=82 m。

knowledge.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓
knowledge.text: 高山融雪補注和道路帶入水需分流判讀，研究聖伯納山背景下排水增量是否跟隨季節或車流。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。
knowledge.textEn: Separate snowmelt recharge and road-carried water, checking whether drainage changes follow season or traffic. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「測壓水頭」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Piezometric head” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=82 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=804.42 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為884.862 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=82 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=804.42 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 884.862 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照融雪期、降雨和車流時序的水量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare flow with snowmelt, rainfall and traffic histories.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「測壓水頭」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Piezometric head” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照融雪期、降雨和車流時序的水量。使用分層測壓管及流量計，配合降雨或潮位序列分辨補注與設備影響，將讀值統一換算至同一高程基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare flow with snowmelt, rainfall and traffic histories. Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：對照融雪期、降雨和車流時序的水量。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Great St Bernard Tunnel, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Compare flow with snowmelt, rainfall and traffic histories. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：車輛帶入水若當地下水增壓會誤導襯砌判讀。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Road-carried water misclassified as rising groundwater misleads lining assessment. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「測壓水頭」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Piezometric head” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 車輛帶入水若當地下水增壓會誤導襯砌判讀。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Road-carried water misclassified as rising groundwater misleads lining assessment. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Piezometric head and lining pressure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
擴散長度就是鋼筋開始腐蝕的位置和精確時間。
車輛帶入水若當地下水增壓會誤導襯砌判讀。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Diffusion length gives the exact location and time of corrosion initiation.
Road-carried water misclassified as rising groundwater misleads lining assessment.
quiz.explanation: 車輛帶入水若當地下水增壓會誤導襯砌判讀。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Road-carried water misclassified as rising groundwater misleads lining assessment. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「擴散特徵長度」如何影響聖伯納山隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Diffusion characteristic length” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Great St Bernard Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 除冰鹽帶入的暴露可能集中於路側低區，不能以高處乾燥取樣代表整個斷面。海水或除冰鹽可提供氯離子，材料孔隙與裂縫控制其傳輸；鋼筋腐蝕還需要局部電化學條件。平方根擴散長度僅顯示時間尺度，並不是腐蝕門檻深度；表面濃度變化、乾濕循環、結合效應及施工裂縫須另行辨識。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「擴散特徵長度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Deicing-salt exposure can concentrate near low roadside zones, so dry high-level samples do not represent the section. Seawater or deicing salt supplies chloride, while pores and cracks govern transport; reinforcement corrosion also depends on local electrochemical conditions. A square-root diffusion length indicates a time scale, not a corrosion-threshold depth. Surface concentration, wetting cycles, binding and construction cracks must be distinguished rather than hidden in one fitted diffusivity. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Diffusion characteristic length” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：擴散係數=1e-12 m²/s；暴露時間=15 year。ℓ=√(Dt); 1 year=365.25×86400 s; m→mm ×1000=21.7569 mm。僅把暴露時間增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為22.8189 mm。邊界：特徵長度，不是腐蝕起始壽命或氯鹽門檻深度；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: diffusivity=1e-12 m²/s; exposure=15 year. ℓ=√(Dt); 1 year=365.25×86400 s; m→mm ×1000=21.7569 mm. Increasing only exposure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 22.8189 mm. Boundary: Characteristic length, not corrosion-initiation life or chloride-threshold depth. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：按高度與距車道位置比較氯鹽、含水及裂縫。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare chloride, moisture and cracks by height and distance from traffic.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Increasing only exposure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 22.8189 mm. Boundary: Characteristic length, not corrosion-initiation life or chloride-threshold depth.
