knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Chloride transport and durability interpretation", which statement holds?
options: 設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。
原創教學假設：擴散係數=1e-12 m²/s；暴露時間=15 year。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
Original teaching assumptions: diffusivity=1e-12 m²/s; exposure=15 year. ℓ=√(Dt); 1 year=365.25×86400 s; m→mm ×1000=21.7569 mm.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：擴散係數=1e-12 m²/s；暴露時間=15 year。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: diffusivity=1e-12 m²/s; exposure=15 year. ℓ=√(Dt); 1 year=365.25×86400 s; m→mm ×1000=21.7569 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Chloride transport and durability interpretation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「擴散特徵長度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Diffusion characteristic length” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 按高度與距車道位置比較氯鹽、含水及裂縫。以分層取樣的氯鹽剖面配合裂縫圖與電位量測，檢查擴散模型是否只適用未開裂材料。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare chloride, moisture and cracks by height and distance from traffic. Combine depth-resolved chloride samples with crack maps and potential measurements, checking whether the diffusion model applies only to uncracked material. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「擴散特徵長度」的交付需回答：按高度與距車道位置比較氯鹽、含水及裂縫。保留取樣深度、含水狀態及材料批次，用多種證據解釋劣化；維修優先序依構件功能與實際病害制定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Great St Bernard Tunnel, the diffusion characteristic length handover must address the following evidence: Compare chloride, moisture and cracks by height and distance from traffic. Retain sample depth, moisture and material batches and interpret deterioration using multiple evidence types; prioritise repairs by function and observed defects.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：採樣位置偏乾會系統性低估易濕區劣化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sampling dry locations systematically understates deterioration in wet zones. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 按高度與距車道位置比較氯鹽、含水及裂縫。以分層取樣的氯鹽剖面配合裂縫圖與電位量測，檢查擴散模型是否只適用未開裂材料。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Compare chloride, moisture and cracks by height and distance from traffic. Combine depth-resolved chloride samples with crack maps and potential measurements, checking whether the diffusion model applies only to uncracked material. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「擴散特徵長度」的交付需回答：按高度與距車道位置比較氯鹽、含水及裂縫。保留取樣深度、含水狀態及材料批次，用多種證據解釋劣化；維修優先序依構件功能與實際病害制定。
knowledge.textEn: For Great St Bernard Tunnel, the diffusion characteristic length handover must address the following evidence: Compare chloride, moisture and cracks by height and distance from traffic. Retain sample depth, moisture and material batches and interpret deterioration using multiple evidence types; prioritise repairs by function and observed defects.

quiz.question: 要驗證「氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Chloride transport and durability interpretation"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
照度越高就必然使隧道內所有物體更容易辨識。
按高度與距車道位置比較氯鹽、含水及裂縫。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Higher illuminance necessarily makes every tunnel object easier to detect.
Compare chloride, moisture and cracks by height and distance from traffic.
quiz.explanation: 按高度與距車道位置比較氯鹽、含水及裂縫。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare chloride, moisture and cracks by height and distance from traffic. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Chloride transport and durability interpretation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「擴散特徵長度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Diffusion characteristic length” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 採樣位置偏乾會系統性低估易濕區劣化。把一次電位讀值當腐蝕速率會誤判剩餘壽命，裂縫快速傳輸也可能被平均材料係數掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sampling dry locations systematically understates deterioration in wet zones. Treating one potential reading as corrosion rate misjudges remaining life, while averaged material coefficients conceal rapid crack transport. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：平方根擴散長度僅顯示時間尺度，並不是腐蝕門檻深度；表面濃度變化、乾濕循環、結合效應及施工裂縫須另行辨識。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Surface concentration, wetting cycles, binding and construction cracks must be distinguished rather than hidden in one fitted diffusivity.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「擴散長度就是鋼筋開始腐蝕的位置和精確時間。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Diffusion length gives the exact location and time of corrosion initiation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 採樣位置偏乾會系統性低估易濕區劣化。把一次電位讀值當腐蝕速率會誤判剩餘壽命，裂縫快速傳輸也可能被平均材料係數掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Sampling dry locations systematically understates deterioration in wet zones. Treating one potential reading as corrosion rate misjudges remaining life, while averaged material coefficients conceal rapid crack transport.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Chloride transport and durability interpretation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 採樣位置偏乾會系統性低估易濕區劣化。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
optionsEn: Sampling dry locations systematically understates deterioration in wet zones.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
quiz.explanation: 採樣位置偏乾會系統性低估易濕區劣化。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Sampling dry locations systematically understates deterioration in wet zones. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「環向受力與接縫柔度」與「疏散時間與分區可用性」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ring force and joint flexibility" and "Evacuation time and zone availability": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ring force and joint flexibility: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「襯砌環向壓縮」如何影響聖伯納山隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lining hoop compression” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Great St Bernard Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 既有襯砌修補前先辨認地層荷載、漏水與材料劣化，聖伯納山教材不把所有裂縫歸為強度不足。圓形襯砌對均勻外壓可主要以環向壓縮抵抗，但接頭轉動、偏壓與背填空隙會引起彎矩。薄環膜應力只說明其中一條受力路徑；脫模、運輸、頂推及永久狀態的荷載不同，環片局部接觸與止水條件必須另外檢核。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「襯砌環向壓縮」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Before lining repair, distinguish ground loading, leakage and material deterioration instead of treating all cracks as inadequate strength. A circular lining resists uniform external pressure largely through hoop compression, but joint rotation, uneven load and backfill voids generate bending. Thin-ring membrane stress describes only one load path. Demoulding, transport, jacking and permanent states impose different actions, requiring separate checks of local segment contact and sealing rather than one permanent-load calculation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Lining hoop compression” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.54 MPa；半徑=3.6 m；厚度=0.35 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.54 MPa; radius=3.6 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=5.55429 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「襯砌環向壓縮」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Lining hoop compression”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度
knowledge.text: 既有襯砌修補前先辨認地層荷載、漏水與材料劣化，聖伯納山教材不把所有裂縫歸為強度不足。圓形襯砌對均勻外壓可主要以環向壓縮抵抗，但接頭轉動、偏壓與背填空隙會引起彎矩。
knowledge.textEn: Before lining repair, distinguish ground loading, leakage and material deterioration instead of treating all cracks as inadequate strength. A circular lining resists uniform external pressure largely through hoop compression, but joint rotation, uneven load and backfill voids generate bending.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「環向受力與接縫柔度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ring force and joint flexibility" is correct?
options: 混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
既有襯砌修補前先辨認地層荷載、漏水與材料劣化，聖伯納山教材不把所有裂縫歸為強度不足。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
optionsEn: Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
Before lining repair, distinguish ground loading, leakage and material deterioration instead of treating all cracks as inadequate strength.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
quiz.explanation: 既有襯砌修補前先辨認地層荷載、漏水與材料劣化，聖伯納山教材不把所有裂縫歸為強度不足。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Before lining repair, distinguish ground loading, leakage and material deterioration instead of treating all cracks as inadequate strength. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ring force and joint flexibility: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「襯砌環向壓縮」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.54 MPa；半徑=3.6 m；厚度=0.35 m。σθ=pr/t=5.55429 MPa。僅把均勻外壓增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為6.10971 MPa。邊界：薄圓環膜應力，不是接縫、偏壓或矩形框架解；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.54 MPa; radius=3.6 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=5.55429 MPa. Increasing only uniform external pressure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 6.10971 MPa. Boundary: Thin circular-ring membrane stress, not a joint, uneven-load or rectangular-frame solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較裂縫方向、季節開合與外水頭變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare crack orientation and seasonal opening against external head changes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型

Drawings distinguish stages, joint stiffness and backfill conditions; component acceptance reconciles geometry, material batches and the applicable sealing-test envelope.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：表面補縫而未辨認持續變形會反覆出現同類病害。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Surface sealing without identifying continuing movement leads to recurrent defects. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ring force and joint flexibility: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「襯砌環向壓縮」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lining hoop compression” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 表面補縫而未辨認持續變形會反覆出現同類病害。局部脫空增加環片彎曲，裂縫未必代表混凝土平均強度不足；忽略接縫接觸會把補強方向導向錯誤位置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Surface sealing without identifying continuing movement leads to recurrent defects. Local voids increase bending, so cracks need not indicate inadequate mean concrete strength; neglecting joint contact can misdirect strengthening. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：薄環膜應力只說明其中一條受力路徑；脫模、運輸、頂推及永久狀態的荷載不同，環片局部接觸與止水條件必須另外檢核。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Demoulding, transport, jacking and permanent states impose different actions, requiring separate checks of local segment contact and sealing rather than one permanent-load calculation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 表面補縫而未辨認持續變形會反覆出現同類病害。局部脫空增加環片彎曲，裂縫未必代表混凝土平均強度不足；忽略接縫接觸會把補強方向導向錯誤位置。

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「環向受力與接縫柔度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ring force and joint flexibility" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Surface sealing without identifying continuing movement leads to recurrent defects.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
quiz.explanation: 表面補縫而未辨認持續變形會反覆出現同類病害。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Surface sealing without identifying continuing movement leads to recurrent defects. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Evacuation time and zone availability: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「所需疏散時間」如何影響聖伯納山隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Required evacuation time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Great St Bernard Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 雙向交通中事故兩側使用者位置不同，教學路徑分別處理回頭、停車與前方阻隔情境。疏散時間包含辨識、反應、移動及排隊，不只由出口距離決定。人員速度會受煙熱、能見度及行動能力影響，安全判斷還要比較可用安全時間；橫通道存在但門或鄰孔不可用時，圖上的最短路線不一定能作實際選擇。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「所需疏散時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Users lie on different sides of an incident in bidirectional traffic; distinguish turnaround, stopped queues and blocked-forward-path cases. Evacuation includes detection, response, travel and queues, not merely distance to an exit. Smoke, visibility and mobility alter walking speed, while safety requires comparison with available safe time. A passage shown on a plan may be unusable because its door or receiving bore is unavailable, invalidating the nominal shortest route. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Required evacuation time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：前置時間=104 s；行走距離=340 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=104 s; travel distance=340 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「所需疏散時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「所需疏散時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Required evacuation time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：前置時間=104 s；行走距離=340 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。RSET=tpre+d/v=529 s。僅把行走距離增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為571.5 s。邊界：單群體固定速度，不含排隊煙熱及能力差異，不能單獨判安全；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Test passage availability and message visibility from different starting positions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 用不同起始位置測試通道及訊息可見性。以人流模擬或受控演練分辨前置時間、行走與門口排隊，核對每個出口接收區的可用狀態及通訊紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Test passage availability and message visibility from different starting positions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「所需疏散時間」的交付需回答：用不同起始位置測試通道及訊息可見性。疏散模型保留人口、速度分布及出口狀態，演練改動由營運與防災責任者批准，教材算例不得當作現場指揮程序。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Great St Bernard Tunnel, the required evacuation time handover must address the following evidence: Test passage availability and message visibility from different starting positions. Retain population, speed distribution and exit states; operations and fire-safety owners approve drill changes, and classroom calculations are not incident-command procedures.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：假設所有人都朝同一出口會漏掉事故位置造成的阻隔。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Assuming everyone uses one exit ignores obstruction by incident location. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Separate pre-movement, travel and doorway queues through simulation or controlled drills, checking receiving-zone availability and communication records for each exit. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

Retain population, speed distribution and exit states; operations and fire-safety owners approve drill changes, and classroom calculations are not incident-command procedures.

quiz.question: 要驗證「疏散時間與分區可用性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Evacuation time and zone availability"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
用不同起始位置測試通道及訊息可見性。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Test passage availability and message visibility from different starting positions.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.

steps.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Evacuation time and zone availability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「所需疏散時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Required evacuation time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 假設所有人都朝同一出口會漏掉事故位置造成的阻隔。以最快成人速度套全部旅客會低估需求，若忽略接收孔受煙或車流影響，疏散可能移到另一個危險邊界。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Assuming everyone uses one exit ignores obstruction by incident location. Applying the fastest adult speed to everyone understates demand; overlooking smoke or traffic in the receiving bore can transfer evacuees into another hazard. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：人員速度會受煙熱、能見度及行動能力影響，安全判斷還要比較可用安全時間；橫通道存在但門或鄰孔不可用時，圖上的最短路線不一定能作實際選擇。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A passage shown on a plan may be unusable because its door or receiving bore is unavailable, invalidating the nominal shortest route.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 假設所有人都朝同一出口會漏掉事故位置造成的阻隔。以最快成人速度套全部旅客會低估需求，若忽略接收孔受煙或車流影響，疏散可能移到另一個危險邊界。
knowledge.textEn: Assuming everyone uses one exit ignores obstruction by incident location. Applying the fastest adult speed to everyone understates demand; overlooking smoke or traffic in the receiving bore can transfer evacuees into another hazard.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「疏散時間與分區可用性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Evacuation time and zone availability" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。
假設所有人都朝同一出口會漏掉事故位置造成的阻隔。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
Assuming everyone uses one exit ignores obstruction by incident location.
quiz.explanation: 假設所有人都朝同一出口會漏掉事故位置造成的阻隔。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Assuming everyone uses one exit ignores obstruction by incident location. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「設備備援與共同失效」與「資產編碼與可追溯交接」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Equipment redundancy and common failure" and "Asset identity and traceable handover": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 設備備援與共同失效：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Equipment redundancy and common failure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「系統不可用率」如何影響聖伯納山隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “System unavailability” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Great St Bernard Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 兩端控制室可提高監督能力，但共用通訊或電源仍會造成共同故障，研究控制權交接證據。兩套設備只有在故障近似獨立且切換可靠時，並聯才顯著降低不可用率。共用配電、控制軟體、冷卻或受淹位置會把獨立假設破壞；維修停用也改變當下配置，因此可靠度模型必須明列共有資源和設備狀態，不能只數備用台數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「系統不可用率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Two control rooms improve supervision but shared communication or power can still fail; examine evidence for authority transfer. Parallel equipment sharply reduces unavailability only when failures are approximately independent and transfer works. Shared power, software, cooling or flood exposure breaks that assumption. Planned maintenance also changes the available configuration, so reliability models must identify shared resources and states rather than count spare units or multiply unsupported independent probabilities. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “System unavailability” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：單機不可用率=0.022 無因次。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: single-unit unavailability=0.022 dimensionless.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「系統不可用率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “System unavailability”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 設備備援與共同失效
knowledge.text: 兩端控制室可提高監督能力，但共用通訊或電源仍會造成共同故障，研究控制權交接證據。兩套設備只有在故障近似獨立且切換可靠時，並聯才顯著降低不可用率。
knowledge.textEn: Two control rooms improve supervision but shared communication or power can still fail; examine evidence for authority transfer. Parallel equipment sharply reduces unavailability only when failures are approximately independent and transfer works.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「設備備援與共同失效」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Equipment redundancy and common failure" is correct?
options: 兩端控制室可提高監督能力，但共用通訊或電源仍會造成共同故障，研究控制權交接證據。
設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
optionsEn: Two control rooms improve supervision but shared communication or power can still fail; examine evidence for authority transfer.
Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
quiz.explanation: 兩端控制室可提高監督能力，但共用通訊或電源仍會造成共同故障，研究控制權交接證據。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Two control rooms improve supervision but shared communication or power can still fail; examine evidence for authority transfer. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 設備備援與共同失效：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Equipment redundancy and common failure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「系統不可用率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “System unavailability” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：單機不可用率=0.022 無因次。Uparallel=U²=0.000484 probability。僅把單機不可用率增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.00058564 probability。邊界：完全獨立並聯與完美切換，不含共同失效；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: single-unit unavailability=0.022 dimensionless. Uparallel=U²=0.000484 probability. Increasing only single-unit unavailability by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.00058564 probability. Boundary: Independent parallel units with perfect transfer, excluding common failures. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：測試主從切換並追查共用鏈路與時間同步。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Test authority transfer and trace shared links and time synchronisation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：單機不可用率=0.022 無因次。Uparallel=U²=0.000484 probability。僅把單機不可用率增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.00058564 probability。邊界：完全獨立並聯與完美切換，不含共同失效；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: single-unit unavailability=0.022 dimensionless. Uparallel=U²=0.000484 probability. Increasing only single-unit unavailability by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.00058564 probability. Boundary: Independent parallel units with perfect transfer, excluding common failures. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「設備備援與共同失效」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Equipment redundancy and common failure", which statement holds?
options: 風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
原創教學假設：單機不可用率=0.022 無因次。
混凝土抗壓強度合格就代表厚壁構件不會產生熱裂縫。
optionsEn: Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
Original teaching assumptions: single-unit unavailability=0.022 dimensionless.
Adequate compressive strength proves that thick concrete cannot develop thermal cracks.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：單機不可用率=0.022 無因次。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: single-unit unavailability=0.022 dimensionless. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 設備備援與共同失效：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Equipment redundancy and common failure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「系統不可用率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “System unavailability” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 測試主從切換並追查共用鏈路與時間同步。由設備清單畫出故障樹，將電源、控制及實體位置追到共同節點，並用事件及維修紀錄檢查獨立假設。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Test authority transfer and trace shared links and time synchronisation. Build a fault tree from the asset list, trace power, control and location to shared nodes, and test independence against incident and maintenance records. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「系統不可用率」的交付需回答：測試主從切換並追查共用鏈路與時間同步。維修計畫附當日可用配置與剩餘備援，任何共同資源更動同步更新故障樹，切換試驗由設備及營運團隊共同見證。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Great St Bernard Tunnel, the system unavailability handover must address the following evidence: Test authority transfer and trace shared links and time synchronisation. Attach the actual configuration and remaining redundancy to maintenance plans, update fault trees after shared-resource changes, and witness transfer tests jointly.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：兩室畫面一致不證明資料鏈路或電源相互獨立。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Matching displays do not prove independent data links or power. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 測試主從切換並追查共用鏈路與時間同步。由設備清單畫出故障樹，將電源、控制及實體位置追到共同節點，並用事件及維修紀錄檢查獨立假設。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Test authority transfer and trace shared links and time synchronisation. Build a fault tree from the asset list, trace power, control and location to shared nodes, and test independence against incident and maintenance records. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「系統不可用率」的交付需回答：測試主從切換並追查共用鏈路與時間同步。維修計畫附當日可用配置與剩餘備援，任何共同資源更動同步更新故障樹，切換試驗由設備及營運團隊共同見證。
knowledge.textEn: For Great St Bernard Tunnel, the system unavailability handover must address the following evidence: Test authority transfer and trace shared links and time synchronisation. Attach the actual configuration and remaining redundancy to maintenance plans, update fault trees after shared-resource changes, and witness transfer tests jointly.

quiz.question: 要驗證「設備備援與共同失效」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Equipment redundancy and common failure"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
擴散長度就是鋼筋開始腐蝕的位置和精確時間。
測試主從切換並追查共用鏈路與時間同步。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Diffusion length gives the exact location and time of corrosion initiation.
Test authority transfer and trace shared links and time synchronisation.
quiz.explanation: 測試主從切換並追查共用鏈路與時間同步。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Test authority transfer and trace shared links and time synchronisation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 設備備援與共同失效：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Equipment redundancy and common failure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「系統不可用率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “System unavailability” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 兩室畫面一致不證明資料鏈路或電源相互獨立。重複安裝卻共用單一供電可能在一次故障中全部停機，帳面可靠度很高但實際不可用時間沒有降低。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Matching displays do not prove independent data links or power. Duplicated equipment on one supply can fail together in a single event, leaving actual downtime unchanged despite optimistic calculated reliability. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：共用配電、控制軟體、冷卻或受淹位置會把獨立假設破壞；維修停用也改變當下配置，因此可靠度模型必須明列共有資源和設備狀態，不能只數備用台數。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Planned maintenance also changes the available configuration, so reliability models must identify shared resources and states rather than count spare units or multiply unsupported independent probabilities.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 兩室畫面一致不證明資料鏈路或電源相互獨立。重複安裝卻共用單一供電可能在一次故障中全部停機，帳面可靠度很高但實際不可用時間沒有降低。
knowledge.textEn: Matching displays do not prove independent data links or power. Duplicated equipment on one supply can fail together in a single event, leaving actual downtime unchanged despite optimistic calculated reliability.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「設備備援與共同失效」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Equipment redundancy and common failure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 兩室畫面一致不證明資料鏈路或電源相互獨立。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
optionsEn: Matching displays do not prove independent data links or power.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
quiz.explanation: 兩室畫面一致不證明資料鏈路或電源相互獨立。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Matching displays do not prove independent data links or power. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「資產資料完整度」如何影響聖伯納山隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Asset-record completeness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Great St Bernard Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 跨境維修需讓兩種語言的設備清單對應同一位置和工單，研究名詞翻譯與唯一識別碼分離。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「資產資料完整度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cross-border maintenance needs multilingual inventories linked to one location and work order, separating translated names from unique identifiers. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision. Drawings without change history cannot distinguish replacement from deterioration. Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Asset-record completeness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：設備總數=112 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=112 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=85.7143 %.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「資產資料完整度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Asset-record completeness”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接

knowledge.textEn: Cross-border maintenance needs multilingual inventories linked to one location and work order, separating translated names from unique identifiers. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「資產編碼與可追溯交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Asset identity and traceable handover" is correct?
options: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
跨境維修需讓兩種語言的設備清單對應同一位置和工單，研究名詞翻譯與唯一識別碼分離。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
Cross-border maintenance needs multilingual inventories linked to one location and work order, separating translated names from unique identifiers.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 跨境維修需讓兩種語言的設備清單對應同一位置和工單，研究名詞翻譯與唯一識別碼分離。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Cross-border maintenance needs multilingual inventories linked to one location and work order, separating translated names from unique identifiers. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「資產資料完整度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Asset-record completeness” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：設備總數=112 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=85.7143 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為84.2857 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=112 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=85.7143 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 84.2857 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：抽查兩控制室對同一告警的定位及維修責任。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check both rooms locate one alarm identically and assign the same maintenance responsibility.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：設備總數=112 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=85.7143 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為84.2857 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=112 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=85.7143 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 84.2857 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「資產編碼與可追溯交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Asset identity and traceable handover", which statement holds?
options: 照度越高就必然使隧道內所有物體更容易辨識。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
原創教學假設：設備總數=112 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。
optionsEn: Higher illuminance necessarily makes every tunnel object easier to detect.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Original teaching assumptions: asset count=112 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=85.7143 %.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：設備總數=112 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=112 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=85.7143 %. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「資產資料完整度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Asset-record completeness” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 抽查兩控制室對同一告警的定位及維修責任。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check both rooms locate one alarm identically and assign the same maintenance responsibility. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：抽查兩控制室對同一告警的定位及維修責任。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Great St Bernard Tunnel, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Check both rooms locate one alarm identically and assign the same maintenance responsibility. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：同名設備位於不同洞端時，文字翻譯不能取代位置編碼。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Translation cannot replace location codes when similarly named assets occupy opposite portals. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.

quiz.question: 要驗證「資產編碼與可追溯交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Asset identity and traceable handover"?
options: 抽查兩控制室對同一告警的定位及維修責任。

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「資產編碼與可追溯交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Asset identity and traceable handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
同名設備位於不同洞端時，文字翻譯不能取代位置編碼。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Translation cannot replace location codes when similarly named assets occupy opposite portals.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 同名設備位於不同洞端時，文字翻譯不能取代位置編碼。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Translation cannot replace location codes when similarly named assets occupy opposite portals. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 蒙布朗隧道
summary: 蒙布朗隧道連接法國與義大利，營運機構列長11.6公里並記錄1965年開通。本課以長公路的系統思考為主軸，分別研究通風網路、受熱材料、事故偵知、人的反應、設備冗餘及整修交付。歷史事件只用核對過的年代，假想事故條件不被包裝為原事故重建。
summaryEn: Mont Blanc Tunnel connects France and Italy; its operator reports 11.6 km and opening in 1965. This course uses a systems perspective on ventilation networks, heated materials, detection, human response, redundancy and refurbishment handover. Historical dates follow checked records, while hypothetical incident conditions are not presented as reconstruction of an actual accident.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創綜合審查：先計算「通風網路與壓力損失」，再獨立計算「疏散時間與分區可用性」。原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=1020 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.1 m/s。Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=36.7583 Pa。僅把平均風速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為44.4775 Pa。邊界：定密度直管摩阻，局部損失及外風另計；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：前置時間=106 s；行走距離=300 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。RSET=tpre+d/v=481 s。僅把行走距離增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為518.5 s。邊界：單群體固定速度，不含排隊煙熱及能力差異，不能單獨判安全；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated review: first calculate ventilation network and pressure loss, then independently calculate evacuation time and zone availability. Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=1020 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.1 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=36.7583 Pa. Increasing only mean velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 44.4775 Pa. Boundary: Constant-density straight-duct friction; local loss and external wind are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=106 s; travel distance=300 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. RSET=tpre+d/v=481 s. Increasing only travel distance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 518.5 s. Boundary: One group at fixed speed without queues, smoke or mobility differences; not a safety conclusion. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「服務邊界與路線代價」與「通風網路與壓力損失」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Service boundaries and alignment cost" and "Ventilation network and pressure loss": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「路線里程與端點」如何影響蒙布朗隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Alignment chainage and endpoints” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Mont Blanc Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 蒙布朗跨境服務涉及兩端引道和管制，教材比較相同端點的洞內時間及整體等待而非單一最短車程。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「路線里程與端點」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cross-border service includes approaches and controls; compare in-tunnel time and total waiting between common endpoints rather than one shortest journey. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk. Compare options between identical endpoints and distinguish running bores, approaches and service galleries. Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Alignment chainage and endpoints” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：長度=17.2 km；速度=60 km/h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: length=17.2 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=17.2 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「路線里程與端點」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Alignment chainage and endpoints”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 服務邊界與路線代價
knowledge.text: 蒙布朗跨境服務涉及兩端引道和管制，教材比較相同端點的洞內時間及整體等待而非單一最短車程。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。
knowledge.textEn: Cross-border service includes approaches and controls; compare in-tunnel time and total waiting between common endpoints rather than one shortest journey. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「服務邊界與路線代價」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Service boundaries and alignment cost" is correct?
options: 最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
蒙布朗跨境服務涉及兩端引道和管制，教材比較相同端點的洞內時間及整體等待而非單一最短車程。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
optionsEn: The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
Cross-border service includes approaches and controls; compare in-tunnel time and total waiting between common endpoints rather than one shortest journey.
Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 蒙布朗跨境服務涉及兩端引道和管制，教材比較相同端點的洞內時間及整體等待而非單一最短車程。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Cross-border service includes approaches and controls; compare in-tunnel time and total waiting between common endpoints rather than one shortest journey. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「路線里程與端點」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Alignment chainage and endpoints” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：長度=17.2 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=17.2 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為18.92 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: length=17.2 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=17.2 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 18.92 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將正常行車和入口排隊時間分開紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record ordinary travel and entrance queue time separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：長度=17.2 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=17.2 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為18.92 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: length=17.2 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=17.2 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 18.92 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「服務邊界與路線代價」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Service boundaries and alignment cost", which statement holds?
options: 混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
原創教學假設：長度=17.2 km；速度=60 km/h。
optionsEn: Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
Original teaching assumptions: length=17.2 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=17.2 min.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：長度=17.2 km；速度=60 km/h。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: length=17.2 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=17.2 min. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「路線里程與端點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Alignment chainage and endpoints” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將正常行車和入口排隊時間分開紀錄。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record ordinary travel and entrance queue time separately. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：將正常行車和入口排隊時間分開紀錄。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Mont Blanc Tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Record ordinary travel and entrance queue time separately. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：隧道內暢通不代表兩端交通系統沒有瓶頸。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Free flow inside does not establish unconstrained approaches. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將正常行車和入口排隊時間分開紀錄。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Record ordinary travel and entrance queue time separately. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：將正常行車和入口排隊時間分開紀錄。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。
knowledge.textEn: For Mont Blanc Tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Record ordinary travel and entrance queue time separately. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.

quiz.question: 要驗證「服務邊界與路線代價」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Service boundaries and alignment cost"?
options: 將正常行車和入口排隊時間分開紀錄。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
集水坑總容積除以平均入流就是保證可用的反應時間。
optionsEn: Record ordinary travel and entrance queue time separately.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Gross sump volume divided by average inflow is a guaranteed response time.
quiz.explanation: 將正常行車和入口排隊時間分開紀錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record ordinary travel and entrance queue time separately. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「路線里程與端點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Alignment chainage and endpoints” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 隧道內暢通不代表兩端交通系統沒有瓶頸。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Free flow inside does not establish unconstrained approaches. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 隧道內暢通不代表兩端交通系統沒有瓶頸。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。
knowledge.textEn: Free flow inside does not establish unconstrained approaches. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「服務邊界與路線代價」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Service boundaries and alignment cost" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
隧道內暢通不代表兩端交通系統沒有瓶頸。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Free flow inside does not establish unconstrained approaches.
Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 隧道內暢通不代表兩端交通系統沒有瓶頸。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Free flow inside does not establish unconstrained approaches. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「風道摩擦壓損」如何影響蒙布朗隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Duct friction loss” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Mont Blanc Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 蒙布朗案例用來研究正常污染稀釋與假想火災控煙的不同目標，不能只提高風量就宣稱情境改善。風機提供壓差，實際風量由風道摩阻、局部損失、外風與其他風機共同決定。支路開關會重新分配整個網路，不能把額定風量直接加總；正常污染稀釋與火災控煙也有不同目標，需要分別建立受控邊界和故障情境。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「風道摩擦壓損」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Distinguish normal pollutant dilution from hypothetical fire smoke-control objectives; more airflow alone does not prove an improved scenario. Fans supply pressure, but actual flow follows friction, local losses, external wind and interactions with other fans. Switching a branch redistributes the network rather than simply adding rated flows. Routine dilution and fire smoke control have different objectives, so each needs explicit boundaries, operating states and failure cases rather than one universal flow target. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Duct friction loss” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=1020 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.1 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=1020 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.1 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=36.7583 Pa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「風道摩擦壓損」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Duct friction loss”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 通風網路與壓力損失
knowledge.text: 蒙布朗案例用來研究正常污染稀釋與假想火災控煙的不同目標，不能只提高風量就宣稱情境改善。風機提供壓差，實際風量由風道摩阻、局部損失、外風與其他風機共同決定。
knowledge.textEn: Distinguish normal pollutant dilution from hypothetical fire smoke-control objectives; more airflow alone does not prove an improved scenario. Fans supply pressure, but actual flow follows friction, local losses, external wind and interactions with other fans.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「通風網路與壓力損失」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
