混凝土抗壓強度合格就代表厚壁構件不會產生熱裂縫。
蒙布朗案例用來研究正常污染稀釋與假想火災控煙的不同目標，不能只提高風量就宣稱情境改善。
optionsEn: Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
Adequate compressive strength proves that thick concrete cannot develop thermal cracks.
Distinguish normal pollutant dilution from hypothetical fire smoke-control objectives; more airflow alone does not prove an improved scenario.
quiz.explanation: 蒙布朗案例用來研究正常污染稀釋與假想火災控煙的不同目標，不能只提高風量就宣稱情境改善。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Distinguish normal pollutant dilution from hypothetical fire smoke-control objectives; more airflow alone does not prove an improved scenario. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「風道摩擦壓損」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Duct friction loss” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=1020 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.1 m/s。Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=36.7583 Pa。僅把平均風速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為44.4775 Pa。邊界：定密度直管摩阻，局部損失及外風另計；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=1020 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.1 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=36.7583 Pa. Increasing only mean velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 44.4775 Pa. Boundary: Constant-density straight-duct friction; local loss and external wind are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在不同受控邊界下比較風向、門位及抽排分布。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare airflow direction, door states and extraction distribution under distinct controlled boundaries.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=1020 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.1 m/s。Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=36.7583 Pa。僅把平均風速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為44.4775 Pa。邊界：定密度直管摩阻，局部損失及外風另計；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=1020 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.1 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=36.7583 Pa. Increasing only mean velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 44.4775 Pa. Boundary: Constant-density straight-duct friction; local loss and external wind are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「通風網路與壓力損失」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ventilation network and pressure loss", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=1020 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.1 m/s。
照度越高就必然使隧道內所有物體更容易辨識。
設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless.
Higher illuminance necessarily makes every tunnel object easier to detect.
Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=1020 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.1 m/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=1020 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.1 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=36.7583 Pa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「風道摩擦壓損」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Duct friction loss” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在不同受控邊界下比較風向、門位及抽排分布。沿線同步量測靜壓與風速，記錄風門及其他風機狀態，再把實測工作點和風機曲線、網路壓損比較。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare airflow direction, door states and extraction distribution under distinct controlled boundaries. Measure pressure and velocity synchronously, record dampers and other fans, and compare the measured duty point with fan curves and network resistance. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「風道摩擦壓損」的交付需回答：在不同受控邊界下比較風向、門位及抽排分布。驗收採明確風門和車流邊界，維修改線後重新核對網路工作點，火災模式由防災責任工程師簽認而非沿用正常模式。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Mont Blanc Tunnel, the duct friction loss handover must address the following evidence: Compare airflow direction, door states and extraction distribution under distinct controlled boundaries. Commission with specified damper and traffic boundaries, recheck duty points after rerouting, and have the fire-safety engineer approve emergency modes independently.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：錯誤風向可能把煙帶向人員區，即使總風量增加。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Wrong airflow direction can carry smoke toward users despite increased total flow. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在不同受控邊界下比較風向、門位及抽排分布。沿線同步量測靜壓與風速，記錄風門及其他風機狀態，再把實測工作點和風機曲線、網路壓損比較。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Compare airflow direction, door states and extraction distribution under distinct controlled boundaries. Measure pressure and velocity synchronously, record dampers and other fans, and compare the measured duty point with fan curves and network resistance. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「風道摩擦壓損」的交付需回答：在不同受控邊界下比較風向、門位及抽排分布。驗收採明確風門和車流邊界，維修改線後重新核對網路工作點，火災模式由防災責任工程師簽認而非沿用正常模式。
knowledge.textEn: For Mont Blanc Tunnel, the duct friction loss handover must address the following evidence: Compare airflow direction, door states and extraction distribution under distinct controlled boundaries. Commission with specified damper and traffic boundaries, recheck duty points after rerouting, and have the fire-safety engineer approve emergency modes independently.

quiz.question: 要驗證「通風網路與壓力損失」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ventilation network and pressure loss"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
在不同受控邊界下比較風向、門位及抽排分布。
增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Compare airflow direction, door states and extraction distribution under distinct controlled boundaries.
Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
quiz.explanation: 在不同受控邊界下比較風向、門位及抽排分布。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare airflow direction, door states and extraction distribution under distinct controlled boundaries. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「風道摩擦壓損」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Duct friction loss” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 錯誤風向可能把煙帶向人員區，即使總風量增加。只看風機轉速會漏掉風門誤位或短路漏風，可能在總耗電增加時，真正需要的區段反而風量不足。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Wrong airflow direction can carry smoke toward users despite increased total flow. Fan speed alone misses a misplaced damper or leakage shortcut; total power may rise while the critical section receives less air. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：支路開關會重新分配整個網路，不能把額定風量直接加總；正常污染稀釋與火災控煙也有不同目標，需要分別建立受控邊界和故障情境。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Routine dilution and fire smoke control have different objectives, so each needs explicit boundaries, operating states and failure cases rather than one universal flow target.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 錯誤風向可能把煙帶向人員區，即使總風量增加。只看風機轉速會漏掉風門誤位或短路漏風，可能在總耗電增加時，真正需要的區段反而風量不足。

quiz.question: 在「通風網路與壓力損失」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ventilation network and pressure loss" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
混凝土抗壓強度合格就代表厚壁構件不會產生熱裂縫。
錯誤風向可能把煙帶向人員區，即使總風量增加。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Adequate compressive strength proves that thick concrete cannot develop thermal cracks.
Wrong airflow direction can carry smoke toward users despite increased total flow.
quiz.explanation: 錯誤風向可能把煙帶向人員區，即使總風量增加。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Wrong airflow direction can carry smoke toward users despite increased total flow. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「溫度拘束與構件裂縫」與「環向受力與接縫柔度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Thermal restraint and component cracking" and "Ring force and joint flexibility": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 溫度拘束與構件裂縫：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Thermal restraint and component cracking: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「拘束溫度應變」如何影響蒙布朗隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Restrained thermal strain” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Mont Blanc Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 假想受熱襯砌的熱膨脹拘束與混凝土剝落屬不同機制，蒙布朗教材只以線彈性式建立量級。厚壁構件在水化升溫後冷卻，若相鄰構件或基座限制收縮，熱應變會轉為拉應力。抗壓強度達標不等於抗裂合格，因為彈性模數成熟、徐變、溫度梯度與澆置順序都影響實際拘束；完全拘束彈性估算只能當量級上限比較。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「拘束溫度應變」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Restrained expansion and concrete spalling are different mechanisms; a linear-elastic exercise establishes scale without predicting actual fire damage. A thick element cools after hydration, and restraint from adjacent pours or its base converts contraction into tension. Compressive-strength compliance does not establish crack resistance because modulus development, creep, gradients and pour sequence influence restraint. A fully restrained elastic estimate is therefore a scale bound, not a prediction of actual cracking or residual stress. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Restrained thermal strain” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：線膨脹係數=1e-05 K⁻¹；溫差=23 K；彈性模數=25 GPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: expansion coefficient=1e-05 K⁻¹; temperature difference=23 K; elastic modulus=25 GPa. σ=EαΔT, GPa→MPa ×1000=5.75 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土抗壓強度合格就代表厚壁構件不會產生熱裂縫。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adequate compressive strength proves that thick concrete cannot develop thermal cracks." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「拘束溫度應變」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 溫度拘束與構件裂縫：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Thermal restraint and component cracking: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「拘束溫度應變」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Restrained thermal strain” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：線膨脹係數=1e-05 K⁻¹；溫差=23 K；彈性模數=25 GPa。σ=EαΔT, GPa→MPa ×1000=5.75 MPa。僅把溫差增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為6.325 MPa。邊界：完全拘束線彈性量級，未含徐變開裂和拘束鬆弛；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: expansion coefficient=1e-05 K⁻¹; temperature difference=23 K; elastic modulus=25 GPa. σ=EαΔT, GPa→MPa ×1000=5.75 MPa. Increasing only temperature difference by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 6.325 MPa. Boundary: Fully restrained linear-elastic scale without creep, cracking or restraint relaxation. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將溫度深度分布、含水和裂縫方向一起檢查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check temperature through depth, moisture and crack orientation together.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型

Increasing only temperature difference by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 6.325 MPa. Boundary: Fully restrained linear-elastic scale without creep, cracking or restraint relaxation. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「溫度拘束與構件裂縫」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

Original teaching assumptions: expansion coefficient=1e-05 K⁻¹; temperature difference=23 K; elastic modulus=25 GPa. σ=EαΔT, GPa→MPa ×1000=5.75 MPa.

steps.title: 溫度拘束與構件裂縫：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Thermal restraint and component cracking: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「拘束溫度應變」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Restrained thermal strain” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將溫度深度分布、含水和裂縫方向一起檢查。記錄核心表面溫度及同條件試體成熟度，將裂縫位置與溫差、拆模及鄰段澆置時間配對，檢查熱歷程是否被遺漏。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check temperature through depth, moisture and crack orientation together. Record core/surface temperature and matched-cured maturity, pairing cracks with temperature differences, formwork removal and adjacent pours to identify missing thermal history. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「拘束溫度應變」的交付需回答：將溫度深度分布、含水和裂縫方向一起檢查。澆置前核准溫度監測及養護方案，變更材料、拆模或澆置順序時重新檢查熱分析，將裂縫與接縫止水的責任一併交付。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Mont Blanc Tunnel, the restrained thermal strain handover must address the following evidence: Check temperature through depth, moisture and crack orientation together. Approve monitoring and curing before pours, revisit thermal analysis after material or sequence changes, and hand over crack and waterstop responsibilities together.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：均溫模型不能代表表層急熱梯度及剝落。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Uniform temperature cannot represent rapid surface gradients or spalling. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將溫度深度分布、含水和裂縫方向一起檢查。記錄核心表面溫度及同條件試體成熟度，將裂縫位置與溫差、拆模及鄰段澆置時間配對，檢查熱歷程是否被遺漏。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Check temperature through depth, moisture and crack orientation together. Record core/surface temperature and matched-cured maturity, pairing cracks with temperature differences, formwork removal and adjacent pours to identify missing thermal history. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「拘束溫度應變」的交付需回答：將溫度深度分布、含水和裂縫方向一起檢查。澆置前核准溫度監測及養護方案，變更材料、拆模或澆置順序時重新檢查熱分析，將裂縫與接縫止水的責任一併交付。
knowledge.textEn: For Mont Blanc Tunnel, the restrained thermal strain handover must address the following evidence: Check temperature through depth, moisture and crack orientation together. Approve monitoring and curing before pours, revisit thermal analysis after material or sequence changes, and hand over crack and waterstop responsibilities together.

quiz.question: 要驗證「溫度拘束與構件裂縫」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Thermal restraint and component cracking"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。

quiz.explanationEn: Check temperature through depth, moisture and crack orientation together. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 溫度拘束與構件裂縫：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Thermal restraint and component cracking: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「拘束溫度應變」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Restrained thermal strain” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 均溫模型不能代表表層急熱梯度及剝落。標準養護試體合格而現場過早冷卻，仍可能形成貫穿裂縫並影響止水；僅增加後續抗壓試驗無法重建失去的養護。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Uniform temperature cannot represent rapid surface gradients or spalling. Passing standard-cured specimens does not prevent through-cracking after rapid cooling, and more later strength tests cannot reconstruct inadequate curing. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：抗壓強度達標不等於抗裂合格，因為彈性模數成熟、徐變、溫度梯度與澆置順序都影響實際拘束；完全拘束彈性估算只能當量級上限比較。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A fully restrained elastic estimate is therefore a scale bound, not a prediction of actual cracking or residual stress.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土抗壓強度合格就代表厚壁構件不會產生熱裂縫。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adequate compressive strength proves that thick concrete cannot develop thermal cracks." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 均溫模型不能代表表層急熱梯度及剝落。標準養護試體合格而現場過早冷卻，仍可能形成貫穿裂縫並影響止水；僅增加後續抗壓試驗無法重建失去的養護。
knowledge.textEn: Uniform temperature cannot represent rapid surface gradients or spalling. Passing standard-cured specimens does not prevent through-cracking after rapid cooling, and more later strength tests cannot reconstruct inadequate curing.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「溫度拘束與構件裂縫」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Thermal restraint and component cracking" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 均溫模型不能代表表層急熱梯度及剝落。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
optionsEn: Uniform temperature cannot represent rapid surface gradients or spalling.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
quiz.explanation: 均溫模型不能代表表層急熱梯度及剝落。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Uniform temperature cannot represent rapid surface gradients or spalling. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ring force and joint flexibility: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「襯砌環向壓縮」如何影響蒙布朗隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lining hoop compression” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Mont Blanc Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 長期整修需區分原有缺陷與新病害，蒙布朗襯砌教學以幾何、材料和支承證據重建荷載路徑。圓形襯砌對均勻外壓可主要以環向壓縮抵抗，但接頭轉動、偏壓與背填空隙會引起彎矩。薄環膜應力只說明其中一條受力路徑；脫模、運輸、頂推及永久狀態的荷載不同，環片局部接觸與止水條件必須另外檢核。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「襯砌環向壓縮」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Refurbishment separates legacy defects from new deterioration using geometry, material and support evidence to reconstruct load paths. A circular lining resists uniform external pressure largely through hoop compression, but joint rotation, uneven load and backfill voids generate bending. Thin-ring membrane stress describes only one load path. Demoulding, transport, jacking and permanent states impose different actions, requiring separate checks of local segment contact and sealing rather than one permanent-load calculation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Lining hoop compression” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.56 MPa；半徑=3.3 m；厚度=0.35 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.56 MPa; radius=3.3 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=5.28 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「襯砌環向壓縮」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Lining hoop compression”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度
knowledge.text: 長期整修需區分原有缺陷與新病害，蒙布朗襯砌教學以幾何、材料和支承證據重建荷載路徑。圓形襯砌對均勻外壓可主要以環向壓縮抵抗，但接頭轉動、偏壓與背填空隙會引起彎矩。
knowledge.textEn: Refurbishment separates legacy defects from new deterioration using geometry, material and support evidence to reconstruct load paths. A circular lining resists uniform external pressure largely through hoop compression, but joint rotation, uneven load and backfill voids generate bending.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

照度越高就必然使隧道內所有物體更容易辨識。
optionsEn: Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
Refurbishment separates legacy defects from new deterioration using geometry, material and support evidence to reconstruct load paths.
Higher illuminance necessarily makes every tunnel object easier to detect.

steps.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ring force and joint flexibility: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「襯砌環向壓縮」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lining hoop compression” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.56 MPa；半徑=3.3 m；厚度=0.35 m。σθ=pr/t=5.28 MPa。僅把均勻外壓增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為5.808 MPa。邊界：薄圓環膜應力，不是接縫、偏壓或矩形框架解；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.56 MPa; radius=3.3 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=5.28 MPa. Increasing only uniform external pressure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 5.808 MPa. Boundary: Thin circular-ring membrane stress, not a joint, uneven-load or rectangular-frame solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照歷年裂縫圖、掃描斷面及滲水位置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare historical crack maps, scanned sections and leak locations.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「襯砌環向壓縮」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lining hoop compression” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照歷年裂縫圖、掃描斷面及滲水位置。將環形變形、接縫張開與應變和含接頭彈簧的模型比較，分開安裝後、背填後及水頭回升後的基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare historical crack maps, scanned sections and leak locations. Compare ring distortion, joint opening and strain with a joint-spring model, separating baselines after installation, grouting and head recovery. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.failure: 注意干擾：把所有新看見的裂縫當新產生會錯估劣化速率。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating newly observed cracks as newly formed overstates deterioration rate. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ring force and joint flexibility: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「襯砌環向壓縮」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lining hoop compression” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把所有新看見的裂縫當新產生會錯估劣化速率。局部脫空增加環片彎曲，裂縫未必代表混凝土平均強度不足；忽略接縫接觸會把補強方向導向錯誤位置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating newly observed cracks as newly formed overstates deterioration rate. Local voids increase bending, so cracks need not indicate inadequate mean concrete strength; neglecting joint contact can misdirect strengthening. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：薄環膜應力只說明其中一條受力路徑；脫模、運輸、頂推及永久狀態的荷載不同，環片局部接觸與止水條件必須另外檢核。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Demoulding, transport, jacking and permanent states impose different actions, requiring separate checks of local segment contact and sealing rather than one permanent-load calculation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把所有新看見的裂縫當新產生會錯估劣化速率。局部脫空增加環片彎曲，裂縫未必代表混凝土平均強度不足；忽略接縫接觸會把補強方向導向錯誤位置。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「環向受力與接縫柔度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ring force and joint flexibility" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把所有新看見的裂縫當新產生會錯估劣化速率。
照度越高就必然使隧道內所有物體更容易辨識。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Treating newly observed cracks as newly formed overstates deterioration rate.
Higher illuminance necessarily makes every tunnel object easier to detect.
quiz.explanation: 把所有新看見的裂縫當新產生會錯估劣化速率。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating newly observed cracks as newly formed overstates deterioration rate. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「視覺適應與路面亮度」與「疏散時間與分區可用性」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: 視覺適應與路面亮度：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「漫反射亮度」如何影響蒙布朗隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Diffuse luminance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Mont Blanc Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 事故和正常行車需要不同的視覺資訊，教材把路面照明與方向標示的可見性分開。駕駛從洞外進入洞內時視覺適應需要時間，照度並不等同從駕駛視角看到的亮度。路面反射、濕度、燈具配光及背景對比共同影響辨識；朗伯模型只示範理想漫反射，不能直接制定入口段燈具間距或真實道路安全值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「漫反射亮度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Normal driving and incident response need different visual information; distinguish road lighting from visibility of directional signs. Driver adaptation takes time when entering a tunnel, and illuminance is not the luminance seen from the driving position. Pavement reflection, wetness, luminaire distribution and background contrast affect detection. A Lambertian model illustrates ideal diffuse reflection only; it cannot establish entrance-zone spacing or actual road-safety limits without photometric and operational assessment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Diffuse luminance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：照度=106 lx；反射率=0.24 無因次。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: illuminance=106 lx; reflectance=0.24 dimensionless.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「照度越高就必然使隧道內所有物體更容易辨識。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Higher illuminance necessarily makes every tunnel object easier to detect." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「漫反射亮度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Diffuse luminance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 視覺適應與路面亮度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Visual adaptation and pavement luminance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「漫反射亮度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Diffuse luminance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 從停車人員和駕駛兩種視角核對標示及亮度。以駕駛視角的亮度量測配合照度網格，分別檢查乾濕路面與燈具衰減，保留外部天空條件。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check signs and luminance from stopped-user and driving viewpoints. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Hand over viewing geometry, pavement state and photometric calibration; test changes against approved scenarios rather than treating ideal reflection as an acceptance criterion.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：行車視角合格不保證下車後能辨識安全路徑。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Adequate driving visibility does not prove that a user on foot can identify the safe route. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 視覺適應與路面亮度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Visual adaptation and pavement luminance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「漫反射亮度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Diffuse luminance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 行車視角合格不保證下車後能辨識安全路徑。照度平均值合格仍可能存在低亮度障礙區或眩光，感測器沾污也會使調光系統低估外界亮度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Adequate driving visibility does not prove that a user on foot can identify the safe route. Acceptable average illuminance can coexist with dark obstacles or glare, while sensor contamination may bias adaptive lighting controls. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：路面反射、濕度、燈具配光及背景對比共同影響辨識；朗伯模型只示範理想漫反射，不能直接制定入口段燈具間距或真實道路安全值。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A Lambertian model illustrates ideal diffuse reflection only; it cannot establish entrance-zone spacing or actual road-safety limits without photometric and operational assessment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「照度越高就必然使隧道內所有物體更容易辨識。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Higher illuminance necessarily makes every tunnel object easier to detect." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.textEn: Adequate driving visibility does not prove that a user on foot can identify the safe route. Acceptable average illuminance can coexist with dark obstacles or glare, while sensor contamination may bias adaptive lighting controls.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「視覺適應與路面亮度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Visual adaptation and pavement luminance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
行車視角合格不保證下車後能辨識安全路徑。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
Adequate driving visibility does not prove that a user on foot can identify the safe route.
quiz.explanation: 行車視角合格不保證下車後能辨識安全路徑。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Adequate driving visibility does not prove that a user on foot can identify the safe route. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Required evacuation time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Mont Blanc Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 蒙布朗假想情境將偵知、決策、下車和步行分段，避免只以出口距離估算完整撤離。疏散時間包含辨識、反應、移動及排隊，不只由出口距離決定。人員速度會受煙熱、能見度及行動能力影響，安全判斷還要比較可用安全時間；橫通道存在但門或鄰孔不可用時，圖上的最短路線不一定能作實際選擇。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「所需疏散時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate detection, decision, vehicle exit and walking in a hypothetical Mont Blanc scenario rather than estimating total evacuation from distance alone. Evacuation includes detection, response, travel and queues, not merely distance to an exit. Smoke, visibility and mobility alter walking speed, while safety requires comparison with available safe time. A passage shown on a plan may be unusable because its door or receiving bore is unavailable, invalidating the nominal shortest route. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Required evacuation time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：前置時間=106 s；行走距離=300 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

quiz.question: 關於「疏散時間與分區可用性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.

quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：前置時間=106 s；行走距離=300 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=106 s; travel distance=300 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Evacuation time and zone availability: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「所需疏散時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Required evacuation time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 演練按時間戳辨認各階段，保留不同起始位置。以人流模擬或受控演練分辨前置時間、行走與門口排隊，核對每個出口接收區的可用狀態及通訊紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Timestamp each exercise stage and retain varied starting positions. Separate pre-movement, travel and doorway queues through simulation or controlled drills, checking receiving-zone availability and communication records for each exit. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「所需疏散時間」的交付需回答：演練按時間戳辨認各階段，保留不同起始位置。疏散模型保留人口、速度分布及出口狀態，演練改動由營運與防災責任者批准，教材算例不得當作現場指揮程序。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Mont Blanc Tunnel, the required evacuation time handover must address the following evidence: Timestamp each exercise stage and retain varied starting positions. Retain population, speed distribution and exit states; operations and fire-safety owners approve drill changes, and classroom calculations are not incident-command procedures.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：反應延遲被省略時，精確步速仍會產生偏低總時間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitted response delay produces a low total despite precise walking speed. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Timestamp each exercise stage and retain varied starting positions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

quiz.question: 要驗證「疏散時間與分區可用性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Evacuation time and zone availability"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
混凝土抗壓強度合格就代表厚壁構件不會產生熱裂縫。
演練按時間戳辨認各階段，保留不同起始位置。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Adequate compressive strength proves that thick concrete cannot develop thermal cracks.
Timestamp each exercise stage and retain varied starting positions.
quiz.explanation: 演練按時間戳辨認各階段，保留不同起始位置。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Timestamp each exercise stage and retain varied starting positions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Evacuation time and zone availability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「所需疏散時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Required evacuation time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 反應延遲被省略時，精確步速仍會產生偏低總時間。以最快成人速度套全部旅客會低估需求，若忽略接收孔受煙或車流影響，疏散可能移到另一個危險邊界。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitted response delay produces a low total despite precise walking speed. Applying the fastest adult speed to everyone understates demand; overlooking smoke or traffic in the receiving bore can transfer evacuees into another hazard. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：人員速度會受煙熱、能見度及行動能力影響，安全判斷還要比較可用安全時間；橫通道存在但門或鄰孔不可用時，圖上的最短路線不一定能作實際選擇。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A passage shown on a plan may be unusable because its door or receiving bore is unavailable, invalidating the nominal shortest route.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 反應延遲被省略時，精確步速仍會產生偏低總時間。以最快成人速度套全部旅客會低估需求，若忽略接收孔受煙或車流影響，疏散可能移到另一個危險邊界。
knowledge.textEn: Omitted response delay produces a low total despite precise walking speed. Applying the fastest adult speed to everyone understates demand; overlooking smoke or traffic in the receiving bore can transfer evacuees into another hazard.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「疏散時間與分區可用性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Evacuation time and zone availability" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 反應延遲被省略時，精確步速仍會產生偏低總時間。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。
optionsEn: Omitted response delay produces a low total despite precise walking speed.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
quiz.explanation: 反應延遲被省略時，精確步速仍會產生偏低總時間。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Omitted response delay produces a low total despite precise walking speed. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「設備備援與共同失效」與「停泵緩衝與有效集水容積」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Equipment redundancy and common failure" and "Outage buffer and effective sump volume": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 設備備援與共同失效：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Equipment redundancy and common failure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「系統不可用率」如何影響蒙布朗隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “System unavailability” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Mont Blanc Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 偵知、通訊和供電構成串聯依賴，教材研究兩套感測器共用控制器時為何不能直接平方失效率。兩套設備只有在故障近似獨立且切換可靠時，並聯才顯著降低不可用率。共用配電、控制軟體、冷卻或受淹位置會把獨立假設破壞；維修停用也改變當下配置，因此可靠度模型必須明列共有資源和設備狀態，不能只數備用台數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「系統不可用率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Detection, communication and power form dependencies; examine why two sensors on one controller do not justify squaring failure probability. Parallel equipment sharply reduces unavailability only when failures are approximately independent and transfer works. Shared power, software, cooling or flood exposure breaks that assumption. Planned maintenance also changes the available configuration, so reliability models must identify shared resources and states rather than count spare units or multiply unsupported independent probabilities. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “System unavailability” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：單機不可用率=0.023 無因次。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: single-unit unavailability=0.023 dimensionless.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「系統不可用率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “System unavailability”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 設備備援與共同失效
knowledge.text: 偵知、通訊和供電構成串聯依賴，教材研究兩套感測器共用控制器時為何不能直接平方失效率。兩套設備只有在故障近似獨立且切換可靠時，並聯才顯著降低不可用率。
knowledge.textEn: Detection, communication and power form dependencies; examine why two sensors on one controller do not justify squaring failure probability. Parallel equipment sharply reduces unavailability only when failures are approximately independent and transfer works.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「設備備援與共同失效」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Equipment redundancy and common failure" is correct?
options: 設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。
偵知、通訊和供電構成串聯依賴，教材研究兩套感測器共用控制器時為何不能直接平方失效率。
集水坑總容積除以平均入流就是保證可用的反應時間。
optionsEn: Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
Detection, communication and power form dependencies; examine why two sensors on one controller do not justify squaring failure probability.
Gross sump volume divided by average inflow is a guaranteed response time.
quiz.explanation: 偵知、通訊和供電構成串聯依賴，教材研究兩套感測器共用控制器時為何不能直接平方失效率。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Detection, communication and power form dependencies; examine why two sensors on one controller do not justify squaring failure probability. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 設備備援與共同失效：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Equipment redundancy and common failure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「系統不可用率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “System unavailability” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：單機不可用率=0.023 無因次。Uparallel=U²=0.000529 probability。僅把單機不可用率增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.00064009 probability。邊界：完全獨立並聯與完美切換，不含共同失效；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: single-unit unavailability=0.023 dimensionless. Uparallel=U²=0.000529 probability. Increasing only single-unit unavailability by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.00064009 probability. Boundary: Independent parallel units with perfect transfer, excluding common failures. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：沿告警鏈逐點確認共用設備和故障傳遞。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Trace shared equipment and fault propagation along the alarm chain.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：單機不可用率=0.023 無因次。Uparallel=U²=0.000529 probability。僅把單機不可用率增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.00064009 probability。邊界：完全獨立並聯與完美切換，不含共同失效；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: single-unit unavailability=0.023 dimensionless. Uparallel=U²=0.000529 probability. Increasing only single-unit unavailability by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.00064009 probability. Boundary: Independent parallel units with perfect transfer, excluding common failures. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「設備備援與共同失效」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Equipment redundancy and common failure", which statement holds?
options: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
原創教學假設：單機不可用率=0.023 無因次。
optionsEn: Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
Original teaching assumptions: single-unit unavailability=0.023 dimensionless.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：單機不可用率=0.023 無因次。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: single-unit unavailability=0.023 dimensionless. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 設備備援與共同失效：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Equipment redundancy and common failure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「系統不可用率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “System unavailability” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.

steps.instructionEn: Trace shared equipment and fault propagation along the alarm chain. Build a fault tree from the asset list, trace power, control and location to shared nodes, and test independence against incident and maintenance records. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Mont Blanc Tunnel, the system unavailability handover must address the following evidence: Trace shared equipment and fault propagation along the alarm chain. Attach the actual configuration and remaining redundancy to maintenance plans, update fault trees after shared-resource changes, and witness transfer tests jointly.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：共同控制器失效會同時切斷兩個看似獨立感測通道。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A common controller failure disables two apparently independent sensing channels. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 沿告警鏈逐點確認共用設備和故障傳遞。由設備清單畫出故障樹，將電源、控制及實體位置追到共同節點，並用事件及維修紀錄檢查獨立假設。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Trace shared equipment and fault propagation along the alarm chain. Build a fault tree from the asset list, trace power, control and location to shared nodes, and test independence against incident and maintenance records. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.textEn: For Mont Blanc Tunnel, the system unavailability handover must address the following evidence: Trace shared equipment and fault propagation along the alarm chain. Attach the actual configuration and remaining redundancy to maintenance plans, update fault trees after shared-resource changes, and witness transfer tests jointly.

quiz.question: 要驗證「設備備援與共同失效」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 設備備援與共同失效：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Equipment redundancy and common failure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「系統不可用率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “System unavailability” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 共同控制器失效會同時切斷兩個看似獨立感測通道。重複安裝卻共用單一供電可能在一次故障中全部停機，帳面可靠度很高但實際不可用時間沒有降低。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A common controller failure disables two apparently independent sensing channels. Duplicated equipment on one supply can fail together in a single event, leaving actual downtime unchanged despite optimistic calculated reliability. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：共用配電、控制軟體、冷卻或受淹位置會把獨立假設破壞；維修停用也改變當下配置，因此可靠度模型必須明列共有資源和設備狀態，不能只數備用台數。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Planned maintenance also changes the available configuration, so reliability models must identify shared resources and states rather than count spare units or multiply unsupported independent probabilities.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 共同控制器失效會同時切斷兩個看似獨立感測通道。重複安裝卻共用單一供電可能在一次故障中全部停機，帳面可靠度很高但實際不可用時間沒有降低。
knowledge.textEn: A common controller failure disables two apparently independent sensing channels. Duplicated equipment on one supply can fail together in a single event, leaving actual downtime unchanged despite optimistic calculated reliability.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「設備備援與共同失效」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

Gross sump volume divided by average inflow is a guaranteed response time.

steps.title: 停泵緩衝與有效集水容積：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Outage buffer and effective sump volume: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「剩餘集水容積」如何影響蒙布朗隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Remaining sump volume” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Mont Blanc Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 道路水、清洗水和滲水在假想集水系統中有不同時間尺度，教材分析同時進流對容量的影響。集水坑在泵停止後提供有限緩衝，剩餘容積需扣除初始水量、沉積及不可用死角。緩衝時間取決於淨入流，不是名牌抽水能力；警報延遲、備援切換與水量突增會消耗餘裕，排水電力又可能與其他安全設備共用失效原因。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「剩餘集水容積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Road water, wash water and seepage have different time scales; assess coincident inflows into a hypothetical sump. A sump offers finite buffering after pumps stop, with usable volume reduced by initial water, sediment and dead spaces. Buffer time depends on net inflow rather than pump nameplate capacity. Alarm delay, transfer time and inflow surges consume reserve, while shared electrical dependencies may disable drainage and other safety equipment together. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Remaining sump volume” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：有效剩餘容積=560 m³；淨入流=0.19 m³/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: usable reserve=560 m³; net inflow=0.19 m³/s. t=V/Q/60=49.1228 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「集水坑總容積除以平均入流就是保證可用的反應時間。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Gross sump volume divided by average inflow is a guaranteed response time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「剩餘集水容積」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Remaining sump volume”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 停泵緩衝與有效集水容積
knowledge.titleEn: Outage buffer and effective sump volume
knowledge.text: 道路水、清洗水和滲水在假想集水系統中有不同時間尺度，教材分析同時進流對容量的影響。集水坑在泵停止後提供有限緩衝，剩餘容積需扣除初始水量、沉積及不可用死角。
knowledge.textEn: Road water, wash water and seepage have different time scales; assess coincident inflows into a hypothetical sump. A sump offers finite buffering after pumps stop, with usable volume reduced by initial water, sediment and dead spaces.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：集水坑總容積除以平均入流就是保證可用的反應時間。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Gross sump volume divided by average inflow is a guaranteed response time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「停泵緩衝與有效集水容積」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
道路水、清洗水和滲水在假想集水系統中有不同時間尺度，教材分析同時進流對容量的影響。
optionsEn: Gross sump volume divided by average inflow is a guaranteed response time.
Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
Road water, wash water and seepage have different time scales; assess coincident inflows into a hypothetical sump.
quiz.explanation: 道路水、清洗水和滲水在假想集水系統中有不同時間尺度，教材分析同時進流對容量的影響。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Road water, wash water and seepage have different time scales; assess coincident inflows into a hypothetical sump. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 停泵緩衝與有效集水容積：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Outage buffer and effective sump volume: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「剩餘集水容積」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Remaining sump volume” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：有效剩餘容積=560 m³；淨入流=0.19 m³/s。t=V/Q/60=49.1228 min。僅把淨入流增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為44.6571 min。邊界：停泵固定入流，不含警報延遲及水量突增；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: usable reserve=560 m³; net inflow=0.19 m³/s. t=V/Q/60=49.1228 min. Increasing only net inflow by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 44.6571 min. Boundary: Constant inflow during outage, excluding alarm delay and inflow surges. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將清洗計畫與降雨和泵曲線一起閉合水量帳。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Close the balance using cleaning schedules, rainfall and pump curves.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Boundary: Constant inflow during outage, excluding alarm delay and inflow surges. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「剩餘集水容積」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 只依平日滲水選泵會漏掉清洗或事件排水尖峰。未扣除沉積的總容積會高估反應時間，若警報與抽水同失電，操作者可能在緩衝已耗盡後才得知水位上升。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
