Gross volume without sediment deduction overstates response time; shared loss of alarm and pumping power can hide rising water until the buffer is exhausted. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：緩衝時間取決於淨入流，不是名牌抽水能力；警報延遲、備援切換與水量突增會消耗餘裕，排水電力又可能與其他安全設備共用失效原因。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Alarm delay, transfer time and inflow surges consume reserve, while shared electrical dependencies may disable drainage and other safety equipment together.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「集水坑總容積除以平均入流就是保證可用的反應時間。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Gross sump volume divided by average inflow is a guaranteed response time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只依平日滲水選泵會漏掉清洗或事件排水尖峰。未扣除沉積的總容積會高估反應時間，若警報與抽水同失電，操作者可能在緩衝已耗盡後才得知水位上升。
knowledge.textEn: Sizing from routine seepage alone misses wash or incident-drainage peaks. Gross volume without sediment deduction overstates response time; shared loss of alarm and pumping power can hide rising water until the buffer is exhausted.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「停泵緩衝與有效集水容積」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Outage buffer and effective sump volume" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
只依平日滲水選泵會漏掉清洗或事件排水尖峰。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
Sizing from routine seepage alone misses wash or incident-drainage peaks.
quiz.explanation: 只依平日滲水選泵會漏掉清洗或事件排水尖峰。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Sizing from routine seepage alone misses wash or incident-drainage peaks. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」與「資產編碼與可追溯交接」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Shared access and transport bottlenecks" and "Asset identity and traceable handover": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「出渣運輸節拍」如何影響蒙布朗隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Muck-transport cycle” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Mont Blanc Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 蒙布朗整修窗口包含隔離、施工和重新測試，短期關閉的有效工時不能以日曆時間直接估算。多工作面只有在供電、通風、出渣與材料供應同步充足時才增加總產量。共用豎井或軌道形成串聯瓶頸，排隊和維修窗口會降低名目容量；緩衝區太大又可能侵占通行與救援空間，因此不能單純把各面產能相加。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「出渣運輸節拍」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Refurbishment windows include isolation, work and retesting; productive hours differ from calendar closure duration. Multiple headings increase output only when power, air, muck transport and materials support them together. Shared shafts or railways become serial bottlenecks, while queues and maintenance reduce nominal capacity. Large buffers may obstruct personnel and rescue access, so face capacities cannot simply be added without a network-level transport and storage check. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Muck-transport cycle” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=33 t；往返週期=38 min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=33 t; cycle=38 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「出渣運輸節拍」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Muck-transport cycle”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸
knowledge.text: 蒙布朗整修窗口包含隔離、施工和重新測試，短期關閉的有效工時不能以日曆時間直接估算。多工作面只有在供電、通風、出渣與材料供應同步充足時才增加總產量。
knowledge.textEn: Refurbishment windows include isolation, work and retesting; productive hours differ from calendar closure duration. Multiple headings increase output only when power, air, muck transport and materials support them together.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Shared access and transport bottlenecks" is correct?
options: 蒙布朗整修窗口包含隔離、施工和重新測試，短期關閉的有效工時不能以日曆時間直接估算。
增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
optionsEn: Refurbishment windows include isolation, work and retesting; productive hours differ from calendar closure duration.
Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
quiz.explanation: 蒙布朗整修窗口包含隔離、施工和重新測試，短期關閉的有效工時不能以日曆時間直接估算。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Refurbishment windows include isolation, work and retesting; productive hours differ from calendar closure duration. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「出渣運輸節拍」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Muck-transport cycle” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=33 t；往返週期=38 min。C=N payload 60/T=208.421 t/h。僅把往返週期增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為189.474 t/h。邊界：無排隊理想循環，並非共享路段實際產能；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=33 t; cycle=38 min. C=N payload 60/T=208.421 t/h. Increasing only cycle by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 189.474 t/h. Boundary: Ideal cycle without queues, not actual shared-route production. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用完整作業鏈核對材料搬運和恢復測試占時。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check material handling and restoration tests within the full work sequence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=33 t；往返週期=38 min。C=N payload 60/T=208.421 t/h。僅把往返週期增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為189.474 t/h。邊界：無排隊理想循環，並非共享路段實際產能；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=33 t; cycle=38 min. C=N payload 60/T=208.421 t/h. Increasing only cycle by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 189.474 t/h. Boundary: Ideal cycle without queues, not actual shared-route production. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Shared access and transport bottlenecks", which statement holds?
options: 風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=33 t；往返週期=38 min。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
optionsEn: Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=33 t; cycle=38 min.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=33 t；往返週期=38 min。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=33 t; cycle=38 min. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「出渣運輸節拍」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Muck-transport cycle” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用完整作業鏈核對材料搬運和恢復測試占時。以裝載質量、往返時間及排隊時間重建物流曲線，再核對緩衝占用、共用通道優先權與維修時段。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check material handling and restoration tests within the full work sequence. Reconstruct flow from payload, round-trip and queue times, then check buffer occupancy, shared-route priorities and maintenance periods. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「出渣運輸節拍」的交付需回答：用完整作業鏈核對材料搬運和恢復測試占時。每日排程同時標示人員、材料和維修的占用時段，任何物流改線先檢查通風與應變通道，不能只看運量提升。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Mont Blanc Tunnel, the muck-transport cycle handover must address the following evidence: Check material handling and restoration tests within the full work sequence. Schedules show personnel, materials and maintenance occupancy together; rerouting first checks ventilation and emergency access rather than only throughput gains.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：省略重測會留下設備已安裝但未證明可用的狀態。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitted retesting leaves installed equipment without demonstrated availability. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用完整作業鏈核對材料搬運和恢復測試占時。以裝載質量、往返時間及排隊時間重建物流曲線，再核對緩衝占用、共用通道優先權與維修時段。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Check material handling and restoration tests within the full work sequence. Reconstruct flow from payload, round-trip and queue times, then check buffer occupancy, shared-route priorities and maintenance periods. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「出渣運輸節拍」的交付需回答：用完整作業鏈核對材料搬運和恢復測試占時。每日排程同時標示人員、材料和維修的占用時段，任何物流改線先檢查通風與應變通道，不能只看運量提升。
knowledge.textEn: For Mont Blanc Tunnel, the muck-transport cycle handover must address the following evidence: Check material handling and restoration tests within the full work sequence. Schedules show personnel, materials and maintenance occupancy together; rerouting first checks ventilation and emergency access rather than only throughput gains.

quiz.question: 要驗證「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Shared access and transport bottlenecks"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
用完整作業鏈核對材料搬運和恢復測試占時。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
Check material handling and restoration tests within the full work sequence.
quiz.explanation: 用完整作業鏈核對材料搬運和恢復測試占時。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check material handling and restoration tests within the full work sequence. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「出渣運輸節拍」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Muck-transport cycle” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 省略重測會留下設備已安裝但未證明可用的狀態。把理想往返時間當全天常數會忽略交會等待與卸料堵塞，導致工作面停工或把材料堆入必要通道。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitted retesting leaves installed equipment without demonstrated availability. Treating an ideal cycle as constant all day misses passing delays and unloading blockages, stopping headings or pushing material into essential access space. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：共用豎井或軌道形成串聯瓶頸，排隊和維修窗口會降低名目容量；緩衝區太大又可能侵占通行與救援空間，因此不能單純把各面產能相加。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 省略重測會留下設備已安裝但未證明可用的狀態。把理想往返時間當全天常數會忽略交會等待與卸料堵塞，導致工作面停工或把材料堆入必要通道。
knowledge.textEn: Omitted retesting leaves installed equipment without demonstrated availability. Treating an ideal cycle as constant all day misses passing delays and unloading blockages, stopping headings or pushing material into essential access space.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Shared access and transport bottlenecks" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 省略重測會留下設備已安裝但未證明可用的狀態。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
optionsEn: Omitted retesting leaves installed equipment without demonstrated availability.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
quiz.explanation: 省略重測會留下設備已安裝但未證明可用的狀態。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Omitted retesting leaves installed equipment without demonstrated availability. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「資產資料完整度」如何影響蒙布朗隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Asset-record completeness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Mont Blanc Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 跨境營運資料需讓事件時間、設備狀態與工單互相對應，蒙布朗教材要求保留事件版本而非覆寫。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「資產資料完整度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cross-border records must align event times, asset states and work orders while preserving revisions instead of overwriting history. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision. Drawings without change history cannot distinguish replacement from deterioration. Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Asset-record completeness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：設備總數=113 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=113 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=85.8407 %.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「資產資料完整度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Asset-record completeness”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接
knowledge.text: 跨境營運資料需讓事件時間、設備狀態與工單互相對應，蒙布朗教材要求保留事件版本而非覆寫。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。
knowledge.textEn: Cross-border records must align event times, asset states and work orders while preserving revisions instead of overwriting history. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「資產編碼與可追溯交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Asset identity and traceable handover" is correct?
options: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
跨境營運資料需讓事件時間、設備狀態與工單互相對應，蒙布朗教材要求保留事件版本而非覆寫。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
Cross-border records must align event times, asset states and work orders while preserving revisions instead of overwriting history.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 跨境營運資料需讓事件時間、設備狀態與工單互相對應，蒙布朗教材要求保留事件版本而非覆寫。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Cross-border records must align event times, asset states and work orders while preserving revisions instead of overwriting history. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「資產資料完整度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Asset-record completeness” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：設備總數=113 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=85.8407 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為84.4248 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=113 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=85.8407 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 84.4248 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：抽查一個事件從偵知到維修完成的資料鏈。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Trace one event from detection through maintenance completion.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：設備總數=113 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=85.8407 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為84.4248 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=113 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=85.8407 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 84.4248 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「資產編碼與可追溯交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Asset identity and traceable handover", which statement holds?
options: 混凝土抗壓強度合格就代表厚壁構件不會產生熱裂縫。
照度越高就必然使隧道內所有物體更容易辨識。
原創教學假設：設備總數=113 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。
optionsEn: Adequate compressive strength proves that thick concrete cannot develop thermal cracks.
Higher illuminance necessarily makes every tunnel object easier to detect.
Original teaching assumptions: asset count=113 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=85.8407 %.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：設備總數=113 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=113 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=85.8407 %. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「資產資料完整度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Asset-record completeness” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 抽查一個事件從偵知到維修完成的資料鏈。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Trace one event from detection through maintenance completion. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：抽查一個事件從偵知到維修完成的資料鏈。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Mont Blanc Tunnel, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Trace one event from detection through maintenance completion. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：時鐘不同步會顛倒事件順序而誤導根因分析。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unsynchronised clocks reverse apparent event order and mislead root-cause analysis. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 抽查一個事件從偵知到維修完成的資料鏈。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Trace one event from detection through maintenance completion. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：抽查一個事件從偵知到維修完成的資料鏈。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。
knowledge.textEn: For Mont Blanc Tunnel, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Trace one event from detection through maintenance completion. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.

quiz.question: 要驗證「資產編碼與可追溯交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Asset identity and traceable handover"?
options: 抽查一個事件從偵知到維修完成的資料鏈。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。
optionsEn: Trace one event from detection through maintenance completion.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
quiz.explanation: 抽查一個事件從偵知到維修完成的資料鏈。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Trace one event from detection through maintenance completion. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「資產資料完整度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Asset-record completeness” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 時鐘不同步會顛倒事件順序而誤導根因分析。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unsynchronised clocks reverse apparent event order and mislead root-cause analysis. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 時鐘不同步會顛倒事件順序而誤導根因分析。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。
knowledge.textEn: Unsynchronised clocks reverse apparent event order and mislead root-cause analysis. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「資產編碼與可追溯交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Asset identity and traceable handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
時鐘不同步會顛倒事件順序而誤導根因分析。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Unsynchronised clocks reverse apparent event order and mislead root-cause analysis.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 時鐘不同步會顛倒事件順序而誤導根因分析。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Unsynchronised clocks reverse apparent event order and mislead root-cause analysis. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 弗雷瑞斯公路隧道
summary: 法國交通主管機關列弗雷瑞斯原隧道12.87公里、1980年營運，並於2025年公告第二孔開通活動。本課不把原始單孔狀態當成永久現況，而以新舊孔轉換為主軸，研究重車交通、岩體、通風隔離、跨孔救援與設備版本，建立分階段可驗證的營運模型。
summaryEn: The French transport ministry records the original Frejus tunnel as 12.87 km, in service from 1980, and announced the second-tube opening event in 2025. The course does not treat the original single-bore arrangement as permanent. It studies staged transfer, freight traffic, rock behaviour, airflow isolation, cross-bore rescue and equipment revisions.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創綜合審查：先計算「破碎帶連通與預報更新」，再獨立計算「通風網路與壓力損失」。原創教學假設：滲透係數=5e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=340 m²。Q=k i A=0.00357 m³/s。僅把滲透係數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.003927 m³/s。邊界：均質飽和達西流，不代表裂隙集中流；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=1060 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.5 m/s。Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=48.6937 Pa。僅把平均風速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為58.9194 Pa。邊界：定密度直管摩阻，局部損失及外風另計；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated review: first calculate fault connectivity and forecast updating, then independently calculate ventilation network and pressure loss. Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=5e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=340 m². Q=k i A=0.00357 m³/s. Increasing only conductivity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.003927 m³/s. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated Darcy flow, not concentrated fracture flow. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=1060 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.5 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=48.6937 Pa. Increasing only mean velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 58.9194 Pa. Boundary: Constant-density straight-duct friction; local loss and external wind are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「服務邊界與路線代價」與「破碎帶連通與預報更新」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Service boundaries and alignment cost" and "Fault connectivity and forecast updating": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「路線里程與端點」如何影響弗雷瑞斯公路隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Alignment chainage and endpoints” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Frejus Road Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 弗雷瑞斯由原孔到第二孔的配置變化需先定義階段，教材把道路容量、救援通道和施工空間分開。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「路線里程與端點」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Define configuration stages before comparing the original and second tubes, separating road capacity, rescue access and construction space. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk. Compare options between identical endpoints and distinguish running bores, approaches and service galleries. Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Alignment chainage and endpoints” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：長度=17.6 km；速度=60 km/h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: length=17.6 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=17.6 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「路線里程與端點」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Alignment chainage and endpoints”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 服務邊界與路線代價
knowledge.text: 弗雷瑞斯由原孔到第二孔的配置變化需先定義階段，教材把道路容量、救援通道和施工空間分開。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。
knowledge.textEn: Define configuration stages before comparing the original and second tubes, separating road capacity, rescue access and construction space. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「服務邊界與路線代價」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Service boundaries and alignment cost" is correct?
options: 最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
弗雷瑞斯由原孔到第二孔的配置變化需先定義階段，教材把道路容量、救援通道和施工空間分開。
岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
optionsEn: The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
Define configuration stages before comparing the original and second tubes, separating road capacity, rescue access and construction space.
Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
quiz.explanation: 弗雷瑞斯由原孔到第二孔的配置變化需先定義階段，教材把道路容量、救援通道和施工空間分開。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Define configuration stages before comparing the original and second tubes, separating road capacity, rescue access and construction space. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「路線里程與端點」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Alignment chainage and endpoints” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：長度=17.6 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=17.6 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為19.36 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: length=17.6 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=17.6 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 19.36 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每個方案附日期和孔別，不混用不同時期示意圖。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Attach dates and bore identifiers to each option and avoid mixing historical diagrams.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：長度=17.6 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=17.6 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為19.36 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: length=17.6 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=17.6 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 19.36 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「服務邊界與路線代價」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Service boundaries and alignment cost", which statement holds?
options: 支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
原創教學假設：長度=17.6 km；速度=60 km/h。
optionsEn: Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
Original teaching assumptions: length=17.6 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=17.6 min.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：長度=17.6 km；速度=60 km/h。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: length=17.6 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=17.6 min. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「路線里程與端點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Alignment chainage and endpoints” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每個方案附日期和孔別，不混用不同時期示意圖。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Attach dates and bore identifiers to each option and avoid mixing historical diagrams. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：每個方案附日期和孔別，不混用不同時期示意圖。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Frejus Road Tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Attach dates and bore identifiers to each option and avoid mixing historical diagrams. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把舊單孔描述用於新配置會錯估對向衝突及逃生路線。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Applying an old single-bore description misstates opposing traffic and escape routes. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每個方案附日期和孔別，不混用不同時期示意圖。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Attach dates and bore identifiers to each option and avoid mixing historical diagrams. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：每個方案附日期和孔別，不混用不同時期示意圖。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。
knowledge.textEn: For Frejus Road Tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Attach dates and bore identifiers to each option and avoid mixing historical diagrams. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.

quiz.question: 要驗證「服務邊界與路線代價」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Service boundaries and alignment cost"?
options: 每個方案附日期和孔別，不混用不同時期示意圖。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
optionsEn: Attach dates and bore identifiers to each option and avoid mixing historical diagrams.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
quiz.explanation: 每個方案附日期和孔別，不混用不同時期示意圖。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Attach dates and bore identifiers to each option and avoid mixing historical diagrams. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「路線里程與端點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Alignment chainage and endpoints” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把舊單孔描述用於新配置會錯估對向衝突及逃生路線。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Applying an old single-bore description misstates opposing traffic and escape routes. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把舊單孔描述用於新配置會錯估對向衝突及逃生路線。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。
knowledge.textEn: Applying an old single-bore description misstates opposing traffic and escape routes. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「服務邊界與路線代價」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Service boundaries and alignment cost" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把舊單孔描述用於新配置會錯估對向衝突及逃生路線。
岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Applying an old single-bore description misstates opposing traffic and escape routes.
Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
quiz.explanation: 把舊單孔描述用於新配置會錯估對向衝突及逃生路線。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Applying an old single-bore description misstates opposing traffic and escape routes. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Fault connectivity and forecast updating: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「破碎帶連通性」如何影響弗雷瑞斯公路隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fault-zone connectivity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Frejus Road Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 平行第二孔可利用原孔資料但不能省略新探查，弗雷瑞斯教材研究斜交節理在兩孔位置的差異。斷層帶可以含很硬的岩塊，但整體變形與湧水常由填充節理和連通裂隙控制。單一岩芯強度不能代表整個掌子面；超前鑽孔、出水變化與揭露地質須回饋同一里程模型，預報則應保留不同情境及其證據權重。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「破碎帶連通性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The second tube can use first-bore records without replacing new investigation; examine oblique joints crossing each bore at different positions. A fault zone may contain strong intact blocks while filled joints and connected fractures govern its bulk deformation and inflow. One core strength does not represent the entire face. Probe records, water response and exposed geology must update a common chainage model, preserving competing interpretations and their evidential weight rather than treating a forecast as certainty. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fault-zone connectivity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：滲透係數=5e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=340 m²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=5e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=340 m².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「破碎帶連通性」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Fault-zone connectivity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新
knowledge.text: 平行第二孔可利用原孔資料但不能省略新探查，弗雷瑞斯教材研究斜交節理在兩孔位置的差異。斷層帶可以含很硬的岩塊，但整體變形與湧水常由填充節理和連通裂隙控制。
knowledge.textEn: The second tube can use first-bore records without replacing new investigation; examine oblique joints crossing each bore at different positions. A fault zone may contain strong intact blocks while filled joints and connected fractures govern its bulk deformation and inflow.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「破碎帶連通與預報更新」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fault connectivity and forecast updating" is correct?

知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。
平行第二孔可利用原孔資料但不能省略新探查，弗雷瑞斯教材研究斜交節理在兩孔位置的差異。
optionsEn: Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction.
The second tube can use first-bore records without replacing new investigation; examine oblique joints crossing each bore at different positions.
quiz.explanation: 平行第二孔可利用原孔資料但不能省略新探查，弗雷瑞斯教材研究斜交節理在兩孔位置的差異。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The second tube can use first-bore records without replacing new investigation; examine oblique joints crossing each bore at different positions. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fault connectivity and forecast updating: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「破碎帶連通性」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fault-zone connectivity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：滲透係數=5e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=340 m²。Q=k i A=0.00357 m³/s。僅把滲透係數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.003927 m³/s。邊界：均質飽和達西流，不代表裂隙集中流；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=5e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=340 m². Q=k i A=0.00357 m³/s. Increasing only conductivity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.003927 m³/s. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated Darcy flow, not concentrated fracture flow. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將構造方位投影到兩孔里程，再用新揭露驗證。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Project structural orientation onto both chainages and test against new exposures.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「破碎帶連通與預報更新」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
照度越高就必然使隧道內所有物體更容易辨識。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=5e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=340 m².
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
Higher illuminance necessarily makes every tunnel object easier to detect.

steps.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fault connectivity and forecast updating: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「破碎帶連通性」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fault-zone connectivity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將構造方位投影到兩孔里程，再用新揭露驗證。將岩心回收、裂隙方位與出水曲線按里程對齊，用未參與建模的孔段作交叉檢驗，檢查是否只擬合已知資料。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Project structural orientation onto both chainages and test against new exposures. Align recovery, fracture orientation and inflow by chainage; test the interpretation against a withheld borehole interval to detect fitting only the known observations. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「破碎帶連通性」的交付需回答：將構造方位投影到兩孔里程，再用新揭露驗證。每次地質模型更新保留舊版與新增證據，差異由地質及支護設計者共同判讀，施工條件改變需重新確認核准範圍。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Frejus Road Tunnel, the fault-zone connectivity handover must address the following evidence: Project structural orientation onto both chainages and test against new exposures. Retain previous interpretations and new evidence at every update; geology and support designers jointly interpret differences and reconfirm approved bounds when ground conditions change.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：按相同里程直接配對地質會忽略斜交造成的位置差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Matching geology at equal chainage ignores offsets caused by oblique structures. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「破碎帶連通與預報更新」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fault connectivity and forecast updating"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
將構造方位投影到兩孔里程，再用新揭露驗證。
設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Project structural orientation onto both chainages and test against new exposures.
Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
quiz.explanation: 將構造方位投影到兩孔里程，再用新揭露驗證。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Project structural orientation onto both chainages and test against new exposures. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fault connectivity and forecast updating: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「破碎帶連通性」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fault-zone connectivity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 按相同里程直接配對地質會忽略斜交造成的位置差。只用完整岩石強度會漏掉軟弱填充物，可能在看似堅硬的地層中出現收斂加快、支護過載或水量突增。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Matching geology at equal chainage ignores offsets caused by oblique structures. Intact strength alone misses weak infill, allowing accelerating convergence, support overload or sudden inflow in ground that superficially appears strong. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：單一岩芯強度不能代表整個掌子面；超前鑽孔、出水變化與揭露地質須回饋同一里程模型，預報則應保留不同情境及其證據權重。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Probe records, water response and exposed geology must update a common chainage model, preserving competing interpretations and their evidential weight rather than treating a forecast as certainty.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 按相同里程直接配對地質會忽略斜交造成的位置差。只用完整岩石強度會漏掉軟弱填充物，可能在看似堅硬的地層中出現收斂加快、支護過載或水量突增。
knowledge.textEn: Matching geology at equal chainage ignores offsets caused by oblique structures. Intact strength alone misses weak infill, allowing accelerating convergence, support overload or sudden inflow in ground that superficially appears strong.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「破碎帶連通與預報更新」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fault connectivity and forecast updating" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。
按相同里程直接配對地質會忽略斜交造成的位置差。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction.
Matching geology at equal chainage ignores offsets caused by oblique structures.
quiz.explanation: 按相同里程直接配對地質會忽略斜交造成的位置差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Matching geology at equal chainage ignores offsets caused by oblique structures. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「覆土應力與洞壁重分配」與「支護啟動與變形容量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cover stress and wall redistribution" and "Support activation and deformation capacity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 覆土應力與洞壁重分配：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cover stress and wall redistribution: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「洞壁切向應力」如何影響弗雷瑞斯公路隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tangential wall stress” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Frejus Road Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 第二孔開挖與原孔營運並存時需檢查岩柱應力重分配，單孔覆土估算只是起點。開挖使岩體洞壁失去徑向拘束，遠場荷載轉移到周圍岩體，局部切向應力可能升高。圓孔彈性解可辨識量級，但節理、非圓斷面、塑性區與原位應力比會改變峰值位置，不能只用覆土重量推定全部三維應力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「洞壁切向應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When excavation coexists with first-bore operation, examine pillar stress redistribution beyond a single-hole cover estimate. Excavation removes radial confinement at the wall and transfers load through the surrounding rock, potentially raising local tangential stress. An elastic circular-hole solution identifies scale, but joints, noncircular geometry, yielding and the in-situ stress ratio alter the peak location. Cover weight alone cannot establish the complete three-dimensional stress state or support demand. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Tangential wall stress” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：覆土深度=920 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: cover=920 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=71.76 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「洞壁切向應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Tangential wall stress”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: When excavation coexists with first-bore operation, examine pillar stress redistribution beyond a single-hole cover estimate. Excavation removes radial confinement at the wall and transfers load through the surrounding rock, potentially raising local tangential stress.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cover stress and wall redistribution" is correct?
options: 第二孔開挖與原孔營運並存時需檢查岩柱應力重分配，單孔覆土估算只是起點。
知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
optionsEn: When excavation coexists with first-bore operation, examine pillar stress redistribution beyond a single-hole cover estimate.

Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「洞壁切向應力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tangential wall stress” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：覆土深度=920 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。σθ,max=3γH/1000=71.76 MPa。僅把覆土深度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為78.936 MPa。邊界：無支承彈性圓孔，僅垂直遠場壓縮且水平遠場應力為零時，側壁最大環向壓應力；不是任意位置應力或完整三維原位解；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: cover=920 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=71.76 MPa. Increasing only cover by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 78.936 MPa. Boundary: Maximum tangential compression at the sidewalls of an unsupported elastic circular hole under vertical uniaxial remote loading with zero horizontal remote stress; not stress at any point or the complete three-dimensional in-situ state. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把原孔位移與新掌子面距離對齊，排除溫度漂移。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align old-bore movement with new-face distance while excluding thermal drift.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Boundary: Maximum tangential compression at the sidewalls of an unsupported elastic circular hole under vertical uniaxial remote loading with zero horizontal remote stress; not stress at any point or the complete three-dimensional in-situ state. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「覆土應力與洞壁重分配」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
原創教學假設：覆土深度=920 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。

optionsEn: Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
Original teaching assumptions: cover=920 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=71.76 MPa.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：覆土深度=920 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: cover=920 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=71.76 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 覆土應力與洞壁重分配：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cover stress and wall redistribution: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「洞壁切向應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tangential wall stress” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把原孔位移與新掌子面距離對齊，排除溫度漂移。將原位應力量測、岩石試驗及洞壁破壞方位相互比較，再用多點伸長計檢查變形是否與所假設應力方向一致。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align old-bore movement with new-face distance while excluding thermal drift. Compare in-situ stress measurements, rock tests and wall-damage orientation, then use multipoint extensometers to test consistency with the assumed stress directions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「洞壁切向應力」的交付需回答：把原孔位移與新掌子面距離對齊，排除溫度漂移。保留應力模型的座標、邊界和材料假設，量測與預測不符時先核對代表性，再由岩力設計者選擇非線性或節理模型。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Frejus Road Tunnel, the tangential wall stress handover must address the following evidence: Align old-bore movement with new-face distance while excluding thermal drift. Record stress-model coordinates, boundaries and material assumptions; when observations disagree, check representativeness before the rock designer selects nonlinear or jointed models.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未扣溫度的位移可能被誤判成新孔造成的地盤作用。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Uncorrected thermal movement can be misattributed to excavation interaction. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Compare in-situ stress measurements, rock tests and wall-damage orientation, then use multipoint extensometers to test consistency with the assumed stress directions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.text: 本案「洞壁切向應力」的交付需回答：把原孔位移與新掌子面距離對齊，排除溫度漂移。保留應力模型的座標、邊界和材料假設，量測與預測不符時先核對代表性，再由岩力設計者選擇非線性或節理模型。

quiz.question: 要驗證「覆土應力與洞壁重分配」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cover stress and wall redistribution"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
把原孔位移與新掌子面距離對齊，排除溫度漂移。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
Align old-bore movement with new-face distance while excluding thermal drift.
quiz.explanation: 把原孔位移與新掌子面距離對齊，排除溫度漂移。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Align old-bore movement with new-face distance while excluding thermal drift. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 覆土應力與洞壁重分配：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cover stress and wall redistribution: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「洞壁切向應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tangential wall stress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未扣溫度的位移可能被誤判成新孔造成的地盤作用。把彈性峰值直接當岩體強度可能誤判支護需求；相反地忽略剝落或擠壓也會讓局部破壞逐步侵入淨空。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Uncorrected thermal movement can be misattributed to excavation interaction. Equating an elastic peak with rock-mass strength misjudges support demand; overlooking spalling or squeezing lets damage progressively consume clearance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：圓孔彈性解可辨識量級，但節理、非圓斷面、塑性區與原位應力比會改變峰值位置，不能只用覆土重量推定全部三維應力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Cover weight alone cannot establish the complete three-dimensional stress state or support demand.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 未扣溫度的位移可能被誤判成新孔造成的地盤作用。把彈性峰值直接當岩體強度可能誤判支護需求；相反地忽略剝落或擠壓也會讓局部破壞逐步侵入淨空。
knowledge.textEn: Uncorrected thermal movement can be misattributed to excavation interaction. Equating an elastic peak with rock-mass strength misjudges support demand; overlooking spalling or squeezing lets damage progressively consume clearance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「覆土應力與洞壁重分配」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cover stress and wall redistribution" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 未扣溫度的位移可能被誤判成新孔造成的地盤作用。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
optionsEn: Uncorrected thermal movement can be misattributed to excavation interaction.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
quiz.explanation: 未扣溫度的位移可能被誤判成新孔造成的地盤作用。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Uncorrected thermal movement can be misattributed to excavation interaction. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「支護安裝時點」如何影響弗雷瑞斯公路隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Support activation time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Frejus Road Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 弗雷瑞斯新舊支護設計背景不同，教材比較荷載啟動時點及長期劣化，不只比較材料強度。支護荷載由開挖釋放量和支護啟動時間共同決定，越早安裝不一定讓構件受力越小。地盤反力與支護曲線必須連同掌子面距離及封閉順序理解；擠壓性地層還需保留變形容量，不能只追求高剛度與高材料強度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「支護安裝時點」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: New and old support have different histories; compare activation time and ageing rather than material strength alone. Support load depends on stress release and activation time, so earlier installation does not necessarily reduce member forces. Interpret ground-reaction and support curves together with distance from the face and closure sequence. Squeezing ground also needs deformation capacity; high stiffness and material strength alone do not guarantee a compatible support response. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Support activation time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：局部剛度=44 kN/mm；位移=8 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=44 kN/mm; movement=8 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「支護安裝時點」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Support activation time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 支護啟動與變形容量
knowledge.text: 弗雷瑞斯新舊支護設計背景不同，教材比較荷載啟動時點及長期劣化，不只比較材料強度。支護荷載由開挖釋放量和支護啟動時間共同決定，越早安裝不一定讓構件受力越小。
knowledge.textEn: New and old support have different histories; compare activation time and ageing rather than material strength alone. Support load depends on stress release and activation time, so earlier installation does not necessarily reduce member forces.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「支護啟動與變形容量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Support activation and deformation capacity" is correct?
options: 支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
弗雷瑞斯新舊支護設計背景不同，教材比較荷載啟動時點及長期劣化，不只比較材料強度。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
optionsEn: Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
New and old support have different histories; compare activation time and ageing rather than material strength alone.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
quiz.explanation: 弗雷瑞斯新舊支護設計背景不同，教材比較荷載啟動時點及長期劣化，不只比較材料強度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: New and old support have different histories; compare activation time and ageing rather than material strength alone. The other options are common misconceptions.
