optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Reconstruct cutting, erection, maintenance and transport over complete shifts.
quiz.explanation: 以完整班次重建切削、拼裝、保養和運輸時間帳。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconstruct cutting, erection, maintenance and transport over complete shifts. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 掘進利用率與設備停時：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Boring utilisation and equipment downtime: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「有效掘進利用率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Effective boring utilisation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 最佳機器日進尺不能直接代表整個工程平均產能。只提高瞬時進尺可能使出渣或刀具超出有效工況，短暫改善後增加停機，平均進尺和零件壽命反而下降。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: The best machine day does not represent project-average production. Higher instantaneous advance can overload cutters or muck transport and create longer stoppages that reduce average progress and component life. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 最佳機器日進尺不能直接代表整個工程平均產能。只提高瞬時進尺可能使出渣或刀具超出有效工況，短暫改善後增加停機，平均進尺和零件壽命反而下降。
knowledge.textEn: The best machine day does not represent project-average production. Higher instantaneous advance can overload cutters or muck transport and create longer stoppages that reduce average progress and component life.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「掘進利用率與設備停時」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Boring utilisation and equipment downtime" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 最佳機器日進尺不能直接代表整個工程平均產能。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
optionsEn: The best machine day does not represent project-average production.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
quiz.explanation: 最佳機器日進尺不能直接代表整個工程平均產能。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: The best machine day does not represent project-average production. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」與「控制網與貫通誤差」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Shared access and transport bottlenecks" and "Control network and breakthrough error": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「出渣運輸節拍」如何影響布倫納基線隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Muck-transport cycle” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Brenner Base Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 側向施工入口和先進坑共用運輸網，教材研究一個出渣節點故障如何影響多工作面。多工作面只有在供電、通風、出渣與材料供應同步充足時才增加總產量。共用豎井或軌道形成串聯瓶頸，排隊和維修窗口會降低名目容量；緩衝區太大又可能侵占通行與救援空間，因此不能單純把各面產能相加。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「出渣運輸節拍」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Side accesses and exploratory galleries form a shared network; examine how one spoil-node outage propagates to several headings. Multiple headings increase output only when power, air, muck transport and materials support them together. Shared shafts or railways become serial bottlenecks, while queues and maintenance reduce nominal capacity. Large buffers may obstruct personnel and rescue access, so face capacities cannot simply be added without a network-level transport and storage check. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Muck-transport cycle” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=35 t；往返週期=36 min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=35 t; cycle=36 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「出渣運輸節拍」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Muck-transport cycle”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸
knowledge.text: 側向施工入口和先進坑共用運輸網，教材研究一個出渣節點故障如何影響多工作面。多工作面只有在供電、通風、出渣與材料供應同步充足時才增加總產量。
knowledge.textEn: Side accesses and exploratory galleries form a shared network; examine how one spoil-node outage propagates to several headings. Multiple headings increase output only when power, air, muck transport and materials support them together.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Shared access and transport bottlenecks" is correct?
options: 增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
側向施工入口和先進坑共用運輸網，教材研究一個出渣節點故障如何影響多工作面。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
optionsEn: Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
Side accesses and exploratory galleries form a shared network; examine how one spoil-node outage propagates to several headings.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
quiz.explanation: 側向施工入口和先進坑共用運輸網，教材研究一個出渣節點故障如何影響多工作面。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Side accesses and exploratory galleries form a shared network; examine how one spoil-node outage propagates to several headings. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「出渣運輸節拍」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Muck-transport cycle” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=35 t；往返週期=36 min。C=N payload 60/T=233.333 t/h。僅把往返週期增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為212.121 t/h。邊界：無排隊理想循環，並非共享路段實際產能；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=35 t; cycle=36 min. C=N payload 60/T=233.333 t/h. Increasing only cycle by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 212.121 t/h. Boundary: Ideal cycle without queues, not actual shared-route production. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用排隊時間和緩衝存量找出串聯瓶頸。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Identify serial bottlenecks from queue time and buffer inventory.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=35 t；往返週期=36 min。C=N payload 60/T=233.333 t/h。僅把往返週期增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為212.121 t/h。邊界：無排隊理想循環，並非共享路段實際產能；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=35 t; cycle=36 min. C=N payload 60/T=233.333 t/h. Increasing only cycle by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 212.121 t/h. Boundary: Ideal cycle without queues, not actual shared-route production. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Shared access and transport bottlenecks", which statement holds?
options: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=35 t；往返週期=36 min。
optionsEn: Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=35 t; cycle=36 min.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=35 t；往返週期=36 min。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=35 t; cycle=36 min. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「出渣運輸節拍」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Muck-transport cycle” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用排隊時間和緩衝存量找出串聯瓶頸。以裝載質量、往返時間及排隊時間重建物流曲線，再核對緩衝占用、共用通道優先權與維修時段。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Identify serial bottlenecks from queue time and buffer inventory. Reconstruct flow from payload, round-trip and queue times, then check buffer occupancy, shared-route priorities and maintenance periods. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「出渣運輸節拍」的交付需回答：用排隊時間和緩衝存量找出串聯瓶頸。每日排程同時標示人員、材料和維修的占用時段，任何物流改線先檢查通風與應變通道，不能只看運量提升。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Brenner Base Tunnel, the muck-transport cycle handover must address the following evidence: Identify serial bottlenecks from queue time and buffer inventory. Schedules show personnel, materials and maintenance occupancy together; rerouting first checks ventilation and emergency access rather than only throughput gains.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：各面名目產量相加會忽略共同卸料設備的容量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Summed face ratings omit capacity of shared unloading equipment. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用排隊時間和緩衝存量找出串聯瓶頸。以裝載質量、往返時間及排隊時間重建物流曲線，再核對緩衝占用、共用通道優先權與維修時段。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Identify serial bottlenecks from queue time and buffer inventory. Reconstruct flow from payload, round-trip and queue times, then check buffer occupancy, shared-route priorities and maintenance periods. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「出渣運輸節拍」的交付需回答：用排隊時間和緩衝存量找出串聯瓶頸。每日排程同時標示人員、材料和維修的占用時段，任何物流改線先檢查通風與應變通道，不能只看運量提升。
knowledge.textEn: For Brenner Base Tunnel, the muck-transport cycle handover must address the following evidence: Identify serial bottlenecks from queue time and buffer inventory. Schedules show personnel, materials and maintenance occupancy together; rerouting first checks ventilation and emergency access rather than only throughput gains.

quiz.question: 要驗證「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Shared access and transport bottlenecks"?
options: 用排隊時間和緩衝存量找出串聯瓶頸。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。
optionsEn: Identify serial bottlenecks from queue time and buffer inventory.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction.
quiz.explanation: 用排隊時間和緩衝存量找出串聯瓶頸。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Identify serial bottlenecks from queue time and buffer inventory. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「出渣運輸節拍」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Muck-transport cycle” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 各面名目產量相加會忽略共同卸料設備的容量。把理想往返時間當全天常數會忽略交會等待與卸料堵塞，導致工作面停工或把材料堆入必要通道。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Summed face ratings omit capacity of shared unloading equipment. Treating an ideal cycle as constant all day misses passing delays and unloading blockages, stopping headings or pushing material into essential access space. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：共用豎井或軌道形成串聯瓶頸，排隊和維修窗口會降低名目容量；緩衝區太大又可能侵占通行與救援空間，因此不能單純把各面產能相加。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Large buffers may obstruct personnel and rescue access, so face capacities cannot simply be added without a network-level transport and storage check.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 各面名目產量相加會忽略共同卸料設備的容量。把理想往返時間當全天常數會忽略交會等待與卸料堵塞，導致工作面停工或把材料堆入必要通道。
knowledge.textEn: Summed face ratings omit capacity of shared unloading equipment. Treating an ideal cycle as constant all day misses passing delays and unloading blockages, stopping headings or pushing material into essential access space.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Shared access and transport bottlenecks" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
各面名目產量相加會忽略共同卸料設備的容量。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Summed face ratings omit capacity of shared unloading equipment.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
quiz.explanation: 各面名目產量相加會忽略共同卸料設備的容量。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Summed face ratings omit capacity of shared unloading equipment. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「方向角誤差」如何影響布倫納基線隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Orientation error” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Brenner Base Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 跨境兩端控制網需統一坐標尺度與高程，布倫納教材特別檢查地表到深部基準傳遞。長隧道的微小方向誤差會沿距離累積，地下控制網又缺少直接衛星定位，必須把地表基準可靠傳到洞內。閉合差很小不代表無系統誤差；尺度、折光、儀器定向與高程基準可能共同偏移，誤差相關性也使平方和估算失真。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「方向角誤差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cross-border networks require common scale and elevation, with explicit checks on transfer from surface to depth. Small orientation errors accumulate over long drives, while underground networks lack direct satellite positioning and depend on transferring surface control. A small closure does not exclude systematic bias: scale, refraction, orientation and vertical datum may shift together. Correlated errors also invalidate a naive root-sum-square combination of supposedly independent observations. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Orientation error” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：控制長度=4800 m；方向偏角=2.7 arcsec。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: control length=4800 m; orientation error=2.7 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0628319 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「方向角誤差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Orientation error”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 控制網與貫通誤差
knowledge.text: 跨境兩端控制網需統一坐標尺度與高程，布倫納教材特別檢查地表到深部基準傳遞。長隧道的微小方向誤差會沿距離累積，地下控制網又缺少直接衛星定位，必須把地表基準可靠傳到洞內。
knowledge.textEn: Cross-border networks require common scale and elevation, with explicit checks on transfer from surface to depth. Small orientation errors accumulate over long drives, while underground networks lack direct satellite positioning and depend on transferring surface control.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「控制網與貫通誤差」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Control network and breakthrough error" is correct?
options: 兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。
跨境兩端控制網需統一坐標尺度與高程，布倫納教材特別檢查地表到深部基準傳遞。
optionsEn: Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis.
Cross-border networks require common scale and elevation, with explicit checks on transfer from surface to depth.
quiz.explanation: 跨境兩端控制網需統一坐標尺度與高程，布倫納教材特別檢查地表到深部基準傳遞。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Cross-border networks require common scale and elevation, with explicit checks on transfer from surface to depth. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「方向角誤差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Orientation error” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：控制長度=4800 m；方向偏角=2.7 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0628319 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.069115 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: control length=4800 m; orientation error=2.7 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0628319 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.069115 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：由獨立網重算尺度及定向，保留溫度改正資料。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Recompute scale and orientation independently and retain thermal corrections.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: control length=4800 m; orientation error=2.7 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0628319 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.069115 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「控制網與貫通誤差」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Control network and breakthrough error", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：控制長度=4800 m；方向偏角=2.7 arcsec。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: control length=4800 m; orientation error=2.7 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0628319 m.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：控制長度=4800 m；方向偏角=2.7 arcsec。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: control length=4800 m; orientation error=2.7 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0628319 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「方向角誤差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Orientation error” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 由獨立網重算尺度及定向，保留溫度改正資料。由獨立測量組複核地表到洞內的轉換，保留原始角距及溫度資料，用不同控制線比較方向與高程偏差。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Recompute scale and orientation independently and retain thermal corrections. Independently check surface-to-tunnel transformations, retain raw angles, distances and temperatures, and compare orientation and elevation through separate control routes. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「方向角誤差」的交付需回答：由獨立網重算尺度及定向，保留溫度改正資料。貫通前凍結座標、尺度與高程版本，獨立組直接使用原始觀測重算；不得只傳遞整理好的坐標而遺失校正資訊。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Brenner Base Tunnel, the orientation error handover must address the following evidence: Recompute scale and orientation independently and retain thermal corrections. Freeze coordinate, scale and height revisions before breakthrough; independent reviewers recompute raw observations rather than receiving only adjusted coordinates without corrections.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：同一轉換參數用錯可讓兩國網各自閉合卻整體錯接。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A wrong shared transformation permits local closure but a global mismatch. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 由獨立網重算尺度及定向，保留溫度改正資料。由獨立測量組複核地表到洞內的轉換，保留原始角距及溫度資料，用不同控制線比較方向與高程偏差。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Recompute scale and orientation independently and retain thermal corrections. Independently check surface-to-tunnel transformations, retain raw angles, distances and temperatures, and compare orientation and elevation through separate control routes. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「方向角誤差」的交付需回答：由獨立網重算尺度及定向，保留溫度改正資料。貫通前凍結座標、尺度與高程版本，獨立組直接使用原始觀測重算；不得只傳遞整理好的坐標而遺失校正資訊。
knowledge.textEn: For Brenner Base Tunnel, the orientation error handover must address the following evidence: Recompute scale and orientation independently and retain thermal corrections. Freeze coordinate, scale and height revisions before breakthrough; independent reviewers recompute raw observations rather than receiving only adjusted coordinates without corrections.

quiz.question: 要驗證「控制網與貫通誤差」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Control network and breakthrough error"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
由獨立網重算尺度及定向，保留溫度改正資料。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Recompute scale and orientation independently and retain thermal corrections.
Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
quiz.explanation: 由獨立網重算尺度及定向，保留溫度改正資料。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Recompute scale and orientation independently and retain thermal corrections. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「方向角誤差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Orientation error” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 同一轉換參數用錯可讓兩國網各自閉合卻整體錯接。共用錯誤基準可能讓兩組測量同時看似一致，直到貫通或軌道銜接才發現系統偏差，修正成本遠高於早期複核。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A wrong shared transformation permits local closure but a global mismatch. A shared wrong datum can make separate surveys appear consistent until breakthrough or track connection exposes bias that is costly to correct. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：閉合差很小不代表無系統誤差；尺度、折光、儀器定向與高程基準可能共同偏移，誤差相關性也使平方和估算失真。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Correlated errors also invalidate a naive root-sum-square combination of supposedly independent observations.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 同一轉換參數用錯可讓兩國網各自閉合卻整體錯接。共用錯誤基準可能讓兩組測量同時看似一致，直到貫通或軌道銜接才發現系統偏差，修正成本遠高於早期複核。
knowledge.textEn: A wrong shared transformation permits local closure but a global mismatch. A shared wrong datum can make separate surveys appear consistent until breakthrough or track connection exposes bias that is costly to correct.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「控制網與貫通誤差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Control network and breakthrough error" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。
同一轉換參數用錯可讓兩國網各自閉合卻整體錯接。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis.
A wrong shared transformation permits local closure but a global mismatch.
quiz.explanation: 同一轉換參數用錯可讓兩國網各自閉合卻整體錯接。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A wrong shared transformation permits local closure but a global mismatch. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「基線縱坡與牽引需求」與「資產編碼與可追溯交接」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Base-alignment grade and traction demand" and "Asset identity and traceable handover": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 基線縱坡與牽引需求：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Base-alignment grade and traction demand: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「坡度阻力功率」如何影響布倫納基線隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Grade-resistance power” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Brenner Base Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 低坡度是布倫納運輸目的之一，教材計算坡度功率後另外列出加速、氣動與列車間距需求。基線鐵路用較小縱坡降低重載列車的重力阻力，但仍有滾動、空氣阻力及加速需求。土建線形和供電容量必須使用同一列車與速度情境，短距陡坡也不能被平均坡度掩蓋；制動方向的能量處理則是另一個需要獨立檢核的工況。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「坡度阻力功率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Low gradient supports the transport purpose; calculate grade power while separately listing acceleration, aerodynamics and spacing demands. A base alignment reduces heavy-train gravity resistance through gentler gradients, but rolling resistance, aerodynamic drag and acceleration remain. Civil geometry and power capacity must use consistent train and speed cases. Short steep sections cannot be hidden in an average gradient, while braking energy in the opposite direction requires its own operating and electrical assessment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Grade-resistance power” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：列車質量=1.5e+06 kg；縱坡=0.0066 無因次；速度=20 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: train mass=1.5e+06 kg; grade=0.0066 dimensionless; speed=20 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「坡度阻力功率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Grade-resistance power”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 基線縱坡與牽引需求
knowledge.text: 低坡度是布倫納運輸目的之一，教材計算坡度功率後另外列出加速、氣動與列車間距需求。基線鐵路用較小縱坡降低重載列車的重力阻力，但仍有滾動、空氣阻力及加速需求。

A base alignment reduces heavy-train gravity resistance through gentler gradients, but rolling resistance, aerodynamic drag and acceleration remain.

knowledge.text: 誤解：基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「基線縱坡與牽引需求」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Base-alignment grade and traction demand" is correct?
options: 低坡度是布倫納運輸目的之一，教材計算坡度功率後另外列出加速、氣動與列車間距需求。
基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
optionsEn: Low gradient supports the transport purpose; calculate grade power while separately listing acceleration, aerodynamics and spacing demands.
A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis.

steps.instructionEn: Check dimensionless grade conversion and mass before equal-speed comparison. steps.failure: 注意干擾：把千分比當百分比會使坡度功率放大十倍。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Confusing per mille with percent multiplies grade power by ten. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.instruction: 把千分比當百分比會使坡度功率放大十倍。平均坡度低卻存在短陡坡時，峰值功率可能超過預估，速度下降又會增加區段占用時間，牽連營運容量。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Confusing per mille with percent multiplies grade power by ten. A short steep grade can exceed power estimates despite a low average, reducing speed and extending block occupation with capacity consequences. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：土建線形和供電容量必須使用同一列車與速度情境，短距陡坡也不能被平均坡度掩蓋；制動方向的能量處理則是另一個需要獨立檢核的工況。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「資產資料完整度」如何影響布倫納基線隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Asset-record completeness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Brenner Base Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先進坑由調查轉為維護用途時，資料需保留地質與設備兩種索引，避免施工資料在營運期失聯。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「資產資料完整度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: As the exploratory gallery gains a maintenance role, preserve both geological and equipment indexing through handover. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision. Drawings without change history cannot distinguish replacement from deterioration. Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Asset-record completeness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：從維修位置反查該里程探查、支護和排水紀錄。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Brenner Base Tunnel, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Trace a maintenance location back to investigation, support and drainage records. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只有設備清單而缺地質里程連結會妨礙異常水量診斷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An asset list without geological chainage linkage impedes abnormal-inflow diagnosis. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 從維修位置反查該里程探查、支護和排水紀錄。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Trace a maintenance location back to investigation, support and drainage records. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：從維修位置反查該里程探查、支護和排水紀錄。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。
knowledge.textEn: For Brenner Base Tunnel, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Trace a maintenance location back to investigation, support and drainage records. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.

quiz.question: 要驗證「資產編碼與可追溯交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Asset identity and traceable handover"?
options: 從維修位置反查該里程探查、支護和排水紀錄。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
optionsEn: Trace a maintenance location back to investigation, support and drainage records.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
quiz.explanation: 從維修位置反查該里程探查、支護和排水紀錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Trace a maintenance location back to investigation, support and drainage records. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「資產資料完整度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Asset-record completeness” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只有設備清單而缺地質里程連結會妨礙異常水量診斷。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An asset list without geological chainage linkage impedes abnormal-inflow diagnosis. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只有設備清單而缺地質里程連結會妨礙異常水量診斷。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。
knowledge.textEn: An asset list without geological chainage linkage impedes abnormal-inflow diagnosis. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「資產編碼與可追溯交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Asset identity and traceable handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只有設備清單而缺地質里程連結會妨礙異常水量診斷。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
An asset list without geological chainage linkage impedes abnormal-inflow diagnosis.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 只有設備清單而缺地質里程連結會妨礙異常水量診斷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An asset list without geological chainage linkage impedes abnormal-inflow diagnosis. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 新武界引水隧道
summary: 台電典藏說明新武界及栗栖溪引水工程的規劃與施工，列16.5公里引水範圍及其中6.5公里TBM中段，記錄2002年該掘進段貫通。本課把土木、地質與水力目的串接，研究水路能量、探查代表性、支護和施工物流；這些尺度不被混寫成單一孔全長或發電容量。
summaryEn: Taipower describes planning and construction for New Wujie and Lixi conveyance, including a 16.5 km scope and a 6.5 km TBM middle section that broke through in 2002. This course connects civil, geological and hydraulic purposes through energy, investigation, support and logistics, without confusing those scopes with one bore length or generating capacity.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創綜合審查：先計算「破碎帶連通與預報更新」，再獨立計算「輸水摩阻與瞬變邊界」。原創教學假設：滲透係數=2e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=360 m²。Q=k i A=0.001512 m³/s。僅把滲透係數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0016632 m³/s。邊界：均質飽和達西流，不代表裂隙集中流；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：達西因子=0.02 無因次；長度=1800 m；直徑=4 m；流速=2 m/s。hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g), g=9.81 m/s²=1.83486 m。僅把流速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為2.22018 m。邊界：滿管穩態摩阻，不含水錘與局部損失；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated review: first calculate fault connectivity and forecast updating, then independently calculate conveyance friction and transient boundaries. Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=2e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=360 m². Q=k i A=0.001512 m³/s. Increasing only conductivity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0016632 m³/s. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated Darcy flow, not concentrated fracture flow. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.02 dimensionless; length=1800 m; diameter=4 m; velocity=2 m/s. hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g), g=9.81 m/s²=1.83486 m. Increasing only velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 2.22018 m. Boundary: Steady full-pipe friction, excluding water hammer and local loss. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「地下水路與傳遞時間」與「破碎帶連通與預報更新」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Underground water routes and travel time" and "Fault connectivity and forecast updating": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 地下水路與傳遞時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Underground water routes and travel time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水體平流時間」如何影響新武界引水隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Water advection time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 新武界是引水工程，路線由取水、出口水位和能量坡度決定，教材用水體平流而非車輛旅行時間。地下排水或引水設施的路線先由集水區、入流點、出口水位及坡度定義，不能以交通旅行時間衡量。定速水體的行程可用距離除速度估算，但洪峰波速、蓄水與回水會改變訊號傳遞；各支路必須在共同水位與時間基準下連接。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水體平流時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: New Wujie is a conveyance work; intake, outlet level and energy gradient define the route, so the example uses water advection rather than vehicle travel. An underground water route is defined by catchments, inflows, outfall level and gradient, not vehicle journey time. Distance divided by velocity estimates constant-speed material travel, while flood-wave celerity, storage and backwater alter signal propagation. Branches must be connected using common level and time references before interpreting arrival or control response. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Water advection time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：水路長度=2000 m；水體速度=1.5 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: reach length=2000 m; water velocity=1.5 m/s. t=L/v/60=22.2222 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「水體流過全程的時間必然等於洪峰抵達的時間。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Material travel time necessarily equals flood-peak arrival time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水體平流時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Water advection time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 地下水路與傳遞時間
knowledge.titleEn: Underground water routes and travel time
knowledge.text: 新武界是引水工程，路線由取水、出口水位和能量坡度決定，教材用水體平流而非車輛旅行時間。地下排水或引水設施的路線先由集水區、入流點、出口水位及坡度定義，不能以交通旅行時間衡量。
knowledge.textEn: New Wujie is a conveyance work; intake, outlet level and energy gradient define the route, so the example uses water advection rather than vehicle travel. An underground water route is defined by catchments, inflows, outfall level and gradient, not vehicle journey time.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：水體流過全程的時間必然等於洪峰抵達的時間。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Material travel time necessarily equals flood-peak arrival time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「地下水路與傳遞時間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Underground water routes and travel time" is correct?
options: 水體流過全程的時間必然等於洪峰抵達的時間。
新武界是引水工程，路線由取水、出口水位和能量坡度決定，教材用水體平流而非車輛旅行時間。
岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
optionsEn: Material travel time necessarily equals flood-peak arrival time.
New Wujie is a conveyance work; intake, outlet level and energy gradient define the route, so the example uses water advection rather than vehicle travel.
Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
quiz.explanation: 新武界是引水工程，路線由取水、出口水位和能量坡度決定，教材用水體平流而非車輛旅行時間。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: New Wujie is a conveyance work; intake, outlet level and energy gradient define the route, so the example uses water advection rather than vehicle travel. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 地下水路與傳遞時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Underground water routes and travel time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水體平流時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Water advection time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：水路長度=2000 m；水體速度=1.5 m/s。t=L/v/60=22.2222 min。僅把水路長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為24.4444 min。邊界：定速水體平流，不是洪峰波速或完整洪水演算；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: reach length=2000 m; water velocity=1.5 m/s. t=L/v/60=22.2222 min. Increasing only reach length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 24.4444 min. Boundary: Constant-speed water advection, not flood-wave celerity or complete routing. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對上下游水位基準和各引水支路的連接範圍。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check level datum and connection scope for upstream, downstream and branch inflows.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：水路長度=2000 m；水體速度=1.5 m/s。t=L/v/60=22.2222 min。僅把水路長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為24.4444 min。邊界：定速水體平流，不是洪峰波速或完整洪水演算；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: reach length=2000 m; water velocity=1.5 m/s. t=L/v/60=22.2222 min. Increasing only reach length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 24.4444 min. Boundary: Constant-speed water advection, not flood-wave celerity or complete routing. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「地下水路與傳遞時間」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Underground water routes and travel time", which statement holds?
options: 刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。
只算穩態流量就能排除輸水隧道的水錘與氣囊。
原創教學假設：水路長度=2000 m；水體速度=1.5 m/s。
optionsEn: A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance.
A steady-flow calculation excludes water hammer and trapped air in a conveyance tunnel.
Original teaching assumptions: reach length=2000 m; water velocity=1.5 m/s. t=L/v/60=22.2222 min.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：水路長度=2000 m；水體速度=1.5 m/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: reach length=2000 m; water velocity=1.5 m/s. t=L/v/60=22.2222 min. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 地下水路與傳遞時間：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Underground water routes and travel time: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水體平流時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Water advection time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對上下游水位基準和各引水支路的連接範圍。對齊入口與出口水位流量時間序列，利用允許的示蹤或模型比較平流時間與洪峰時差，保留回水條件。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check level datum and connection scope for upstream, downstream and branch inflows. Align inlet and outlet level-flow histories; use permitted tracer data or modelling to distinguish material travel from peak lag while preserving backwater conditions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「水體平流時間」的交付需回答：核對上下游水位基準和各引水支路的連接範圍。路線圖同時標示水位基準、支路與控制邊界，所有時間比較註明是物質、波峰或設備延遲，避免混用。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel, the water advection time handover must address the following evidence: Check level datum and connection scope for upstream, downstream and branch inflows. Route diagrams show level datum, branches and control boundaries; label each time as material travel, wave propagation or equipment delay.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把引水長度直接換成交通效益會完全失去功能邊界。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Converting conveyance length into a traffic benefit loses the functional boundary. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
