knowledge.text: 核對上下游水位基準和各引水支路的連接範圍。對齊入口與出口水位流量時間序列，利用允許的示蹤或模型比較平流時間與洪峰時差，保留回水條件。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Check level datum and connection scope for upstream, downstream and branch inflows. Align inlet and outlet level-flow histories; use permitted tracer data or modelling to distinguish material travel from peak lag while preserving backwater conditions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「水體平流時間」的交付需回答：核對上下游水位基準和各引水支路的連接範圍。路線圖同時標示水位基準、支路與控制邊界，所有時間比較註明是物質、波峰或設備延遲，避免混用。
knowledge.textEn: For New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel, the water advection time handover must address the following evidence: Check level datum and connection scope for upstream, downstream and branch inflows. Route diagrams show level datum, branches and control boundaries; label each time as material travel, wave propagation or equipment delay.

quiz.question: 要驗證「地下水路與傳遞時間」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Underground water routes and travel time"?
options: 核對上下游水位基準和各引水支路的連接範圍。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
optionsEn: Check level datum and connection scope for upstream, downstream and branch inflows.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
quiz.explanation: 核對上下游水位基準和各引水支路的連接範圍。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check level datum and connection scope for upstream, downstream and branch inflows. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 地下水路與傳遞時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Underground water routes and travel time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水體平流時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Water advection time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把引水長度直接換成交通效益會完全失去功能邊界。把平流時間當洪峰預警時間會忽略波速和支路入流，控制指令可能在假定水體到達之前已失去適用性。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Converting conveyance length into a traffic benefit loses the functional boundary. Using advection time as flood-warning time ignores celerity and side inflows, allowing control assumptions to fail before the assumed arrival. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：定速水體的行程可用距離除速度估算，但洪峰波速、蓄水與回水會改變訊號傳遞；各支路必須在共同水位與時間基準下連接。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Branches must be connected using common level and time references before interpreting arrival or control response.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「水體流過全程的時間必然等於洪峰抵達的時間。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Material travel time necessarily equals flood-peak arrival time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把引水長度直接換成交通效益會完全失去功能邊界。把平流時間當洪峰預警時間會忽略波速和支路入流，控制指令可能在假定水體到達之前已失去適用性。
knowledge.textEn: Converting conveyance length into a traffic benefit loses the functional boundary. Using advection time as flood-warning time ignores celerity and side inflows, allowing control assumptions to fail before the assumed arrival.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「地下水路與傳遞時間」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Underground water routes and travel time" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把引水長度直接換成交通效益會完全失去功能邊界。
岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Converting conveyance length into a traffic benefit loses the functional boundary.
Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
quiz.explanation: 把引水長度直接換成交通效益會完全失去功能邊界。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Converting conveyance length into a traffic benefit loses the functional boundary. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Fault connectivity and forecast updating: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「破碎帶連通性」如何影響新武界引水隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fault-zone connectivity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 台電記錄強調探查與機械配合，本課研究長水平孔的岩性代表性及未探區裂隙不確定度。斷層帶可以含很硬的岩塊，但整體變形與湧水常由填充節理和連通裂隙控制。單一岩芯強度不能代表整個掌子面；超前鑽孔、出水變化與揭露地質須回饋同一里程模型，預報則應保留不同情境及其證據權重。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「破碎帶連通性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Taipower emphasises investigation-machine coordination; examine representativeness of a long horizontal probe and fracture uncertainty outside it. A fault zone may contain strong intact blocks while filled joints and connected fractures govern its bulk deformation and inflow. One core strength does not represent the entire face. Probe records, water response and exposed geology must update a common chainage model, preserving competing interpretations and their evidential weight rather than treating a forecast as certainty. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fault-zone connectivity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：滲透係數=2e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=360 m²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=2e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=360 m².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「破碎帶連通性」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Fault-zone connectivity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新
knowledge.text: 台電記錄強調探查與機械配合，本課研究長水平孔的岩性代表性及未探區裂隙不確定度。斷層帶可以含很硬的岩塊，但整體變形與湧水常由填充節理和連通裂隙控制。
knowledge.textEn: Taipower emphasises investigation-machine coordination; examine representativeness of a long horizontal probe and fracture uncertainty outside it. A fault zone may contain strong intact blocks while filled joints and connected fractures govern its bulk deformation and inflow.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「破碎帶連通與預報更新」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fault connectivity and forecast updating" is correct?
options: 岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
台電記錄強調探查與機械配合，本課研究長水平孔的岩性代表性及未探區裂隙不確定度。
optionsEn: Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Taipower emphasises investigation-machine coordination; examine representativeness of a long horizontal probe and fracture uncertainty outside it.
quiz.explanation: 台電記錄強調探查與機械配合，本課研究長水平孔的岩性代表性及未探區裂隙不確定度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Taipower emphasises investigation-machine coordination; examine representativeness of a long horizontal probe and fracture uncertainty outside it. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fault connectivity and forecast updating: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「破碎帶連通性」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fault-zone connectivity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：滲透係數=2e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=360 m²。Q=k i A=0.001512 m³/s。僅把滲透係數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0016632 m³/s。邊界：均質飽和達西流，不代表裂隙集中流；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=2e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=360 m². Q=k i A=0.001512 m³/s. Increasing only conductivity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0016632 m³/s. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated Darcy flow, not concentrated fracture flow. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以後續揭露核對探孔預測，標記偏離路線的取樣區。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check probe predictions against later exposure and mark sampled areas away from the alignment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：滲透係數=2e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=360 m²。Q=k i A=0.001512 m³/s。僅把滲透係數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0016632 m³/s。邊界：均質飽和達西流，不代表裂隙集中流；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=2e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=360 m². Q=k i A=0.001512 m³/s. Increasing only conductivity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0016632 m³/s. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated Darcy flow, not concentrated fracture flow. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「破碎帶連通與預報更新」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fault connectivity and forecast updating", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：滲透係數=2e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=360 m²。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=2e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=360 m².
Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：滲透係數=2e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=360 m²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=2e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=360 m². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fault connectivity and forecast updating: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「破碎帶連通性」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fault-zone connectivity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以後續揭露核對探孔預測，標記偏離路線的取樣區。將岩心回收、裂隙方位與出水曲線按里程對齊，用未參與建模的孔段作交叉檢驗，檢查是否只擬合已知資料。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check probe predictions against later exposure and mark sampled areas away from the alignment. Align recovery, fracture orientation and inflow by chainage; test the interpretation against a withheld borehole interval to detect fitting only the known observations. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「破碎帶連通性」的交付需回答：以後續揭露核對探孔預測，標記偏離路線的取樣區。每次地質模型更新保留舊版與新增證據，差異由地質及支護設計者共同判讀，施工條件改變需重新確認核准範圍。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel, the fault-zone connectivity handover must address the following evidence: Check probe predictions against later exposure and mark sampled areas away from the alignment. Retain previous interpretations and new evidence at every update; geology and support designers jointly interpret differences and reconfirm approved bounds when ground conditions change.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：一支長孔仍可能平行錯過不利構造，長度不等於完整覆蓋。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A long hole can run parallel to an adverse structure; length is not complete coverage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以後續揭露核對探孔預測，標記偏離路線的取樣區。將岩心回收、裂隙方位與出水曲線按里程對齊，用未參與建模的孔段作交叉檢驗，檢查是否只擬合已知資料。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Check probe predictions against later exposure and mark sampled areas away from the alignment. Align recovery, fracture orientation and inflow by chainage; test the interpretation against a withheld borehole interval to detect fitting only the known observations. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「破碎帶連通性」的交付需回答：以後續揭露核對探孔預測，標記偏離路線的取樣區。每次地質模型更新保留舊版與新增證據，差異由地質及支護設計者共同判讀，施工條件改變需重新確認核准範圍。
knowledge.textEn: For New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel, the fault-zone connectivity handover must address the following evidence: Check probe predictions against later exposure and mark sampled areas away from the alignment. Retain previous interpretations and new evidence at every update; geology and support designers jointly interpret differences and reconfirm approved bounds when ground conditions change.

quiz.question: 要驗證「破碎帶連通與預報更新」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fault connectivity and forecast updating"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以後續揭露核對探孔預測，標記偏離路線的取樣區。
增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Check probe predictions against later exposure and mark sampled areas away from the alignment.
Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
quiz.explanation: 以後續揭露核對探孔預測，標記偏離路線的取樣區。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check probe predictions against later exposure and mark sampled areas away from the alignment. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fault connectivity and forecast updating: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「破碎帶連通性」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fault-zone connectivity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 一支長孔仍可能平行錯過不利構造，長度不等於完整覆蓋。只用完整岩石強度會漏掉軟弱填充物，可能在看似堅硬的地層中出現收斂加快、支護過載或水量突增。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A long hole can run parallel to an adverse structure; length is not complete coverage. Intact strength alone misses weak infill, allowing accelerating convergence, support overload or sudden inflow in ground that superficially appears strong. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：單一岩芯強度不能代表整個掌子面；超前鑽孔、出水變化與揭露地質須回饋同一里程模型，預報則應保留不同情境及其證據權重。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Probe records, water response and exposed geology must update a common chainage model, preserving competing interpretations and their evidential weight rather than treating a forecast as certainty.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 一支長孔仍可能平行錯過不利構造，長度不等於完整覆蓋。只用完整岩石強度會漏掉軟弱填充物，可能在看似堅硬的地層中出現收斂加快、支護過載或水量突增。
knowledge.textEn: A long hole can run parallel to an adverse structure; length is not complete coverage. Intact strength alone misses weak infill, allowing accelerating convergence, support overload or sudden inflow in ground that superficially appears strong.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「破碎帶連通與預報更新」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fault connectivity and forecast updating" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
一支長孔仍可能平行錯過不利構造，長度不等於完整覆蓋。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
A long hole can run parallel to an adverse structure; length is not complete coverage.
quiz.explanation: 一支長孔仍可能平行錯過不利構造，長度不等於完整覆蓋。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A long hole can run parallel to an adverse structure; length is not complete coverage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」與「掘進利用率與設備停時」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Piezometric head and lining pressure" and "Boring utilisation and equipment downtime": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「測壓水頭」如何影響新武界引水隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Piezometric head” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 引水隧道施工時外部地下水與營運時內水壓方向不同，教材把內外壓組合按階段列清。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「測壓水頭」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: External groundwater during excavation and internal conveyance pressure during operation act differently; list pressure combinations by stage. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level. Drainage reduces pressure but can increase effective stress and settlement. Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Piezometric head” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=96 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=96 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=941.76 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「測壓水頭」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Piezometric head”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓
knowledge.text: 引水隧道施工時外部地下水與營運時內水壓方向不同，教材把內外壓組合按階段列清。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。
knowledge.textEn: External groundwater during excavation and internal conveyance pressure during operation act differently; list pressure combinations by stage. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Piezometric head and lining pressure" is correct?
options: 引水隧道施工時外部地下水與營運時內水壓方向不同，教材把內外壓組合按階段列清。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。
optionsEn: External groundwater during excavation and internal conveyance pressure during operation act differently; list pressure combinations by stage.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance.
quiz.explanation: 引水隧道施工時外部地下水與營運時內水壓方向不同，教材把內外壓組合按階段列清。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: External groundwater during excavation and internal conveyance pressure during operation act differently; list pressure combinations by stage. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「測壓水頭」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Piezometric head” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=96 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=941.76 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1035.94 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=96 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=941.76 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1035.94 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較空洞、充水和停水狀態的內外測壓基準。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare internal and external pressure references for empty, filled and shutdown states.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=96 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=941.76 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1035.94 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=96 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=941.76 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1035.94 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Piezometric head and lining pressure", which statement holds?
options: 只算穩態流量就能排除輸水隧道的水錘與氣囊。
原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=96 m。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
optionsEn: A steady-flow calculation excludes water hammer and trapped air in a conveyance tunnel.
Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=96 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=941.76 kPa.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=96 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=96 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=941.76 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「測壓水頭」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Piezometric head” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較空洞、充水和停水狀態的內外測壓基準。使用分層測壓管及流量計，配合降雨或潮位序列分辨補注與設備影響，將讀值統一換算至同一高程基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare internal and external pressure references for empty, filled and shutdown states. Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：比較空洞、充水和停水狀態的內外測壓基準。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Compare internal and external pressure references for empty, filled and shutdown states. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只驗滿水時淨內壓會漏掉放空後外壓控制情境。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Checking filled-state net internal pressure misses external pressure after draining. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較空洞、充水和停水狀態的內外測壓基準。使用分層測壓管及流量計，配合降雨或潮位序列分辨補注與設備影響，將讀值統一換算至同一高程基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Compare internal and external pressure references for empty, filled and shutdown states. Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：比較空洞、充水和停水狀態的內外測壓基準。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。
knowledge.textEn: For New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Compare internal and external pressure references for empty, filled and shutdown states. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.

quiz.question: 要驗證「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Piezometric head and lining pressure"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
施工後泉水變少就能單獨證明隧道造成全部減流。
比較空洞、充水和停水狀態的內外測壓基準。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Reduced spring flow after construction alone proves the tunnel caused the entire change.
Compare internal and external pressure references for empty, filled and shutdown states.
quiz.explanation: 比較空洞、充水和停水狀態的內外測壓基準。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare internal and external pressure references for empty, filled and shutdown states. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「測壓水頭」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Piezometric head” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只驗滿水時淨內壓會漏掉放空後外壓控制情境。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Checking filled-state net internal pressure misses external pressure after draining. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 掘進利用率與設備停時：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Boring utilisation and equipment downtime: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「有效掘進利用率」如何影響新武界引水隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。

steps.instruction: 公開資料的最高日進尺與月平均是不同統計量，本課以新武界背景重建班次利用率而非追逐紀錄。TBM瞬時貫入率只描述刀盤切削的一段時間，拼裝、換刀、出渣與維修決定每天真正進尺。岩石強度與磨蝕性對刀具的影響不同，混合掌子面又產生不對稱作用；比較機器績效須按地質分區和停時原因分類，不能只排序最高進尺。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「有效掘進利用率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Published peak daily and mean monthly advance are different statistics; reconstruct shift utilisation rather than treating a production record as normal. Strength and abrasivity affect cutters differently, while mixed faces impose asymmetric loading. Compare performance by ground domain and downtime cause, because the highest short-duration penetration rate can coexist with poor daily production and increased maintenance demand. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Effective boring utilisation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：切削速率=1.98 m/h；有效利用率=0.295 無因次。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「有效掘進利用率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 掘進利用率與設備停時：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「有效掘進利用率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Effective boring utilisation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：切削速率=1.98 m/h；有效利用率=0.295 無因次。D=24vu=14.0184 m/day。僅把有效利用率增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為15.4202 m/day。邊界：平均循環模型，未表示地質轉換及停機分布；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: active penetration=1.98 m/h; utilisation=0.295 dimensionless. D=24vu=14.0184 m/day. Increasing only utilisation by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 15.4202 m/day. Boundary: Mean-cycle model without ground transitions or downtime distribution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將最高日、完整月份與停機日納入同一時間帳。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Include peak day, full month and stoppage days in one time balance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「支護安裝時點」如何影響新武界引水隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Support activation time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 引水隧道的初期支護先穩定開挖，永久內襯還有水理和耐久功能，教材明確區分兩者驗證。支護荷載由開挖釋放量和支護啟動時間共同決定，越早安裝不一定讓構件受力越小。地盤反力與支護曲線必須連同掌子面距離及封閉順序理解；擠壓性地層還需保留變形容量，不能只追求高剛度與高材料強度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「支護安裝時點」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Initial support stabilises excavation while permanent lining also serves hydraulics and durability; verify these functions separately. Support load depends on stress release and activation time, so earlier installation does not necessarily reduce member forces. Interpret ground-reaction and support curves together with distance from the face and closure sequence. Squeezing ground also needs deformation capacity; high stiffness and material strength alone do not guarantee a compatible support response. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Support activation time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：局部剛度=46 kN/mm；位移=9 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=46 kN/mm; movement=9 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「支護安裝時點」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Support activation time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 支護啟動與變形容量
knowledge.text: 引水隧道的初期支護先穩定開挖，永久內襯還有水理和耐久功能，教材明確區分兩者驗證。支護荷載由開挖釋放量和支護啟動時間共同決定，越早安裝不一定讓構件受力越小。
knowledge.textEn: Initial support stabilises excavation while permanent lining also serves hydraulics and durability; verify these functions separately. Support load depends on stress release and activation time, so earlier installation does not necessarily reduce member forces.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「支護啟動與變形容量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Support activation and deformation capacity" is correct?
options: 支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
只算穩態流量就能排除輸水隧道的水錘與氣囊。
引水隧道的初期支護先穩定開挖，永久內襯還有水理和耐久功能，教材明確區分兩者驗證。
optionsEn: Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
A steady-flow calculation excludes water hammer and trapped air in a conveyance tunnel.
Initial support stabilises excavation while permanent lining also serves hydraulics and durability; verify these functions separately.
quiz.explanation: 引水隧道的初期支護先穩定開挖，永久內襯還有水理和耐久功能，教材明確區分兩者驗證。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Initial support stabilises excavation while permanent lining also serves hydraulics and durability; verify these functions separately. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「支護安裝時點」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Support activation time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：局部剛度=46 kN/mm；位移=9 mm。F=ku=414 kN。僅把位移增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為455.4 kN。邊界：線性局部彈簧，不含屈服或時間效應；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=46 kN/mm; movement=9 mm. F=ku=414 kN. Increasing only movement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 455.4 kN. Boundary: Local linear spring without yielding or time effects. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以施工收斂與後續內襯幾何資料分階段核對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check construction convergence and later lining geometry as separate stages.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：局部剛度=46 kN/mm；位移=9 mm。F=ku=414 kN。僅把位移增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為455.4 kN。邊界：線性局部彈簧，不含屈服或時間效應；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=46 kN/mm; movement=9 mm. F=ku=414 kN. Increasing only movement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 455.4 kN. Boundary: Local linear spring without yielding or time effects. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「支護啟動與變形容量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Support activation and deformation capacity", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：局部剛度=46 kN/mm；位移=9 mm。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
施工後泉水變少就能單獨證明隧道造成全部減流。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=46 kN/mm; movement=9 mm.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
Reduced spring flow after construction alone proves the tunnel caused the entire change.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：局部剛度=46 kN/mm；位移=9 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=46 kN/mm; movement=9 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「支護安裝時點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Support activation time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以施工收斂與後續內襯幾何資料分階段核對。同步記錄收斂、支護荷重與安裝里程，比較同一地質分區內的速率及荷載，不將不同開挖齡期讀值直接混合。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check construction convergence and later lining geometry as separate stages. Synchronise convergence, support loads and installation chainage; compare rates and loads within one ground domain without mixing readings at different excavation ages. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「支護安裝時點」的交付需回答：以施工收斂與後續內襯幾何資料分階段核對。把安裝時間和量測資料一起交付支護設計者，任何級別變更都需地質及位移證據，不能憑單一瞬間讀值自行改支護。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel, the support activation time handover must address the following evidence: Check construction convergence and later lining geometry as separate stages. Submit installation times with measurements to the support designer; class changes need both ground and movement evidence, not an isolated instantaneous reading.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：初期支護穩定不能證明永久水理斷面已達需求。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Stable initial support does not establish the permanent hydraulic section. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以施工收斂與後續內襯幾何資料分階段核對。同步記錄收斂、支護荷重與安裝里程，比較同一地質分區內的速率及荷載，不將不同開挖齡期讀值直接混合。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Check construction convergence and later lining geometry as separate stages. Synchronise convergence, support loads and installation chainage; compare rates and loads within one ground domain without mixing readings at different excavation ages. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「支護安裝時點」的交付需回答：以施工收斂與後續內襯幾何資料分階段核對。把安裝時間和量測資料一起交付支護設計者，任何級別變更都需地質及位移證據，不能憑單一瞬間讀值自行改支護。
knowledge.textEn: For New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel, the support activation time handover must address the following evidence: Check construction convergence and later lining geometry as separate stages. Submit installation times with measurements to the support designer; class changes need both ground and movement evidence, not an isolated instantaneous reading.

quiz.question: 要驗證「支護啟動與變形容量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Support activation and deformation capacity"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
以施工收斂與後續內襯幾何資料分階段核對。
岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Check construction convergence and later lining geometry as separate stages.
Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
quiz.explanation: 以施工收斂與後續內襯幾何資料分階段核對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check construction convergence and later lining geometry as separate stages. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「支護安裝時點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Support activation time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 初期支護穩定不能證明永久水理斷面已達需求。過晚封閉會讓不可回復變形增加，過硬且行程不足的支護也可能脆裂，兩者都可能表現為裂縫而需不同處理。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Stable initial support does not establish the permanent hydraulic section. Late closure increases irreversible movement, while excessively stiff support with little travel can fail brittly; both produce cracks but require different diagnoses. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：地盤反力與支護曲線必須連同掌子面距離及封閉順序理解；擠壓性地層還需保留變形容量，不能只追求高剛度與高材料強度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Squeezing ground also needs deformation capacity; high stiffness and material strength alone do not guarantee a compatible support response.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 初期支護穩定不能證明永久水理斷面已達需求。過晚封閉會讓不可回復變形增加，過硬且行程不足的支護也可能脆裂，兩者都可能表現為裂縫而需不同處理。
knowledge.textEn: Stable initial support does not establish the permanent hydraulic section. Late closure increases irreversible movement, while excessively stiff support with little travel can fail brittly; both produce cracks but require different diagnoses.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「支護啟動與變形容量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Support activation and deformation capacity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
只算穩態流量就能排除輸水隧道的水錘與氣囊。
初期支護穩定不能證明永久水理斷面已達需求。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
A steady-flow calculation excludes water hammer and trapped air in a conveyance tunnel.
Stable initial support does not establish the permanent hydraulic section.
quiz.explanation: 初期支護穩定不能證明永久水理斷面已達需求。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Stable initial support does not establish the permanent hydraulic section. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 輸水摩阻與瞬變邊界：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Conveyance friction and transient boundaries: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「滿管沿程損失」如何影響新武界引水隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Full-pipe friction loss” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 新武界水理教材以滿管摩阻建立能量帳，再列閘門瞬變和可能自由水面轉換的額外需求。輸水隧道由上下游能量差驅動，沿程粗糙度、接頭及局部收縮消耗水頭；流速增加使摩阻快速上升。穩態滿管式不能描述水錘、自由水面轉換或氣囊，閘門動作和停機歷程必須另外建立瞬變模型與通氣條件。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「滿管沿程損失」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Build a full-pipe friction balance, then identify separate gate-transient and possible free-surface-transition requirements. A conveyance tunnel is driven by upstream and downstream energy levels; roughness, joints and contractions consume head, with friction rising rapidly with velocity. A steady full-pipe equation does not describe water hammer, free-surface transitions or trapped air. Gate movements and shutdown histories require separate transient modelling and explicit ventilation conditions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Full-pipe friction loss” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：達西因子=0.02 無因次；長度=1800 m；直徑=4 m；流速=2 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.02 dimensionless; length=1800 m; diameter=4 m; velocity=2 m/s. hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g), g=9.81 m/s²=1.83486 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只算穩態流量就能排除輸水隧道的水錘與氣囊。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A steady-flow calculation excludes water hammer and trapped air in a conveyance tunnel." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「滿管沿程損失」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Full-pipe friction loss”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 新武界水理教材以滿管摩阻建立能量帳，再列閘門瞬變和可能自由水面轉換的額外需求。輸水隧道由上下游能量差驅動，沿程粗糙度、接頭及局部收縮消耗水頭；流速增加使摩阻快速上升。
knowledge.textEn: Build a full-pipe friction balance, then identify separate gate-transient and possible free-surface-transition requirements. A conveyance tunnel is driven by upstream and downstream energy levels; roughness, joints and contractions consume head, with friction rising rapidly with velocity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只算穩態流量就能排除輸水隧道的水錘與氣囊。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A steady-flow calculation excludes water hammer and trapped air in a conveyance tunnel. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「輸水摩阻與瞬變邊界」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Conveyance friction and transient boundaries" is correct?
options: 新武界水理教材以滿管摩阻建立能量帳，再列閘門瞬變和可能自由水面轉換的額外需求。
只算穩態流量就能排除輸水隧道的水錘與氣囊。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
optionsEn: Build a full-pipe friction balance, then identify separate gate-transient and possible free-surface-transition requirements.
A steady-flow calculation excludes water hammer and trapped air in a conveyance tunnel.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
quiz.explanation: 新武界水理教材以滿管摩阻建立能量帳，再列閘門瞬變和可能自由水面轉換的額外需求。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Build a full-pipe friction balance, then identify separate gate-transient and possible free-surface-transition requirements. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 輸水摩阻與瞬變邊界：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Conveyance friction and transient boundaries: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「滿管沿程損失」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Full-pipe friction loss” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：達西因子=0.02 無因次；長度=1800 m；直徑=4 m；流速=2 m/s。hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g), g=9.81 m/s²=1.83486 m。僅把流速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為2.22018 m。邊界：滿管穩態摩阻，不含水錘與局部損失；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.02 dimensionless; length=1800 m; diameter=4 m; velocity=2 m/s. hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g), g=9.81 m/s²=1.83486 m. Increasing only velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 2.22018 m. Boundary: Steady full-pipe friction, excluding water hammer and local loss. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用同時流量和水位反算水頭損失，保留閘門狀態。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Infer head loss from simultaneous flow and levels with gate state recorded.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：達西因子=0.02 無因次；長度=1800 m；直徑=4 m；流速=2 m/s。hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g), g=9.81 m/s²=1.83486 m。僅把流速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為2.22018 m。邊界：滿管穩態摩阻，不含水錘與局部損失；不是本工程實測或允收值。

Increasing only velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 2.22018 m. Boundary: Steady full-pipe friction, excluding water hammer and local loss. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「輸水摩阻與瞬變邊界」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Conveyance friction and transient boundaries", which statement holds?
options: 增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
原創教學假設：達西因子=0.02 無因次；長度=1800 m；直徑=4 m；流速=2 m/s。
水體流過全程的時間必然等於洪峰抵達的時間。
optionsEn: Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.02 dimensionless; length=1800 m; diameter=4 m; velocity=2 m/s. hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g), g=9.81 m/s²=1.83486 m.
Material travel time necessarily equals flood-peak arrival time.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：達西因子=0.02 無因次；長度=1800 m；直徑=4 m；流速=2 m/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.02 dimensionless; length=1800 m; diameter=4 m; velocity=2 m/s. hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g), g=9.81 m/s²=1.83486 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 輸水摩阻與瞬變邊界：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Conveyance friction and transient boundaries: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「滿管沿程損失」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Full-pipe friction loss” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用同時流量和水位反算水頭損失，保留閘門狀態。以同步上下游水位和流量核對能量坡度，分辨入口損失與沿程損失，保留閘門及氣壓狀態。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Infer head loss from simultaneous flow and levels with gate state recorded. Use synchronised levels and flow to check energy gradient, separate entrance from distributed losses and preserve gate and air-pressure states. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「滿管沿程損失」的交付需回答：用同時流量和水位反算水頭損失，保留閘門狀態。水理交付需包含水位基準、流量、閘門歷程及模型適用狀態；瞬變與通氣由水理設計者另行檢核。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel, the full-pipe friction loss handover must address the following evidence: Infer head loss from simultaneous flow and levels with gate state recorded. Hydraulic handover includes level datum, flow, gate histories and model regimes; specialists independently assess transients and air movement.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把非穩態壓力峰用來反算粗糙度會產生失真參數。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Inferring roughness from transient peaks produces misleading parameters. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用同時流量和水位反算水頭損失，保留閘門狀態。以同步上下游水位和流量核對能量坡度，分辨入口損失與沿程損失，保留閘門及氣壓狀態。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Infer head loss from simultaneous flow and levels with gate state recorded. Use synchronised levels and flow to check energy gradient, separate entrance from distributed losses and preserve gate and air-pressure states. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「滿管沿程損失」的交付需回答：用同時流量和水位反算水頭損失，保留閘門狀態。水理交付需包含水位基準、流量、閘門歷程及模型適用狀態；瞬變與通氣由水理設計者另行檢核。
knowledge.textEn: For New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel, the full-pipe friction loss handover must address the following evidence: Infer head loss from simultaneous flow and levels with gate state recorded. Hydraulic handover includes level datum, flow, gate histories and model regimes; specialists independently assess transients and air movement.

quiz.question: 要驗證「輸水摩阻與瞬變邊界」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Conveyance friction and transient boundaries"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
用同時流量和水位反算水頭損失，保留閘門狀態。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Infer head loss from simultaneous flow and levels with gate state recorded.
quiz.explanation: 用同時流量和水位反算水頭損失，保留閘門狀態。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Infer head loss from simultaneous flow and levels with gate state recorded. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 輸水摩阻與瞬變邊界：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Conveyance friction and transient boundaries: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「滿管沿程損失」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Full-pipe friction loss” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把非穩態壓力峰用來反算粗糙度會產生失真參數。把閘門急動後的壓力峰當穩態摩阻，會錯估粗糙度並漏掉瞬變作用；未排出的氣囊也會改變有效斷面。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Inferring roughness from transient peaks produces misleading parameters. Treating post-gate pressure peaks as steady friction biases roughness and misses transients; trapped air also changes effective area. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：穩態滿管式不能描述水錘、自由水面轉換或氣囊，閘門動作和停機歷程必須另外建立瞬變模型與通氣條件。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Gate movements and shutdown histories require separate transient modelling and explicit ventilation conditions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只算穩態流量就能排除輸水隧道的水錘與氣囊。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A steady-flow calculation excludes water hammer and trapped air in a conveyance tunnel." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把非穩態壓力峰用來反算粗糙度會產生失真參數。把閘門急動後的壓力峰當穩態摩阻，會錯估粗糙度並漏掉瞬變作用；未排出的氣囊也會改變有效斷面。
knowledge.textEn: Inferring roughness from transient peaks produces misleading parameters. Treating post-gate pressure peaks as steady friction biases roughness and misses transients; trapped air also changes effective area.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「輸水摩阻與瞬變邊界」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Conveyance friction and transient boundaries" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把非穩態壓力峰用來反算粗糙度會產生失真參數。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
optionsEn: Inferring roughness from transient peaks produces misleading parameters.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
quiz.explanation: 把非穩態壓力峰用來反算粗糙度會產生失真參數。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Inferring roughness from transient peaks produces misleading parameters. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「環向受力與接縫柔度」與「控制網與貫通誤差」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ring force and joint flexibility" and "Control network and breakthrough error": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ring force and joint flexibility: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「襯砌環向壓縮」如何影響新武界引水隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lining hoop compression” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 引水內襯的平整度和接縫同時影響摩阻與結構，教材將環向量級和局部缺陷分開。圓形襯砌對均勻外壓可主要以環向壓縮抵抗，但接頭轉動、偏壓與背填空隙會引起彎矩。薄環膜應力只說明其中一條受力路徑；脫模、運輸、頂推及永久狀態的荷載不同，環片局部接觸與止水條件必須另外檢核。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「襯砌環向壓縮」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Lining smoothness and joints affect hydraulics and structure; separate hoop-force scale from local defects. A circular lining resists uniform external pressure largely through hoop compression, but joint rotation, uneven load and backfill voids generate bending. Thin-ring membrane stress describes only one load path. Demoulding, transport, jacking and permanent states impose different actions, requiring separate checks of local segment contact and sealing rather than one permanent-load calculation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Lining hoop compression” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.62 MPa；半徑=3.6 m；厚度=0.35 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.62 MPa; radius=3.6 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=6.37714 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「襯砌環向壓縮」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Lining hoop compression”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度
knowledge.text: 引水內襯的平整度和接縫同時影響摩阻與結構，教材將環向量級和局部缺陷分開。圓形襯砌對均勻外壓可主要以環向壓縮抵抗，但接頭轉動、偏壓與背填空隙會引起彎矩。
knowledge.textEn: Lining smoothness and joints affect hydraulics and structure; separate hoop-force scale from local defects. A circular lining resists uniform external pressure largely through hoop compression, but joint rotation, uneven load and backfill voids generate bending.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「環向受力與接縫柔度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ring force and joint flexibility" is correct?
options: 混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
引水內襯的平整度和接縫同時影響摩阻與結構，教材將環向量級和局部缺陷分開。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
optionsEn: Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
Lining smoothness and joints affect hydraulics and structure; separate hoop-force scale from local defects.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
quiz.explanation: 引水內襯的平整度和接縫同時影響摩阻與結構，教材將環向量級和局部缺陷分開。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Lining smoothness and joints affect hydraulics and structure; separate hoop-force scale from local defects. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ring force and joint flexibility: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「襯砌環向壓縮」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lining hoop compression” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.62 MPa；半徑=3.6 m；厚度=0.35 m。σθ=pr/t=6.37714 MPa。僅把均勻外壓增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為7.01486 MPa。邊界：薄圓環膜應力，不是接縫、偏壓或矩形框架解；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.62 MPa; radius=3.6 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=6.37714 MPa. Increasing only uniform external pressure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 7.01486 MPa. Boundary: Thin circular-ring membrane stress, not a joint, uneven-load or rectangular-frame solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把斷面掃描、接縫錯台和水理損失資料連結。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Link section scans, joint offsets and hydraulic-loss data.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Orientation error” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 引水坡度微小時高程誤差可改變排水與淨空判讀，新武界教材強調共同高程基準。長隧道的微小方向誤差會沿距離累積，地下控制網又缺少直接衛星定位，必須把地表基準可靠傳到洞內。閉合差很小不代表無系統誤差；尺度、折光、儀器定向與高程基準可能共同偏移，誤差相關性也使平方和估算失真。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「方向角誤差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: With small conveyance gradients, height errors alter drainage and clearance interpretation; maintain a common elevation reference. Small orientation errors accumulate over long drives, while underground networks lack direct satellite positioning and depend on transferring surface control. Correlated errors also invalidate a naive root-sum-square combination of supposedly independent observations. steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.instruction: 由獨立水準路線重算進出口及中段高程。由獨立測量組複核地表到洞內的轉換，保留原始角距及溫度資料，用不同控制線比較方向與高程偏差。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Recompute inlet, outlet and intermediate elevations through independent levelling. Independently check surface-to-tunnel transformations, retain raw angles, distances and temperatures, and compare orientation and elevation through separate control routes. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「方向角誤差」的交付需回答：由獨立水準路線重算進出口及中段高程。貫通前凍結座標、尺度與高程版本，獨立組直接使用原始觀測重算；不得只傳遞整理好的坐標而遺失校正資訊。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel, the orientation error handover must address the following evidence: Recompute inlet, outlet and intermediate elevations through independent levelling. Freeze coordinate, scale and height revisions before breakthrough; independent reviewers recompute raw observations rather than receiving only adjusted coordinates without corrections.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：角度閉合好不證明縱斷面水準沒有系統偏差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Good angular closure does not establish an unbiased longitudinal level profile. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Independently check surface-to-tunnel transformations, retain raw angles, distances and temperatures, and compare orientation and elevation through separate control routes. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.text: 本案「方向角誤差」的交付需回答：由獨立水準路線重算進出口及中段高程。貫通前凍結座標、尺度與高程版本，獨立組直接使用原始觀測重算；不得只傳遞整理好的坐標而遺失校正資訊。
