Freeze coordinate, scale and height revisions before breakthrough; independent reviewers recompute raw observations rather than receiving only adjusted coordinates without corrections.

quiz.question: 要驗證「控制網與貫通誤差」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Control network and breakthrough error"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
由獨立水準路線重算進出口及中段高程。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Recompute inlet, outlet and intermediate elevations through independent levelling.
Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
quiz.explanation: 由獨立水準路線重算進出口及中段高程。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Recompute inlet, outlet and intermediate elevations through independent levelling. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「方向角誤差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Orientation error” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 角度閉合好不證明縱斷面水準沒有系統偏差。共用錯誤基準可能讓兩組測量同時看似一致，直到貫通或軌道銜接才發現系統偏差，修正成本遠高於早期複核。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Good angular closure does not establish an unbiased longitudinal level profile. A shared wrong datum can make separate surveys appear consistent until breakthrough or track connection exposes bias that is costly to correct. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：閉合差很小不代表無系統誤差；尺度、折光、儀器定向與高程基準可能共同偏移，誤差相關性也使平方和估算失真。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Correlated errors also invalidate a naive root-sum-square combination of supposedly independent observations.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 角度閉合好不證明縱斷面水準沒有系統偏差。共用錯誤基準可能讓兩組測量同時看似一致，直到貫通或軌道銜接才發現系統偏差，修正成本遠高於早期複核。
knowledge.textEn: Good angular closure does not establish an unbiased longitudinal level profile. A shared wrong datum can make separate surveys appear consistent until breakthrough or track connection exposes bias that is costly to correct.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「控制網與貫通誤差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Control network and breakthrough error" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
角度閉合好不證明縱斷面水準沒有系統偏差。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
Good angular closure does not establish an unbiased longitudinal level profile.
quiz.explanation: 角度閉合好不證明縱斷面水準沒有系統偏差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Good angular closure does not establish an unbiased longitudinal level profile. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」與「水量帳與環境受體」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Shared access and transport bottlenecks" and "Water balance and environmental receptors": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「出渣運輸節拍」如何影響新武界引水隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Muck-transport cycle” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 山區引水工程多面施工仍受材料、出渣及維修通道限制，教材把機械產能與供應節拍分開。多工作面只有在供電、通風、出渣與材料供應同步充足時才增加總產量。共用豎井或軌道形成串聯瓶頸，排隊和維修窗口會降低名目容量；緩衝區太大又可能侵占通行與救援空間，因此不能單純把各面產能相加。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「出渣運輸節拍」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Multiple mountain headings remain limited by material, spoil and maintenance access; distinguish machine capacity from supply cycle. Multiple headings increase output only when power, air, muck transport and materials support them together. Shared shafts or railways become serial bottlenecks, while queues and maintenance reduce nominal capacity. Large buffers may obstruct personnel and rescue access, so face capacities cannot simply be added without a network-level transport and storage check. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Muck-transport cycle” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=36 t；往返週期=38 min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=36 t; cycle=38 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「出渣運輸節拍」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Muck-transport cycle”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸
knowledge.text: 山區引水工程多面施工仍受材料、出渣及維修通道限制，教材把機械產能與供應節拍分開。多工作面只有在供電、通風、出渣與材料供應同步充足時才增加總產量。
knowledge.textEn: Multiple mountain headings remain limited by material, spoil and maintenance access; distinguish machine capacity from supply cycle. Multiple headings increase output only when power, air, muck transport and materials support them together.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Shared access and transport bottlenecks" is correct?
options: 山區引水工程多面施工仍受材料、出渣及維修通道限制，教材把機械產能與供應節拍分開。
增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
施工後泉水變少就能單獨證明隧道造成全部減流。
optionsEn: Multiple mountain headings remain limited by material, spoil and maintenance access; distinguish machine capacity from supply cycle.
Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
Reduced spring flow after construction alone proves the tunnel caused the entire change.
quiz.explanation: 山區引水工程多面施工仍受材料、出渣及維修通道限制，教材把機械產能與供應節拍分開。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Multiple mountain headings remain limited by material, spoil and maintenance access; distinguish machine capacity from supply cycle. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「出渣運輸節拍」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Muck-transport cycle” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=36 t；往返週期=38 min。C=N payload 60/T=227.368 t/h。僅把往返週期增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為206.699 t/h。邊界：無排隊理想循環，並非共享路段實際產能；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=36 t; cycle=38 min. C=N payload 60/T=227.368 t/h. Increasing only cycle by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 206.699 t/h. Boundary: Ideal cycle without queues, not actual shared-route production. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對環片或內襯材料、刀具和出渣的共用占時。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check shared access time for lining materials, cutters and spoil.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=36 t；往返週期=38 min。C=N payload 60/T=227.368 t/h。僅把往返週期增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為206.699 t/h。邊界：無排隊理想循環，並非共享路段實際產能；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=36 t; cycle=38 min. C=N payload 60/T=227.368 t/h. Increasing only cycle by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 206.699 t/h. Boundary: Ideal cycle without queues, not actual shared-route production. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Shared access and transport bottlenecks", which statement holds?
options: 岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=36 t；往返週期=38 min。
刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。
optionsEn: Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=36 t; cycle=38 min.
A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=36 t；往返週期=38 min。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=36 t; cycle=38 min. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「出渣運輸節拍」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Muck-transport cycle” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對環片或內襯材料、刀具和出渣的共用占時。以裝載質量、往返時間及排隊時間重建物流曲線，再核對緩衝占用、共用通道優先權與維修時段。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check shared access time for lining materials, cutters and spoil. Reconstruct flow from payload, round-trip and queue times, then check buffer occupancy, shared-route priorities and maintenance periods. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「出渣運輸節拍」的交付需回答：核對環片或內襯材料、刀具和出渣的共用占時。每日排程同時標示人員、材料和維修的占用時段，任何物流改線先檢查通風與應變通道，不能只看運量提升。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel, the muck-transport cycle handover must address the following evidence: Check shared access time for lining materials, cutters and spoil. Schedules show personnel, materials and maintenance occupancy together; rerouting first checks ventilation and emergency access rather than only throughput gains.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：出渣優先若排擠刀具維修會降低後續有效切削時間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Spoil priority that displaces cutter maintenance reduces later productive cutting. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對環片或內襯材料、刀具和出渣的共用占時。以裝載質量、往返時間及排隊時間重建物流曲線，再核對緩衝占用、共用通道優先權與維修時段。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Check shared access time for lining materials, cutters and spoil. Reconstruct flow from payload, round-trip and queue times, then check buffer occupancy, shared-route priorities and maintenance periods. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「出渣運輸節拍」的交付需回答：核對環片或內襯材料、刀具和出渣的共用占時。每日排程同時標示人員、材料和維修的占用時段，任何物流改線先檢查通風與應變通道，不能只看運量提升。
knowledge.textEn: For New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel, the muck-transport cycle handover must address the following evidence: Check shared access time for lining materials, cutters and spoil. Schedules show personnel, materials and maintenance occupancy together; rerouting first checks ventilation and emergency access rather than only throughput gains.

quiz.question: 要驗證「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Shared access and transport bottlenecks"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
只算穩態流量就能排除輸水隧道的水錘與氣囊。
核對環片或內襯材料、刀具和出渣的共用占時。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A steady-flow calculation excludes water hammer and trapped air in a conveyance tunnel.
Check shared access time for lining materials, cutters and spoil.
quiz.explanation: 核對環片或內襯材料、刀具和出渣的共用占時。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check shared access time for lining materials, cutters and spoil. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「出渣運輸節拍」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Muck-transport cycle” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 出渣優先若排擠刀具維修會降低後續有效切削時間。把理想往返時間當全天常數會忽略交會等待與卸料堵塞，導致工作面停工或把材料堆入必要通道。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Spoil priority that displaces cutter maintenance reduces later productive cutting. Treating an ideal cycle as constant all day misses passing delays and unloading blockages, stopping headings or pushing material into essential access space. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：共用豎井或軌道形成串聯瓶頸，排隊和維修窗口會降低名目容量；緩衝區太大又可能侵占通行與救援空間，因此不能單純把各面產能相加。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Large buffers may obstruct personnel and rescue access, so face capacities cannot simply be added without a network-level transport and storage check.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 出渣優先若排擠刀具維修會降低後續有效切削時間。把理想往返時間當全天常數會忽略交會等待與卸料堵塞，導致工作面停工或把材料堆入必要通道。

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Shared access and transport bottlenecks" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 出渣優先若排擠刀具維修會降低後續有效切削時間。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
施工後泉水變少就能單獨證明隧道造成全部減流。
optionsEn: Spoil priority that displaces cutter maintenance reduces later productive cutting.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Reduced spring flow after construction alone proves the tunnel caused the entire change.
quiz.explanation: 出渣優先若排擠刀具維修會降低後續有效切削時間。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Spoil priority that displaces cutter maintenance reduces later productive cutting. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 水量帳與環境受體：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Water balance and environmental receptors: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「邊界水量差」如何影響新武界引水隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Boundary water-balance residual” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 引水目的與施工排水可能改變不同流域受體，本課以水量帳區分轉移水、地層滲水和天然補注。隧道排水可能改變泉水、溪流或地下水補注，但同時還有降雨、季節與既有抽水等影響。水量平衡需要明確時間和空間邊界，殘差不能直接歸因於某一裂隙；應用施工前基線和對照站區分自然變化與工程效應。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「邊界水量差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Conveyance and construction drainage affect different receptors; separate transferred water, groundwater inflow and natural recharge. Tunnel drainage may alter springs, streams or groundwater recharge, alongside rainfall, seasonal change and existing abstraction. A water balance needs explicit temporal and spatial boundaries; its residual cannot be assigned directly to one fracture. Baseline observations and control locations help separate natural variability from construction effects rather than equating correlation with causation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Boundary water-balance residual” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：流入=148 m³/day；流出=79 m³/day；其他損失=20 m³/day。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: inflow=148 m³/day; outflow=79 m³/day; other loss=20 m³/day. ΔS=I−O−loss=49 m³/day.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「施工後泉水變少就能單獨證明隧道造成全部減流。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reduced spring flow after construction alone proves the tunnel caused the entire change." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「邊界水量差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Boundary water-balance residual”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 水量帳與環境受體
knowledge.text: 引水目的與施工排水可能改變不同流域受體，本課以水量帳區分轉移水、地層滲水和天然補注。隧道排水可能改變泉水、溪流或地下水補注，但同時還有降雨、季節與既有抽水等影響。
knowledge.textEn: Conveyance and construction drainage affect different receptors; separate transferred water, groundwater inflow and natural recharge. Tunnel drainage may alter springs, streams or groundwater recharge, alongside rainfall, seasonal change and existing abstraction.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：施工後泉水變少就能單獨證明隧道造成全部減流。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Reduced spring flow after construction alone proves the tunnel caused the entire change. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「水量帳與環境受體」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Water balance and environmental receptors" is correct?
options: 施工後泉水變少就能單獨證明隧道造成全部減流。
引水目的與施工排水可能改變不同流域受體，本課以水量帳區分轉移水、地層滲水和天然補注。
水體流過全程的時間必然等於洪峰抵達的時間。
optionsEn: Reduced spring flow after construction alone proves the tunnel caused the entire change.
Conveyance and construction drainage affect different receptors; separate transferred water, groundwater inflow and natural recharge.
Material travel time necessarily equals flood-peak arrival time.
quiz.explanation: 引水目的與施工排水可能改變不同流域受體，本課以水量帳區分轉移水、地層滲水和天然補注。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Conveyance and construction drainage affect different receptors; separate transferred water, groundwater inflow and natural recharge. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 水量帳與環境受體：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Water balance and environmental receptors: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「邊界水量差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Boundary water-balance residual” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：流入=148 m³/day；流出=79 m³/day；其他損失=20 m³/day。ΔS=I−O−loss=49 m³/day。僅把流入增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為63.8 m³/day。邊界：指定邊界日水量帳，不是因果或含水層參數證明；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: inflow=148 m³/day; outflow=79 m³/day; other loss=20 m³/day. ΔS=I−O−loss=49 m³/day. Increasing only inflow by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 63.8 m³/day. Boundary: Daily balance in a stated boundary, not causal proof or aquifer-parameter identification. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：明示集水區和時間邊界，以對照點核對季節變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: State catchment and time boundaries and use controls to check seasonality.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：流入=148 m³/day；流出=79 m³/day；其他損失=20 m³/day。ΔS=I−O−loss=49 m³/day。僅把流入增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為63.8 m³/day。邊界：指定邊界日水量帳，不是因果或含水層參數證明；不是本工程實測或允收值。

Increasing only inflow by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 63.8 m³/day. Boundary: Daily balance in a stated boundary, not causal proof or aquifer-parameter identification. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「水量帳與環境受體」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Water balance and environmental receptors", which statement holds?
options: 目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
原創教學假設：流入=148 m³/day；流出=79 m³/day；其他損失=20 m³/day。

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「邊界水量差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.observationEn: Site practice: For New Wujie water-conveyance tunnel, the boundary water-balance residual handover must address the following evidence: State catchment and time boundaries and use controls to check seasonality. steps.failure: 注意干擾：將轉引水量視為地下水損失會錯估環境影響來源。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「施工後泉水變少就能單獨證明隧道造成全部減流。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Reduced spring flow after construction alone proves the tunnel caused the entire change." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將轉引水量視為地下水損失會錯估環境影響來源。未量到的支流或時間錯位會產生假性水量損失，錯把所有減流歸於隧道可能導致無效補救。
knowledge.textEn: Treating diverted surface water as groundwater loss misidentifies environmental effects. Unmeasured tributaries or timing mismatch create false losses; attributing every decrease to the tunnel can prompt ineffective mitigation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「水量帳與環境受體」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Water balance and environmental receptors" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
將轉引水量視為地下水損失會錯估環境影響來源。
水體流過全程的時間必然等於洪峰抵達的時間。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Treating diverted surface water as groundwater loss misidentifies environmental effects.
Material travel time necessarily equals flood-peak arrival time.
quiz.explanation: 將轉引水量視為地下水損失會錯估環境影響來源。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating diverted surface water as groundwater loss misidentifies environmental effects. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 蘇花改觀音隧道
summary: 公路機關列觀音隧道約7.9公里、雙孔單向配置，並記錄利用舊北迴隧道增加施工工作面。本課從這項既有設施再利用出發，分析地質弱帶、地下水、控制網、施工交通與通風設備介面；貫通和2020年蘇花改全線通車是不同事件，課程不把兩者混為一談。
summaryEn: The highway authority describes Guanyin as approximately 7.9 km with twin directional bores and reuse of an old railway tunnel to create working faces. This course follows weak ground, groundwater, survey, construction traffic and ventilation interfaces. Breakthrough and the 2020 opening of the full Suhua improvement corridor remain distinct events.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創綜合審查：先計算「破碎帶連通與預報更新」，再獨立計算「控制網與貫通誤差」。原創教學假設：滲透係數=3e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=370 m²。Q=k i A=0.002331 m³/s。僅把滲透係數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0025641 m³/s。邊界：均質飽和達西流，不代表裂隙集中流；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：控制長度=5040 m；方向偏角=2.5 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0610865 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0671952 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated review: first calculate fault connectivity and forecast updating, then independently calculate control network and breakthrough error. Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=3e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=370 m². Q=k i A=0.002331 m³/s. Increasing only conductivity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0025641 m³/s. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated Darcy flow, not concentrated fracture flow. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: control length=5040 m; orientation error=2.5 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0610865 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0671952 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「服務邊界與路線代價」與「破碎帶連通與預報更新」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Service boundaries and alignment cost" and "Fault connectivity and forecast updating": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「路線里程與端點」如何影響蘇花改觀音隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Alignment chainage and endpoints” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Suhua Highway Guanyin Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 觀音與鄰接谷風及短橋形成連續服務路廊，教材分開單隧道里程與系統連續行車範圍。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「路線里程與端點」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Guanyin and neighbouring tunnel-bridge links form a continuous corridor; distinguish one tunnel length from the operational route. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk. Compare options between identical endpoints and distinguish running bores, approaches and service galleries. Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Alignment chainage and endpoints” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：長度=18.8 km；速度=60 km/h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: length=18.8 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=18.8 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「路線里程與端點」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Alignment chainage and endpoints”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 服務邊界與路線代價
knowledge.text: 觀音與鄰接谷風及短橋形成連續服務路廊，教材分開單隧道里程與系統連續行車範圍。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。
knowledge.textEn: Guanyin and neighbouring tunnel-bridge links form a continuous corridor; distinguish one tunnel length from the operational route. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「服務邊界與路線代價」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Service boundaries and alignment cost" is correct?
options: 最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
觀音與鄰接谷風及短橋形成連續服務路廊，教材分開單隧道里程與系統連續行車範圍。
岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
optionsEn: The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
Guanyin and neighbouring tunnel-bridge links form a continuous corridor; distinguish one tunnel length from the operational route.
Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
quiz.explanation: 觀音與鄰接谷風及短橋形成連續服務路廊，教材分開單隧道里程與系統連續行車範圍。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Guanyin and neighbouring tunnel-bridge links form a continuous corridor; distinguish one tunnel length from the operational route. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「路線里程與端點」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Alignment chainage and endpoints” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：長度=18.8 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=18.8 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為20.68 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: length=18.8 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=18.8 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 20.68 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以相同起訖點核對觀音、橋及鄰洞的範圍。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconcile Guanyin, bridge and adjacent-bore scope between fixed endpoints.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：長度=18.8 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=18.8 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為20.68 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: length=18.8 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=18.8 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 20.68 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「服務邊界與路線代價」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Service boundaries and alignment cost", which statement holds?
options: 支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
原創教學假設：長度=18.8 km；速度=60 km/h。
optionsEn: Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
Original teaching assumptions: length=18.8 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=18.8 min.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：長度=18.8 km；速度=60 km/h。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: length=18.8 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=18.8 min. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「路線里程與端點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Alignment chainage and endpoints” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以相同起訖點核對觀音、橋及鄰洞的範圍。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconcile Guanyin, bridge and adjacent-bore scope between fixed endpoints. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：以相同起訖點核對觀音、橋及鄰洞的範圍。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Suhua Highway Guanyin Tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Reconcile Guanyin, bridge and adjacent-bore scope between fixed endpoints. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只看單洞長度可能漏掉鄰洞事故對交通及救援的影響。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Single-bore length misses adjacent-tunnel effects on traffic and rescue. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以相同起訖點核對觀音、橋及鄰洞的範圍。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Reconcile Guanyin, bridge and adjacent-bore scope between fixed endpoints. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：以相同起訖點核對觀音、橋及鄰洞的範圍。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。
knowledge.textEn: For Suhua Highway Guanyin Tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Reconcile Guanyin, bridge and adjacent-bore scope between fixed endpoints. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.

quiz.question: 要驗證「服務邊界與路線代價」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Service boundaries and alignment cost"?
options: 以相同起訖點核對觀音、橋及鄰洞的範圍。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
optionsEn: Reconcile Guanyin, bridge and adjacent-bore scope between fixed endpoints.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 以相同起訖點核對觀音、橋及鄰洞的範圍。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconcile Guanyin, bridge and adjacent-bore scope between fixed endpoints. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「路線里程與端點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Alignment chainage and endpoints” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只看單洞長度可能漏掉鄰洞事故對交通及救援的影響。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Single-bore length misses adjacent-tunnel effects on traffic and rescue. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「服務邊界與路線代價」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

steps.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Fault connectivity and forecast updating: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「破碎帶連通性」如何影響蘇花改觀音隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fault-zone connectivity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Suhua Highway Guanyin Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 觀音公開論壇討論地質弱帶，本課研究裂隙填充、產狀和掌子面水量如何共同修正預報。斷層帶可以含很硬的岩塊，但整體變形與湧水常由填充節理和連通裂隙控制。單一岩芯強度不能代表整個掌子面；超前鑽孔、出水變化與揭露地質須回饋同一里程模型，預報則應保留不同情境及其證據權重。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「破碎帶連通性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Official technical forums discuss weak zones; combine infill, orientation and face inflow to update forecasts. A fault zone may contain strong intact blocks while filled joints and connected fractures govern its bulk deformation and inflow. One core strength does not represent the entire face. Probe records, water response and exposed geology must update a common chainage model, preserving competing interpretations and their evidential weight rather than treating a forecast as certainty. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fault-zone connectivity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：滲透係數=3e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=370 m²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=3e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=370 m².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「破碎帶連通性」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Fault-zone connectivity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新
knowledge.text: 觀音公開論壇討論地質弱帶，本課研究裂隙填充、產狀和掌子面水量如何共同修正預報。斷層帶可以含很硬的岩塊，但整體變形與湧水常由填充節理和連通裂隙控制。
knowledge.textEn: Official technical forums discuss weak zones; combine infill, orientation and face inflow to update forecasts. A fault zone may contain strong intact blocks while filled joints and connected fractures govern its bulk deformation and inflow.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「破碎帶連通與預報更新」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fault connectivity and forecast updating" is correct?
options: 岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
觀音公開論壇討論地質弱帶，本課研究裂隙填充、產狀和掌子面水量如何共同修正預報。
optionsEn: Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Official technical forums discuss weak zones; combine infill, orientation and face inflow to update forecasts.
quiz.explanation: 觀音公開論壇討論地質弱帶，本課研究裂隙填充、產狀和掌子面水量如何共同修正預報。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Official technical forums discuss weak zones; combine infill, orientation and face inflow to update forecasts. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fault connectivity and forecast updating: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「破碎帶連通性」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fault-zone connectivity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：滲透係數=3e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=370 m²。Q=k i A=0.002331 m³/s。僅把滲透係數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0025641 m³/s。邊界：均質飽和達西流，不代表裂隙集中流；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=3e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=370 m². Q=k i A=0.002331 m³/s. Increasing only conductivity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0025641 m³/s. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated Darcy flow, not concentrated fracture flow. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：按工作面和里程整理弱帶類型與後續支護反應。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Organise weak-zone types and support response by face and chainage.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：滲透係數=3e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=370 m²。Q=k i A=0.002331 m³/s。僅把滲透係數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0025641 m³/s。邊界：均質飽和達西流，不代表裂隙集中流；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=3e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=370 m². Q=k i A=0.002331 m³/s. Increasing only conductivity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0025641 m³/s. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated Darcy flow, not concentrated fracture flow. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「破碎帶連通與預報更新」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fault connectivity and forecast updating", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：滲透係數=3e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=370 m²。
增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
只要空間分成兩層就可以採用相同的樓板荷載。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=3e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=370 m².
Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
Any space divided into two levels can use the same deck loading.

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=3e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=370 m². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fault connectivity and forecast updating: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「破碎帶連通性」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fault-zone connectivity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 按工作面和里程整理弱帶類型與後續支護反應。將岩心回收、裂隙方位與出水曲線按里程對齊，用未參與建模的孔段作交叉檢驗，檢查是否只擬合已知資料。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Organise weak-zone types and support response by face and chainage. Align recovery, fracture orientation and inflow by chainage; test the interpretation against a withheld borehole interval to detect fitting only the known observations. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Suhua Highway Guanyin Tunnel, the fault-zone connectivity handover must address the following evidence: Organise weak-zone types and support response by face and chainage. Retain previous interpretations and new evidence at every update; geology and support designers jointly interpret differences and reconfirm approved bounds when ground conditions change.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：同一弱帶名稱可能含不同水理連通性，不能只套固定參數。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: One weak-zone label can hide differing connectivity and cannot dictate fixed parameters. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」與「支護啟動與變形容量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Piezometric head and lining pressure" and "Support activation and deformation capacity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「測壓水頭」如何影響蘇花改觀音隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Piezometric head” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Suhua Highway Guanyin Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 舊鐵路坑與新道路孔可能形成水力聯繫，教材檢查增加工作面後出水重新分配的假想情境。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「測壓水頭」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Old railway galleries and new road bores may interact hydraulically; test hypothetical flow redistribution after new access opens. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level. Drainage reduces pressure but can increase effective stress and settlement. Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Piezometric head” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=100 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=100 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=981 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「測壓水頭」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Piezometric head”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓
knowledge.text: 舊鐵路坑與新道路孔可能形成水力聯繫，教材檢查增加工作面後出水重新分配的假想情境。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。
knowledge.textEn: Old railway galleries and new road bores may interact hydraulically; test hypothetical flow redistribution after new access opens. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Piezometric head and lining pressure" is correct?
options: 舊鐵路坑與新道路孔可能形成水力聯繫，教材檢查增加工作面後出水重新分配的假想情境。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
optionsEn: Old railway galleries and new road bores may interact hydraulically; test hypothetical flow redistribution after new access opens.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
quiz.explanation: 舊鐵路坑與新道路孔可能形成水力聯繫，教材檢查增加工作面後出水重新分配的假想情境。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Old railway galleries and new road bores may interact hydraulically; test hypothetical flow redistribution after new access opens. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「測壓水頭」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Piezometric head” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=100 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=981 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1079.1 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=100 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=981 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1079.1 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步記錄舊坑及新孔水頭與出流變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronise old-gallery and new-bore head and flow changes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=100 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=981 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1079.1 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=100 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=981 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1079.1 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Piezometric head and lining pressure", which statement holds?
options: 兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=100 m。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
optionsEn: Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=100 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=981 kPa.
Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=100 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=100 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=981 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「測壓水頭」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Piezometric head” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步記錄舊坑及新孔水頭與出流變化。使用分層測壓管及流量計，配合降雨或潮位序列分辨補注與設備影響，將讀值統一換算至同一高程基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronise old-gallery and new-bore head and flow changes. Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：同步記錄舊坑及新孔水頭與出流變化。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Suhua Highway Guanyin Tunnel, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Synchronise old-gallery and new-bore head and flow changes. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：新孔水少可能只是舊坑先截水，並非地層原本乾燥。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Low new-bore flow may reflect interception by the old gallery rather than dry ground. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同步記錄舊坑及新孔水頭與出流變化。使用分層測壓管及流量計，配合降雨或潮位序列分辨補注與設備影響，將讀值統一換算至同一高程基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Synchronise old-gallery and new-bore head and flow changes. Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：同步記錄舊坑及新孔水頭與出流變化。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。
knowledge.textEn: For Suhua Highway Guanyin Tunnel, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Synchronise old-gallery and new-bore head and flow changes. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.

quiz.question: 要驗證「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Piezometric head and lining pressure"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
同步記錄舊坑及新孔水頭與出流變化。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
Synchronise old-gallery and new-bore head and flow changes.
quiz.explanation: 同步記錄舊坑及新孔水頭與出流變化。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Synchronise old-gallery and new-bore head and flow changes. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「測壓水頭」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Piezometric head” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 新孔水少可能只是舊坑先截水，並非地層原本乾燥。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Low new-bore flow may reflect interception by the old gallery rather than dry ground. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 新孔水少可能只是舊坑先截水，並非地層原本乾燥。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。
knowledge.textEn: Low new-bore flow may reflect interception by the old gallery rather than dry ground. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Piezometric head and lining pressure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 新孔水少可能只是舊坑先截水，並非地層原本乾燥。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
optionsEn: Low new-bore flow may reflect interception by the old gallery rather than dry ground.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
quiz.explanation: 新孔水少可能只是舊坑先截水，並非地層原本乾燥。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Low new-bore flow may reflect interception by the old gallery rather than dry ground. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「支護安裝時點」如何影響蘇花改觀音隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Support activation time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Suhua Highway Guanyin Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 多工作面通過弱帶的支護時序不同，教材比較相同地質但不同封閉時間的收斂荷重。支護荷載由開挖釋放量和支護啟動時間共同決定，越早安裝不一定讓構件受力越小。地盤反力與支護曲線必須連同掌子面距離及封閉順序理解；擠壓性地層還需保留變形容量，不能只追求高剛度與高材料強度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「支護安裝時點」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Different headings cross weak zones with different closure timing; compare loads and convergence within the same geology. Support load depends on stress release and activation time, so earlier installation does not necessarily reduce member forces. Interpret ground-reaction and support curves together with distance from the face and closure sequence. Squeezing ground also needs deformation capacity; high stiffness and material strength alone do not guarantee a compatible support response. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Support activation time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：局部剛度=47 kN/mm；位移=8 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=47 kN/mm; movement=8 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「支護安裝時點」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Support activation time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 支護啟動與變形容量
knowledge.text: 多工作面通過弱帶的支護時序不同，教材比較相同地質但不同封閉時間的收斂荷重。支護荷載由開挖釋放量和支護啟動時間共同決定，越早安裝不一定讓構件受力越小。
knowledge.textEn: Different headings cross weak zones with different closure timing; compare loads and convergence within the same geology. Support load depends on stress release and activation time, so earlier installation does not necessarily reduce member forces.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「支護啟動與變形容量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Support activation and deformation capacity" is correct?
options: 支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
多工作面通過弱帶的支護時序不同，教材比較相同地質但不同封閉時間的收斂荷重。
增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
optionsEn: Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
Different headings cross weak zones with different closure timing; compare loads and convergence within the same geology.
Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
quiz.explanation: 多工作面通過弱帶的支護時序不同，教材比較相同地質但不同封閉時間的收斂荷重。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Different headings cross weak zones with different closure timing; compare loads and convergence within the same geology. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「支護安裝時點」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Support activation time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：局部剛度=47 kN/mm；位移=8 mm。F=ku=376 kN。僅把位移增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為413.6 kN。邊界：線性局部彈簧，不含屈服或時間效應；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=47 kN/mm; movement=8 mm. F=ku=376 kN. Increasing only movement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 413.6 kN. Boundary: Local linear spring without yielding or time effects. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將封閉時間標在各工作面的同齡期曲線。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Mark closure time on age-aligned histories from each heading.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：局部剛度=47 kN/mm；位移=8 mm。F=ku=376 kN。僅把位移增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為413.6 kN。邊界：線性局部彈簧，不含屈服或時間效應；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=47 kN/mm; movement=8 mm. F=ku=376 kN. Increasing only movement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 413.6 kN. Boundary: Local linear spring without yielding or time effects. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「支護啟動與變形容量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Support activation and deformation capacity", which statement holds?
options: 只要空間分成兩層就可以採用相同的樓板荷載。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
原創教學假設：局部剛度=47 kN/mm；位移=8 mm。
optionsEn: Any space divided into two levels can use the same deck loading.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=47 kN/mm; movement=8 mm.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：局部剛度=47 kN/mm；位移=8 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=47 kN/mm; movement=8 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「支護安裝時點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Support activation time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將封閉時間標在各工作面的同齡期曲線。同步記錄收斂、支護荷重與安裝里程，比較同一地質分區內的速率及荷載，不將不同開挖齡期讀值直接混合。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Mark closure time on age-aligned histories from each heading. Synchronise convergence, support loads and installation chainage; compare rates and loads within one ground domain without mixing readings at different excavation ages. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「支護安裝時點」的交付需回答：將封閉時間標在各工作面的同齡期曲線。把安裝時間和量測資料一起交付支護設計者，任何級別變更都需地質及位移證據，不能憑單一瞬間讀值自行改支護。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Suhua Highway Guanyin Tunnel, the support activation time handover must address the following evidence: Mark closure time on age-aligned histories from each heading. Submit installation times with measurements to the support designer; class changes need both ground and movement evidence, not an isolated instantaneous reading.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：按施工日期直接比較會混入不同開挖齡期。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Comparing calendar dates directly mixes different excavation ages. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將封閉時間標在各工作面的同齡期曲線。同步記錄收斂、支護荷重與安裝里程，比較同一地質分區內的速率及荷載，不將不同開挖齡期讀值直接混合。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Mark closure time on age-aligned histories from each heading. Synchronise convergence, support loads and installation chainage; compare rates and loads within one ground domain without mixing readings at different excavation ages. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
