knowledge.text: 本案「支護安裝時點」的交付需回答：將封閉時間標在各工作面的同齡期曲線。把安裝時間和量測資料一起交付支護設計者，任何級別變更都需地質及位移證據，不能憑單一瞬間讀值自行改支護。
knowledge.textEn: For Suhua Highway Guanyin Tunnel, the support activation time handover must address the following evidence: Mark closure time on age-aligned histories from each heading. Submit installation times with measurements to the support designer; class changes need both ground and movement evidence, not an isolated instantaneous reading.

quiz.question: 要驗證「支護啟動與變形容量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Support activation and deformation capacity"?
options: 將封閉時間標在各工作面的同齡期曲線。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Mark closure time on age-aligned histories from each heading.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 將封閉時間標在各工作面的同齡期曲線。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Mark closure time on age-aligned histories from each heading. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「支護安裝時點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Support activation time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 按施工日期直接比較會混入不同開挖齡期。過晚封閉會讓不可回復變形增加，過硬且行程不足的支護也可能脆裂，兩者都可能表現為裂縫而需不同處理。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Comparing calendar dates directly mixes different excavation ages. Late closure increases irreversible movement, while excessively stiff support with little travel can fail brittly; both produce cracks but require different diagnoses. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：地盤反力與支護曲線必須連同掌子面距離及封閉順序理解；擠壓性地層還需保留變形容量，不能只追求高剛度與高材料強度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Squeezing ground also needs deformation capacity; high stiffness and material strength alone do not guarantee a compatible support response.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 按施工日期直接比較會混入不同開挖齡期。過晚封閉會讓不可回復變形增加，過硬且行程不足的支護也可能脆裂，兩者都可能表現為裂縫而需不同處理。
knowledge.textEn: Comparing calendar dates directly mixes different excavation ages. Late closure increases irreversible movement, while excessively stiff support with little travel can fail brittly; both produce cracks but require different diagnoses.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「支護啟動與變形容量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Support activation and deformation capacity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
按施工日期直接比較會混入不同開挖齡期。
增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Comparing calendar dates directly mixes different excavation ages.
Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
quiz.explanation: 按施工日期直接比較會混入不同開挖齡期。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Comparing calendar dates directly mixes different excavation ages. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」與「控制網與貫通誤差」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Shared access and transport bottlenecks" and "Control network and breakthrough error": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「出渣運輸節拍」如何影響蘇花改觀音隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Muck-transport cycle” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Suhua Highway Guanyin Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 既有鐵路坑增設工作面也帶來共享通道瓶頸，觀音教材用完整循環檢查材料與出渣交會。多工作面只有在供電、通風、出渣與材料供應同步充足時才增加總產量。共用豎井或軌道形成串聯瓶頸，排隊和維修窗口會降低名目容量；緩衝區太大又可能侵占通行與救援空間，因此不能單純把各面產能相加。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「出渣運輸節拍」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Reusing a railway gallery adds headings but also shared-access bottlenecks; examine complete material and spoil cycles. Multiple headings increase output only when power, air, muck transport and materials support them together. Shared shafts or railways become serial bottlenecks, while queues and maintenance reduce nominal capacity. Large buffers may obstruct personnel and rescue access, so face capacities cannot simply be added without a network-level transport and storage check. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Muck-transport cycle” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=37 t；往返週期=34 min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=37 t; cycle=34 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「出渣運輸節拍」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Muck-transport cycle”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Shared access and transport bottlenecks" is correct?
options: 增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。

optionsEn: Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「出渣運輸節拍」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Muck-transport cycle” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 工作面數增加不能直接倍增每日總進尺。把理想往返時間當全天常數會忽略交會等待與卸料堵塞，導致工作面停工或把材料堆入必要通道。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: More headings do not directly multiply daily total advance. Treating an ideal cycle as constant all day misses passing delays and unloading blockages, stopping headings or pushing material into essential access space. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：共用豎井或軌道形成串聯瓶頸，排隊和維修窗口會降低名目容量；緩衝區太大又可能侵占通行與救援空間，因此不能單純把各面產能相加。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Large buffers may obstruct personnel and rescue access, so face capacities cannot simply be added without a network-level transport and storage check.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
More headings do not directly multiply daily total advance.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「方向角誤差」如何影響蘇花改觀音隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Orientation error” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Suhua Highway Guanyin Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 多面貫通需把舊坑坐標傳入新孔，教材分析歷史基準與現代控制網轉換的誤差。長隧道的微小方向誤差會沿距離累積，地下控制網又缺少直接衛星定位，必須把地表基準可靠傳到洞內。閉合差很小不代表無系統誤差；尺度、折光、儀器定向與高程基準可能共同偏移，誤差相關性也使平方和估算失真。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「方向角誤差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Multiple breakthroughs require transfer from old-gallery coordinates into new bores, including historical-to-modern datum errors. Small orientation errors accumulate over long drives, while underground networks lack direct satellite positioning and depend on transferring surface control. A small closure does not exclude systematic bias: scale, refraction, orientation and vertical datum may shift together. Correlated errors also invalidate a naive root-sum-square combination of supposedly independent observations. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Orientation error” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：控制長度=5040 m；方向偏角=2.5 arcsec。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: control length=5040 m; orientation error=2.5 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0610865 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「方向角誤差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.text: 誤解：兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

optionsEn: Multiple breakthroughs require transfer from old-gallery coordinates into new bores, including historical-to-modern datum errors.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：控制長度=5040 m；方向偏角=2.5 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0610865 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0671952 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

Freeze coordinate, scale and height revisions before breakthrough; independent reviewers recompute raw observations rather than receiving only adjusted coordinates without corrections.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：舊坑幾何吻合不證明其坐標可直接用於新道路孔。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Agreement with old-gallery geometry does not validate direct coordinate reuse. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用新地表控制獨立覆核舊坑基準與方向。由獨立測量組複核地表到洞內的轉換，保留原始角距及溫度資料，用不同控制線比較方向與高程偏差。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Independently recheck old-gallery references and orientation from new surface control. Independently check surface-to-tunnel transformations, retain raw angles, distances and temperatures, and compare orientation and elevation through separate control routes. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.text: 本案「方向角誤差」的交付需回答：用新地表控制獨立覆核舊坑基準與方向。貫通前凍結座標、尺度與高程版本，獨立組直接使用原始觀測重算；不得只傳遞整理好的坐標而遺失校正資訊。

Freeze coordinate, scale and height revisions before breakthrough; independent reviewers recompute raw observations rather than receiving only adjusted coordinates without corrections.

quiz.question: 要驗證「控制網與貫通誤差」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Control network and breakthrough error"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
用新地表控制獨立覆核舊坑基準與方向。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Independently recheck old-gallery references and orientation from new surface control.

quiz.explanationEn: Independently recheck old-gallery references and orientation from new surface control. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「方向角誤差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Orientation error” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 舊坑幾何吻合不證明其坐標可直接用於新道路孔。共用錯誤基準可能讓兩組測量同時看似一致，直到貫通或軌道銜接才發現系統偏差，修正成本遠高於早期複核。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Agreement with old-gallery geometry does not validate direct coordinate reuse. A shared wrong datum can make separate surveys appear consistent until breakthrough or track connection exposes bias that is costly to correct. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：閉合差很小不代表無系統誤差；尺度、折光、儀器定向與高程基準可能共同偏移，誤差相關性也使平方和估算失真。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Correlated errors also invalidate a naive root-sum-square combination of supposedly independent observations.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 舊坑幾何吻合不證明其坐標可直接用於新道路孔。共用錯誤基準可能讓兩組測量同時看似一致，直到貫通或軌道銜接才發現系統偏差，修正成本遠高於早期複核。
knowledge.textEn: Agreement with old-gallery geometry does not validate direct coordinate reuse. A shared wrong datum can make separate surveys appear consistent until breakthrough or track connection exposes bias that is costly to correct.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「控制網與貫通誤差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Control network and breakthrough error" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 舊坑幾何吻合不證明其坐標可直接用於新道路孔。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
只要空間分成兩層就可以採用相同的樓板荷載。
optionsEn: Agreement with old-gallery geometry does not validate direct coordinate reuse.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Any space divided into two levels can use the same deck loading.
quiz.explanation: 舊坑幾何吻合不證明其坐標可直接用於新道路孔。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Agreement with old-gallery geometry does not validate direct coordinate reuse. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「內部樓板與荷載路徑」與「通風網路與壓力損失」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Internal decks and load paths" and "Ventilation network and pressure loss": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 內部樓板與荷載路徑：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Internal decks and load paths: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「樓板條帶受彎」如何影響蘇花改觀音隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Deck-strip bending” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Suhua Highway Guanyin Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 觀音通風機房及管道情境中的隔板是設備風道構件，不是雙層道路樓板，荷載功能必須先辨認。雙層公路的樓板、或隧道內設備隔板，都把局部荷載傳給支承，但兩者功能與設計作用並不相同。簡支條帶可估計均載彎矩，集中輪載、剪力、疲勞與火災降強度必須另驗；幾何空間分層不能取代結構邊界的確認。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「樓板條帶受彎」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A ventilation-room or duct partition is an equipment-airway component, not a double-deck roadway slab; establish its function first. A double-deck road slab and an equipment partition both transfer local loads to supports but serve different functions and design actions. A simply supported strip estimates uniform-load bending. Concentrated wheel loads, shear, fatigue and fire-reduced strength require separate checks; dividing space geometrically does not establish the actual structural restraints. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Deck-strip bending” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：單位長載重=37 kN/m；跨距=3.9 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: line load=37 kN/m; span=3.9 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要空間分成兩層就可以採用相同的樓板荷載。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Any space divided into two levels can use the same deck loading." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「樓板條帶受彎」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Deck-strip bending”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 內部樓板與荷載路徑
knowledge.text: 觀音通風機房及管道情境中的隔板是設備風道構件，不是雙層道路樓板，荷載功能必須先辨認。雙層公路的樓板、或隧道內設備隔板，都把局部荷載傳給支承，但兩者功能與設計作用並不相同。
knowledge.textEn: A ventilation-room or duct partition is an equipment-airway component, not a double-deck roadway slab; establish its function first. A double-deck road slab and an equipment partition both transfer local loads to supports but serve different functions and design actions.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要空間分成兩層就可以採用相同的樓板荷載。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Any space divided into two levels can use the same deck loading. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「內部樓板與荷載路徑」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Internal decks and load paths" is correct?
options: 只要空間分成兩層就可以採用相同的樓板荷載。
觀音通風機房及管道情境中的隔板是設備風道構件，不是雙層道路樓板，荷載功能必須先辨認。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
optionsEn: Any space divided into two levels can use the same deck loading.
A ventilation-room or duct partition is an equipment-airway component, not a double-deck roadway slab; establish its function first.
Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 觀音通風機房及管道情境中的隔板是設備風道構件，不是雙層道路樓板，荷載功能必須先辨認。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A ventilation-room or duct partition is an equipment-airway component, not a double-deck roadway slab; establish its function first. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 內部樓板與荷載路徑：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Internal decks and load paths: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「樓板條帶受彎」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Deck-strip bending” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：單位長載重=37 kN/m；跨距=3.9 m。M=qL²/8=70.3462 kN·m。僅把跨距增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為85.119 kN·m。邊界：均載簡支單向條帶，連續框架及板效應另驗；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: line load=37 kN/m; span=3.9 m. M=qL²/8=70.3462 kN·m. Increasing only span by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 85.119 kN·m. Boundary: Uniformly loaded simply supported strip; frame continuity and plate action need separate checks. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對隔板支承、風壓及維修荷載，不套車輪荷載。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check partition supports, air pressure and maintenance loading without substituting wheel loads.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：單位長載重=37 kN/m；跨距=3.9 m。M=qL²/8=70.3462 kN·m。僅把跨距增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為85.119 kN·m。邊界：均載簡支單向條帶，連續框架及板效應另驗；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: line load=37 kN/m; span=3.9 m. M=qL²/8=70.3462 kN·m. Increasing only span by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 85.119 kN·m. Boundary: Uniformly loaded simply supported strip; frame continuity and plate action need separate checks. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「內部樓板與荷載路徑」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Internal decks and load paths", which statement holds?
options: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
原創教學假設：單位長載重=37 kN/m；跨距=3.9 m。
optionsEn: Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
Original teaching assumptions: line load=37 kN/m; span=3.9 m.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：單位長載重=37 kN/m；跨距=3.9 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: line load=37 kN/m; span=3.9 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 內部樓板與荷載路徑：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Internal decks and load paths: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「樓板條帶受彎」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Deck-strip bending” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對隔板支承、風壓及維修荷載，不套車輪荷載。核對支承位置、施工接縫及荷載分布，將實測撓度與分階段模型比較，分辨整體變形與支承滑移。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check partition supports, air pressure and maintenance loading without substituting wheel loads. Check support positions, construction joints and load distribution; compare measured deflection with staged models to distinguish member bending from support slip. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「樓板條帶受彎」的交付需回答：核對隔板支承、風壓及維修荷載，不套車輪荷載。交付時明示樓板用途、支承及各施工階段，讓建築淨空、設備配置及結構假設在同一版本中核對。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Suhua Highway Guanyin Tunnel, the deck-strip bending handover must address the following evidence: Check partition supports, air pressure and maintenance loading without substituting wheel loads. State deck function, supports and construction stages at handover so clearance, equipment layout and structural assumptions can be reconciled in one revision.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將風道隔板當行車樓板會錯置荷載與檢核目的。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating an airway partition as a roadway deck misassigns loads and checks. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對隔板支承、風壓及維修荷載，不套車輪荷載。核對支承位置、施工接縫及荷載分布，將實測撓度與分階段模型比較，分辨整體變形與支承滑移。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Check partition supports, air pressure and maintenance loading without substituting wheel loads. Check support positions, construction joints and load distribution; compare measured deflection with staged models to distinguish member bending from support slip. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「樓板條帶受彎」的交付需回答：核對隔板支承、風壓及維修荷載，不套車輪荷載。交付時明示樓板用途、支承及各施工階段，讓建築淨空、設備配置及結構假設在同一版本中核對。
knowledge.textEn: For Suhua Highway Guanyin Tunnel, the deck-strip bending handover must address the following evidence: Check partition supports, air pressure and maintenance loading without substituting wheel loads. State deck function, supports and construction stages at handover so clearance, equipment layout and structural assumptions can be reconciled in one revision.

quiz.question: 要驗證「內部樓板與荷載路徑」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Internal decks and load paths"?
options: 核對隔板支承、風壓及維修荷載，不套車輪荷載。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
optionsEn: Check partition supports, air pressure and maintenance loading without substituting wheel loads.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
quiz.explanation: 核對隔板支承、風壓及維修荷載，不套車輪荷載。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check partition supports, air pressure and maintenance loading without substituting wheel loads. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 內部樓板與荷載路徑：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Internal decks and load paths: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「樓板條帶受彎」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Deck-strip bending” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將風道隔板當行車樓板會錯置荷載與檢核目的。把隔板誤當行車樓板會使用錯誤荷載，反之漏掉交通集中荷載則低估局部彎剪與疲勞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating an airway partition as a roadway deck misassigns loads and checks. Mistaking a partition for a roadway deck applies the wrong actions, while omitting concentrated traffic load underestimates local bending, shear and fatigue. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：簡支條帶可估計均載彎矩，集中輪載、剪力、疲勞與火災降強度必須另驗；幾何空間分層不能取代結構邊界的確認。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Concentrated wheel loads, shear, fatigue and fire-reduced strength require separate checks; dividing space geometrically does not establish the actual structural restraints.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要空間分成兩層就可以採用相同的樓板荷載。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Any space divided into two levels can use the same deck loading." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將風道隔板當行車樓板會錯置荷載與檢核目的。把隔板誤當行車樓板會使用錯誤荷載，反之漏掉交通集中荷載則低估局部彎剪與疲勞。
knowledge.textEn: Treating an airway partition as a roadway deck misassigns loads and checks. Mistaking a partition for a roadway deck applies the wrong actions, while omitting concentrated traffic load underestimates local bending, shear and fatigue.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「內部樓板與荷載路徑」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Internal decks and load paths" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
將風道隔板當行車樓板會錯置荷載與檢核目的。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Treating an airway partition as a roadway deck misassigns loads and checks.
Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 將風道隔板當行車樓板會錯置荷載與檢核目的。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating an airway partition as a roadway deck misassigns loads and checks. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「風道摩擦壓損」如何影響蘇花改觀音隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Duct friction loss” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Suhua Highway Guanyin Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 觀音與相鄰設施的通風控制需保留門位和車流邊界，教材分析設備維修時支路阻力重分配。風機提供壓差，實際風量由風道摩阻、局部損失、外風與其他風機共同決定。支路開關會重新分配整個網路，不能把額定風量直接加總；正常污染稀釋與火災控煙也有不同目標，需要分別建立受控邊界和故障情境。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「風道摩擦壓損」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ventilation control must retain door and traffic boundaries across linked facilities; examine resistance redistribution during maintenance. Fans supply pressure, but actual flow follows friction, local losses, external wind and interactions with other fans. Switching a branch redistributes the network rather than simply adding rated flows. Routine dilution and fire smoke control have different objectives, so each needs explicit boundaries, operating states and failure cases rather than one universal flow target. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Duct friction loss” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=1180 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.7 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=1180 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.7 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=60.5783 Pa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「風道摩擦壓損」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Duct friction loss”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 通風網路與壓力損失
knowledge.text: 觀音與相鄰設施的通風控制需保留門位和車流邊界，教材分析設備維修時支路阻力重分配。風機提供壓差，實際風量由風道摩阻、局部損失、外風與其他風機共同決定。
knowledge.textEn: Ventilation control must retain door and traffic boundaries across linked facilities; examine resistance redistribution during maintenance. Fans supply pressure, but actual flow follows friction, local losses, external wind and interactions with other fans.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「通風網路與壓力損失」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ventilation network and pressure loss" is correct?
options: 風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
觀音與相鄰設施的通風控制需保留門位和車流邊界，教材分析設備維修時支路阻力重分配。
optionsEn: Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
Ventilation control must retain door and traffic boundaries across linked facilities; examine resistance redistribution during maintenance.
quiz.explanation: 觀音與相鄰設施的通風控制需保留門位和車流邊界，教材分析設備維修時支路阻力重分配。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Ventilation control must retain door and traffic boundaries across linked facilities; examine resistance redistribution during maintenance. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「風道摩擦壓損」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Duct friction loss” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=1180 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.7 m/s。Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=60.5783 Pa。僅把平均風速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為73.2997 Pa。邊界：定密度直管摩阻，局部損失及外風另計；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=1180 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.7 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=60.5783 Pa. Increasing only mean velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 73.2997 Pa. Boundary: Constant-density straight-duct friction; local loss and external wind are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步比較風門狀態、機房壓差與孔內風速。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare damper state, plant-room pressure and in-bore velocity simultaneously.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=1180 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.7 m/s。Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=60.5783 Pa。僅把平均風速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為73.2997 Pa。邊界：定密度直管摩阻，局部損失及外風另計；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=1180 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.7 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=60.5783 Pa. Increasing only mean velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 73.2997 Pa. Boundary: Constant-density straight-duct friction; local loss and external wind are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「通風網路與壓力損失」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ventilation network and pressure loss", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=1180 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.7 m/s。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=1180 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.7 m/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=1180 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.7 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=60.5783 Pa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「風道摩擦壓損」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Duct friction loss” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步比較風門狀態、機房壓差與孔內風速。沿線同步量測靜壓與風速，記錄風門及其他風機狀態，再把實測工作點和風機曲線、網路壓損比較。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare damper state, plant-room pressure and in-bore velocity simultaneously. Measure pressure and velocity synchronously, record dampers and other fans, and compare the measured duty point with fan curves and network resistance. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「風道摩擦壓損」的交付需回答：同步比較風門狀態、機房壓差與孔內風速。驗收採明確風門和車流邊界，維修改線後重新核對網路工作點，火災模式由防災責任工程師簽認而非沿用正常模式。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Suhua Highway Guanyin Tunnel, the duct friction loss handover must address the following evidence: Compare damper state, plant-room pressure and in-bore velocity simultaneously. Commission with specified damper and traffic boundaries, recheck duty points after rerouting, and have the fire-safety engineer approve emergency modes independently.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：機房風量正常可能伴隨風道漏風而使道路區效果不足。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Normal plant flow can coexist with duct leakage and inadequate roadway flow. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同步比較風門狀態、機房壓差與孔內風速。沿線同步量測靜壓與風速，記錄風門及其他風機狀態，再把實測工作點和風機曲線、網路壓損比較。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Compare damper state, plant-room pressure and in-bore velocity simultaneously. Measure pressure and velocity synchronously, record dampers and other fans, and compare the measured duty point with fan curves and network resistance. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「風道摩擦壓損」的交付需回答：同步比較風門狀態、機房壓差與孔內風速。驗收採明確風門和車流邊界，維修改線後重新核對網路工作點，火災模式由防災責任工程師簽認而非沿用正常模式。
knowledge.textEn: For Suhua Highway Guanyin Tunnel, the duct friction loss handover must address the following evidence: Compare damper state, plant-room pressure and in-bore velocity simultaneously. Commission with specified damper and traffic boundaries, recheck duty points after rerouting, and have the fire-safety engineer approve emergency modes independently.

quiz.question: 要驗證「通風網路與壓力損失」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ventilation network and pressure loss"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
同步比較風門狀態、機房壓差與孔內風速。
增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Compare damper state, plant-room pressure and in-bore velocity simultaneously.
Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
quiz.explanation: 同步比較風門狀態、機房壓差與孔內風速。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare damper state, plant-room pressure and in-bore velocity simultaneously. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「風道摩擦壓損」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Duct friction loss” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 機房風量正常可能伴隨風道漏風而使道路區效果不足。只看風機轉速會漏掉風門誤位或短路漏風，可能在總耗電增加時，真正需要的區段反而風量不足。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Normal plant flow can coexist with duct leakage and inadequate roadway flow. Fan speed alone misses a misplaced damper or leakage shortcut; total power may rise while the critical section receives less air. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：支路開關會重新分配整個網路，不能把額定風量直接加總；正常污染稀釋與火災控煙也有不同目標，需要分別建立受控邊界和故障情境。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Routine dilution and fire smoke control have different objectives, so each needs explicit boundaries, operating states and failure cases rather than one universal flow target.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 機房風量正常可能伴隨風道漏風而使道路區效果不足。只看風機轉速會漏掉風門誤位或短路漏風，可能在總耗電增加時，真正需要的區段反而風量不足。
knowledge.textEn: Normal plant flow can coexist with duct leakage and inadequate roadway flow. Fan speed alone misses a misplaced damper or leakage shortcut; total power may rise while the critical section receives less air.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「通風網路與壓力損失」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ventilation network and pressure loss" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
機房風量正常可能伴隨風道漏風而使道路區效果不足。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
Normal plant flow can coexist with duct leakage and inadequate roadway flow.
quiz.explanation: 機房風量正常可能伴隨風道漏風而使道路區效果不足。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Normal plant flow can coexist with duct leakage and inadequate roadway flow. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「疏散時間與分區可用性」與「資產編碼與可追溯交接」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Evacuation time and zone availability" and "Asset identity and traceable handover": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Evacuation time and zone availability: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「所需疏散時間」如何影響蘇花改觀音隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Required evacuation time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Suhua Highway Guanyin Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 連續長隧道路廊的救援需確認鄰孔及出口狀態，教材把最短橫通道距離和完整轉移路徑分開。疏散時間包含辨識、反應、移動及排隊，不只由出口距離決定。人員速度會受煙熱、能見度及行動能力影響，安全判斷還要比較可用安全時間；橫通道存在但門或鄰孔不可用時，圖上的最短路線不一定能作實際選擇。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「所需疏散時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A linked long-tunnel corridor needs receiving-bore and exit checks; separate nearest passage distance from the complete transfer route. Evacuation includes detection, response, travel and queues, not merely distance to an exit. Smoke, visibility and mobility alter walking speed, while safety requires comparison with available safe time. A passage shown on a plan may be unusable because its door or receiving bore is unavailable, invalidating the nominal shortest route. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Required evacuation time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：前置時間=114 s；行走距離=360 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=114 s; travel distance=360 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「所需疏散時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Required evacuation time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性
knowledge.text: 連續長隧道路廊的救援需確認鄰孔及出口狀態，教材把最短橫通道距離和完整轉移路徑分開。疏散時間包含辨識、反應、移動及排隊，不只由出口距離決定。
knowledge.textEn: A linked long-tunnel corridor needs receiving-bore and exit checks; separate nearest passage distance from the complete transfer route. Evacuation includes detection, response, travel and queues, not merely distance to an exit.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「疏散時間與分區可用性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Evacuation time and zone availability" is correct?
options: 連續長隧道路廊的救援需確認鄰孔及出口狀態，教材把最短橫通道距離和完整轉移路徑分開。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
optionsEn: A linked long-tunnel corridor needs receiving-bore and exit checks; separate nearest passage distance from the complete transfer route.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
quiz.explanation: 連續長隧道路廊的救援需確認鄰孔及出口狀態，教材把最短橫通道距離和完整轉移路徑分開。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A linked long-tunnel corridor needs receiving-bore and exit checks; separate nearest passage distance from the complete transfer route. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Evacuation time and zone availability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「所需疏散時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Required evacuation time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：前置時間=114 s；行走距離=360 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。RSET=tpre+d/v=564 s。僅把行走距離增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為609 s。邊界：單群體固定速度，不含排隊煙熱及能力差異，不能單獨判安全；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=114 s; travel distance=360 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. RSET=tpre+d/v=564 s. Increasing only travel distance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 609 s. Boundary: One group at fixed speed without queues, smoke or mobility differences; not a safety conclusion. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：走查橫通道後續路徑及實際門位，保留施工封閉。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Walk the route beyond each passage and record actual doors and closures.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：前置時間=114 s；行走距離=360 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。RSET=tpre+d/v=564 s。僅把行走距離增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為609 s。邊界：單群體固定速度，不含排隊煙熱及能力差異，不能單獨判安全；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=114 s; travel distance=360 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. RSET=tpre+d/v=564 s. Increasing only travel distance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 609 s. Boundary: One group at fixed speed without queues, smoke or mobility differences; not a safety conclusion. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「疏散時間與分區可用性」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Evacuation time and zone availability", which statement holds?
options: 岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
原創教學假設：前置時間=114 s；行走距離=360 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
optionsEn: Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=114 s; travel distance=360 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s.
Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：前置時間=114 s；行走距離=360 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=114 s; travel distance=360 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Evacuation time and zone availability: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「所需疏散時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Required evacuation time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 走查橫通道後續路徑及實際門位，保留施工封閉。以人流模擬或受控演練分辨前置時間、行走與門口排隊，核對每個出口接收區的可用狀態及通訊紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Walk the route beyond each passage and record actual doors and closures. Separate pre-movement, travel and doorway queues through simulation or controlled drills, checking receiving-zone availability and communication records for each exit. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「所需疏散時間」的交付需回答：走查橫通道後續路徑及實際門位，保留施工封閉。疏散模型保留人口、速度分布及出口狀態，演練改動由營運與防災責任者批准，教材算例不得當作現場指揮程序。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Suhua Highway Guanyin Tunnel, the required evacuation time handover must address the following evidence: Walk the route beyond each passage and record actual doors and closures. Retain population, speed distribution and exit states; operations and fire-safety owners approve drill changes, and classroom calculations are not incident-command procedures.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：到達橫通道並不等於已抵達可持續停留的安全位置。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Reaching a cross passage does not establish arrival at a sustainable safe location. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 走查橫通道後續路徑及實際門位，保留施工封閉。以人流模擬或受控演練分辨前置時間、行走與門口排隊，核對每個出口接收區的可用狀態及通訊紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Walk the route beyond each passage and record actual doors and closures. Separate pre-movement, travel and doorway queues through simulation or controlled drills, checking receiving-zone availability and communication records for each exit. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「所需疏散時間」的交付需回答：走查橫通道後續路徑及實際門位，保留施工封閉。疏散模型保留人口、速度分布及出口狀態，演練改動由營運與防災責任者批准，教材算例不得當作現場指揮程序。

Retain population, speed distribution and exit states; operations and fire-safety owners approve drill changes, and classroom calculations are not incident-command procedures.

quiz.question: 要驗證「疏散時間與分區可用性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Evacuation time and zone availability"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
走查橫通道後續路徑及實際門位，保留施工封閉。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
Walk the route beyond each passage and record actual doors and closures.
quiz.explanation: 走查橫通道後續路徑及實際門位，保留施工封閉。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Walk the route beyond each passage and record actual doors and closures. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Evacuation time and zone availability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「所需疏散時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Required evacuation time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 到達橫通道並不等於已抵達可持續停留的安全位置。以最快成人速度套全部旅客會低估需求，若忽略接收孔受煙或車流影響，疏散可能移到另一個危險邊界。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Reaching a cross passage does not establish arrival at a sustainable safe location. Applying the fastest adult speed to everyone understates demand; overlooking smoke or traffic in the receiving bore can transfer evacuees into another hazard. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：人員速度會受煙熱、能見度及行動能力影響，安全判斷還要比較可用安全時間；橫通道存在但門或鄰孔不可用時，圖上的最短路線不一定能作實際選擇。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A passage shown on a plan may be unusable because its door or receiving bore is unavailable, invalidating the nominal shortest route.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.
