混凝土抗壓強度合格就代表厚壁構件不會產生熱裂縫。
optionsEn: Immersion surveying must handle tide, attitude and control revisions; examine accumulated bias along the element chain.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
Adequate compressive strength proves that thick concrete cannot develop thermal cracks.
quiz.explanation: 海上沉放量測須處理潮位、姿態和控制網版本，教材研究偏差如何沿管列累積。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「方向角誤差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Orientation error” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：控制長度=5160 m；方向偏角=2.5 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.062541 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0687951 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: control length=5160 m; orientation error=2.5 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.062541 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0687951 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以獨立岸基觀測覆核定位及落底後高程。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Independently check positioning and post-placement elevation from shore control.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0687951 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

quiz.question: 依「控制網與貫通誤差」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。

quiz.explanation: 以獨立岸基觀測覆核定位及落底後高程。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Independently check positioning and post-placement elevation from shore control. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「方向角誤差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Orientation error” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 多次觀測若共用錯誤潮位基準，不會自行消除高程偏差。共用錯誤基準可能讓兩組測量同時看似一致，直到貫通或軌道銜接才發現系統偏差，修正成本遠高於早期複核。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Repeated observations sharing a wrong tidal datum do not remove elevation bias. A shared wrong datum can make separate surveys appear consistent until breakthrough or track connection exposes bias that is costly to correct. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：閉合差很小不代表無系統誤差；尺度、折光、儀器定向與高程基準可能共同偏移，誤差相關性也使平方和估算失真。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Correlated errors also invalidate a naive root-sum-square combination of supposedly independent observations.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 多次觀測若共用錯誤潮位基準，不會自行消除高程偏差。共用錯誤基準可能讓兩組測量同時看似一致，直到貫通或軌道銜接才發現系統偏差，修正成本遠高於早期複核。
knowledge.textEn: Repeated observations sharing a wrong tidal datum do not remove elevation bias. A shared wrong datum can make separate surveys appear consistent until breakthrough or track connection exposes bias that is costly to correct.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「控制網與貫通誤差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Control network and breakthrough error" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 多次觀測若共用錯誤潮位基準，不會自行消除高程偏差。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
混凝土抗壓強度合格就代表厚壁構件不會產生熱裂縫。
optionsEn: Repeated observations sharing a wrong tidal datum do not remove elevation bias.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Adequate compressive strength proves that thick concrete cannot develop thermal cracks.
quiz.explanation: 多次觀測若共用錯誤潮位基準，不會自行消除高程偏差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Repeated observations sharing a wrong tidal datum do not remove elevation bias. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「溫度拘束與構件裂縫」與「氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Thermal restraint and component cracking" and "Chloride transport and durability interpretation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 溫度拘束與構件裂縫：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Thermal restraint and component cracking: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「拘束溫度應變」如何影響港珠澳大橋海底隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Restrained thermal strain” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao immersed tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大型預製箱體受早期水化熱與後續降溫，教材把熱應力量級和裂縫水密要求分開。厚壁構件在水化升溫後冷卻，若相鄰構件或基座限制收縮，熱應變會轉為拉應力。抗壓強度達標不等於抗裂合格，因為彈性模數成熟、徐變、溫度梯度與澆置順序都影響實際拘束；完全拘束彈性估算只能當量級上限比較。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「拘束溫度應變」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Large precast boxes experience hydration heat and later cooling; distinguish thermal-stress scale from crack-watertightness requirements. A thick element cools after hydration, and restraint from adjacent pours or its base converts contraction into tension. Compressive-strength compliance does not establish crack resistance because modulus development, creep, gradients and pour sequence influence restraint. A fully restrained elastic estimate is therefore a scale bound, not a prediction of actual cracking or residual stress. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Restrained thermal strain” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：線膨脹係數=1e-05 K⁻¹；溫差=28 K；彈性模數=25 GPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: expansion coefficient=1e-05 K⁻¹; temperature difference=28 K; elastic modulus=25 GPa. σ=EαΔT, GPa→MPa ×1000=7 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土抗壓強度合格就代表厚壁構件不會產生熱裂縫。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adequate compressive strength proves that thick concrete cannot develop thermal cracks." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「拘束溫度應變」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Restrained thermal strain”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 溫度拘束與構件裂縫
knowledge.text: 大型預製箱體受早期水化熱與後續降溫，教材把熱應力量級和裂縫水密要求分開。厚壁構件在水化升溫後冷卻，若相鄰構件或基座限制收縮，熱應變會轉為拉應力。
knowledge.textEn: Large precast boxes experience hydration heat and later cooling; distinguish thermal-stress scale from crack-watertightness requirements. A thick element cools after hydration, and restraint from adjacent pours or its base converts contraction into tension.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：混凝土抗壓強度合格就代表厚壁構件不會產生熱裂縫。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adequate compressive strength proves that thick concrete cannot develop thermal cracks. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「溫度拘束與構件裂縫」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Thermal restraint and component cracking" is correct?
options: 混凝土抗壓強度合格就代表厚壁構件不會產生熱裂縫。
大型預製箱體受早期水化熱與後續降溫，教材把熱應力量級和裂縫水密要求分開。
擴散長度就是鋼筋開始腐蝕的位置和精確時間。
optionsEn: Adequate compressive strength proves that thick concrete cannot develop thermal cracks.
Large precast boxes experience hydration heat and later cooling; distinguish thermal-stress scale from crack-watertightness requirements.
Diffusion length gives the exact location and time of corrosion initiation.
quiz.explanation: 大型預製箱體受早期水化熱與後續降溫，教材把熱應力量級和裂縫水密要求分開。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Large precast boxes experience hydration heat and later cooling; distinguish thermal-stress scale from crack-watertightness requirements. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 溫度拘束與構件裂縫：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Thermal restraint and component cracking: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「拘束溫度應變」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Restrained thermal strain” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：線膨脹係數=1e-05 K⁻¹；溫差=28 K；彈性模數=25 GPa。σ=EαΔT, GPa→MPa ×1000=7 MPa。僅把溫差增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為7.7 MPa。邊界：完全拘束線彈性量級，未含徐變開裂和拘束鬆弛；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: expansion coefficient=1e-05 K⁻¹; temperature difference=28 K; elastic modulus=25 GPa. σ=EαΔT, GPa→MPa ×1000=7 MPa. Increasing only temperature difference by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 7.7 MPa. Boundary: Fully restrained linear-elastic scale without creep, cracking or restraint relaxation. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較厚壁內外溫差及拘束位置的裂縫分布。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare through-wall gradients with cracking near restraints.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：線膨脹係數=1e-05 K⁻¹；溫差=28 K；彈性模數=25 GPa。σ=EαΔT, GPa→MPa ×1000=7 MPa。僅把溫差增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為7.7 MPa。邊界：完全拘束線彈性量級，未含徐變開裂和拘束鬆弛；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: expansion coefficient=1e-05 K⁻¹; temperature difference=28 K; elastic modulus=25 GPa. σ=EαΔT, GPa→MPa ×1000=7 MPa. Increasing only temperature difference by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 7.7 MPa. Boundary: Fully restrained linear-elastic scale without creep, cracking or restraint relaxation. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「溫度拘束與構件裂縫」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Thermal restraint and component cracking", which statement holds?
options: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
矩形沉管可以直接使用圓環均勻外壓公式設計。
原創教學假設：線膨脹係數=1e-05 K⁻¹；溫差=28 K；彈性模數=25 GPa。
optionsEn: Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
A rectangular immersed tube can be designed directly with a circular-ring pressure formula.
Original teaching assumptions: expansion coefficient=1e-05 K⁻¹; temperature difference=28 K; elastic modulus=25 GPa. σ=EαΔT, GPa→MPa ×1000=7 MPa.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：線膨脹係數=1e-05 K⁻¹；溫差=28 K；彈性模數=25 GPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: expansion coefficient=1e-05 K⁻¹; temperature difference=28 K; elastic modulus=25 GPa. σ=EαΔT, GPa→MPa ×1000=7 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 溫度拘束與構件裂縫：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Thermal restraint and component cracking: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「拘束溫度應變」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Restrained thermal strain” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較厚壁內外溫差及拘束位置的裂縫分布。記錄核心表面溫度及同條件試體成熟度，將裂縫位置與溫差、拆模及鄰段澆置時間配對，檢查熱歷程是否被遺漏。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare through-wall gradients with cracking near restraints. Record core/surface temperature and matched-cured maturity, pairing cracks with temperature differences, formwork removal and adjacent pours to identify missing thermal history. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「拘束溫度應變」的交付需回答：比較厚壁內外溫差及拘束位置的裂縫分布。澆置前核准溫度監測及養護方案，變更材料、拆模或澆置順序時重新檢查熱分析，將裂縫與接縫止水的責任一併交付。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao immersed tunnel, the restrained thermal strain handover must address the following evidence: Compare through-wall gradients with cracking near restraints. Approve monitoring and curing before pours, revisit thermal analysis after material or sequence changes, and hand over crack and waterstop responsibilities together.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：單一平均溫度無法代表厚壁熱梯度引起的局部應力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: One average temperature does not represent local stress from thick-wall gradients. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較厚壁內外溫差及拘束位置的裂縫分布。記錄核心表面溫度及同條件試體成熟度，將裂縫位置與溫差、拆模及鄰段澆置時間配對，檢查熱歷程是否被遺漏。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Compare through-wall gradients with cracking near restraints. Record core/surface temperature and matched-cured maturity, pairing cracks with temperature differences, formwork removal and adjacent pours to identify missing thermal history. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「拘束溫度應變」的交付需回答：比較厚壁內外溫差及拘束位置的裂縫分布。澆置前核准溫度監測及養護方案，變更材料、拆模或澆置順序時重新檢查熱分析，將裂縫與接縫止水的責任一併交付。
knowledge.textEn: For Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao immersed tunnel, the restrained thermal strain handover must address the following evidence: Compare through-wall gradients with cracking near restraints. Approve monitoring and curing before pours, revisit thermal analysis after material or sequence changes, and hand over crack and waterstop responsibilities together.

quiz.question: 要驗證「溫度拘束與構件裂縫」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Thermal restraint and component cracking"?
options: 比較厚壁內外溫差及拘束位置的裂縫分布。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
各管節平均高程接近就能排除接頭差異變形。
optionsEn: Compare through-wall gradients with cracking near restraints.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Similar mean element elevations exclude differential movement at joints.
quiz.explanation: 比較厚壁內外溫差及拘束位置的裂縫分布。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare through-wall gradients with cracking near restraints. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 溫度拘束與構件裂縫：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Thermal restraint and component cracking: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「拘束溫度應變」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Restrained thermal strain” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 單一平均溫度無法代表厚壁熱梯度引起的局部應力。標準養護試體合格而現場過早冷卻，仍可能形成貫穿裂縫並影響止水；僅增加後續抗壓試驗無法重建失去的養護。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: One average temperature does not represent local stress from thick-wall gradients. Passing standard-cured specimens does not prevent through-cracking after rapid cooling, and more later strength tests cannot reconstruct inadequate curing. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：抗壓強度達標不等於抗裂合格，因為彈性模數成熟、徐變、溫度梯度與澆置順序都影響實際拘束；完全拘束彈性估算只能當量級上限比較。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A fully restrained elastic estimate is therefore a scale bound, not a prediction of actual cracking or residual stress.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土抗壓強度合格就代表厚壁構件不會產生熱裂縫。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adequate compressive strength proves that thick concrete cannot develop thermal cracks." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 單一平均溫度無法代表厚壁熱梯度引起的局部應力。標準養護試體合格而現場過早冷卻，仍可能形成貫穿裂縫並影響止水；僅增加後續抗壓試驗無法重建失去的養護。
knowledge.textEn: One average temperature does not represent local stress from thick-wall gradients. Passing standard-cured specimens does not prevent through-cracking after rapid cooling, and more later strength tests cannot reconstruct inadequate curing.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「溫度拘束與構件裂縫」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Thermal restraint and component cracking" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

擴散長度就是鋼筋開始腐蝕的位置和精確時間。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
One average temperature does not represent local stress from thick-wall gradients.
Diffusion length gives the exact location and time of corrosion initiation.

quiz.explanationEn: One average temperature does not represent local stress from thick-wall gradients. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Chloride transport and durability interpretation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「擴散特徵長度」如何影響港珠澳大橋海底隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Diffusion characteristic length” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao immersed tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 外海鹽水環境下箱體表面與接頭傳輸不同，教材將擴散特徵長度和鋼筋腐蝕啟動分開。海水或除冰鹽可提供氯離子，材料孔隙與裂縫控制其傳輸；鋼筋腐蝕還需要局部電化學條件。平方根擴散長度僅顯示時間尺度，並不是腐蝕門檻深度；表面濃度變化、乾濕循環、結合效應及施工裂縫須另行辨識。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「擴散特徵長度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Box surfaces and joints transport chloride differently; distinguish characteristic diffusion length from reinforcement corrosion initiation. Seawater or deicing salt supplies chloride, while pores and cracks govern transport; reinforcement corrosion also depends on local electrochemical conditions. A square-root diffusion length indicates a time scale, not a corrosion-threshold depth. Surface concentration, wetting cycles, binding and construction cracks must be distinguished rather than hidden in one fitted diffusivity. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Diffusion characteristic length” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：擴散係數=3e-12 m²/s；暴露時間=17 year。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: diffusivity=3e-12 m²/s; exposure=17 year. ℓ=√(Dt); 1 year=365.25×86400 s; m→mm ×1000=40.1178 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「擴散長度就是鋼筋開始腐蝕的位置和精確時間。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Diffusion length gives the exact location and time of corrosion initiation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「擴散特徵長度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Diffusion characteristic length”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Seawater or deicing salt supplies chloride, while pores and cracks govern transport; reinforcement corrosion also depends on local electrochemical conditions.

外海鹽水環境下箱體表面與接頭傳輸不同，教材將擴散特徵長度和鋼筋腐蝕啟動分開。

Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.

steps.title: 氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Chloride transport and durability interpretation: quantitative estimate

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Diffusion characteristic length” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：擴散係數=3e-12 m²/s；暴露時間=17 year。ℓ=√(Dt); 1 year=365.25×86400 s; m→mm ×1000=40.1178 mm。僅把暴露時間增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為42.0759 mm。邊界：特徵長度，不是腐蝕起始壽命或氯鹽門檻深度；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: diffusivity=3e-12 m²/s; exposure=17 year. ℓ=√(Dt); 1 year=365.25×86400 s; m→mm ×1000=40.1178 mm. Increasing only exposure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 42.0759 mm. Boundary: Characteristic length, not corrosion-initiation life or chloride-threshold depth. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：按裂縫與未裂區分層取樣，不把接縫水當材料係數。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Sample cracked and uncracked zones separately rather than fitting joint water into a material coefficient.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

Positive residual buoyancy establishes stability in every sea state.

steps.title: 氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Chloride transport and durability interpretation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「擴散特徵長度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Diffusion characteristic length” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 按裂縫與未裂區分層取樣，不把接縫水當材料係數。以分層取樣的氯鹽剖面配合裂縫圖與電位量測，檢查擴散模型是否只適用未開裂材料。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Sample cracked and uncracked zones separately rather than fitting joint water into a material coefficient. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ventilation network and pressure loss" and "Asset identity and traceable handover": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「風道摩擦壓損」如何影響港珠澳大橋海底隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Duct friction loss” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao immersed tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 隧道與人工島通風設施互為邊界，教材研究島上外風與孔內車流對工況點的聯合作用。風機提供壓差，實際風量由風道摩阻、局部損失、外風與其他風機共同決定。支路開關會重新分配整個網路，不能把額定風量直接加總；正常污染稀釋與火災控煙也有不同目標，需要分別建立受控邊界和故障情境。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「風道摩擦壓損」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Island ventilation facilities and the tunnel share boundaries; examine external wind and traffic effects on operating points. Fans supply pressure, but actual flow follows friction, local losses, external wind and interactions with other fans. Switching a branch redistributes the network rather than simply adding rated flows. Routine dilution and fire smoke control have different objectives, so each needs explicit boundaries, operating states and failure cases rather than one universal flow target. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Duct friction loss” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=1220 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.8 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=1220 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.8 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=66.063 Pa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「風道摩擦壓損」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Duct friction loss”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 通風網路與壓力損失
knowledge.text: 隧道與人工島通風設施互為邊界，教材研究島上外風與孔內車流對工況點的聯合作用。風機提供壓差，實際風量由風道摩阻、局部損失、外風與其他風機共同決定。
knowledge.textEn: Island ventilation facilities and the tunnel share boundaries; examine external wind and traffic effects on operating points. Fans supply pressure, but actual flow follows friction, local losses, external wind and interactions with other fans.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「通風網路與壓力損失」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ventilation network and pressure loss" is correct?
options: 隧道與人工島通風設施互為邊界，教材研究島上外風與孔內車流對工況點的聯合作用。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
optionsEn: Island ventilation facilities and the tunnel share boundaries; examine external wind and traffic effects on operating points.
Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
quiz.explanation: 隧道與人工島通風設施互為邊界，教材研究島上外風與孔內車流對工況點的聯合作用。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Island ventilation facilities and the tunnel share boundaries; examine external wind and traffic effects on operating points. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「風道摩擦壓損」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Duct friction loss” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=1220 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.8 m/s。Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=66.063 Pa。僅把平均風速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為79.9362 Pa。邊界：定密度直管摩阻，局部損失及外風另計；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=1220 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.8 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=66.063 Pa. Increasing only mean velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 79.9362 Pa. Boundary: Constant-density straight-duct friction; local loss and external wind are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步量測外風、風機狀態、風道壓差及道路風速。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronise wind, fan state, duct pressure and roadway velocity.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=1220 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.8 m/s。Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=66.063 Pa。僅把平均風速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為79.9362 Pa。邊界：定密度直管摩阻，局部損失及外風另計；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=1220 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.8 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=66.063 Pa. Increasing only mean velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 79.9362 Pa. Boundary: Constant-density straight-duct friction; local loss and external wind are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「通風網路與壓力損失」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ventilation network and pressure loss", which statement holds?
options: 矩形沉管可以直接使用圓環均勻外壓公式設計。
原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=1220 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.8 m/s。
各管節平均高程接近就能排除接頭差異變形。
optionsEn: A rectangular immersed tube can be designed directly with a circular-ring pressure formula.
Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless.
Similar mean element elevations exclude differential movement at joints.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=1220 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.8 m/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=1220 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.8 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=66.063 Pa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「風道摩擦壓損」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Duct friction loss” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步量測外風、風機狀態、風道壓差及道路風速。沿線同步量測靜壓與風速，記錄風門及其他風機狀態，再把實測工作點和風機曲線、網路壓損比較。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronise wind, fan state, duct pressure and roadway velocity. Measure pressure and velocity synchronously, record dampers and other fans, and compare the measured duty point with fan curves and network resistance. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「風道摩擦壓損」的交付需回答：同步量測外風、風機狀態、風道壓差及道路風速。驗收採明確風門和車流邊界，維修改線後重新核對網路工作點，火災模式由防災責任工程師簽認而非沿用正常模式。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao immersed tunnel, the duct friction loss handover must address the following evidence: Synchronise wind, fan state, duct pressure and roadway velocity. Commission with specified damper and traffic boundaries, recheck duty points after rerouting, and have the fire-safety engineer approve emergency modes independently.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：額定風量不含島上風壓變化，不能直接代表實際換氣。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Rated flow excludes varying island wind pressure and is not actual ventilation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同步量測外風、風機狀態、風道壓差及道路風速。沿線同步量測靜壓與風速，記錄風門及其他風機狀態，再把實測工作點和風機曲線、網路壓損比較。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Synchronise wind, fan state, duct pressure and roadway velocity. Measure pressure and velocity synchronously, record dampers and other fans, and compare the measured duty point with fan curves and network resistance. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「風道摩擦壓損」的交付需回答：同步量測外風、風機狀態、風道壓差及道路風速。驗收採明確風門和車流邊界，維修改線後重新核對網路工作點，火災模式由防災責任工程師簽認而非沿用正常模式。
knowledge.textEn: For Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao immersed tunnel, the duct friction loss handover must address the following evidence: Synchronise wind, fan state, duct pressure and roadway velocity. Commission with specified damper and traffic boundaries, recheck duty points after rerouting, and have the fire-safety engineer approve emergency modes independently.

quiz.question: 要驗證「通風網路與壓力損失」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ventilation network and pressure loss"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
同步量測外風、風機狀態、風道壓差及道路風速。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
Synchronise wind, fan state, duct pressure and roadway velocity.
quiz.explanation: 同步量測外風、風機狀態、風道壓差及道路風速。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Synchronise wind, fan state, duct pressure and roadway velocity. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「風道摩擦壓損」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Duct friction loss” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 額定風量不含島上風壓變化，不能直接代表實際換氣。只看風機轉速會漏掉風門誤位或短路漏風，可能在總耗電增加時，真正需要的區段反而風量不足。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Rated flow excludes varying island wind pressure and is not actual ventilation. Fan speed alone misses a misplaced damper or leakage shortcut; total power may rise while the critical section receives less air. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：支路開關會重新分配整個網路，不能把額定風量直接加總；正常污染稀釋與火災控煙也有不同目標，需要分別建立受控邊界和故障情境。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Routine dilution and fire smoke control have different objectives, so each needs explicit boundaries, operating states and failure cases rather than one universal flow target.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 額定風量不含島上風壓變化，不能直接代表實際換氣。只看風機轉速會漏掉風門誤位或短路漏風，可能在總耗電增加時，真正需要的區段反而風量不足。
knowledge.textEn: Rated flow excludes varying island wind pressure and is not actual ventilation. Fan speed alone misses a misplaced damper or leakage shortcut; total power may rise while the critical section receives less air.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「通風網路與壓力損失」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ventilation network and pressure loss" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 額定風量不含島上風壓變化，不能直接代表實際換氣。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
optionsEn: Rated flow excludes varying island wind pressure and is not actual ventilation.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
quiz.explanation: 額定風量不含島上風壓變化，不能直接代表實際換氣。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Rated flow excludes varying island wind pressure and is not actual ventilation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「資產資料完整度」如何影響港珠澳大橋海底隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Asset-record completeness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao immersed tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 管節量產與多區施工的資料須對應最終安裝位置，教材檢查材料批次、接頭和檢修點的關聯。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「資產資料完整度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Production and multiple work zones need records tied to final installation, linking batches, joints and inspection points. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision. Drawings without change history cannot distinguish replacement from deterioration. Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Asset-record completeness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：設備總數=118 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=118 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=86.4407 %.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「資產資料完整度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Asset-record completeness”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接
knowledge.text: 管節量產與多區施工的資料須對應最終安裝位置，教材檢查材料批次、接頭和檢修點的關聯。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。
knowledge.textEn: Production and multiple work zones need records tied to final installation, linking batches, joints and inspection points. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「資產編碼與可追溯交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Asset identity and traceable handover" is correct?
options: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
管節量產與多區施工的資料須對應最終安裝位置，教材檢查材料批次、接頭和檢修點的關聯。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
Production and multiple work zones need records tied to final installation, linking batches, joints and inspection points.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 管節量產與多區施工的資料須對應最終安裝位置，教材檢查材料批次、接頭和檢修點的關聯。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Production and multiple work zones need records tied to final installation, linking batches, joints and inspection points. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「資產資料完整度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Asset-record completeness” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：設備總數=118 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=86.4407 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為85.0847 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=118 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=86.4407 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 85.0847 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：由一個漏點反查管節編號、試驗和接頭施工紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Trace one leak to element identity, tests and joint-construction records.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：設備總數=118 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=86.4407 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為85.0847 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=118 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=86.4407 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 85.0847 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「資產編碼與可追溯交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Asset identity and traceable handover", which statement holds?
options: 剩餘浮力為正就代表浮運姿態在所有波況穩定。
接縫平均寬度合格就不必量測局部錯台及扭轉。
原創教學假設：設備總數=118 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。
optionsEn: Positive residual buoyancy establishes stability in every sea state.
An acceptable average joint width makes local offset and twist measurements unnecessary.
Original teaching assumptions: asset count=118 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=86.4407 %.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：設備總數=118 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=118 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=86.4407 %. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「資產資料完整度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Asset-record completeness” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 由一個漏點反查管節編號、試驗和接頭施工紀錄。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Trace one leak to element identity, tests and joint-construction records. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：由一個漏點反查管節編號、試驗和接頭施工紀錄。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao immersed tunnel, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Trace one leak to element identity, tests and joint-construction records. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：編號沿用工廠順序而未改安裝序會錯配維修證據。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Keeping factory order instead of installed order mislinks repair evidence. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 由一個漏點反查管節編號、試驗和接頭施工紀錄。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Trace one leak to element identity, tests and joint-construction records. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：由一個漏點反查管節編號、試驗和接頭施工紀錄。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。
knowledge.textEn: For Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao immersed tunnel, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Trace one leak to element identity, tests and joint-construction records. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.

quiz.question: 要驗證「資產編碼與可追溯交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Asset identity and traceable handover"?
options: 由一個漏點反查管節編號、試驗和接頭施工紀錄。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
混凝土抗壓強度合格就代表厚壁構件不會產生熱裂縫。
optionsEn: Trace one leak to element identity, tests and joint-construction records.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Adequate compressive strength proves that thick concrete cannot develop thermal cracks.
quiz.explanation: 由一個漏點反查管節編號、試驗和接頭施工紀錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Trace one leak to element identity, tests and joint-construction records. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「資產資料完整度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Asset-record completeness” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 編號沿用工廠順序而未改安裝序會錯配維修證據。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Keeping factory order instead of installed order mislinks repair evidence. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 編號沿用工廠順序而未改安裝序會錯配維修證據。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。
knowledge.textEn: Keeping factory order instead of installed order mislinks repair evidence. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「資產編碼與可追溯交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Asset identity and traceable handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
編號沿用工廠順序而未改安裝序會錯配維修證據。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Keeping factory order instead of installed order mislinks repair evidence.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 編號沿用工廠順序而未改安裝序會錯配維修證據。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Keeping factory order instead of installed order mislinks repair evidence. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 獅子洋隧道
summary: 國家鐵路局公開技術資料列獅子洋隧道10.8公里、雙孔單線，並記錄2011年12月通車及軟土、土岩複合與岩層的變化。本課從地層切換到結構和軌道平順性，串接長距離盾構、接合測量、列車氣動及救援；公開設計數字與本課假想模型分開呈現。
summaryEn: The National Railway Administration records Shiziyang as 10.8 km with twin single-track bores, opening in December 2011 through soft soil, mixed and rock strata. This course links ground transitions to structural and track geometry, long shield drives, connection surveys, train aerodynamics and rescue, keeping published design context separate from teaching calculations.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創綜合審查：先計算「破碎帶連通與預報更新」，再獨立計算「環向受力與接縫柔度」。原創教學假設：滲透係數=5e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=390 m²。Q=k i A=0.004095 m³/s。僅把滲透係數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0045045 m³/s。邊界：均質飽和達西流，不代表裂隙集中流；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.68 MPa；半徑=3.5 m；厚度=0.35 m。σθ=pr/t=6.8 MPa。僅把均勻外壓增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為7.48 MPa。邊界：薄圓環膜應力，不是接縫、偏壓或矩形框架解；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated review: first calculate fault connectivity and forecast updating, then independently calculate ring force and joint flexibility. Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=5e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=390 m². Q=k i A=0.004095 m³/s. Increasing only conductivity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0045045 m³/s. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated Darcy flow, not concentrated fracture flow. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.68 MPa; radius=3.5 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=6.8 MPa. Increasing only uniform external pressure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 7.48 MPa. Boundary: Thin circular-ring membrane stress, not a joint, uneven-load or rectangular-frame solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「服務邊界與路線代價」與「破碎帶連通與預報更新」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Service boundaries and alignment cost" and "Fault connectivity and forecast updating": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「路線里程與端點」如何影響獅子洋隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Alignment chainage and endpoints” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shiziyang Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 獅子洋總隧道與盾構段的範圍不同，教材先確認雙孔單線的計量方式，不把兩孔相加當列車行程。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「路線里程與端點」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Total tunnel and shielded sections have different extents; define twin single-track measurement without adding both bores into train travel distance. quiz.question: 關於「服務邊界與路線代價」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「路線里程與端點」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Alignment chainage and endpoints” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：長度=19.6 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=19.6 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為21.56 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: length=19.6 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=19.6 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 21.56 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對中心線長、總開挖長與接線範圍。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconcile centreline travel length, total excavation length and approaches.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「服務邊界與路線代價」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。

Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「路線里程與端點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Alignment chainage and endpoints” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對中心線長、總開挖長與接線範圍。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconcile centreline travel length, total excavation length and approaches. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：核對中心線長、總開挖長與接線範圍。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Shiziyang Tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Reconcile centreline travel length, total excavation length and approaches. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把雙孔工程量當單趟長度會使時間和容量估算加倍。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using twin-bore quantities as one journey length doubles time and capacity inputs. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對中心線長、總開挖長與接線範圍。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Reconcile centreline travel length, total excavation length and approaches. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.text: 本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：核對中心線長、總開挖長與接線範圍。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。
knowledge.textEn: For Shiziyang Tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Reconcile centreline travel length, total excavation length and approaches. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.

quiz.question: 要驗證「服務邊界與路線代價」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Service boundaries and alignment cost"?
options: 核對中心線長、總開挖長與接線範圍。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
動壓公式算出的數值就是長鐵路隧道完整壓力波。
optionsEn: Reconcile centreline travel length, total excavation length and approaches.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A dynamic-pressure calculation is the complete pressure-wave prediction for a long rail tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 核對中心線長、總開挖長與接線範圍。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconcile centreline travel length, total excavation length and approaches. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「路線里程與端點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Alignment chainage and endpoints” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把雙孔工程量當單趟長度會使時間和容量估算加倍。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using twin-bore quantities as one journey length doubles time and capacity inputs. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把雙孔工程量當單趟長度會使時間和容量估算加倍。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。
knowledge.textEn: Using twin-bore quantities as one journey length doubles time and capacity inputs. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「服務邊界與路線代價」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Service boundaries and alignment cost" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把雙孔工程量當單趟長度會使時間和容量估算加倍。
岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Using twin-bore quantities as one journey length doubles time and capacity inputs.
Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
quiz.explanation: 把雙孔工程量當單趟長度會使時間和容量估算加倍。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using twin-bore quantities as one journey length doubles time and capacity inputs. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Fault connectivity and forecast updating: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「破碎帶連通性」如何影響獅子洋隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fault-zone connectivity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shiziyang Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 公開資料記載軟土至土岩複合及岩層變化，本課研究混合面比例和裂隙如何共同改變掘進反應。斷層帶可以含很硬的岩塊，但整體變形與湧水常由填充節理和連通裂隙控制。單一岩芯強度不能代表整個掌子面；超前鑽孔、出水變化與揭露地質須回饋同一里程模型，預報則應保留不同情境及其證據權重。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「破碎帶連通性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Published ground transitions motivate analysis of mixed-face proportions and fractures that change boring response together. A fault zone may contain strong intact blocks while filled joints and connected fractures govern its bulk deformation and inflow. One core strength does not represent the entire face. Probe records, water response and exposed geology must update a common chainage model, preserving competing interpretations and their evidential weight rather than treating a forecast as certainty. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fault-zone connectivity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：滲透係數=5e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=390 m²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=5e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=390 m².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「破碎帶連通性」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Fault-zone connectivity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Published ground transitions motivate analysis of mixed-face proportions and fractures that change boring response together. A fault zone may contain strong intact blocks while filled joints and connected fractures govern its bulk deformation and inflow.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「破碎帶連通與預報更新」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fault connectivity and forecast updating" is correct?
options: 岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
公開資料記載軟土至土岩複合及岩層變化，本課研究混合面比例和裂隙如何共同改變掘進反應。
optionsEn: Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Published ground transitions motivate analysis of mixed-face proportions and fractures that change boring response together.
quiz.explanation: 公開資料記載軟土至土岩複合及岩層變化，本課研究混合面比例和裂隙如何共同改變掘進反應。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Published ground transitions motivate analysis of mixed-face proportions and fractures that change boring response together. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fault connectivity and forecast updating: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「破碎帶連通性」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fault-zone connectivity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：滲透係數=5e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=390 m²。Q=k i A=0.004095 m³/s。僅把滲透係數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0045045 m³/s。邊界：均質飽和達西流，不代表裂隙集中流；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=5e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=390 m². Q=k i A=0.004095 m³/s. Increasing only conductivity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0045045 m³/s. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated Darcy flow, not concentrated fracture flow. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對齊扭矩波動、地質揭露與出渣粒徑。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align torque fluctuation, exposures and spoil grading.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：滲透係數=5e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=390 m²。Q=k i A=0.004095 m³/s。僅把滲透係數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0045045 m³/s。邊界：均質飽和達西流，不代表裂隙集中流；不是本工程實測或允收值。

Increasing only conductivity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0045045 m³/s. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated Darcy flow, not concentrated fracture flow. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「破碎帶連通與預報更新」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fault connectivity and forecast updating", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：滲透係數=5e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=390 m²。
灌入體積等於理論空隙就能證明襯砌背後全部填滿。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=5e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=390 m².
Injected volume equal to the theoretical annulus proves complete filling behind the lining.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：滲透係數=5e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=390 m²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=5e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=390 m². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fault connectivity and forecast updating: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「破碎帶連通性」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fault-zone connectivity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對齊扭矩波動、地質揭露與出渣粒徑。將岩心回收、裂隙方位與出水曲線按里程對齊，用未參與建模的孔段作交叉檢驗，檢查是否只擬合已知資料。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align torque fluctuation, exposures and spoil grading. Align recovery, fracture orientation and inflow by chainage; test the interpretation against a withheld borehole interval to detect fitting only the known observations. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「破碎帶連通性」的交付需回答：對齊扭矩波動、地質揭露與出渣粒徑。每次地質模型更新保留舊版與新增證據，差異由地質及支護設計者共同判讀，施工條件改變需重新確認核准範圍。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Shiziyang Tunnel, the fault-zone connectivity handover must address the following evidence: Align torque fluctuation, exposures and spoil grading. Retain previous interpretations and new evidence at every update; geology and support designers jointly interpret differences and reconfirm approved bounds when ground conditions change.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把所有扭矩峰當岩石變硬會漏掉面內不均和設備因素。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating all torque peaks as harder rock misses face heterogeneity and equipment causes. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
