quiz.question: 要驗證「破碎帶連通與預報更新」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fault connectivity and forecast updating"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
對齊扭矩波動、地質揭露與出渣粒徑。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Align torque fluctuation, exposures and spoil grading.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
quiz.explanation: 對齊扭矩波動、地質揭露與出渣粒徑。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Align torque fluctuation, exposures and spoil grading. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fault connectivity and forecast updating: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「破碎帶連通性」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fault-zone connectivity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把所有扭矩峰當岩石變硬會漏掉面內不均和設備因素。只用完整岩石強度會漏掉軟弱填充物，可能在看似堅硬的地層中出現收斂加快、支護過載或水量突增。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating all torque peaks as harder rock misses face heterogeneity and equipment causes. Intact strength alone misses weak infill, allowing accelerating convergence, support overload or sudden inflow in ground that superficially appears strong. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：單一岩芯強度不能代表整個掌子面；超前鑽孔、出水變化與揭露地質須回饋同一里程模型，預報則應保留不同情境及其證據權重。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Probe records, water response and exposed geology must update a common chainage model, preserving competing interpretations and their evidential weight rather than treating a forecast as certainty.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把所有扭矩峰當岩石變硬會漏掉面內不均和設備因素。只用完整岩石強度會漏掉軟弱填充物，可能在看似堅硬的地層中出現收斂加快、支護過載或水量突增。
knowledge.textEn: Treating all torque peaks as harder rock misses face heterogeneity and equipment causes. Intact strength alone misses weak infill, allowing accelerating convergence, support overload or sudden inflow in ground that superficially appears strong.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「破碎帶連通與預報更新」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fault connectivity and forecast updating" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
把所有扭矩峰當岩石變硬會漏掉面內不均和設備因素。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Treating all torque peaks as harder rock misses face heterogeneity and equipment causes.
quiz.explanation: 把所有扭矩峰當岩石變硬會漏掉面內不均和設備因素。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating all torque peaks as harder rock misses face heterogeneity and equipment causes. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」與「掘進利用率與設備停時」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Piezometric head and lining pressure" and "Boring utilisation and equipment downtime": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「測壓水頭」如何影響獅子洋隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Piezometric head” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shiziyang Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 獅子洋水下地層的水壓教材採分層測壓，不以同一海面水頭代表所有軟硬交界。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「測壓水頭」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Use layered pressure observations rather than assigning one sea-level head to every soft-hard interface. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level. Drainage reduces pressure but can increase effective stress and settlement. Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Piezometric head” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=108 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=108 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1059.48 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「測壓水頭」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Piezometric head”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓
knowledge.text: 獅子洋水下地層的水壓教材採分層測壓，不以同一海面水頭代表所有軟硬交界。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。
knowledge.textEn: Use layered pressure observations rather than assigning one sea-level head to every soft-hard interface. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Piezometric head and lining pressure" is correct?
options: 獅子洋水下地層的水壓教材採分層測壓，不以同一海面水頭代表所有軟硬交界。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。
optionsEn: Use layered pressure observations rather than assigning one sea-level head to every soft-hard interface.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance.
quiz.explanation: 獅子洋水下地層的水壓教材採分層測壓，不以同一海面水頭代表所有軟硬交界。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.instruction: 低透水層的延遲水壓可能被短時讀值漏掉。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Short observations can miss delayed pressure in low-permeability layers. steps.instruction: 長距離盾構的磨耗與停機需要按軟土、混合面及岩段分類，教材不以單一平均進尺判斷所有區段。TBM瞬時貫入率只描述刀盤切削的一段時間，拼裝、換刀、出渣與維修決定每天真正進尺。岩石強度與磨蝕性對刀具的影響不同，混合掌子面又產生不對稱作用；比較機器績效須按地質分區和停時原因分類，不能只排序最高進尺。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「有效掘進利用率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.instruction: 逐刀具位置比較磨耗與地層暴露時間。由時間戳分離切削、拼裝與故障，將刀具位置、磨耗量及推力扭矩對齊里程，檢查停時是否集中在特定地層。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare wear by cutter position and time exposed to each ground type. Separate cutting, erection and faults by timestamp; align cutter position, wear, thrust and torque with chainage and test clustering by ground type. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「有效掘進利用率」的交付需回答：逐刀具位置比較磨耗與地層暴露時間。停機紀錄使用可追溯原因碼，把地質變化與設備故障分開統計，參數調整只能在設備和施工團隊核准程序內進行。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Shiziyang Tunnel, the effective boring utilisation handover must address the following evidence: Compare wear by cutter position and time exposed to each ground type. Use traceable downtime codes, separating geological change from equipment faults; parameter changes stay within procedures approved by equipment and construction teams.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：平均磨耗可能掩蓋局部刀具先失效造成的非對稱作用。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Mean wear conceals early local cutter failure and asymmetric loading. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Compare wear by cutter position and time exposed to each ground type. Separate cutting, erection and faults by timestamp; align cutter position, wear, thrust and torque with chainage and test clustering by ground type. knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「有效掘進利用率」的交付需回答：逐刀具位置比較磨耗與地層暴露時間。停機紀錄使用可追溯原因碼，把地質變化與設備故障分開統計，參數調整只能在設備和施工團隊核准程序內進行。

quiz.question: 要驗證「掘進利用率與設備停時」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Boring utilisation and equipment downtime"?
options: 逐刀具位置比較磨耗與地層暴露時間。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Compare wear by cutter position and time exposed to each ground type.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 逐刀具位置比較磨耗與地層暴露時間。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare wear by cutter position and time exposed to each ground type. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 掘進利用率與設備停時：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Boring utilisation and equipment downtime: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「有效掘進利用率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Effective boring utilisation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 平均磨耗可能掩蓋局部刀具先失效造成的非對稱作用。只提高瞬時進尺可能使出渣或刀具超出有效工況，短暫改善後增加停機，平均進尺和零件壽命反而下降。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mean wear conceals early local cutter failure and asymmetric loading. Higher instantaneous advance can overload cutters or muck transport and create longer stoppages that reduce average progress and component life. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：岩石強度與磨蝕性對刀具的影響不同，混合掌子面又產生不對稱作用；比較機器績效須按地質分區和停時原因分類，不能只排序最高進尺。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compare performance by ground domain and downtime cause, because the highest short-duration penetration rate can coexist with poor daily production and increased maintenance demand.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 平均磨耗可能掩蓋局部刀具先失效造成的非對稱作用。只提高瞬時進尺可能使出渣或刀具超出有效工況，短暫改善後增加停機，平均進尺和零件壽命反而下降。
knowledge.textEn: Mean wear conceals early local cutter failure and asymmetric loading. Higher instantaneous advance can overload cutters or muck transport and create longer stoppages that reduce average progress and component life.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「掘進利用率與設備停時」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Boring utilisation and equipment downtime" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
平均磨耗可能掩蓋局部刀具先失效造成的非對稱作用。
灌入體積等於理論空隙就能證明襯砌背後全部填滿。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Mean wear conceals early local cutter failure and asymmetric loading.
Injected volume equal to the theoretical annulus proves complete filling behind the lining.
quiz.explanation: 平均磨耗可能掩蓋局部刀具先失效造成的非對稱作用。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Mean wear conceals early local cutter failure and asymmetric loading. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「背填連續性與體積帳」與「環向受力與接縫柔度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Backfill continuity and volume balance" and "Ring force and joint flexibility": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 背填連續性與體積帳：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Backfill continuity and volume balance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「襯砌背後幾何空隙」如何影響獅子洋隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Geometric lining annulus” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shiziyang Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 高速軌道對沉陷敏感，獅子洋教材把背填幾何空隙與實際地層損失分開，不以注量當沉陷控制證明。盾尾空隙須由背填恢復襯砌與地層的接觸，但幾何空隙不是必然注入量。超挖、地層吸收、回流和材料體積變化都會改變收支；注入量達到目標仍不代表每個位置填滿，需要把壓力、時間與後續變形一起判讀。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「襯砌背後幾何空隙」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Track geometry is sensitive to settlement; separate annular void from actual ground loss and do not use grout volume alone as proof of control. Backfill restores contact across the shield-tail gap, but geometric void is not the required injected volume. Overbreak, absorption, return and material volume change alter the balance. Meeting a volume target does not prove complete spatial filling; pressure, timing and later deformation must be interpreted together rather than using a single total. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Geometric lining annulus” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：開挖外徑=8.76 m；襯砌外徑=8.46 m；環長=1.5 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: excavated diameter=8.76 m; lining diameter=8.46 m; ring length=1.5 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「灌入體積等於理論空隙就能證明襯砌背後全部填滿。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Injected volume equal to the theoretical annulus proves complete filling behind the lining." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「襯砌背後幾何空隙」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Geometric lining annulus”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 背填連續性與體積帳
knowledge.text: 高速軌道對沉陷敏感，獅子洋教材把背填幾何空隙與實際地層損失分開，不以注量當沉陷控制證明。盾尾空隙須由背填恢復襯砌與地層的接觸，但幾何空隙不是必然注入量。
knowledge.textEn: Track geometry is sensitive to settlement; separate annular void from actual ground loss and do not use grout volume alone as proof of control. Backfill restores contact across the shield-tail gap, but geometric void is not the required injected volume.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：灌入體積等於理論空隙就能證明襯砌背後全部填滿。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Injected volume equal to the theoretical annulus proves complete filling behind the lining. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「背填連續性與體積帳」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Backfill continuity and volume balance" is correct?
options: 灌入體積等於理論空隙就能證明襯砌背後全部填滿。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
高速軌道對沉陷敏感，獅子洋教材把背填幾何空隙與實際地層損失分開，不以注量當沉陷控制證明。
optionsEn: Injected volume equal to the theoretical annulus proves complete filling behind the lining.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
Track geometry is sensitive to settlement; separate annular void from actual ground loss and do not use grout volume alone as proof of control.
quiz.explanation: 高速軌道對沉陷敏感，獅子洋教材把背填幾何空隙與實際地層損失分開，不以注量當沉陷控制證明。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Track geometry is sensitive to settlement; separate annular void from actual ground loss and do not use grout volume alone as proof of control. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 背填連續性與體積帳：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Backfill continuity and volume balance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「襯砌背後幾何空隙」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Geometric lining annulus” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：開挖外徑=8.76 m；襯砌外徑=8.46 m；環長=1.5 m。V=π(De²−Dl²)L/4=6.08605 m³。僅把環長增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為6.69466 m³。邊界：同心幾何空隙，不等於實際灌漿需求或完成證明；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: excavated diameter=8.76 m; lining diameter=8.46 m; ring length=1.5 m. V=π(De²−Dl²)L/4=6.08605 m³. Increasing only ring length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 6.69466 m³. Boundary: Concentric geometric void, not actual grout demand or proof of completion. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：結合注壓、注量、環片浮動和地表或孔內位移。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Combine pressure, volume, segment flotation and ground or tunnel movement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：開挖外徑=8.76 m；襯砌外徑=8.46 m；環長=1.5 m。V=π(De²−Dl²)L/4=6.08605 m³。僅把環長增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為6.69466 m³。邊界：同心幾何空隙，不等於實際灌漿需求或完成證明；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: excavated diameter=8.76 m; lining diameter=8.46 m; ring length=1.5 m. V=π(De²−Dl²)L/4=6.08605 m³. Increasing only ring length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 6.69466 m³. Boundary: Concentric geometric void, not actual grout demand or proof of completion. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「背填連續性與體積帳」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Backfill continuity and volume balance", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：開挖外徑=8.76 m；襯砌外徑=8.46 m；環長=1.5 m。
動壓公式算出的數值就是長鐵路隧道完整壓力波。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: excavated diameter=8.76 m; lining diameter=8.46 m; ring length=1.5 m.
A dynamic-pressure calculation is the complete pressure-wave prediction for a long rail tunnel.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：開挖外徑=8.76 m；襯砌外徑=8.46 m；環長=1.5 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: excavated diameter=8.76 m; lining diameter=8.46 m; ring length=1.5 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 背填連續性與體積帳：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Backfill continuity and volume balance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「襯砌背後幾何空隙」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Geometric lining annulus” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 結合注壓、注量、環片浮動和地表或孔內位移。用環片及開挖尺寸計算幾何空隙，核對注入回流質量與時間戳，再以適當無損檢測及變形資料查局部缺填。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Combine pressure, volume, segment flotation and ground or tunnel movement. Calculate the annulus from lining and excavation dimensions, reconcile injected/returned mass and timing, then use suitable nondestructive and deformation evidence for local gaps. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「襯砌背後幾何空隙」的交付需回答：結合注壓、注量、環片浮動和地表或孔內位移。將每環幾何、材料批次及注入回流紀錄綁定，缺填診斷由土建及地工共同確認，後續處置不只追求增加總注量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Shiziyang Tunnel, the geometric lining annulus handover must address the following evidence: Combine pressure, volume, segment flotation and ground or tunnel movement. Link each ring to geometry, material batch and injection/return records; structural and ground teams diagnose gaps together rather than merely increasing volume.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：高注量可能伴隨流失，並不能保證軌道支承均勻。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: High take may reflect loss and does not ensure uniform track support. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 結合注壓、注量、環片浮動和地表或孔內位移。用環片及開挖尺寸計算幾何空隙，核對注入回流質量與時間戳，再以適當無損檢測及變形資料查局部缺填。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Combine pressure, volume, segment flotation and ground or tunnel movement. Calculate the annulus from lining and excavation dimensions, reconcile injected/returned mass and timing, then use suitable nondestructive and deformation evidence for local gaps. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「襯砌背後幾何空隙」的交付需回答：結合注壓、注量、環片浮動和地表或孔內位移。將每環幾何、材料批次及注入回流紀錄綁定，缺填診斷由土建及地工共同確認，後續處置不只追求增加總注量。
knowledge.textEn: For Shiziyang Tunnel, the geometric lining annulus handover must address the following evidence: Combine pressure, volume, segment flotation and ground or tunnel movement. Link each ring to geometry, material batch and injection/return records; structural and ground teams diagnose gaps together rather than merely increasing volume.

quiz.question: 要驗證「背填連續性與體積帳」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Backfill continuity and volume balance"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
結合注壓、注量、環片浮動和地表或孔內位移。
岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Combine pressure, volume, segment flotation and ground or tunnel movement.
Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
quiz.explanation: 結合注壓、注量、環片浮動和地表或孔內位移。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Combine pressure, volume, segment flotation and ground or tunnel movement. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 背填連續性與體積帳：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Backfill continuity and volume balance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「襯砌背後幾何空隙」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Geometric lining annulus” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 高注量可能伴隨流失，並不能保證軌道支承均勻。局部通道讓材料回流時，總注量可能正常但背後仍有空洞，環片變形與接頭滲漏可能延後出現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: High take may reflect loss and does not ensure uniform track support. Preferential return paths can give normal total injection while leaving voids, with delayed segment distortion and leakage. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：超挖、地層吸收、回流和材料體積變化都會改變收支；注入量達到目標仍不代表每個位置填滿，需要把壓力、時間與後續變形一起判讀。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Meeting a volume target does not prove complete spatial filling; pressure, timing and later deformation must be interpreted together rather than using a single total.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「灌入體積等於理論空隙就能證明襯砌背後全部填滿。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Injected volume equal to the theoretical annulus proves complete filling behind the lining." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 高注量可能伴隨流失，並不能保證軌道支承均勻。局部通道讓材料回流時，總注量可能正常但背後仍有空洞，環片變形與接頭滲漏可能延後出現。
knowledge.textEn: High take may reflect loss and does not ensure uniform track support. Preferential return paths can give normal total injection while leaving voids, with delayed segment distortion and leakage.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「背填連續性與體積帳」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Backfill continuity and volume balance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
高注量可能伴隨流失，並不能保證軌道支承均勻。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
High take may reflect loss and does not ensure uniform track support.
quiz.explanation: 高注量可能伴隨流失，並不能保證軌道支承均勻。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: High take may reflect loss and does not ensure uniform track support. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ring force and joint flexibility: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「襯砌環向壓縮」如何影響獅子洋隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lining hoop compression” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shiziyang Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 公開技術背景包含不同地層對應結構，本課用薄環示例後指出內襯與縱向構件需另建空間模型。圓形襯砌對均勻外壓可主要以環向壓縮抵抗，但接頭轉動、偏壓與背填空隙會引起彎矩。薄環膜應力只說明其中一條受力路徑；脫模、運輸、頂推及永久狀態的荷載不同，環片局部接觸與止水條件必須另外檢核。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「襯砌環向壓縮」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Different ground-dependent structures require a spatial model for internal lining and longitudinal members beyond a thin-ring example. A circular lining resists uniform external pressure largely through hoop compression, but joint rotation, uneven load and backfill voids generate bending. Thin-ring membrane stress describes only one load path. Demoulding, transport, jacking and permanent states impose different actions, requiring separate checks of local segment contact and sealing rather than one permanent-load calculation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Lining hoop compression” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.68 MPa；半徑=3.5 m；厚度=0.35 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.68 MPa; radius=3.5 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=6.8 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「襯砌環向壓縮」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Lining hoop compression”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度
knowledge.text: 公開技術背景包含不同地層對應結構，本課用薄環示例後指出內襯與縱向構件需另建空間模型。圓形襯砌對均勻外壓可主要以環向壓縮抵抗，但接頭轉動、偏壓與背填空隙會引起彎矩。
knowledge.textEn: Different ground-dependent structures require a spatial model for internal lining and longitudinal members beyond a thin-ring example. A circular lining resists uniform external pressure largely through hoop compression, but joint rotation, uneven load and backfill voids generate bending.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「環向受力與接縫柔度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ring force and joint flexibility" is correct?
options: 公開技術背景包含不同地層對應結構，本課用薄環示例後指出內襯與縱向構件需另建空間模型。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
optionsEn: Different ground-dependent structures require a spatial model for internal lining and longitudinal members beyond a thin-ring example.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
quiz.explanation: 公開技術背景包含不同地層對應結構，本課用薄環示例後指出內襯與縱向構件需另建空間模型。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Different ground-dependent structures require a spatial model for internal lining and longitudinal members beyond a thin-ring example. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ring force and joint flexibility: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「襯砌環向壓縮」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lining hoop compression” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.68 MPa；半徑=3.5 m；厚度=0.35 m。σθ=pr/t=6.8 MPa。僅把均勻外壓增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為7.48 MPa。邊界：薄圓環膜應力，不是接縫、偏壓或矩形框架解；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.68 MPa; radius=3.5 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=6.8 MPa. Increasing only uniform external pressure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 7.48 MPa. Boundary: Thin circular-ring membrane stress, not a joint, uneven-load or rectangular-frame solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較環向應變、縱向沉陷和軌道基座反應。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare hoop strain, longitudinal settlement and track-support response.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.68 MPa；半徑=3.5 m；厚度=0.35 m。σθ=pr/t=6.8 MPa。僅把均勻外壓增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為7.48 MPa。邊界：薄圓環膜應力，不是接縫、偏壓或矩形框架解；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.68 MPa; radius=3.5 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=6.8 MPa. Increasing only uniform external pressure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 7.48 MPa. Boundary: Thin circular-ring membrane stress, not a joint, uneven-load or rectangular-frame solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「環向受力與接縫柔度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ring force and joint flexibility", which statement holds?
options: 只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.68 MPa；半徑=3.5 m；厚度=0.35 m。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.68 MPa; radius=3.5 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=6.8 MPa.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.68 MPa；半徑=3.5 m；厚度=0.35 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.68 MPa; radius=3.5 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=6.8 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ring force and joint flexibility: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「襯砌環向壓縮」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lining hoop compression” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較環向應變、縱向沉陷和軌道基座反應。將環形變形、接縫張開與應變和含接頭彈簧的模型比較，分開安裝後、背填後及水頭回升後的基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare hoop strain, longitudinal settlement and track-support response. Compare ring distortion, joint opening and strain with a joint-spring model, separating baselines after installation, grouting and head recovery. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「襯砌環向壓縮」的交付需回答：比較環向應變、縱向沉陷和軌道基座反應。設計圖應分開標註各施工階段、接頭剛度及背填條件，構件驗收同時核對幾何、材料批次與止水試驗適用包絡。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Shiziyang Tunnel, the lining hoop compression handover must address the following evidence: Compare hoop strain, longitudinal settlement and track-support response. Drawings distinguish stages, joint stiffness and backfill conditions; component acceptance reconciles geometry, material batches and the applicable sealing-test envelope.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只驗環向壓縮會漏掉軟硬交界縱向彎曲。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Hoop compression alone misses longitudinal bending across a stiffness transition. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 比較環向應變、縱向沉陷和軌道基座反應。將環形變形、接縫張開與應變和含接頭彈簧的模型比較，分開安裝後、背填後及水頭回升後的基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Compare hoop strain, longitudinal settlement and track-support response. Compare ring distortion, joint opening and strain with a joint-spring model, separating baselines after installation, grouting and head recovery. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「襯砌環向壓縮」的交付需回答：比較環向應變、縱向沉陷和軌道基座反應。設計圖應分開標註各施工階段、接頭剛度及背填條件，構件驗收同時核對幾何、材料批次與止水試驗適用包絡。

Drawings distinguish stages, joint stiffness and backfill conditions; component acceptance reconciles geometry, material batches and the applicable sealing-test envelope.

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ring force and joint flexibility"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。

quiz.explanationEn: Compare hoop strain, longitudinal settlement and track-support response. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「襯砌環向壓縮」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lining hoop compression” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只驗環向壓縮會漏掉軟硬交界縱向彎曲。局部脫空增加環片彎曲，裂縫未必代表混凝土平均強度不足；忽略接縫接觸會把補強方向導向錯誤位置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Hoop compression alone misses longitudinal bending across a stiffness transition. Local voids increase bending, so cracks need not indicate inadequate mean concrete strength; neglecting joint contact can misdirect strengthening. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：薄環膜應力只說明其中一條受力路徑；脫模、運輸、頂推及永久狀態的荷載不同，環片局部接觸與止水條件必須另外檢核。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Demoulding, transport, jacking and permanent states impose different actions, requiring separate checks of local segment contact and sealing rather than one permanent-load calculation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「環向受力與接縫柔度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ring force and joint flexibility" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
optionsEn: Hoop compression alone misses longitudinal bending across a stiffness transition.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「控制網與貫通誤差」與「列車壓力波與動壓量級」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Control network and breakthrough error" and "Train pressure waves and dynamic-pressure scale": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「方向角誤差」如何影響獅子洋隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Orientation error” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shiziyang Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水下長驅接合需把控制網誤差與盾構姿態分開，獅子洋教材分析相向掘進的方向累積。長隧道的微小方向誤差會沿距離累積，地下控制網又缺少直接衛星定位，必須把地表基準可靠傳到洞內。閉合差很小不代表無系統誤差；尺度、折光、儀器定向與高程基準可能共同偏移，誤差相關性也使平方和估算失真。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「方向角誤差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Underwater connection requires separation of network error from machine attitude, including direction accumulation in opposing drives. Small orientation errors accumulate over long drives, while underground networks lack direct satellite positioning and depend on transferring surface control. A small closure does not exclude systematic bias: scale, refraction, orientation and vertical datum may shift together. Correlated errors also invalidate a naive root-sum-square combination of supposedly independent observations. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Orientation error” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：控制長度=5280 m；方向偏角=2.6 arcsec。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: control length=5280 m; orientation error=2.6 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0665552 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「方向角誤差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Orientation error”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 控制網與貫通誤差
knowledge.text: 水下長驅接合需把控制網誤差與盾構姿態分開，獅子洋教材分析相向掘進的方向累積。長隧道的微小方向誤差會沿距離累積，地下控制網又缺少直接衛星定位，必須把地表基準可靠傳到洞內。
knowledge.textEn: Underwater connection requires separation of network error from machine attitude, including direction accumulation in opposing drives. Small orientation errors accumulate over long drives, while underground networks lack direct satellite positioning and depend on transferring surface control.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「控制網與貫通誤差」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Control network and breakthrough error" is correct?
options: 兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
水下長驅接合需把控制網誤差與盾構姿態分開，獅子洋教材分析相向掘進的方向累積。
動壓公式算出的數值就是長鐵路隧道完整壓力波。
optionsEn: Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
Underwater connection requires separation of network error from machine attitude, including direction accumulation in opposing drives.
A dynamic-pressure calculation is the complete pressure-wave prediction for a long rail tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 水下長驅接合需把控制網誤差與盾構姿態分開，獅子洋教材分析相向掘進的方向累積。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Underwater connection requires separation of network error from machine attitude, including direction accumulation in opposing drives. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「方向角誤差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Orientation error” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：控制長度=5280 m；方向偏角=2.6 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0665552 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0732107 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: control length=5280 m; orientation error=2.6 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0665552 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0732107 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：獨立核對兩端原始角距及接合前探測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Independently check raw observations from both ends and preconnection surveys.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：控制長度=5280 m；方向偏角=2.6 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0665552 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0732107 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: control length=5280 m; orientation error=2.6 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0665552 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0732107 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「控制網與貫通誤差」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Control network and breakthrough error", which statement holds?
options: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
原創教學假設：控制長度=5280 m；方向偏角=2.6 arcsec。
optionsEn: Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
Original teaching assumptions: control length=5280 m; orientation error=2.6 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0665552 m.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：控制長度=5280 m；方向偏角=2.6 arcsec。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: control length=5280 m; orientation error=2.6 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0665552 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「方向角誤差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Orientation error” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 獨立核對兩端原始角距及接合前探測。由獨立測量組複核地表到洞內的轉換，保留原始角距及溫度資料，用不同控制線比較方向與高程偏差。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Independently check raw observations from both ends and preconnection surveys. Independently check surface-to-tunnel transformations, retain raw angles, distances and temperatures, and compare orientation and elevation through separate control routes. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「方向角誤差」的交付需回答：獨立核對兩端原始角距及接合前探測。貫通前凍結座標、尺度與高程版本，獨立組直接使用原始觀測重算；不得只傳遞整理好的坐標而遺失校正資訊。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Shiziyang Tunnel, the orientation error handover must address the following evidence: Independently check raw observations from both ends and preconnection surveys. Freeze coordinate, scale and height revisions before breakthrough; independent reviewers recompute raw observations rather than receiving only adjusted coordinates without corrections.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：盾構姿態看似正常可能只是跟隨偏移的導向基準。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Normal machine attitude may merely follow a biased guidance reference. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 獨立核對兩端原始角距及接合前探測。由獨立測量組複核地表到洞內的轉換，保留原始角距及溫度資料，用不同控制線比較方向與高程偏差。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。

Independently check surface-to-tunnel transformations, retain raw angles, distances and temperatures, and compare orientation and elevation through separate control routes. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

Freeze coordinate, scale and height revisions before breakthrough; independent reviewers recompute raw observations rather than receiving only adjusted coordinates without corrections.

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Control network and breakthrough error"?
options: 獨立核對兩端原始角距及接合前探測。

quiz.explanationEn: Independently check raw observations from both ends and preconnection surveys. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

quiz.question: 在「控制網與貫通誤差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Control network and breakthrough error" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Normal machine attitude may merely follow a biased guidance reference.
A dynamic-pressure calculation is the complete pressure-wave prediction for a long rail tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 盾構姿態看似正常可能只是跟隨偏移的導向基準。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Normal machine attitude may merely follow a biased guidance reference. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 列車壓力波與動壓量級：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Train pressure waves and dynamic-pressure scale: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「入口壓力擾動」如何影響獅子洋隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Portal pressure disturbance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shiziyang Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 高速列車的動壓與洞口波形不同，教材以速度平方尺度說明為何還需阻塞比和緩衝結構分析。列車進洞壓縮前方空氣，波動在洞口、橫通道和斷面變化處傳播與反射。速度和阻塞比影響壓力量級，但不可壓動壓只是比較尺度，不能替代可壓縮瞬變計算；兩車交會、門位與列車外形都可能改變乘客及設備的壓力歷程。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「入口壓力擾動」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Dynamic pressure differs from portal wave shape; velocity-squared scaling explains why blockage and entrance structures still need analysis. A train entering a tunnel compresses the air ahead, producing waves reflected at portals, passages and section changes. Speed and blockage influence magnitude, but incompressible dynamic pressure is only a comparison scale, not a compressible transient solution. Train encounters, door states and vehicle shape change the pressure histories experienced by passengers and equipment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Portal pressure disturbance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；列車速度=59 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: air density=1.2 kg/m³; train speed=59 m/s. q=ρv²/2=2088.6 Pa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「動壓公式算出的數值就是長鐵路隧道完整壓力波。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A dynamic-pressure calculation is the complete pressure-wave prediction for a long rail tunnel." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「入口壓力擾動」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Portal pressure disturbance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 列車壓力波與動壓量級
knowledge.titleEn: Train pressure waves and dynamic-pressure scale
knowledge.text: 高速列車的動壓與洞口波形不同，教材以速度平方尺度說明為何還需阻塞比和緩衝結構分析。列車進洞壓縮前方空氣，波動在洞口、橫通道和斷面變化處傳播與反射。
knowledge.textEn: Dynamic pressure differs from portal wave shape; velocity-squared scaling explains why blockage and entrance structures still need analysis. A train entering a tunnel compresses the air ahead, producing waves reflected at portals, passages and section changes.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：動壓公式算出的數值就是長鐵路隧道完整壓力波。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A dynamic-pressure calculation is the complete pressure-wave prediction for a long rail tunnel. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「列車壓力波與動壓量級」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Train pressure waves and dynamic-pressure scale" is correct?
options: 動壓公式算出的數值就是長鐵路隧道完整壓力波。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
高速列車的動壓與洞口波形不同，教材以速度平方尺度說明為何還需阻塞比和緩衝結構分析。
optionsEn: A dynamic-pressure calculation is the complete pressure-wave prediction for a long rail tunnel.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
Dynamic pressure differs from portal wave shape; velocity-squared scaling explains why blockage and entrance structures still need analysis.
quiz.explanation: 高速列車的動壓與洞口波形不同，教材以速度平方尺度說明為何還需阻塞比和緩衝結構分析。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Dynamic pressure differs from portal wave shape; velocity-squared scaling explains why blockage and entrance structures still need analysis. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 列車壓力波與動壓量級：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Train pressure waves and dynamic-pressure scale: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「入口壓力擾動」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Portal pressure disturbance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；列車速度=59 m/s。q=ρv²/2=2088.6 Pa。僅把列車速度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為2527.21 Pa。邊界：不可壓動壓尺度，不是可壓縮列車壓力波解；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: air density=1.2 kg/m³; train speed=59 m/s. q=ρv²/2=2088.6 Pa. Increasing only train speed by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 2527.21 Pa. Boundary: Incompressible dynamic-pressure scale, not a compressible train pressure-wave solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步量測速度和多位置壓力，辨識反射到達。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronise speed and pressure at several locations to identify reflected arrivals.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；列車速度=59 m/s。q=ρv²/2=2088.6 Pa。僅把列車速度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為2527.21 Pa。邊界：不可壓動壓尺度，不是可壓縮列車壓力波解；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: air density=1.2 kg/m³; train speed=59 m/s. q=ρv²/2=2088.6 Pa. Increasing only train speed by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 2527.21 Pa. Boundary: Incompressible dynamic-pressure scale, not a compressible train pressure-wave solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「列車壓力波與動壓量級」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Train pressure waves and dynamic-pressure scale", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；列車速度=59 m/s。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: air density=1.2 kg/m³; train speed=59 m/s. q=ρv²/2=2088.6 Pa.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；列車速度=59 m/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: air density=1.2 kg/m³; train speed=59 m/s. q=ρv²/2=2088.6 Pa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 列車壓力波與動壓量級：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Train pressure waves and dynamic-pressure scale: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「入口壓力擾動」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Portal pressure disturbance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步量測速度和多位置壓力，辨識反射到達。以相同列車編組、速度和門位量測多點壓力歷程，檢查峰值、上升時間及反射抵達時刻，而不只比較一個最大值。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronise speed and pressure at several locations to identify reflected arrivals. Measure pressure histories at several points with matching train formation, speed and door states, comparing rise time and reflection arrival as well as peaks. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「入口壓力擾動」的交付需回答：同步量測速度和多位置壓力，辨識反射到達。試車報告記錄編組、速度、溫度及門位版本，土建斷面變更與設備耐壓驗證共用同一氣動模型，不能各自選有利情境。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Shiziyang Tunnel, the portal pressure disturbance handover must address the following evidence: Synchronise speed and pressure at several locations to identify reflected arrivals. Trial reports retain formation, speed, temperature and door revisions; civil changes and equipment-pressure checks share one aerodynamic model rather than selectively favourable cases.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：直接用動壓預測舒適性會忽略列車與隧道幾何。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using dynamic pressure alone for comfort ignores train and tunnel geometry. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同步量測速度和多位置壓力，辨識反射到達。以相同列車編組、速度和門位量測多點壓力歷程，檢查峰值、上升時間及反射抵達時刻，而不只比較一個最大值。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Synchronise speed and pressure at several locations to identify reflected arrivals. Measure pressure histories at several points with matching train formation, speed and door states, comparing rise time and reflection arrival as well as peaks. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「入口壓力擾動」的交付需回答：同步量測速度和多位置壓力，辨識反射到達。試車報告記錄編組、速度、溫度及門位版本，土建斷面變更與設備耐壓驗證共用同一氣動模型，不能各自選有利情境。
knowledge.textEn: For Shiziyang Tunnel, the portal pressure disturbance handover must address the following evidence: Synchronise speed and pressure at several locations to identify reflected arrivals. Trial reports retain formation, speed, temperature and door revisions; civil changes and equipment-pressure checks share one aerodynamic model rather than selectively favourable cases.

quiz.question: 要驗證「列車壓力波與動壓量級」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Train pressure waves and dynamic-pressure scale"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
同步量測速度和多位置壓力，辨識反射到達。
灌入體積等於理論空隙就能證明襯砌背後全部填滿。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Synchronise speed and pressure at several locations to identify reflected arrivals.
Injected volume equal to the theoretical annulus proves complete filling behind the lining.
quiz.explanation: 同步量測速度和多位置壓力，辨識反射到達。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Synchronise speed and pressure at several locations to identify reflected arrivals. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 列車壓力波與動壓量級：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Train pressure waves and dynamic-pressure scale: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「入口壓力擾動」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Portal pressure disturbance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 直接用動壓預測舒適性會忽略列車與隧道幾何。以單一動壓數字當允收值會漏掉壓力梯度與反射疊加，可能使門扇、密封或乘客舒適度需求被低估。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using dynamic pressure alone for comfort ignores train and tunnel geometry. Using one dynamic-pressure value for acceptance misses gradients and superposed reflections, understating demands on doors, seals or passenger comfort. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：速度和阻塞比影響壓力量級，但不可壓動壓只是比較尺度，不能替代可壓縮瞬變計算；兩車交會、門位與列車外形都可能改變乘客及設備的壓力歷程。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Train encounters, door states and vehicle shape change the pressure histories experienced by passengers and equipment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「動壓公式算出的數值就是長鐵路隧道完整壓力波。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A dynamic-pressure calculation is the complete pressure-wave prediction for a long rail tunnel." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 直接用動壓預測舒適性會忽略列車與隧道幾何。以單一動壓數字當允收值會漏掉壓力梯度與反射疊加，可能使門扇、密封或乘客舒適度需求被低估。
knowledge.textEn: Using dynamic pressure alone for comfort ignores train and tunnel geometry. Using one dynamic-pressure value for acceptance misses gradients and superposed reflections, understating demands on doors, seals or passenger comfort.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「列車壓力波與動壓量級」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Train pressure waves and dynamic-pressure scale" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
直接用動壓預測舒適性會忽略列車與隧道幾何。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
Using dynamic pressure alone for comfort ignores train and tunnel geometry.
quiz.explanation: 直接用動壓預測舒適性會忽略列車與隧道幾何。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using dynamic pressure alone for comfort ignores train and tunnel geometry. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「疏散時間與分區可用性」與「資產編碼與可追溯交接」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Evacuation time and zone availability" and "Asset identity and traceable handover": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Evacuation time and zone availability: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「所需疏散時間」如何影響獅子洋隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Required evacuation time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shiziyang Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水下雙孔鐵路的救援需確定列車停車位置和鄰孔狀態，教材將下車流率和步行分開。疏散時間包含辨識、反應、移動及排隊，不只由出口距離決定。人員速度會受煙熱、能見度及行動能力影響，安全判斷還要比較可用安全時間；橫通道存在但門或鄰孔不可用時，圖上的最短路線不一定能作實際選擇。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「所需疏散時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Subsea twin-bore rescue depends on stopping position and receiving-bore state; separate detraining flow from walking. Evacuation includes detection, response, travel and queues, not merely distance to an exit. Smoke, visibility and mobility alter walking speed, while safety requires comparison with available safe time. A passage shown on a plan may be unusable because its door or receiving bore is unavailable, invalidating the nominal shortest route. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Required evacuation time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：前置時間=118 s；行走距離=360 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=118 s; travel distance=360 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「所需疏散時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Required evacuation time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「所需疏散時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Required evacuation time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：前置時間=118 s；行走距離=360 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。RSET=tpre+d/v=568 s。僅把行走距離增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為613 s。邊界：單群體固定速度，不含排隊煙熱及能力差異，不能單獨判安全；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=118 s; travel distance=360 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. RSET=tpre+d/v=568 s. Increasing only travel distance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 613 s. Boundary: One group at fixed speed without queues, smoke or mobility differences; not a safety conclusion. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以不同停車點演練門位及可用路徑。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Exercise door positions and usable routes for different stopping points.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「所需疏散時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Required evacuation time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以不同停車點演練門位及可用路徑。以人流模擬或受控演練分辨前置時間、行走與門口排隊，核對每個出口接收區的可用狀態及通訊紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Exercise door positions and usable routes for different stopping points. Separate pre-movement, travel and doorway queues through simulation or controlled drills, checking receiving-zone availability and communication records for each exit. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「所需疏散時間」的交付需回答：以不同停車點演練門位及可用路徑。疏散模型保留人口、速度分布及出口狀態，演練改動由營運與防災責任者批准，教材算例不得當作現場指揮程序。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Shiziyang Tunnel, the required evacuation time handover must address the following evidence: Exercise door positions and usable routes for different stopping points. Retain population, speed distribution and exit states; operations and fire-safety owners approve drill changes, and classroom calculations are not incident-command procedures.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：最短路徑未必對應所有車廂都能立即進入。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: The shortest route may not be immediately accessible from every carriage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「疏散時間與分區可用性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Evacuation time and zone availability"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。

steps.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Evacuation time and zone availability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「所需疏散時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Required evacuation time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 最短路徑未必對應所有車廂都能立即進入。以最快成人速度套全部旅客會低估需求，若忽略接收孔受煙或車流影響，疏散可能移到另一個危險邊界。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: The shortest route may not be immediately accessible from every carriage. Applying the fastest adult speed to everyone understates demand; overlooking smoke or traffic in the receiving bore can transfer evacuees into another hazard. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：人員速度會受煙熱、能見度及行動能力影響，安全判斷還要比較可用安全時間；橫通道存在但門或鄰孔不可用時，圖上的最短路線不一定能作實際選擇。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A passage shown on a plan may be unusable because its door or receiving bore is unavailable, invalidating the nominal shortest route.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 最短路徑未必對應所有車廂都能立即進入。以最快成人速度套全部旅客會低估需求，若忽略接收孔受煙或車流影響，疏散可能移到另一個危險邊界。
knowledge.textEn: The shortest route may not be immediately accessible from every carriage. Applying the fastest adult speed to everyone understates demand; overlooking smoke or traffic in the receiving bore can transfer evacuees into another hazard.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「疏散時間與分區可用性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
optionsEn: The shortest route may not be immediately accessible from every carriage.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
quiz.explanation: 最短路徑未必對應所有車廂都能立即進入。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: The shortest route may not be immediately accessible from every carriage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Asset-record completeness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shiziyang Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 混合地層的結構與軌道維護需要共同里程索引，教材把病害、地質和施工背填資料連結。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「資產資料完整度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Structure and track maintenance across mixed ground need common chainage linking defects, geology and grouting records. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision. Drawings without change history cannot distinguish replacement from deterioration. Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Asset-record completeness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：設備總數=119 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。
