steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「風道摩擦壓損」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Duct friction loss” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=1300 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.5 m/s。Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=59.7188 Pa。僅把平均風速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為72.2597 Pa。邊界：定密度直管摩阻，局部損失及外風另計；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=1300 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.5 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=59.7188 Pa. Increasing only mean velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 72.2597 Pa. Boundary: Constant-density straight-duct friction; local loss and external wind are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測現地溫壓及風速，再比較風機實際工況。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure local temperature, pressure and velocity before comparing fan operating points.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=1300 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.5 m/s。Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=59.7188 Pa。僅把平均風速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為72.2597 Pa。邊界：定密度直管摩阻，局部損失及外風另計；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=1300 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.5 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=59.7188 Pa. Increasing only mean velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 72.2597 Pa. Boundary: Constant-density straight-duct friction; local loss and external wind are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「通風網路與壓力損失」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ventilation network and pressure loss", which statement holds?
options: 基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。
原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=1300 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.5 m/s。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis.
Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=1300 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.5 m/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=1300 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.5 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=59.7188 Pa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「風道摩擦壓損」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Duct friction loss” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測現地溫壓及風速，再比較風機實際工況。沿線同步量測靜壓與風速，記錄風門及其他風機狀態，再把實測工作點和風機曲線、網路壓損比較。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure local temperature, pressure and velocity before comparing fan operating points. Measure pressure and velocity synchronously, record dampers and other fans, and compare the measured duty point with fan curves and network resistance. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「風道摩擦壓損」的交付需回答：量測現地溫壓及風速，再比較風機實際工況。驗收採明確風門和車流邊界，維修改線後重新核對網路工作點，火災模式由防災責任工程師簽認而非沿用正常模式。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For New Guanjiao Tunnel, the duct friction loss handover must address the following evidence: Measure local temperature, pressure and velocity before comparing fan operating points. Commission with specified damper and traffic boundaries, recheck duty points after rerouting, and have the fire-safety engineer approve emergency modes independently.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：體積流量相同不代表質量流量和污染稀釋條件完全相同。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Equal volumetric flow does not ensure equal mass flow or dilution conditions. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 量測現地溫壓及風速，再比較風機實際工況。沿線同步量測靜壓與風速，記錄風門及其他風機狀態，再把實測工作點和風機曲線、網路壓損比較。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Measure local temperature, pressure and velocity before comparing fan operating points. Measure pressure and velocity synchronously, record dampers and other fans, and compare the measured duty point with fan curves and network resistance. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「風道摩擦壓損」的交付需回答：量測現地溫壓及風速，再比較風機實際工況。驗收採明確風門和車流邊界，維修改線後重新核對網路工作點，火災模式由防災責任工程師簽認而非沿用正常模式。
knowledge.textEn: For New Guanjiao Tunnel, the duct friction loss handover must address the following evidence: Measure local temperature, pressure and velocity before comparing fan operating points. Commission with specified damper and traffic boundaries, recheck duty points after rerouting, and have the fire-safety engineer approve emergency modes independently.

quiz.question: 要驗證「通風網路與壓力損失」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ventilation network and pressure loss"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
量測現地溫壓及風速，再比較風機實際工況。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
Measure local temperature, pressure and velocity before comparing fan operating points.
quiz.explanation: 量測現地溫壓及風速，再比較風機實際工況。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure local temperature, pressure and velocity before comparing fan operating points. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「風道摩擦壓損」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Duct friction loss” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 體積流量相同不代表質量流量和污染稀釋條件完全相同。只看風機轉速會漏掉風門誤位或短路漏風，可能在總耗電增加時，真正需要的區段反而風量不足。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Equal volumetric flow does not ensure equal mass flow or dilution conditions. Fan speed alone misses a misplaced damper or leakage shortcut; total power may rise while the critical section receives less air. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：支路開關會重新分配整個網路，不能把額定風量直接加總；正常污染稀釋與火災控煙也有不同目標，需要分別建立受控邊界和故障情境。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Routine dilution and fire smoke control have different objectives, so each needs explicit boundaries, operating states and failure cases rather than one universal flow target.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 體積流量相同不代表質量流量和污染稀釋條件完全相同。只看風機轉速會漏掉風門誤位或短路漏風，可能在總耗電增加時，真正需要的區段反而風量不足。
knowledge.textEn: Equal volumetric flow does not ensure equal mass flow or dilution conditions. Fan speed alone misses a misplaced damper or leakage shortcut; total power may rise while the critical section receives less air.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「通風網路與壓力損失」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ventilation network and pressure loss" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 體積流量相同不代表質量流量和污染稀釋條件完全相同。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
optionsEn: Equal volumetric flow does not ensure equal mass flow or dilution conditions.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
quiz.explanation: 體積流量相同不代表質量流量和污染稀釋條件完全相同。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Equal volumetric flow does not ensure equal mass flow or dilution conditions. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」與「控制網與貫通誤差」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Shared access and transport bottlenecks" and "Control network and breakthrough error": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「出渣運輸節拍」如何影響關角隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Muck-transport cycle” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “New Guanjiao Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 長斜井及多工作面的物料循環受高原設備利用率影響，教材把運輸與工作面切削分開排程。多工作面只有在供電、通風、出渣與材料供應同步充足時才增加總產量。共用豎井或軌道形成串聯瓶頸，排隊和維修窗口會降低名目容量；緩衝區太大又可能侵占通行與救援空間，因此不能單純把各面產能相加。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「出渣運輸節拍」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Long accesses and multiple headings couple transport with equipment availability; schedule haulage separately from cutting. Multiple headings increase output only when power, air, muck transport and materials support them together. Shared shafts or railways become serial bottlenecks, while queues and maintenance reduce nominal capacity. Large buffers may obstruct personnel and rescue access, so face capacities cannot simply be added without a network-level transport and storage check. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Muck-transport cycle” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=40 t；往返週期=36 min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=40 t; cycle=36 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「出渣運輸節拍」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Muck-transport cycle”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸
knowledge.text: 長斜井及多工作面的物料循環受高原設備利用率影響，教材把運輸與工作面切削分開排程。多工作面只有在供電、通風、出渣與材料供應同步充足時才增加總產量。
knowledge.textEn: Long accesses and multiple headings couple transport with equipment availability; schedule haulage separately from cutting. Multiple headings increase output only when power, air, muck transport and materials support them together.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Shared access and transport bottlenecks" is correct?
options: 增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
長斜井及多工作面的物料循環受高原設備利用率影響，教材把運輸與工作面切削分開排程。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
optionsEn: Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
Long accesses and multiple headings couple transport with equipment availability; schedule haulage separately from cutting.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
quiz.explanation: 長斜井及多工作面的物料循環受高原設備利用率影響，教材把運輸與工作面切削分開排程。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Long accesses and multiple headings couple transport with equipment availability; schedule haulage separately from cutting. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「出渣運輸節拍」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Muck-transport cycle” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=40 t；往返週期=36 min。C=N payload 60/T=266.667 t/h。僅把往返週期增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為242.424 t/h。邊界：無排隊理想循環，並非共享路段實際產能；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=40 t; cycle=36 min. C=N payload 60/T=266.667 t/h. Increasing only cycle by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 242.424 t/h. Boundary: Ideal cycle without queues, not actual shared-route production. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：按載重、坡度及等待重建完整往返循環。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconstruct round trips using payload, gradient and waiting time.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=40 t；往返週期=36 min。

Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「出渣運輸節拍」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Muck-transport cycle” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 按載重、坡度及等待重建完整往返循環。以裝載質量、往返時間及排隊時間重建物流曲線，再核對緩衝占用、共用通道優先權與維修時段。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconstruct round trips using payload, gradient and waiting time. Reconstruct flow from payload, round-trip and queue times, then check buffer occupancy, shared-route priorities and maintenance periods. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「出渣運輸節拍」的交付需回答：按載重、坡度及等待重建完整往返循環。每日排程同時標示人員、材料和維修的占用時段，任何物流改線先檢查通風與應變通道，不能只看運量提升。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For New Guanjiao Tunnel, the muck-transport cycle handover must address the following evidence: Reconstruct round trips using payload, gradient and waiting time. Schedules show personnel, materials and maintenance occupancy together; rerouting first checks ventilation and emergency access rather than only throughput gains.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只用平地車速估循環會低估斜井和卸料占時。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using level-road speed understates access-gradient and unloading time. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Shared access and transport bottlenecks"?
options: 按載重、坡度及等待重建完整往返循環。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。

optionsEn: Reconstruct round trips using payload, gradient and waiting time.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The average between two readings is the maximum rate at every time in the interval.
quiz.explanation: 按載重、坡度及等待重建完整往返循環。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconstruct round trips using payload, gradient and waiting time. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Shared access and transport bottlenecks: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「出渣運輸節拍」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Muck-transport cycle” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只用平地車速估循環會低估斜井和卸料占時。把理想往返時間當全天常數會忽略交會等待與卸料堵塞，導致工作面停工或把材料堆入必要通道。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using level-road speed understates access-gradient and unloading time. Treating an ideal cycle as constant all day misses passing delays and unloading blockages, stopping headings or pushing material into essential access space. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：共用豎井或軌道形成串聯瓶頸，排隊和維修窗口會降低名目容量；緩衝區太大又可能侵占通行與救援空間，因此不能單純把各面產能相加。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Large buffers may obstruct personnel and rescue access, so face capacities cannot simply be added without a network-level transport and storage check.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只用平地車速估循環會低估斜井和卸料占時。把理想往返時間當全天常數會忽略交會等待與卸料堵塞，導致工作面停工或把材料堆入必要通道。
knowledge.textEn: Using level-road speed understates access-gradient and unloading time. Treating an ideal cycle as constant all day misses passing delays and unloading blockages, stopping headings or pushing material into essential access space.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Shared access and transport bottlenecks" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
只用平地車速估循環會低估斜井和卸料占時。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Using level-road speed understates access-gradient and unloading time.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
quiz.explanation: 只用平地車速估循環會低估斜井和卸料占時。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using level-road speed understates access-gradient and unloading time. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.objective: 說明「方向角誤差」如何影響關角隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Orientation error” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “New Guanjiao Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 多斜井傳遞控制到深部主孔時，教材研究每條入口網絡誤差是否獨立，不能任意平方和。長隧道的微小方向誤差會沿距離累積，地下控制網又缺少直接衛星定位，必須把地表基準可靠傳到洞內。閉合差很小不代表無系統誤差；尺度、折光、儀器定向與高程基準可能共同偏移，誤差相關性也使平方和估算失真。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「方向角誤差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Multiple access networks transfer control underground; test independence before combining errors by root-sum-square. Small orientation errors accumulate over long drives, while underground networks lack direct satellite positioning and depend on transferring surface control. A small closure does not exclude systematic bias: scale, refraction, orientation and vertical datum may shift together. Correlated errors also invalidate a naive root-sum-square combination of supposedly independent observations. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Orientation error” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：控制長度=5400 m；方向偏角=2.7 arcsec。

Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較各入口原始基準和共同控制點的相關性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare reference origins and correlations among shared control points.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：控制長度=5400 m；方向偏角=2.7 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0706858 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0777544 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。

Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0777544 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「方向角誤差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Orientation error” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較各入口原始基準和共同控制點的相關性。由獨立測量組複核地表到洞內的轉換，保留原始角距及溫度資料，用不同控制線比較方向與高程偏差。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare reference origins and correlations among shared control points. Independently check surface-to-tunnel transformations, retain raw angles, distances and temperatures, and compare orientation and elevation through separate control routes. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: For New Guanjiao Tunnel, the orientation error handover must address the following evidence: Compare reference origins and correlations among shared control points. Freeze coordinate, scale and height revisions before breakthrough; independent reviewers recompute raw observations rather than receiving only adjusted coordinates without corrections.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：共享基準誤差會在多面網絡一致存在而未被互比發現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Shared datum error persists across headings and escapes mutual comparison. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「控制網與貫通誤差」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

Compare reference origins and correlations among shared control points.

quiz.explanationEn: Compare reference origins and correlations among shared control points. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「方向角誤差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Orientation error” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 共享基準誤差會在多面網絡一致存在而未被互比發現。共用錯誤基準可能讓兩組測量同時看似一致，直到貫通或軌道銜接才發現系統偏差，修正成本遠高於早期複核。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Shared datum error persists across headings and escapes mutual comparison. A shared wrong datum can make separate surveys appear consistent until breakthrough or track connection exposes bias that is costly to correct. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：閉合差很小不代表無系統誤差；尺度、折光、儀器定向與高程基準可能共同偏移，誤差相關性也使平方和估算失真。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Correlated errors also invalidate a naive root-sum-square combination of supposedly independent observations.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.textEn: Shared datum error persists across headings and escapes mutual comparison. A shared wrong datum can make separate surveys appear consistent until breakthrough or track connection exposes bias that is costly to correct.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「控制網與貫通誤差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Control network and breakthrough error" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。
共享基準誤差會在多面網絡一致存在而未被互比發現。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis.
Shared datum error persists across headings and escapes mutual comparison.
quiz.explanation: 共享基準誤差會在多面網絡一致存在而未被互比發現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Shared datum error persists across headings and escapes mutual comparison. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「基線縱坡與牽引需求」與「資產編碼與可追溯交接」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Base-alignment grade and traction demand" and "Asset identity and traceable handover": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 基線縱坡與牽引需求：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Base-alignment grade and traction demand: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「坡度阻力功率」如何影響關角隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Grade-resistance power” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “New Guanjiao Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 高原列車坡度功率教材只計重力分量，另列空氣密度、車輛性能和營運規則需求。基線鐵路用較小縱坡降低重載列車的重力阻力，但仍有滾動、空氣阻力及加速需求。土建線形和供電容量必須使用同一列車與速度情境，短距陡坡也不能被平均坡度掩蓋；制動方向的能量處理則是另一個需要獨立檢核的工況。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「坡度阻力功率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The plateau traction exercise calculates only gravity demand while retaining separate density, vehicle-performance and operating-rule needs. A base alignment reduces heavy-train gravity resistance through gentler gradients, but rolling resistance, aerodynamic drag and acceleration remain. Civil geometry and power capacity must use consistent train and speed cases. Short steep sections cannot be hidden in an average gradient, while braking energy in the opposite direction requires its own operating and electrical assessment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Grade-resistance power” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：列車質量=1.6e+06 kg；縱坡=0.0066 無因次；速度=20 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: train mass=1.6e+06 kg; grade=0.0066 dimensionless; speed=20 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「坡度阻力功率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.titleEn: Base-alignment grade and traction demand: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「坡度阻力功率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Grade-resistance power” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對質量、坡度單位和速度，將其他阻力另表。以里程高程表逐段計算坡度，對照列車性能曲線和供電模型，另檢核低速牽引及下坡制動，不只比較平均功率。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check mass, grade units and speed and list other resistance separately. Calculate local grades from chainage and elevation, compare with train-performance and power models, and separately check low-speed traction and downhill braking. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Civil, track, power and operations teams approve one alignment and train envelope before handover; grade changes update both performance and capacity calculations.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：低空氣密度不會減少列車重力坡度阻力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Lower air density does not reduce gravitational grade resistance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 基線縱坡與牽引需求：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Base-alignment grade and traction demand: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「坡度阻力功率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Grade-resistance power” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 低空氣密度不會減少列車重力坡度阻力。平均坡度低卻存在短陡坡時，峰值功率可能超過預估，速度下降又會增加區段占用時間，牽連營運容量。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Lower air density does not reduce gravitational grade resistance. A short steep grade can exceed power estimates despite a low average, reducing speed and extending block occupation with capacity consequences. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：土建線形和供電容量必須使用同一列車與速度情境，短距陡坡也不能被平均坡度掩蓋；制動方向的能量處理則是另一個需要獨立檢核的工況。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Short steep sections cannot be hidden in an average gradient, while braking energy in the opposite direction requires its own operating and electrical assessment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Lower air density does not reduce gravitational grade resistance. A short steep grade can exceed power estimates despite a low average, reducing speed and extending block occupation with capacity consequences.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「基線縱坡與牽引需求」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Base-alignment grade and traction demand" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 低空氣密度不會減少列車重力坡度阻力。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
optionsEn: Lower air density does not reduce gravitational grade resistance.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
quiz.explanation: 低空氣密度不會減少列車重力坡度阻力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Lower air density does not reduce gravitational grade resistance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「資產資料完整度」如何影響關角隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Asset-record completeness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “New Guanjiao Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 長距離多工區資料交付需把斜井里程轉成主孔統一索引，教材研究同名測點的識別問題。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「資產資料完整度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Long multi-lot handover converts access chainages into main-bore indexing and resolves similarly named monitoring points. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision. Drawings without change history cannot distinguish replacement from deterioration. Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Asset-record completeness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：設備總數=120 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=120 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=86.6667 %.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「資產資料完整度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Asset-record completeness”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接
knowledge.text: 長距離多工區資料交付需把斜井里程轉成主孔統一索引，教材研究同名測點的識別問題。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。
knowledge.textEn: Long multi-lot handover converts access chainages into main-bore indexing and resolves similarly named monitoring points. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「資產編碼與可追溯交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Asset identity and traceable handover" is correct?
options: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
長距離多工區資料交付需把斜井里程轉成主孔統一索引，教材研究同名測點的識別問題。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
Long multi-lot handover converts access chainages into main-bore indexing and resolves similarly named monitoring points.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 長距離多工區資料交付需把斜井里程轉成主孔統一索引，教材研究同名測點的識別問題。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Long multi-lot handover converts access chainages into main-bore indexing and resolves similarly named monitoring points. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「資產資料完整度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Asset-record completeness” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：設備總數=120 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=86.6667 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為85.3333 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=120 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=86.6667 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 85.3333 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：抽查測點可追到主孔位置、安裝時間和校正紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Trace monitoring points to main-bore location, installation time and calibration.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：設備總數=120 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=86.6667 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為85.3333 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=120 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=86.6667 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 85.3333 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「資產編碼與可追溯交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Asset identity and traceable handover", which statement holds?
options: 支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
原創教學假設：設備總數=120 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。

quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：設備總數=120 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。 重算時請保留單位。

Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：抽查測點可追到主孔位置、安裝時間和校正紀錄。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。
knowledge.textEn: For New Guanjiao Tunnel, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Trace monitoring points to main-bore location, installation time and calibration. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.

quiz.question: 要驗證「資產編碼與可追溯交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Asset identity and traceable handover"?
options: 抽查測點可追到主孔位置、安裝時間和校正紀錄。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
optionsEn: Trace monitoring points to main-bore location, installation time and calibration.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
quiz.explanation: 抽查測點可追到主孔位置、安裝時間和校正紀錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Trace monitoring points to main-bore location, installation time and calibration. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「資產資料完整度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Asset-record completeness” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 斜井里程未轉換會把異常收斂定位到錯誤地質區。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unconverted access chainage places abnormal convergence in the wrong ground domain. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 斜井里程未轉換會把異常收斂定位到錯誤地質區。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。
knowledge.textEn: Unconverted access chainage places abnormal convergence in the wrong ground domain. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「資產編碼與可追溯交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Asset identity and traceable handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
斜井里程未轉換會把異常收斂定位到錯誤地質區。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Unconverted access chainage places abnormal convergence in the wrong ground domain.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 斜井里程未轉換會把異常收斂定位到錯誤地質區。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Unconverted access chainage places abnormal convergence in the wrong ground domain. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 秦嶺終南山公路隧道
summary: 陝西交通官方年鑑附錄記錄秦嶺終南山公路隧道18.02公里及2007年1月20日通車。本課將長公路的視覺環境、豎井風路、岩體應力、水壓及設備可靠度整合，要求學員區分舒適感與可量測的障礙辨識。教學通風與照明參數不聲稱是本工程的營運設定。
summaryEn: The Shaanxi transport yearbook appendix records an 18.02 km tunnel and opening on 20 January 2007. This course integrates visual environment, shaft airflow, rock stress, water pressure and reliability, distinguishing perceived comfort from measurable obstacle detection. Teaching ventilation and lighting parameters are not represented as the project operating settings.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創綜合審查：先計算「覆土應力與洞壁重分配」，再獨立計算「視覺適應與路面亮度」。原創教學假設：覆土深度=1130 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。σθ,max=3γH/1000=88.14 MPa。僅把覆土深度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為96.954 MPa。邊界：無支承彈性圓孔，僅垂直遠場壓縮且水平遠場應力為零時，側壁最大環向壓應力；不是任意位置應力或完整三維原位解；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：照度=122 lx；反射率=0.25 無因次。L=ρE/π=9.70845 cd/m²。僅把照度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為10.6793 cd/m²。邊界：理想朗伯漫反射，不是真實濕路面亮度；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated review: first calculate cover stress and wall redistribution, then independently calculate visual adaptation and pavement luminance. Original teaching assumptions: cover=1130 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=88.14 MPa. Increasing only cover by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 96.954 MPa. Boundary: Maximum tangential compression at the sidewalls of an unsupported elastic circular hole under vertical uniaxial remote loading with zero horizontal remote stress; not stress at any point or the complete three-dimensional in-situ state. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: illuminance=122 lx; reflectance=0.25 dimensionless. L=ρE/π=9.70845 cd/m². Increasing only illuminance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 10.6793 cd/m². Boundary: Ideal Lambertian reflection, not actual wet-road luminance. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「服務邊界與路線代價」與「覆土應力與洞壁重分配」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Service boundaries and alignment cost" and "Cover stress and wall redistribution": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「路線里程與端點」如何影響秦嶺終南山公路隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Alignment chainage and endpoints” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Qinling Zhongnanshan Highway Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 終南山兩孔的土建總長與單趟行車長度不同，教材比較穿山服務時保留兩端引道和坡度。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「路線里程與端點」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Twin-bore construction length differs from one journey; retain approaches and gradients when comparing the mountain crossing. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk. Compare options between identical endpoints and distinguish running bores, approaches and service galleries. Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Alignment chainage and endpoints” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：長度=20.4 km；速度=60 km/h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: length=20.4 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=20.4 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「路線里程與端點」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Alignment chainage and endpoints”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 服務邊界與路線代價
knowledge.text: 終南山兩孔的土建總長與單趟行車長度不同，教材比較穿山服務時保留兩端引道和坡度。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。
knowledge.textEn: Twin-bore construction length differs from one journey; retain approaches and gradients when comparing the mountain crossing. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「服務邊界與路線代價」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Service boundaries and alignment cost" is correct?
options: 最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
終南山兩孔的土建總長與單趟行車長度不同，教材比較穿山服務時保留兩端引道和坡度。
知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。
optionsEn: The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
Twin-bore construction length differs from one journey; retain approaches and gradients when comparing the mountain crossing.
Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction.
quiz.explanation: 終南山兩孔的土建總長與單趟行車長度不同，教材比較穿山服務時保留兩端引道和坡度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Twin-bore construction length differs from one journey; retain approaches and gradients when comparing the mountain crossing. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「路線里程與端點」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Alignment chainage and endpoints” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：長度=20.4 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=20.4 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為22.44 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: length=20.4 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=20.4 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 22.44 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對長度是否單孔中心線或雙孔工程量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check whether length denotes one centreline or combined bore quantities.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：長度=20.4 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=20.4 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為22.44 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: length=20.4 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=20.4 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 22.44 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「服務邊界與路線代價」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Service boundaries and alignment cost", which statement holds?
options: 目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
照度越高就必然使隧道內所有物體更容易辨識。
原創教學假設：長度=20.4 km；速度=60 km/h。
optionsEn: No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Higher illuminance necessarily makes every tunnel object easier to detect.
Original teaching assumptions: length=20.4 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=20.4 min.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：長度=20.4 km；速度=60 km/h。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: length=20.4 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=20.4 min. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「路線里程與端點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Alignment chainage and endpoints” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對長度是否單孔中心線或雙孔工程量。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check whether length denotes one centreline or combined bore quantities. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：核對長度是否單孔中心線或雙孔工程量。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Qinling Zhongnanshan Highway Tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Check whether length denotes one centreline or combined bore quantities. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以雙孔總長算行程會使旅行時間成倍錯誤。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using combined bore length multiplies journey time incorrectly. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對長度是否單孔中心線或雙孔工程量。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Check whether length denotes one centreline or combined bore quantities. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：核對長度是否單孔中心線或雙孔工程量。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。
knowledge.textEn: For Qinling Zhongnanshan Highway Tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Check whether length denotes one centreline or combined bore quantities. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.

quiz.question: 要驗證「服務邊界與路線代價」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Service boundaries and alignment cost"?
options: 核對長度是否單孔中心線或雙孔工程量。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
optionsEn: Check whether length denotes one centreline or combined bore quantities.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.

quiz.explanationEn: Check whether length denotes one centreline or combined bore quantities. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「路線里程與端點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Alignment chainage and endpoints” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以雙孔總長算行程會使旅行時間成倍錯誤。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using combined bore length multiplies journey time incorrectly. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以雙孔總長算行程會使旅行時間成倍錯誤。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。
knowledge.textEn: Using combined bore length multiplies journey time incorrectly. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「服務邊界與路線代價」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Service boundaries and alignment cost" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
以雙孔總長算行程會使旅行時間成倍錯誤。
知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Using combined bore length multiplies journey time incorrectly.
Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction.
quiz.explanation: 以雙孔總長算行程會使旅行時間成倍錯誤。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using combined bore length multiplies journey time incorrectly. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 覆土應力與洞壁重分配：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cover stress and wall redistribution: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「洞壁切向應力」如何影響秦嶺終南山公路隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tangential wall stress” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Qinling Zhongnanshan Highway Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 秦嶺山體的覆土和節理提供不同破壞機制，教材以彈性峰值作尺度，再辨認剝落或弱帶變形。開挖使岩體洞壁失去徑向拘束，遠場荷載轉移到周圍岩體，局部切向應力可能升高。圓孔彈性解可辨識量級，但節理、非圓斷面、塑性區與原位應力比會改變峰值位置，不能只用覆土重量推定全部三維應力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「洞壁切向應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cover and joints produce different failure mechanisms; use elastic peaks for scale before distinguishing spalling from weak-zone movement. Excavation removes radial confinement at the wall and transfers load through the surrounding rock, potentially raising local tangential stress. An elastic circular-hole solution identifies scale, but joints, noncircular geometry, yielding and the in-situ stress ratio alter the peak location. Cover weight alone cannot establish the complete three-dimensional stress state or support demand. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Tangential wall stress” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：覆土深度=1130 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: cover=1130 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=88.14 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「洞壁切向應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Tangential wall stress”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 覆土應力與洞壁重分配
knowledge.text: 秦嶺山體的覆土和節理提供不同破壞機制，教材以彈性峰值作尺度，再辨認剝落或弱帶變形。開挖使岩體洞壁失去徑向拘束，遠場荷載轉移到周圍岩體，局部切向應力可能升高。
knowledge.textEn: Cover and joints produce different failure mechanisms; use elastic peaks for scale before distinguishing spalling from weak-zone movement. Excavation removes radial confinement at the wall and transfers load through the surrounding rock, potentially raising local tangential stress.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「覆土應力與洞壁重分配」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cover stress and wall redistribution" is correct?
options: 知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。
岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
秦嶺山體的覆土和節理提供不同破壞機制，教材以彈性峰值作尺度，再辨認剝落或弱帶變形。
optionsEn: Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction.
Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
Cover and joints produce different failure mechanisms; use elastic peaks for scale before distinguishing spalling from weak-zone movement.
quiz.explanation: 秦嶺山體的覆土和節理提供不同破壞機制，教材以彈性峰值作尺度，再辨認剝落或弱帶變形。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Cover and joints produce different failure mechanisms; use elastic peaks for scale before distinguishing spalling from weak-zone movement. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 覆土應力與洞壁重分配：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cover stress and wall redistribution: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「洞壁切向應力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tangential wall stress” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：覆土深度=1130 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。σθ,max=3γH/1000=88.14 MPa。僅把覆土深度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為96.954 MPa。邊界：無支承彈性圓孔，僅垂直遠場壓縮且水平遠場應力為零時，側壁最大環向壓應力；不是任意位置應力或完整三維原位解；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: cover=1130 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=88.14 MPa. Increasing only cover by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 96.954 MPa. Boundary: Maximum tangential compression at the sidewalls of an unsupported elastic circular hole under vertical uniaxial remote loading with zero horizontal remote stress; not stress at any point or the complete three-dimensional in-situ state. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將破壞方位、岩石試驗與多點位移對照。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare damage orientation, rock tests and multipoint displacement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：覆土深度=1130 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。σθ,max=3γH/1000=88.14 MPa。僅把覆土深度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為96.954 MPa。邊界：無支承彈性圓孔，僅垂直遠場壓縮且水平遠場應力為零時，側壁最大環向壓應力；不是任意位置應力或完整三維原位解；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: cover=1130 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=88.14 MPa. Increasing only cover by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 96.954 MPa. Boundary: Maximum tangential compression at the sidewalls of an unsupported elastic circular hole under vertical uniaxial remote loading with zero horizontal remote stress; not stress at any point or the complete three-dimensional in-situ state. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「覆土應力與洞壁重分配」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cover stress and wall redistribution", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：覆土深度=1130 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: cover=1130 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=88.14 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 覆土應力與洞壁重分配：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cover stress and wall redistribution: testing and verification

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tangential wall stress” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將破壞方位、岩石試驗與多點位移對照。將原位應力量測、岩石試驗及洞壁破壞方位相互比較，再用多點伸長計檢查變形是否與所假設應力方向一致。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare damage orientation, rock tests and multipoint displacement. Compare in-situ stress measurements, rock tests and wall-damage orientation, then use multipoint extensometers to test consistency with the assumed stress directions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「洞壁切向應力」的交付需回答：將破壞方位、岩石試驗與多點位移對照。保留應力模型的座標、邊界和材料假設，量測與預測不符時先核對代表性，再由岩力設計者選擇非線性或節理模型。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Qinling Zhongnanshan Highway Tunnel, the tangential wall stress handover must address the following evidence: Compare damage orientation, rock tests and multipoint displacement. Record stress-model coordinates, boundaries and material assumptions; when observations disagree, check representativeness before the rock designer selects nonlinear or jointed models.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：覆土最大位置不必然是所有類型變形最嚴重位置。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Maximum cover need not coincide with every type of maximum deformation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

Compare in-situ stress measurements, rock tests and wall-damage orientation, then use multipoint extensometers to test consistency with the assumed stress directions. knowledge.text: 本案「洞壁切向應力」的交付需回答：將破壞方位、岩石試驗與多點位移對照。保留應力模型的座標、邊界和材料假設，量測與預測不符時先核對代表性，再由岩力設計者選擇非線性或節理模型。

options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
