steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「洞壁切向應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tangential wall stress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 覆土最大位置不必然是所有類型變形最嚴重位置。把彈性峰值直接當岩體強度可能誤判支護需求；相反地忽略剝落或擠壓也會讓局部破壞逐步侵入淨空。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Maximum cover need not coincide with every type of maximum deformation. Equating an elastic peak with rock-mass strength misjudges support demand; overlooking spalling or squeezing lets damage progressively consume clearance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：圓孔彈性解可辨識量級，但節理、非圓斷面、塑性區與原位應力比會改變峰值位置，不能只用覆土重量推定全部三維應力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Cover weight alone cannot establish the complete three-dimensional stress state or support demand.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 覆土最大位置不必然是所有類型變形最嚴重位置。把彈性峰值直接當岩體強度可能誤判支護需求；相反地忽略剝落或擠壓也會讓局部破壞逐步侵入淨空。
knowledge.textEn: Maximum cover need not coincide with every type of maximum deformation. Equating an elastic peak with rock-mass strength misjudges support demand; overlooking spalling or squeezing lets damage progressively consume clearance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「覆土應力與洞壁重分配」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cover stress and wall redistribution" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
覆土最大位置不必然是所有類型變形最嚴重位置。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
Maximum cover need not coincide with every type of maximum deformation.
quiz.explanation: 覆土最大位置不必然是所有類型變形最嚴重位置。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Maximum cover need not coincide with every type of maximum deformation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「破碎帶連通與預報更新」與「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Fault connectivity and forecast updating" and "Piezometric head and lining pressure": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Fault connectivity and forecast updating: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「破碎帶連通性」如何影響秦嶺終南山公路隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fault-zone connectivity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Qinling Zhongnanshan Highway Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 長路線需要持續更新破碎帶模型，終南山教材研究探孔未命中與真實無弱帶的差別。斷層帶可以含很硬的岩塊，但整體變形與湧水常由填充節理和連通裂隙控制。單一岩芯強度不能代表整個掌子面；超前鑽孔、出水變化與揭露地質須回饋同一里程模型，預報則應保留不同情境及其證據權重。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「破碎帶連通性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Long alignments need continuing fault-model updates; distinguish a missed structure from genuine absence of weak ground. A fault zone may contain strong intact blocks while filled joints and connected fractures govern its bulk deformation and inflow. One core strength does not represent the entire face. Probe records, water response and exposed geology must update a common chainage model, preserving competing interpretations and their evidential weight rather than treating a forecast as certainty. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fault-zone connectivity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：滲透係數=2e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.2 無因次；通水面積=410 m²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=2e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.2 dimensionless; flow area=410 m².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「破碎帶連通性」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Fault-zone connectivity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新
knowledge.text: 長路線需要持續更新破碎帶模型，終南山教材研究探孔未命中與真實無弱帶的差別。斷層帶可以含很硬的岩塊，但整體變形與湧水常由填充節理和連通裂隙控制。
knowledge.textEn: Long alignments need continuing fault-model updates; distinguish a missed structure from genuine absence of weak ground. A fault zone may contain strong intact blocks while filled joints and connected fractures govern its bulk deformation and inflow.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「破碎帶連通與預報更新」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fault connectivity and forecast updating" is correct?
options: 長路線需要持續更新破碎帶模型，終南山教材研究探孔未命中與真實無弱帶的差別。
岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
optionsEn: Long alignments need continuing fault-model updates; distinguish a missed structure from genuine absence of weak ground.
Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
quiz.explanation: 長路線需要持續更新破碎帶模型，終南山教材研究探孔未命中與真實無弱帶的差別。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Long alignments need continuing fault-model updates; distinguish a missed structure from genuine absence of weak ground. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fault connectivity and forecast updating: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「破碎帶連通性」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fault-zone connectivity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：滲透係數=2e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.2 無因次；通水面積=410 m²。Q=k i A=0.001804 m³/s。僅把滲透係數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0019844 m³/s。邊界：均質飽和達西流，不代表裂隙集中流；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=2e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.2 dimensionless; flow area=410 m². Q=k i A=0.001804 m³/s. Increasing only conductivity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0019844 m³/s. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated Darcy flow, not concentrated fracture flow. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：保留探孔方向及未覆蓋體積，對照揭露地質。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Retain probe orientation and unsampled volume against exposed geology.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：滲透係數=2e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.2 無因次；通水面積=410 m²。Q=k i A=0.001804 m³/s。僅把滲透係數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0019844 m³/s。邊界：均質飽和達西流，不代表裂隙集中流；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=2e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.2 dimensionless; flow area=410 m². Q=k i A=0.001804 m³/s. Increasing only conductivity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0019844 m³/s. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated Darcy flow, not concentrated fracture flow. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「破碎帶連通與預報更新」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fault connectivity and forecast updating", which statement holds?
options: 照度越高就必然使隧道內所有物體更容易辨識。
原創教學假設：滲透係數=2e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.2 無因次；通水面積=410 m²。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
optionsEn: Higher illuminance necessarily makes every tunnel object easier to detect.
Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=2e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.2 dimensionless; flow area=410 m².
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：滲透係數=2e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.2 無因次；通水面積=410 m²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=2e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.2 dimensionless; flow area=410 m². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fault connectivity and forecast updating: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「破碎帶連通性」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fault-zone connectivity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 保留探孔方向及未覆蓋體積，對照揭露地質。將岩心回收、裂隙方位與出水曲線按里程對齊，用未參與建模的孔段作交叉檢驗，檢查是否只擬合已知資料。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Retain probe orientation and unsampled volume against exposed geology. Align recovery, fracture orientation and inflow by chainage; test the interpretation against a withheld borehole interval to detect fitting only the known observations. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「破碎帶連通性」的交付需回答：保留探孔方向及未覆蓋體積，對照揭露地質。每次地質模型更新保留舊版與新增證據，差異由地質及支護設計者共同判讀，施工條件改變需重新確認核准範圍。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Qinling Zhongnanshan Highway Tunnel, the fault-zone connectivity handover must address the following evidence: Retain probe orientation and unsampled volume against exposed geology. Retain previous interpretations and new evidence at every update; geology and support designers jointly interpret differences and reconfirm approved bounds when ground conditions change.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：無異常讀值若來自錯過構造，不能提高整段穩定信心。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: No anomaly from a missed structure cannot justify confidence in the whole reach. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 保留探孔方向及未覆蓋體積，對照揭露地質。將岩心回收、裂隙方位與出水曲線按里程對齊，用未參與建模的孔段作交叉檢驗，檢查是否只擬合已知資料。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Retain probe orientation and unsampled volume against exposed geology. Align recovery, fracture orientation and inflow by chainage; test the interpretation against a withheld borehole interval to detect fitting only the known observations. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「破碎帶連通性」的交付需回答：保留探孔方向及未覆蓋體積，對照揭露地質。每次地質模型更新保留舊版與新增證據，差異由地質及支護設計者共同判讀，施工條件改變需重新確認核准範圍。
knowledge.textEn: For Qinling Zhongnanshan Highway Tunnel, the fault-zone connectivity handover must address the following evidence: Retain probe orientation and unsampled volume against exposed geology. Retain previous interpretations and new evidence at every update; geology and support designers jointly interpret differences and reconfirm approved bounds when ground conditions change.

quiz.question: 要驗證「破碎帶連通與預報更新」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fault connectivity and forecast updating"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
保留探孔方向及未覆蓋體積，對照揭露地質。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
Retain probe orientation and unsampled volume against exposed geology.
quiz.explanation: 保留探孔方向及未覆蓋體積，對照揭露地質。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Retain probe orientation and unsampled volume against exposed geology. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「破碎帶連通與預報更新」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fault connectivity and forecast updating" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 無異常讀值若來自錯過構造，不能提高整段穩定信心。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
optionsEn: No anomaly from a missed structure cannot justify confidence in the whole reach.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
quiz.explanation: 無異常讀值若來自錯過構造，不能提高整段穩定信心。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: No anomaly from a missed structure cannot justify confidence in the whole reach. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「測壓水頭」如何影響秦嶺終南山公路隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Piezometric head” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Qinling Zhongnanshan Highway Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 洞內排水與山體含水層互相影響，教材檢查支路封閉或泵停後外壓回升情境。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「測壓水頭」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Drainage interacts with mountain aquifers; assess head recovery after branch closure or pump outage. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level. Drainage reduces pressure but can increase effective stress and settlement. Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Piezometric head” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=117 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=117 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1147.77 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「測壓水頭」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Piezometric head”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓
knowledge.text: 洞內排水與山體含水層互相影響，教材檢查支路封閉或泵停後外壓回升情境。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。
knowledge.textEn: Drainage interacts with mountain aquifers; assess head recovery after branch closure or pump outage. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Piezometric head and lining pressure" is correct?
options: 目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
洞內排水與山體含水層互相影響，教材檢查支路封閉或泵停後外壓回升情境。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
optionsEn: No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Drainage interacts with mountain aquifers; assess head recovery after branch closure or pump outage.
Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 洞內排水與山體含水層互相影響，教材檢查支路封閉或泵停後外壓回升情境。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Drainage interacts with mountain aquifers; assess head recovery after branch closure or pump outage. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「測壓水頭」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Piezometric head” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=117 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1147.77 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1262.55 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=117 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1147.77 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1262.55 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以分層測壓和排水流量檢查回復時間尺度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use layered pressure and flow to examine recovery time scales.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=117 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1147.77 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1262.55 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=117 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1147.77 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1262.55 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Piezometric head and lining pressure", which statement holds?
options: 支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。
原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=117 m。
optionsEn: Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=117 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1147.77 kPa.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=117 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=117 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1147.77 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「測壓水頭」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Piezometric head” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以分層測壓和排水流量檢查回復時間尺度。使用分層測壓管及流量計，配合降雨或潮位序列分辨補注與設備影響，將讀值統一換算至同一高程基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use layered pressure and flow to examine recovery time scales. Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：以分層測壓和排水流量檢查回復時間尺度。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Qinling Zhongnanshan Highway Tunnel, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Use layered pressure and flow to examine recovery time scales. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：正常排水水頭低不代表堵塞後也維持同一壓力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Low drained head does not establish the same pressure after blockage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以分層測壓和排水流量檢查回復時間尺度。使用分層測壓管及流量計，配合降雨或潮位序列分辨補注與設備影響，將讀值統一換算至同一高程基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Use layered pressure and flow to examine recovery time scales. Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：以分層測壓和排水流量檢查回復時間尺度。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。
knowledge.textEn: For Qinling Zhongnanshan Highway Tunnel, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Use layered pressure and flow to examine recovery time scales. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.

quiz.question: 要驗證「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Piezometric head and lining pressure"?
options: 以分層測壓和排水流量檢查回復時間尺度。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Use layered pressure and flow to examine recovery time scales.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 以分層測壓和排水流量檢查回復時間尺度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use layered pressure and flow to examine recovery time scales. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「測壓水頭」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Piezometric head” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 正常排水水頭低不代表堵塞後也維持同一壓力。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Low drained head does not establish the same pressure after blockage. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 正常排水水頭低不代表堵塞後也維持同一壓力。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。
knowledge.textEn: Low drained head does not establish the same pressure after blockage. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Piezometric head and lining pressure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
正常排水水頭低不代表堵塞後也維持同一壓力。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Low drained head does not establish the same pressure after blockage.
Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 正常排水水頭低不代表堵塞後也維持同一壓力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Low drained head does not establish the same pressure after blockage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「通風網路與壓力損失」與「視覺適應與路面亮度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ventilation network and pressure loss" and "Visual adaptation and pavement luminance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「風道摩擦壓損」如何影響秦嶺終南山公路隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Duct friction loss” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Qinling Zhongnanshan Highway Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 長道路豎井與水平風道形成網路，教材將支路阻力、外風與風機工況一起求解。風機提供壓差，實際風量由風道摩阻、局部損失、外風與其他風機共同決定。支路開關會重新分配整個網路，不能把額定風量直接加總；正常污染稀釋與火災控煙也有不同目標，需要分別建立受控邊界和故障情境。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「風道摩擦壓損」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Shafts and horizontal ducts form a network requiring branch resistance, external wind and fan operating points to be considered together. Fans supply pressure, but actual flow follows friction, local losses, external wind and interactions with other fans. Switching a branch redistributes the network rather than simply adding rated flows. Routine dilution and fire smoke control have different objectives, so each needs explicit boundaries, operating states and failure cases rather than one universal flow target. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Duct friction loss” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=1340 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.4 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=1340 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.4 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=58.089 Pa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Duct friction loss”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 通風網路與壓力損失
knowledge.text: 長道路豎井與水平風道形成網路，教材將支路阻力、外風與風機工況一起求解。風機提供壓差，實際風量由風道摩阻、局部損失、外風與其他風機共同決定。
knowledge.textEn: Shafts and horizontal ducts form a network requiring branch resistance, external wind and fan operating points to be considered together. Fans supply pressure, but actual flow follows friction, local losses, external wind and interactions with other fans.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「通風網路與壓力損失」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ventilation network and pressure loss" is correct?
options: 風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
照度越高就必然使隧道內所有物體更容易辨識。
長道路豎井與水平風道形成網路，教材將支路阻力、外風與風機工況一起求解。
optionsEn: Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
Higher illuminance necessarily makes every tunnel object easier to detect.
Shafts and horizontal ducts form a network requiring branch resistance, external wind and fan operating points to be considered together.
quiz.explanation: 長道路豎井與水平風道形成網路，教材將支路阻力、外風與風機工況一起求解。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Shafts and horizontal ducts form a network requiring branch resistance, external wind and fan operating points to be considered together. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「風道摩擦壓損」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Duct friction loss” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=1340 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.4 m/s。Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=58.089 Pa。僅把平均風速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為70.2877 Pa。邊界：定密度直管摩阻，局部損失及外風另計；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=1340 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.4 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=58.089 Pa. Increasing only mean velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 70.2877 Pa. Boundary: Constant-density straight-duct friction; local loss and external wind are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時量測井口、風道和道路區的壓差與風速。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure shaft, duct and roadway pressure and velocity simultaneously.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「通風網路與壓力損失」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「風道摩擦壓損」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Duct friction loss” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同時量測井口、風道和道路區的壓差與風速。沿線同步量測靜壓與風速，記錄風門及其他風機狀態，再把實測工作點和風機曲線、網路壓損比較。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure shaft, duct and roadway pressure and velocity simultaneously. Measure pressure and velocity synchronously, record dampers and other fans, and compare the measured duty point with fan curves and network resistance. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「風道摩擦壓損」的交付需回答：同時量測井口、風道和道路區的壓差與風速。驗收採明確風門和車流邊界，維修改線後重新核對網路工作點，火災模式由防災責任工程師簽認而非沿用正常模式。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Qinling Zhongnanshan Highway Tunnel, the duct friction loss handover must address the following evidence: Measure shaft, duct and roadway pressure and velocity simultaneously. Commission with specified damper and traffic boundaries, recheck duty points after rerouting, and have the fire-safety engineer approve emergency modes independently.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：井口風量大可能只是支路短路，未必改善遠端道路區。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: High shaft flow may reflect a shortcut rather than improved distant roadway ventilation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Measure pressure and velocity synchronously, record dampers and other fans, and compare the measured duty point with fan curves and network resistance. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.text: 本案「風道摩擦壓損」的交付需回答：同時量測井口、風道和道路區的壓差與風速。驗收採明確風門和車流邊界，維修改線後重新核對網路工作點，火災模式由防災責任工程師簽認而非沿用正常模式。

Commission with specified damper and traffic boundaries, recheck duty points after rerouting, and have the fire-safety engineer approve emergency modes independently.

quiz.question: 要驗證「通風網路與壓力損失」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ventilation network and pressure loss"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
同時量測井口、風道和道路區的壓差與風速。
知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Measure shaft, duct and roadway pressure and velocity simultaneously.
Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction.
quiz.explanation: 同時量測井口、風道和道路區的壓差與風速。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure shaft, duct and roadway pressure and velocity simultaneously. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「風道摩擦壓損」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Duct friction loss” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 井口風量大可能只是支路短路，未必改善遠端道路區。只看風機轉速會漏掉風門誤位或短路漏風，可能在總耗電增加時，真正需要的區段反而風量不足。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: High shaft flow may reflect a shortcut rather than improved distant roadway ventilation. Fan speed alone misses a misplaced damper or leakage shortcut; total power may rise while the critical section receives less air. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：支路開關會重新分配整個網路，不能把額定風量直接加總；正常污染稀釋與火災控煙也有不同目標，需要分別建立受控邊界和故障情境。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Routine dilution and fire smoke control have different objectives, so each needs explicit boundaries, operating states and failure cases rather than one universal flow target.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 井口風量大可能只是支路短路，未必改善遠端道路區。只看風機轉速會漏掉風門誤位或短路漏風，可能在總耗電增加時，真正需要的區段反而風量不足。
knowledge.textEn: High shaft flow may reflect a shortcut rather than improved distant roadway ventilation. Fan speed alone misses a misplaced damper or leakage shortcut; total power may rise while the critical section receives less air.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「通風網路與壓力損失」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ventilation network and pressure loss" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
照度越高就必然使隧道內所有物體更容易辨識。
井口風量大可能只是支路短路，未必改善遠端道路區。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Higher illuminance necessarily makes every tunnel object easier to detect.
High shaft flow may reflect a shortcut rather than improved distant roadway ventilation.
quiz.explanation: 井口風量大可能只是支路短路，未必改善遠端道路區。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: High shaft flow may reflect a shortcut rather than improved distant roadway ventilation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 視覺適應與路面亮度：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「漫反射亮度」如何影響秦嶺終南山公路隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Diffuse luminance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Qinling Zhongnanshan Highway Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 終南山長距離行車的視覺變化可作人因研究背景，教材將景觀亮度與道路障礙對比分開量測。駕駛從洞外進入洞內時視覺適應需要時間，照度並不等同從駕駛視角看到的亮度。路面反射、濕度、燈具配光及背景對比共同影響辨識；朗伯模型只示範理想漫反射，不能直接制定入口段燈具間距或真實道路安全值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「漫反射亮度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Visual variation provides a human-factors setting, but decorative brightness and road-obstacle contrast require separate measurements. Driver adaptation takes time when entering a tunnel, and illuminance is not the luminance seen from the driving position. Pavement reflection, wetness, luminaire distribution and background contrast affect detection. A Lambertian model illustrates ideal diffuse reflection only; it cannot establish entrance-zone spacing or actual road-safety limits without photometric and operational assessment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Diffuse luminance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：照度=122 lx；反射率=0.25 無因次。

steps.check: 系統圖標明「漫反射亮度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 視覺適應與路面亮度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Visual adaptation and pavement luminance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「漫反射亮度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Diffuse luminance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：照度=122 lx；反射率=0.25 無因次。L=ρE/π=9.70845 cd/m²。僅把照度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為10.6793 cd/m²。邊界：理想朗伯漫反射，不是真實濕路面亮度；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: illuminance=122 lx; reflectance=0.25 dimensionless. L=ρE/π=9.70845 cd/m². Increasing only illuminance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 10.6793 cd/m². Boundary: Ideal Lambertian reflection, not actual wet-road luminance. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從實際駕駛視角比較不同背景下相同障礙的可見性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare the same obstacle under different backgrounds from the driving viewpoint.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：照度=122 lx；反射率=0.25 無因次。L=ρE/π=9.70845 cd/m²。僅把照度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為10.6793 cd/m²。邊界：理想朗伯漫反射，不是真實濕路面亮度；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: illuminance=122 lx; reflectance=0.25 dimensionless. L=ρE/π=9.70845 cd/m². Increasing only illuminance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 10.6793 cd/m². Boundary: Ideal Lambertian reflection, not actual wet-road luminance. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「視覺適應與路面亮度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Visual adaptation and pavement luminance", which statement holds?
options: 設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。
原創教學假設：照度=122 lx；反射率=0.25 無因次。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
Original teaching assumptions: illuminance=122 lx; reflectance=0.25 dimensionless.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：照度=122 lx；反射率=0.25 無因次。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: illuminance=122 lx; reflectance=0.25 dimensionless. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 視覺適應與路面亮度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Visual adaptation and pavement luminance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「漫反射亮度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Diffuse luminance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 從實際駕駛視角比較不同背景下相同障礙的可見性。以駕駛視角的亮度量測配合照度網格，分別檢查乾濕路面與燈具衰減，保留外部天空條件。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare the same obstacle under different backgrounds from the driving viewpoint. Combine driver-view luminance with illuminance grids, checking dry and wet pavement and lamp depreciation while preserving exterior sky conditions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「漫反射亮度」的交付需回答：從實際駕駛視角比較不同背景下相同障礙的可見性。將視角、路面狀態和光度校正連同量測交付，照明調整需按核准場景測試，不把理想反射公式當驗收標準。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Qinling Zhongnanshan Highway Tunnel, the diffuse luminance handover must address the following evidence: Compare the same obstacle under different backgrounds from the driving viewpoint. Hand over viewing geometry, pavement state and photometric calibration; test changes against approved scenarios rather than treating ideal reflection as an acceptance criterion.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：景觀明亮不保證路面反光或眩光不妨礙辨識。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Bright decoration does not exclude glare or reflections that hinder detection. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 從實際駕駛視角比較不同背景下相同障礙的可見性。以駕駛視角的亮度量測配合照度網格，分別檢查乾濕路面與燈具衰減，保留外部天空條件。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。

Combine driver-view luminance with illuminance grids, checking dry and wet pavement and lamp depreciation while preserving exterior sky conditions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.text: 本案「漫反射亮度」的交付需回答：從實際駕駛視角比較不同背景下相同障礙的可見性。將視角、路面狀態和光度校正連同量測交付，照明調整需按核准場景測試，不把理想反射公式當驗收標準。
knowledge.textEn: For Qinling Zhongnanshan Highway Tunnel, the diffuse luminance handover must address the following evidence: Compare the same obstacle under different backgrounds from the driving viewpoint. Hand over viewing geometry, pavement state and photometric calibration; test changes against approved scenarios rather than treating ideal reflection as an acceptance criterion.

quiz.question: 要驗證「視覺適應與路面亮度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Visual adaptation and pavement luminance"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
從實際駕駛視角比較不同背景下相同障礙的可見性。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
Compare the same obstacle under different backgrounds from the driving viewpoint.
quiz.explanation: 從實際駕駛視角比較不同背景下相同障礙的可見性。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare the same obstacle under different backgrounds from the driving viewpoint. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 視覺適應與路面亮度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Visual adaptation and pavement luminance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「漫反射亮度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Diffuse luminance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 景觀明亮不保證路面反光或眩光不妨礙辨識。照度平均值合格仍可能存在低亮度障礙區或眩光，感測器沾污也會使調光系統低估外界亮度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Bright decoration does not exclude glare or reflections that hinder detection. Acceptable average illuminance can coexist with dark obstacles or glare, while sensor contamination may bias adaptive lighting controls. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：路面反射、濕度、燈具配光及背景對比共同影響辨識；朗伯模型只示範理想漫反射，不能直接制定入口段燈具間距或真實道路安全值。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A Lambertian model illustrates ideal diffuse reflection only; it cannot establish entrance-zone spacing or actual road-safety limits without photometric and operational assessment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「照度越高就必然使隧道內所有物體更容易辨識。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Higher illuminance necessarily makes every tunnel object easier to detect." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 景觀明亮不保證路面反光或眩光不妨礙辨識。照度平均值合格仍可能存在低亮度障礙區或眩光，感測器沾污也會使調光系統低估外界亮度。
knowledge.textEn: Bright decoration does not exclude glare or reflections that hinder detection. Acceptable average illuminance can coexist with dark obstacles or glare, while sensor contamination may bias adaptive lighting controls.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「視覺適應與路面亮度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Visual adaptation and pavement luminance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 景觀明亮不保證路面反光或眩光不妨礙辨識。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
optionsEn: Bright decoration does not exclude glare or reflections that hinder detection.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
quiz.explanation: 景觀明亮不保證路面反光或眩光不妨礙辨識。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Bright decoration does not exclude glare or reflections that hinder detection. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「支護啟動與變形容量」與「疏散時間與分區可用性」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Support activation and deformation capacity" and "Evacuation time and zone availability": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「支護安裝時點」如何影響秦嶺終南山公路隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Support activation time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Qinling Zhongnanshan Highway Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 洞室擴大或通風連接會改變局部支護路徑，教材不把一般斷面支護直接套到交會部。支護荷載由開挖釋放量和支護啟動時間共同決定，越早安裝不一定讓構件受力越小。地盤反力與支護曲線必須連同掌子面距離及封閉順序理解；擠壓性地層還需保留變形容量，不能只追求高剛度與高材料強度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「支護安裝時點」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Enlargements and ventilation connections alter support paths; do not copy ordinary-section support into junctions. Support load depends on stress release and activation time, so earlier installation does not necessarily reduce member forces. Interpret ground-reaction and support curves together with distance from the face and closure sequence. Squeezing ground also needs deformation capacity; high stiffness and material strength alone do not guarantee a compatible support response. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Support activation time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：局部剛度=51 kN/mm；位移=11 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=51 kN/mm; movement=11 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「支護安裝時點」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Support activation time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 支護啟動與變形容量
knowledge.text: 洞室擴大或通風連接會改變局部支護路徑，教材不把一般斷面支護直接套到交會部。支護荷載由開挖釋放量和支護啟動時間共同決定，越早安裝不一定讓構件受力越小。
knowledge.textEn: Enlargements and ventilation connections alter support paths; do not copy ordinary-section support into junctions. Support load depends on stress release and activation time, so earlier installation does not necessarily reduce member forces.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「支護啟動與變形容量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Support activation and deformation capacity" is correct?
options: 支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
洞室擴大或通風連接會改變局部支護路徑，教材不把一般斷面支護直接套到交會部。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
optionsEn: Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
Enlargements and ventilation connections alter support paths; do not copy ordinary-section support into junctions.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
quiz.explanation: 洞室擴大或通風連接會改變局部支護路徑，教材不把一般斷面支護直接套到交會部。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Enlargements and ventilation connections alter support paths; do not copy ordinary-section support into junctions. The other options are common misconceptions.

quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Support activation and deformation capacity", which statement holds?
options: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。

Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction.

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「支護安裝時點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Support activation time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將交會部收斂和支護荷重與一般區分開比較。同步記錄收斂、支護荷重與安裝里程，比較同一地質分區內的速率及荷載，不將不同開挖齡期讀值直接混合。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare junction convergence and support force separately from ordinary reaches. Synchronise convergence, support loads and installation chainage; compare rates and loads within one ground domain without mixing readings at different excavation ages. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「支護安裝時點」的交付需回答：將交會部收斂和支護荷重與一般區分開比較。把安裝時間和量測資料一起交付支護設計者，任何級別變更都需地質及位移證據，不能憑單一瞬間讀值自行改支護。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Qinling Zhongnanshan Highway Tunnel, the support activation time handover must address the following evidence: Compare junction convergence and support force separately from ordinary reaches. Submit installation times with measurements to the support designer; class changes need both ground and movement evidence, not an isolated instantaneous reading.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：交會部三維釋放可能使相同材料支護承受不同作用。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Three-dimensional release at junctions changes actions despite identical support material. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Synchronise convergence, support loads and installation chainage; compare rates and loads within one ground domain without mixing readings at different excavation ages. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.text: 本案「支護安裝時點」的交付需回答：將交會部收斂和支護荷重與一般區分開比較。把安裝時間和量測資料一起交付支護設計者，任何級別變更都需地質及位移證據，不能憑單一瞬間讀值自行改支護。

Submit installation times with measurements to the support designer; class changes need both ground and movement evidence, not an isolated instantaneous reading.

quiz.question: 要驗證「支護啟動與變形容量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Support activation and deformation capacity"?
options: 將交會部收斂和支護荷重與一般區分開比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
optionsEn: Compare junction convergence and support force separately from ordinary reaches.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
quiz.explanation: 將交會部收斂和支護荷重與一般區分開比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare junction convergence and support force separately from ordinary reaches. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「支護安裝時點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Support activation time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 交會部三維釋放可能使相同材料支護承受不同作用。過晚封閉會讓不可回復變形增加，過硬且行程不足的支護也可能脆裂，兩者都可能表現為裂縫而需不同處理。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Three-dimensional release at junctions changes actions despite identical support material. Late closure increases irreversible movement, while excessively stiff support with little travel can fail brittly; both produce cracks but require different diagnoses. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：地盤反力與支護曲線必須連同掌子面距離及封閉順序理解；擠壓性地層還需保留變形容量，不能只追求高剛度與高材料強度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Squeezing ground also needs deformation capacity; high stiffness and material strength alone do not guarantee a compatible support response.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 交會部三維釋放可能使相同材料支護承受不同作用。過晚封閉會讓不可回復變形增加，過硬且行程不足的支護也可能脆裂，兩者都可能表現為裂縫而需不同處理。
knowledge.textEn: Three-dimensional release at junctions changes actions despite identical support material. Late closure increases irreversible movement, while excessively stiff support with little travel can fail brittly; both produce cracks but require different diagnoses.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「支護啟動與變形容量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Support activation and deformation capacity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
交會部三維釋放可能使相同材料支護承受不同作用。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Three-dimensional release at junctions changes actions despite identical support material.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
quiz.explanation: 交會部三維釋放可能使相同材料支護承受不同作用。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Three-dimensional release at junctions changes actions despite identical support material. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Evacuation time and zone availability: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「所需疏散時間」如何影響秦嶺終南山公路隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Required evacuation time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Qinling Zhongnanshan Highway Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 長道路撤離需要保留反應、步行和接收區狀態，教材研究不同事故里程的路徑差異。疏散時間包含辨識、反應、移動及排隊，不只由出口距離決定。人員速度會受煙熱、能見度及行動能力影響，安全判斷還要比較可用安全時間；橫通道存在但門或鄰孔不可用時，圖上的最短路線不一定能作實際選擇。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「所需疏散時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Evacuation includes response, walking and receiving-area state; compare routes for different incident chainages. Evacuation includes detection, response, travel and queues, not merely distance to an exit. Smoke, visibility and mobility alter walking speed, while safety requires comparison with available safe time. A passage shown on a plan may be unusable because its door or receiving bore is unavailable, invalidating the nominal shortest route. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Required evacuation time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：前置時間=122 s；行走距離=340 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=122 s; travel distance=340 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「所需疏散時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Required evacuation time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性
knowledge.text: 長道路撤離需要保留反應、步行和接收區狀態，教材研究不同事故里程的路徑差異。疏散時間包含辨識、反應、移動及排隊，不只由出口距離決定。
knowledge.textEn: Evacuation includes response, walking and receiving-area state; compare routes for different incident chainages. Evacuation includes detection, response, travel and queues, not merely distance to an exit.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「疏散時間與分區可用性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Evacuation time and zone availability" is correct?
options: 只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。
長道路撤離需要保留反應、步行和接收區狀態，教材研究不同事故里程的路徑差異。
optionsEn: Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
Evacuation includes response, walking and receiving-area state; compare routes for different incident chainages.
quiz.explanation: 長道路撤離需要保留反應、步行和接收區狀態，教材研究不同事故里程的路徑差異。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Evacuation includes response, walking and receiving-area state; compare routes for different incident chainages. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Evacuation time and zone availability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「所需疏散時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Required evacuation time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：前置時間=122 s；行走距離=340 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。RSET=tpre+d/v=547 s。僅把行走距離增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為589.5 s。邊界：單群體固定速度，不含排隊煙熱及能力差異，不能單獨判安全；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=122 s; travel distance=340 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. RSET=tpre+d/v=547 s. Increasing only travel distance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 589.5 s. Boundary: One group at fixed speed without queues, smoke or mobility differences; not a safety conclusion. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：按事故位置重新核對標示可見性和橫通道可用性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Recheck sign visibility and passage availability by incident location.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：前置時間=122 s；行走距離=340 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。RSET=tpre+d/v=547 s。僅把行走距離增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為589.5 s。邊界：單群體固定速度，不含排隊煙熱及能力差異，不能單獨判安全；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=122 s; travel distance=340 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. RSET=tpre+d/v=547 s. Increasing only travel distance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 589.5 s. Boundary: One group at fixed speed without queues, smoke or mobility differences; not a safety conclusion. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「疏散時間與分區可用性」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Evacuation time and zone availability", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：前置時間=122 s；行走距離=340 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=122 s; travel distance=340 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：前置時間=122 s；行走距離=340 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=122 s; travel distance=340 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.instruction: 按事故位置重新核對標示可見性和橫通道可用性。以人流模擬或受控演練分辨前置時間、行走與門口排隊，核對每個出口接收區的可用狀態及通訊紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Recheck sign visibility and passage availability by incident location. Separate pre-movement, travel and doorway queues through simulation or controlled drills, checking receiving-zone availability and communication records for each exit. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
