Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較同壓試驗及鄰孔反應，保留材料凝結條件。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare equal-pressure tests and neighbouring responses with setting conditions recorded.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：試前同壓流量=0.0164 m³/s；試後同壓流量=0.0052 m³/s。r=100(Qbefore−Qafter)/Qbefore=68.2927 %。僅把試後同壓流量增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為65.122 %。邊界：相同水頭與試段的流量減量，不是全岩體封水率或長期保證；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: flow before at equal pressure=0.0164 m³/s; flow after at equal pressure=0.0052 m³/s. r=100(Qbefore−Qafter)/Qbefore=68.2927 %. Increasing only flow after at equal pressure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 65.122 %. Boundary: Flow reduction at equal head and test interval, not whole-rock sealing efficiency or long-term assurance. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「裂隙封水與試驗前後比較」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fracture sealing and before-after testing", which statement holds?
options: 集水坑總容積除以平均入流就是保證可用的反應時間。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
原創教學假設：試前同壓流量=0.0164 m³/s；試後同壓流量=0.0052 m³/s。
optionsEn: Gross sump volume divided by average inflow is a guaranteed response time.
Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
Original teaching assumptions: flow before at equal pressure=0.0164 m³/s; flow after at equal pressure=0.0052 m³/s. r=100(Qbefore−Qafter)/Qbefore=68.2927 %.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：試前同壓流量=0.0164 m³/s；試後同壓流量=0.0052 m³/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: flow before at equal pressure=0.0164 m³/s; flow after at equal pressure=0.0052 m³/s. r=100(Qbefore−Qafter)/Qbefore=68.2927 %. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 裂隙封水與試驗前後比較：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fracture sealing and before-after testing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「同條件入流減量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Equal-condition inflow reduction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較同壓試驗及鄰孔反應，保留材料凝結條件。重複相同水頭和試段長度的水力試驗，同步觀察鄰孔壓力與出水，保存注漿歷程和試驗時間。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare equal-pressure tests and neighbouring responses with setting conditions recorded. Repeat tests at equal head and interval length, observe neighbouring pressure and flow and preserve injection histories and test timing. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「同條件入流減量」的交付需回答：比較同壓試驗及鄰孔反應，保留材料凝結條件。把注入量、同條件水力結果和未覆蓋區分開交付，任何封水判斷保留替代水路及後續確認需求，不以教材減量當現場允收。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Ryfylke Tunnel, the equal-condition inflow reduction handover must address the following evidence: Compare equal-pressure tests and neighbouring responses with setting conditions recorded. Hand over injection quantity, equal-condition hydraulic results and untested areas separately, retaining alternative paths and follow-up checks rather than using classroom reduction as field acceptance.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：遠端流失可能讓近區試段仍有未封閉的主水路。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Distant grout loss can leave the dominant local water path open. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較同壓試驗及鄰孔反應，保留材料凝結條件。重複相同水頭和試段長度的水力試驗，同步觀察鄰孔壓力與出水，保存注漿歷程和試驗時間。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Compare equal-pressure tests and neighbouring responses with setting conditions recorded. Repeat tests at equal head and interval length, observe neighbouring pressure and flow and preserve injection histories and test timing. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「同條件入流減量」的交付需回答：比較同壓試驗及鄰孔反應，保留材料凝結條件。把注入量、同條件水力結果和未覆蓋區分開交付，任何封水判斷保留替代水路及後續確認需求，不以教材減量當現場允收。
knowledge.textEn: For Ryfylke Tunnel, the equal-condition inflow reduction handover must address the following evidence: Compare equal-pressure tests and neighbouring responses with setting conditions recorded. Hand over injection quantity, equal-condition hydraulic results and untested areas separately, retaining alternative paths and follow-up checks rather than using classroom reduction as field acceptance.

quiz.question: 要驗證「裂隙封水與試驗前後比較」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fracture sealing and before-after testing"?
options: 比較同壓試驗及鄰孔反應，保留材料凝結條件。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Compare equal-pressure tests and neighbouring responses with setting conditions recorded.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 比較同壓試驗及鄰孔反應，保留材料凝結條件。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare equal-pressure tests and neighbouring responses with setting conditions recorded. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 裂隙封水與試驗前後比較：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fracture sealing and before-after testing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「同條件入流減量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Equal-condition inflow reduction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 遠端流失可能讓近區試段仍有未封閉的主水路。注漿流入遠端裂隙或形成局部封口，可能使單孔出水減少但主水路仍連通；改變測試水頭也會造成假性改善。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Distant grout loss can leave the dominant local water path open. Grout entering distant fractures or sealing only a collar can reduce one outlet while the main path remains connected; changed test head also creates apparent improvement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：比較前後入流必須保持壓力、水頭和試段邊界一致，否則自然衰減或排水重分配也會降低讀值；灌漿效果要由水力試驗、鄰孔反應和後續揭露共同驗證。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Hydraulic tests, neighbouring-hole response and later exposure jointly establish the interpretation rather than injection quantity alone.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「單孔流量下降就能證明整個掌子面已永久封水。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Reduced flow at one hole proves permanent sealing of the entire face." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 遠端流失可能讓近區試段仍有未封閉的主水路。注漿流入遠端裂隙或形成局部封口，可能使單孔出水減少但主水路仍連通；改變測試水頭也會造成假性改善。
knowledge.textEn: Distant grout loss can leave the dominant local water path open. Grout entering distant fractures or sealing only a collar can reduce one outlet while the main path remains connected; changed test head also creates apparent improvement.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「裂隙封水與試驗前後比較」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fracture sealing and before-after testing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
遠端流失可能讓近區試段仍有未封閉的主水路。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Distant grout loss can leave the dominant local water path open.
Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
quiz.explanation: 遠端流失可能讓近區試段仍有未封閉的主水路。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Distant grout loss can leave the dominant local water path open. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「支護啟動與變形容量」與「環向受力與接縫柔度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Support activation and deformation capacity" and "Ring force and joint flexibility": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「支護安裝時點」如何影響挪威里菲爾克隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Support activation time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ryfylke Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 深海孔的岩體支護與防水功能分開，教材研究節理塊體穩定而仍有高滲流的情境。支護荷載由開挖釋放量和支護啟動時間共同決定，越早安裝不一定讓構件受力越小。地盤反力與支護曲線必須連同掌子面距離及封閉順序理解；擠壓性地層還需保留變形容量，不能只追求高剛度與高材料強度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「支護安裝時點」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate rock support from waterproofing; stable joint blocks can coexist with significant seepage. Support load depends on stress release and activation time, so earlier installation does not necessarily reduce member forces. Interpret ground-reaction and support curves together with distance from the face and closure sequence. Squeezing ground also needs deformation capacity; high stiffness and material strength alone do not guarantee a compatible support response. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Support activation time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：局部剛度=52 kN/mm；位移=9 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=52 kN/mm; movement=9 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「支護安裝時點」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Support activation time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 支護啟動與變形容量
knowledge.text: 深海孔的岩體支護與防水功能分開，教材研究節理塊體穩定而仍有高滲流的情境。支護荷載由開挖釋放量和支護啟動時間共同決定，越早安裝不一定讓構件受力越小。
knowledge.textEn: Separate rock support from waterproofing; stable joint blocks can coexist with significant seepage. Support load depends on stress release and activation time, so earlier installation does not necessarily reduce member forces.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「支護啟動與變形容量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Support activation and deformation capacity" is correct?
options: 支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
深海孔的岩體支護與防水功能分開，教材研究節理塊體穩定而仍有高滲流的情境。
optionsEn: Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
Separate rock support from waterproofing; stable joint blocks can coexist with significant seepage.
quiz.explanation: 深海孔的岩體支護與防水功能分開，教材研究節理塊體穩定而仍有高滲流的情境。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Separate rock support from waterproofing; stable joint blocks can coexist with significant seepage. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「支護安裝時點」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Support activation time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：局部剛度=52 kN/mm；位移=9 mm。F=ku=468 kN。僅把位移增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為514.8 kN。邊界：線性局部彈簧，不含屈服或時間效應；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=52 kN/mm; movement=9 mm. F=ku=468 kN. Increasing only movement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 514.8 kN. Boundary: Local linear spring without yielding or time effects. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把塊體位移、錨固荷重與流量各自量測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure block movement, anchor force and flow separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：局部剛度=52 kN/mm；位移=9 mm。F=ku=468 kN。僅把位移增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為514.8 kN。邊界：線性局部彈簧，不含屈服或時間效應；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=52 kN/mm; movement=9 mm. F=ku=468 kN. Increasing only movement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 514.8 kN. Boundary: Local linear spring without yielding or time effects. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「支護啟動與變形容量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Support activation and deformation capacity", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：局部剛度=52 kN/mm；位移=9 mm。
設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=52 kN/mm; movement=9 mm.
Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：局部剛度=52 kN/mm；位移=9 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=52 kN/mm; movement=9 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「支護安裝時點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Support activation time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把塊體位移、錨固荷重與流量各自量測。同步記錄收斂、支護荷重與安裝里程，比較同一地質分區內的速率及荷載，不將不同開挖齡期讀值直接混合。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure block movement, anchor force and flow separately. Synchronise convergence, support loads and installation chainage; compare rates and loads within one ground domain without mixing readings at different excavation ages. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「支護安裝時點」的交付需回答：把塊體位移、錨固荷重與流量各自量測。把安裝時間和量測資料一起交付支護設計者，任何級別變更都需地質及位移證據，不能憑單一瞬間讀值自行改支護。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Ryfylke Tunnel, the support activation time handover must address the following evidence: Measure block movement, anchor force and flow separately. Submit installation times with measurements to the support designer; class changes need both ground and movement evidence, not an isolated instantaneous reading.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：位移小不能當作封水成功，也不能由漏水推定支護失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Small movement does not prove sealing, and leakage alone does not prove support failure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把塊體位移、錨固荷重與流量各自量測。同步記錄收斂、支護荷重與安裝里程，比較同一地質分區內的速率及荷載，不將不同開挖齡期讀值直接混合。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Measure block movement, anchor force and flow separately. Synchronise convergence, support loads and installation chainage; compare rates and loads within one ground domain without mixing readings at different excavation ages. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「支護安裝時點」的交付需回答：把塊體位移、錨固荷重與流量各自量測。把安裝時間和量測資料一起交付支護設計者，任何級別變更都需地質及位移證據，不能憑單一瞬間讀值自行改支護。
knowledge.textEn: For Ryfylke Tunnel, the support activation time handover must address the following evidence: Measure block movement, anchor force and flow separately. Submit installation times with measurements to the support designer; class changes need both ground and movement evidence, not an isolated instantaneous reading.

quiz.question: 要驗證「支護啟動與變形容量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Support activation and deformation capacity"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
把塊體位移、錨固荷重與流量各自量測。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Measure block movement, anchor force and flow separately.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
quiz.explanation: 把塊體位移、錨固荷重與流量各自量測。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure block movement, anchor force and flow separately. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「支護安裝時點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Support activation time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 位移小不能當作封水成功，也不能由漏水推定支護失效。過晚封閉會讓不可回復變形增加，過硬且行程不足的支護也可能脆裂，兩者都可能表現為裂縫而需不同處理。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Small movement does not prove sealing, and leakage alone does not prove support failure. Late closure increases irreversible movement, while excessively stiff support with little travel can fail brittly; both produce cracks but require different diagnoses. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：地盤反力與支護曲線必須連同掌子面距離及封閉順序理解；擠壓性地層還需保留變形容量，不能只追求高剛度與高材料強度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Squeezing ground also needs deformation capacity; high stiffness and material strength alone do not guarantee a compatible support response.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 位移小不能當作封水成功，也不能由漏水推定支護失效。過晚封閉會讓不可回復變形增加，過硬且行程不足的支護也可能脆裂，兩者都可能表現為裂縫而需不同處理。
knowledge.textEn: Small movement does not prove sealing, and leakage alone does not prove support failure. Late closure increases irreversible movement, while excessively stiff support with little travel can fail brittly; both produce cracks but require different diagnoses.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「支護啟動與變形容量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Support activation and deformation capacity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
位移小不能當作封水成功，也不能由漏水推定支護失效。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
Small movement does not prove sealing, and leakage alone does not prove support failure.
quiz.explanation: 位移小不能當作封水成功，也不能由漏水推定支護失效。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Small movement does not prove sealing, and leakage alone does not prove support failure. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ring force and joint flexibility: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「襯砌環向壓縮」如何影響挪威里菲爾克隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lining hoop compression” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ryfylke Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 防水襯砌和噴覆支護的作用需依斷面釐清，教材薄環式僅對假想連續圓形襯砌適用。圓形襯砌對均勻外壓可主要以環向壓縮抵抗，但接頭轉動、偏壓與背填空隙會引起彎矩。薄環膜應力只說明其中一條受力路徑；脫模、運輸、頂推及永久狀態的荷載不同，環片局部接觸與止水條件必須另外檢核。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「襯砌環向壓縮」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Clarify waterproof lining and sprayed-support functions; the thin-ring exercise applies only to a hypothetical continuous circular lining. A circular lining resists uniform external pressure largely through hoop compression, but joint rotation, uneven load and backfill voids generate bending. Thin-ring membrane stress describes only one load path. Demoulding, transport, jacking and permanent states impose different actions, requiring separate checks of local segment contact and sealing rather than one permanent-load calculation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Lining hoop compression” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.74 MPa；半徑=3.5 m；厚度=0.35 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.74 MPa; radius=3.5 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=7.4 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「襯砌環向壓縮」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Lining hoop compression”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度
knowledge.text: 防水襯砌和噴覆支護的作用需依斷面釐清，教材薄環式僅對假想連續圓形襯砌適用。圓形襯砌對均勻外壓可主要以環向壓縮抵抗，但接頭轉動、偏壓與背填空隙會引起彎矩。
knowledge.textEn: Clarify waterproof lining and sprayed-support functions; the thin-ring exercise applies only to a hypothetical continuous circular lining. A circular lining resists uniform external pressure largely through hoop compression, but joint rotation, uneven load and backfill voids generate bending.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「環向受力與接縫柔度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ring force and joint flexibility" is correct?
options: 防水襯砌和噴覆支護的作用需依斷面釐清，教材薄環式僅對假想連續圓形襯砌適用。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
集水坑總容積除以平均入流就是保證可用的反應時間。
optionsEn: Clarify waterproof lining and sprayed-support functions; the thin-ring exercise applies only to a hypothetical continuous circular lining.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
Gross sump volume divided by average inflow is a guaranteed response time.
quiz.explanation: 防水襯砌和噴覆支護的作用需依斷面釐清，教材薄環式僅對假想連續圓形襯砌適用。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Clarify waterproof lining and sprayed-support functions; the thin-ring exercise applies only to a hypothetical continuous circular lining. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ring force and joint flexibility: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「襯砌環向壓縮」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lining hoop compression” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.74 MPa；半徑=3.5 m；厚度=0.35 m。σθ=pr/t=7.4 MPa。僅把均勻外壓增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為8.14 MPa。邊界：薄圓環膜應力，不是接縫、偏壓或矩形框架解；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.74 MPa; radius=3.5 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=7.4 MPa. Increasing only uniform external pressure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 8.14 MPa. Boundary: Thin circular-ring membrane stress, not a joint, uneven-load or rectangular-frame solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對實際結構型式後再決定是否可用環向模型。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check structural form before deciding whether a hoop model applies.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.74 MPa；半徑=3.5 m；厚度=0.35 m。σθ=pr/t=7.4 MPa。僅把均勻外壓增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為8.14 MPa。邊界：薄圓環膜應力，不是接縫、偏壓或矩形框架解；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.74 MPa; radius=3.5 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=7.4 MPa. Increasing only uniform external pressure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 8.14 MPa. Boundary: Thin circular-ring membrane stress, not a joint, uneven-load or rectangular-frame solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「環向受力與接縫柔度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ring force and joint flexibility", which statement holds?
options: 風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.74 MPa；半徑=3.5 m；厚度=0.35 m。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.74 MPa; radius=3.5 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=7.4 MPa.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.74 MPa；半徑=3.5 m；厚度=0.35 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.74 MPa; radius=3.5 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=7.4 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ring force and joint flexibility: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「襯砌環向壓縮」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lining hoop compression” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對實際結構型式後再決定是否可用環向模型。將環形變形、接縫張開與應變和含接頭彈簧的模型比較，分開安裝後、背填後及水頭回升後的基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check structural form before deciding whether a hoop model applies. Compare ring distortion, joint opening and strain with a joint-spring model, separating baselines after installation, grouting and head recovery. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「襯砌環向壓縮」的交付需回答：核對實際結構型式後再決定是否可用環向模型。設計圖應分開標註各施工階段、接頭剛度及背填條件，構件驗收同時核對幾何、材料批次與止水試驗適用包絡。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Ryfylke Tunnel, the lining hoop compression handover must address the following evidence: Check structural form before deciding whether a hoop model applies. Drawings distinguish stages, joint stiffness and backfill conditions; component acceptance reconciles geometry, material batches and the applicable sealing-test envelope.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把非連續防水系統當完整承壓環會虛構受力路徑。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating a discontinuous waterproof system as a pressure ring invents a load path. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對實際結構型式後再決定是否可用環向模型。將環形變形、接縫張開與應變和含接頭彈簧的模型比較，分開安裝後、背填後及水頭回升後的基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Check structural form before deciding whether a hoop model applies. Compare ring distortion, joint opening and strain with a joint-spring model, separating baselines after installation, grouting and head recovery. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「襯砌環向壓縮」的交付需回答：核對實際結構型式後再決定是否可用環向模型。設計圖應分開標註各施工階段、接頭剛度及背填條件，構件驗收同時核對幾何、材料批次與止水試驗適用包絡。
knowledge.textEn: For Ryfylke Tunnel, the lining hoop compression handover must address the following evidence: Check structural form before deciding whether a hoop model applies. Drawings distinguish stages, joint stiffness and backfill conditions; component acceptance reconciles geometry, material batches and the applicable sealing-test envelope.

quiz.question: 要驗證「環向受力與接縫柔度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ring force and joint flexibility"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
核對實際結構型式後再決定是否可用環向模型。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
Check structural form before deciding whether a hoop model applies.
quiz.explanation: 核對實際結構型式後再決定是否可用環向模型。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check structural form before deciding whether a hoop model applies. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ring force and joint flexibility: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「襯砌環向壓縮」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lining hoop compression” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把非連續防水系統當完整承壓環會虛構受力路徑。局部脫空增加環片彎曲，裂縫未必代表混凝土平均強度不足；忽略接縫接觸會把補強方向導向錯誤位置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating a discontinuous waterproof system as a pressure ring invents a load path. Local voids increase bending, so cracks need not indicate inadequate mean concrete strength; neglecting joint contact can misdirect strengthening. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：薄環膜應力只說明其中一條受力路徑；脫模、運輸、頂推及永久狀態的荷載不同，環片局部接觸與止水條件必須另外檢核。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Demoulding, transport, jacking and permanent states impose different actions, requiring separate checks of local segment contact and sealing rather than one permanent-load calculation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把非連續防水系統當完整承壓環會虛構受力路徑。局部脫空增加環片彎曲，裂縫未必代表混凝土平均強度不足；忽略接縫接觸會把補強方向導向錯誤位置。
knowledge.textEn: Treating a discontinuous waterproof system as a pressure ring invents a load path. Local voids increase bending, so cracks need not indicate inadequate mean concrete strength; neglecting joint contact can misdirect strengthening.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「環向受力與接縫柔度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ring force and joint flexibility" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把非連續防水系統當完整承壓環會虛構受力路徑。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
集水坑總容積除以平均入流就是保證可用的反應時間。
optionsEn: Treating a discontinuous waterproof system as a pressure ring invents a load path.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Gross sump volume divided by average inflow is a guaranteed response time.
quiz.explanation: 把非連續防水系統當完整承壓環會虛構受力路徑。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating a discontinuous waterproof system as a pressure ring invents a load path. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「停泵緩衝與有效集水容積」與「設備備援與共同失效」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Outage buffer and effective sump volume" and "Equipment redundancy and common failure": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 停泵緩衝與有效集水容積：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Outage buffer and effective sump volume: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「剩餘集水容積」如何影響挪威里菲爾克隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Remaining sump volume” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ryfylke Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 深低點集水需保留持續入流和停電條件，里菲爾克教材計算緩衝時間後另驗泵揚程。集水坑在泵停止後提供有限緩衝，剩餘容積需扣除初始水量、沉積及不可用死角。緩衝時間取決於淨入流，不是名牌抽水能力；警報延遲、備援切換與水量突增會消耗餘裕，排水電力又可能與其他安全設備共用失效原因。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「剩餘集水容積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Low-point sumps need continuing inflow and power-loss cases; calculate buffer time and separately verify pump head. A sump offers finite buffering after pumps stop, with usable volume reduced by initial water, sediment and dead spaces. Buffer time depends on net inflow rather than pump nameplate capacity. Alarm delay, transfer time and inflow surges consume reserve, while shared electrical dependencies may disable drainage and other safety equipment together. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Remaining sump volume” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：有效剩餘容積=740 m³；淨入流=0.18 m³/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: usable reserve=740 m³; net inflow=0.18 m³/s. t=V/Q/60=68.5185 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「集水坑總容積除以平均入流就是保證可用的反應時間。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Gross sump volume divided by average inflow is a guaranteed response time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「剩餘集水容積」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Remaining sump volume”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 停泵緩衝與有效集水容積
knowledge.titleEn: Outage buffer and effective sump volume
knowledge.text: 深低點集水需保留持續入流和停電條件，里菲爾克教材計算緩衝時間後另驗泵揚程。集水坑在泵停止後提供有限緩衝，剩餘容積需扣除初始水量、沉積及不可用死角。
knowledge.textEn: Low-point sumps need continuing inflow and power-loss cases; calculate buffer time and separately verify pump head. A sump offers finite buffering after pumps stop, with usable volume reduced by initial water, sediment and dead spaces.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：集水坑總容積除以平均入流就是保證可用的反應時間。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Gross sump volume divided by average inflow is a guaranteed response time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「停泵緩衝與有效集水容積」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Outage buffer and effective sump volume" is correct?
options: 集水坑總容積除以平均入流就是保證可用的反應時間。
深低點集水需保留持續入流和停電條件，里菲爾克教材計算緩衝時間後另驗泵揚程。
設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。
optionsEn: Gross sump volume divided by average inflow is a guaranteed response time.
Low-point sumps need continuing inflow and power-loss cases; calculate buffer time and separately verify pump head.
Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
quiz.explanation: 深低點集水需保留持續入流和停電條件，里菲爾克教材計算緩衝時間後另驗泵揚程。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Low-point sumps need continuing inflow and power-loss cases; calculate buffer time and separately verify pump head. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 停泵緩衝與有效集水容積：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Outage buffer and effective sump volume: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「剩餘集水容積」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Remaining sump volume” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：有效剩餘容積=740 m³；淨入流=0.18 m³/s。t=V/Q/60=68.5185 min。僅把淨入流增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為62.2896 min。邊界：停泵固定入流，不含警報延遲及水量突增；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: usable reserve=740 m³; net inflow=0.18 m³/s. t=V/Q/60=68.5185 min. Increasing only net inflow by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 62.2896 min. Boundary: Constant inflow during outage, excluding alarm delay and inflow surges. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用實測泵流量、出水水頭與集水位上升率互查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Cross-check pump delivery, discharge head and sump rise rate.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：有效剩餘容積=740 m³；淨入流=0.18 m³/s。t=V/Q/60=68.5185 min。僅把淨入流增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為62.2896 min。邊界：停泵固定入流，不含警報延遲及水量突增；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: usable reserve=740 m³; net inflow=0.18 m³/s. t=V/Q/60=68.5185 min. Increasing only net inflow by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 62.2896 min. Boundary: Constant inflow during outage, excluding alarm delay and inflow surges. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「停泵緩衝與有效集水容積」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Outage buffer and effective sump volume", which statement holds?
options: 只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
原創教學假設：有效剩餘容積=740 m³；淨入流=0.18 m³/s。
optionsEn: Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Original teaching assumptions: usable reserve=740 m³; net inflow=0.18 m³/s. t=V/Q/60=68.5185 min.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：有效剩餘容積=740 m³；淨入流=0.18 m³/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: usable reserve=740 m³; net inflow=0.18 m³/s. t=V/Q/60=68.5185 min. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 停泵緩衝與有效集水容積：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Outage buffer and effective sump volume: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「剩餘集水容積」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Remaining sump volume” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用實測泵流量、出水水頭與集水位上升率互查。以水位容積曲線和流量計核對停泵水位上升率，另檢查淤積、警報時間戳及備援電力切換紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Cross-check pump delivery, discharge head and sump rise rate. Compare outage level-rise rate with the level-volume curve and flowmeter, separately checking sediment, alarm timestamps and backup-power transfer records. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「剩餘集水容積」的交付需回答：用實測泵流量、出水水頭與集水位上升率互查。交接有效容積、初始水位及延遲預算，由排水與電氣責任人共同核對故障情境，定期清淤後保存量測證據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Ryfylke Tunnel, the remaining sump volume handover must address the following evidence: Cross-check pump delivery, discharge head and sump rise rate. Handover usable volume, initial level and delay budgets; drainage and electrical owners jointly review failures and retain measurements after sediment removal.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：名目泵流量在高揚程下可能無法實現，緩衝會提早耗盡。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Nominal pump delivery may be unattainable at high head, exhausting reserve early. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用實測泵流量、出水水頭與集水位上升率互查。以水位容積曲線和流量計核對停泵水位上升率，另檢查淤積、警報時間戳及備援電力切換紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Cross-check pump delivery, discharge head and sump rise rate. Compare outage level-rise rate with the level-volume curve and flowmeter, separately checking sediment, alarm timestamps and backup-power transfer records. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「剩餘集水容積」的交付需回答：用實測泵流量、出水水頭與集水位上升率互查。交接有效容積、初始水位及延遲預算，由排水與電氣責任人共同核對故障情境，定期清淤後保存量測證據。
knowledge.textEn: For Ryfylke Tunnel, the remaining sump volume handover must address the following evidence: Cross-check pump delivery, discharge head and sump rise rate. Handover usable volume, initial level and delay budgets; drainage and electrical owners jointly review failures and retain measurements after sediment removal.

quiz.question: 要驗證「停泵緩衝與有效集水容積」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Outage buffer and effective sump volume"?
options: 用實測泵流量、出水水頭與集水位上升率互查。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
單孔流量下降就能證明整個掌子面已永久封水。
optionsEn: Cross-check pump delivery, discharge head and sump rise rate.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Reduced flow at one hole proves permanent sealing of the entire face.
quiz.explanation: 用實測泵流量、出水水頭與集水位上升率互查。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Cross-check pump delivery, discharge head and sump rise rate. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 停泵緩衝與有效集水容積：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Outage buffer and effective sump volume: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「剩餘集水容積」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Remaining sump volume” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 名目泵流量在高揚程下可能無法實現，緩衝會提早耗盡。未扣除沉積的總容積會高估反應時間，若警報與抽水同失電，操作者可能在緩衝已耗盡後才得知水位上升。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Nominal pump delivery may be unattainable at high head, exhausting reserve early. Gross volume without sediment deduction overstates response time; shared loss of alarm and pumping power can hide rising water until the buffer is exhausted. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：緩衝時間取決於淨入流，不是名牌抽水能力；警報延遲、備援切換與水量突增會消耗餘裕，排水電力又可能與其他安全設備共用失效原因。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Alarm delay, transfer time and inflow surges consume reserve, while shared electrical dependencies may disable drainage and other safety equipment together.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「集水坑總容積除以平均入流就是保證可用的反應時間。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Gross sump volume divided by average inflow is a guaranteed response time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 名目泵流量在高揚程下可能無法實現，緩衝會提早耗盡。未扣除沉積的總容積會高估反應時間，若警報與抽水同失電，操作者可能在緩衝已耗盡後才得知水位上升。
knowledge.textEn: Nominal pump delivery may be unattainable at high head, exhausting reserve early. Gross volume without sediment deduction overstates response time; shared loss of alarm and pumping power can hide rising water until the buffer is exhausted.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「停泵緩衝與有效集水容積」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Outage buffer and effective sump volume" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
名目泵流量在高揚程下可能無法實現，緩衝會提早耗盡。
設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Nominal pump delivery may be unattainable at high head, exhausting reserve early.
Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
quiz.explanation: 名目泵流量在高揚程下可能無法實現，緩衝會提早耗盡。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Nominal pump delivery may be unattainable at high head, exhausting reserve early. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 設備備援與共同失效：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Equipment redundancy and common failure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「系統不可用率」如何影響挪威里菲爾克隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “System unavailability” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ryfylke Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 深低點抽排的兩泵若共享電源及出口管路，教材不把單機不可用率直接平方當全系統風險。兩套設備只有在故障近似獨立且切換可靠時，並聯才顯著降低不可用率。共用配電、控制軟體、冷卻或受淹位置會把獨立假設破壞；維修停用也改變當下配置，因此可靠度模型必須明列共有資源和設備狀態，不能只數備用台數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「系統不可用率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Two sump pumps sharing power and discharge lines do not justify squaring unit unavailability for the whole system. Parallel equipment sharply reduces unavailability only when failures are approximately independent and transfer works. Shared power, software, cooling or flood exposure breaks that assumption. Planned maintenance also changes the available configuration, so reliability models must identify shared resources and states rather than count spare units or multiply unsupported independent probabilities. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “System unavailability” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：單機不可用率=0.032 無因次。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: single-unit unavailability=0.032 dimensionless.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「系統不可用率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “System unavailability”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 設備備援與共同失效
knowledge.text: 深低點抽排的兩泵若共享電源及出口管路，教材不把單機不可用率直接平方當全系統風險。兩套設備只有在故障近似獨立且切換可靠時，並聯才顯著降低不可用率。
knowledge.textEn: Two sump pumps sharing power and discharge lines do not justify squaring unit unavailability for the whole system. Parallel equipment sharply reduces unavailability only when failures are approximately independent and transfer works.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「設備備援與共同失效」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Equipment redundancy and common failure" is correct?
options: 設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
深低點抽排的兩泵若共享電源及出口管路，教材不把單機不可用率直接平方當全系統風險。
optionsEn: Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
Two sump pumps sharing power and discharge lines do not justify squaring unit unavailability for the whole system.
quiz.explanation: 深低點抽排的兩泵若共享電源及出口管路，教材不把單機不可用率直接平方當全系統風險。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Two sump pumps sharing power and discharge lines do not justify squaring unit unavailability for the whole system. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 設備備援與共同失效：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Equipment redundancy and common failure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「系統不可用率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “System unavailability” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：單機不可用率=0.032 無因次。Uparallel=U²=0.001024 probability。僅把單機不可用率增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.00123904 probability。邊界：完全獨立並聯與完美切換，不含共同失效；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: single-unit unavailability=0.032 dimensionless. Uparallel=U²=0.001024 probability. Increasing only single-unit unavailability by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.00123904 probability. Boundary: Independent parallel units with perfect transfer, excluding common failures. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：追查電源、止回和共用管路故障的影響。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Trace effects of power, check-valve and common-pipe failures.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：單機不可用率=0.032 無因次。Uparallel=U²=0.001024 probability。僅把單機不可用率增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.00123904 probability。邊界：完全獨立並聯與完美切換，不含共同失效；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: single-unit unavailability=0.032 dimensionless. Uparallel=U²=0.001024 probability. Increasing only single-unit unavailability by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.00123904 probability. Boundary: Independent parallel units with perfect transfer, excluding common failures. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「設備備援與共同失效」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Equipment redundancy and common failure", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：單機不可用率=0.032 無因次。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: single-unit unavailability=0.032 dimensionless.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：單機不可用率=0.032 無因次。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: single-unit unavailability=0.032 dimensionless. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 設備備援與共同失效：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Equipment redundancy and common failure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「系統不可用率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “System unavailability” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 追查電源、止回和共用管路故障的影響。由設備清單畫出故障樹，將電源、控制及實體位置追到共同節點，並用事件及維修紀錄檢查獨立假設。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Trace effects of power, check-valve and common-pipe failures. Build a fault tree from the asset list, trace power, control and location to shared nodes, and test independence against incident and maintenance records. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「系統不可用率」的交付需回答：追查電源、止回和共用管路故障的影響。維修計畫附當日可用配置與剩餘備援，任何共同資源更動同步更新故障樹，切換試驗由設備及營運團隊共同見證。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Ryfylke Tunnel, the system unavailability handover must address the following evidence: Trace effects of power, check-valve and common-pipe failures. Attach the actual configuration and remaining redundancy to maintenance plans, update fault trees after shared-resource changes, and witness transfer tests jointly.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：共用出口堵塞會讓兩台正常泵都無法排水。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A blocked common outlet prevents both healthy pumps from discharging. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Attach the actual configuration and remaining redundancy to maintenance plans, update fault trees after shared-resource changes, and witness transfer tests jointly.

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Equipment redundancy and common failure"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
