stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「通風網路與壓力損失」與「疏散時間與分區可用性」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ventilation network and pressure loss" and "Evacuation time and zone availability": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「風道摩擦壓損」如何影響挪威里菲爾克隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Duct friction loss” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ryfylke Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 長下坡與上坡車流改變污染源和活塞作用，教材用網路量測辨識風機與車流的相對影響。風機提供壓差，實際風量由風道摩阻、局部損失、外風與其他風機共同決定。支路開關會重新分配整個網路，不能把額定風量直接加總；正常污染稀釋與火災控煙也有不同目標，需要分別建立受控邊界和故障情境。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「風道摩擦壓損」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Descending and climbing traffic change emissions and piston effects; use network observations to distinguish traffic from fan influence. Fans supply pressure, but actual flow follows friction, local losses, external wind and interactions with other fans. Switching a branch redistributes the network rather than simply adding rated flows. Routine dilution and fire smoke control have different objectives, so each needs explicit boundaries, operating states and failure cases rather than one universal flow target. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Duct friction loss” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=1380 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.8 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=1380 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.8 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=74.727 Pa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「風道摩擦壓損」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Duct friction loss”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 通風網路與壓力損失
knowledge.text: 長下坡與上坡車流改變污染源和活塞作用，教材用網路量測辨識風機與車流的相對影響。風機提供壓差，實際風量由風道摩阻、局部損失、外風與其他風機共同決定。
knowledge.textEn: Descending and climbing traffic change emissions and piston effects; use network observations to distinguish traffic from fan influence. Fans supply pressure, but actual flow follows friction, local losses, external wind and interactions with other fans.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「通風網路與壓力損失」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ventilation network and pressure loss" is correct?
options: 長下坡與上坡車流改變污染源和活塞作用，教材用網路量測辨識風機與車流的相對影響。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
optionsEn: Descending and climbing traffic change emissions and piston effects; use network observations to distinguish traffic from fan influence.
Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
quiz.explanation: 長下坡與上坡車流改變污染源和活塞作用，教材用網路量測辨識風機與車流的相對影響。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Descending and climbing traffic change emissions and piston effects; use network observations to distinguish traffic from fan influence. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「風道摩擦壓損」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Duct friction loss” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=1380 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.8 m/s。Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=74.727 Pa。僅把平均風速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為90.4197 Pa。邊界：定密度直管摩阻，局部損失及外風另計；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=1380 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.8 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=74.727 Pa. Increasing only mean velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 90.4197 Pa. Boundary: Constant-density straight-duct friction; local loss and external wind are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時記錄方向車流、風速和壓差，不混用不同時段。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record directional traffic, velocity and pressure simultaneously.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=1380 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.8 m/s。Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=74.727 Pa。僅把平均風速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為90.4197 Pa。邊界：定密度直管摩阻，局部損失及外風另計；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=1380 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.8 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=74.727 Pa. Increasing only mean velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 90.4197 Pa. Boundary: Constant-density straight-duct friction; local loss and external wind are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「通風網路與壓力損失」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ventilation network and pressure loss", which statement holds?
options: 目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=1380 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.8 m/s。
單孔流量下降就能證明整個掌子面已永久封水。
optionsEn: No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless.
Reduced flow at one hole proves permanent sealing of the entire face.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=1380 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.8 m/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=1380 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.8 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=74.727 Pa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「風道摩擦壓損」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Duct friction loss” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同時記錄方向車流、風速和壓差，不混用不同時段。沿線同步量測靜壓與風速，記錄風門及其他風機狀態，再把實測工作點和風機曲線、網路壓損比較。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record directional traffic, velocity and pressure simultaneously. Measure pressure and velocity synchronously, record dampers and other fans, and compare the measured duty point with fan curves and network resistance. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「風道摩擦壓損」的交付需回答：同時記錄方向車流、風速和壓差，不混用不同時段。驗收採明確風門和車流邊界，維修改線後重新核對網路工作點，火災模式由防災責任工程師簽認而非沿用正常模式。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Ryfylke Tunnel, the duct friction loss handover must address the following evidence: Record directional traffic, velocity and pressure simultaneously. Commission with specified damper and traffic boundaries, recheck duty points after rerouting, and have the fire-safety engineer approve emergency modes independently.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：交通方向變化引起的風流不應直接判為風機性能衰退。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Traffic-induced flow changes should not be labelled fan deterioration directly. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同時記錄方向車流、風速和壓差，不混用不同時段。沿線同步量測靜壓與風速，記錄風門及其他風機狀態，再把實測工作點和風機曲線、網路壓損比較。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Record directional traffic, velocity and pressure simultaneously. Measure pressure and velocity synchronously, record dampers and other fans, and compare the measured duty point with fan curves and network resistance. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「風道摩擦壓損」的交付需回答：同時記錄方向車流、風速和壓差，不混用不同時段。驗收採明確風門和車流邊界，維修改線後重新核對網路工作點，火災模式由防災責任工程師簽認而非沿用正常模式。
knowledge.textEn: For Ryfylke Tunnel, the duct friction loss handover must address the following evidence: Record directional traffic, velocity and pressure simultaneously. Commission with specified damper and traffic boundaries, recheck duty points after rerouting, and have the fire-safety engineer approve emergency modes independently.

quiz.question: 要驗證「通風網路與壓力損失」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ventilation network and pressure loss"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
同時記錄方向車流、風速和壓差，不混用不同時段。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
Record directional traffic, velocity and pressure simultaneously.
quiz.explanation: 同時記錄方向車流、風速和壓差，不混用不同時段。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record directional traffic, velocity and pressure simultaneously. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 通風網路與壓力損失：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ventilation network and pressure loss: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「風道摩擦壓損」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Duct friction loss” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 交通方向變化引起的風流不應直接判為風機性能衰退。只看風機轉速會漏掉風門誤位或短路漏風，可能在總耗電增加時，真正需要的區段反而風量不足。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Traffic-induced flow changes should not be labelled fan deterioration directly. Fan speed alone misses a misplaced damper or leakage shortcut; total power may rise while the critical section receives less air. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：支路開關會重新分配整個網路，不能把額定風量直接加總；正常污染稀釋與火災控煙也有不同目標，需要分別建立受控邊界和故障情境。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Routine dilution and fire smoke control have different objectives, so each needs explicit boundaries, operating states and failure cases rather than one universal flow target.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 交通方向變化引起的風流不應直接判為風機性能衰退。只看風機轉速會漏掉風門誤位或短路漏風，可能在總耗電增加時，真正需要的區段反而風量不足。
knowledge.textEn: Traffic-induced flow changes should not be labelled fan deterioration directly. Fan speed alone misses a misplaced damper or leakage shortcut; total power may rise while the critical section receives less air.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「通風網路與壓力損失」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ventilation network and pressure loss" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 交通方向變化引起的風流不應直接判為風機性能衰退。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
optionsEn: Traffic-induced flow changes should not be labelled fan deterioration directly.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
quiz.explanation: 交通方向變化引起的風流不應直接判為風機性能衰退。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Traffic-induced flow changes should not be labelled fan deterioration directly. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Evacuation time and zone availability: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「所需疏散時間」如何影響挪威里菲爾克隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Required evacuation time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ryfylke Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 深海路線兩端爬升距離長，跨孔路徑與最終出口需求不同，教材分階段計算並檢查鄰孔狀態。疏散時間包含辨識、反應、移動及排隊，不只由出口距離決定。人員速度會受煙熱、能見度及行動能力影響，安全判斷還要比較可用安全時間；橫通道存在但門或鄰孔不可用時，圖上的最短路線不一定能作實際選擇。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「所需疏散時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Long ascent to portals makes cross-bore transfer distinct from reaching an ultimate exit; calculate stages and check the receiving bore. Evacuation includes detection, response, travel and queues, not merely distance to an exit. Smoke, visibility and mobility alter walking speed, while safety requires comparison with available safe time. A passage shown on a plan may be unusable because its door or receiving bore is unavailable, invalidating the nominal shortest route. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Required evacuation time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：前置時間=124 s；行走距離=380 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=124 s; travel distance=380 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「所需疏散時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Required evacuation time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性
knowledge.text: 深海路線兩端爬升距離長，跨孔路徑與最終出口需求不同，教材分階段計算並檢查鄰孔狀態。疏散時間包含辨識、反應、移動及排隊，不只由出口距離決定。
knowledge.textEn: Long ascent to portals makes cross-bore transfer distinct from reaching an ultimate exit; calculate stages and check the receiving bore. Evacuation includes detection, response, travel and queues, not merely distance to an exit.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「疏散時間與分區可用性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Evacuation time and zone availability" is correct?
options: 只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
深海路線兩端爬升距離長，跨孔路徑與最終出口需求不同，教材分階段計算並檢查鄰孔狀態。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
Long ascent to portals makes cross-bore transfer distinct from reaching an ultimate exit; calculate stages and check the receiving bore.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 深海路線兩端爬升距離長，跨孔路徑與最終出口需求不同，教材分階段計算並檢查鄰孔狀態。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Long ascent to portals makes cross-bore transfer distinct from reaching an ultimate exit; calculate stages and check the receiving bore. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Evacuation time and zone availability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「所需疏散時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Required evacuation time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：前置時間=124 s；行走距離=380 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。RSET=tpre+d/v=599 s。僅把行走距離增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為646.5 s。邊界：單群體固定速度，不含排隊煙熱及能力差異，不能單獨判安全；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=124 s; travel distance=380 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. RSET=tpre+d/v=599 s. Increasing only travel distance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 646.5 s. Boundary: One group at fixed speed without queues, smoke or mobility differences; not a safety conclusion. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對轉入鄰孔後的交通控制及後續移動方案。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check traffic control and onward movement after transfer to the adjacent bore.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：前置時間=124 s；行走距離=380 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。RSET=tpre+d/v=599 s。僅把行走距離增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為646.5 s。邊界：單群體固定速度，不含排隊煙熱及能力差異，不能單獨判安全；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=124 s; travel distance=380 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. RSET=tpre+d/v=599 s. Increasing only travel distance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 646.5 s. Boundary: One group at fixed speed without queues, smoke or mobility differences; not a safety conclusion. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「疏散時間與分區可用性」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Evacuation time and zone availability", which statement holds?
options: 岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
原創教學假設：前置時間=124 s；行走距離=380 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。
optionsEn: Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=124 s; travel distance=380 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：前置時間=124 s；行走距離=380 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=124 s; travel distance=380 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Evacuation time and zone availability: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「所需疏散時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Required evacuation time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對轉入鄰孔後的交通控制及後續移動方案。以人流模擬或受控演練分辨前置時間、行走與門口排隊，核對每個出口接收區的可用狀態及通訊紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check traffic control and onward movement after transfer to the adjacent bore. Separate pre-movement, travel and doorway queues through simulation or controlled drills, checking receiving-zone availability and communication records for each exit. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「所需疏散時間」的交付需回答：核對轉入鄰孔後的交通控制及後續移動方案。疏散模型保留人口、速度分布及出口狀態，演練改動由營運與防災責任者批准，教材算例不得當作現場指揮程序。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Ryfylke Tunnel, the required evacuation time handover must address the following evidence: Check traffic control and onward movement after transfer to the adjacent bore. Retain population, speed distribution and exit states; operations and fire-safety owners approve drill changes, and classroom calculations are not incident-command procedures.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：到達鄰孔不等於完成所有人員的最終撤離。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Arrival in the adjacent bore does not complete final evacuation for everyone. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對轉入鄰孔後的交通控制及後續移動方案。以人流模擬或受控演練分辨前置時間、行走與門口排隊，核對每個出口接收區的可用狀態及通訊紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Check traffic control and onward movement after transfer to the adjacent bore. Separate pre-movement, travel and doorway queues through simulation or controlled drills, checking receiving-zone availability and communication records for each exit. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「所需疏散時間」的交付需回答：核對轉入鄰孔後的交通控制及後續移動方案。疏散模型保留人口、速度分布及出口狀態，演練改動由營運與防災責任者批准，教材算例不得當作現場指揮程序。
knowledge.textEn: For Ryfylke Tunnel, the required evacuation time handover must address the following evidence: Check traffic control and onward movement after transfer to the adjacent bore. Retain population, speed distribution and exit states; operations and fire-safety owners approve drill changes, and classroom calculations are not incident-command procedures.

quiz.question: 要驗證「疏散時間與分區可用性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Evacuation time and zone availability"?
options: 核對轉入鄰孔後的交通控制及後續移動方案。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
集水坑總容積除以平均入流就是保證可用的反應時間。
optionsEn: Check traffic control and onward movement after transfer to the adjacent bore.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Gross sump volume divided by average inflow is a guaranteed response time.
quiz.explanation: 核對轉入鄰孔後的交通控制及後續移動方案。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check traffic control and onward movement after transfer to the adjacent bore. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Evacuation time and zone availability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「所需疏散時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Required evacuation time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 到達鄰孔不等於完成所有人員的最終撤離。以最快成人速度套全部旅客會低估需求，若忽略接收孔受煙或車流影響，疏散可能移到另一個危險邊界。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Arrival in the adjacent bore does not complete final evacuation for everyone. Applying the fastest adult speed to everyone understates demand; overlooking smoke or traffic in the receiving bore can transfer evacuees into another hazard. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：人員速度會受煙熱、能見度及行動能力影響，安全判斷還要比較可用安全時間；橫通道存在但門或鄰孔不可用時，圖上的最短路線不一定能作實際選擇。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A passage shown on a plan may be unusable because its door or receiving bore is unavailable, invalidating the nominal shortest route.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 到達鄰孔不等於完成所有人員的最終撤離。以最快成人速度套全部旅客會低估需求，若忽略接收孔受煙或車流影響，疏散可能移到另一個危險邊界。
knowledge.textEn: Arrival in the adjacent bore does not complete final evacuation for everyone. Applying the fastest adult speed to everyone understates demand; overlooking smoke or traffic in the receiving bore can transfer evacuees into another hazard.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「疏散時間與分區可用性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Evacuation time and zone availability" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
到達鄰孔不等於完成所有人員的最終撤離。
最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Arrival in the adjacent bore does not complete final evacuation for everyone.
The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
quiz.explanation: 到達鄰孔不等於完成所有人員的最終撤離。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Arrival in the adjacent bore does not complete final evacuation for everyone. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 首都圈外郭放水路
titleEn: Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel
summary: 首都圈外郭放水路由入流設施、地下水路、調壓水槽與泵站共同減少洪水影響，官方圖列水路6.3公里。2002年先行運用的是部分3.3公里區間，工程期至2006年。本課以水量、能量及水位基準串接全系統，避免把地下河道誤當道路隧道或將局部算例當完整洪水演算。
summaryEn: The Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel combines intakes, a 6.3 km underground waterway, a pressure-control tank and pumps. Interim use in 2002 covered a 3.3 km portion; construction continued to 2006. This course connects water balance, energy and level datum without treating the facility as a road or a local calculation as full flood routing.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創綜合審查：先計算「洪水歷線與調蓄餘量」，再獨立計算「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」。原創教學假設：入流=173 m³/s；出流=100 m³/s；時間段=20 min。ΔV=(Qin−Qout)Δt×60=87600 m³。僅把入流增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為108360 m³。邊界：矩形歷線單一時段，真實洪水需逐時積分與水位約束；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=127 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1245.87 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1370.46 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated review: first calculate flood hydrographs and storage reserve, then independently calculate piezometric head and lining pressure. Original teaching assumptions: inflow=173 m³/s; outflow=100 m³/s; interval=20 min. ΔV=(Qin−Qout)Δt×60=87600 m³. Increasing only inflow by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 108360 m³. Boundary: One rectangular-hydrograph interval; real floods need time integration and level constraints. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=127 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1245.87 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1370.46 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「地下水路與傳遞時間」與「洪水歷線與調蓄餘量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Underground water routes and travel time" and "Flood hydrographs and storage reserve": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 地下水路與傳遞時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Underground water routes and travel time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水體平流時間」如何影響首都圈外郭放水路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Water advection time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 首都圈放水路收集多河川入流，教材以水體平流時間辨認路徑，明確區別洪峰波速與控制延遲。地下排水或引水設施的路線先由集水區、入流點、出口水位及坡度定義，不能以交通旅行時間衡量。定速水體的行程可用距離除速度估算，但洪峰波速、蓄水與回水會改變訊號傳遞；各支路必須在共同水位與時間基準下連接。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水體平流時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: reach length=2350 m; water velocity=1.5 m/s. t=L/v/60=26.1111 min. steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Net-inflow storage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 調蓄量由入出流歷線積分決定，教材研究下游高水位限制排放時的庫容消耗。調蓄設施以流入減流出的時間積分決定蓄水變化，最大入流量並不單獨決定所需庫容。下游高水位可能限制排水，水位與可用庫容也不是固定比例；需同時檢查初始蓄水、泵站可用性與洪水歷線的時序。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「淨入流調蓄量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Storage follows integrated inflow minus outflow; examine reserve depletion when downstream high water limits discharge. Storage change is the time integral of inflow minus outflow, so peak inflow alone cannot determine required capacity. High downstream levels can restrict discharge, and level is not always proportional to volume. Initial occupancy, pump availability and hydrograph timing must be assessed together rather than assuming the facility starts empty with unrestricted outflow. steps.title: 洪水歷線與調蓄餘量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Flood hydrographs and storage reserve: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「淨入流調蓄量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Net-inflow storage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：入流=173 m³/s；出流=100 m³/s；時間段=20 min。ΔV=(Qin−Qout)Δt×60=87600 m³。僅把入流增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為108360 m³。邊界：矩形歷線單一時段，真實洪水需逐時積分與水位約束；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: inflow=173 m³/s; outflow=100 m³/s; interval=20 min. ΔV=(Qin−Qout)Δt×60=87600 m³. Increasing only inflow by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 108360 m³. Boundary: One rectangular-hydrograph interval; real floods need time integration and level constraints. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：閉合水位庫容和逐時流量帳，保留初始蓄水。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Close level-volume and time-step flow balances with initial storage retained.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Increasing only inflow by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 108360 m³. Boundary: One rectangular-hydrograph interval; real floods need time integration and level constraints. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「洪水歷線與調蓄餘量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Flood hydrographs and storage reserve", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：入流=173 m³/s；出流=100 m³/s；時間段=20 min。
頂板平均彎矩不大就不必檢查柱頭沖切及基礎差異。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: inflow=173 m³/s; outflow=100 m³/s; interval=20 min. ΔV=(Qin−Qout)Δt×60=87600 m³.
Small mean roof bending eliminates column punching and differential foundation checks.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：入流=173 m³/s；出流=100 m³/s；時間段=20 min。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: inflow=173 m³/s; outflow=100 m³/s; interval=20 min. ΔV=(Qin−Qout)Δt×60=87600 m³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 洪水歷線與調蓄餘量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Flood hydrographs and storage reserve: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「淨入流調蓄量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Net-inflow storage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 閉合水位庫容和逐時流量帳，保留初始蓄水。將入出流歷線與水位庫容曲線閉合，測試不同初始水位和下游回水，檢查流量資料的時間間隔。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Close level-volume and time-step flow balances with initial storage retained. Close inflow-outflow hydrographs against the level-volume curve, test initial levels and downstream backwater and check sampling intervals. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「淨入流調蓄量」的交付需回答：閉合水位庫容和逐時流量帳，保留初始蓄水。交付可重算的逐時水量帳，標記起始水位、泵狀態與邊界洪水；控制決策依核准模型和即時量測而非單段算式。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel, the net-inflow storage handover must address the following evidence: Close level-volume and time-step flow balances with initial storage retained. Deliver a reproducible time-step balance with initial level, pump state and boundary flood; control decisions use approved models and observations, not one interval.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：假設設施全空且泵始終滿流會低估最高水位。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Assuming empty storage and full pumping throughout understates maximum level. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

Deliver a reproducible time-step balance with initial level, pump state and boundary flood; control decisions use approved models and observations, not one interval.

quiz.question: 要驗證「洪水歷線與調蓄餘量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Flood hydrographs and storage reserve"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
閉合水位庫容和逐時流量帳，保留初始蓄水。
設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Close level-volume and time-step flow balances with initial storage retained.
Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
quiz.explanation: 閉合水位庫容和逐時流量帳，保留初始蓄水。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Close level-volume and time-step flow balances with initial storage retained. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 洪水歷線與調蓄餘量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Flood hydrographs and storage reserve: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「淨入流調蓄量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Net-inflow storage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 假設設施全空且泵始終滿流會低估最高水位。以日平均流量代替短時洪峰會低估最高水位，泵可用卻無法克服下游水頭也會造成錯誤出流假設。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Assuming empty storage and full pumping throughout understates maximum level. Daily mean flow misses short peaks and underestimates maximum level; an available pump may still fail to discharge against the downstream head. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：下游高水位可能限制排水，水位與可用庫容也不是固定比例；需同時檢查初始蓄水、泵站可用性與洪水歷線的時序。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Initial occupancy, pump availability and hydrograph timing must be assessed together rather than assuming the facility starts empty with unrestricted outflow.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「泵站名目排水量大於平均入流就不需要調蓄容積。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Nominal pumping above mean inflow eliminates the need for storage." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 假設設施全空且泵始終滿流會低估最高水位。以日平均流量代替短時洪峰會低估最高水位，泵可用卻無法克服下游水頭也會造成錯誤出流假設。
knowledge.textEn: Assuming empty storage and full pumping throughout understates maximum level. Daily mean flow misses short peaks and underestimates maximum level; an available pump may still fail to discharge against the downstream head.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「洪水歷線與調蓄餘量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Flood hydrographs and storage reserve" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只算穩態流量就能排除輸水隧道的水錘與氣囊。
假設設施全空且泵始終滿流會低估最高水位。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A steady-flow calculation excludes water hammer and trapped air in a conveyance tunnel.
Assuming empty storage and full pumping throughout understates maximum level.
quiz.explanation: 假設設施全空且泵始終滿流會低估最高水位。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Assuming empty storage and full pumping throughout understates maximum level. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「輸水摩阻與瞬變邊界」與「豎井跌水與能量消散」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Conveyance friction and transient boundaries" and "Drop-shaft flow and energy dissipation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 輸水摩阻與瞬變邊界：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Conveyance friction and transient boundaries: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「滿管沿程損失」如何影響首都圈外郭放水路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Full-pipe friction loss” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 地下水路的摩阻算例限穩態滿管，教材另外辨認自由水面、回水和局部收縮可能改變流況。輸水隧道由上下游能量差驅動，沿程粗糙度、接頭及局部收縮消耗水頭；流速增加使摩阻快速上升。穩態滿管式不能描述水錘、自由水面轉換或氣囊，閘門動作和停機歷程必須另外建立瞬變模型與通氣條件。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「滿管沿程損失」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The friction example is steady and full-pipe; identify free surfaces, backwater and contractions that can change the flow regime. A conveyance tunnel is driven by upstream and downstream energy levels; roughness, joints and contractions consume head, with friction rising rapidly with velocity. A steady full-pipe equation does not describe water hammer, free-surface transitions or trapped air. Gate movements and shutdown histories require separate transient modelling and explicit ventilation conditions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Full-pipe friction loss” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：達西因子=0.02 無因次；長度=2150 m；直徑=4 m；流速=2 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.02 dimensionless; length=2150 m; diameter=4 m; velocity=2 m/s. hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g), g=9.81 m/s²=2.19164 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只算穩態流量就能排除輸水隧道的水錘與氣囊。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A steady-flow calculation excludes water hammer and trapped air in a conveyance tunnel." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「滿管沿程損失」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Full-pipe friction loss”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 輸水摩阻與瞬變邊界
knowledge.text: 地下水路的摩阻算例限穩態滿管，教材另外辨認自由水面、回水和局部收縮可能改變流況。輸水隧道由上下游能量差驅動，沿程粗糙度、接頭及局部收縮消耗水頭；流速增加使摩阻快速上升。
knowledge.textEn: The friction example is steady and full-pipe; identify free surfaces, backwater and contractions that can change the flow regime. A conveyance tunnel is driven by upstream and downstream energy levels; roughness, joints and contractions consume head, with friction rising rapidly with velocity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只算穩態流量就能排除輸水隧道的水錘與氣囊。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A steady-flow calculation excludes water hammer and trapped air in a conveyance tunnel. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「輸水摩阻與瞬變邊界」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Conveyance friction and transient boundaries" is correct?
options: 地下水路的摩阻算例限穩態滿管，教材另外辨認自由水面、回水和局部收縮可能改變流況。
只算穩態流量就能排除輸水隧道的水錘與氣囊。
跌水位能功率可直接當作豎井壁的均勻壓力。
optionsEn: The friction example is steady and full-pipe; identify free surfaces, backwater and contractions that can change the flow regime.
A steady-flow calculation excludes water hammer and trapped air in a conveyance tunnel.
Drop potential-energy power can be used directly as uniform shaft-wall pressure.
quiz.explanation: 地下水路的摩阻算例限穩態滿管，教材另外辨認自由水面、回水和局部收縮可能改變流況。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The friction example is steady and full-pipe; identify free surfaces, backwater and contractions that can change the flow regime. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 輸水摩阻與瞬變邊界：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Conveyance friction and transient boundaries: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「滿管沿程損失」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Full-pipe friction loss” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以同步水位和流量辨認滿管及非滿管狀態。以同步上下游水位和流量核對能量坡度，分辨入口損失與沿程損失，保留閘門及氣壓狀態。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use simultaneous levels and flow to distinguish pressurised and free-surface states. Use synchronised levels and flow to check energy gradient, separate entrance from distributed losses and preserve gate and air-pressure states. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「滿管沿程損失」的交付需回答：以同步水位和流量辨認滿管及非滿管狀態。水理交付需包含水位基準、流量、閘門歷程及模型適用狀態；瞬變與通氣由水理設計者另行檢核。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel, the full-pipe friction loss handover must address the following evidence: Use simultaneous levels and flow to distinguish pressurised and free-surface states. Hydraulic handover includes level datum, flow, gate histories and model regimes; specialists independently assess transients and air movement.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：在非滿管時套滿管直徑會得到無物理邊界的損失。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using full-pipe geometry in free-surface flow gives an inapplicable loss estimate. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 輸水摩阻與瞬變邊界：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Conveyance friction and transient boundaries: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「滿管沿程損失」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Full-pipe friction loss” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 在非滿管時套滿管直徑會得到無物理邊界的損失。把閘門急動後的壓力峰當穩態摩阻，會錯估粗糙度並漏掉瞬變作用；未排出的氣囊也會改變有效斷面。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using full-pipe geometry in free-surface flow gives an inapplicable loss estimate. Treating post-gate pressure peaks as steady friction biases roughness and misses transients; trapped air also changes effective area. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：穩態滿管式不能描述水錘、自由水面轉換或氣囊，閘門動作和停機歷程必須另外建立瞬變模型與通氣條件。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Gate movements and shutdown histories require separate transient modelling and explicit ventilation conditions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只算穩態流量就能排除輸水隧道的水錘與氣囊。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A steady-flow calculation excludes water hammer and trapped air in a conveyance tunnel." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 在非滿管時套滿管直徑會得到無物理邊界的損失。把閘門急動後的壓力峰當穩態摩阻，會錯估粗糙度並漏掉瞬變作用；未排出的氣囊也會改變有效斷面。
knowledge.textEn: Using full-pipe geometry in free-surface flow gives an inapplicable loss estimate. Treating post-gate pressure peaks as steady friction biases roughness and misses transients; trapped air also changes effective area.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「輸水摩阻與瞬變邊界」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

optionsEn: Using full-pipe geometry in free-surface flow gives an inapplicable loss estimate.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Drop potential-energy power can be used directly as uniform shaft-wall pressure.

steps.title: 豎井跌水與能量消散：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Drop-shaft flow and energy dissipation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「跌水位能通量」如何影響首都圈外郭放水路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Drop potential-energy flux” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 入流豎井把高程能轉成紊流和壓力，教材算位能通量而不是提升機功率或井壁均壓。水流進入豎井時把高程能轉成速度、紊流與壓力波動，空氣捲入和排氣路徑會改變流況。位能通量只能估計需處理的能量量級，不能由此直接求井壁衝擊壓；進流偏心、淹沒與下游回水需實體或數值水理驗證。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「跌水位能通量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Inlet shafts convert elevation energy into turbulence and pressure; calculate potential-energy flux rather than hoist power or uniform wall pressure. Flow entering a shaft converts elevation energy into velocity, turbulence and fluctuating pressure, while entrainment and ventilation change the regime. Potential-energy flux estimates the scale to be dissipated but cannot directly give wall impact pressure. Eccentric entry, submergence and downstream backwater require physical or numerical hydraulic validation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Drop potential-energy flux” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；流量=20 m³/s；跌水高度=30 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; flow=20 m³/s; drop=30 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「跌水位能功率可直接當作豎井壁的均勻壓力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Drop potential-energy power can be used directly as uniform shaft-wall pressure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「跌水位能通量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Drop potential-energy flux”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Flow entering a shaft converts elevation energy into velocity, turbulence and fluctuating pressure, while entrainment and ventilation change the regime.

knowledge.text: 誤解：跌水位能功率可直接當作豎井壁的均勻壓力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

optionsEn: Drop potential-energy power can be used directly as uniform shaft-wall pressure.
Inlet shafts convert elevation energy into turbulence and pressure; calculate potential-energy flux rather than hoist power or uniform wall pressure.
Small mean roof bending eliminates column punching and differential foundation checks.

steps.title: 豎井跌水與能量消散：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Drop-shaft flow and energy dissipation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「跌水位能通量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Drop potential-energy flux” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；流量=20 m³/s；跌水高度=30 m。P=ρgQH/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=5886 kW。僅把流量增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為6474.6 kW。邊界：位能通量，不是井壁壓力或發電輸出；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; flow=20 m³/s; drop=30 m. P=ρgQH/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=5886 kW. Increasing only flow by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 6474.6 kW. Boundary: Potential-energy flux, not shaft-wall pressure or electrical output. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步量測跌水流量、氣壓和局部壓力脈動。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronise drop flow, air pressure and local pressure fluctuations.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 同步量測跌水流量、氣壓和局部壓力脈動。同步量測進出流、水位、井內氣壓和局部壓力脈動，比較淹沒前後工況並檢查取樣頻率。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Deliver energy balance, local-pressure and ventilation models separately; check liquid and air boundaries at regime changes rather than substituting hoist-power calculations.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：平均功率不能直接推出井壁最大衝擊壓。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

quiz.question: 要驗證「豎井跌水與能量消散」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 豎井跌水與能量消散：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Drop-shaft flow and energy dissipation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「跌水位能通量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Drop potential-energy flux” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 平均功率不能直接推出井壁最大衝擊壓。忽略氣路阻塞會低估水位及壓力波動，僅用平均能量可能掩蓋局部衝擊和間歇流。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mean power cannot directly yield peak wall impact pressure. Ignoring a blocked air path underestimates level and pressure fluctuations; average energy can conceal local impact and intermittent flow. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：位能通量只能估計需處理的能量量級，不能由此直接求井壁衝擊壓；進流偏心、淹沒與下游回水需實體或數值水理驗證。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Eccentric entry, submergence and downstream backwater require physical or numerical hydraulic validation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「跌水位能功率可直接當作豎井壁的均勻壓力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Drop potential-energy power can be used directly as uniform shaft-wall pressure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 平均功率不能直接推出井壁最大衝擊壓。忽略氣路阻塞會低估水位及壓力波動，僅用平均能量可能掩蓋局部衝擊和間歇流。
knowledge.textEn: Mean power cannot directly yield peak wall impact pressure. Ignoring a blocked air path underestimates level and pressure fluctuations; average energy can conceal local impact and intermittent flow.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「豎井跌水與能量消散」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Drop-shaft flow and energy dissipation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
平均功率不能直接推出井壁最大衝擊壓。
頂板平均彎矩不大就不必檢查柱頭沖切及基礎差異。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Mean power cannot directly yield peak wall impact pressure.
Small mean roof bending eliminates column punching and differential foundation checks.
quiz.explanation: 平均功率不能直接推出井壁最大衝擊壓。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Mean power cannot directly yield peak wall impact pressure. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「地下大廳頂板與支承」與「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Underground hall roofs and supports" and "Piezometric head and lining pressure": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 地下大廳頂板與支承：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Underground hall roofs and supports: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「頂板荷載傳遞」如何影響首都圈外郭放水路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Roof load transfer” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 調壓大廳頂板經柱網傳力，教材條帶彎矩不取代整體框架、柱頭沖切和底板抗浮。大型地下調壓或蓄水大廳的頂板把覆土和自身重量傳到柱牆，再傳給基礎；水壓改變時底板與頂板的作用也不同。單向條帶只是局部彎矩示例，柱網、沖切、框架拘束、基礎變形及施工回填順序都需要整體模型。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「頂板荷載傳遞」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The pressure-control hall roof transfers load through columns; strip bending does not replace global, punching or flotation checks. A large underground pressure-control or storage hall transfers overburden and self-weight through its roof into columns, walls and foundations. Changing water pressure affects roof and base differently. A one-way strip illustrates local bending only; column layout, punching, frame restraint, foundation movement and backfilling sequence require a global structural model. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Roof load transfer” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：單位長載重=43 kN/m；跨距=3.6 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: line load=43 kN/m; span=3.6 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「頂板平均彎矩不大就不必檢查柱頭沖切及基礎差異。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Small mean roof bending eliminates column punching and differential foundation checks." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「頂板荷載傳遞」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Roof load transfer”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 地下大廳頂板與支承
knowledge.text: 調壓大廳頂板經柱網傳力，教材條帶彎矩不取代整體框架、柱頭沖切和底板抗浮。大型地下調壓或蓄水大廳的頂板把覆土和自身重量傳到柱牆，再傳給基礎；水壓改變時底板與頂板的作用也不同。
knowledge.textEn: The pressure-control hall roof transfers load through columns; strip bending does not replace global, punching or flotation checks. A large underground pressure-control or storage hall transfers overburden and self-weight through its roof into columns, walls and foundations.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：頂板平均彎矩不大就不必檢查柱頭沖切及基礎差異。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Small mean roof bending eliminates column punching and differential foundation checks. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「地下大廳頂板與支承」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Underground hall roofs and supports" is correct?
options: 頂板平均彎矩不大就不必檢查柱頭沖切及基礎差異。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。

optionsEn: Small mean roof bending eliminates column punching and differential foundation checks.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
The pressure-control hall roof transfers load through columns; strip bending does not replace global, punching or flotation checks.

steps.title: 地下大廳頂板與支承：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Underground hall roofs and supports: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「頂板荷載傳遞」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Roof load transfer” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：單位長載重=43 kN/m；跨距=3.6 m。M=qL²/8=69.66 kN·m。僅把跨距增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為84.2886 kN·m。邊界：均載簡支單向條帶，連續框架及板效應另驗；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: line load=43 kN/m; span=3.6 m. M=qL²/8=69.66 kN·m. Increasing only span by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 84.2886 kN·m. Boundary: Uniformly loaded simply supported strip; frame continuity and plate action need separate checks. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對柱網、回填、板撓度與柱軸力。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check column layout, backfill, slab deflection and column force.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：單位長載重=43 kN/m；跨距=3.6 m。M=qL²/8=69.66 kN·m。僅把跨距增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為84.2886 kN·m。邊界：均載簡支單向條帶，連續框架及板效應另驗；不是本工程實測或允收值。

Boundary: Uniformly loaded simply supported strip; frame continuity and plate action need separate checks. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「地下大廳頂板與支承」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

多支水位計讀值相同就能排除共同零點偏差。

Label the strip calculation as local and list global frame, punching and flotation evidence separately, reconciling loads for each construction and water-level stage.

Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.text: 本案「頂板荷載傳遞」的交付需回答：核對柱網、回填、板撓度與柱軸力。將條帶計算標為局部示範，另列整體框架、沖切和抗浮的證據需求，施工與水位階段各自核對荷載。

quiz.question: 要驗證「地下大廳頂板與支承」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 地下大廳頂板與支承：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「頂板荷載傳遞」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Roof load transfer” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 頂板均載模型不能用來宣稱整個大廳抗浮穩定。漏掉局部柱頭作用會在平均彎矩不大時仍低估沖切風險，差異沉陷則可能把荷載重新分配到少數支承。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「測壓水頭」如何影響首都圈外郭放水路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Piezometric head” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 地下水位與內部洪水位可分別變動，教材將放空時外壓和充水時淨內壓分開。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「測壓水頭」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Groundwater and internal flood level vary independently; distinguish external pressure when empty from net internal pressure when filled. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level. Drainage reduces pressure but can increase effective stress and settlement. Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Piezometric head” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=127 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=127 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1245.87 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「測壓水頭」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Piezometric head”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「測壓水頭」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Piezometric head” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=127 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1245.87 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1370.46 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=127 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1245.87 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1370.46 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將兩側水位換成共同高程和表壓後比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Convert both sides to common elevation and gauge pressure before comparison.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=127 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1245.87 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1370.46 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。

Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：試驗與驗證

steps.instruction: 將兩側水位換成共同高程和表壓後比較。使用分層測壓管及流量計，配合降雨或潮位序列分辨補注與設備影響，將讀值統一換算至同一高程基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Convert both sides to common elevation and gauge pressure before comparison. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
