stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「環向受力與接縫柔度」與「水位基準與庫容誤差」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ring force and joint flexibility" and "Level datum and volume uncertainty": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ring force and joint flexibility: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「襯砌環向壓縮」如何影響首都圈外郭放水路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lining hoop compression” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 圓形地下水路的外壓與內壓方向不同，教材均勻環向量級需要按每個水位階段改變淨壓。圓形襯砌對均勻外壓可主要以環向壓縮抵抗，但接頭轉動、偏壓與背填空隙會引起彎矩。薄環膜應力只說明其中一條受力路徑；脫模、運輸、頂推及永久狀態的荷載不同，環片局部接觸與止水條件必須另外檢核。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「襯砌環向壓縮」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: External and internal pressures act oppositely on the circular waterway; update net pressure by water-level stage. A circular lining resists uniform external pressure largely through hoop compression, but joint rotation, uneven load and backfill voids generate bending. Thin-ring membrane stress describes only one load path. Demoulding, transport, jacking and permanent states impose different actions, requiring separate checks of local segment contact and sealing rather than one permanent-load calculation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Lining hoop compression” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.76 MPa；半徑=3.6 m；厚度=0.35 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.76 MPa; radius=3.6 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=7.81714 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「襯砌環向壓縮」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Lining hoop compression”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度
knowledge.text: 圓形地下水路的外壓與內壓方向不同，教材均勻環向量級需要按每個水位階段改變淨壓。圓形襯砌對均勻外壓可主要以環向壓縮抵抗，但接頭轉動、偏壓與背填空隙會引起彎矩。
knowledge.textEn: External and internal pressures act oppositely on the circular waterway; update net pressure by water-level stage. A circular lining resists uniform external pressure largely through hoop compression, but joint rotation, uneven load and backfill voids generate bending.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「環向受力與接縫柔度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ring force and joint flexibility" is correct?
options: 混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
圓形地下水路的外壓與內壓方向不同，教材均勻環向量級需要按每個水位階段改變淨壓。
多支水位計讀值相同就能排除共同零點偏差。
optionsEn: Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
External and internal pressures act oppositely on the circular waterway; update net pressure by water-level stage.
Matching readings from multiple sensors exclude a shared zero-point bias.
quiz.explanation: 圓形地下水路的外壓與內壓方向不同，教材均勻環向量級需要按每個水位階段改變淨壓。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: External and internal pressures act oppositely on the circular waterway; update net pressure by water-level stage. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ring force and joint flexibility: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「襯砌環向壓縮」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lining hoop compression” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.76 MPa；半徑=3.6 m；厚度=0.35 m。σθ=pr/t=7.81714 MPa。僅把均勻外壓增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為8.59886 MPa。邊界：薄圓環膜應力，不是接縫、偏壓或矩形框架解；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.76 MPa; radius=3.6 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=7.81714 MPa. Increasing only uniform external pressure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 8.59886 MPa. Boundary: Thin circular-ring membrane stress, not a joint, uneven-load or rectangular-frame solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較環形變形與內外水位，而非僅單側壓力。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare ring distortion with both water levels, not one-sided pressure alone.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.76 MPa；半徑=3.6 m；厚度=0.35 m。σθ=pr/t=7.81714 MPa。僅把均勻外壓增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為8.59886 MPa。邊界：薄圓環膜應力，不是接縫、偏壓或矩形框架解；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.76 MPa; radius=3.6 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=7.81714 MPa. Increasing only uniform external pressure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 8.59886 MPa. Boundary: Thin circular-ring membrane stress, not a joint, uneven-load or rectangular-frame solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「環向受力與接縫柔度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ring force and joint flexibility", which statement holds?
options: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
泵站名目排水量大於平均入流就不需要調蓄容積。
原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.76 MPa；半徑=3.6 m；厚度=0.35 m。
optionsEn: Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
Nominal pumping above mean inflow eliminates the need for storage.
Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.76 MPa; radius=3.6 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=7.81714 MPa.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.76 MPa；半徑=3.6 m；厚度=0.35 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.76 MPa; radius=3.6 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=7.81714 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ring force and joint flexibility: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「襯砌環向壓縮」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lining hoop compression” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較環形變形與內外水位，而非僅單側壓力。將環形變形、接縫張開與應變和含接頭彈簧的模型比較，分開安裝後、背填後及水頭回升後的基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare ring distortion with both water levels, not one-sided pressure alone. Compare ring distortion, joint opening and strain with a joint-spring model, separating baselines after installation, grouting and head recovery. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「襯砌環向壓縮」的交付需回答：比較環形變形與內外水位，而非僅單側壓力。設計圖應分開標註各施工階段、接頭剛度及背填條件，構件驗收同時核對幾何、材料批次與止水試驗適用包絡。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel, the lining hoop compression handover must address the following evidence: Compare ring distortion with both water levels, not one-sided pressure alone. Drawings distinguish stages, joint stiffness and backfill conditions; component acceptance reconciles geometry, material batches and the applicable sealing-test envelope.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略放空後外壓回升會低估外壓主導階段。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitting external-head recovery after draining understates the external-pressure stage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較環形變形與內外水位，而非僅單側壓力。將環形變形、接縫張開與應變和含接頭彈簧的模型比較，分開安裝後、背填後及水頭回升後的基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Compare ring distortion with both water levels, not one-sided pressure alone. Compare ring distortion, joint opening and strain with a joint-spring model, separating baselines after installation, grouting and head recovery. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「襯砌環向壓縮」的交付需回答：比較環形變形與內外水位，而非僅單側壓力。設計圖應分開標註各施工階段、接頭剛度及背填條件，構件驗收同時核對幾何、材料批次與止水試驗適用包絡。
knowledge.textEn: For Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel, the lining hoop compression handover must address the following evidence: Compare ring distortion with both water levels, not one-sided pressure alone. Drawings distinguish stages, joint stiffness and backfill conditions; component acceptance reconciles geometry, material batches and the applicable sealing-test envelope.

quiz.question: 要驗證「環向受力與接縫柔度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ring force and joint flexibility"?
options: 比較環形變形與內外水位，而非僅單側壓力。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
跌水位能功率可直接當作豎井壁的均勻壓力。
optionsEn: Compare ring distortion with both water levels, not one-sided pressure alone.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Drop potential-energy power can be used directly as uniform shaft-wall pressure.
quiz.explanation: 比較環形變形與內外水位，而非僅單側壓力。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare ring distortion with both water levels, not one-sided pressure alone. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ring force and joint flexibility: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「襯砌環向壓縮」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lining hoop compression” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略放空後外壓回升會低估外壓主導階段。局部脫空增加環片彎曲，裂縫未必代表混凝土平均強度不足；忽略接縫接觸會把補強方向導向錯誤位置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitting external-head recovery after draining understates the external-pressure stage. Local voids increase bending, so cracks need not indicate inadequate mean concrete strength; neglecting joint contact can misdirect strengthening. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：薄環膜應力只說明其中一條受力路徑；脫模、運輸、頂推及永久狀態的荷載不同，環片局部接觸與止水條件必須另外檢核。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Demoulding, transport, jacking and permanent states impose different actions, requiring separate checks of local segment contact and sealing rather than one permanent-load calculation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忽略放空後外壓回升會低估外壓主導階段。局部脫空增加環片彎曲，裂縫未必代表混凝土平均強度不足；忽略接縫接觸會把補強方向導向錯誤位置。
knowledge.textEn: Omitting external-head recovery after draining understates the external-pressure stage. Local voids increase bending, so cracks need not indicate inadequate mean concrete strength; neglecting joint contact can misdirect strengthening.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「環向受力與接縫柔度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ring force and joint flexibility" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
忽略放空後外壓回升會低估外壓主導階段。
多支水位計讀值相同就能排除共同零點偏差。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Omitting external-head recovery after draining understates the external-pressure stage.
Matching readings from multiple sensors exclude a shared zero-point bias.
quiz.explanation: 忽略放空後外壓回升會低估外壓主導階段。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Omitting external-head recovery after draining understates the external-pressure stage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 水位基準與庫容誤差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Level datum and volume uncertainty: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水位零點偏差」如何影響首都圈外郭放水路的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Level zero-point bias” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 控制系統把水位轉成剩餘庫容，教材研究共同零點偏移如何讓多感測器一致卻錯估餘量。調蓄控制依賴水位訊號，但壓力式水位計還受氣壓、密度與安裝高程影響。水位誤差乘局部面積可估計一階庫容偏差；若斷面變寬或分艙逐次連通，必須使用完整水位庫容曲線，而非假設全程固定面積。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水位零點偏差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Controls convert level to reserve volume; examine a shared zero bias that makes sensors agree while misestimating capacity. Storage control depends on level signals, but pressure-based sensors are affected by air pressure, density and installation elevation. Level error times local area estimates first-order volume bias. Widening sections and sequentially connected compartments require the full level-volume relation rather than a constant area across the operating range. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Level zero-point bias” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：局部平面面積=3000 m²；水位零點偏移=0.025 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: local plan area=3000 m²; level zero offset=0.025 m. ΔV=AΔh=75 m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「多支水位計讀值相同就能排除共同零點偏差。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Matching readings from multiple sensors exclude a shared zero-point bias." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水位零點偏差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Level zero-point bias”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 水位基準與庫容誤差
knowledge.text: 控制系統把水位轉成剩餘庫容，教材研究共同零點偏移如何讓多感測器一致卻錯估餘量。調蓄控制依賴水位訊號，但壓力式水位計還受氣壓、密度與安裝高程影響。
knowledge.textEn: Controls convert level to reserve volume; examine a shared zero bias that makes sensors agree while misestimating capacity. Storage control depends on level signals, but pressure-based sensors are affected by air pressure, density and installation elevation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：多支水位計讀值相同就能排除共同零點偏差。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Matching readings from multiple sensors exclude a shared zero-point bias. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「水位基準與庫容誤差」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 水位基準與庫容誤差：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水位零點偏差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Level zero-point bias” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：局部平面面積=3000 m²；水位零點偏移=0.025 m。ΔV=AΔh=75 m³。僅把水位零點偏移增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為82.5 m³。邊界：局部等面積一階庫容誤差，變寬及分艙另計；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: local plan area=3000 m²; level zero offset=0.025 m. ΔV=AΔh=75 m³. Increasing only level zero offset by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 82.5 m³. Boundary: First-order constant-area volume bias; varying width and compartments are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以獨立水準和人工水尺核對零點及庫容表。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check zero and volume tables against independent levelling and a staff gauge.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Boundary: First-order constant-area volume bias; varying width and compartments are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

quiz.question: 依「水位基準與庫容誤差」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

Material travel time necessarily equals flood-peak arrival time.
A steady-flow calculation excludes water hammer and trapped air in a conveyance tunnel.

steps.title: 水位基準與庫容誤差：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水位零點偏差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Level zero-point bias” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以獨立水準和人工水尺核對零點及庫容表。用獨立水準點和人工水尺覆核感測器零點，逐一核對氣壓補償與不同水位的庫容曲線。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check zero and volume tables against independent levelling and a staff gauge. Check sensor zero against independent benchmarks and a staff gauge, verifying air-pressure compensation and the volume relation at several levels. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「水位零點偏差」的交付需回答：以獨立水準和人工水尺核對零點及庫容表。庫容表與水位計使用同一經覆核的高程版本，感測器更換後重驗轉換和警報邏輯，保留原始讀值。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel, the level zero-point bias handover must address the following evidence: Check zero and volume tables against independent levelling and a staff gauge. Use one checked datum revision for volume tables and sensors; after replacement verify conversions and alarm logic while preserving raw readings.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：多支同基準感測器不能互相排除共同高程錯誤。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sensors sharing one reference cannot eliminate a common elevation error by agreement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Level datum and volume uncertainty"?

steps.title: 水位基準與庫容誤差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Level datum and volume uncertainty: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水位零點偏差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Level zero-point bias” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 多支同基準感測器不能互相排除共同高程錯誤。多支感測器共用錯誤高程可互相比對一致，卻一致高估剩餘庫容，使控制系統遲判水位上升。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sensors sharing one reference cannot eliminate a common elevation error by agreement. Several sensors sharing a wrong datum can agree while overestimating remaining volume and delaying recognition of rising water. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：水位誤差乘局部面積可估計一階庫容偏差；若斷面變寬或分艙逐次連通，必須使用完整水位庫容曲線，而非假設全程固定面積。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Widening sections and sequentially connected compartments require the full level-volume relation rather than a constant area across the operating range.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「多支水位計讀值相同就能排除共同零點偏差。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Matching readings from multiple sensors exclude a shared zero-point bias." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「水位基準與庫容誤差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Level datum and volume uncertainty" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。
多支同基準感測器不能互相排除共同高程錯誤。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
Sensors sharing one reference cannot eliminate a common elevation error by agreement.

quiz.explanationEn: Sensors sharing one reference cannot eliminate a common elevation error by agreement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “System unavailability” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 防洪泵組可用性還取決於供電、出口水頭和共用設備，教材獨立並聯式只作下限模型。兩套設備只有在故障近似獨立且切換可靠時，並聯才顯著降低不可用率。共用配電、控制軟體、冷卻或受淹位置會把獨立假設破壞；維修停用也改變當下配置，因此可靠度模型必須明列共有資源和設備狀態，不能只數備用台數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「系統不可用率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Flood-pump availability also depends on power, discharge head and shared assets; the independent-parallel equation is only a restricted model. Parallel equipment sharply reduces unavailability only when failures are approximately independent and transfer works. Shared power, software, cooling or flood exposure breaks that assumption. Planned maintenance also changes the available configuration, so reliability models must identify shared resources and states rather than count spare units or multiply unsupported independent probabilities. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “System unavailability” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “System unavailability” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 追查每泵供電、閘門和共同出水路徑。由設備清單畫出故障樹，將電源、控制及實體位置追到共同節點，並用事件及維修紀錄檢查獨立假設。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Trace each pump feed, gate and shared discharge route. steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel, the system unavailability handover must address the following evidence: Trace each pump feed, gate and shared discharge route. Attach the actual configuration and remaining redundancy to maintenance plans, update fault trees after shared-resource changes, and witness transfer tests jointly.

steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Two healthy pumps may fail to achieve rated flow against the same high tailwater. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.title: 設備備援與共同失效：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Equipment redundancy and common failure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「系統不可用率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “System unavailability” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 兩泵正常仍可能因同一高下游水位無法達名目出流。重複安裝卻共用單一供電可能在一次故障中全部停機，帳面可靠度很高但實際不可用時間沒有降低。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Two healthy pumps may fail to achieve rated flow against the same high tailwater. Duplicated equipment on one supply can fail together in a single event, leaving actual downtime unchanged despite optimistic calculated reliability. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：共用配電、控制軟體、冷卻或受淹位置會把獨立假設破壞；維修停用也改變當下配置，因此可靠度模型必須明列共有資源和設備狀態，不能只數備用台數。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Planned maintenance also changes the available configuration, so reliability models must identify shared resources and states rather than count spare units or multiply unsupported independent probabilities.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Original teaching assumptions: asset count=123 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=86.9919 %.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：設備總數=123 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=123 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=86.9919 %. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「資產資料完整度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Asset-record completeness” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 從一次水位峰回查所有感測器時間與校正版本。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Trace one level peak through sensor timestamps and calibration revisions. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：從一次水位峰回查所有感測器時間與校正版本。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Trace one level peak through sensor timestamps and calibration revisions. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：時鐘錯位會把泵啟動先後顛倒，造成錯誤控制評估。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Clock offsets reverse apparent pump timing and distort control evaluation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 從一次水位峰回查所有感測器時間與校正版本。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Trace one level peak through sensor timestamps and calibration revisions. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：從一次水位峰回查所有感測器時間與校正版本。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。
knowledge.textEn: For Metropolitan Area Outer Underground Discharge Channel, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Trace one level peak through sensor timestamps and calibration revisions. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.

quiz.question: 要驗證「資產編碼與可追溯交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Asset identity and traceable handover"?
options: 從一次水位峰回查所有感測器時間與校正版本。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。
optionsEn: Trace one level peak through sensor timestamps and calibration revisions.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
quiz.explanation: 從一次水位峰回查所有感測器時間與校正版本。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Trace one level peak through sensor timestamps and calibration revisions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「資產資料完整度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Asset-record completeness” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 時鐘錯位會把泵啟動先後顛倒，造成錯誤控制評估。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Clock offsets reverse apparent pump timing and distort control evaluation. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 時鐘錯位會把泵啟動先後顛倒，造成錯誤控制評估。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。
knowledge.textEn: Clock offsets reverse apparent pump timing and distort control evaluation. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「資產編碼與可追溯交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Asset identity and traceable handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
時鐘錯位會把泵啟動先後顛倒，造成錯誤控制評估。
水體流過全程的時間必然等於洪峰抵達的時間。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Clock offsets reverse apparent pump timing and distort control evaluation.
Material travel time necessarily equals flood-peak arrival time.
quiz.explanation: 時鐘錯位會把泵啟動先後顛倒，造成錯誤控制評估。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Clock offsets reverse apparent pump timing and distort control evaluation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 新加坡裕廊岩洞
summary: JTC公開介紹裕廊岩洞可儲存147萬立方公尺液態碳氫產品，並將地下深度與海床下深度分開；2014年開幕有總理公署紀錄。本課從土地介面、岩體節理與支護開始，進入水力封存、產品庫存及監測交付。幾何面積、局部壓差和假想庫存都不等於實際土地效益或操作上限。
summaryEn: JTC describes 1.47 million cubic metres of liquid-hydrocarbon storage and distinguishes depth below ground from depth beneath the seabed; the PMO records the 2014 opening. The course moves from land interfaces and jointed rock to support, hydraulic containment, inventory and monitoring. Geometric area, local pressure difference and hypothetical inventory are not actual land savings or operating limits.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創綜合審查：先計算「岩洞節理楔體與錨固」，再獨立計算「水力封存與共同高程」。原創教學假設：岩塊體積=36 m³；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³；分擔構件數=6 個。T=γV/N=156 kN/anchor。僅把岩塊體積增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為171.6 kN/anchor。邊界：僅自重均分量級，未含節理滑移、錨角及設計係數；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：外側水密度=1000 kg/m³；外側水頭=40 m；產品密度=800 kg/m³；產品液柱=25 m；氣相表壓=20 kPa。Δp=(ρwghw−ρpghp)/1000−pgas, g=9.81 m/s²=176.2 kPa。僅把外側水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為215.44 kPa。邊界：同一高程假想靜壓差，正值只顯示局部向內梯度，不證明全洞室封存；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated review: first calculate cavern wedges and anchorage, then independently calculate hydraulic containment at a common datum. Original teaching assumptions: block volume=36 m³; unit weight=26 kN/m³; sharing anchors=6 count. T=γV/N=156 kN/anchor. Increasing only block volume by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 171.6 kN/anchor. Boundary: Equal self-weight sharing only, excluding sliding, anchor angle and design factors. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: external water density=1000 kg/m³; external head=40 m; product density=800 kg/m³; product head=25 m; gas gauge pressure=20 kPa. Δp=(ρwghw−ρpghp)/1000−pgas, g=9.81 m/s²=176.2 kPa. Increasing only external head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 215.44 kPa. Boundary: Hypothetical pressure difference at one elevation; positive means local inward gradient, not whole-cavern containment. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「地下儲存與地面介面」與「岩洞節理楔體與錨固」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Subsurface storage and surface interfaces" and "Cavern wedges and anchorage": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 地下儲存與地面介面：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Subsurface storage and surface interfaces: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「幾何等效面積」如何影響新加坡裕廊岩洞的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Geometric equivalent area” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jurong Rock Caverns”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 裕廊以地下儲存重新配置地面用途，教材容積除高度只算假想幾何面積，不重述為實際節省土地。地下儲存可以重新分配地面用途，但洞室幾何投影不等於實際釋出的土地。出入口、消防、產品管線、地面製程與維修空間仍占用土地；將容量換算成等效面積只是一個比較基準，須保持高度、利用率和附屬設施範圍一致。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「幾何等效面積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Jurong reallocates surface use through underground storage; volume divided by height gives a hypothetical geometric area, not actual land released. Underground storage changes how surface land is used, but cavern projection is not the actual land released. Access, firefighting, product pipelines, surface processing and maintenance still require space. Converting volume to an equivalent area provides a comparison metric only when height, utilisation and auxiliary-facility boundaries remain consistent. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Geometric equivalent area” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：儲存容積=100000 m³；等效高度=20 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: storage volume=100000 m³; equivalent height=20 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「地下容積除高度就是工程實際節省的地面土地。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Underground volume divided by height equals actual surface land saved." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「幾何等效面積」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Geometric equivalent area”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 地下儲存與地面介面
knowledge.text: 裕廊以地下儲存重新配置地面用途，教材容積除高度只算假想幾何面積，不重述為實際節省土地。地下儲存可以重新分配地面用途，但洞室幾何投影不等於實際釋出的土地。
knowledge.textEn: Jurong reallocates surface use through underground storage; volume divided by height gives a hypothetical geometric area, not actual land released. Underground storage changes how surface land is used, but cavern projection is not the actual land released.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：地下容積除高度就是工程實際節省的地面土地。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Underground volume divided by height equals actual surface land saved. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「地下儲存與地面介面」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Subsurface storage and surface interfaces" is correct?
options: 地下容積除高度就是工程實際節省的地面土地。
裕廊以地下儲存重新配置地面用途，教材容積除高度只算假想幾何面積，不重述為實際節省土地。
錨桿鋼材強度足夠就能排除岩洞楔體掉落。
optionsEn: Underground volume divided by height equals actual surface land saved.
Jurong reallocates surface use through underground storage; volume divided by height gives a hypothetical geometric area, not actual land released.
Adequate anchor steel strength excludes cavern wedge falls.
quiz.explanation: 裕廊以地下儲存重新配置地面用途，教材容積除高度只算假想幾何面積，不重述為實際節省土地。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Jurong reallocates surface use through underground storage; volume divided by height gives a hypothetical geometric area, not actual land released. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 地下儲存與地面介面：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Subsurface storage and surface interfaces: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「幾何等效面積」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Geometric equivalent area” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：儲存容積=100000 m³；等效高度=20 m。A=V/H=5000 m²。僅把等效高度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為4545.45 m²。邊界：假想等斷面平面面積，不是實際節省的地面土地；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: storage volume=100000 m³; equivalent height=20 m. A=V/H=5000 m². Increasing only equivalent height by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 4545.45 m². Boundary: Hypothetical uniform-section plan area, not actual surface land saving. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：總配置另列豎井、管線、消防及地面製程空間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The overall layout separately includes shafts, pipelines, firefighting and surface processing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：儲存容積=100000 m³；等效高度=20 m。A=V/H=5000 m²。僅把等效高度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為4545.45 m²。邊界：假想等斷面平面面積，不是實際節省的地面土地；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: storage volume=100000 m³; equivalent height=20 m. A=V/H=5000 m². Increasing only equivalent height by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 4545.45 m². Boundary: Hypothetical uniform-section plan area, not actual surface land saving. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界

steps.instruction: 總配置另列豎井、管線、消防及地面製程空間。把洞室、豎井與地面設施分層繪圖，核對容積與占地邊界，分別列幾何面積和實際可使用土地。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The overall layout separately includes shafts, pipelines, firefighting and surface processing. Map caverns, shafts and surface facilities separately, reconcile volume and footprint boundaries and distinguish geometric area from usable land. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Jurong Rock Caverns, the geometric equivalent area handover must address the following evidence: The overall layout separately includes shafts, pipelines, firefighting and surface processing. Fix function and auxiliary scope when comparing options, label geometric metrics as assumptions and assess land benefit from the full layout and operational requirements.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只算洞室投影會漏掉支援營運必需的地面設施。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Cavern projection alone omits surface facilities needed for operation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 地下儲存與地面介面：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Subsurface storage and surface interfaces: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「幾何等效面積」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Geometric equivalent area” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只算洞室投影會漏掉支援營運必需的地面設施。只用容積除高度宣稱節省土地會漏掉必要配套，可能低估地面通道、維修和消防的空間需求。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Cavern projection alone omits surface facilities needed for operation. Claiming land saving from volume divided by height omits essential facilities and understates access, maintenance and firefighting space. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：出入口、消防、產品管線、地面製程與維修空間仍占用土地；將容量換算成等效面積只是一個比較基準，須保持高度、利用率和附屬設施範圍一致。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Converting volume to an equivalent area provides a comparison metric only when height, utilisation and auxiliary-facility boundaries remain consistent.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「地下容積除高度就是工程實際節省的地面土地。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Underground volume divided by height equals actual surface land saved." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.textEn: Cavern projection alone omits surface facilities needed for operation. Claiming land saving from volume divided by height omits essential facilities and understates access, maintenance and firefighting space.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「地下儲存與地面介面」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Subsurface storage and surface interfaces" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
只算洞室投影會漏掉支援營運必需的地面設施。
錨桿鋼材強度足夠就能排除岩洞楔體掉落。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Cavern projection alone omits surface facilities needed for operation.
Adequate anchor steel strength excludes cavern wedge falls.
quiz.explanation: 只算洞室投影會漏掉支援營運必需的地面設施。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Cavern projection alone omits surface facilities needed for operation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 岩洞節理楔體與錨固：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cavern wedges and anchorage: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「楔體重力分擔」如何影響新加坡裕廊岩洞的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wedge self-weight sharing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jurong Rock Caverns”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 裕廊大跨洞室的局部楔體由節理交線控制，教材自重均分不代表所有錨桿實際同時受力。大跨岩洞的局部穩定常由節理交線形成的可動楔體控制，完整岩石強度高仍可能產生重力掉塊。均分重量只估計錨固受力量級，滑移方向、節理水壓、錨桿角度與黏結長度須另驗，不能假設所有構件同時等量受力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「楔體重力分擔」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Joint intersections control local wedges in wide caverns; equal weight sharing does not imply simultaneous equal anchor loading. Local stability of a wide cavern can be governed by removable wedges formed by joint intersections even when intact rock is strong. Equal weight sharing estimates anchorage force scale only. Sliding direction, joint pressure, anchor inclination and bond length require separate checks, and simultaneous equal mobilisation of every anchor cannot be assumed. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Wedge self-weight sharing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：岩塊體積=36 m³；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³；分擔構件數=6 個。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: block volume=36 m³; unit weight=26 kN/m³; sharing anchors=6 count.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「錨桿鋼材強度足夠就能排除岩洞楔體掉落。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adequate anchor steel strength excludes cavern wedge falls." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「楔體重力分擔」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Wedge self-weight sharing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 岩洞節理楔體與錨固
knowledge.text: 裕廊大跨洞室的局部楔體由節理交線控制，教材自重均分不代表所有錨桿實際同時受力。大跨岩洞的局部穩定常由節理交線形成的可動楔體控制，完整岩石強度高仍可能產生重力掉塊。
knowledge.textEn: Joint intersections control local wedges in wide caverns; equal weight sharing does not imply simultaneous equal anchor loading. Local stability of a wide cavern can be governed by removable wedges formed by joint intersections even when intact rock is strong.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：錨桿鋼材強度足夠就能排除岩洞楔體掉落。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adequate anchor steel strength excludes cavern wedge falls. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「岩洞節理楔體與錨固」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cavern wedges and anchorage" is correct?
options: 錨桿鋼材強度足夠就能排除岩洞楔體掉落。
知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。
裕廊大跨洞室的局部楔體由節理交線控制，教材自重均分不代表所有錨桿實際同時受力。
optionsEn: Adequate anchor steel strength excludes cavern wedge falls.
Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction.
Joint intersections control local wedges in wide caverns; equal weight sharing does not imply simultaneous equal anchor loading.
quiz.explanation: 裕廊大跨洞室的局部楔體由節理交線控制，教材自重均分不代表所有錨桿實際同時受力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Joint intersections control local wedges in wide caverns; equal weight sharing does not imply simultaneous equal anchor loading. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 岩洞節理楔體與錨固：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cavern wedges and anchorage: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「楔體重力分擔」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wedge self-weight sharing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：岩塊體積=36 m³；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³；分擔構件數=6 個。T=γV/N=156 kN/anchor。僅把岩塊體積增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為171.6 kN/anchor。邊界：僅自重均分量級，未含節理滑移、錨角及設計係數；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: block volume=36 m³; unit weight=26 kN/m³; sharing anchors=6 count. T=γV/N=156 kN/anchor. Increasing only block volume by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 171.6 kN/anchor. Boundary: Equal self-weight sharing only, excluding sliding, anchor angle and design factors. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以三維節理測繪及錨固試驗確認滑移方向和有效長度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use three-dimensional mapping and anchor tests to check sliding direction and effective length.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.
