steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Jurong Rock Caverns, the wedge self-weight sharing handover must address the following evidence: Use three-dimensional mapping and anchor tests to check sliding direction and effective length. Link anchorage drawings to the three-dimensional joint model, state test representativeness and uncertain persistence, and reassess mechanisms when geometry changes.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：錨桿穿過塊體但未超出滑面可能無法提供預期拘束。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An anchor that does not extend beyond the release surface cannot provide expected restraint. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以三維節理測繪及錨固試驗確認滑移方向和有效長度。由掌子面和洞頂節理測繪重建三維塊體，配合錨桿試驗與伸長量檢查受力方向和有效錨固區。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Use three-dimensional mapping and anchor tests to check sliding direction and effective length. Reconstruct three-dimensional blocks from face and roof mapping, combining anchor tests and extension measurements to check force direction and effective bonded zones. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「楔體重力分擔」的交付需回答：以三維節理測繪及錨固試驗確認滑移方向和有效長度。錨固圖與三維節理模型連結，標示試驗代表性及未知延伸，幾何改變後由岩力設計者重驗失穩模式。
knowledge.textEn: For Jurong Rock Caverns, the wedge self-weight sharing handover must address the following evidence: Use three-dimensional mapping and anchor tests to check sliding direction and effective length. Link anchorage drawings to the three-dimensional joint model, state test representativeness and uncertain persistence, and reassess mechanisms when geometry changes.

quiz.question: 要驗證「岩洞節理楔體與錨固」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cavern wedges and anchorage"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以三維節理測繪及錨固試驗確認滑移方向和有效長度。
施工後泉水變少就能單獨證明隧道造成全部減流。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Use three-dimensional mapping and anchor tests to check sliding direction and effective length.
Reduced spring flow after construction alone proves the tunnel caused the entire change.
quiz.explanation: 以三維節理測繪及錨固試驗確認滑移方向和有效長度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use three-dimensional mapping and anchor tests to check sliding direction and effective length. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 岩洞節理楔體與錨固：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cavern wedges and anchorage: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「楔體重力分擔」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Wedge self-weight sharing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 錨桿穿過塊體但未超出滑面可能無法提供預期拘束。節理延伸到錨固端後方可能使錨桿連同塊體移動，材料拉力試驗合格也不能證明岩體黏結可靠。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An anchor that does not extend beyond the release surface cannot provide expected restraint. A joint behind the bonded zone can let anchor and block move together; passing steel tension tests does not prove reliable rock bond. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：均分重量只估計錨固受力量級，滑移方向、節理水壓、錨桿角度與黏結長度須另驗，不能假設所有構件同時等量受力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Sliding direction, joint pressure, anchor inclination and bond length require separate checks, and simultaneous equal mobilisation of every anchor cannot be assumed.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「錨桿鋼材強度足夠就能排除岩洞楔體掉落。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adequate anchor steel strength excludes cavern wedge falls." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 錨桿穿過塊體但未超出滑面可能無法提供預期拘束。節理延伸到錨固端後方可能使錨桿連同塊體移動，材料拉力試驗合格也不能證明岩體黏結可靠。
knowledge.textEn: An anchor that does not extend beyond the release surface cannot provide expected restraint. A joint behind the bonded zone can let anchor and block move together; passing steel tension tests does not prove reliable rock bond.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「岩洞節理楔體與錨固」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cavern wedges and anchorage" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。
錨桿穿過塊體但未超出滑面可能無法提供預期拘束。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction.
An anchor that does not extend beyond the release surface cannot provide expected restraint.
quiz.explanation: 錨桿穿過塊體但未超出滑面可能無法提供預期拘束。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An anchor that does not extend beyond the release surface cannot provide expected restraint. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「覆土應力與洞壁重分配」與「支護啟動與變形容量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cover stress and wall redistribution" and "Support activation and deformation capacity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 覆土應力與洞壁重分配：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cover stress and wall redistribution: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「洞壁切向應力」如何影響新加坡裕廊岩洞的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tangential wall stress” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jurong Rock Caverns”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 洞室群互相影響岩柱和洞頂應力，教材圓孔彈性解只是量級，不能取代非圓大跨群洞模型。開挖使岩體洞壁失去徑向拘束，遠場荷載轉移到周圍岩體，局部切向應力可能升高。圓孔彈性解可辨識量級，但節理、非圓斷面、塑性區與原位應力比會改變峰值位置，不能只用覆土重量推定全部三維應力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「洞壁切向應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cavern groups interact through pillars and roofs; a circular-hole elastic solution is only a scale estimate, not a wide noncircular group model. Excavation removes radial confinement at the wall and transfers load through the surrounding rock, potentially raising local tangential stress. An elastic circular-hole solution identifies scale, but joints, noncircular geometry, yielding and the in-situ stress ratio alter the peak location. Cover weight alone cannot establish the complete three-dimensional stress state or support demand. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Tangential wall stress” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：覆土深度=120 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: cover=120 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=9.36 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「洞壁切向應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Tangential wall stress”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 覆土應力與洞壁重分配
knowledge.text: 洞室群互相影響岩柱和洞頂應力，教材圓孔彈性解只是量級，不能取代非圓大跨群洞模型。開挖使岩體洞壁失去徑向拘束，遠場荷載轉移到周圍岩體，局部切向應力可能升高。
knowledge.textEn: Cavern groups interact through pillars and roofs; a circular-hole elastic solution is only a scale estimate, not a wide noncircular group model. Excavation removes radial confinement at the wall and transfers load through the surrounding rock, potentially raising local tangential stress.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「覆土應力與洞壁重分配」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cover stress and wall redistribution" is correct?
options: 洞室群互相影響岩柱和洞頂應力，教材圓孔彈性解只是量級，不能取代非圓大跨群洞模型。
知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
optionsEn: Cavern groups interact through pillars and roofs; a circular-hole elastic solution is only a scale estimate, not a wide noncircular group model.
Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction.
Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
quiz.explanation: 洞室群互相影響岩柱和洞頂應力，教材圓孔彈性解只是量級，不能取代非圓大跨群洞模型。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Cavern groups interact through pillars and roofs; a circular-hole elastic solution is only a scale estimate, not a wide noncircular group model. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 覆土應力與洞壁重分配：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cover stress and wall redistribution: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「洞壁切向應力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tangential wall stress” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：覆土深度=120 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。σθ,max=3γH/1000=9.36 MPa。僅把覆土深度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為10.296 MPa。邊界：無支承彈性圓孔，僅垂直遠場壓縮且水平遠場應力為零時，側壁最大環向壓應力；不是任意位置應力或完整三維原位解；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: cover=120 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=9.36 MPa. Increasing only cover by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 10.296 MPa. Boundary: Maximum tangential compression at the sidewalls of an unsupported elastic circular hole under vertical uniaxial remote loading with zero horizontal remote stress; not stress at any point or the complete three-dimensional in-situ state. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較洞頂與岩柱位移方向，核對原位應力比。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare roof and pillar movement directions with in-situ stress ratio.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：覆土深度=120 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。σθ,max=3γH/1000=9.36 MPa。僅把覆土深度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為10.296 MPa。邊界：無支承彈性圓孔，僅垂直遠場壓縮且水平遠場應力為零時，側壁最大環向壓應力；不是任意位置應力或完整三維原位解；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: cover=120 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=9.36 MPa. Increasing only cover by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 10.296 MPa. Boundary: Maximum tangential compression at the sidewalls of an unsupported elastic circular hole under vertical uniaxial remote loading with zero horizontal remote stress; not stress at any point or the complete three-dimensional in-situ state. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「覆土應力與洞壁重分配」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cover stress and wall redistribution", which statement holds?
options: 一支測壓管的向內壓差為正就能證明全洞室封存。
原創教學假設：覆土深度=120 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
optionsEn: Positive inward pressure at one piezometer proves whole-cavern containment.
Original teaching assumptions: cover=120 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=9.36 MPa.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：覆土深度=120 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: cover=120 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=9.36 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 覆土應力與洞壁重分配：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cover stress and wall redistribution: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「洞壁切向應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tangential wall stress” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較洞頂與岩柱位移方向，核對原位應力比。將原位應力量測、岩石試驗及洞壁破壞方位相互比較，再用多點伸長計檢查變形是否與所假設應力方向一致。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare roof and pillar movement directions with in-situ stress ratio. Compare in-situ stress measurements, rock tests and wall-damage orientation, then use multipoint extensometers to test consistency with the assumed stress directions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「洞壁切向應力」的交付需回答：比較洞頂與岩柱位移方向，核對原位應力比。保留應力模型的座標、邊界和材料假設，量測與預測不符時先核對代表性，再由岩力設計者選擇非線性或節理模型。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Jurong Rock Caverns, the tangential wall stress handover must address the following evidence: Compare roof and pillar movement directions with in-situ stress ratio. Record stress-model coordinates, boundaries and material assumptions; when observations disagree, check representativeness before the rock designer selects nonlinear or jointed models.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把每洞視為孤立圓孔會漏掉岩柱荷載重分配。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating each cavern as an isolated circle omits pillar load redistribution. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較洞頂與岩柱位移方向，核對原位應力比。將原位應力量測、岩石試驗及洞壁破壞方位相互比較，再用多點伸長計檢查變形是否與所假設應力方向一致。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Compare roof and pillar movement directions with in-situ stress ratio. Compare in-situ stress measurements, rock tests and wall-damage orientation, then use multipoint extensometers to test consistency with the assumed stress directions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「洞壁切向應力」的交付需回答：比較洞頂與岩柱位移方向，核對原位應力比。保留應力模型的座標、邊界和材料假設，量測與預測不符時先核對代表性，再由岩力設計者選擇非線性或節理模型。
knowledge.textEn: For Jurong Rock Caverns, the tangential wall stress handover must address the following evidence: Compare roof and pillar movement directions with in-situ stress ratio. Record stress-model coordinates, boundaries and material assumptions; when observations disagree, check representativeness before the rock designer selects nonlinear or jointed models.

quiz.question: 要驗證「覆土應力與洞壁重分配」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cover stress and wall redistribution"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
比較洞頂與岩柱位移方向，核對原位應力比。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
Compare roof and pillar movement directions with in-situ stress ratio.
quiz.explanation: 比較洞頂與岩柱位移方向，核對原位應力比。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare roof and pillar movement directions with in-situ stress ratio. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 覆土應力與洞壁重分配：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cover stress and wall redistribution: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「洞壁切向應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tangential wall stress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把每洞視為孤立圓孔會漏掉岩柱荷載重分配。把彈性峰值直接當岩體強度可能誤判支護需求；相反地忽略剝落或擠壓也會讓局部破壞逐步侵入淨空。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating each cavern as an isolated circle omits pillar load redistribution. Equating an elastic peak with rock-mass strength misjudges support demand; overlooking spalling or squeezing lets damage progressively consume clearance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：圓孔彈性解可辨識量級，但節理、非圓斷面、塑性區與原位應力比會改變峰值位置，不能只用覆土重量推定全部三維應力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Cover weight alone cannot establish the complete three-dimensional stress state or support demand.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把每洞視為孤立圓孔會漏掉岩柱荷載重分配。把彈性峰值直接當岩體強度可能誤判支護需求；相反地忽略剝落或擠壓也會讓局部破壞逐步侵入淨空。
knowledge.textEn: Treating each cavern as an isolated circle omits pillar load redistribution. Equating an elastic peak with rock-mass strength misjudges support demand; overlooking spalling or squeezing lets damage progressively consume clearance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「覆土應力與洞壁重分配」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cover stress and wall redistribution" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把每洞視為孤立圓孔會漏掉岩柱荷載重分配。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
optionsEn: Treating each cavern as an isolated circle omits pillar load redistribution.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
quiz.explanation: 把每洞視為孤立圓孔會漏掉岩柱荷載重分配。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating each cavern as an isolated circle omits pillar load redistribution. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「支護安裝時點」如何影響新加坡裕廊岩洞的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Support activation time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jurong Rock Caverns”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大跨岩洞支護需隨分層開挖啟動，教材將洞頂先期支護和側壁後續釋放分開。支護荷載由開挖釋放量和支護啟動時間共同決定，越早安裝不一定讓構件受力越小。地盤反力與支護曲線必須連同掌子面距離及封閉順序理解；擠壓性地層還需保留變形容量，不能只追求高剛度與高材料強度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「支護安裝時點」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Support activates during staged cavern excavation; distinguish early roof support from later sidewall release. Support load depends on stress release and activation time, so earlier installation does not necessarily reduce member forces. Interpret ground-reaction and support curves together with distance from the face and closure sequence. Squeezing ground also needs deformation capacity; high stiffness and material strength alone do not guarantee a compatible support response. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Support activation time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：局部剛度=54 kN/mm；位移=8 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=54 kN/mm; movement=8 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「支護安裝時點」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Support activation time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 支護啟動與變形容量
knowledge.text: 大跨岩洞支護需隨分層開挖啟動，教材將洞頂先期支護和側壁後續釋放分開。支護荷載由開挖釋放量和支護啟動時間共同決定，越早安裝不一定讓構件受力越小。
knowledge.textEn: Support activates during staged cavern excavation; distinguish early roof support from later sidewall release. Support load depends on stress release and activation time, so earlier installation does not necessarily reduce member forces.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「支護啟動與變形容量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Support activation and deformation capacity" is correct?
options: 支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
大跨岩洞支護需隨分層開挖啟動，教材將洞頂先期支護和側壁後續釋放分開。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
optionsEn: Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
Support activates during staged cavern excavation; distinguish early roof support from later sidewall release.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
quiz.explanation: 大跨岩洞支護需隨分層開挖啟動，教材將洞頂先期支護和側壁後續釋放分開。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Support activates during staged cavern excavation; distinguish early roof support from later sidewall release. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「支護安裝時點」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Support activation time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：局部剛度=54 kN/mm；位移=8 mm。F=ku=432 kN。僅把位移增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為475.2 kN。邊界：線性局部彈簧，不含屈服或時間效應；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=54 kN/mm; movement=8 mm. F=ku=432 kN. Increasing only movement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 475.2 kN. Boundary: Local linear spring without yielding or time effects. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將各層開挖時間、錨荷重及伸長量同步記錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronise excavation stages, anchor loads and extension measurements.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：局部剛度=54 kN/mm；位移=8 mm。F=ku=432 kN。僅把位移增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為475.2 kN。邊界：線性局部彈簧，不含屈服或時間效應；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=54 kN/mm; movement=8 mm. F=ku=432 kN. Increasing only movement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 475.2 kN. Boundary: Local linear spring without yielding or time effects. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「支護啟動與變形容量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Support activation and deformation capacity", which statement holds?
options: 總幾何容積減目前液位體積就是所有狀態的裝填上限。
施工後泉水變少就能單獨證明隧道造成全部減流。
原創教學假設：局部剛度=54 kN/mm；位移=8 mm。
optionsEn: Gross volume minus current liquid volume is the filling limit under every condition.
Reduced spring flow after construction alone proves the tunnel caused the entire change.
Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=54 kN/mm; movement=8 mm.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：局部剛度=54 kN/mm；位移=8 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=54 kN/mm; movement=8 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 支護啟動與變形容量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Support activation and deformation capacity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「支護安裝時點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Support activation time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將各層開挖時間、錨荷重及伸長量同步記錄。同步記錄收斂、支護荷重與安裝里程，比較同一地質分區內的速率及荷載，不將不同開挖齡期讀值直接混合。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronise excavation stages, anchor loads and extension measurements. Synchronise convergence, support loads and installation chainage; compare rates and loads within one ground domain without mixing readings at different excavation ages. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「支護安裝時點」的交付需回答：將各層開挖時間、錨荷重及伸長量同步記錄。把安裝時間和量測資料一起交付支護設計者，任何級別變更都需地質及位移證據，不能憑單一瞬間讀值自行改支護。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Jurong Rock Caverns, the support activation time handover must address the following evidence: Synchronise excavation stages, anchor loads and extension measurements. Submit installation times with measurements to the support designer; class changes need both ground and movement evidence, not an isolated instantaneous reading.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：早期洞頂穩定不能證明後續下挖不會改變其受力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Early roof stability does not establish unchanged loads during subsequent benching. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將各層開挖時間、錨荷重及伸長量同步記錄。同步記錄收斂、支護荷重與安裝里程，比較同一地質分區內的速率及荷載，不將不同開挖齡期讀值直接混合。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。

Synchronise convergence, support loads and installation chainage; compare rates and loads within one ground domain without mixing readings at different excavation ages. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.text: 本案「支護安裝時點」的交付需回答：將各層開挖時間、錨荷重及伸長量同步記錄。把安裝時間和量測資料一起交付支護設計者，任何級別變更都需地質及位移證據，不能憑單一瞬間讀值自行改支護。

Submit installation times with measurements to the support designer; class changes need both ground and movement evidence, not an isolated instantaneous reading.

quiz.questionEn: When "Support activation and deformation capacity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
早期洞頂穩定不能證明後續下挖不會改變其受力。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Early roof stability does not establish unchanged loads during subsequent benching.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
quiz.explanation: 早期洞頂穩定不能證明後續下挖不會改變其受力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Early roof stability does not establish unchanged loads during subsequent benching. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」與「水力封存與共同高程」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Piezometric head and lining pressure" and "Hydraulic containment at a common datum": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「測壓水頭」如何影響新加坡裕廊岩洞的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Piezometric head” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jurong Rock Caverns”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 周圍地下水是儲存封存分析的重要邊界，裕廊教材區分施工降水與儲存期間所需水頭。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「測壓水頭」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Surrounding groundwater is a containment boundary; distinguish construction dewatering from heads needed during storage. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level. Drainage reduces pressure but can increase effective stress and settlement. Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Piezometric head” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=130 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=130 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1275.3 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「測壓水頭」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Piezometric head”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓
knowledge.text: 周圍地下水是儲存封存分析的重要邊界，裕廊教材區分施工降水與儲存期間所需水頭。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。
knowledge.textEn: Surrounding groundwater is a containment boundary; distinguish construction dewatering from heads needed during storage. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Piezometric head and lining pressure" is correct?
options: 目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
一支測壓管的向內壓差為正就能證明全洞室封存。
周圍地下水是儲存封存分析的重要邊界，裕廊教材區分施工降水與儲存期間所需水頭。
optionsEn: No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Positive inward pressure at one piezometer proves whole-cavern containment.
Surrounding groundwater is a containment boundary; distinguish construction dewatering from heads needed during storage.
quiz.explanation: 周圍地下水是儲存封存分析的重要邊界，裕廊教材區分施工降水與儲存期間所需水頭。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Surrounding groundwater is a containment boundary; distinguish construction dewatering from heads needed during storage. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「測壓水頭」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Piezometric head” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=130 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1275.3 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1402.83 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=130 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1275.3 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1402.83 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較停抽後水頭回復與多位置測壓分布。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare recovery after pumping stops with spatial head distribution.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=130 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1275.3 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1402.83 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=130 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1275.3 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1402.83 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Piezometric head and lining pressure", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=130 m。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=130 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1275.3 kPa.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=130 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=130 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1275.3 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「測壓水頭」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Piezometric head” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較停抽後水頭回復與多位置測壓分布。使用分層測壓管及流量計，配合降雨或潮位序列分辨補注與設備影響，將讀值統一換算至同一高程基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare recovery after pumping stops with spatial head distribution. Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：比較停抽後水頭回復與多位置測壓分布。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Jurong Rock Caverns, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Compare recovery after pumping stops with spatial head distribution. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：施工期越乾燥不代表儲存期封存條件越好。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Drier construction conditions do not necessarily improve storage containment. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較停抽後水頭回復與多位置測壓分布。使用分層測壓管及流量計，配合降雨或潮位序列分辨補注與設備影響，將讀值統一換算至同一高程基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Compare recovery after pumping stops with spatial head distribution. Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：比較停抽後水頭回復與多位置測壓分布。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。
knowledge.textEn: For Jurong Rock Caverns, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Compare recovery after pumping stops with spatial head distribution. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.

quiz.question: 要驗證「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Piezometric head and lining pressure"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
比較停抽後水頭回復與多位置測壓分布。
錨桿鋼材強度足夠就能排除岩洞楔體掉落。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Compare recovery after pumping stops with spatial head distribution.
Adequate anchor steel strength excludes cavern wedge falls.
quiz.explanation: 比較停抽後水頭回復與多位置測壓分布。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare recovery after pumping stops with spatial head distribution. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Piezometric head and lining pressure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「測壓水頭」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Piezometric head” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 施工期越乾燥不代表儲存期封存條件越好。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Drier construction conditions do not necessarily improve storage containment. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 施工期越乾燥不代表儲存期封存條件越好。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。
knowledge.textEn: Drier construction conditions do not necessarily improve storage containment. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「測壓水頭與襯砌外壓」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Piezometric head and lining pressure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
一支測壓管的向內壓差為正就能證明全洞室封存。
施工期越乾燥不代表儲存期封存條件越好。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Positive inward pressure at one piezometer proves whole-cavern containment.
Drier construction conditions do not necessarily improve storage containment.
quiz.explanation: 施工期越乾燥不代表儲存期封存條件越好。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Drier construction conditions do not necessarily improve storage containment. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 水力封存與共同高程：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic containment at a common datum: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「局部向內壓差」如何影響新加坡裕廊岩洞的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Local inward pressure difference” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jurong Rock Caverns”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 產品液柱與氣相表壓共同決定洞壁內壓，教材全部壓力換算至同一高程再判斷局部向內梯度。岩洞液體儲存可利用周圍地下水壓維持向洞內的水力梯度，但產品液柱、氣相壓力和不同高程都影響壓差。單一測點正壓差不證明整座岩洞封存；裂隙連通、操作水位、瞬變及水幕補注的空間分布須共同驗證。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「局部向內壓差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Product head and gas gauge pressure jointly determine internal pressure; convert all terms to one elevation before judging a local inward gradient. Liquid storage in rock can use surrounding groundwater pressure to maintain an inward hydraulic gradient, but product head, gas pressure and elevation affect the difference. A positive value at one point does not prove containment of the entire cavern. Fracture connectivity, operating levels, transients and the spatial distribution of water replenishment require joint assessment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Local inward pressure difference” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：外側水密度=1000 kg/m³；外側水頭=40 m；產品密度=800 kg/m³；產品液柱=25 m；氣相表壓=20 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: external water density=1000 kg/m³; external head=40 m; product density=800 kg/m³; product head=25 m; gas gauge pressure=20 kPa. Δp=(ρwghw−ρpghp)/1000−pgas, g=9.81 m/s²=176.2 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「一支測壓管的向內壓差為正就能證明全洞室封存。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Positive inward pressure at one piezometer proves whole-cavern containment." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「局部向內壓差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Local inward pressure difference”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 水力封存與共同高程
knowledge.titleEn: Hydraulic containment at a common datum
knowledge.text: 產品液柱與氣相表壓共同決定洞壁內壓，教材全部壓力換算至同一高程再判斷局部向內梯度。岩洞液體儲存可利用周圍地下水壓維持向洞內的水力梯度，但產品液柱、氣相壓力和不同高程都影響壓差。
knowledge.textEn: Product head and gas gauge pressure jointly determine internal pressure; convert all terms to one elevation before judging a local inward gradient. Liquid storage in rock can use surrounding groundwater pressure to maintain an inward hydraulic gradient, but product head, gas pressure and elevation affect the difference.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：一支測壓管的向內壓差為正就能證明全洞室封存。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Positive inward pressure at one piezometer proves whole-cavern containment. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「水力封存與共同高程」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Hydraulic containment at a common datum" is correct?
options: 產品液柱與氣相表壓共同決定洞壁內壓，教材全部壓力換算至同一高程再判斷局部向內梯度。
一支測壓管的向內壓差為正就能證明全洞室封存。
總幾何容積減目前液位體積就是所有狀態的裝填上限。
optionsEn: Product head and gas gauge pressure jointly determine internal pressure; convert all terms to one elevation before judging a local inward gradient.
Positive inward pressure at one piezometer proves whole-cavern containment.
Gross volume minus current liquid volume is the filling limit under every condition.
quiz.explanation: 產品液柱與氣相表壓共同決定洞壁內壓，教材全部壓力換算至同一高程再判斷局部向內梯度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Product head and gas gauge pressure jointly determine internal pressure; convert all terms to one elevation before judging a local inward gradient. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 水力封存與共同高程：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic containment at a common datum: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「局部向內壓差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Local inward pressure difference” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：外側水密度=1000 kg/m³；外側水頭=40 m；產品密度=800 kg/m³；產品液柱=25 m；氣相表壓=20 kPa。Δp=(ρwghw−ρpghp)/1000−pgas, g=9.81 m/s²=176.2 kPa。僅把外側水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為215.44 kPa。邊界：同一高程假想靜壓差，正值只顯示局部向內梯度，不證明全洞室封存；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: external water density=1000 kg/m³; external head=40 m; product density=800 kg/m³; product head=25 m; gas gauge pressure=20 kPa. Δp=(ρwghw−ρpghp)/1000−pgas, g=9.81 m/s²=176.2 kPa. Increasing only external head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 215.44 kPa. Boundary: Hypothetical pressure difference at one elevation; positive means local inward gradient, not whole-cavern containment. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時核對外水頭、產品液位、密度和氣相壓力。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check external head, product level, density and gas pressure simultaneously.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：外側水密度=1000 kg/m³；外側水頭=40 m；產品密度=800 kg/m³；產品液柱=25 m；氣相表壓=20 kPa。Δp=(ρwghw−ρpghp)/1000−pgas, g=9.81 m/s²=176.2 kPa。僅把外側水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為215.44 kPa。邊界：同一高程假想靜壓差，正值只顯示局部向內梯度，不證明全洞室封存；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: external water density=1000 kg/m³; external head=40 m; product density=800 kg/m³; product head=25 m; gas gauge pressure=20 kPa. Δp=(ρwghw−ρpghp)/1000−pgas, g=9.81 m/s²=176.2 kPa. Increasing only external head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 215.44 kPa. Boundary: Hypothetical pressure difference at one elevation; positive means local inward gradient, not whole-cavern containment. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「水力封存與共同高程」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Hydraulic containment at a common datum", which statement holds?
options: 施工後泉水變少就能單獨證明隧道造成全部減流。
原創教學假設：外側水密度=1000 kg/m³；外側水頭=40 m；產品密度=800 kg/m³；產品液柱=25 m；氣相表壓=20 kPa。
地下容積除高度就是工程實際節省的地面土地。
optionsEn: Reduced spring flow after construction alone proves the tunnel caused the entire change.
Original teaching assumptions: external water density=1000 kg/m³.
Underground volume divided by height equals actual surface land saved.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：外側水密度=1000 kg/m³；外側水頭=40 m；產品密度=800 kg/m³；產品液柱=25 m；氣相表壓=20 kPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: external water density=1000 kg/m³; external head=40 m; product density=800 kg/m³; product head=25 m; gas gauge pressure=20 kPa. Δp=(ρwghw−ρpghp)/1000−pgas, g=9.81 m/s²=176.2 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 水力封存與共同高程：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic containment at a common datum: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「局部向內壓差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Local inward pressure difference” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同時核對外水頭、產品液位、密度和氣相壓力。將外側測壓、產品液位與氣壓換到同一高程和壓力基準，沿洞頂與側牆多點比較並觀察時間變化。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check external head, product level, density and gas pressure simultaneously. Convert external head, product level and gas pressure to one elevation and pressure reference, comparing multiple roof and wall locations over time. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「局部向內壓差」的交付需回答：同時核對外水頭、產品液位、密度和氣相壓力。封存評估交付共同高程壓力圖、裂隙模型與操作範圍，監測和水力試驗互驗，不能以單一靜壓式核准操作。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Jurong Rock Caverns, the local inward pressure difference handover must address the following evidence: Check external head, product level, density and gas pressure simultaneously. Containment assessment includes common-datum pressure maps, fracture models and operating bounds; monitoring and hydraulic tests corroborate each other beyond one static equation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：漏掉氣相壓力會高估封存餘量，單點正值也不能證明全洞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitted gas pressure overstates margin, and one positive point cannot prove whole-cavern containment. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同時核對外水頭、產品液位、密度和氣相壓力。將外側測壓、產品液位與氣壓換到同一高程和壓力基準，沿洞頂與側牆多點比較並觀察時間變化。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Check external head, product level, density and gas pressure simultaneously. Convert external head, product level and gas pressure to one elevation and pressure reference, comparing multiple roof and wall locations over time. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「局部向內壓差」的交付需回答：同時核對外水頭、產品液位、密度和氣相壓力。封存評估交付共同高程壓力圖、裂隙模型與操作範圍，監測和水力試驗互驗，不能以單一靜壓式核准操作。
knowledge.textEn: For Jurong Rock Caverns, the local inward pressure difference handover must address the following evidence: Check external head, product level, density and gas pressure simultaneously. Containment assessment includes common-datum pressure maps, fracture models and operating bounds; monitoring and hydraulic tests corroborate each other beyond one static equation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「水力封存與共同高程」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Hydraulic containment at a common datum"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。
同時核對外水頭、產品液位、密度和氣相壓力。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction.
Check external head, product level, density and gas pressure simultaneously.
quiz.explanation: 同時核對外水頭、產品液位、密度和氣相壓力。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check external head, product level, density and gas pressure simultaneously. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 水力封存與共同高程：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic containment at a common datum: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「局部向內壓差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Local inward pressure difference” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 漏掉氣相壓力會高估封存餘量，單點正值也不能證明全洞。漏計氣相表壓會高估向內梯度，低水頭裂隙即使離主要測點不遠也可能形成局部向外路徑。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitted gas pressure overstates margin, and one positive point cannot prove whole-cavern containment. Omitting gas gauge pressure overstates inward gradient; a low-head fracture near a main sensor can still create a local outward path. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：單一測點正壓差不證明整座岩洞封存；裂隙連通、操作水位、瞬變及水幕補注的空間分布須共同驗證。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Fracture connectivity, operating levels, transients and the spatial distribution of water replenishment require joint assessment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「一支測壓管的向內壓差為正就能證明全洞室封存。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Positive inward pressure at one piezometer proves whole-cavern containment." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 漏掉氣相壓力會高估封存餘量，單點正值也不能證明全洞。漏計氣相表壓會高估向內梯度，低水頭裂隙即使離主要測點不遠也可能形成局部向外路徑。
knowledge.textEn: Omitted gas pressure overstates margin, and one positive point cannot prove whole-cavern containment. Omitting gas gauge pressure overstates inward gradient; a low-head fracture near a main sensor can still create a local outward path.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「水力封存與共同高程」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Hydraulic containment at a common datum" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 漏掉氣相壓力會高估封存餘量，單點正值也不能證明全洞。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
總幾何容積減目前液位體積就是所有狀態的裝填上限。
optionsEn: Omitted gas pressure overstates margin, and one positive point cannot prove whole-cavern containment.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Gross volume minus current liquid volume is the filling limit under every condition.
quiz.explanation: 漏掉氣相壓力會高估封存餘量，單點正值也不能證明全洞。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Omitted gas pressure overstates margin, and one positive point cannot prove whole-cavern containment. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「儲存容量與產品庫存帳」與「控制網與貫通誤差」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Storage capacity and product inventory" and "Control network and breakthrough error": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 儲存容量與產品庫存帳：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Storage capacity and product inventory: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「可用庫存空間」如何影響新加坡裕廊岩洞的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Available inventory space” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jurong Rock Caverns”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 裕廊是產品儲存而非洪水調蓄，教材扣除既有庫存與保留空間，另區分同溫體積帳與質量帳。岩洞總幾何容積不等於可裝產品量，既有庫存、保留氣相及不可使用區域都需扣除。液體熱膨脹與密度使體積帳和質量帳不同，轉運時還要處理管線存量；簡單差額只適用同一溫度、同一邊界與明確保留空間。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「可用庫存空間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Jurong stores product rather than floods; subtract stock and reserve while distinguishing same-temperature volume from mass accounting. Gross cavern volume is not the amount available for product: existing stock, vapour reserve and unusable regions must be deducted. Thermal expansion and density distinguish volume from mass balances, while transfers involve pipeline inventory. A simple difference applies only at the same temperature, within one boundary and with explicitly reserved space. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Available inventory space” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：總容積=100000 m³；既有庫存=67400 m³；保留空間=5000 m³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: gross volume=100000 m³; existing stock=67400 m³; reserve=5000 m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總幾何容積減目前液位體積就是所有狀態的裝填上限。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Gross volume minus current liquid volume is the filling limit under every condition." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「可用庫存空間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Available inventory space”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 儲存容量與產品庫存帳
knowledge.text: 裕廊是產品儲存而非洪水調蓄，教材扣除既有庫存與保留空間，另區分同溫體積帳與質量帳。岩洞總幾何容積不等於可裝產品量，既有庫存、保留氣相及不可使用區域都需扣除。
knowledge.textEn: Jurong stores product rather than floods; subtract stock and reserve while distinguishing same-temperature volume from mass accounting. Gross cavern volume is not the amount available for product: existing stock, vapour reserve and unusable regions must be deducted.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：總幾何容積減目前液位體積就是所有狀態的裝填上限。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Gross volume minus current liquid volume is the filling limit under every condition. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「儲存容量與產品庫存帳」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Storage capacity and product inventory" is correct?
options: 總幾何容積減目前液位體積就是所有狀態的裝填上限。
裕廊是產品儲存而非洪水調蓄，教材扣除既有庫存與保留空間，另區分同溫體積帳與質量帳。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
optionsEn: Gross volume minus current liquid volume is the filling limit under every condition.
Jurong stores product rather than floods; subtract stock and reserve while distinguishing same-temperature volume from mass accounting.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
quiz.explanation: 裕廊是產品儲存而非洪水調蓄，教材扣除既有庫存與保留空間，另區分同溫體積帳與質量帳。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Jurong stores product rather than floods; subtract stock and reserve while distinguishing same-temperature volume from mass accounting. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 儲存容量與產品庫存帳：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Storage capacity and product inventory: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「可用庫存空間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Available inventory space” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：總容積=100000 m³；既有庫存=67400 m³；保留空間=5000 m³。Vavailable=Vgross−Vstock−Vreserve=27600 m³。僅把既有庫存增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為20860 m³。邊界：假想同溫單室庫存帳，不是裕廊實際操作上限；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: gross volume=100000 m³; existing stock=67400 m³; reserve=5000 m³. Vavailable=Vgross−Vstock−Vreserve=27600 m³. Increasing only existing stock by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 20860 m³. Boundary: Hypothetical same-temperature cavern balance, not Jurong operating limits. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：配對液位容積表、溫度和密度，另列管線存量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Pair level-volume tables, temperature and density and list pipeline inventory separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: gross volume=100000 m³; existing stock=67400 m³; reserve=5000 m³. Vavailable=Vgross−Vstock−Vreserve=27600 m³. Increasing only existing stock by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 20860 m³. Boundary: Hypothetical same-temperature cavern balance, not Jurong operating limits. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 儲存容量與產品庫存帳：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Storage capacity and product inventory: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「可用庫存空間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Available inventory space” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 配對液位容積表、溫度和密度，另列管線存量。以液位容積表、溫度與密度重建庫存，將管線轉運量和洞室量分開，再閉合進出質量帳。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Pair level-volume tables, temperature and density and list pipeline inventory separately. Reconstruct inventory from calibrated level-volume tables, temperature and density, separate pipeline and cavern volumes and close the inlet-outlet mass balance. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「可用庫存空間」的交付需回答：配對液位容積表、溫度和密度，另列管線存量。庫存交付明列溫度基準、保留空間和管線邊界，操作上限以核准設計與程序為準，教材差額僅供帳目理解。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Jurong Rock Caverns, the available inventory space handover must address the following evidence: Pair level-volume tables, temperature and density and list pipeline inventory separately. Inventory records state temperature reference, reserved space and pipeline boundary; approved design and procedures determine operating limits, while the classroom difference illustrates accounting.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把總幾何容積當可立即裝填量會漏掉氣相及保留空間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Gross geometry as immediate filling capacity omits vapour and reserved space. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「儲存容量與產品庫存帳」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Storage capacity and product inventory"?
options: 配對液位容積表、溫度和密度，另列管線存量。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
optionsEn: Pair level-volume tables, temperature and density and list pipeline inventory separately.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
quiz.explanation: 配對液位容積表、溫度和密度，另列管線存量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Pair level-volume tables, temperature and density and list pipeline inventory separately. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 儲存容量與產品庫存帳：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Storage capacity and product inventory: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「可用庫存空間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Available inventory space” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把總幾何容積當可立即裝填量會漏掉氣相及保留空間。不同溫度的體積直接相減會產生假性損失，漏列氣相保留量則高估可用空間並扭曲排程。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Gross geometry as immediate filling capacity omits vapour and reserved space. Subtracting volumes at different temperatures creates apparent losses, while omitted vapour reserve overstates available space and distorts scheduling. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：液體熱膨脹與密度使體積帳和質量帳不同，轉運時還要處理管線存量；簡單差額只適用同一溫度、同一邊界與明確保留空間。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A simple difference applies only at the same temperature, within one boundary and with explicitly reserved space.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「總幾何容積減目前液位體積就是所有狀態的裝填上限。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Gross volume minus current liquid volume is the filling limit under every condition." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把總幾何容積當可立即裝填量會漏掉氣相及保留空間。不同溫度的體積直接相減會產生假性損失，漏列氣相保留量則高估可用空間並扭曲排程。
knowledge.textEn: Gross geometry as immediate filling capacity omits vapour and reserved space. Subtracting volumes at different temperatures creates apparent losses, while omitted vapour reserve overstates available space and distorts scheduling.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「儲存容量與產品庫存帳」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Storage capacity and product inventory" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把總幾何容積當可立即裝填量會漏掉氣相及保留空間。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Gross geometry as immediate filling capacity omits vapour and reserved space.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
quiz.explanation: 把總幾何容積當可立即裝填量會漏掉氣相及保留空間。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Gross geometry as immediate filling capacity omits vapour and reserved space. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「方向角誤差」如何影響新加坡裕廊岩洞的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Orientation error” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jurong Rock Caverns”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 洞室與地面設備的共同高程直接影響靜壓比較，教材研究深部水準基準偏移的封存後果。長隧道的微小方向誤差會沿距離累積，地下控制網又缺少直接衛星定位，必須把地表基準可靠傳到洞內。閉合差很小不代表無系統誤差；尺度、折光、儀器定向與高程基準可能共同偏移，誤差相關性也使平方和估算失真。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「方向角誤差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A shared elevation datum between cavern and surface equipment directly affects pressure comparison; examine consequences of deep benchmark bias. Small orientation errors accumulate over long drives, while underground networks lack direct satellite positioning and depend on transferring surface control. A small closure does not exclude systematic bias: scale, refraction, orientation and vertical datum may shift together. Correlated errors also invalidate a naive root-sum-square combination of supposedly independent observations. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Orientation error” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：控制長度=5880 m；方向偏角=2.7 arcsec。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: control length=5880 m; orientation error=2.7 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.076969 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「方向角誤差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Orientation error”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Small orientation errors accumulate over long drives, while underground networks lack direct satellite positioning and depend on transferring surface control.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「控制網與貫通誤差」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Control network and breakthrough error" is correct?
options: 兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
施工後泉水變少就能單獨證明隧道造成全部減流。
洞室與地面設備的共同高程直接影響靜壓比較，教材研究深部水準基準偏移的封存後果。
optionsEn: Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
Reduced spring flow after construction alone proves the tunnel caused the entire change.
A shared elevation datum between cavern and surface equipment directly affects pressure comparison; examine consequences of deep benchmark bias.
quiz.explanation: 洞室與地面設備的共同高程直接影響靜壓比較，教材研究深部水準基準偏移的封存後果。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A shared elevation datum between cavern and surface equipment directly affects pressure comparison; examine consequences of deep benchmark bias. The other options are common misconceptions.
