地下容積除高度就是工程實際節省的地面土地。
知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: control length=5880 m; orientation error=2.7 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.076969 m.
Underground volume divided by height equals actual surface land saved.
Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：控制長度=5880 m；方向偏角=2.7 arcsec。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: control length=5880 m; orientation error=2.7 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.076969 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「方向角誤差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Orientation error” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以獨立水準路線核對液位與測壓管口高程。由獨立測量組複核地表到洞內的轉換，保留原始角距及溫度資料，用不同控制線比較方向與高程偏差。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Independently level liquid references and piezometer collars. Independently check surface-to-tunnel transformations, retain raw angles, distances and temperatures, and compare orientation and elevation through separate control routes. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「方向角誤差」的交付需回答：以獨立水準路線核對液位與測壓管口高程。貫通前凍結座標、尺度與高程版本，獨立組直接使用原始觀測重算；不得只傳遞整理好的坐標而遺失校正資訊。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Jurong Rock Caverns, the orientation error handover must address the following evidence: Independently level liquid references and piezometer collars. Freeze coordinate, scale and height revisions before breakthrough; independent reviewers recompute raw observations rather than receiving only adjusted coordinates without corrections.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：同一高程錯誤可能讓液位和水頭各自合理但壓差算錯。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: One datum error can make separate levels plausible while the pressure difference is wrong. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Independently level liquid references and piezometer collars. Independently check surface-to-tunnel transformations, retain raw angles, distances and temperatures, and compare orientation and elevation through separate control routes. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「方向角誤差」的交付需回答：以獨立水準路線核對液位與測壓管口高程。貫通前凍結座標、尺度與高程版本，獨立組直接使用原始觀測重算；不得只傳遞整理好的坐標而遺失校正資訊。
knowledge.textEn: For Jurong Rock Caverns, the orientation error handover must address the following evidence: Independently level liquid references and piezometer collars. Freeze coordinate, scale and height revisions before breakthrough; independent reviewers recompute raw observations rather than receiving only adjusted coordinates without corrections.

quiz.question: 要驗證「控制網與貫通誤差」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Control network and breakthrough error"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以獨立水準路線核對液位與測壓管口高程。
目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Independently level liquid references and piezometer collars.
No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
quiz.explanation: 以獨立水準路線核對液位與測壓管口高程。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Independently level liquid references and piezometer collars. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 控制網與貫通誤差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Control network and breakthrough error: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「方向角誤差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Orientation error” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 同一高程錯誤可能讓液位和水頭各自合理但壓差算錯。共用錯誤基準可能讓兩組測量同時看似一致，直到貫通或軌道銜接才發現系統偏差，修正成本遠高於早期複核。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: One datum error can make separate levels plausible while the pressure difference is wrong. A shared wrong datum can make separate surveys appear consistent until breakthrough or track connection exposes bias that is costly to correct. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：閉合差很小不代表無系統誤差；尺度、折光、儀器定向與高程基準可能共同偏移，誤差相關性也使平方和估算失真。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Correlated errors also invalidate a naive root-sum-square combination of supposedly independent observations.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 同一高程錯誤可能讓液位和水頭各自合理但壓差算錯。共用錯誤基準可能讓兩組測量同時看似一致，直到貫通或軌道銜接才發現系統偏差，修正成本遠高於早期複核。
knowledge.textEn: One datum error can make separate levels plausible while the pressure difference is wrong. A shared wrong datum can make separate surveys appear consistent until breakthrough or track connection exposes bias that is costly to correct.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「控制網與貫通誤差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Control network and breakthrough error" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
施工後泉水變少就能單獨證明隧道造成全部減流。
同一高程錯誤可能讓液位和水頭各自合理但壓差算錯。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Reduced spring flow after construction alone proves the tunnel caused the entire change.
One datum error can make separate levels plausible while the pressure difference is wrong.
quiz.explanation: 同一高程錯誤可能讓液位和水頭各自合理但壓差算錯。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: One datum error can make separate levels plausible while the pressure difference is wrong. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「水量帳與環境受體」與「資產編碼與可追溯交接」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Water balance and environmental receptors" and "Asset identity and traceable handover": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 水量帳與環境受體：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Water balance and environmental receptors: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「邊界水量差」如何影響新加坡裕廊岩洞的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Boundary water-balance residual” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jurong Rock Caverns”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 儲存岩洞周圍水量帳需分開補注、滲入和產品管線範圍，教材不以水量殘差直接宣稱產品洩漏。隧道排水可能改變泉水、溪流或地下水補注，但同時還有降雨、季節與既有抽水等影響。水量平衡需要明確時間和空間邊界，殘差不能直接歸因於某一裂隙；應用施工前基線和對照站區分自然變化與工程效應。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「邊界水量差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate recharge, water ingress and product-pipeline boundaries; a water-balance residual is not direct proof of product leakage. Tunnel drainage may alter springs, streams or groundwater recharge, alongside rainfall, seasonal change and existing abstraction. A water balance needs explicit temporal and spatial boundaries; its residual cannot be assigned directly to one fracture. Baseline observations and control locations help separate natural variability from construction effects rather than equating correlation with causation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Boundary water-balance residual” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：流入=172 m³/day；流出=78 m³/day；其他損失=20 m³/day。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: inflow=172 m³/day; outflow=78 m³/day; other loss=20 m³/day. ΔS=I−O−loss=74 m³/day.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「施工後泉水變少就能單獨證明隧道造成全部減流。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reduced spring flow after construction alone proves the tunnel caused the entire change." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「邊界水量差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Boundary water-balance residual”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 水量帳與環境受體
knowledge.text: 儲存岩洞周圍水量帳需分開補注、滲入和產品管線範圍，教材不以水量殘差直接宣稱產品洩漏。隧道排水可能改變泉水、溪流或地下水補注，但同時還有降雨、季節與既有抽水等影響。
knowledge.textEn: Separate recharge, water ingress and product-pipeline boundaries; a water-balance residual is not direct proof of product leakage. Tunnel drainage may alter springs, streams or groundwater recharge, alongside rainfall, seasonal change and existing abstraction.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：施工後泉水變少就能單獨證明隧道造成全部減流。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Reduced spring flow after construction alone proves the tunnel caused the entire change. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「水量帳與環境受體」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Water balance and environmental receptors" is correct?
options: 儲存岩洞周圍水量帳需分開補注、滲入和產品管線範圍，教材不以水量殘差直接宣稱產品洩漏。
施工後泉水變少就能單獨證明隧道造成全部減流。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
optionsEn: Separate recharge, water ingress and product-pipeline boundaries; a water-balance residual is not direct proof of product leakage.
Reduced spring flow after construction alone proves the tunnel caused the entire change.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
quiz.explanation: 儲存岩洞周圍水量帳需分開補注、滲入和產品管線範圍，教材不以水量殘差直接宣稱產品洩漏。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Separate recharge, water ingress and product-pipeline boundaries; a water-balance residual is not direct proof of product leakage. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 水量帳與環境受體：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Water balance and environmental receptors: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「邊界水量差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Boundary water-balance residual” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：流入=172 m³/day；流出=78 m³/day；其他損失=20 m³/day。ΔS=I−O−loss=74 m³/day。僅把流入增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為91.2 m³/day。邊界：指定邊界日水量帳，不是因果或含水層參數證明；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: inflow=172 m³/day; outflow=78 m³/day; other loss=20 m³/day. ΔS=I−O−loss=74 m³/day. Increasing only inflow by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 91.2 m³/day. Boundary: Daily balance in a stated boundary, not causal proof or aquifer-parameter identification. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以水位、水量與獨立品質檢測交叉判讀，保留缺測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Combine level, flow and independent quality evidence while preserving data gaps.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：流入=172 m³/day；流出=78 m³/day；其他損失=20 m³/day。ΔS=I−O−loss=74 m³/day。僅把流入增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為91.2 m³/day。邊界：指定邊界日水量帳，不是因果或含水層參數證明；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: inflow=172 m³/day; outflow=78 m³/day; other loss=20 m³/day. ΔS=I−O−loss=74 m³/day. Increasing only inflow by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 91.2 m³/day. Boundary: Daily balance in a stated boundary, not causal proof or aquifer-parameter identification. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「水量帳與環境受體」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Water balance and environmental receptors", which statement holds?
options: 錨桿鋼材強度足夠就能排除岩洞楔體掉落。
原創教學假設：流入=172 m³/day；流出=78 m³/day；其他損失=20 m³/day。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
optionsEn: Adequate anchor steel strength excludes cavern wedge falls.
Original teaching assumptions: inflow=172 m³/day; outflow=78 m³/day; other loss=20 m³/day. ΔS=I−O−loss=74 m³/day.
Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：流入=172 m³/day；流出=78 m³/day；其他損失=20 m³/day。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: inflow=172 m³/day; outflow=78 m³/day; other loss=20 m³/day. ΔS=I−O−loss=74 m³/day. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 水量帳與環境受體：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Water balance and environmental receptors: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「邊界水量差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Boundary water-balance residual” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以水位、水量與獨立品質檢測交叉判讀，保留缺測。同步比較雨量、泉流、排水與對照井，核對儀器缺測和蓄水變化，對不同季節分別閉合水量帳。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Combine level, flow and independent quality evidence while preserving data gaps. Compare rainfall, spring flow, drainage and control wells, checking missing data and storage change and closing balances separately by season. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「邊界水量差」的交付需回答：以水位、水量與獨立品質檢測交叉判讀，保留缺測。預先定義受體、基線及資料缺口，任何因果判斷都需列出替代解釋，補救效果也用同一監測邊界評估。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Jurong Rock Caverns, the boundary water-balance residual handover must address the following evidence: Combine level, flow and independent quality evidence while preserving data gaps. Define receptors, baselines and data gaps beforehand; causal judgements list alternatives, and mitigation is evaluated within the same monitoring boundary.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未量測的地下水支路可能造成殘差，不能單憑差額定因。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unmeasured groundwater branches create residuals that cannot alone identify cause. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以水位、水量與獨立品質檢測交叉判讀，保留缺測。同步比較雨量、泉流、排水與對照井，核對儀器缺測和蓄水變化，對不同季節分別閉合水量帳。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Combine level, flow and independent quality evidence while preserving data gaps. Compare rainfall, spring flow, drainage and control wells, checking missing data and storage change and closing balances separately by season. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「邊界水量差」的交付需回答：以水位、水量與獨立品質檢測交叉判讀，保留缺測。預先定義受體、基線及資料缺口，任何因果判斷都需列出替代解釋，補救效果也用同一監測邊界評估。
knowledge.textEn: For Jurong Rock Caverns, the boundary water-balance residual handover must address the following evidence: Combine level, flow and independent quality evidence while preserving data gaps. Define receptors, baselines and data gaps beforehand; causal judgements list alternatives, and mitigation is evaluated within the same monitoring boundary.

quiz.question: 要驗證「水量帳與環境受體」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Water balance and environmental receptors"?

quiz.explanationEn: Combine level, flow and independent quality evidence while preserving data gaps. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 水量帳與環境受體：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Water balance and environmental receptors: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「邊界水量差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Boundary water-balance residual” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未量測的地下水支路可能造成殘差，不能單憑差額定因。未量到的支流或時間錯位會產生假性水量損失，錯把所有減流歸於隧道可能導致無效補救。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unmeasured groundwater branches create residuals that cannot alone identify cause. Unmeasured tributaries or timing mismatch create false losses; attributing every decrease to the tunnel can prompt ineffective mitigation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：水量平衡需要明確時間和空間邊界，殘差不能直接歸因於某一裂隙；應用施工前基線和對照站區分自然變化與工程效應。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Baseline observations and control locations help separate natural variability from construction effects rather than equating correlation with causation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「施工後泉水變少就能單獨證明隧道造成全部減流。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Reduced spring flow after construction alone proves the tunnel caused the entire change." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 未量測的地下水支路可能造成殘差，不能單憑差額定因。未量到的支流或時間錯位會產生假性水量損失，錯把所有減流歸於隧道可能導致無效補救。
knowledge.textEn: Unmeasured groundwater branches create residuals that cannot alone identify cause. Unmeasured tributaries or timing mismatch create false losses; attributing every decrease to the tunnel can prompt ineffective mitigation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「水量帳與環境受體」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。
optionsEn: Unmeasured groundwater branches create residuals that cannot alone identify cause.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「資產資料完整度」如何影響新加坡裕廊岩洞的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Asset-record completeness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jurong Rock Caverns”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 產品儲存設備與岩體監測必須連接位置及狀態，教材把產品庫存表、測壓和支護檢查放在同一可追溯鏈。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「資產資料完整度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Link product-system records and rock monitoring by location and state, connecting inventory, pressure and support inspections traceably. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision. Drawings without change history cannot distinguish replacement from deterioration. Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Asset-record completeness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：設備總數=124 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=124 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=87.0968 %.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「資產資料完整度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Asset-record completeness”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

地下容積除高度就是工程實際節省的地面土地。

steps.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Asset identity and traceable handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「資產資料完整度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Asset-record completeness” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：設備總數=124 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=87.0968 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為85.8065 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: asset count=124 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=87.0968 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 85.8065 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：抽查某洞室異常可否回查操作狀態、感測校正和地質。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Trace a cavern anomaly to operating state, sensor calibration and geology.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 85.8065 %. steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: One instrument trend without operating context can misclassify normal transfer as abnormal seepage. steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「資產資料完整度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Asset-record completeness” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只看單一儀表趨勢而缺操作狀態會把正常轉運當異常滲流。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: One instrument trend without operating context can misclassify normal transfer as abnormal seepage. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只看單一儀表趨勢而缺操作狀態會把正常轉運當異常滲流。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。
knowledge.textEn: One instrument trend without operating context can misclassify normal transfer as abnormal seepage. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「資產編碼與可追溯交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Asset identity and traceable handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只看單一儀表趨勢而缺操作狀態會把正常轉運當異常滲流。
地下容積除高度就是工程實際節省的地面土地。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
One instrument trend without operating context can misclassify normal transfer as abnormal seepage.
Underground volume divided by height equals actual surface land saved.
quiz.explanation: 只看單一儀表趨勢而缺操作狀態會把正常轉運當異常滲流。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: One instrument trend without operating context can misclassify normal transfer as abnormal seepage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 隧道超前探測鑽孔
titleEn: Probe drilling ahead of tunnel faces
summary: 本課聚焦以孔位、鑽進訊號與水文證據建立可更新的掌子面前方模型。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。
summaryEn: This course focuses on build an updateable ahead-of-face model from borehole geometry, drilling signals and hydraulic evidence. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設孔長30 m、偏角10°，橫向距離為30 sin10°=5.21 m；小角度定位誤差仍須另列。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設直孔100 m有1°方位偏差，末端側向差100 sin1°=1.745 m；這不是隨機誤差的標準差。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed 30 m hole inclined by 10°, lateral reach is 30 sin10°=5.21 m; small angular positioning errors require separate allowance. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed straight 100 m hole with a 1° bearing bias has a lateral offset of 100 sin1°=1.745 m; this is not a random-error standard deviation. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「探測目標與盲區」與「孔跡與角度誤差」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Targets and blind zones" and "Trajectory and angular error": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 探測目標與盲區：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Targets and blind zones: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「探測目標與盲區」如何影響隧道超前探測鑽孔的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Targets and blind zones” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Probe drilling ahead of tunnel faces”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 超前鑽孔是一條細長的取樣路徑，孔間未穿越的岩體仍可能藏有斷層。先把要回答的問題分成岩性界面、含水帶與空洞，再檢查孔軸是否真正截交目標；孔深不能代替橫向覆蓋。 假設孔長30 m、偏角10°，橫向距離為30 sin10°=5.21 m；小角度定位誤差仍須另列。 若將兩個無異常孔之間直接填成完整岩體，偏斜斷層可能被漏掉；開挖後突然出現破碎帶，原先支護與水處理預案便失去依據。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「探測目標與盲區」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A probe hole samples a slender path through the ground. A fault can remain between adjacent paths even when both holes are long. Separate the questions of lithological boundaries, water-bearing zones and voids, then check whether the planned trajectories actually intersect each target. For an assumed 30 m hole inclined by 10°, lateral reach is 30 sin10°=5.21 m; small angular positioning errors require separate allowance. Interpolating intact rock between two uneventful holes can miss an oblique fault. Unexpected broken ground during excavation then undermines the original support and water-management assumptions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Targets and blind zones” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鑽得越深就一定已排除整個掌子面前方風險。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Greater drilling depth always eliminates risk across the entire face ahead." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「探測目標與盲區」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Targets and blind zones”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 探測目標與盲區
knowledge.text: 超前鑽孔是一條細長的取樣路徑，孔間未穿越的岩體仍可能藏有斷層。先把要回答的問題分成岩性界面、含水帶與空洞，再檢查孔軸是否真正截交目標；孔深不能代替橫向覆蓋。
knowledge.textEn: A probe hole samples a slender path through the ground. A fault can remain between adjacent paths even when both holes are long.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鑽得越深就一定已排除整個掌子面前方風險。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Greater drilling depth always eliminates risk across the entire face ahead. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「探測目標與盲區」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Targets and blind zones" is correct?
options: 鑽得越深就一定已排除整個掌子面前方風險。
超前鑽孔是一條細長的取樣路徑，孔間未穿越的岩體仍可能藏有斷層。
孔口方向正確即可把所有孔內位置當成直線。
optionsEn: Greater drilling depth always eliminates risk across the entire face ahead.
A probe hole samples a slender path through the ground.
A correct collar direction makes every downhole position a straight-line projection.
quiz.explanation: 超前鑽孔是一條細長的取樣路徑，孔間未穿越的岩體仍可能藏有斷層。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A probe hole samples a slender path through the ground. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 探測目標與盲區：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Targets and blind zones: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「探測目標與盲區」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Targets and blind zones” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設孔長30 m、偏角10°，橫向距離為30 sin10°=5.21 m；小角度定位誤差仍須另列。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed 30 m hole inclined by 10°, lateral reach is 30 sin10°=5.21 m; small angular positioning errors require separate allowance. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將孔口座標與實測方位投到同一里程剖面，標出各孔的覆蓋範圍及無資料區。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot surveyed collars and measured bearings on one chainage section, explicitly marking unsampled zones.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設孔長30 m、偏角10°，橫向距離為30 sin10°=5.21 m；小角度定位誤差仍須另列。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed 30 m hole inclined by 10°, lateral reach is 30 sin10°=5.21 m; small angular positioning errors require separate allowance.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「探測目標與盲區」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Targets and blind zones", which statement holds?
options: 岩屑從孔口流出時的鑽頭深度就是它的原始深度。
兩孔表壓相同就代表它們具有相同的地下水水頭。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: Bit depth when cuttings emerge is their original geological depth.
Equal gauge pressures in two holes imply equal groundwater head.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 探測目標與盲區：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Targets and blind zones: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「探測目標與盲區」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Targets and blind zones” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將孔口座標與實測方位投到同一里程剖面，標出各孔的覆蓋範圍及無資料區。以已知出露面或追加交叉孔驗證目標是否截交；地質師須逐項確認原先問題已回答，不能以完成鑽孔數量代替調查品質。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot surveyed collars and measured bearings on one chainage section, explicitly marking unsampled zones. Compare target intersections with mapped exposures or independent crossing holes. The geologist must confirm which original questions have been answered; completing the planned number of holes is not itself an acceptance criterion. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：調查圖必須同時顯示孔跡與未取樣體積，將不能排除的地質假說交由主管地質工程師決定追加調查或保留控制措施。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Show both trajectories and unsampled volumes on the investigation drawing, and refer unresolved geological hypotheses to the responsible geotechnical engineer for additional evidence or retained controls.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若將兩個無異常孔之間直接填成完整岩體，偏斜斷層可能被漏掉；開挖後突然出現破碎帶，原先支護與水處理預案便失去依據。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Interpolating intact rock between two uneventful holes can miss an oblique fault. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將孔口座標與實測方位投到同一里程剖面，標出各孔的覆蓋範圍及無資料區。以已知出露面或追加交叉孔驗證目標是否截交；地質師須逐項確認原先問題已回答，不能以完成鑽孔數量代替調查品質。
knowledge.textEn: Plot surveyed collars and measured bearings on one chainage section, explicitly marking unsampled zones. Compare target intersections with mapped exposures or independent crossing holes. The geologist must confirm which original questions have been answered; completing the planned number of holes is not itself an acceptance criterion.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 調查圖必須同時顯示孔跡與未取樣體積，將不能排除的地質假說交由主管地質工程師決定追加調查或保留控制措施。
knowledge.textEn: Show both trajectories and unsampled volumes on the investigation drawing, and refer unresolved geological hypotheses to the responsible geotechnical engineer for additional evidence or retained controls.

quiz.question: 要驗證「探測目標與盲區」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Targets and blind zones"?
options: 將孔口座標與實測方位投到同一里程剖面，標出各孔的覆蓋範圍及無資料區。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
兩種儀器都沒有警報就代表風險機率必定為零。
optionsEn: Plot surveyed collars and measured bearings on one chainage section, explicitly marking unsampled zones.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
No alarm from two instruments necessarily means zero hazard probability.
quiz.explanation: 將孔口座標與實測方位投到同一里程剖面，標出各孔的覆蓋範圍及無資料區。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Plot surveyed collars and measured bearings on one chainage section, explicitly marking unsampled zones. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 探測目標與盲區：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Targets and blind zones: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「探測目標與盲區」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Targets and blind zones” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若將兩個無異常孔之間直接填成完整岩體，偏斜斷層可能被漏掉；開挖後突然出現破碎帶，原先支護與水處理預案便失去依據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Interpolating intact rock between two uneventful holes can miss an oblique fault. Unexpected broken ground during excavation then undermines the original support and water-management assumptions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若將兩個無異常孔之間直接填成完整岩體，偏斜斷層可能被漏掉；開挖後突然出現破碎帶，原先支護與水處理預案便失去依據。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Unexpected broken ground during excavation then undermines the original support and water-management assumptions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鑽得越深就一定已排除整個掌子面前方風險。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Greater drilling depth always eliminates risk across the entire face ahead." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「探測目標與盲區」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Targets and blind zones" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若將兩個無異常孔之間直接填成完整岩體，偏斜斷層可能被漏掉；開挖後突然出現破碎帶，原先支護與水處理預案便失去依據。
孔口方向正確即可把所有孔內位置當成直線。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Interpolating intact rock between two uneventful holes can miss an oblique fault.

quiz.explanationEn: Interpolating intact rock between two uneventful holes can miss an oblique fault. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 孔跡與角度誤差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Trajectory and angular error: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「孔跡與角度誤差」如何影響隧道超前探測鑽孔的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Trajectory and angular error” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Probe drilling ahead of tunnel faces”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 孔軸會因層面、鑽具剛度與鑽進偏心而彎曲，孔口方向只是起點。長孔把很小的角度偏差放大成可觀的平面位置差，因此地層交界里程必須附帶孔跡品質，不能只用鑽桿長度定位。 假設直孔100 m有1°方位偏差，末端側向差100 sin1°=1.745 m；這不是隨機誤差的標準差。 若鋼製設備使磁方位偏轉而未被識別，孔跡可能看似平順卻整體錯位；不同孔的同一地層因此被誤判為錯動或厚度變化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「孔跡與角度誤差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Boreholes curve under bedding effects, drill-string stiffness and eccentric drilling. Collar orientation describes only the starting direction. A small angular bias produces a substantial positional difference over a long hole, so an interpreted contact needs trajectory quality as well as rod length. An assumed straight 100 m hole with a 1° bearing bias has a lateral offset of 100 sin1°=1.745 m; this is not a random-error standard deviation. Unrecognized magnetic interference from steel equipment can shift an apparently smooth trajectory. The same geological contact in different holes may then be mistaken for fault displacement or changing thickness. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Trajectory and angular error” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「孔口方向正確即可把所有孔內位置當成直線。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A correct collar direction makes every downhole position a straight-line projection." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「孔跡與角度誤差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Trajectory and angular error”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 孔跡與角度誤差
knowledge.text: 孔軸會因層面、鑽具剛度與鑽進偏心而彎曲，孔口方向只是起點。長孔把很小的角度偏差放大成可觀的平面位置差，因此地層交界里程必須附帶孔跡品質，不能只用鑽桿長度定位。
knowledge.textEn: Boreholes curve under bedding effects, drill-string stiffness and eccentric drilling. Collar orientation describes only the starting direction.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：孔口方向正確即可把所有孔內位置當成直線。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A correct collar direction makes every downhole position a straight-line projection. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「孔跡與角度誤差」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Trajectory and angular error" is correct?
options: 孔口方向正確即可把所有孔內位置當成直線。
比能越大就能直接換算出越高的岩石抗壓強度。
孔軸會因層面、鑽具剛度與鑽進偏心而彎曲，孔口方向只是起點。
optionsEn: A correct collar direction makes every downhole position a straight-line projection.
Higher specific energy directly determines a higher uniaxial rock strength.
Boreholes curve under bedding effects, drill-string stiffness and eccentric drilling.
quiz.explanation: 孔軸會因層面、鑽具剛度與鑽進偏心而彎曲，孔口方向只是起點。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Boreholes curve under bedding effects, drill-string stiffness and eccentric drilling. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 孔跡與角度誤差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Trajectory and angular error: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「孔跡與角度誤差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Trajectory and angular error” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設直孔100 m有1°方位偏差，末端側向差100 sin1°=1.745 m；這不是隨機誤差的標準差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed straight 100 m hole with a 1° bearing bias has a lateral offset of 100 sin1°=1.745 m; this is not a random-error standard deviation. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：使用適合現場磁性環境的孔內測斜方法，與孔口獨立測量連接並保留測站間距。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use a deviation survey suited to the magnetic environment and connect it to an independent collar survey.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed straight 100 m hole with a 1° bearing bias has a lateral offset of 100 sin1°=1.745 m; this is not a random-error standard deviation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「孔跡與角度誤差」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Trajectory and angular error", which statement holds?
options: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
返水比供水多就足以推算整座隧道的湧水量。

optionsEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
Excess return flow is sufficient to predict total tunnel groundwater inflow.
A permeability from one borehole applies unconditionally along the entire tunnel.

steps.title: 孔跡與角度誤差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Trajectory and angular error: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「孔跡與角度誤差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Trajectory and angular error” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 使用適合現場磁性環境的孔內測斜方法，與孔口獨立測量連接並保留測站間距。把正反向讀值和已知控制段比較，釐清系統偏差；地層位置的允收精度須由調查目的訂定，不能只引用儀器型錄精度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use a deviation survey suited to the magnetic environment and connect it to an independent collar survey. Retain station spacing and compare reverse readings with a known control interval. Specify acceptable contact-location uncertainty from the investigation purpose rather than the instrument brochure alone. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接孔跡時提供原始角度、坐標基準、修正方法及誤差範圍，讓設計者重建地層位置；大於目的精度的偏差由測量主管核准處置。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Deliver raw angles, coordinate datum, correction method and uncertainty so the designer can reconstruct contacts; the survey lead must resolve deviations exceeding the purpose-specific positional requirement.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若鋼製設備使磁方位偏轉而未被識別，孔跡可能看似平順卻整體錯位；不同孔的同一地層因此被誤判為錯動或厚度變化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unrecognized magnetic interference from steel equipment can shift an apparently smooth trajectory. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 鑽進比能辨識：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Drilling specific energy: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「鑽進比能辨識」如何影響隧道超前探測鑽孔的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Drilling specific energy” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Probe drilling ahead of tunnel faces”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 扭矩與轉速提供破岩功率，除以切削體積速率得到旋轉比能。比能上升可能來自硬岩，也可能是磨鈍鑽頭、孔壁摩擦或堵塞；只有在鑽具與操作條件可比時，才可把趨勢視為地質線索。 假設T=200 N·m、每轉進尺0.02 m、孔徑0.1 m，E=2πT/(πD²p/4)=8.0 MJ/m³，僅含旋轉功。 磨耗後的能耗增加若全被解讀為高強度岩，可能低估軟弱夾層；硬度圖與取樣矛盾時應回查機械狀態，而非刪除不符合預期的岩心紀錄。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「鑽進比能辨識」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Torque and rotation give cutting power, which divided by excavated volume rate gives rotational specific energy. Rising energy may indicate harder rock, but also a worn bit, wall friction or blockage. Geological interpretation therefore requires comparable tooling and operating conditions. Assume T=200 N·m, penetration p=0.02 m/revolution and D=0.1 m. E=2πT/(πD²p/4)=8.0 MJ/m³, accounting only for rotational work. Treating wear-related energy increase as stronger rock may conceal a weak interbed. Disagreement with samples should trigger a tooling review, not deletion of inconvenient core observations. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Drilling specific energy” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「比能越大就能直接換算出越高的岩石抗壓強度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Higher specific energy directly determines a higher uniaxial rock strength." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「鑽進比能辨識」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Drilling specific energy”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鑽進比能辨識
knowledge.text: 扭矩與轉速提供破岩功率，除以切削體積速率得到旋轉比能。比能上升可能來自硬岩，也可能是磨鈍鑽頭、孔壁摩擦或堵塞；只有在鑽具與操作條件可比時，才可把趨勢視為地質線索。
knowledge.textEn: Torque and rotation give cutting power, which divided by excavated volume rate gives rotational specific energy. Rising energy may indicate harder rock, but also a worn bit, wall friction or blockage.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：比能越大就能直接換算出越高的岩石抗壓強度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Higher specific energy directly determines a higher uniaxial rock strength. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鑽進比能辨識」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Drilling specific energy" is correct?
options: 扭矩與轉速提供破岩功率，除以切削體積速率得到旋轉比能。
比能越大就能直接換算出越高的岩石抗壓強度。
岩屑從孔口流出時的鑽頭深度就是它的原始深度。
optionsEn: Torque and rotation give cutting power, which divided by excavated volume rate gives rotational specific energy.
Higher specific energy directly determines a higher uniaxial rock strength.
Bit depth when cuttings emerge is their original geological depth.
quiz.explanation: 扭矩與轉速提供破岩功率，除以切削體積速率得到旋轉比能。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Torque and rotation give cutting power, which divided by excavated volume rate gives rotational specific energy. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鑽進比能辨識：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Drilling specific energy: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鑽進比能辨識」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Drilling specific energy” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設T=200 N·m、每轉進尺0.02 m、孔徑0.1 m，E=2πT/(πD²p/4)=8.0 MJ/m³，僅含旋轉功。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume T=200 N·m, penetration p=0.02 m/revolution and D=0.1 m. E=2πT/(πD²p/4)=8.0 MJ/m³, accounting only for rotational work. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將扭矩、轉速、推力、進尺與換鑽頭時間同步繪圖，與岩屑及岩心描述比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize torque, speed, thrust, penetration and bit-change times with cuttings and core descriptions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設T=200 N·m、每轉進尺0.02 m、孔徑0.1 m，E=2πT/(πD²p/4)=8.0 MJ/m³，僅含旋轉功。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume T=200 N·m, penetration p=0.02 m/revolution and D=0.1 m. E=2πT/(πD²p/4)=8.0 MJ/m³, accounting only for rotational work.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「鑽進比能辨識」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Drilling specific energy", which statement holds?
options: 兩孔表壓相同就代表它們具有相同的地下水水頭。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
兩種儀器都沒有警報就代表風險機率必定為零。
optionsEn: Equal gauge pressures in two holes imply equal groundwater head.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
No alarm from two instruments necessarily means zero hazard probability.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鑽進比能辨識：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Drilling specific energy: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鑽進比能辨識」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Drilling specific energy” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將扭矩、轉速、推力、進尺與換鑽頭時間同步繪圖，與岩屑及岩心描述比較。先剔除接桿與空轉段，再確認感測器量程及時間戳；若訊號變化只跟換具同時發生，不接受為地層界面的獨立證據。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize torque, speed, thrust, penetration and bit-change times with cuttings and core descriptions. Exclude rod changes and idle rotation, then check sensor range and timestamps. A change coincident only with tool replacement is not accepted as independent evidence of a geological contact. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以同一鑽頭生命週期建立比較基線，把維護事件列在地質日誌旁；未經場址校準的能量指標只可作為取樣優先順序。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Build comparison baselines within a single bit life and place maintenance events beside the geology log; an uncalibrated energy index may prioritize sampling but cannot replace strength testing.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：磨耗後的能耗增加若全被解讀為高強度岩，可能低估軟弱夾層；硬度圖與取樣矛盾時應回查機械狀態，而非刪除不符合預期的岩心紀錄。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating wear-related energy increase as stronger rock may conceal a weak interbed. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將扭矩、轉速、推力、進尺與換鑽頭時間同步繪圖，與岩屑及岩心描述比較。先剔除接桿與空轉段，再確認感測器量程及時間戳；若訊號變化只跟換具同時發生，不接受為地層界面的獨立證據。
knowledge.textEn: Synchronize torque, speed, thrust, penetration and bit-change times with cuttings and core descriptions. Exclude rod changes and idle rotation, then check sensor range and timestamps. A change coincident only with tool replacement is not accepted as independent evidence of a geological contact.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以同一鑽頭生命週期建立比較基線，把維護事件列在地質日誌旁；未經場址校準的能量指標只可作為取樣優先順序。
knowledge.textEn: Build comparison baselines within a single bit life and place maintenance events beside the geology log; an uncalibrated energy index may prioritize sampling but cannot replace strength testing.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鑽進比能辨識」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Drilling specific energy"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
調查報告交付百分之百就等於所有地質風險已消失。
將扭矩、轉速、推力、進尺與換鑽頭時間同步繪圖，與岩屑及岩心描述比較。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Delivering the entire investigation report means all geological risk has disappeared.
Synchronize torque, speed, thrust, penetration and bit-change times with cuttings and core descriptions.
quiz.explanation: 將扭矩、轉速、推力、進尺與換鑽頭時間同步繪圖，與岩屑及岩心描述比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Synchronize torque, speed, thrust, penetration and bit-change times with cuttings and core descriptions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 鑽進比能辨識：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Drilling specific energy: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鑽進比能辨識」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Drilling specific energy” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 磨耗後的能耗增加若全被解讀為高強度岩，可能低估軟弱夾層；硬度圖與取樣矛盾時應回查機械狀態，而非刪除不符合預期的岩心紀錄。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating wear-related energy increase as stronger rock may conceal a weak interbed. Disagreement with samples should trigger a tooling review, not deletion of inconvenient core observations. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：磨耗後的能耗增加若全被解讀為高強度岩，可能低估軟弱夾層；硬度圖與取樣矛盾時應回查機械狀態，而非刪除不符合預期的岩心紀錄。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Disagreement with samples should trigger a tooling review, not deletion of inconvenient core observations.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「比能越大就能直接換算出越高的岩石抗壓強度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Higher specific energy directly determines a higher uniaxial rock strength." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 磨耗後的能耗增加若全被解讀為高強度岩，可能低估軟弱夾層；硬度圖與取樣矛盾時應回查機械狀態，而非刪除不符合預期的岩心紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: Treating wear-related energy increase as stronger rock may conceal a weak interbed. Disagreement with samples should trigger a tooling review, not deletion of inconvenient core observations.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鑽進比能辨識」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Drilling specific energy" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 磨耗後的能耗增加若全被解讀為高強度岩，可能低估軟弱夾層；硬度圖與取樣矛盾時應回查機械狀態，而非刪除不符合預期的岩心紀錄。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
岩屑從孔口流出時的鑽頭深度就是它的原始深度。

A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.

steps.title: 岩屑輸送延遲：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cuttings transport lag: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「岩屑輸送延遲」如何影響隧道超前探測鑽孔的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cuttings transport lag” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Probe drilling ahead of tunnel faces”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 岩屑到達孔口時已落後鑽頭位置，且不同粒徑在回流中速度不同。若依回收時間直接指定地層深度，薄弱夾層會被向深處平移並混合；回流路徑、流量與沉積需要共同解釋。 假設回流容積0.15 m³、流量0.003 m³/s，平均延遲50 s；進尺0.01 m/s時深度偏移0.50 m。 把延遲岩屑當作即時訊號會錯置含水或破碎帶，尤其薄層可能被多次混樣抹平；其結果是預警里程看似精確，實際已過了需要評估的區段。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「岩屑輸送延遲」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cuttings arrive at the collar after the bit has advanced, and different sizes travel at different speeds. Assigning depth from recovery time alone displaces and mixes thin layers. Return-path volume, flow and settling must be interpreted together. With assumed return volume 0.15 m³ and flow 0.003 m³/s, mean delay is 50 s; advancement at 0.01 m/s shifts assigned depth by 0.50 m. Interpreting delayed cuttings as an immediate signal misplaces wet or fractured zones. Thin layers can be averaged away, producing a precise-looking warning chainage after the critical interval has passed. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cuttings transport lag” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「岩屑從孔口流出時的鑽頭深度就是它的原始深度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Bit depth when cuttings emerge is their original geological depth." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「岩屑輸送延遲」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Cuttings transport lag”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.
