quiz.explanationEn: Aliasing can masquerade as geological attenuation; resampling smooths the curve but does not correct it. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「疊加與相關雜訊」與「測線幾何與偏移」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Stacking and correlated noise" and "Survey geometry and migration": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 疊加與相關雜訊：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Stacking and correlated noise: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「疊加與相關雜訊」如何影響隧道震波地質探測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stacking and correlated noise” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seismic prediction ahead of tunnel excavation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 重複訊號相干相加，獨立零均值雜訊的標準差只按平方根增加，故疊加可改善訊雜比。持續機械振動若與測次同步，卻也會相干累積，不能用測次數保證品質。 假設16筆獨立等品質訊號疊加，振幅訊雜比提高√16=4倍，20log10(4)=12.04 dB。 把相干機械雜訊誤當隨機雜訊會在疊加後產生更清晰的假反射，品質指標反而變好；若只選漂亮測次，報告會掩蓋訊號的不穩定性。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「疊加與相關雜訊」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Repeated signals add coherently while independent zero-mean noise grows only with the square root of count. Synchronous mechanical vibration also adds coherently, so record count alone cannot guarantee improved quality. Stacking an assumed 16 independent equal-quality records improves amplitude signal-to-noise ratio by √16=4, or 20log10(4)=12.04 dB. Coherent machine noise can become a clearer false reflector after stacking while superficial quality indicators improve. Selecting only attractive records conceals instability and biases the final interpretation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Stacking and correlated noise” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「任何雜訊都會按疊加筆數的平方根規則消失。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every kind of noise decreases according to the square-root stacking rule." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「疊加與相關雜訊」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Stacking and correlated noise”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 疊加與相關雜訊
knowledge.text: 重複訊號相干相加，獨立零均值雜訊的標準差只按平方根增加，故疊加可改善訊雜比。持續機械振動若與測次同步，卻也會相干累積，不能用測次數保證品質。
knowledge.textEn: Repeated signals add coherently while independent zero-mean noise grows only with the square root of count. Synchronous mechanical vibration also adds coherently, so record count alone cannot guarantee improved quality.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：任何雜訊都會按疊加筆數的平方根規則消失。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every kind of noise decreases according to the square-root stacking rule. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「疊加與相關雜訊」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Stacking and correlated noise" is correct?
options: 任何雜訊都會按疊加筆數的平方根規則消失。

重複訊號相干相加，獨立零均值雜訊的標準差只按平方根增加，故疊加可改善訊雜比。
optionsEn: Every kind of noise decreases according to the square-root stacking rule.
All reflections measured at a sidewall must originate directly ahead of the face.
Repeated signals add coherently while independent zero-mean noise grows only with the square root of count.
quiz.explanation: 重複訊號相干相加，獨立零均值雜訊的標準差只按平方根增加，故疊加可改善訊雜比。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 疊加與相關雜訊：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stacking and correlated noise: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「疊加與相關雜訊」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Stacking and correlated noise” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設16筆獨立等品質訊號疊加，振幅訊雜比提高√16=4倍，20log10(4)=12.04 dB。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Stacking an assumed 16 independent equal-quality records improves amplitude signal-to-noise ratio by √16=4, or 20log10(4)=12.04 dB. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較不同子集合的疊加結果及背景振動時段，量測噪音是否隨平方根縮減；若異常只在特定機具運轉時存在，需以獨立時段或替代量測驗證。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare stacks from different subsets and background-vibration periods, testing whether noise follows square-root reduction; an anomaly tied to one operating machine requires an independent time window or alternative measurement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 比較不同子集合的疊加結果及背景振動時段，量測噪音是否隨平方根縮減；若異常只在特定機具運轉時存在，需以獨立時段或替代量測驗證。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把相干機械雜訊誤當隨機雜訊會在疊加後產生更清晰的假反射，品質指標反而變好；若只選漂亮測次，報告會掩蓋訊號的不穩定性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 測線幾何與偏移：機制與系統路徑

Old face chainage or incorrect sidewall coordinates shift the entire image. Responses may occur too early or late, with the discrepancy wrongly blamed on inherently unpredictable geology. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Survey geometry and migration” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed reflector range 80 m and azimuth uncertainty 5°, lateral position scale is 80sin5°=6.97 m; chainage error alone is insufficient. stages.description: 本階段聚焦「波速與彈性假設」與「衰減與振幅混淆」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Velocity and elastic assumptions" and "Attenuation and amplitude ambiguity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 波速與彈性假設：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Velocity and elastic assumptions: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「波速與彈性假設」如何影響隧道震波地質探測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Velocity and elastic assumptions” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seismic prediction ahead of tunnel excavation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 動態波速對應小應變快速載入，不能直接當成長時間靜態變形模數。裂隙閉合、飽和與各向異性使兩者差異更大，任何由波速推算的模數都必須保留密度和均質等向假設。 假設ρ=2500 kg/m³、Vs=2000 m/s，Gdyn=ρVs²=10 GPa；Vs增加10%使Gdyn增加21%。 把高頻動態模數直接放入長期收斂模型通常會低估變形，裂隙岩尤為明顯；模數看似精確卻缺少應變範圍，模型結果便不可追溯。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「波速與彈性假設」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Dynamic velocities describe small-strain rapid loading rather than long-term static stiffness. Crack closure, saturation and anisotropy increase the distinction. Moduli inferred from waves must retain density and homogeneous isotropic assumptions. For assumed ρ=2500 kg/m³ and Vs=2000 m/s, Gdyn=ρVs²=10 GPa; a 10% rise in Vs raises Gdyn by 21%. Direct use of high-frequency dynamic modulus in a long-term convergence model can underpredict movement, especially in jointed rock. A precise modulus without strain-scale context makes the result untraceable. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Velocity and elastic assumptions” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「波速推得的動態模數可以直接代表長期靜態變形。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A velocity-derived dynamic modulus directly represents long-term static deformation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「波速與彈性假設」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Velocity and elastic assumptions”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 波速與彈性假設
knowledge.text: 動態波速對應小應變快速載入，不能直接當成長時間靜態變形模數。裂隙閉合、飽和與各向異性使兩者差異更大，任何由波速推算的模數都必須保留密度和均質等向假設。
knowledge.textEn: Dynamic velocities describe small-strain rapid loading rather than long-term static stiffness. Crack closure, saturation and anisotropy increase the distinction.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：波速推得的動態模數可以直接代表長期靜態變形。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A velocity-derived dynamic modulus directly represents long-term static deformation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「波速與彈性假設」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Velocity and elastic assumptions" is correct?
options: 波速推得的動態模數可以直接代表長期靜態變形。
動態波速對應小應變快速載入，不能直接當成長時間靜態變形模數。
只要遠處振幅較小就能證明前方存在含水破碎帶。
optionsEn: A velocity-derived dynamic modulus directly represents long-term static deformation.
Dynamic velocities describe small-strain rapid loading rather than long-term static stiffness.
A smaller distant amplitude proves a water-bearing fractured zone lies ahead.
quiz.explanation: 動態波速對應小應變快速載入，不能直接當成長時間靜態變形模數。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Dynamic velocities describe small-strain rapid loading rather than long-term static stiffness. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 波速與彈性假設：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Velocity and elastic assumptions: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「波速與彈性假設」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Velocity and elastic assumptions” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設ρ=2500 kg/m³、Vs=2000 m/s，Gdyn=ρVs²=10 GPa；Vs增加10%使Gdyn增加21%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed ρ=2500 kg/m³ and Vs=2000 m/s, Gdyn=ρVs²=10 GPa; a 10% rise in Vs raises Gdyn by 21%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較不同方向的P與S波速度並附密度來源，再與相同岩性靜態試驗分開繪圖；若要用於變形計算，必須有場址校準與應變尺度說明，而非以一個固定折減係數自動接受。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare directional P- and S-wave velocities with documented density, plotting static tests separately; deformation use requires site calibration and strain-scale justification rather than automatic acceptance through one reduction factor.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設ρ=2500 kg/m³、Vs=2000 m/s，Gdyn=ρVs²=10 GPa；Vs增加10%使Gdyn增加21%。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed ρ=2500 kg/m³ and Vs=2000 m/s, Gdyn=ρVs²=10 GPa; a 10% rise in Vs raises Gdyn by 21%.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「波速與彈性假設」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Velocity and elastic assumptions", which statement holds?
options: 只統計成功預警案例就能完整評估探測可靠度。
反射走時乘波速就是距離，不必考慮去程回程。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: Counting successful warning examples alone fully evaluates prediction reliability.
Multiplying reflection travel time by velocity gives distance without accounting for the return path.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 波速與彈性假設：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Velocity and elastic assumptions: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「波速與彈性假設」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Velocity and elastic assumptions” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較不同方向的P與S波速度並附密度來源，再與相同岩性靜態試驗分開繪圖；若要用於變形計算，必須有場址校準與應變尺度說明，而非以一個固定折減係數自動接受。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把高頻動態模數直接放入長期收斂模型通常會低估變形，裂隙岩尤為明顯；模數看似精確卻缺少應變範圍，模型結果便不可追溯。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare directional P- and S-wave velocities with documented density, plotting static tests separately; deformation use requires site calibration and strain-scale justification rather than automatic acceptance through one reduction factor. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Direct use of high-frequency dynamic modulus in a long-term convergence model can underpredict movement, especially in jointed rock. A precise modulus without strain-scale context makes the result untraceable. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄波速與彈性假設的資料來源與適用條件。比較不同方向的P與S波速度並附密度來源，再與相同岩性靜態試驗分開繪圖；若要用於變形計算，必須有場址校準與應變尺度說明，而非以一個固定折減係數自動接受。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for velocity and elastic assumptions. Compare directional P- and S-wave velocities with documented density, plotting static tests separately; deformation use requires site calibration and strain-scale justification rather than automatic acceptance through one reduction factor.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把高頻動態模數直接放入長期收斂模型通常會低估變形，裂隙岩尤為明顯；模數看似精確卻缺少應變範圍，模型結果便不可追溯。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Direct use of high-frequency dynamic modulus in a long-term convergence model can underpredict movement, especially in jointed rock. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較不同方向的P與S波速度並附密度來源，再與相同岩性靜態試驗分開繪圖；若要用於變形計算，必須有場址校準與應變尺度說明，而非以一個固定折減係數自動接受。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把高頻動態模數直接放入長期收斂模型通常會低估變形，裂隙岩尤為明顯；模數看似精確卻缺少應變範圍，模型結果便不可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Compare directional P- and S-wave velocities with documented density, plotting static tests separately; deformation use requires site calibration and strain-scale justification rather than automatic acceptance through one reduction factor. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Direct use of high-frequency dynamic modulus in a long-term convergence model can underpredict movement, especially in jointed rock. A precise modulus without strain-scale context makes the result untraceable.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄波速與彈性假設的資料來源與適用條件。比較不同方向的P與S波速度並附密度來源，再與相同岩性靜態試驗分開繪圖；若要用於變形計算，必須有場址校準與應變尺度說明，而非以一個固定折減係數自動接受。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for velocity and elastic assumptions. Compare directional P- and S-wave velocities with documented density, plotting static tests separately; deformation use requires site calibration and strain-scale justification rather than automatic acceptance through one reduction factor.

quiz.question: 要驗證「波速與彈性假設」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Velocity and elastic assumptions"?
options: 比較不同方向的P與S波速度並附密度來源，再與相同岩性靜態試驗分開繪圖；若要用於變形計算，必須有場址校準與應變尺度說明，而非以一個固定折減係數自動接受。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
取樣後再提高插值點數即可完全修復時間混疊。
optionsEn: Compare directional P- and S-wave velocities with documented density, plotting static tests separately.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Adding interpolation points after acquisition completely repairs temporal aliasing.
quiz.explanation: 比較不同方向的P與S波速度並附密度來源，再與相同岩性靜態試驗分開繪圖；若要用於變形計算，必須有場址校準與應變尺度說明，而非以一個固定折減係數自動接受。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare directional P- and S-wave velocities with documented density, plotting static tests separately; deformation use requires site calibration and strain-scale justification rather than automatic acceptance through one reduction factor. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 波速與彈性假設：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Velocity and elastic assumptions: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「波速與彈性假設」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Velocity and elastic assumptions” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把高頻動態模數直接放入長期收斂模型通常會低估變形，裂隙岩尤為明顯；模數看似精確卻缺少應變範圍，模型結果便不可追溯。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Direct use of high-frequency dynamic modulus in a long-term convergence model can underpredict movement, especially in jointed rock. A precise modulus without strain-scale context makes the result untraceable. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把高頻動態模數直接放入長期收斂模型通常會低估變形，裂隙岩尤為明顯；模數看似精確卻缺少應變範圍，模型結果便不可追溯。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A precise modulus without strain-scale context makes the result untraceable.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「波速推得的動態模數可以直接代表長期靜態變形。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A velocity-derived dynamic modulus directly represents long-term static deformation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把高頻動態模數直接放入長期收斂模型通常會低估變形，裂隙岩尤為明顯；模數看似精確卻缺少應變範圍，模型結果便不可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Direct use of high-frequency dynamic modulus in a long-term convergence model can underpredict movement, especially in jointed rock. A precise modulus without strain-scale context makes the result untraceable.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「波速與彈性假設」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Velocity and elastic assumptions" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把高頻動態模數直接放入長期收斂模型通常會低估變形，裂隙岩尤為明顯；模數看似精確卻缺少應變範圍，模型結果便不可追溯。
只要遠處振幅較小就能證明前方存在含水破碎帶。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Direct use of high-frequency dynamic modulus in a long-term convergence model can underpredict movement, especially in jointed rock.
A smaller distant amplitude proves a water-bearing fractured zone lies ahead.
quiz.explanation: 把高頻動態模數直接放入長期收斂模型通常會低估變形，裂隙岩尤為明顯；模數看似精確卻缺少應變範圍，模型結果便不可追溯。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Direct use of high-frequency dynamic modulus in a long-term convergence model can underpredict movement, especially in jointed rock. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 衰減與振幅混淆：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Attenuation and amplitude ambiguity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「衰減與振幅混淆」如何影響隧道震波地質探測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Attenuation and amplitude ambiguity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seismic prediction ahead of tunnel excavation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 振幅沿路徑受材料吸收、散射和幾何擴散共同減弱。接收器耦合不良也會降低振幅，因此衰減參數的反演需要校準源強與接收增益，不能只比較遠近兩個峰值。 假設純指數衰減A/A0=e^(−αx)，α=0.01 m⁻¹、x=50 m，比例e⁻⁰·⁵=0.607；未計擴散。 鬆動感測器可讓完好岩體看似強衰減帶，若再由此推測地下水會放大誤判；反之自動增益補償也可能掩蓋真實的遠距訊號衰減。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「衰減與振幅混淆」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Amplitude decays through absorption, scattering and geometric spreading. Poor receiver coupling also reduces amplitude, so attenuation inversion requires source and receiver calibration rather than a comparison of two peaks alone. Assume purely exponential decay A/A0=e^(−αx), α=0.01 m⁻¹ and x=50 m. The ratio is e⁻⁰·⁵=0.607, excluding geometric spreading. A loose receiver can make intact rock resemble a strongly attenuating zone and encourage false groundwater inference; automatic gain correction can conversely conceal genuine attenuation at distance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Attenuation and amplitude ambiguity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.title: 衰減與振幅混淆
knowledge.text: 振幅沿路徑受材料吸收、散射和幾何擴散共同減弱。接收器耦合不良也會降低振幅，因此衰減參數的反演需要校準源強與接收增益，不能只比較遠近兩個峰值。
knowledge.textEn: Amplitude decays through absorption, scattering and geometric spreading. Poor receiver coupling also reduces amplitude, so attenuation inversion requires source and receiver calibration rather than a comparison of two peaks alone.

knowledge.text: 誤解：只要遠處振幅較小就能證明前方存在含水破碎帶。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

steps.title: 衰減與振幅混淆：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設純指數衰減A/A0=e^(−αx)，α=0.01 m⁻¹、x=50 m，比例e⁻⁰·⁵=0.607；未計擴散。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume purely exponential decay A/A0=e^(−αx), α=0.01 m⁻¹ and x=50 m. The ratio is e⁻⁰·⁵=0.607, excluding geometric spreading. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.title: 走時誤差傳播：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Travel-time uncertainty propagation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seismic prediction ahead of tunnel excavation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 速度與走時各有不確定性，定位可信度由兩者共同控制。若速度來自同一批到時資料，誤差可能相關；平方和公式只適用獨立小誤差，不能把未知系統偏差包裝成高精度標準差。 假設d=80 m、速度標準不確定5%、走時2%，獨立時ud=80√(0.05²+0.02²)=4.31 m。 忽略速度不確定性會使時間拾取再精準也無法改善真實定位；以窄信賴帶掩蓋錯誤速度模型，可能讓探孔錯過原本應驗證的異常位置。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「走時誤差傳播」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Velocity and time jointly control location uncertainty. If velocity is estimated from the same arrivals, errors may correlate. Root-sum-square propagation applies only to small independent errors, not unidentified systematic bias. Assume d=80 m with independent relative standard uncertainties of 5% in velocity and 2% in time; ud=80√(0.05²+0.02²)=4.31 m. Ignoring velocity uncertainty prevents precise timing from improving actual location. A narrow confidence band around the wrong velocity model can direct verification holes away from the true anomaly. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Travel-time uncertainty propagation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

optionsEn: Velocity and time jointly control location uncertainty.

quiz.explanation: 速度與走時各有不確定性，定位可信度由兩者共同控制。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 走時誤差傳播：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Travel-time uncertainty propagation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「走時誤差傳播」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Travel-time uncertainty propagation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設d=80 m、速度標準不確定5%、走時2%，獨立時ud=80√(0.05²+0.02²)=4.31 m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume d=80 m with independent relative standard uncertainties of 5% in velocity and 2% in time; ud=80√(0.05²+0.02²)=4.31 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：由不同判讀者盲選到時，對照速度模型敏感度及儀器時間校準；報告分列隨機、系統與模型誤差，並用已知界面檢驗實際覆蓋率，而不把一個標準差當成確定界線。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Have independent interpreters pick arrivals blindly and compare velocity sensitivity with clock calibration; separate random, systematic and model errors and test coverage at known interfaces rather than treating one standard deviation as a definite boundary.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 走時誤差傳播：試驗與驗證

steps.instructionEn: Have independent interpreters pick arrivals blindly and compare velocity sensitivity with clock calibration; separate random, systematic and model errors and test coverage at known interfaces rather than treating one standard deviation as a definite boundary. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Ignoring velocity uncertainty prevents precise timing from improving actual location. A narrow confidence band around the wrong velocity model can direct verification holes away from the true anomaly. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 走時誤差傳播：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Travel-time uncertainty propagation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「走時誤差傳播」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Travel-time uncertainty propagation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略速度不確定性會使時間拾取再精準也無法改善真實定位；以窄信賴帶掩蓋錯誤速度模型，可能讓探孔錯過原本應驗證的異常位置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring velocity uncertainty prevents precise timing from improving actual location. A narrow confidence band around the wrong velocity model can direct verification holes away from the true anomaly. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：忽略速度不確定性會使時間拾取再精準也無法改善真實定位；以窄信賴帶掩蓋錯誤速度模型，可能讓探孔錯過原本應驗證的異常位置。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A narrow confidence band around the wrong velocity model can direct verification holes away from the true anomaly.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「走時拾取非常準確時，就可以忽略波速模型誤差。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Very precise arrival picking makes velocity-model uncertainty irrelevant to location." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忽略速度不確定性會使時間拾取再精準也無法改善真實定位；以窄信賴帶掩蓋錯誤速度模型，可能讓探孔錯過原本應驗證的異常位置。
knowledge.textEn: Ignoring velocity uncertainty prevents precise timing from improving actual location. A narrow confidence band around the wrong velocity model can direct verification holes away from the true anomaly.

quiz.explanationEn: Ignoring velocity uncertainty prevents precise timing from improving actual location. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 預測與揭露對照：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Prediction and exposure comparison: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「預測與揭露對照」如何影響隧道震波地質探測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Prediction and exposure comparison” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seismic prediction ahead of tunnel excavation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 預測須在開挖揭露前固定版本，否則事後調整解釋會掩蓋漏判。判斷品質同時看成功預警與無異常區的錯警報，並把不可見範圍列出，不能讓彩色影像代替可核對的假說。 假設已知10個異常中預測8個，靈敏度80%；另有20個正常區錯報3個，假陽性率15%，兩指標分列。 僅展示成功案例會使預測能力看似完美，漏判和假警報都被消失；依這種偏差資料減少探孔，反而使未被震波捕捉的風險缺乏最後驗證。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「預測與揭露對照」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Freeze predictions before excavation exposes the ground, or retrospective interpretation hides misses. Assess both successful warnings and false alarms in quiet zones and state blind areas; a colored image is not a testable hypothesis. If 8 of an assumed 10 anomalies are predicted, sensitivity is 80%; 3 false alarms among 20 normal intervals give 15% false-positive rate, reported separately. Presenting only successful examples makes prediction appear flawless by removing misses and false alarms. Reducing probing on that biased evidence leaves seismically undetected hazards without independent verification. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Prediction and exposure comparison” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只統計成功預警案例就能完整評估探測可靠度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Counting successful warning examples alone fully evaluates prediction reliability." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「預測與揭露對照」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.text: 誤解：只統計成功預警案例就能完整評估探測可靠度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

title: 鑽孔岩心記錄與岩體分類
summary: 本課聚焦從回次、節理與試驗代表性推導岩體分類的適用邊界。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。
summaryEn: This course focuses on derive rock-mass classification boundaries from runs, discontinuities and test representativeness. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設鑽進3.0 m、岩心2.7 m，TCR=90%，缺失0.3 m；缺失所在深度仍不唯一。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設2 m回次內長度至少100 mm的健全岩心合計1.4 m，RQD=1.4/2×100=70%。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed advance 3.0 m and recovered core 2.7 m, TCR=90% and loss=0.3 m; the location of that loss remains nonunique. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If sound pieces at least 100 mm long total an assumed 1.4 m within a 2 m run, RQD=1.4/2×100=70%. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「回次與深度閉合」與「岩石品質指標」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Runs and depth closure" and "Rock quality designation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 回次與深度閉合：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Runs and depth closure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「回次與深度閉合」如何影響鑽孔岩心記錄與岩體分類的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Runs and depth closure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Core logging and rock-mass classification”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 岩心箱的順序建立地下空間的索引，鑽進回次與回收長度不閉合時，後續試驗再精準也會失去位置。接桿量測、殘留岩心與鑽具長度須分開記錄，不能把深度誤差藏入某個破碎段。 假設鑽進3.0 m、岩心2.7 m，TCR=90%，缺失0.3 m；缺失所在深度仍不唯一。 把孔底殘留岩心歸入下一回次會重複或錯置地層，缺失區則可能被假想成完整材料；其後的強度曲線雖連續，卻不對應真實深度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「回次與深度閉合」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Core-box order indexes subsurface space. If advance and recovery do not close, even precise tests lose their location. Record rod measurements, retained core and tooling lengths separately instead of hiding a depth discrepancy inside a broken interval. For assumed advance 3.0 m and recovered core 2.7 m, TCR=90% and loss=0.3 m; the location of that loss remains nonunique. Assigning retained bottom core to the next run duplicates or shifts geology and can fill losses with imaginary intact material. A smooth subsequent strength profile then represents the wrong depths. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Runs and depth closure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Missing core may always be assigned arbitrarily to the bottom of a run." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

knowledge.text: 誤解：岩心缺失的深度可以任意放在該回次最底部。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Missing core may always be assigned arbitrarily to the bottom of a run. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.title: 回次與深度閉合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Runs and depth closure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「回次與深度閉合」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Runs and depth closure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設鑽進3.0 m、岩心2.7 m，TCR=90%，缺失0.3 m；缺失所在深度仍不唯一。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed advance 3.0 m and recovered core 2.7 m, TCR=90% and loss=0.3 m; the location of that loss remains nonunique. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對鑽班原始進尺、岩心箱分隔牌與完整照片，重新量測岩心長度；深度無法閉合的回次需標出不確定區間，待記錄者與地質師共同釐清，不能默默移動標牌。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconcile original drilling advance, run dividers and complete photographs and remeasure recovered length; mark unresolved intervals for joint review by the logger and geologist rather than silently moving a divider.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 回次與深度閉合：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「回次與深度閉合」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Runs and depth closure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對鑽班原始進尺、岩心箱分隔牌與完整照片，重新量測岩心長度；深度無法閉合的回次需標出不確定區間，待記錄者與地質師共同釐清，不能默默移動標牌。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把孔底殘留岩心歸入下一回次會重複或錯置地層，缺失區則可能被假想成完整材料；其後的強度曲線雖連續，卻不對應真實深度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconcile original drilling advance, run dividers and complete photographs and remeasure recovered length; mark unresolved intervals for joint review by the logger and geologist rather than silently moving a divider. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Assigning retained bottom core to the next run duplicates or shifts geology and can fill losses with imaginary intact material. A smooth subsequent strength profile then represents the wrong depths. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄回次與深度閉合的資料來源與適用條件。核對鑽班原始進尺、岩心箱分隔牌與完整照片，重新量測岩心長度；深度無法閉合的回次需標出不確定區間，待記錄者與地質師共同釐清，不能默默移動標牌。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for runs and depth closure. Reconcile original drilling advance, run dividers and complete photographs and remeasure recovered length; mark unresolved intervals for joint review by the logger and geologist rather than silently moving a divider.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把孔底殘留岩心歸入下一回次會重複或錯置地層，缺失區則可能被假想成完整材料；其後的強度曲線雖連續，卻不對應真實深度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Assigning retained bottom core to the next run duplicates or shifts geology and can fill losses with imaginary intact material. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

A smooth subsequent strength profile then represents the wrong depths.

steps.title: 回次與深度閉合：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Runs and depth closure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「回次與深度閉合」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Runs and depth closure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把孔底殘留岩心歸入下一回次會重複或錯置地層，缺失區則可能被假想成完整材料；其後的強度曲線雖連續，卻不對應真實深度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Assigning retained bottom core to the next run duplicates or shifts geology and can fill losses with imaginary intact material. A smooth subsequent strength profile then represents the wrong depths. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把孔底殘留岩心歸入下一回次會重複或錯置地層，缺失區則可能被假想成完整材料；其後的強度曲線雖連續，卻不對應真實深度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A smooth subsequent strength profile then represents the wrong depths.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「岩心缺失的深度可以任意放在該回次最底部。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Missing core may always be assigned arbitrarily to the bottom of a run." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把孔底殘留岩心歸入下一回次會重複或錯置地層，缺失區則可能被假想成完整材料；其後的強度曲線雖連續，卻不對應真實深度。
knowledge.textEn: Assigning retained bottom core to the next run duplicates or shifts geology and can fill losses with imaginary intact material. A smooth subsequent strength profile then represents the wrong depths.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「回次與深度閉合」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

把孔底殘留岩心歸入下一回次會重複或錯置地層，缺失區則可能被假想成完整材料；其後的強度曲線雖連續，卻不對應真實深度。
岩心回收率很高就代表岩石品質指標必定很高。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Assigning retained bottom core to the next run duplicates or shifts geology and can fill losses with imaginary intact material.
High total core recovery necessarily means a high rock quality designation.

quiz.explanationEn: Assigning retained bottom core to the next run duplicates or shifts geology and can fill losses with imaginary intact material. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 岩石品質指標：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rock quality designation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「岩石品質指標」如何影響鑽孔岩心記錄與岩體分類的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rock quality designation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Core logging and rock-mass classification”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: RQD只計符合長度條件的健全岩心，機械折斷應辨識並重接；它反映沿孔方向的塊體分割，而不是完整三維岩體強度。與孔平行的節理很少被截交，方向偏差必須保留。 假設2 m回次內長度至少100 mm的健全岩心合計1.4 m，RQD=1.4/2×100=70%。 把鑽具造成的折斷當成自然節理會低估RQD；只看高RQD又可能漏掉一條控制大楔體的持續節理，支護需求並不隨單一百分比單調決定。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「岩石品質指標」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: RQD counts sound pieces meeting a length criterion, with recognized mechanical breaks reassembled. It describes segmentation along the hole rather than three-dimensional mass strength. Joints parallel to the hole are undersampled, so directional bias remains. If sound pieces at least 100 mm long total an assumed 1.4 m within a 2 m run, RQD=1.4/2×100=70%. Counting drilling breaks as natural joints underestimates RQD. Conversely, high RQD can coexist with one persistent plane controlling a large wedge, so support demand is not determined by that percentage alone. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rock quality designation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「岩心回收率很高就代表岩石品質指標必定很高。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High total core recovery necessarily means a high rock quality designation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「岩石品質指標」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Rock quality designation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 岩石品質指標
knowledge.text: RQD只計符合長度條件的健全岩心，機械折斷應辨識並重接；它反映沿孔方向的塊體分割，而不是完整三維岩體強度。與孔平行的節理很少被截交，方向偏差必須保留。
knowledge.textEn: RQD counts sound pieces meeting a length criterion, with recognized mechanical breaks reassembled. It describes segmentation along the hole rather than three-dimensional mass strength.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：岩心回收率很高就代表岩石品質指標必定很高。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: High total core recovery necessarily means a high rock quality designation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「岩石品質指標」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rock quality designation" is correct?
options: 岩心回收率很高就代表岩石品質指標必定很高。
不同方向鑽孔的表觀節理間距可以不修正直接比較。

optionsEn: High total core recovery necessarily means a high rock quality designation.
Apparent joint spacing from differently oriented holes can be compared without correction.

quiz.explanation: RQD只計符合長度條件的健全岩心，機械折斷應辨識並重接；它反映沿孔方向的塊體分割，而不是完整三維岩體強度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.observation: 如何核對：用端面吻合與新鮮破面區分機械斷裂，逐段保留計入長度及照片；另一位記錄者獨立複核臨界長度岩心，再對照孔方向與節理組，確認分類未忽略取樣方向。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型

knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If sound pieces at least 100 mm long total an assumed 1.4 m within a 2 m run, RQD=1.4/2×100=70%.

quiz.question: 依「岩石品質指標」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

The water factor in a multiplicative rock index never changes during construction.

steps.title: 岩石品質指標：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rock quality designation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「岩石品質指標」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rock quality designation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用端面吻合與新鮮破面區分機械斷裂，逐段保留計入長度及照片；另一位記錄者獨立複核臨界長度岩心，再對照孔方向與節理組，確認分類未忽略取樣方向。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把鑽具造成的折斷當成自然節理會低估RQD；只看高RQD又可能漏掉一條控制大楔體的持續節理，支護需求並不隨單一百分比單調決定。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Distinguish mechanical breaks using matching fresh ends and retain counted lengths and photographs; a second logger checks borderline pieces, then compares hole orientation with joint sets to expose directional sampling bias. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Counting drilling breaks as natural joints underestimates RQD. Conversely, high RQD can coexist with one persistent plane controlling a large wedge, so support demand is not determined by that percentage alone. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄岩石品質指標的資料來源與適用條件。用端面吻合與新鮮破面區分機械斷裂，逐段保留計入長度及照片；另一位記錄者獨立複核臨界長度岩心，再對照孔方向與節理組，確認分類未忽略取樣方向。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for rock quality designation. Distinguish mechanical breaks using matching fresh ends and retain counted lengths and photographs; a second logger checks borderline pieces, then compares hole orientation with joint sets to expose directional sampling bias.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把鑽具造成的折斷當成自然節理會低估RQD；只看高RQD又可能漏掉一條控制大楔體的持續節理，支護需求並不隨單一百分比單調決定。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Counting drilling breaks as natural joints underestimates RQD. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Distinguish mechanical breaks using matching fresh ends and retain counted lengths and photographs; a second logger checks borderline pieces, then compares hole orientation with joint sets to expose directional sampling bias. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Counting drilling breaks as natural joints underestimates RQD. Conversely, high RQD can coexist with one persistent plane controlling a large wedge, so support demand is not determined by that percentage alone.

quiz.question: 要驗證「岩石品質指標」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Rock quality designation"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
用端面吻合與新鮮破面區分機械斷裂，逐段保留計入長度及照片；另一位記錄者獨立複核臨界長度岩心，再對照孔方向與節理組，確認分類未忽略取樣方向。
兩位記錄者有分歧時，把總分平均就能消除偏差。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Distinguish mechanical breaks using matching fresh ends and retain counted lengths and photographs.
Averaging two disagreeing loggers' total scores removes the underlying bias.
quiz.explanation: 用端面吻合與新鮮破面區分機械斷裂，逐段保留計入長度及照片；另一位記錄者獨立複核臨界長度岩心，再對照孔方向與節理組，確認分類未忽略取樣方向。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Distinguish mechanical breaks using matching fresh ends and retain counted lengths and photographs; a second logger checks borderline pieces, then compares hole orientation with joint sets to expose directional sampling bias. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 岩石品質指標：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rock quality designation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「岩石品質指標」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rock quality designation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把鑽具造成的折斷當成自然節理會低估RQD；只看高RQD又可能漏掉一條控制大楔體的持續節理，支護需求並不隨單一百分比單調決定。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Counting drilling breaks as natural joints underestimates RQD. Conversely, high RQD can coexist with one persistent plane controlling a large wedge, so support demand is not determined by that percentage alone. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把鑽具造成的折斷當成自然節理會低估RQD；只看高RQD又可能漏掉一條控制大楔體的持續節理，支護需求並不隨單一百分比單調決定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Conversely, high RQD can coexist with one persistent plane controlling a large wedge, so support demand is not determined by that percentage alone.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「岩心回收率很高就代表岩石品質指標必定很高。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "High total core recovery necessarily means a high rock quality designation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把鑽具造成的折斷當成自然節理會低估RQD；只看高RQD又可能漏掉一條控制大楔體的持續節理，支護需求並不隨單一百分比單調決定。
knowledge.textEn: Counting drilling breaks as natural joints underestimates RQD. Conversely, high RQD can coexist with one persistent plane controlling a large wedge, so support demand is not determined by that percentage alone.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「岩石品質指標」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Rock quality designation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
不同方向鑽孔的表觀節理間距可以不修正直接比較。
把鑽具造成的折斷當成自然節理會低估RQD；只看高RQD又可能漏掉一條控制大楔體的持續節理，支護需求並不隨單一百分比單調決定。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Apparent joint spacing from differently oriented holes can be compared without correction.
Counting drilling breaks as natural joints underestimates RQD.
quiz.explanation: 把鑽具造成的折斷當成自然節理會低估RQD；只看高RQD又可能漏掉一條控制大楔體的持續節理，支護需求並不隨單一百分比單調決定。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Counting drilling breaks as natural joints underestimates RQD. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「節理間距方向」與「節理表面與充填」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Directional joint spacing" and "Joint surfaces and infill": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 節理間距方向：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Directional joint spacing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「節理間距方向」如何影響鑽孔岩心記錄與岩體分類的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Directional joint spacing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Core logging and rock-mass classification”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 掃描線截交頻率取決於節理法線和測線夾角；同一岩體由不同方向鑽孔會得到不同表觀間距。幾何修正接近平行時變得不穩定，應報告不可辨識的組別而非無限放大權重。 假設真法向間距0.3 m、測線與法線60°，表觀間距0.3/cos60°=0.6 m。 忽略方向會把一組密集但與孔平行的節理判成稀疏，造成塊體尺寸高估；粗暴修正少數截交又會讓單一節理主導整體統計。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「節理間距方向」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Intersection frequency depends on the angle between joint normal and survey line. Different hole directions produce different apparent spacing. Corrections become unstable near parallel orientation, requiring an unresolved-set warning rather than unbounded weighting. Assume normal spacing 0.3 m and a 60° angle between line and normal; apparent spacing is 0.3/cos60°=0.6 m. Ignoring orientation makes a closely spaced, hole-parallel joint set appear sparse and overestimates block size. Aggressive correction of a few intersections can instead let one observation dominate the statistics. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Directional joint spacing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「不同方向鑽孔的表觀節理間距可以不修正直接比較。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Apparent joint spacing from differently oriented holes can be compared without correction." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「節理間距方向」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Directional joint spacing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 節理間距方向
knowledge.text: 掃描線截交頻率取決於節理法線和測線夾角；同一岩體由不同方向鑽孔會得到不同表觀間距。幾何修正接近平行時變得不穩定，應報告不可辨識的組別而非無限放大權重。
knowledge.textEn: Intersection frequency depends on the angle between joint normal and survey line. Different hole directions produce different apparent spacing.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：不同方向鑽孔的表觀節理間距可以不修正直接比較。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Apparent joint spacing from differently oriented holes can be compared without correction. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「節理間距方向」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Directional joint spacing" is correct?
options: 掃描線截交頻率取決於節理法線和測線夾角；同一岩體由不同方向鑽孔會得到不同表觀間距。
不同方向鑽孔的表觀節理間距可以不修正直接比較。
洗乾淨的節理岩壁足以代表原位含填料剪切行為。
optionsEn: Intersection frequency depends on the angle between joint normal and survey line.
Apparent joint spacing from differently oriented holes can be compared without correction.
Cleaned joint walls adequately represent the original infilled joint's shear behavior.
quiz.explanation: 掃描線截交頻率取決於節理法線和測線夾角；同一岩體由不同方向鑽孔會得到不同表觀間距。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Intersection frequency depends on the angle between joint normal and survey line. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 節理間距方向：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Directional joint spacing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「節理間距方向」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Directional joint spacing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設真法向間距0.3 m、測線與法線60°，表觀間距0.3/cos60°=0.6 m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume normal spacing 0.3 m and a 60° angle between line and normal; apparent spacing is 0.3/cos60°=0.6 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將孔軸與節理極點畫在同一球面投影，查核取向資料的定向基準；以不同方向孔或露頭掃描線交叉驗證，接近平行且樣本稀少的組別須在報告中明示下限或缺口。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot hole axes and joint poles on the same stereonet and verify orientation datum; cross-check differently directed holes or exposure scanlines and state bounds or gaps for nearly parallel, sparsely sampled sets.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設真法向間距0.3 m、測線與法線60°，表觀間距0.3/cos60°=0.6 m。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume normal spacing 0.3 m and a 60° angle between line and normal; apparent spacing is 0.3/cos60°=0.6 m.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「節理間距方向」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Directional joint spacing", which statement holds?
options: 岩體分類總分相同，就表示它們具有相同破壞機制。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。

steps.title: 節理間距方向：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Directional joint spacing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「節理間距方向」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Directional joint spacing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將孔軸與節理極點畫在同一球面投影，查核取向資料的定向基準；以不同方向孔或露頭掃描線交叉驗證，接近平行且樣本稀少的組別須在報告中明示下限或缺口。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：忽略方向會把一組密集但與孔平行的節理判成稀疏，造成塊體尺寸高估；粗暴修正少數截交又會讓單一節理主導整體統計。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot hole axes and joint poles on the same stereonet and verify orientation datum; cross-check differently directed holes or exposure scanlines and state bounds or gaps for nearly parallel, sparsely sampled sets. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Ignoring orientation makes a closely spaced, hole-parallel joint set appear sparse and overestimates block size. Aggressive correction of a few intersections can instead let one observation dominate the statistics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄節理間距方向的資料來源與適用條件。將孔軸與節理極點畫在同一球面投影，查核取向資料的定向基準；以不同方向孔或露頭掃描線交叉驗證，接近平行且樣本稀少的組別須在報告中明示下限或缺口。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for directional joint spacing. Plot hole axes and joint poles on the same stereonet and verify orientation datum; cross-check differently directed holes or exposure scanlines and state bounds or gaps for nearly parallel, sparsely sampled sets.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略方向會把一組密集但與孔平行的節理判成稀疏，造成塊體尺寸高估；粗暴修正少數截交又會讓單一節理主導整體統計。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring orientation makes a closely spaced, hole-parallel joint set appear sparse and overestimates block size. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 節理間距方向：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Directional joint spacing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「節理間距方向」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Directional joint spacing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略方向會把一組密集但與孔平行的節理判成稀疏，造成塊體尺寸高估；粗暴修正少數截交又會讓單一節理主導整體統計。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring orientation makes a closely spaced, hole-parallel joint set appear sparse and overestimates block size. Aggressive correction of a few intersections can instead let one observation dominate the statistics. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：忽略方向會把一組密集但與孔平行的節理判成稀疏，造成塊體尺寸高估；粗暴修正少數截交又會讓單一節理主導整體統計。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Aggressive correction of a few intersections can instead let one observation dominate the statistics.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忽略方向會把一組密集但與孔平行的節理判成稀疏，造成塊體尺寸高估；粗暴修正少數截交又會讓單一節理主導整體統計。
knowledge.textEn: Ignoring orientation makes a closely spaced, hole-parallel joint set appear sparse and overestimates block size. Aggressive correction of a few intersections can instead let one observation dominate the statistics.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.title: 節理表面與充填：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Joint surfaces and infill: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「節理表面與充填」如何影響鑽孔岩心記錄與岩體分類的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Joint surfaces and infill” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Core logging and rock-mass classification”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 節理粗糙度、風化與充填共同決定剪力機制，兩個表面是否接觸比單看顏色重要。厚軟填土可隔開岩壁粗糙峰，於是完整岩石強度再高也不能代表節理面的抗剪能力。 假設填料厚4 mm、有效粗糙峰高2 mm，厚度比4/2=2；此幾何比不等於可直接使用的強度折減係數。 洗去黏土後記錄的粗糙岩壁會誇大現地摩擦力，乾燥樣品也可能掩蓋遇水軟化；看似良好節理在開挖卸荷與滲水後仍可能滑動。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「節理表面與充填」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Roughness, weathering and infill jointly govern joint shear. Contact between opposing walls matters more than color. Thick weak infill can separate rough rock asperities, making intact rock strength irrelevant to the shearing plane. For assumed infill thickness 4 mm and effective asperity height 2 mm, the ratio is 2; this geometric ratio is not a directly usable strength-reduction factor. Washing clay away exaggerates the friction represented by rough walls, while dry samples conceal water softening. An apparently favorable joint can still slide after excavation unloading and seepage. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Joint surfaces and infill” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「洗乾淨的節理岩壁足以代表原位含填料剪切行為。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Cleaned joint walls adequately represent the original infilled joint's shear behavior." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「節理表面與充填」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Joint surfaces and infill”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 節理表面與充填
knowledge.text: 節理粗糙度、風化與充填共同決定剪力機制，兩個表面是否接觸比單看顏色重要。厚軟填土可隔開岩壁粗糙峰，於是完整岩石強度再高也不能代表節理面的抗剪能力。
knowledge.textEn: Roughness, weathering and infill jointly govern joint shear. Contact between opposing walls matters more than color.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：洗乾淨的節理岩壁足以代表原位含填料剪切行為。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Cleaned joint walls adequately represent the original infilled joint's shear behavior. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「節理表面與充填」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Joint surfaces and infill" is correct?
options: 洗乾淨的節理岩壁足以代表原位含填料剪切行為。
節理粗糙度、風化與充填共同決定剪力機制，兩個表面是否接觸比單看顏色重要。
完整岩心抗壓強度就是含節理岩體的設計強度。
optionsEn: Cleaned joint walls adequately represent the original infilled joint's shear behavior.
Roughness, weathering and infill jointly govern joint shear.
Intact-core compressive strength is the design strength of the jointed rock mass.
quiz.explanation: 節理粗糙度、風化與充填共同決定剪力機制，兩個表面是否接觸比單看顏色重要。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Roughness, weathering and infill jointly govern joint shear. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 節理表面與充填：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Joint surfaces and infill: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「節理表面與充填」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Joint surfaces and infill” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設填料厚4 mm、有效粗糙峰高2 mm，厚度比4/2=2；此幾何比不等於可直接使用的強度折減係數。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed infill thickness 4 mm and effective asperity height 2 mm, the ratio is 2; this geometric ratio is not a directly usable strength-reduction factor. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以比例照片、觸感及樣品描述保存填料厚度和連續性，避免清洗後才記錄；同時比較飽和狀態及相同法向應力的剪力試驗，只有一致的材料與邊界條件才可互相比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Preserve scaled photographs and samples of infill thickness and continuity before washing; compare saturation and shear tests at matching normal stress, accepting comparisons only for consistent material and boundary conditions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設填料厚4 mm、有效粗糙峰高2 mm，厚度比4/2=2；此幾何比不等於可直接使用的強度折減係數。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed infill thickness 4 mm and effective asperity height 2 mm, the ratio is 2; this geometric ratio is not a directly usable strength-reduction factor.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「節理表面與充填」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Joint surfaces and infill", which statement holds?

steps.title: 節理表面與充填：失效診斷

steps.instructionEn: Washing clay away exaggerates the friction represented by rough walls, while dry samples conceal water softening. quiz.question: 在「節理表面與充填」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

洗去黏土後記錄的粗糙岩壁會誇大現地摩擦力，乾燥樣品也可能掩蓋遇水軟化；看似良好節理在開挖卸荷與滲水後仍可能滑動。
完整岩心抗壓強度就是含節理岩體的設計強度。

Washing clay away exaggerates the friction represented by rough walls, while dry samples conceal water softening.
Intact-core compressive strength is the design strength of the jointed rock mass.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「單軸強度與取樣」與「分類分項透明」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Uniaxial strength and sampling" and "Transparent classification components": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 單軸強度與取樣：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Uniaxial strength and sampling: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「單軸強度與取樣」如何影響鑽孔岩心記錄與岩體分類的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Uniaxial strength and sampling” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Core logging and rock-mass classification”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 單軸壓縮是完整岩石試件的強度，不包含大尺度節理。端面平整、長徑比與含水狀態影響破壞模式，若只挑完整段製樣，得到的分布會系統性排除最差地層。 假設直徑50 mm試體破壞荷重200 kN，σ=P/(πD²/4)=101.9 MPa；不等於岩體強度。 端部摩擦可能使試件呈異常錐形破壞，缺陷樣本剔除過多又會抬高平均強度；將這種平均值直接給整體岩體，會掩蓋支配變形的弱面。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「單軸強度與取樣」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Uniaxial compression measures intact specimen strength, excluding large joints. End preparation, slenderness and moisture influence failure. Selecting only pieces convenient for preparation systematically removes the weakest ground from the resulting distribution. An assumed 50 mm diameter specimen failing at 200 kN gives σ=P/(πD²/4)=101.9 MPa; this is not rock-mass strength. End friction can produce abnormal conical failure, while rejecting too many flawed samples raises mean strength. Applying that mean to the mass hides weak surfaces controlling deformation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Uniaxial strength and sampling” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「完整岩心抗壓強度就是含節理岩體的設計強度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Intact-core compressive strength is the design strength of the jointed rock mass." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「單軸強度與取樣」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Uniaxial strength and sampling”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 單軸強度與取樣
knowledge.text: 單軸壓縮是完整岩石試件的強度，不包含大尺度節理。端面平整、長徑比與含水狀態影響破壞模式，若只挑完整段製樣，得到的分布會系統性排除最差地層。
knowledge.textEn: Uniaxial compression measures intact specimen strength, excluding large joints. End preparation, slenderness and moisture influence failure.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：完整岩心抗壓強度就是含節理岩體的設計強度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Intact-core compressive strength is the design strength of the jointed rock mass. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「單軸強度與取樣」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 完整岩心抗壓強度就是含節理岩體的設計強度。
岩體分類總分相同，就表示它們具有相同破壞機制。
單軸壓縮是完整岩石試件的強度，不包含大尺度節理。
optionsEn: Intact-core compressive strength is the design strength of the jointed rock mass.
Equal rock-mass classification totals imply identical governing failure mechanisms.
Uniaxial compression measures intact specimen strength, excluding large joints.
quiz.explanation: 單軸壓縮是完整岩石試件的強度，不包含大尺度節理。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Uniaxial compression measures intact specimen strength, excluding large joints. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed 50 mm diameter specimen failing at 200 kN gives σ=P/(πD²/4)=101.9 MPa; this is not rock-mass strength. steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: End friction can produce abnormal conical failure, while rejecting too many flawed samples raises mean strength. Applying that mean to the mass hides weak surfaces controlling deformation.
