steps.title: 單軸強度與取樣：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Uniaxial strength and sampling: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「單軸強度與取樣」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Uniaxial strength and sampling” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 端部摩擦可能使試件呈異常錐形破壞，缺陷樣本剔除過多又會抬高平均強度；將這種平均值直接給整體岩體，會掩蓋支配變形的弱面。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: End friction can produce abnormal conical failure, while rejecting too many flawed samples raises mean strength. Applying that mean to the mass hides weak surfaces controlling deformation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：端部摩擦可能使試件呈異常錐形破壞，缺陷樣本剔除過多又會抬高平均強度；將這種平均值直接給整體岩體，會掩蓋支配變形的弱面。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Intact-core compressive strength is the design strength of the jointed rock mass." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「單軸強度與取樣」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Uniaxial strength and sampling" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
岩體分類總分相同，就表示它們具有相同破壞機制。
端部摩擦可能使試件呈異常錐形破壞，缺陷樣本剔除過多又會抬高平均強度；將這種平均值直接給整體岩體，會掩蓋支配變形的弱面。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Equal rock-mass classification totals imply identical governing failure mechanisms.
End friction can produce abnormal conical failure, while rejecting too many flawed samples raises mean strength.
quiz.explanation: 端部摩擦可能使試件呈異常錐形破壞，缺陷樣本剔除過多又會抬高平均強度；將這種平均值直接給整體岩體，會掩蓋支配變形的弱面。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: End friction can produce abnormal conical failure, while rejecting too many flawed samples raises mean strength. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 分類分項透明：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Transparent classification components: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「分類分項透明」如何影響鑽孔岩心記錄與岩體分類的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Transparent classification components” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Core logging and rock-mass classification”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分類系統把多種觀測壓縮成工程指標，總分相同並不意味相同失效機制。強度佳但節理不利與強度弱但塊狀完整可能得到相似分數，設計必須保留各分項及地下水情境。 假設六個示範評分為12、15、10、20、7、−5，合計59；此加總練習不聲稱對應某版分類門檻。 把缺少資料的分項設成最有利分數，會產生看似完整的分類；兩種機制不同的岩體因總分相同被配上同一支護，可能漏掉楔體或擠壓問題。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分類分項透明」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Classification compresses observations into an index, but equal totals need not mean equal mechanisms. Strong rock with adverse joints can resemble weak but massive rock numerically, so component ratings and groundwater scenarios must remain visible. Assumed illustrative component scores of 12,15,10,20,7 and −5 total 59; this arithmetic exercise does not claim a threshold in a particular classification edition. Assigning favorable values to missing components creates false completeness. Equal totals can then assign identical support to different mechanisms, overlooking wedge instability or squeezing ground. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Transparent classification components” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「岩體分類總分相同，就表示它們具有相同破壞機制。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal rock-mass classification totals imply identical governing failure mechanisms." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「分類分項透明」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Transparent classification components”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 分類系統把多種觀測壓縮成工程指標，總分相同並不意味相同失效機制。強度佳但節理不利與強度弱但塊狀完整可能得到相似分數，設計必須保留各分項及地下水情境。
knowledge.textEn: Classification compresses observations into an index, but equal totals need not mean equal mechanisms. Strong rock with adverse joints can resemble weak but massive rock numerically, so component ratings and groundwater scenarios must remain visible.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：岩體分類總分相同，就表示它們具有相同破壞機制。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal rock-mass classification totals imply identical governing failure mechanisms. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「分類分項透明」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Transparent classification components" is correct?
options: 分類系統把多種觀測壓縮成工程指標，總分相同並不意味相同失效機制。
岩體分類總分相同，就表示它們具有相同破壞機制。
乘法岩體指標中的地下水因子永遠不會隨施工改變。
optionsEn: Classification compresses observations into an index, but equal totals need not mean equal mechanisms.
Equal rock-mass classification totals imply identical governing failure mechanisms.
The water factor in a multiplicative rock index never changes during construction.
quiz.explanation: 分類系統把多種觀測壓縮成工程指標，總分相同並不意味相同失效機制。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Classification compresses observations into an index, but equal totals need not mean equal mechanisms. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 分類分項透明：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Transparent classification components: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「分類分項透明」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Transparent classification components” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設六個示範評分為12、15、10、20、7、−5，合計59；此加總練習不聲稱對應某版分類門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed illustrative component scores of 12,15,10,20,7 and −5 total 59; this arithmetic exercise does not claim a threshold in a particular classification edition. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Retain evidence, rating-table edition and assessor for every component and test water and orientation sensitivity; verify support applicability against exposures and movement, using the total as an index rather than an automatic construction instruction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

Retain evidence, rating-table edition and assessor for every component and test water and orientation sensitivity.
quiz.explanation: 保存每一分項的原始依據、評分表版本及評分者，對地下水或取向做敏感度比較；以實際出露和變形驗證推薦支護的適用性，總分僅作索引而非自動施工指令。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Retain evidence, rating-table edition and assessor for every component and test water and orientation sensitivity; verify support applicability against exposures and movement, using the total as an index rather than an automatic construction instruction. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 分類分項透明：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Transparent classification components: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「分類分項透明」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Transparent classification components” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把缺少資料的分項設成最有利分數，會產生看似完整的分類；兩種機制不同的岩體因總分相同被配上同一支護，可能漏掉楔體或擠壓問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Assigning favorable values to missing components creates false completeness. Equal totals can then assign identical support to different mechanisms, overlooking wedge instability or squeezing ground. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把缺少資料的分項設成最有利分數，會產生看似完整的分類；兩種機制不同的岩體因總分相同被配上同一支護，可能漏掉楔體或擠壓問題。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Equal totals can then assign identical support to different mechanisms, overlooking wedge instability or squeezing ground.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「岩體分類總分相同，就表示它們具有相同破壞機制。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal rock-mass classification totals imply identical governing failure mechanisms." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把缺少資料的分項設成最有利分數，會產生看似完整的分類；兩種機制不同的岩體因總分相同被配上同一支護，可能漏掉楔體或擠壓問題。
knowledge.textEn: Assigning favorable values to missing components creates false completeness. Equal totals can then assign identical support to different mechanisms, overlooking wedge instability or squeezing ground.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「分類分項透明」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Transparent classification components" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把缺少資料的分項設成最有利分數，會產生看似完整的分類；兩種機制不同的岩體因總分相同被配上同一支護，可能漏掉楔體或擠壓問題。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
乘法岩體指標中的地下水因子永遠不會隨施工改變。
optionsEn: Assigning favorable values to missing components creates false completeness.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
The water factor in a multiplicative rock index never changes during construction.
quiz.explanation: 把缺少資料的分項設成最有利分數，會產生看似完整的分類；兩種機制不同的岩體因總分相同被配上同一支護，可能漏掉楔體或擠壓問題。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Assigning favorable values to missing components creates false completeness. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「乘法指標敏感」與「尺度與代表體積」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Multiplicative index sensitivity" and "Scale and representative volume": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 乘法指標敏感：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Multiplicative index sensitivity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「乘法指標敏感」如何影響鑽孔岩心記錄與岩體分類的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Multiplicative index sensitivity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Core logging and rock-mass classification”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 乘法形式的岩體指標對分母與低值項特別敏感，輸入稍有改動即可跨越多個等級。這種指標是經驗模型，必須使用同一版本定義，不能把不同方法中同名因子混在一起。 假設Q=(60/9)(2/3)(1/5)=0.889；若Jw由1降為0.5，其餘不變，Q=0.444。 把地下水因子視為永久不變會忽略季節或開挖導水，錯誤分母又可使指標偏差數倍；輸出小數位再多也不能補足取樣與判讀不足。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「乘法指標敏感」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Multiplicative rock indices are sensitive to denominators and small factors, so modest input changes may cross several classes. These empirical models require consistent edition-specific definitions; similarly named factors from different systems are not interchangeable. For assumed Q=(60/9)(2/3)(1/5)=0.889, reducing Jw from 1 to 0.5 while holding other factors fixed gives Q=0.444. Treating water factors as permanent ignores seasonal or excavation-induced changes; an incorrect denominator shifts the index severalfold, and extra decimal places do not cure deficient sampling or interpretation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Multiplicative index sensitivity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「乘法岩體指標中的地下水因子永遠不會隨施工改變。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The water factor in a multiplicative rock index never changes during construction." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「乘法指標敏感」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Multiplicative index sensitivity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 乘法指標敏感
knowledge.text: 乘法形式的岩體指標對分母與低值項特別敏感，輸入稍有改動即可跨越多個等級。這種指標是經驗模型，必須使用同一版本定義，不能把不同方法中同名因子混在一起。
knowledge.textEn: Multiplicative rock indices are sensitive to denominators and small factors, so modest input changes may cross several classes. These empirical models require consistent edition-specific definitions; similarly named factors from different systems are not interchangeable.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：乘法岩體指標中的地下水因子永遠不會隨施工改變。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The water factor in a multiplicative rock index never changes during construction. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「乘法指標敏感」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Multiplicative index sensitivity" is correct?
options: 乘法岩體指標中的地下水因子永遠不會隨施工改變。
乘法形式的岩體指標對分母與低值項特別敏感，輸入稍有改動即可跨越多個等級。
岩心與隧道的尺寸比可直接當成強度折減係數。
optionsEn: The water factor in a multiplicative rock index never changes during construction.
Multiplicative rock indices are sensitive to denominators and small factors, so modest input changes may cross several classes.
The core-to-tunnel size ratio directly supplies the required strength-reduction factor.
quiz.explanation: 乘法形式的岩體指標對分母與低值項特別敏感，輸入稍有改動即可跨越多個等級。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Multiplicative rock indices are sensitive to denominators and small factors, so modest input changes may cross several classes. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 乘法指標敏感：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Multiplicative index sensitivity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「乘法指標敏感」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Multiplicative index sensitivity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設Q=(60/9)(2/3)(1/5)=0.889；若Jw由1降為0.5，其餘不變，Q=0.444。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed Q=(60/9)(2/3)(1/5)=0.889, reducing Jw from 1 to 0.5 while holding other factors fixed gives Q=0.444. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：由原始節理組數、粗糙狀況、水情與應力描述追查各比值，另以合理上下限重算；若輸入只是假設，結果不得轉成精確支護間距，需由岩工工程師結合失效分析審查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Trace each ratio to joint-set count, surface condition, water and stress descriptions and recalculate plausible bounds; assumed inputs must not become precise support spacing without rock-engineering review of failure mechanisms.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設Q=(60/9)(2/3)(1/5)=0.889；若Jw由1降為0.5，其餘不變，Q=0.444。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed Q=(60/9)(2/3)(1/5)=0.889, reducing Jw from 1 to 0.5 while holding other factors fixed gives Q=0.444.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「乘法指標敏感」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Multiplicative index sensitivity", which statement holds?
options: 折減整體模數後再加同一節理弱化不會重複計算。
岩心回收率很高就代表岩石品質指標必定很高。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: Reducing bulk stiffness and adding the same joint weakening cannot double-count damage.
High total core recovery necessarily means a high rock quality designation.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 乘法指標敏感：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Multiplicative index sensitivity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「乘法指標敏感」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Multiplicative index sensitivity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 由原始節理組數、粗糙狀況、水情與應力描述追查各比值，另以合理上下限重算；若輸入只是假設，結果不得轉成精確支護間距，需由岩工工程師結合失效分析審查。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把地下水因子視為永久不變會忽略季節或開挖導水，錯誤分母又可使指標偏差數倍；輸出小數位再多也不能補足取樣與判讀不足。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Trace each ratio to joint-set count, surface condition, water and stress descriptions and recalculate plausible bounds; assumed inputs must not become precise support spacing without rock-engineering review of failure mechanisms. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Treating water factors as permanent ignores seasonal or excavation-induced changes; an incorrect denominator shifts the index severalfold, and extra decimal places do not cure deficient sampling or interpretation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄乘法指標敏感的資料來源與適用條件。由原始節理組數、粗糙狀況、水情與應力描述追查各比值，另以合理上下限重算；若輸入只是假設，結果不得轉成精確支護間距，需由岩工工程師結合失效分析審查。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for multiplicative index sensitivity. Trace each ratio to joint-set count, surface condition, water and stress descriptions and recalculate plausible bounds; assumed inputs must not become precise support spacing without rock-engineering review of failure mechanisms.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把地下水因子視為永久不變會忽略季節或開挖導水，錯誤分母又可使指標偏差數倍；輸出小數位再多也不能補足取樣與判讀不足。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating water factors as permanent ignores seasonal or excavation-induced changes; an incorrect denominator shifts the index severalfold, and extra decimal places do not cure deficient sampling or interpretation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Multiplicative index sensitivity"?

steps.instruction: 小岩心可能完全避開長而連續的節理，卻又把局部碎裂段過度放大。從厘米試件到隧道尺度需要描述結構面的持續性、間距與連通，不能只把試體尺寸比例套在強度上。 假設隧道直徑10 m、岩心直徑0.05 m，尺度比200；截面面積比200²=40000，不能據此直接縮減強度。 過度依賴完整小樣會低估大塊體滑落，單一破碎回次又可能使整段支護過度保守；兩種偏差都來自把局部觀測誤當代表體積。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「尺度與代表體積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Small cores may miss persistent joints while overemphasizing one crushed interval. Moving from centimetre specimens to tunnel scale requires persistence, spacing and connectivity, not a strength correction based solely on specimen dimensions. For assumed tunnel diameter 10 m and core diameter 0.05 m, length ratio is 200 and area ratio 40000; neither directly determines a strength reduction. Reliance on intact small samples underestimates large-block movement, whereas one crushed run may overstate support demand along a long reach; both mistakes confuse local evidence with a representative volume. 過度依賴完整小樣會低估大塊體滑落，單一破碎回次又可能使整段支護過度保守；兩種偏差都來自把局部觀測誤當代表體積。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Averaging two disagreeing loggers' total scores removes the underlying bias.
Reliance on intact small samples underestimates large-block movement, whereas one crushed run may overstate support demand along a long reach.
quiz.explanation: 過度依賴完整小樣會低估大塊體滑落，單一破碎回次又可能使整段支護過度保守；兩種偏差都來自把局部觀測誤當代表體積。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Reliance on intact small samples underestimates large-block movement, whereas one crushed run may overstate support demand along a long reach; both mistakes confuse local evidence with a representative volume. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「記錄者差異控制」與「分類到模型交接」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Controlling logger differences" and "Classification-to-model handover": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 記錄者差異控制：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Controlling logger differences: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「記錄者差異控制」如何影響鑽孔岩心記錄與岩體分類的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Controlling logger differences” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Core logging and rock-mass classification”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 岩心描述含觀察與判斷，顏色、風化與節理條件的用語須有共同基準。雙人記錄不是取平均即可，分歧若集中於某一因子，應先找照明、樣品狀態或定義差異。 假設20段中兩位記錄者有16段分類一致，原始一致率80%；它未扣除偶然一致，不能等同Kappa。 不同班次使用不同風化尺度會造成假的地質突變，總分平均反而藏住問題；後續設計無法知道變化來自地層還是記錄習慣。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「記錄者差異控制」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Core logging combines observation and judgment. Color, weathering and joint condition need common definitions. Independent logs should not simply be averaged; concentrated disagreement points to lighting, sample state or inconsistent definitions requiring review. If two loggers agree on 16 of an assumed 20 intervals, raw agreement is 80%; without chance correction this is not a kappa statistic. Different weathering scales across shifts create artificial geological changes, and averaged totals hide the problem. Designers then cannot distinguish changing ground from changing logging practice. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Controlling logger differences” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩位記錄者有分歧時，把總分平均就能消除偏差。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Averaging two disagreeing loggers' total scores removes the underlying bias." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「記錄者差異控制」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Controlling logger differences”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 記錄者差異控制
knowledge.text: 岩心描述含觀察與判斷，顏色、風化與節理條件的用語須有共同基準。雙人記錄不是取平均即可，分歧若集中於某一因子，應先找照明、樣品狀態或定義差異。
knowledge.textEn: Core logging combines observation and judgment. Color, weathering and joint condition need common definitions.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩位記錄者有分歧時，把總分平均就能消除偏差。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Averaging two disagreeing loggers' total scores removes the underlying bias. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「記錄者差異控制」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Controlling logger differences" is correct?
options: 岩心描述含觀察與判斷，顏色、風化與節理條件的用語須有共同基準。
兩位記錄者有分歧時，把總分平均就能消除偏差。
折減整體模數後再加同一節理弱化不會重複計算。
optionsEn: Core logging combines observation and judgment.
Averaging two disagreeing loggers' total scores removes the underlying bias.
Reducing bulk stiffness and adding the same joint weakening cannot double-count damage.
quiz.explanation: 岩心描述含觀察與判斷，顏色、風化與節理條件的用語須有共同基準。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Core logging combines observation and judgment. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 記錄者差異控制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Controlling logger differences: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「記錄者差異控制」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Controlling logger differences” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設20段中兩位記錄者有16段分類一致，原始一致率80%；它未扣除偶然一致，不能等同Kappa。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If two loggers agree on 16 of an assumed 20 intervals, raw agreement is 80%; without chance correction this is not a kappa statistic. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以盲重記固定比例岩心，交叉比較分項而非只比總分；用保留的照片和樣品討論分歧並記錄裁定依據，若方法改版則保留舊版，避免悄悄改寫原始觀察。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Blindly relog a fixed sample and compare components rather than totals; resolve discrepancies using retained images and specimens and document the basis, preserving earlier versions when methods change instead of rewriting original observations.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設20段中兩位記錄者有16段分類一致，原始一致率80%；它未扣除偶然一致，不能等同Kappa。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If two loggers agree on 16 of an assumed 20 intervals, raw agreement is 80%; without chance correction this is not a kappa statistic.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「記錄者差異控制」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Controlling logger differences", which statement holds?
options: 岩心回收率很高就代表岩石品質指標必定很高。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
洗乾淨的節理岩壁足以代表原位含填料剪切行為。
optionsEn: High total core recovery necessarily means a high rock quality designation.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
Cleaned joint walls adequately represent the original infilled joint's shear behavior.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 記錄者差異控制：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Controlling logger differences: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「記錄者差異控制」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Controlling logger differences” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以盲重記固定比例岩心，交叉比較分項而非只比總分；用保留的照片和樣品討論分歧並記錄裁定依據，若方法改版則保留舊版，避免悄悄改寫原始觀察。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：不同班次使用不同風化尺度會造成假的地質突變，總分平均反而藏住問題；後續設計無法知道變化來自地層還是記錄習慣。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Blindly relog a fixed sample and compare components rather than totals; resolve discrepancies using retained images and specimens and document the basis, preserving earlier versions when methods change instead of rewriting original observations. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Different weathering scales across shifts create artificial geological changes, and averaged totals hide the problem. Designers then cannot distinguish changing ground from changing logging practice. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄記錄者差異控制的資料來源與適用條件。以盲重記固定比例岩心，交叉比較分項而非只比總分；用保留的照片和樣品討論分歧並記錄裁定依據，若方法改版則保留舊版，避免悄悄改寫原始觀察。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for controlling logger differences. Blindly relog a fixed sample and compare components rather than totals; resolve discrepancies using retained images and specimens and document the basis, preserving earlier versions when methods change instead of rewriting original observations.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：不同班次使用不同風化尺度會造成假的地質突變，總分平均反而藏住問題；後續設計無法知道變化來自地層還是記錄習慣。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Different weathering scales across shifts create artificial geological changes, and averaged totals hide the problem. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以盲重記固定比例岩心，交叉比較分項而非只比總分；用保留的照片和樣品討論分歧並記錄裁定依據，若方法改版則保留舊版，避免悄悄改寫原始觀察。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：不同班次使用不同風化尺度會造成假的地質突變，總分平均反而藏住問題；後續設計無法知道變化來自地層還是記錄習慣。
knowledge.textEn: Blindly relog a fixed sample and compare components rather than totals; resolve discrepancies using retained images and specimens and document the basis, preserving earlier versions when methods change instead of rewriting original observations. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Different weathering scales across shifts create artificial geological changes, and averaged totals hide the problem. Designers then cannot distinguish changing ground from changing logging practice.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄記錄者差異控制的資料來源與適用條件。以盲重記固定比例岩心，交叉比較分項而非只比總分；用保留的照片和樣品討論分歧並記錄裁定依據，若方法改版則保留舊版，避免悄悄改寫原始觀察。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for controlling logger differences. Blindly relog a fixed sample and compare components rather than totals; resolve discrepancies using retained images and specimens and document the basis, preserving earlier versions when methods change instead of rewriting original observations.

quiz.question: 要驗證「記錄者差異控制」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Controlling logger differences"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
岩體分類總分相同，就表示它們具有相同破壞機制。

Equal rock-mass classification totals imply identical governing failure mechanisms.

steps.title: 記錄者差異控制：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Controlling logger differences: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「記錄者差異控制」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Controlling logger differences” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 不同班次使用不同風化尺度會造成假的地質突變，總分平均反而藏住問題；後續設計無法知道變化來自地層還是記錄習慣。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Different weathering scales across shifts create artificial geological changes, and averaged totals hide the problem. Designers then cannot distinguish changing ground from changing logging practice. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：不同班次使用不同風化尺度會造成假的地質突變，總分平均反而藏住問題；後續設計無法知道變化來自地層還是記錄習慣。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Designers then cannot distinguish changing ground from changing logging practice.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩位記錄者有分歧時，把總分平均就能消除偏差。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Averaging two disagreeing loggers' total scores removes the underlying bias." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 不同班次使用不同風化尺度會造成假的地質突變，總分平均反而藏住問題；後續設計無法知道變化來自地層還是記錄習慣。

steps.title: 分類到模型交接：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Classification-to-model handover: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「分類到模型交接」如何影響鑽孔岩心記錄與岩體分類的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Classification-to-model handover” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Core logging and rock-mass classification”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 岩體分類提供經驗參考，數值模型還需要應力、構造與水文邊界。交接應列明哪些參數來自試驗、哪些來自關聯式，並說明不利節理是否顯式建模，避免同一弱化作用被重複計入。 假設10個設計參數中6個實測、4個推估，推估比例40%；這是證據組成而非模型失敗機率。 若同時折減整體模數又以低剛度節理表達同一裂隙，可能重複弱化；反過來省略節理而仍用完整岩模數，會得到不合理的小變形。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分類到模型交接」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Classification supplies empirical context while analysis also requires stress, structure and hydraulic boundaries. Handover distinguishes tested and correlated parameters and explicit joints, preventing the same weakening effect from being counted twice. If 6 of an assumed 10 design parameters are measured and 4 inferred, the inferred fraction is 40%; this describes evidence composition, not model failure probability. Reducing bulk stiffness and adding soft joints for the same fractures can double-count weakening; omitting joints while retaining intact-rock stiffness produces unrealistically small movements in the opposite direction. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Classification-to-model handover” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「折減整體模數後再加同一節理弱化不會重複計算。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reducing bulk stiffness and adding the same joint weakening cannot double-count damage." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「分類到模型交接」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

quiz.question: 關於「分類到模型交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 分類到模型交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Classification-to-model handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「分類到模型交接」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Classification-to-model handover” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設10個設計參數中6個實測、4個推估，推估比例40%；這是證據組成而非模型失敗機率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 6 of an assumed 10 design parameters are measured and 4 inferred, the inferred fraction is 40%; this describes evidence composition, not model failure probability. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從設計參數表抽查至岩心箱、試驗單與分類公式，檢查單位、版本和尺度；針對推估參數安排敏感度包絡，只有主管工程師確認主控失效機制與資料相符後才釋出分析結論。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Trace model parameters to core boxes, test sheets and classification equations, checking units, edition and scale; bracket inferred values in sensitivity analysis and release conclusions only after engineering review of governing failure mechanisms.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 分類到模型交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Classification-to-model handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「分類到模型交接」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Classification-to-model handover” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 從設計參數表抽查至岩心箱、試驗單與分類公式，檢查單位、版本和尺度；針對推估參數安排敏感度包絡，只有主管工程師確認主控失效機制與資料相符後才釋出分析結論。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：若同時折減整體模數又以低剛度節理表達同一裂隙，可能重複弱化；反過來省略節理而仍用完整岩模數，會得到不合理的小變形。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Trace model parameters to core boxes, test sheets and classification equations, checking units, edition and scale; bracket inferred values in sensitivity analysis and release conclusions only after engineering review of governing failure mechanisms. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Reducing bulk stiffness and adding soft joints for the same fractures can double-count weakening; omitting joints while retaining intact-rock stiffness produces unrealistically small movements in the opposite direction. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄分類到模型交接的資料來源與適用條件。從設計參數表抽查至岩心箱、試驗單與分類公式，檢查單位、版本和尺度；針對推估參數安排敏感度包絡，只有主管工程師確認主控失效機制與資料相符後才釋出分析結論。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for classification-to-model handover. Trace model parameters to core boxes, test sheets and classification equations, checking units, edition and scale; bracket inferred values in sensitivity analysis and release conclusions only after engineering review of governing failure mechanisms.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若同時折減整體模數又以低剛度節理表達同一裂隙，可能重複弱化；反過來省略節理而仍用完整岩模數，會得到不合理的小變形。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Reducing bulk stiffness and adding soft joints for the same fractures can double-count weakening; omitting joints while retaining intact-rock stiffness produces unrealistically small movements in the opposite direction. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Reducing bulk stiffness and adding soft joints for the same fractures can double-count weakening; omitting joints while retaining intact-rock stiffness produces unrealistically small movements in the opposite direction.

steps.title: 分類到模型交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Classification-to-model handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「分類到模型交接」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Classification-to-model handover” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若同時折減整體模數又以低剛度節理表達同一裂隙，可能重複弱化；反過來省略節理而仍用完整岩模數，會得到不合理的小變形。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Reducing bulk stiffness and adding soft joints for the same fractures can double-count weakening; omitting joints while retaining intact-rock stiffness produces unrealistically small movements in the opposite direction. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若同時折減整體模數又以低剛度節理表達同一裂隙，可能重複弱化；反過來省略節理而仍用完整岩模數，會得到不合理的小變形。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Reducing bulk stiffness and adding soft joints for the same fractures can double-count weakening; omitting joints while retaining intact-rock stiffness produces unrealistically small movements in the opposite direction.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「折減整體模數後再加同一節理弱化不會重複計算。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Reducing bulk stiffness and adding the same joint weakening cannot double-count damage." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「分類到模型交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若同時折減整體模數又以低剛度節理表達同一裂隙，可能重複弱化；反過來省略節理而仍用完整岩模數，會得到不合理的小變形。
岩心缺失的深度可以任意放在該回次最底部。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Reducing bulk stiffness and adding soft joints for the same fractures can double-count weakening.
Missing core may always be assigned arbitrarily to the bottom of a run.
quiz.explanation: 若同時折減整體模數又以低剛度節理表達同一裂隙，可能重複弱化；反過來省略節理而仍用完整岩模數，會得到不合理的小變形。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Reducing bulk stiffness and adding soft joints for the same fractures can double-count weakening; omitting joints while retaining intact-rock stiffness produces unrealistically small movements in the opposite direction. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 孔內電視與裂隙判釋
summary: 本課聚焦以孔壁成像幾何、方位校準及水力交叉證據辨識裂隙。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。
summaryEn: This course focuses on interpret fractures through borehole-image geometry, orientation calibration and hydraulic cross-checks. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設100 m孔中光學可讀70 m、聲學可讀90 m，重疊可讀65 m，至少一種可讀為70+90−65=95 m。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設鉛直孔直徑0.10 m、正弦半振幅0.05 m，tanδ=2A/D=1，δ=45°。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed 100 m hole, readable optical length 70 m, acoustic length 90 m and overlap 65 m give 95 m readable by at least one method. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed vertical hole of diameter 0.10 m and sinusoidal half-amplitude 0.05 m, tanδ=2A/D=1 and δ=45°. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「光學與聲學互補」與「展開影像與傾角」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Optical and acoustic complementarity" and "Unwrapped images and dip": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 光學與聲學互補：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Optical and acoustic complementarity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「光學與聲學互補」如何影響孔內電視與裂隙判釋的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Optical and acoustic complementarity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Borehole imaging and fracture interpretation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 光學影像顯示顏色和材料關係，聲學影像反映孔壁反射與幾何，兩者對混濁水及孔壁覆膜的反應不同。互補資料可區分影像消失與真正的構造中斷，不能把看不清的區段當成無裂隙。 假設100 m孔中光學可讀70 m、聲學可讀90 m，重疊可讀65 m，至少一種可讀為70+90−65=95 m。 自動增亮可能把噪點變成假裂隙，聲學低振幅也可能只是粗糙孔壁；若未保存可讀性限制，裂隙統計會把資料缺失誤當優良岩體。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「光學與聲學互補」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Optical images show color and material relationships, while acoustic images respond to wall reflection and geometry. Turbid water and coatings affect them differently, so combined evidence separates lost visibility from a real structural termination. For an assumed 100 m hole, readable optical length 70 m, acoustic length 90 m and overlap 65 m give 95 m readable by at least one method. Automatic enhancement may turn noise into apparent cracks, and low acoustic amplitude can reflect rough walls. Missing readability limits make fracture statistics confuse absent data with sound rock. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Optical and acoustic complementarity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「孔壁影像看不清楚的區段可以直接記為沒有裂隙。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Unreadable borehole-wall intervals can be logged directly as having no fractures." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「光學與聲學互補」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Optical and acoustic complementarity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 光學與聲學互補
knowledge.text: 光學影像顯示顏色和材料關係，聲學影像反映孔壁反射與幾何，兩者對混濁水及孔壁覆膜的反應不同。互補資料可區分影像消失與真正的構造中斷，不能把看不清的區段當成無裂隙。
knowledge.textEn: Optical images show color and material relationships, while acoustic images respond to wall reflection and geometry. Turbid water and coatings affect them differently, so combined evidence separates lost visibility from a real structural termination.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：孔壁影像看不清楚的區段可以直接記為沒有裂隙。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Unreadable borehole-wall intervals can be logged directly as having no fractures. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「光學與聲學互補」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Optical and acoustic complementarity" is correct?
options: 孔壁影像看不清楚的區段可以直接記為沒有裂隙。
光學影像顯示顏色和材料關係，聲學影像反映孔壁反射與幾何，兩者對混濁水及孔壁覆膜的反應不同。
展開圖的峰谷總高度就是正弦半振幅。
optionsEn: Unreadable borehole-wall intervals can be logged directly as having no fractures.
Optical images show color and material relationships, while acoustic images respond to wall reflection and geometry.
The total peak-to-trough image height is the sinusoidal half-amplitude.
quiz.explanation: 光學影像顯示顏色和材料關係，聲學影像反映孔壁反射與幾何，兩者對混濁水及孔壁覆膜的反應不同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Optical images show color and material relationships, while acoustic images respond to wall reflection and geometry. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 光學與聲學互補：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Optical and acoustic complementarity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「光學與聲學互補」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Optical and acoustic complementarity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設100 m孔中光學可讀70 m、聲學可讀90 m，重疊可讀65 m，至少一種可讀為70+90−65=95 m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed 100 m hole, readable optical length 70 m, acoustic length 90 m and overlap 65 m give 95 m readable by at least one method. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐段建立可讀性遮罩，對照水清濁、反射振幅與孔徑，將兩種影像同深度並排；無法判讀的5 m仍需其他資料補足，不能把不同物理對比強行當成同一顏色尺度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Create interval-by-interval readability masks and align images with turbidity, amplitude and diameter; the unreadable 5 m still needs other evidence, and different physical contrasts must not be forced onto one color scale.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設100 m孔中光學可讀70 m、聲學可讀90 m，重疊可讀65 m，至少一種可讀為70+90−65=95 m。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed 100 m hole, readable optical length 70 m, acoustic length 90 m and overlap 65 m give 95 m readable by at least one method.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「光學與聲學互補」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Optical and acoustic complementarity", which statement holds?
options: 影像正北標記必定等於地理北，鋼套管不會影響。
影像暗帶寬度可直接當成裂隙的水力開度。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。

The width of a dark image band directly equals hydraulic fracture aperture.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.

steps.title: 光學與聲學互補：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Optical and acoustic complementarity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「光學與聲學互補」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Optical and acoustic complementarity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐段建立可讀性遮罩，對照水清濁、反射振幅與孔徑，將兩種影像同深度並排；無法判讀的5 m仍需其他資料補足，不能把不同物理對比強行當成同一顏色尺度。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：自動增亮可能把噪點變成假裂隙，聲學低振幅也可能只是粗糙孔壁；若未保存可讀性限制，裂隙統計會把資料缺失誤當優良岩體。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Create interval-by-interval readability masks and align images with turbidity, amplitude and diameter; the unreadable 5 m still needs other evidence, and different physical contrasts must not be forced onto one color scale. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Automatic enhancement may turn noise into apparent cracks, and low acoustic amplitude can reflect rough walls. Missing readability limits make fracture statistics confuse absent data with sound rock. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄光學與聲學互補的資料來源與適用條件。逐段建立可讀性遮罩，對照水清濁、反射振幅與孔徑，將兩種影像同深度並排；無法判讀的5 m仍需其他資料補足，不能把不同物理對比強行當成同一顏色尺度。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for optical and acoustic complementarity. Create interval-by-interval readability masks and align images with turbidity, amplitude and diameter; the unreadable 5 m still needs other evidence, and different physical contrasts must not be forced onto one color scale.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：自動增亮可能把噪點變成假裂隙，聲學低振幅也可能只是粗糙孔壁；若未保存可讀性限制，裂隙統計會把資料缺失誤當優良岩體。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Automatic enhancement may turn noise into apparent cracks, and low acoustic amplitude can reflect rough walls. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐段建立可讀性遮罩，對照水清濁、反射振幅與孔徑，將兩種影像同深度並排；無法判讀的5 m仍需其他資料補足，不能把不同物理對比強行當成同一顏色尺度。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：自動增亮可能把噪點變成假裂隙，聲學低振幅也可能只是粗糙孔壁；若未保存可讀性限制，裂隙統計會把資料缺失誤當優良岩體。
knowledge.textEn: Create interval-by-interval readability masks and align images with turbidity, amplitude and diameter; the unreadable 5 m still needs other evidence, and different physical contrasts must not be forced onto one color scale. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Automatic enhancement may turn noise into apparent cracks, and low acoustic amplitude can reflect rough walls. Missing readability limits make fracture statistics confuse absent data with sound rock.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄光學與聲學互補的資料來源與適用條件。逐段建立可讀性遮罩，對照水清濁、反射振幅與孔徑，將兩種影像同深度並排；無法判讀的5 m仍需其他資料補足，不能把不同物理對比強行當成同一顏色尺度。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for optical and acoustic complementarity. Create interval-by-interval readability masks and align images with turbidity, amplitude and diameter; the unreadable 5 m still needs other evidence, and different physical contrasts must not be forced onto one color scale.

quiz.question: 要驗證「光學與聲學互補」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Optical and acoustic complementarity"?
options: 逐段建立可讀性遮罩，對照水清濁、反射振幅與孔徑，將兩種影像同深度並排；無法判讀的5 m仍需其他資料補足，不能把不同物理對比強行當成同一顏色尺度。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
看起來最寬的裂隙必定是導水能力最大的裂隙。
optionsEn: Create interval-by-interval readability masks and align images with turbidity, amplitude and diameter.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The widest-looking fracture necessarily has the greatest hydraulic conductivity.

quiz.explanationEn: Create interval-by-interval readability masks and align images with turbidity, amplitude and diameter; the unreadable 5 m still needs other evidence, and different physical contrasts must not be forced onto one color scale. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 光學與聲學互補：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Optical and acoustic complementarity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「光學與聲學互補」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Optical and acoustic complementarity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 自動增亮可能把噪點變成假裂隙，聲學低振幅也可能只是粗糙孔壁；若未保存可讀性限制，裂隙統計會把資料缺失誤當優良岩體。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Automatic enhancement may turn noise into apparent cracks, and low acoustic amplitude can reflect rough walls. Missing readability limits make fracture statistics confuse absent data with sound rock. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：自動增亮可能把噪點變成假裂隙，聲學低振幅也可能只是粗糙孔壁；若未保存可讀性限制，裂隙統計會把資料缺失誤當優良岩體。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Missing readability limits make fracture statistics confuse absent data with sound rock.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「孔壁影像看不清楚的區段可以直接記為沒有裂隙。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Unreadable borehole-wall intervals can be logged directly as having no fractures." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 自動增亮可能把噪點變成假裂隙，聲學低振幅也可能只是粗糙孔壁；若未保存可讀性限制，裂隙統計會把資料缺失誤當優良岩體。
knowledge.textEn: Automatic enhancement may turn noise into apparent cracks, and low acoustic amplitude can reflect rough walls. Missing readability limits make fracture statistics confuse absent data with sound rock.

quiz.question: 在「光學與聲學互補」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Optical and acoustic complementarity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
自動增亮可能把噪點變成假裂隙，聲學低振幅也可能只是粗糙孔壁；若未保存可讀性限制，裂隙統計會把資料缺失誤當優良岩體。
展開圖的峰谷總高度就是正弦半振幅。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Automatic enhancement may turn noise into apparent cracks, and low acoustic amplitude can reflect rough walls.
The total peak-to-trough image height is the sinusoidal half-amplitude.
quiz.explanation: 自動增亮可能把噪點變成假裂隙，聲學低振幅也可能只是粗糙孔壁；若未保存可讀性限制，裂隙統計會把資料缺失誤當優良岩體。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Automatic enhancement may turn noise into apparent cracks, and low acoustic amplitude can reflect rough walls. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 展開影像與傾角：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Unwrapped images and dip: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「展開影像與傾角」如何影響孔內電視與裂隙判釋的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Unwrapped images and dip” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Borehole imaging and fracture interpretation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 平面裂隙切穿圓孔時在展開圖上形成正弦曲線；波幅與孔徑共同決定相對孔軸的傾角。只有孔軸近鉛直且坐標已校正時，簡單幾何傾角才可直接視為地質傾角。 假設鉛直孔直徑0.10 m、正弦半振幅0.05 m，tanδ=2A/D=1，δ=45°。 把峰谷差誤當半振幅會高估傾角，孔徑擴大未更新也會使姿態偏差；成像曲線雖擬合良好，錯誤幾何仍會導致楔體方向判斷失準。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「展開影像與傾角」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A planar fracture intersecting a circular hole becomes a sinusoid when unwrapped. Its amplitude and hole diameter determine dip relative to the axis. This simple dip represents geological dip directly only for a properly oriented near-vertical hole. For an assumed vertical hole of diameter 0.10 m and sinusoidal half-amplitude 0.05 m, tanδ=2A/D=1 and δ=45°. Using peak-to-trough height as half-amplitude overestimates dip, while uncorrected enlargement also biases orientation. A well-fitted sinusoid can therefore yield a wrong wedge direction through incorrect geometry. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Unwrapped images and dip” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「展開圖的峰谷總高度就是正弦半振幅。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The total peak-to-trough image height is the sinusoidal half-amplitude." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「展開影像與傾角」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Unwrapped images and dip”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 展開影像與傾角
knowledge.text: 平面裂隙切穿圓孔時在展開圖上形成正弦曲線；波幅與孔徑共同決定相對孔軸的傾角。只有孔軸近鉛直且坐標已校正時，簡單幾何傾角才可直接視為地質傾角。
knowledge.textEn: A planar fracture intersecting a circular hole becomes a sinusoid when unwrapped. Its amplitude and hole diameter determine dip relative to the axis.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：展開圖的峰谷總高度就是正弦半振幅。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The total peak-to-trough image height is the sinusoidal half-amplitude. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「展開影像與傾角」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Unwrapped images and dip" is correct?
options: 展開圖的峰谷總高度就是正弦半振幅。
掃描時間間隔固定就保證垂直像素的深度間距固定。
平面裂隙切穿圓孔時在展開圖上形成正弦曲線；波幅與孔徑共同決定相對孔軸的傾角。
optionsEn: The total peak-to-trough image height is the sinusoidal half-amplitude.
A fixed scan-time interval guarantees constant vertical pixel spacing in depth.
A planar fracture intersecting a circular hole becomes a sinusoid when unwrapped.
quiz.explanation: 平面裂隙切穿圓孔時在展開圖上形成正弦曲線；波幅與孔徑共同決定相對孔軸的傾角。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A planar fracture intersecting a circular hole becomes a sinusoid when unwrapped. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 展開影像與傾角：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Unwrapped images and dip: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「展開影像與傾角」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Unwrapped images and dip” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設鉛直孔直徑0.10 m、正弦半振幅0.05 m，tanδ=2A/D=1，δ=45°。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed vertical hole of diameter 0.10 m and sinusoidal half-amplitude 0.05 m, tanδ=2A/D=1 and δ=45°. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以人工選點和自動擬合互相比較，標示正弦最高最低點及實測孔徑；利用定向岩心查核傾向，偏斜孔須做完整三維旋轉，不能只把傾角加上孔斜。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare manual picks with automated fitting, marking extrema and measured diameter; verify orientation with oriented core and apply a full three-dimensional transformation in deviated holes instead of simply adding borehole inclination.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設鉛直孔直徑0.10 m、正弦半振幅0.05 m，tanδ=2A/D=1，δ=45°。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed vertical hole of diameter 0.10 m and sinusoidal half-amplitude 0.05 m, tanδ=2A/D=1 and δ=45°.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「展開影像與傾角」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
孔壁橢圓化一定由原位應力造成，不可能是鑽進效應。
每一種節理方向被單一鑽孔取樣的機率都相同。
optionsEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
Borehole ovality always comes from in-situ stress rather than drilling effects.
A single borehole samples every joint orientation with equal probability.

steps.title: 展開影像與傾角：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unwrapped images and dip: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「展開影像與傾角」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Unwrapped images and dip” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以人工選點和自動擬合互相比較，標示正弦最高最低點及實測孔徑；利用定向岩心查核傾向，偏斜孔須做完整三維旋轉，不能只把傾角加上孔斜。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把峰谷差誤當半振幅會高估傾角，孔徑擴大未更新也會使姿態偏差；成像曲線雖擬合良好，錯誤幾何仍會導致楔體方向判斷失準。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare manual picks with automated fitting, marking extrema and measured diameter; verify orientation with oriented core and apply a full three-dimensional transformation in deviated holes instead of simply adding borehole inclination. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Using peak-to-trough height as half-amplitude overestimates dip, while uncorrected enlargement also biases orientation. A well-fitted sinusoid can therefore yield a wrong wedge direction through incorrect geometry. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄展開影像與傾角的資料來源與適用條件。以人工選點和自動擬合互相比較，標示正弦最高最低點及實測孔徑；利用定向岩心查核傾向，偏斜孔須做完整三維旋轉，不能只把傾角加上孔斜。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for unwrapped images and dip. Compare manual picks with automated fitting, marking extrema and measured diameter; verify orientation with oriented core and apply a full three-dimensional transformation in deviated holes instead of simply adding borehole inclination.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把峰谷差誤當半振幅會高估傾角，孔徑擴大未更新也會使姿態偏差；成像曲線雖擬合良好，錯誤幾何仍會導致楔體方向判斷失準。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using peak-to-trough height as half-amplitude overestimates dip, while uncorrected enlargement also biases orientation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以人工選點和自動擬合互相比較，標示正弦最高最低點及實測孔徑；利用定向岩心查核傾向，偏斜孔須做完整三維旋轉，不能只把傾角加上孔斜。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把峰谷差誤當半振幅會高估傾角，孔徑擴大未更新也會使姿態偏差；成像曲線雖擬合良好，錯誤幾何仍會導致楔體方向判斷失準。
knowledge.textEn: Compare manual picks with automated fitting, marking extrema and measured diameter; verify orientation with oriented core and apply a full three-dimensional transformation in deviated holes instead of simply adding borehole inclination. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Using peak-to-trough height as half-amplitude overestimates dip, while uncorrected enlargement also biases orientation. A well-fitted sinusoid can therefore yield a wrong wedge direction through incorrect geometry.

knowledge.title: 現場實務

knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for unwrapped images and dip. Compare manual picks with automated fitting, marking extrema and measured diameter; verify orientation with oriented core and apply a full three-dimensional transformation in deviated holes instead of simply adding borehole inclination.

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Unwrapped images and dip"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以人工選點和自動擬合互相比較，標示正弦最高最低點及實測孔徑；利用定向岩心查核傾向，偏斜孔須做完整三維旋轉，不能只把傾角加上孔斜。
使用調整過模型參數的同批影像也算獨立驗證。

Compare manual picks with automated fitting, marking extrema and measured diameter.
Images already used to tune the model also count as independent validation.

steps.title: 展開影像與傾角：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Unwrapped images and dip: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「展開影像與傾角」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Unwrapped images and dip” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把峰谷差誤當半振幅會高估傾角，孔徑擴大未更新也會使姿態偏差；成像曲線雖擬合良好，錯誤幾何仍會導致楔體方向判斷失準。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using peak-to-trough height as half-amplitude overestimates dip, while uncorrected enlargement also biases orientation. A well-fitted sinusoid can therefore yield a wrong wedge direction through incorrect geometry. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把峰谷差誤當半振幅會高估傾角，孔徑擴大未更新也會使姿態偏差；成像曲線雖擬合良好，錯誤幾何仍會導致楔體方向判斷失準。

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「深度與速度校準」與「磁方位與鋼材影響」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Depth and speed calibration" and "Magnetic azimuth and steel effects": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 深度與速度校準：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Depth and speed calibration: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「深度與速度校準」如何影響孔內電視與裂隙判釋的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Depth and speed calibration” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Borehole imaging and fracture interpretation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 纜線伸長、滑輪打滑與記錄延遲會使影像深度偏離鑽孔記錄。垂直像素間距依賴移動速度及掃描頻率，只有固定時間間隔並不保證固定深度間距，必須使用校正後的深度編碼。 假設移動速度0.05 m/s、掃描20行/s，垂直間距0.0025 m=2.5 mm；速度加倍則為5 mm。 速度突變會拉長或壓縮裂隙影像，深度漂移則使同一裂隙看似兩條；以錯位資料對照水力試驗，可能將導水能力配給錯誤構造面。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「深度與速度校準」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cable stretch, wheel slip and latency shift image depth relative to the log. Vertical pixel spacing depends on travel speed and scan frequency; fixed time intervals do not guarantee fixed depth spacing without corrected depth encoding. At assumed travel speed 0.05 m/s and 20 scan lines/s, vertical spacing is 0.0025 m=2.5 mm; doubling speed makes it 5 mm. Speed changes stretch or compress fracture images, while depth drift can make one fracture appear twice. Misaligned hydraulic comparisons can then assign transmissivity to the wrong structural plane. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Depth and speed calibration” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。

knowledge.title: 深度與速度校準
knowledge.text: 纜線伸長、滑輪打滑與記錄延遲會使影像深度偏離鑽孔記錄。垂直像素間距依賴移動速度及掃描頻率，只有固定時間間隔並不保證固定深度間距，必須使用校正後的深度編碼。
knowledge.textEn: Cable stretch, wheel slip and latency shift image depth relative to the log. Vertical pixel spacing depends on travel speed and scan frequency; fixed time intervals do not guarantee fixed depth spacing without corrected depth encoding.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：掃描時間間隔固定就保證垂直像素的深度間距固定。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A fixed scan-time interval guarantees constant vertical pixel spacing in depth. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

optionsEn: Cable stretch, wheel slip and latency shift image depth relative to the log.
A fixed scan-time interval guarantees constant vertical pixel spacing in depth.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設移動速度0.05 m/s、掃描20行/s，垂直間距0.0025 m=2.5 mm；速度加倍則為5 mm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. At assumed travel speed 0.05 m/s and 20 scan lines/s, vertical spacing is 0.0025 m=2.5 mm; doubling speed makes it 5 mm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate depth against a known casing end or distinct marker and compare the same feature in upward and downward logs; retain speed and encoder records and resolve cumulative depth error before interpreting geological displacement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 深度與速度校準：試驗與驗證

steps.instruction: 利用已知套管端或清楚地層標記校準深度，對照上行下行影像的同一特徵；保留速度變化及編碼器原始值，若誤差隨深度累積，先修正測深系統再討論地層錯動。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：速度突變會拉長或壓縮裂隙影像，深度漂移則使同一裂隙看似兩條；以錯位資料對照水力試驗，可能將導水能力配給錯誤構造面。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
