steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Magnetic azimuth and steel effects” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Borehole imaging and fracture interpretation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 磁羅盤在鋼套管附近或含磁性礦物岩層會失真，圖像正北標記因此不一定是地理北。方位偏差不改變正弦形狀，故肉眼難以發現，必須以獨立定向資料檢查。 假設投影長20 m、方位偏5°，側向誤差20sin5°=1.74 m；同一裂隙傾角可能仍看似正確。 把磁北當真北會讓所有節理組一致旋轉，統計仍集中卻整體錯誤；若再與隧道軸線比較，可能錯判某組是否會朝開挖空間出露。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「磁方位與鋼材影響」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Steel casing and magnetic minerals disturb a compass, so the image north marker may differ from geographic north. Azimuth bias leaves sinusoidal shape unchanged and is hard to spot visually, requiring independent orientation evidence. For assumed projected length 20 m and azimuth bias 5°, lateral error is 20sin5°=1.74 m even while the fracture dip appears correct. Treating magnetic north as true north rotates every joint set coherently, preserving a tight but wrong distribution. Comparison with the tunnel axis can then misidentify whether a set daylights into the opening. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Magnetic azimuth and steel effects” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設投影長20 m、方位偏5°，側向誤差20sin5°=1.74 m；同一裂隙傾角可能仍看似正確。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.title: 磁方位與鋼材影響：失效診斷

steps.instructionEn: Using band width as hydraulic aperture amplifies flow errors through the cubic relation, and staining can make a closed crack look wide, misdirecting subsequent investigation of conductive zones. quiz.question: 在「表觀裂隙開度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「裂隙組與取樣偏差」與「導水裂隙交叉證據」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Joint sets and sampling bias" and "Cross-evidence for conductive fractures": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 裂隙組與取樣偏差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Joint sets and sampling bias: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「裂隙組與取樣偏差」如何影響孔內電視與裂隙判釋的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Joint sets and sampling bias” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Borehole imaging and fracture interpretation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 孔壁看到的是被孔截交的裂隙，不是所有方向等機率的樣本。組群分析應同時考慮取向、深度與可讀性，少量離群點可能是真實構造轉折，不能為了漂亮群集全部刪除。 假設可讀孔段20 m截交30條裂隙，線性密度1.5 m⁻¹；不經方向修正不能當體積裂隙密度。 若把不利取向的少數裂隙當雜訊，可能漏掉主控楔體；把影像不清的區間放入分母，又會低估裂隙密度並造成假的岩質改善。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「裂隙組與取樣偏差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The image includes only fractures intersected by the hole, not an equal-probability sample of orientations. Clustering must consider direction, depth and readability; a few outliers may mark real structural changes rather than disposable noise. If an assumed readable 20 m interval intersects 30 fractures, linear intensity is 1.5 m⁻¹; it is not volumetric fracture density without orientation treatment. Discarding sparse adverse orientations may remove the planes controlling a wedge. Including unreadable intervals in the denominator also underestimates fracture intensity and creates artificial improvement in rock quality. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Joint sets and sampling bias” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每一種節理方向被單一鑽孔取樣的機率都相同。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A single borehole samples every joint orientation with equal probability." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「裂隙組與取樣偏差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Joint sets and sampling bias”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 裂隙組與取樣偏差
knowledge.text: 孔壁看到的是被孔截交的裂隙，不是所有方向等機率的樣本。組群分析應同時考慮取向、深度與可讀性，少量離群點可能是真實構造轉折，不能為了漂亮群集全部刪除。
knowledge.textEn: The image includes only fractures intersected by the hole, not an equal-probability sample of orientations. Clustering must consider direction, depth and readability; a few outliers may mark real structural changes rather than disposable noise.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：每一種節理方向被單一鑽孔取樣的機率都相同。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A single borehole samples every joint orientation with equal probability. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「裂隙組與取樣偏差」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Joint sets and sampling bias" is correct?
options: 每一種節理方向被單一鑽孔取樣的機率都相同。
孔壁看到的是被孔截交的裂隙，不是所有方向等機率的樣本。
看起來最寬的裂隙必定是導水能力最大的裂隙。
optionsEn: A single borehole samples every joint orientation with equal probability.
The image includes only fractures intersected by the hole, not an equal-probability sample of orientations.
The widest-looking fracture necessarily has the greatest hydraulic conductivity.
quiz.explanation: 孔壁看到的是被孔截交的裂隙，不是所有方向等機率的樣本。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The image includes only fractures intersected by the hole, not an equal-probability sample of orientations. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 裂隙組與取樣偏差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Joint sets and sampling bias: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「裂隙組與取樣偏差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Joint sets and sampling bias” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設可讀孔段20 m截交30條裂隙，線性密度1.5 m⁻¹；不經方向修正不能當體積裂隙密度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If an assumed readable 20 m interval intersects 30 fractures, linear intensity is 1.5 m⁻¹; it is not volumetric fracture density without orientation treatment. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以球面圖標示每條裂隙及其深度，和不同方向孔的組群比較；保留人工挑點、擬合殘差及可讀性遮罩，只有可解釋的測量錯誤可排除，地質離群則另列。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot each fracture with depth on a stereonet and compare differently oriented holes; retain manual picks, fit residuals and readability masks, excluding only justified measurement errors while retaining geological outliers separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設可讀孔段20 m截交30條裂隙，線性密度1.5 m⁻¹；不經方向修正不能當體積裂隙密度。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If an assumed readable 20 m interval intersects 30 fractures, linear intensity is 1.5 m⁻¹; it is not volumetric fracture density without orientation treatment.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「裂隙組與取樣偏差」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Joint sets and sampling bias", which statement holds?
options: 只保存彩色三維模型就足以重新校正全部裂隙方位。
展開圖的峰谷總高度就是正弦半振幅。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: Saving only the colored three-dimensional model permits recalibration of all fracture orientations.
The total peak-to-trough image height is the sinusoidal half-amplitude.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。

knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄導水裂隙交叉證據的資料來源與適用條件。將孔內流量、溫度與影像裂隙標記對齊，核對抽水或自然狀態及時間；以隔離區間試驗確認連通，報告將可見裂隙與證實導水裂隙分開，避免外觀推論充當試驗結果。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for cross-evidence for conductive fractures. Align flow, temperature and image picks, documenting pumping or ambient state and time; confirm connectivity with interval testing and distinguish visible fractures from hydraulically demonstrated ones in the report.

quiz.question: 要驗證「導水裂隙交叉證據」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cross-evidence for conductive fractures"?

將孔內流量、溫度與影像裂隙標記對齊，核對抽水或自然狀態及時間；以隔離區間試驗確認連通，報告將可見裂隙與證實導水裂隙分開，避免外觀推論充當試驗結果。
孔壁橢圓化一定由原位應力造成，不可能是鑽進效應。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Align flow, temperature and image picks, documenting pumping or ambient state and time.
Borehole ovality always comes from in-situ stress rather than drilling effects.
quiz.explanation: 將孔內流量、溫度與影像裂隙標記對齊，核對抽水或自然狀態及時間；以隔離區間試驗確認連通，報告將可見裂隙與證實導水裂隙分開，避免外觀推論充當試驗結果。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Align flow, temperature and image picks, documenting pumping or ambient state and time; confirm connectivity with interval testing and distinguish visible fractures from hydraulically demonstrated ones in the report. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 導水裂隙交叉證據：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cross-evidence for conductive fractures: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「導水裂隙交叉證據」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cross-evidence for conductive fractures” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 缺少深度校準會把流量躍變配到鄰近裂隙，非穩態儲存也能製造假交換；結果可能在錯誤位置安排封堵，留下真正的導水通道。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Depth mismatch assigns a flow change to the wrong fracture, and transient storage can mimic exchange. Treatment may then target the wrong location while the true conductive path remains unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：缺少深度校準會把流量躍變配到鄰近裂隙，非穩態儲存也能製造假交換；結果可能在錯誤位置安排封堵，留下真正的導水通道。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Treatment may then target the wrong location while the true conductive path remains unresolved.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「看起來最寬的裂隙必定是導水能力最大的裂隙。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The widest-looking fracture necessarily has the greatest hydraulic conductivity." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「導水裂隙交叉證據」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

使用調整過模型參數的同批影像也算獨立驗證。

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Images already used to tune the model also count as independent validation.
Depth mismatch assigns a flow change to the wrong fracture, and transient storage can mimic exchange.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「自動判讀與盲查」與「影像資料工程交接」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Automated interpretation and blind checks" and "Image-data engineering handover": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 自動判讀與盲查：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Automated interpretation and blind checks: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「自動判讀與盲查」如何影響孔內電視與裂隙判釋的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Automated interpretation and blind checks” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Borehole imaging and fracture interpretation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 演算法擅長找連續曲線，但電纜陰影、層理和鑽痕也可形成規律圖樣。訓練資料的岩性與水況限制模型外推，須以獨立人工盲查估計漏判和誤判，而非只看輸出數量。 假設人工確認20條裂隙，模型找到16條且另誤報4條，召回率16/20=80%，精確率16/(16+4)=80%。 只在清楚影像測試會高估模型效能，模糊水況下可能系統性漏掉細裂隙；以演算法輸出當真值再訓練，會把原先偏差固化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「自動判讀與盲查」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Algorithms find continuous curves, but cable shadows, bedding and drill marks can also form regular patterns. Training lithology and water conditions limit transfer, requiring independent blind checks of misses and false detections rather than output counts alone. For an assumed 20 confirmed fractures, 16 detections plus 4 false positives give recall 80% and precision 16/(16+4)=80%. Testing only clear images overstates performance and may hide systematic loss of fine fractures in turbid water. Retraining on automated output treated as truth perpetuates the initial bias. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Automated interpretation and blind checks” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「使用調整過模型參數的同批影像也算獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Images already used to tune the model also count as independent validation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「自動判讀與盲查」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Automated interpretation and blind checks”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 演算法擅長找連續曲線，但電纜陰影、層理和鑽痕也可形成規律圖樣。訓練資料的岩性與水況限制模型外推，須以獨立人工盲查估計漏判和誤判，而非只看輸出數量。
knowledge.textEn: Algorithms find continuous curves, but cable shadows, bedding and drill marks can also form regular patterns. Training lithology and water conditions limit transfer, requiring independent blind checks of misses and false detections rather than output counts alone.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：使用調整過模型參數的同批影像也算獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Images already used to tune the model also count as independent validation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「自動判讀與盲查」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

optionsEn: Algorithms find continuous curves, but cable shadows, bedding and drill marks can also form regular patterns.
Images already used to tune the model also count as independent validation.
Saving only the colored three-dimensional model permits recalibration of all fracture orientations.

steps.title: 自動判讀與盲查：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Automated interpretation and blind checks: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「自動判讀與盲查」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Automated interpretation and blind checks” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設人工確認20條裂隙，模型找到16條且另誤報4條，召回率16/20=80%，精確率16/(16+4)=80%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed 20 confirmed fractures, 16 detections plus 4 false positives give recall 80% and precision 16/(16+4)=80%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：預先選定含不同可讀性與岩性的盲查區段，將人工與模型逐條配對並保存漏判原因；部署版本與訓練域需可追溯，不以同一批調參影像宣稱獨立驗證。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Preselect blind intervals covering lithology and readability, match manual and model detections and retain reasons for misses; preserve deployed version and training domain, never calling tuning images independent validation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 自動判讀與盲查：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Automated interpretation and blind checks: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「自動判讀與盲查」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Automated interpretation and blind checks” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 預先選定含不同可讀性與岩性的盲查區段，將人工與模型逐條配對並保存漏判原因；部署版本與訓練域需可追溯，不以同一批調參影像宣稱獨立驗證。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：只在清楚影像測試會高估模型效能，模糊水況下可能系統性漏掉細裂隙；以演算法輸出當真值再訓練，會把原先偏差固化。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Preselect blind intervals covering lithology and readability, match manual and model detections and retain reasons for misses; preserve deployed version and training domain, never calling tuning images independent validation. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Testing only clear images overstates performance and may hide systematic loss of fine fractures in turbid water. Retraining on automated output treated as truth perpetuates the initial bias. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Preselect blind intervals covering lithology and readability, match manual and model detections and retain reasons for misses; preserve deployed version and training domain, never calling tuning images independent validation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只在清楚影像測試會高估模型效能，模糊水況下可能系統性漏掉細裂隙；以演算法輸出當真值再訓練，會把原先偏差固化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 自動判讀與盲查：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Automated interpretation and blind checks: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「自動判讀與盲查」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Automated interpretation and blind checks” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只在清楚影像測試會高估模型效能，模糊水況下可能系統性漏掉細裂隙；以演算法輸出當真值再訓練，會把原先偏差固化。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Testing only clear images overstates performance and may hide systematic loss of fine fractures in turbid water. Retraining on automated output treated as truth perpetuates the initial bias. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只在清楚影像測試會高估模型效能，模糊水況下可能系統性漏掉細裂隙；以演算法輸出當真值再訓練，會把原先偏差固化。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Retraining on automated output treated as truth perpetuates the initial bias.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「使用調整過模型參數的同批影像也算獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Images already used to tune the model also count as independent validation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只在清楚影像測試會高估模型效能，模糊水況下可能系統性漏掉細裂隙；以演算法輸出當真值再訓練，會把原先偏差固化。
knowledge.textEn: Testing only clear images overstates performance and may hide systematic loss of fine fractures in turbid water. Retraining on automated output treated as truth perpetuates the initial bias.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「自動判讀與盲查」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Automated interpretation and blind checks" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只在清楚影像測試會高估模型效能，模糊水況下可能系統性漏掉細裂隙；以演算法輸出當真值再訓練，會把原先偏差固化。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
只保存彩色三維模型就足以重新校正全部裂隙方位。
optionsEn: Testing only clear images overstates performance and may hide systematic loss of fine fractures in turbid water.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Saving only the colored three-dimensional model permits recalibration of all fracture orientations.
quiz.explanation: 只在清楚影像測試會高估模型效能，模糊水況下可能系統性漏掉細裂隙；以演算法輸出當真值再訓練，會把原先偏差固化。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Testing only clear images overstates performance and may hide systematic loss of fine fractures in turbid water. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 影像資料工程交接：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Image-data engineering handover: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「影像資料工程交接」如何影響孔內電視與裂隙判釋的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Image-data engineering handover” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Borehole imaging and fracture interpretation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 成像報告的線條是判釋結果，原始影像與校正紀錄才讓後人重建判斷。深度、方位、孔徑與採集條件必須形成版本一致的資料組，否則漂亮三維模型不能支援可追溯的工程審查。 假設100條判釋裂隙中92條具完整原圖與校準鏈，追溯率92%；其餘8條需個別標示證據缺口。 只有匯出圖片而無原始資料時，後續無法修正方位或重新判讀；若舊版裂隙混入新孔跡，整合模型可能出現不存在的交線與楔體。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「影像資料工程交接」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Interpretation lines are results, while raw images and calibration allow reconstruction. Depth, azimuth, diameter and acquisition conditions must form a version-consistent dataset; an attractive three-dimensional model alone cannot support an auditable engineering review. If 92 of an assumed 100 interpreted fractures have complete image and calibration chains, traceability is 92%; the other 8 need explicit individual evidence gaps. Image exports without raw records cannot support orientation correction or reinterpretation. Combining old fracture picks with a new trajectory may create intersections and wedges that never existed. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Image-data engineering handover” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只保存彩色三維模型就足以重新校正全部裂隙方位。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Saving only the colored three-dimensional model permits recalibration of all fracture orientations." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「影像資料工程交接」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Image-data engineering handover”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 影像資料工程交接
knowledge.text: 成像報告的線條是判釋結果，原始影像與校正紀錄才讓後人重建判斷。深度、方位、孔徑與採集條件必須形成版本一致的資料組，否則漂亮三維模型不能支援可追溯的工程審查。
knowledge.textEn: Interpretation lines are results, while raw images and calibration allow reconstruction. Depth, azimuth, diameter and acquisition conditions must form a version-consistent dataset; an attractive three-dimensional model alone cannot support an auditable engineering review.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只保存彩色三維模型就足以重新校正全部裂隙方位。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Saving only the colored three-dimensional model permits recalibration of all fracture orientations. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「影像資料工程交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Image-data engineering handover" is correct?
options: 只保存彩色三維模型就足以重新校正全部裂隙方位。
成像報告的線條是判釋結果，原始影像與校正紀錄才讓後人重建判斷。
孔壁影像看不清楚的區段可以直接記為沒有裂隙。
optionsEn: Saving only the colored three-dimensional model permits recalibration of all fracture orientations.
Interpretation lines are results, while raw images and calibration allow reconstruction.
Unreadable borehole-wall intervals can be logged directly as having no fractures.
quiz.explanation: 成像報告的線條是判釋結果，原始影像與校正紀錄才讓後人重建判斷。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Interpretation lines are results, while raw images and calibration allow reconstruction. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 影像資料工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Image-data engineering handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「影像資料工程交接」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Image-data engineering handover” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設100條判釋裂隙中92條具完整原圖與校準鏈，追溯率92%；其餘8條需個別標示證據缺口。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 92 of an assumed 100 interpreted fractures have complete image and calibration chains, traceability is 92%; the other 8 need explicit individual evidence gaps. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：隨機抽取裂隙由三維模型回查原圖、選點、校正及孔號，確認座標和深度版本一致；資料管理者與地質師共同簽認無法追溯項，設計者才能知道哪些判釋可重算。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Trace sampled model fractures to raw images, picks, corrections and hole identity, checking coordinate and depth versions; data and geology leads jointly identify untraceable records so designers know which interpretations can be reconstructed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設100條判釋裂隙中92條具完整原圖與校準鏈，追溯率92%；其餘8條需個別標示證據缺口。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 92 of an assumed 100 interpreted fractures have complete image and calibration chains, traceability is 92%; the other 8 need explicit individual evidence gaps.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「影像資料工程交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Image-data engineering handover", which statement holds?
options: 掃描時間間隔固定就保證垂直像素的深度間距固定。
孔壁橢圓化一定由原位應力造成，不可能是鑽進效應。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: A fixed scan-time interval guarantees constant vertical pixel spacing in depth.
Borehole ovality always comes from in-situ stress rather than drilling effects.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 影像資料工程交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Image-data engineering handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「影像資料工程交接」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Image-data engineering handover” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 隨機抽取裂隙由三維模型回查原圖、選點、校正及孔號，確認座標和深度版本一致；資料管理者與地質師共同簽認無法追溯項，設計者才能知道哪些判釋可重算。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：只有匯出圖片而無原始資料時，後續無法修正方位或重新判讀；若舊版裂隙混入新孔跡，整合模型可能出現不存在的交線與楔體。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Trace sampled model fractures to raw images, picks, corrections and hole identity, checking coordinate and depth versions; data and geology leads jointly identify untraceable records so designers know which interpretations can be reconstructed. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Image exports without raw records cannot support orientation correction or reinterpretation. Combining old fracture picks with a new trajectory may create intersections and wedges that never existed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄影像資料工程交接的資料來源與適用條件。隨機抽取裂隙由三維模型回查原圖、選點、校正及孔號，確認座標和深度版本一致；資料管理者與地質師共同簽認無法追溯項，設計者才能知道哪些判釋可重算。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for image-data engineering handover. Trace sampled model fractures to raw images, picks, corrections and hole identity, checking coordinate and depth versions; data and geology leads jointly identify untraceable records so designers know which interpretations can be reconstructed.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只有匯出圖片而無原始資料時，後續無法修正方位或重新判讀；若舊版裂隙混入新孔跡，整合模型可能出現不存在的交線與楔體。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Image exports without raw records cannot support orientation correction or reinterpretation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Combining old fracture picks with a new trajectory may create intersections and wedges that never existed.

quiz.question: 要驗證「影像資料工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Image-data engineering handover"?
options: 隨機抽取裂隙由三維模型回查原圖、選點、校正及孔號，確認座標和深度版本一致；資料管理者與地質師共同簽認無法追溯項，設計者才能知道哪些判釋可重算。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。

optionsEn: Trace sampled model fractures to raw images, picks, corrections and hole identity, checking coordinate and depth versions.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A single borehole samples every joint orientation with equal probability.

quiz.question: 在「影像資料工程交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Image-data engineering handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只有匯出圖片而無原始資料時，後續無法修正方位或重新判讀；若舊版裂隙混入新孔跡，整合模型可能出現不存在的交線與楔體。
孔壁影像看不清楚的區段可以直接記為沒有裂隙。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Image exports without raw records cannot support orientation correction or reinterpretation.
Unreadable borehole-wall intervals can be logged directly as having no fractures.
quiz.explanation: 只有匯出圖片而無原始資料時，後續無法修正方位或重新判讀；若舊版裂隙混入新孔跡，整合模型可能出現不存在的交線與楔體。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Image exports without raw records cannot support orientation correction or reinterpretation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 原位岩體應力量測
summary: 本課聚焦區分原位應力、測試擾動與反演假設，建立可審查的應力模型。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。
summaryEn: This course focuses on separate in-situ stress, test disturbance and inversion assumptions in an auditable stress model. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設平均密度2600 kg/m³、深度500 m，σv=ρgh=12.75 MPa；未計地形與構造修正。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設平面σx=12、σy=8、τxy=3 MPa，主值10±√13，得13.61及6.39 MPa；未代表第三主值。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. With assumed mean density 2600 kg/m³ and depth 500 m, σv=ρgh=12.75 MPa, excluding topographic and tectonic corrections. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed plane components σx=12, σy=8 and τxy=3 MPa, principal values are 10±√13=13.61 and 6.39 MPa; no third principal stress is specified. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「覆土重量基準」與「應力張量與主值」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Overburden stress baseline" and "Stress tensor and principal values": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 覆土重量基準：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Overburden stress baseline: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「覆土重量基準」如何影響原位岩體應力量測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Overburden stress baseline” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “In-situ rock-stress measurement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 垂直自重應力由上覆岩層重量積分而來，但山谷地形與構造應力會使局部狀態偏離一維近似。覆土估值提供量級檢查，不能取代現地量測，更不能據此假設水平應力必然相同。 假設平均密度2600 kg/m³、深度500 m，σv=ρgh=12.75 MPa；未計地形與構造修正。 把隧道深度誤用為海拔會造成大幅應力錯估，忽略谷側自由面也可能高估約束；之後用錯誤基準判定量測失敗，反而刪除真實高水平應力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「覆土重量基準」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Vertical overburden follows the integrated weight of rock, but topography and tectonic stress alter local conditions. The estimate is a scale check rather than a replacement for measurement, and does not imply equal horizontal stress. With assumed mean density 2600 kg/m³ and depth 500 m, σv=ρgh=12.75 MPa, excluding topographic and tectonic corrections. Using altitude instead of cover depth grossly misestimates stress, while ignoring a valley free surface overstates confinement. The incorrect baseline may then cause genuine high horizontal stress to be rejected. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Overburden stress baseline” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「隧道海拔乘岩石重度就是上覆岩體垂直應力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Tunnel altitude multiplied by rock unit weight gives vertical overburden stress." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「覆土重量基準」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Overburden stress baseline”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 覆土重量基準
knowledge.text: 垂直自重應力由上覆岩層重量積分而來，但山谷地形與構造應力會使局部狀態偏離一維近似。覆土估值提供量級檢查，不能取代現地量測，更不能據此假設水平應力必然相同。
knowledge.textEn: Vertical overburden follows the integrated weight of rock, but topography and tectonic stress alter local conditions. The estimate is a scale check rather than a replacement for measurement, and does not imply equal horizontal stress.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：隧道海拔乘岩石重度就是上覆岩體垂直應力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Tunnel altitude multiplied by rock unit weight gives vertical overburden stress. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「覆土重量基準」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Overburden stress baseline" is correct?
options: 隧道海拔乘岩石重度就是上覆岩體垂直應力。
垂直自重應力由上覆岩層重量積分而來，但山谷地形與構造應力會使局部狀態偏離一維近似。
只要主應力量值正確，坐標軸和剪應力符號就不重要。
optionsEn: Tunnel altitude multiplied by rock unit weight gives vertical overburden stress.
Vertical overburden follows the integrated weight of rock, but topography and tectonic stress alter local conditions.
Correct principal magnitudes make coordinate axes and shear signs unimportant.
quiz.explanation: 垂直自重應力由上覆岩層重量積分而來，但山谷地形與構造應力會使局部狀態偏離一維近似。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Vertical overburden follows the integrated weight of rock, but topography and tectonic stress alter local conditions. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 覆土重量基準：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Overburden stress baseline: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「覆土重量基準」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Overburden stress baseline” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設平均密度2600 kg/m³、深度500 m，σv=ρgh=12.75 MPa；未計地形與構造修正。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. With assumed mean density 2600 kg/m³ and depth 500 m, σv=ρgh=12.75 MPa, excluding topographic and tectonic corrections. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用地形、分層密度及孔口高程建立自重包絡，與量測分量在同一坐標比較；顯著差異須先查基準與局部地形，再由岩工工程師評估是否反映構造或測試擾動。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build an overburden envelope from topography, layered density and collar elevation and compare measured components in one frame; investigate datum and topography before interpreting differences as tectonics or testing disturbance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設平均密度2600 kg/m³、深度500 m，σv=ρgh=12.75 MPa；未計地形與構造修正。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. With assumed mean density 2600 kg/m³ and depth 500 m, σv=ρgh=12.75 MPa, excluding topographic and tectonic corrections.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「覆土重量基準」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Overburden stress baseline", which statement holds?
options: 套鑽量到的所有應變都只能來自原始應力釋放。
任何單側孔壁剝落都能直接判定最大主應力方向。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: All strain measured during overcoring must arise solely from original stress relief.
Any one-sided borehole spalling directly establishes the maximum principal-stress direction.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 覆土重量基準：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Overburden stress baseline: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「覆土重量基準」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Overburden stress baseline” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用地形、分層密度及孔口高程建立自重包絡，與量測分量在同一坐標比較；顯著差異須先查基準與局部地形，再由岩工工程師評估是否反映構造或測試擾動。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把隧道深度誤用為海拔會造成大幅應力錯估，忽略谷側自由面也可能高估約束；之後用錯誤基準判定量測失敗，反而刪除真實高水平應力。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build an overburden envelope from topography, layered density and collar elevation and compare measured components in one frame; investigate datum and topography before interpreting differences as tectonics or testing disturbance. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Using altitude instead of cover depth grossly misestimates stress, while ignoring a valley free surface overstates confinement. The incorrect baseline may then cause genuine high horizontal stress to be rejected. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄覆土重量基準的資料來源與適用條件。用地形、分層密度及孔口高程建立自重包絡，與量測分量在同一坐標比較；顯著差異須先查基準與局部地形，再由岩工工程師評估是否反映構造或測試擾動。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for overburden stress baseline. Build an overburden envelope from topography, layered density and collar elevation and compare measured components in one frame; investigate datum and topography before interpreting differences as tectonics or testing disturbance.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把隧道深度誤用為海拔會造成大幅應力錯估，忽略谷側自由面也可能高估約束；之後用錯誤基準判定量測失敗，反而刪除真實高水平應力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using altitude instead of cover depth grossly misestimates stress, while ignoring a valley free surface overstates confinement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用地形、分層密度及孔口高程建立自重包絡，與量測分量在同一坐標比較；顯著差異須先查基準與局部地形，再由岩工工程師評估是否反映構造或測試擾動。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把隧道深度誤用為海拔會造成大幅應力錯估，忽略谷側自由面也可能高估約束；之後用錯誤基準判定量測失敗，反而刪除真實高水平應力。
knowledge.textEn: Build an overburden envelope from topography, layered density and collar elevation and compare measured components in one frame; investigate datum and topography before interpreting differences as tectonics or testing disturbance. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Using altitude instead of cover depth grossly misestimates stress, while ignoring a valley free surface overstates confinement. The incorrect baseline may then cause genuine high horizontal stress to be rejected.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄覆土重量基準的資料來源與適用條件。用地形、分層密度及孔口高程建立自重包絡，與量測分量在同一坐標比較；顯著差異須先查基準與局部地形，再由岩工工程師評估是否反映構造或測試擾動。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for overburden stress baseline. Build an overburden envelope from topography, layered density and collar elevation and compare measured components in one frame; investigate datum and topography before interpreting differences as tectonics or testing disturbance.

quiz.question: 要驗證「覆土重量基準」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Overburden stress baseline"?
options: 用地形、分層密度及孔口高程建立自重包絡，與量測分量在同一坐標比較；顯著差異須先查基準與局部地形，再由岩工工程師評估是否反映構造或測試擾動。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
洞壁附近的應力量測必定就是未擾動遠場應力。
optionsEn: Build an overburden envelope from topography, layered density and collar elevation and compare measured components in one frame.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A measurement near the tunnel wall necessarily represents undisturbed far-field stress.
quiz.explanation: 用地形、分層密度及孔口高程建立自重包絡，與量測分量在同一坐標比較；顯著差異須先查基準與局部地形，再由岩工工程師評估是否反映構造或測試擾動。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Build an overburden envelope from topography, layered density and collar elevation and compare measured components in one frame; investigate datum and topography before interpreting differences as tectonics or testing disturbance. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 覆土重量基準：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Overburden stress baseline: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「覆土重量基準」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Overburden stress baseline” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把隧道深度誤用為海拔會造成大幅應力錯估，忽略谷側自由面也可能高估約束；之後用錯誤基準判定量測失敗，反而刪除真實高水平應力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using altitude instead of cover depth grossly misestimates stress, while ignoring a valley free surface overstates confinement. The incorrect baseline may then cause genuine high horizontal stress to be rejected. steps.title: 應力張量與主值：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Stress tensor and principal values: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「應力張量與主值」如何影響原位岩體應力量測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stress tensor and principal values” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “In-situ rock-stress measurement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 應力是具有方向的張量，單一法向讀值不能描述岩體三維受力。主應力由張量特徵值求得，旋轉坐標只改變分量表達，不改變主值；壓縮正負號與剪應力定義需一致。 假設平面σx=12、σy=8、τxy=3 MPa，主值10±√13，得13.61及6.39 MPa；未代表第三主值。 交換剪應力符號會旋轉主方向，單位或坐標軸混淆又可能保持合理主值卻方向錯誤；支護與岩爆評估因此可能針對錯誤方位。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「應力張量與主值」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Stress is a directional tensor, not one normal reading. Principal stresses are its eigenvalues; rotating coordinates changes components but not the principal values. Compression sign convention and shear definitions must remain consistent throughout the analysis. For assumed plane components σx=12, σy=8 and τxy=3 MPa, principal values are 10±√13=13.61 and 6.39 MPa; no third principal stress is specified. Reversing shear sign rotates principal direction; unit or axis mistakes can leave plausible magnitudes with incorrect orientation. Support and rockburst assessments may consequently focus on the wrong direction. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Stress tensor and principal values” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.textEn: Stress is a directional tensor, not one normal reading. Principal stresses are its eigenvalues; rotating coordinates changes components but not the principal values.

knowledge.text: 誤解：只要主應力量值正確，坐標軸和剪應力符號就不重要。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed plane components σx=12, σy=8 and τxy=3 MPa, principal values are 10±√13=13.61 and 6.39 MPa; no third principal stress is specified. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：獨立計算特徵值並檢查跡與行列式在旋轉前後不變，對照儀器座標到地理座標的旋轉矩陣；報告列出量測分量、符號和未辨識方向，避免用二維結果假裝完整三維狀態。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Independently calculate eigenvalues and verify invariant trace and determinant, checking the instrument-to-geographic rotation matrix; report measured components, signs and unresolved directions rather than presenting a plane result as complete three-dimensional stress.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Every rock must use a coefficient of exactly one when subtracting pore pressure.
Reversing shear sign rotates principal direction; unit or axis mistakes can leave plausible magnitudes with incorrect orientation.
quiz.explanation: 交換剪應力符號會旋轉主方向，單位或坐標軸混淆又可能保持合理主值卻方向錯誤；支護與岩爆評估因此可能針對錯誤方位。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Reversing shear sign rotates principal direction; unit or axis mistakes can leave plausible magnitudes with incorrect orientation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「有效應力與孔壓」與「套鑽應變回復」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Effective stress and pore pressure" and "Overcoring strain relief": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 有效應力與孔壓：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Effective stress and pore pressure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「有效應力與孔壓」如何影響原位岩體應力量測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Effective stress and pore pressure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “In-situ rock-stress measurement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 岩骨架承擔的有效應力取決於總應力與孔壓耦合，Biot係數不一定恰為一。減壓或開挖同時改變邊界與排水條件，不能用同一孔壓直接扣所有已受擾動測點。 假設σ=15 MPa、u=3 MPa、α=0.8，σ′=σ−αu=12.6 MPa；若係數α=1則為12 MPa。 重複扣除已換算過的孔壓會低估有效應力，忽略未平衡壓力又會使不同方法看似矛盾；錯誤可能被誤解為真實的空間應力變化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「有效應力與孔壓」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Effective skeleton stress depends on total stress, pore pressure and a Biot coefficient that need not equal one. Depressurization and excavation change boundaries and drainage, so one pressure value cannot be subtracted indiscriminately at disturbed locations. For assumed σ=15 MPa, u=3 MPa and α=0.8, σ′=σ−αu=12.6 MPa; with α=1 it becomes 12 MPa. Subtracting pore pressure twice underestimates effective stress, while nonequilibrated pressure makes methods appear inconsistent. Such bookkeeping errors can be mistaken for genuine spatial stress variation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Effective stress and pore pressure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有岩石都必須用等於一的係數扣除孔隙水壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every rock must use a coefficient of exactly one when subtracting pore pressure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「有效應力與孔壓」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Effective stress and pore pressure”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 有效應力與孔壓
knowledge.text: 岩骨架承擔的有效應力取決於總應力與孔壓耦合，Biot係數不一定恰為一。減壓或開挖同時改變邊界與排水條件，不能用同一孔壓直接扣所有已受擾動測點。
knowledge.textEn: Effective skeleton stress depends on total stress, pore pressure and a Biot coefficient that need not equal one. Depressurization and excavation change boundaries and drainage, so one pressure value cannot be subtracted indiscriminately at disturbed locations.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：所有岩石都必須用等於一的係數扣除孔隙水壓。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every rock must use a coefficient of exactly one when subtracting pore pressure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「有效應力與孔壓」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Effective stress and pore pressure" is correct?
options: 岩骨架承擔的有效應力取決於總應力與孔壓耦合，Biot係數不一定恰為一。
所有岩石都必須用等於一的係數扣除孔隙水壓。
套鑽量到的所有應變都只能來自原始應力釋放。
optionsEn: Effective skeleton stress depends on total stress, pore pressure and a Biot coefficient that need not equal one.
Every rock must use a coefficient of exactly one when subtracting pore pressure.
All strain measured during overcoring must arise solely from original stress relief.
quiz.explanation: 岩骨架承擔的有效應力取決於總應力與孔壓耦合，Biot係數不一定恰為一。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Effective skeleton stress depends on total stress, pore pressure and a Biot coefficient that need not equal one. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 有效應力與孔壓：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Effective stress and pore pressure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「有效應力與孔壓」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Effective stress and pore pressure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設σ=15 MPa、u=3 MPa、α=0.8，σ′=σ−αu=12.6 MPa；若係數α=1則為12 MPa。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed σ=15 MPa, u=3 MPa and α=0.8, σ′=σ−αu=12.6 MPa; with α=1 it becomes 12 MPa. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將孔壓量測與應力試驗時間、隔離區間及排水狀態對齊，明列係數來源；比較總應力與有效應力兩種輸出，只有同一物理定義與飽和狀態的結果才可合併。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align pore-pressure observations with test time, isolated interval and drainage state and document coefficient origin; report total and effective values separately, combining only results with consistent physical definition and saturation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設σ=15 MPa、u=3 MPa、α=0.8，σ′=σ−αu=12.6 MPa；若係數α=1則為12 MPa。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed σ=15 MPa, u=3 MPa and α=0.8, σ′=σ−αu=12.6 MPa; with α=1 it becomes 12 MPa.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「有效應力與孔壓」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Effective stress and pore pressure", which statement holds?
options: 任何單側孔壁剝落都能直接判定最大主應力方向。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
洞壁附近的應力量測必定就是未擾動遠場應力。
optionsEn: Any one-sided borehole spalling directly establishes the maximum principal-stress direction.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
A measurement near the tunnel wall necessarily represents undisturbed far-field stress.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 有效應力與孔壓：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Effective stress and pore pressure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「有效應力與孔壓」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Effective stress and pore pressure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將孔壓量測與應力試驗時間、隔離區間及排水狀態對齊，明列係數來源；比較總應力與有效應力兩種輸出，只有同一物理定義與飽和狀態的結果才可合併。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：重複扣除已換算過的孔壓會低估有效應力，忽略未平衡壓力又會使不同方法看似矛盾；錯誤可能被誤解為真實的空間應力變化。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align pore-pressure observations with test time, isolated interval and drainage state and document coefficient origin; report total and effective values separately, combining only results with consistent physical definition and saturation. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Subtracting pore pressure twice underestimates effective stress, while nonequilibrated pressure makes methods appear inconsistent. Such bookkeeping errors can be mistaken for genuine spatial stress variation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄有效應力與孔壓的資料來源與適用條件。將孔壓量測與應力試驗時間、隔離區間及排水狀態對齊，明列係數來源；比較總應力與有效應力兩種輸出，只有同一物理定義與飽和狀態的結果才可合併。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for effective stress and pore pressure. Align pore-pressure observations with test time, isolated interval and drainage state and document coefficient origin; report total and effective values separately, combining only results with consistent physical definition and saturation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：重複扣除已換算過的孔壓會低估有效應力，忽略未平衡壓力又會使不同方法看似矛盾；錯誤可能被誤解為真實的空間應力變化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Subtracting pore pressure twice underestimates effective stress, while nonequilibrated pressure makes methods appear inconsistent. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將孔壓量測與應力試驗時間、隔離區間及排水狀態對齊，明列係數來源；比較總應力與有效應力兩種輸出，只有同一物理定義與飽和狀態的結果才可合併。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：重複扣除已換算過的孔壓會低估有效應力，忽略未平衡壓力又會使不同方法看似矛盾；錯誤可能被誤解為真實的空間應力變化。
knowledge.textEn: Align pore-pressure observations with test time, isolated interval and drainage state and document coefficient origin; report total and effective values separately, combining only results with consistent physical definition and saturation. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Subtracting pore pressure twice underestimates effective stress, while nonequilibrated pressure makes methods appear inconsistent. Such bookkeeping errors can be mistaken for genuine spatial stress variation.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄有效應力與孔壓的資料來源與適用條件。將孔壓量測與應力試驗時間、隔離區間及排水狀態對齊，明列係數來源；比較總應力與有效應力兩種輸出，只有同一物理定義與飽和狀態的結果才可合併。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for effective stress and pore pressure. Align pore-pressure observations with test time, isolated interval and drainage state and document coefficient origin; report total and effective values separately, combining only results with consistent physical definition and saturation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「有效應力與孔壓」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Effective stress and pore pressure"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
不同深度的應力只要取平均就可代表整個場址。
將孔壓量測與應力試驗時間、隔離區間及排水狀態對齊，明列係數來源；比較總應力與有效應力兩種輸出，只有同一物理定義與飽和狀態的結果才可合併。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Averaging stress measurements at different depths adequately represents the entire site.
Align pore-pressure observations with test time, isolated interval and drainage state and document coefficient origin.
quiz.explanation: 將孔壓量測與應力試驗時間、隔離區間及排水狀態對齊，明列係數來源；比較總應力與有效應力兩種輸出，只有同一物理定義與飽和狀態的結果才可合併。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Align pore-pressure observations with test time, isolated interval and drainage state and document coefficient origin; report total and effective values separately, combining only results with consistent physical definition and saturation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 有效應力與孔壓：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Effective stress and pore pressure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「有效應力與孔壓」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Effective stress and pore pressure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 重複扣除已換算過的孔壓會低估有效應力，忽略未平衡壓力又會使不同方法看似矛盾；錯誤可能被誤解為真實的空間應力變化。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Subtracting pore pressure twice underestimates effective stress, while nonequilibrated pressure makes methods appear inconsistent. Such bookkeeping errors can be mistaken for genuine spatial stress variation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：重複扣除已換算過的孔壓會低估有效應力，忽略未平衡壓力又會使不同方法看似矛盾；錯誤可能被誤解為真實的空間應力變化。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Such bookkeeping errors can be mistaken for genuine spatial stress variation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「所有岩石都必須用等於一的係數扣除孔隙水壓。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every rock must use a coefficient of exactly one when subtracting pore pressure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 重複扣除已換算過的孔壓會低估有效應力，忽略未平衡壓力又會使不同方法看似矛盾；錯誤可能被誤解為真實的空間應力變化。
knowledge.textEn: Subtracting pore pressure twice underestimates effective stress, while nonequilibrated pressure makes methods appear inconsistent. Such bookkeeping errors can be mistaken for genuine spatial stress variation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「有效應力與孔壓」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Effective stress and pore pressure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 重複扣除已換算過的孔壓會低估有效應力，忽略未平衡壓力又會使不同方法看似矛盾；錯誤可能被誤解為真實的空間應力變化。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
套鑽量到的所有應變都只能來自原始應力釋放。
optionsEn: Subtracting pore pressure twice underestimates effective stress, while nonequilibrated pressure makes methods appear inconsistent.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
All strain measured during overcoring must arise solely from original stress relief.
quiz.explanation: 重複扣除已換算過的孔壓會低估有效應力，忽略未平衡壓力又會使不同方法看似矛盾；錯誤可能被誤解為真實的空間應力變化。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Subtracting pore pressure twice underestimates effective stress, while nonequilibrated pressure makes methods appear inconsistent. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 套鑽應變回復：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Overcoring strain relief: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「套鑽應變回復」如何影響原位岩體應力量測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Overcoring strain relief” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “In-situ rock-stress measurement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 套鑽釋放局部約束後的應變，需配合彈性常數反演原始應力。岩石若有裂隙、塑性或溫度變化，回復量不再只來自彈性卸載，感測器黏結和方向也會控制可辨識性。 假設單軸示意E=40 GPa、回復應變200 με，σ=Eε=8 MPa；實際多軸套鑽需完整校正矩陣。 套鑽過程新裂縫會產生突然應變跳動，若照線彈性式解讀便可能得到虛假的高應力；量規脫黏也可能呈現平順但偏低的回復。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「套鑽應變回復」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

A new crack during overcoring produces a strain jump that linear inversion can misread as high stress; debonded gauges may instead show smooth but falsely low relief. For an assumed uniaxial illustration E=40 GPa and relieved strain 200 με, σ=Eε=8 MPa; real multiaxial overcoring requires a full calibration matrix. stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Hydraulic-fracture pressure interpretation" and "Borehole breakouts and orientation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 水力破裂壓力判讀：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic-fracture pressure interpretation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水力破裂壓力判讀」如何影響原位岩體應力量測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hydraulic-fracture pressure interpretation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “In-situ rock-stress measurement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 壓力歷程包含管路儲能、裂縫起裂、延伸與閉合，不同轉折對應不同物理事件。閉合壓力可提供特定法向應力線索，但既有節理重開與滲漏會讓簡化理論不適用。 假設地表讀值8 MPa、測段低100 m且水密度1000 kg/m³，靜水修正0.981 MPa，井下8.981 MPa；未計流動損失。 把泵停止時的瞬間尖峰當閉合壓力會混入管路效應，隔離失效又可能使壓力下降看似裂縫延伸；兩者均可導致應力量值失真。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水力破裂壓力判讀」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pressure history combines line storage, initiation, propagation and closure, with different transitions representing different processes. Closure informs a specific normal stress, but reopening existing joints and leakage can invalidate simple interpretations. Assume surface pressure 8 MPa and an interval 100 m lower with water density 1000 kg/m³; static correction 0.981 MPa gives 8.981 MPa downhole, excluding flowing losses. Treating the immediate pump-stop spike as closure pressure includes line effects, while failed isolation may make leakage resemble fracture extension. Both distort the inferred stress magnitude. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Hydraulic-fracture pressure interpretation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 孔壁應力集中可造成成對崩落，但鑽具磨損、節理剝落也可能留下近似形狀。方向推論需符合孔軸、岩性與應力集中模型，裂縫影像和孔徑資料應相互支持而不是互相替代。 假設線彈性均質等向岩、無內壓自由圓孔壁，孔軸沿第三主應力方向；遠場主水平應力20與10 MPa，最大環向壓應力3×20−10=50 MPa。 把單側節理剝落當成應力崩落會給錯誤主方向，孔徑平均又會抹去成對特徵；若未檢查局部破裂，方向結果可能只是鑽進痕跡。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「孔壁崩落與方位」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Stress concentration can form paired breakouts, but drilling wear and joint spalling produce similar shapes. Orientation inference must fit the hole axis, lithology and concentration model, with images and calipers providing complementary evidence. Assume homogeneous isotropic linear elasticity, a traction-free circular wall without internal pressure, and borehole axis along the third principal direction; horizontal principal stresses 20 and 10 MPa give maximum hoop compression 50 MPa. Interpreting one-sided joint spalling as a breakout gives a false principal direction, while averaged caliper data erase paired features. Unchecked orientation results may describe drilling marks rather than stress. quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Borehole breakouts and orientation" is correct?
options: 孔壁應力集中可造成成對崩落，但鑽具磨損、節理剝落也可能留下近似形狀。
任何單側孔壁剝落都能直接判定最大主應力方向。
層理岩的不同方向模數可以任意交換而不影響反演。
optionsEn: Stress concentration can form paired breakouts, but drilling wear and joint spalling produce similar shapes.
Any one-sided borehole spalling directly establishes the maximum principal-stress direction.
Directional moduli in bedded rock can be interchanged without affecting inversion.
quiz.explanation: 孔壁應力集中可造成成對崩落，但鑽具磨損、節理剝落也可能留下近似形狀。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 孔壁崩落與方位：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Borehole breakouts and orientation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「孔壁崩落與方位」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Borehole breakouts and orientation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設線彈性均質等向岩、無內壓自由圓孔壁，孔軸沿第三主應力方向；遠場主水平應力20與10 MPa，最大環向壓應力3×20−10=50 MPa。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume homogeneous isotropic linear elasticity, a traction-free circular wall without internal pressure, and borehole axis along the third principal direction; horizontal principal stresses 20 and 10 MPa give maximum hoop compression 50 MPa. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比對成對特徵是否沿深度穩定、與已知鑽具方向無關，並查核孔壁裂縫與岩性轉換；方向估計附可用區間及不確定度，僅在模型假設成立時才供主應力方位推論。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check whether paired features persist with depth independently of drilling orientation and compare wall cracks and lithology; report usable intervals and angular uncertainty, inferring stress direction only when the mechanical assumptions are justified.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 孔壁崩落與方位：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「孔壁崩落與方位」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Borehole breakouts and orientation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比對成對特徵是否沿深度穩定、與已知鑽具方向無關，並查核孔壁裂縫與岩性轉換；方向估計附可用區間及不確定度，僅在模型假設成立時才供主應力方位推論。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把單側節理剝落當成應力崩落會給錯誤主方向，孔徑平均又會抹去成對特徵；若未檢查局部破裂，方向結果可能只是鑽進痕跡。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check whether paired features persist with depth independently of drilling orientation and compare wall cracks and lithology; report usable intervals and angular uncertainty, inferring stress direction only when the mechanical assumptions are justified. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Interpreting one-sided joint spalling as a breakout gives a false principal direction, while averaged caliper data erase paired features. Unchecked orientation results may describe drilling marks rather than stress. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for borehole breakouts and orientation. Check whether paired features persist with depth independently of drilling orientation and compare wall cracks and lithology; report usable intervals and angular uncertainty, inferring stress direction only when the mechanical assumptions are justified.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把單側節理剝落當成應力崩落會給錯誤主方向，孔徑平均又會抹去成對特徵；若未檢查局部破裂，方向結果可能只是鑽進痕跡。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Interpreting one-sided joint spalling as a breakout gives a false principal direction, while averaged caliper data erase paired features. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「孔壁崩落與方位」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Borehole breakouts and orientation"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
所有岩石都必須用等於一的係數扣除孔隙水壓。
比對成對特徵是否沿深度穩定、與已知鑽具方向無關，並查核孔壁裂縫與岩性轉換；方向估計附可用區間及不確定度，僅在模型假設成立時才供主應力方位推論。
