steps.title: 孔壁崩落與方位：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Borehole breakouts and orientation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「孔壁崩落與方位」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Borehole breakouts and orientation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把單側節理剝落當成應力崩落會給錯誤主方向，孔徑平均又會抹去成對特徵；若未檢查局部破裂，方向結果可能只是鑽進痕跡。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Interpreting one-sided joint spalling as a breakout gives a false principal direction, while averaged caliper data erase paired features. Unchecked orientation results may describe drilling marks rather than stress. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把單側節理剝落當成應力崩落會給錯誤主方向，孔徑平均又會抹去成對特徵；若未檢查局部破裂，方向結果可能只是鑽進痕跡。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Unchecked orientation results may describe drilling marks rather than stress.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「任何單側孔壁剝落都能直接判定最大主應力方向。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Any one-sided borehole spalling directly establishes the maximum principal-stress direction." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把單側節理剝落當成應力崩落會給錯誤主方向，孔徑平均又會抹去成對特徵；若未檢查局部破裂，方向結果可能只是鑽進痕跡。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「孔壁崩落與方位」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
層理岩的不同方向模數可以任意交換而不影響反演。
optionsEn: Interpreting one-sided joint spalling as a breakout gives a false principal direction, while averaged caliper data erase paired features.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Directional moduli in bedded rock can be interchanged without affecting inversion.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「彈性各向異性」與「開挖擾動與距離」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Elastic anisotropy" and "Excavation disturbance and distance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 彈性各向異性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Elastic anisotropy: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「彈性各向異性」如何影響原位岩體應力量測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Elastic anisotropy” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “In-situ rock-stress measurement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 層理岩沿不同方向有不同剛度，量到相同應變未必代表相同應力。以等向性反演各向異性岩石會把材料方向性錯配成應力方向性，因此取樣方向與彈性矩陣須同步交接。 假設同一100 με在兩向模數20與40 GPa下，單軸示意應力分別2與4 MPa；並非完整各向異性解。 模數選錯方向會使應力比例偏差，增加量規數卻不增加方向資訊仍不能解決；過度參數化反演可能完美擬合雜訊而失去物理可信度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「彈性各向異性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Layered rock has direction-dependent stiffness, so equal strain need not mean equal stress. Isotropic inversion can misattribute material anisotropy to stress anisotropy, requiring specimen orientation and elastic matrices to accompany the measurements. For assumed strain 100 με and directional moduli 20 and 40 GPa, uniaxial illustrative stresses are 2 and 4 MPa, not a full anisotropic solution. Using stiffness from the wrong direction biases stress ratios, and adding gauges without directional diversity does not cure it. An overparameterized inversion can fit noise perfectly while losing physical credibility. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Elastic anisotropy” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「層理岩的不同方向模數可以任意交換而不影響反演。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Directional moduli in bedded rock can be interchanged without affecting inversion." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「彈性各向異性」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Elastic anisotropy”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 層理岩沿不同方向有不同剛度，量到相同應變未必代表相同應力。以等向性反演各向異性岩石會把材料方向性錯配成應力方向性，因此取樣方向與彈性矩陣須同步交接。
knowledge.textEn: Layered rock has direction-dependent stiffness, so equal strain need not mean equal stress. Isotropic inversion can misattribute material anisotropy to stress anisotropy, requiring specimen orientation and elastic matrices to accompany the measurements.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：層理岩的不同方向模數可以任意交換而不影響反演。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Directional moduli in bedded rock can be interchanged without affecting inversion. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「彈性各向異性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Elastic anisotropy" is correct?

層理岩沿不同方向有不同剛度，量到相同應變未必代表相同應力。

optionsEn: Directional moduli in bedded rock can be interchanged without affecting inversion.
Layered rock has direction-dependent stiffness, so equal strain need not mean equal stress.
A measurement near the tunnel wall necessarily represents undisturbed far-field stress.
quiz.explanation: 層理岩沿不同方向有不同剛度，量到相同應變未必代表相同應力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設同一100 με在兩向模數20與40 GPa下，單軸示意應力分別2與4 MPa；並非完整各向異性解。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed strain 100 με and directional moduli 20 and 40 GPa, uniaxial illustrative stresses are 2 and 4 MPa, not a full anisotropic solution. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以定向試件量測多方向剛度及泊松效應，核對儀器方向與層理方向；比較等向與各向異性反演殘差，若資料不足以辨識全部常數，需給出模型範圍而非硬湊唯一解。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Test oriented specimens for directional stiffness and lateral response and align gauge and bedding directions; compare isotropic and anisotropic inversion residuals, reporting model bounds when data cannot identify every elastic constant.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 彈性各向異性：試驗與驗證

Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Using stiffness from the wrong direction biases stress ratios, and adding gauges without directional diversity does not cure it. An overparameterized inversion can fit noise perfectly while losing physical credibility. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for elastic anisotropy. Test oriented specimens for directional stiffness and lateral response and align gauge and bedding directions; compare isotropic and anisotropic inversion residuals, reporting model bounds when data cannot identify every elastic constant.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：模數選錯方向會使應力比例偏差，增加量規數卻不增加方向資訊仍不能解決；過度參數化反演可能完美擬合雜訊而失去物理可信度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

quiz.question: 要驗證「彈性各向異性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.

steps.title: 彈性各向異性：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「彈性各向異性」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Elastic anisotropy” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 模數選錯方向會使應力比例偏差，增加量規數卻不增加方向資訊仍不能解決；過度參數化反演可能完美擬合雜訊而失去物理可信度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using stiffness from the wrong direction biases stress ratios, and adding gauges without directional diversity does not cure it. An overparameterized inversion can fit noise perfectly while losing physical credibility. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：模數選錯方向會使應力比例偏差，增加量規數卻不增加方向資訊仍不能解決；過度參數化反演可能完美擬合雜訊而失去物理可信度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: An overparameterized inversion can fit noise perfectly while losing physical credibility.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「層理岩的不同方向模數可以任意交換而不影響反演。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Directional moduli in bedded rock can be interchanged without affecting inversion." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 模數選錯方向會使應力比例偏差，增加量規數卻不增加方向資訊仍不能解決；過度參數化反演可能完美擬合雜訊而失去物理可信度。
knowledge.textEn: Using stiffness from the wrong direction biases stress ratios, and adding gauges without directional diversity does not cure it. An overparameterized inversion can fit noise perfectly while losing physical credibility.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「彈性各向異性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Elastic anisotropy" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
模數選錯方向會使應力比例偏差，增加量規數卻不增加方向資訊仍不能解決；過度參數化反演可能完美擬合雜訊而失去物理可信度。
洞壁附近的應力量測必定就是未擾動遠場應力。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Using stiffness from the wrong direction biases stress ratios, and adding gauges without directional diversity does not cure it.
A measurement near the tunnel wall necessarily represents undisturbed far-field stress.
quiz.explanation: 模數選錯方向會使應力比例偏差，增加量規數卻不增加方向資訊仍不能解決；過度參數化反演可能完美擬合雜訊而失去物理可信度。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using stiffness from the wrong direction biases stress ratios, and adding gauges without directional diversity does not cure it. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 開挖擾動與距離：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 隧道附近量到的應力已受自由面卸載與集中影響，距掌子面遠不一定等於未擾動。應以開挖幾何、破裂帶與量測時序判斷代表性，不能直接把近壁測點當成遠場應力。 假設圓孔彈性影響項比例a²/r²，a=5 m、r=15 m時為1/9=0.111；只是幾何衰減項，不是完整應力。 將卸載後低應力當成原始狀態會低估深部風險，將局部集中當遠場又會過度放大；兩者皆使後續開挖分析的邊界載入不正確。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「開挖擾動與距離」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Stress near a tunnel is redistributed by unloading and concentration; distance from the face alone does not prove undisturbed conditions. Excavation geometry, damage and timing determine whether a measurement represents the far field. For an assumed circular-opening elastic term a²/r² with a=5 m and r=15 m, the term is 1/9=0.111; it is not the complete stress solution. Using unloaded stress as the initial state underestimates deeper risk, while treating local concentration as far-field stress exaggerates it. Both apply incorrect boundary loading in subsequent excavation analysis. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Excavation disturbance and distance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「洞壁附近的應力量測必定就是未擾動遠場應力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A measurement near the tunnel wall necessarily represents undisturbed far-field stress." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「開挖擾動與距離」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Excavation disturbance and distance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A measurement near the tunnel wall necessarily represents undisturbed far-field stress. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「開挖擾動與距離」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Excavation disturbance and distance" is correct?
options: 洞壁附近的應力量測必定就是未擾動遠場應力。
反演殘差很小就證明不存在共同感測器偏差。
隧道附近量到的應力已受自由面卸載與集中影響，距掌子面遠不一定等於未擾動。
optionsEn: A measurement near the tunnel wall necessarily represents undisturbed far-field stress.
Small inversion residuals prove that common sensor bias is absent.
Stress near a tunnel is redistributed by unloading and concentration; distance from the face alone does not prove undisturbed conditions.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「開挖擾動與距離」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

optionsEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
Tunnel altitude multiplied by rock unit weight gives vertical overburden stress.
Every rock must use a coefficient of exactly one when subtracting pore pressure.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 開挖擾動與距離：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Excavation disturbance and distance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「開挖擾動與距離」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Excavation disturbance and distance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把測點放入已記錄施工階段的三維模型，與不同距離、不同時間測點比較；若近壁裂隙或塑性明顯，需使用相應模型說明擾動，不能用單一距離門檻宣布原位代表性。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：將卸載後低應力當成原始狀態會低估深部風險，將局部集中當遠場又會過度放大；兩者皆使後續開挖分析的邊界載入不正確。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Place measurements in a model matching recorded excavation stages and compare locations and times; where near-wall cracking or plasticity is evident, model disturbance explicitly rather than declaring representativeness from one distance threshold. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Using unloaded stress as the initial state underestimates deeper risk, while treating local concentration as far-field stress exaggerates it. Both apply incorrect boundary loading in subsequent excavation analysis. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄開挖擾動與距離的資料來源與適用條件。把測點放入已記錄施工階段的三維模型，與不同距離、不同時間測點比較；若近壁裂隙或塑性明顯，需使用相應模型說明擾動，不能用單一距離門檻宣布原位代表性。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for excavation disturbance and distance. Place measurements in a model matching recorded excavation stages and compare locations and times; where near-wall cracking or plasticity is evident, model disturbance explicitly rather than declaring representativeness from one distance threshold.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將卸載後低應力當成原始狀態會低估深部風險，將局部集中當遠場又會過度放大；兩者皆使後續開挖分析的邊界載入不正確。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using unloaded stress as the initial state underestimates deeper risk, while treating local concentration as far-field stress exaggerates it. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Using unloaded stress as the initial state underestimates deeper risk, while treating local concentration as far-field stress exaggerates it. Both apply incorrect boundary loading in subsequent excavation analysis.

quiz.question: 要驗證「開挖擾動與距離」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Excavation disturbance and distance"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
把測點放入已記錄施工階段的三維模型，與不同距離、不同時間測點比較；若近壁裂隙或塑性明顯，需使用相應模型說明擾動，不能用單一距離門檻宣布原位代表性。
泵浦停止後的第一個壓力尖峰就是裂縫閉合壓力。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Place measurements in a model matching recorded excavation stages and compare locations and times.
The first pressure spike after pump shutdown is the fracture closure pressure.
quiz.explanation: 把測點放入已記錄施工階段的三維模型，與不同距離、不同時間測點比較；若近壁裂隙或塑性明顯，需使用相應模型說明擾動，不能用單一距離門檻宣布原位代表性。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Place measurements in a model matching recorded excavation stages and compare locations and times; where near-wall cracking or plasticity is evident, model disturbance explicitly rather than declaring representativeness from one distance threshold. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 開挖擾動與距離：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Excavation disturbance and distance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「開挖擾動與距離」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Excavation disturbance and distance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將卸載後低應力當成原始狀態會低估深部風險，將局部集中當遠場又會過度放大；兩者皆使後續開挖分析的邊界載入不正確。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using unloaded stress as the initial state underestimates deeper risk, while treating local concentration as far-field stress exaggerates it. Both apply incorrect boundary loading in subsequent excavation analysis. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：將卸載後低應力當成原始狀態會低估深部風險，將局部集中當遠場又會過度放大；兩者皆使後續開挖分析的邊界載入不正確。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Both apply incorrect boundary loading in subsequent excavation analysis.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「洞壁附近的應力量測必定就是未擾動遠場應力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A measurement near the tunnel wall necessarily represents undisturbed far-field stress." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將卸載後低應力當成原始狀態會低估深部風險，將局部集中當遠場又會過度放大；兩者皆使後續開挖分析的邊界載入不正確。
knowledge.textEn: Using unloaded stress as the initial state underestimates deeper risk, while treating local concentration as far-field stress exaggerates it. Both apply incorrect boundary loading in subsequent excavation analysis.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「開挖擾動與距離」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Excavation disturbance and distance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
反演殘差很小就證明不存在共同感測器偏差。
將卸載後低應力當成原始狀態會低估深部風險，將局部集中當遠場又會過度放大；兩者皆使後續開挖分析的邊界載入不正確。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Small inversion residuals prove that common sensor bias is absent.
Using unloaded stress as the initial state underestimates deeper risk, while treating local concentration as far-field stress exaggerates it.
quiz.explanation: 將卸載後低應力當成原始狀態會低估深部風險，將局部集中當遠場又會過度放大；兩者皆使後續開挖分析的邊界載入不正確。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using unloaded stress as the initial state underestimates deeper risk, while treating local concentration as far-field stress exaggerates it. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「反演殘差與不確定」與「應力模型工程移交」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Inversion residuals and uncertainty" and "Engineering stress-model handover": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 反演殘差與不確定：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Inversion residuals and uncertainty: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「反演殘差與不確定」如何影響原位岩體應力量測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Inversion residuals and uncertainty” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “In-situ rock-stress measurement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 多通道反演可利用冗餘資料檢查模型，但小殘差只表示資料彼此相容，不代表假設一定正確。系統性溫度偏差會同時污染多個通道，須以獨立方法與重複測點辨識。 假設三個應變殘差3、−4、0 με，RMSE=√(25/3)=2.89 με；此值不含共同零點偏移。 只選殘差最小的模型可能選中過度擬合，測點共享校準偏差又讓重複結果看似可靠；其後把窄信賴區間當成真實地質均一性會誤導設計。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「反演殘差與不確定」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Redundant channels test internal model consistency, but small residuals do not prove correct assumptions. A systematic thermal bias can contaminate all channels together and requires independent methods and repeated locations to identify. For assumed strain residuals 3,−4 and 0 με, RMSE=√(25/3)=2.89 με; this excludes a shared zero offset. Choosing the smallest residual can favor overfitting, and shared calibration bias makes repeated measurements appear reliable. A narrow fitted interval may then be wrongly treated as evidence of uniform geological stress. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Inversion residuals and uncertainty” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「反演殘差很小就證明不存在共同感測器偏差。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Small inversion residuals prove that common sensor bias is absent." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「反演殘差與不確定」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Inversion residuals and uncertainty”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 反演殘差與不確定
knowledge.text: 多通道反演可利用冗餘資料檢查模型，但小殘差只表示資料彼此相容，不代表假設一定正確。系統性溫度偏差會同時污染多個通道，須以獨立方法與重複測點辨識。
knowledge.textEn: Redundant channels test internal model consistency, but small residuals do not prove correct assumptions. A systematic thermal bias can contaminate all channels together and requires independent methods and repeated locations to identify.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：反演殘差很小就證明不存在共同感測器偏差。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Small inversion residuals prove that common sensor bias is absent. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「反演殘差與不確定」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Inversion residuals and uncertainty" is correct?
options: 多通道反演可利用冗餘資料檢查模型，但小殘差只表示資料彼此相容，不代表假設一定正確。
反演殘差很小就證明不存在共同感測器偏差。
不同深度的應力只要取平均就可代表整個場址。
optionsEn: Redundant channels test internal model consistency, but small residuals do not prove correct assumptions.
Small inversion residuals prove that common sensor bias is absent.
Averaging stress measurements at different depths adequately represents the entire site.
quiz.explanation: 多通道反演可利用冗餘資料檢查模型，但小殘差只表示資料彼此相容，不代表假設一定正確。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Redundant channels test internal model consistency, but small residuals do not prove correct assumptions. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 反演殘差與不確定：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Inversion residuals and uncertainty: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「反演殘差與不確定」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Inversion residuals and uncertainty” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設三個應變殘差3、−4、0 με，RMSE=√(25/3)=2.89 με；此值不含共同零點偏移。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed strain residuals 3,−4 and 0 με, RMSE=√(25/3)=2.89 με; this excludes a shared zero offset. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：檢查殘差方向與溫度、深度及量規通道的相關性，以留一通道方式檢查反演穩健性；報告保留原始訊號、校準與參數協方差，對共同偏差另做敏感度分析。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Examine residual correlations with temperature, depth and channel and test leave-one-channel stability; retain raw signals, calibrations and parameter covariance, with separate sensitivity analysis for common-mode biases.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設三個應變殘差3、−4、0 με，RMSE=√(25/3)=2.89 με；此值不含共同零點偏移。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed strain residuals 3,−4 and 0 με, RMSE=√(25/3)=2.89 με; this excludes a shared zero offset.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「反演殘差與不確定」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Inversion residuals and uncertainty", which statement holds?
options: 只要主應力量值正確，坐標軸和剪應力符號就不重要。

optionsEn: Correct principal magnitudes make coordinate axes and shear signs unimportant.

steps.title: 反演殘差與不確定：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Inversion residuals and uncertainty: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「反演殘差與不確定」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Inversion residuals and uncertainty” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 檢查殘差方向與溫度、深度及量規通道的相關性，以留一通道方式檢查反演穩健性；報告保留原始訊號、校準與參數協方差，對共同偏差另做敏感度分析。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：只選殘差最小的模型可能選中過度擬合，測點共享校準偏差又讓重複結果看似可靠；其後把窄信賴區間當成真實地質均一性會誤導設計。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Examine residual correlations with temperature, depth and channel and test leave-one-channel stability; retain raw signals, calibrations and parameter covariance, with separate sensitivity analysis for common-mode biases. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Choosing the smallest residual can favor overfitting, and shared calibration bias makes repeated measurements appear reliable. A narrow fitted interval may then be wrongly treated as evidence of uniform geological stress. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Examine residual correlations with temperature, depth and channel and test leave-one-channel stability; retain raw signals, calibrations and parameter covariance, with separate sensitivity analysis for common-mode biases.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只選殘差最小的模型可能選中過度擬合，測點共享校準偏差又讓重複結果看似可靠；其後把窄信賴區間當成真實地質均一性會誤導設計。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「反演殘差與不確定」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Inversion residuals and uncertainty"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
任何單側孔壁剝落都能直接判定最大主應力方向。
檢查殘差方向與溫度、深度及量規通道的相關性，以留一通道方式檢查反演穩健性；報告保留原始訊號、校準與參數協方差，對共同偏差另做敏感度分析。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Any one-sided borehole spalling directly establishes the maximum principal-stress direction.
Examine residual correlations with temperature, depth and channel and test leave-one-channel stability.
quiz.explanation: 檢查殘差方向與溫度、深度及量規通道的相關性，以留一通道方式檢查反演穩健性；報告保留原始訊號、校準與參數協方差，對共同偏差另做敏感度分析。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Examine residual correlations with temperature, depth and channel and test leave-one-channel stability; retain raw signals, calibrations and parameter covariance, with separate sensitivity analysis for common-mode biases. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 反演殘差與不確定：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Inversion residuals and uncertainty: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「反演殘差與不確定」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Inversion residuals and uncertainty” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只選殘差最小的模型可能選中過度擬合，測點共享校準偏差又讓重複結果看似可靠；其後把窄信賴區間當成真實地質均一性會誤導設計。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Choosing the smallest residual can favor overfitting, and shared calibration bias makes repeated measurements appear reliable. A narrow fitted interval may then be wrongly treated as evidence of uniform geological stress. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只選殘差最小的模型可能選中過度擬合，測點共享校準偏差又讓重複結果看似可靠；其後把窄信賴區間當成真實地質均一性會誤導設計。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A narrow fitted interval may then be wrongly treated as evidence of uniform geological stress.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「反演殘差很小就證明不存在共同感測器偏差。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Small inversion residuals prove that common sensor bias is absent." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只選殘差最小的模型可能選中過度擬合，測點共享校準偏差又讓重複結果看似可靠；其後把窄信賴區間當成真實地質均一性會誤導設計。
knowledge.textEn: Choosing the smallest residual can favor overfitting, and shared calibration bias makes repeated measurements appear reliable. A narrow fitted interval may then be wrongly treated as evidence of uniform geological stress.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「反演殘差與不確定」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Inversion residuals and uncertainty" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只選殘差最小的模型可能選中過度擬合，測點共享校準偏差又讓重複結果看似可靠；其後把窄信賴區間當成真實地質均一性會誤導設計。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
不同深度的應力只要取平均就可代表整個場址。
optionsEn: Choosing the smallest residual can favor overfitting, and shared calibration bias makes repeated measurements appear reliable.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Averaging stress measurements at different depths adequately represents the entire site.
quiz.explanation: 只選殘差最小的模型可能選中過度擬合，測點共享校準偏差又讓重複結果看似可靠；其後把窄信賴區間當成真實地質均一性會誤導設計。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Choosing the smallest residual can favor overfitting, and shared calibration bias makes repeated measurements appear reliable. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 應力模型工程移交：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Engineering stress-model handover: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「應力模型工程移交」如何影響原位岩體應力量測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Engineering stress-model handover” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “In-situ rock-stress measurement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 場址應力模型需整合多種方法、地形與構造，保留互相矛盾的資料及解釋。模型應提供應力張量隨位置的範圍，而非只有三個代表值；施工揭露新資訊時才能合理更新邊界條件。 假設三測點最大主應力18、22、26 MPa，平均22 MPa、範圍8 MPa；小樣本不能據此宣稱全場正態分布。 把不同深度和不同方法直接平均會抹去構造分區，缺少符號或坐標定義更會使接收者誤用；即使平均數正確，整個開挖模型仍可能承受錯向載入。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「應力模型工程移交」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A site stress model integrates methods, topography and structure while retaining contradictory data and interpretations. Spatial tensor ranges, rather than only three representative numbers, allow excavation evidence to update boundary conditions rationally. Assumed maximum principal stresses 18,22 and 26 MPa have mean 22 MPa and range 8 MPa; this small sample does not establish a site-wide normal distribution. Averaging different depths and methods erases structural domains; missing signs or coordinate definitions invite misuse. Even a correct average can apply loads in the wrong direction to the excavation model. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Engineering stress-model handover” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「不同深度的應力只要取平均就可代表整個場址。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Averaging stress measurements at different depths adequately represents the entire site." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「應力模型工程移交」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Engineering stress-model handover”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 應力模型工程移交
knowledge.text: 場址應力模型需整合多種方法、地形與構造，保留互相矛盾的資料及解釋。模型應提供應力張量隨位置的範圍，而非只有三個代表值；施工揭露新資訊時才能合理更新邊界條件。
knowledge.textEn: A site stress model integrates methods, topography and structure while retaining contradictory data and interpretations. Spatial tensor ranges, rather than only three representative numbers, allow excavation evidence to update boundary conditions rationally.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：不同深度的應力只要取平均就可代表整個場址。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Averaging stress measurements at different depths adequately represents the entire site. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「應力模型工程移交」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Engineering stress-model handover" is correct?
options: 不同深度的應力只要取平均就可代表整個場址。
場址應力模型需整合多種方法、地形與構造，保留互相矛盾的資料及解釋。
隧道海拔乘岩石重度就是上覆岩體垂直應力。
optionsEn: Averaging stress measurements at different depths adequately represents the entire site.
A site stress model integrates methods, topography and structure while retaining contradictory data and interpretations.
Tunnel altitude multiplied by rock unit weight gives vertical overburden stress.
quiz.explanation: 場址應力模型需整合多種方法、地形與構造，保留互相矛盾的資料及解釋。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A site stress model integrates methods, topography and structure while retaining contradictory data and interpretations. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 應力模型工程移交：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Engineering stress-model handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「應力模型工程移交」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Engineering stress-model handover” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設三測點最大主應力18、22、26 MPa，平均22 MPa、範圍8 MPa；小樣本不能據此宣稱全場正態分布。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed maximum principal stresses 18,22 and 26 MPa have mean 22 MPa and range 8 MPa; this small sample does not establish a site-wide normal distribution. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：交付各測點坐標、方法、時間、排水狀態與張量不確定度，選取低中高情境重算主控機制；由岩工、設計與施工負責人確認哪些新觀測會觸發模型重審。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Deliver coordinates, methods, time, drainage and tensor uncertainty for each location and analyze low, central and high scenarios; rock, design and construction leads agree which new observations trigger model review.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設三測點最大主應力18、22、26 MPa，平均22 MPa、範圍8 MPa；小樣本不能據此宣稱全場正態分布。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed maximum principal stresses 18,22 and 26 MPa have mean 22 MPa and range 8 MPa; this small sample does not establish a site-wide normal distribution.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「應力模型工程移交」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Engineering stress-model handover", which statement holds?
options: 所有岩石都必須用等於一的係數扣除孔隙水壓。

steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for engineering stress-model handover. steps.failure: 注意干擾：把不同深度和不同方法直接平均會抹去構造分區，缺少符號或坐標定義更會使接收者誤用；即使平均數正確，整個開挖模型仍可能承受錯向載入。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Averaging different depths and methods erases structural domains; missing signs or coordinate definitions invite misuse. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 交付各測點坐標、方法、時間、排水狀態與張量不確定度，選取低中高情境重算主控機制；由岩工、設計與施工負責人確認哪些新觀測會觸發模型重審。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把不同深度和不同方法直接平均會抹去構造分區，缺少符號或坐標定義更會使接收者誤用；即使平均數正確，整個開挖模型仍可能承受錯向載入。
knowledge.textEn: Deliver coordinates, methods, time, drainage and tensor uncertainty for each location and analyze low, central and high scenarios; rock, design and construction leads agree which new observations trigger model review. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Averaging different depths and methods erases structural domains; missing signs or coordinate definitions invite misuse. Even a correct average can apply loads in the wrong direction to the excavation model.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄應力模型工程移交的資料來源與適用條件。交付各測點坐標、方法、時間、排水狀態與張量不確定度，選取低中高情境重算主控機制；由岩工、設計與施工負責人確認哪些新觀測會觸發模型重審。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for engineering stress-model handover. Deliver coordinates, methods, time, drainage and tensor uncertainty for each location and analyze low, central and high scenarios; rock, design and construction leads agree which new observations trigger model review.

quiz.question: 要驗證「應力模型工程移交」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Engineering stress-model handover"?
options: 交付各測點坐標、方法、時間、排水狀態與張量不確定度，選取低中高情境重算主控機制；由岩工、設計與施工負責人確認哪些新觀測會觸發模型重審。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
層理岩的不同方向模數可以任意交換而不影響反演。
optionsEn: Deliver coordinates, methods, time, drainage and tensor uncertainty for each location and analyze low, central and high scenarios.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Directional moduli in bedded rock can be interchanged without affecting inversion.
quiz.explanation: 交付各測點坐標、方法、時間、排水狀態與張量不確定度，選取低中高情境重算主控機制；由岩工、設計與施工負責人確認哪些新觀測會觸發模型重審。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Deliver coordinates, methods, time, drainage and tensor uncertainty for each location and analyze low, central and high scenarios; rock, design and construction leads agree which new observations trigger model review. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 應力模型工程移交：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Engineering stress-model handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「應力模型工程移交」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Engineering stress-model handover” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把不同深度和不同方法直接平均會抹去構造分區，缺少符號或坐標定義更會使接收者誤用；即使平均數正確，整個開挖模型仍可能承受錯向載入。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Averaging different depths and methods erases structural domains; missing signs or coordinate definitions invite misuse. Even a correct average can apply loads in the wrong direction to the excavation model. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把不同深度和不同方法直接平均會抹去構造分區，缺少符號或坐標定義更會使接收者誤用；即使平均數正確，整個開挖模型仍可能承受錯向載入。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Even a correct average can apply loads in the wrong direction to the excavation model.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「不同深度的應力只要取平均就可代表整個場址。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Averaging stress measurements at different depths adequately represents the entire site." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把不同深度和不同方法直接平均會抹去構造分區，缺少符號或坐標定義更會使接收者誤用；即使平均數正確，整個開挖模型仍可能承受錯向載入。
knowledge.textEn: Averaging different depths and methods erases structural domains; missing signs or coordinate definitions invite misuse. Even a correct average can apply loads in the wrong direction to the excavation model.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「應力模型工程移交」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Engineering stress-model handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把不同深度和不同方法直接平均會抹去構造分區，缺少符號或坐標定義更會使接收者誤用；即使平均數正確，整個開挖模型仍可能承受錯向載入。
隧道海拔乘岩石重度就是上覆岩體垂直應力。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Averaging different depths and methods erases structural domains; missing signs or coordinate definitions invite misuse.
Tunnel altitude multiplied by rock unit weight gives vertical overburden stress.
quiz.explanation: 把不同深度和不同方法直接平均會抹去構造分區，缺少符號或坐標定義更會使接收者誤用；即使平均數正確，整個開挖模型仍可能承受錯向載入。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Averaging different depths and methods erases structural domains; missing signs or coordinate definitions invite misuse. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 岩體節理剪力試驗
summary: 本課聚焦以法向條件、粗糙峰破壞與位移歷程區分節理峰值和殘餘抗剪。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。
summaryEn: This course focuses on separate peak and residual joint resistance through normal boundaries, asperity damage and displacement history. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設c=0、σn′=1 MPa、φ=35°，τ=σn′tanφ=0.700 MPa；摩擦角φ降25°時為0.466 MPa。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設σn=1.2 MPa、u=0.4 MPa，σn′=0.8 MPa；摩擦角φ=30°時抗剪應力τ=0.8tan30°=0.462 MPa。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume c=0, σn′=1 MPa and φ=35°; τ=σn′tanφ=0.700 MPa, falling to 0.466 MPa at φ=25°. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed σn=1.2 MPa and u=0.4 MPa, σn′=0.8 MPa; at φ=30°, τ=0.8tan30°=0.462 MPa. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「法向應力與摩擦」與「孔壓與有效法向力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Normal stress and friction" and "Pore pressure and effective normal force": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 法向應力與摩擦：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Normal stress and friction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「法向應力與摩擦」如何影響岩體節理剪力試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Normal stress and friction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rock-joint shear testing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 節理抗剪力由接觸面法向約束與表面特性共同產生，切向力不應單獨解讀。線性摩擦包絡是指定應力範圍的近似，外推到低應力可能虛構黏聚力，高應力又可能壓碎粗糙峰。 假設c=0、σn′=1 MPa、φ=35°，τ=σn′tanφ=0.700 MPa；摩擦角φ降25°時為0.466 MPa。 不同粗糙度試件混合擬合會產生假的黏聚截距，進而高估低約束節理強度；開挖卸荷後最需要保守判讀的區間反而被外推誤導。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「法向應力與摩擦」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Joint resistance depends on normal confinement and surface condition, not shear force alone. A linear envelope approximates a specified stress range; extrapolation can invent low-stress cohesion or miss asperity crushing under high confinement. Assume c=0, σn′=1 MPa and φ=35°; τ=σn′tanφ=0.700 MPa, falling to 0.466 MPa at φ=25°. Mixing specimens with different roughness can create a false cohesion intercept and overestimate low-confinement resistance, misleading the unloading conditions most relevant beside a newly excavated tunnel. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Normal stress and friction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩點擬合的線性摩擦包絡可以外推到任何法向應力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A linear friction envelope fitted to two points applies at any normal stress." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「法向應力與摩擦」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Normal stress and friction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 法向應力與摩擦
knowledge.text: 節理抗剪力由接觸面法向約束與表面特性共同產生，切向力不應單獨解讀。線性摩擦包絡是指定應力範圍的近似，外推到低應力可能虛構黏聚力，高應力又可能壓碎粗糙峰。
knowledge.textEn: Joint resistance depends on normal confinement and surface condition, not shear force alone. A linear envelope approximates a specified stress range; extrapolation can invent low-stress cohesion or miss asperity crushing under high confinement.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩點擬合的線性摩擦包絡可以外推到任何法向應力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A linear friction envelope fitted to two points applies at any normal stress. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「法向應力與摩擦」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Normal stress and friction" is correct?
options: 兩點擬合的線性摩擦包絡可以外推到任何法向應力。
節理抗剪力由接觸面法向約束與表面特性共同產生，切向力不應單獨解讀。
外加法向荷重除面積就是含水節理的有效法向應力。
optionsEn: A linear friction envelope fitted to two points applies at any normal stress.
Joint resistance depends on normal confinement and surface condition, not shear force alone.
Applied normal load divided by area equals effective stress on a wet joint.
quiz.explanation: 節理抗剪力由接觸面法向約束與表面特性共同產生，切向力不應單獨解讀。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Joint resistance depends on normal confinement and surface condition, not shear force alone. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 法向應力與摩擦：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Normal stress and friction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「法向應力與摩擦」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Normal stress and friction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設c=0、σn′=1 MPa、φ=35°，τ=σn′tanφ=0.700 MPa；摩擦角φ降25°時為0.466 MPa。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume c=0, σn′=1 MPa and φ=35°; τ=σn′tanφ=0.700 MPa, falling to 0.466 MPa at φ=25°. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以多個法向應力級試驗並保留完整位移曲線，分別擬合峰值與殘餘值；只有涵蓋設計應力範圍且試件狀態一致的包絡才可交付，不把兩點擬合視為普遍定律。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Test multiple normal stresses and retain complete displacement curves, fitting peak and residual envelopes separately; deliver envelopes only over represented design stresses and consistent specimen conditions rather than treating a two-point fit as universal.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設c=0、σn′=1 MPa、φ=35°，τ=σn′tanφ=0.700 MPa；摩擦角φ降25°時為0.466 MPa。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume c=0, σn′=1 MPa and φ=35°; τ=σn′tanφ=0.700 MPa, falling to 0.466 MPa at φ=25°.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「法向應力與摩擦」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Normal stress and friction", which statement holds?
options: 只用單側位移計就能完全排除試件轉動造成的假剪脹。
剪切位移增加時，應力仍應永遠除以最初重疊面積。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: One displacement gauge on one side completely excludes rocking-induced false dilation.
Shear stress should always use initial overlap area as displacement increases.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 法向應力與摩擦：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Normal stress and friction: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「法向應力與摩擦」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Normal stress and friction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以多個法向應力級試驗並保留完整位移曲線，分別擬合峰值與殘餘值；只有涵蓋設計應力範圍且試件狀態一致的包絡才可交付，不把兩點擬合視為普遍定律。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：不同粗糙度試件混合擬合會產生假的黏聚截距，進而高估低約束節理強度；開挖卸荷後最需要保守判讀的區間反而被外推誤導。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Test multiple normal stresses and retain complete displacement curves, fitting peak and residual envelopes separately; deliver envelopes only over represented design stresses and consistent specimen conditions rather than treating a two-point fit as universal. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Mixing specimens with different roughness can create a false cohesion intercept and overestimate low-confinement resistance, misleading the unloading conditions most relevant beside a newly excavated tunnel. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄法向應力與摩擦的資料來源與適用條件。以多個法向應力級試驗並保留完整位移曲線，分別擬合峰值與殘餘值；只有涵蓋設計應力範圍且試件狀態一致的包絡才可交付，不把兩點擬合視為普遍定律。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for normal stress and friction. Test multiple normal stresses and retain complete displacement curves, fitting peak and residual envelopes separately; deliver envelopes only over represented design stresses and consistent specimen conditions rather than treating a two-point fit as universal.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：不同粗糙度試件混合擬合會產生假的黏聚截距，進而高估低約束節理強度；開挖卸荷後最需要保守判讀的區間反而被外推誤導。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Mixing specimens with different roughness can create a false cohesion intercept and overestimate low-confinement resistance, misleading the unloading conditions most relevant beside a newly excavated tunnel. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「法向應力與摩擦」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Normal stress and friction"?
options: 以多個法向應力級試驗並保留完整位移曲線，分別擬合峰值與殘餘值；只有涵蓋設計應力範圍且試件狀態一致的包絡才可交付，不把兩點擬合視為普遍定律。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
一條高解析表面剖面足以代表所有方向和尺度的粗糙度。
optionsEn: Test multiple normal stresses and retain complete displacement curves, fitting peak and residual envelopes separately.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
One high-resolution profile represents roughness in every direction and at every scale.
quiz.explanation: 以多個法向應力級試驗並保留完整位移曲線，分別擬合峰值與殘餘值；只有涵蓋設計應力範圍且試件狀態一致的包絡才可交付，不把兩點擬合視為普遍定律。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Test multiple normal stresses and retain complete displacement curves, fitting peak and residual envelopes separately; deliver envelopes only over represented design stresses and consistent specimen conditions rather than treating a two-point fit as universal. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 法向應力與摩擦：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Normal stress and friction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「法向應力與摩擦」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Normal stress and friction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 不同粗糙度試件混合擬合會產生假的黏聚截距，進而高估低約束節理強度；開挖卸荷後最需要保守判讀的區間反而被外推誤導。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mixing specimens with different roughness can create a false cohesion intercept and overestimate low-confinement resistance, misleading the unloading conditions most relevant beside a newly excavated tunnel. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：不同粗糙度試件混合擬合會產生假的黏聚截距，進而高估低約束節理強度；開挖卸荷後最需要保守判讀的區間反而被外推誤導。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Mixing specimens with different roughness can create a false cohesion intercept and overestimate low-confinement resistance, misleading the unloading conditions most relevant beside a newly excavated tunnel.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩點擬合的線性摩擦包絡可以外推到任何法向應力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A linear friction envelope fitted to two points applies at any normal stress." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 不同粗糙度試件混合擬合會產生假的黏聚截距，進而高估低約束節理強度；開挖卸荷後最需要保守判讀的區間反而被外推誤導。
knowledge.textEn: Mixing specimens with different roughness can create a false cohesion intercept and overestimate low-confinement resistance, misleading the unloading conditions most relevant beside a newly excavated tunnel.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「法向應力與摩擦」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Normal stress and friction" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
不同粗糙度試件混合擬合會產生假的黏聚截距，進而高估低約束節理強度；開挖卸荷後最需要保守判讀的區間反而被外推誤導。
外加法向荷重除面積就是含水節理的有效法向應力。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.

Mixing specimens with different roughness can create a false cohesion intercept and overestimate low-confinement resistance, misleading the unloading conditions most relevant beside a newly excavated tunnel.
Applied normal load divided by area equals effective stress on a wet joint.
quiz.explanation: 不同粗糙度試件混合擬合會產生假的黏聚截距，進而高估低約束節理強度；開挖卸荷後最需要保守判讀的區間反而被外推誤導。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Mixing specimens with different roughness can create a false cohesion intercept and overestimate low-confinement resistance, misleading the unloading conditions most relevant beside a newly excavated tunnel. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 孔壓與有效法向力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pore pressure and effective normal force: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「孔壓與有效法向力」如何影響岩體節理剪力試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pore pressure and effective normal force” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rock-joint shear testing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水壓減少有效接觸約束，但充填物內的孔壓是否均勻取決於排水與載入速率。名義外加法向荷重不等於節理有效法向力，局部未排水反應也不能用遠處水位直接代替。 假設σn=1.2 MPa、u=0.4 MPa，σn′=0.8 MPa；摩擦角φ=30°時抗剪應力τ=0.8tan30°=0.462 MPa。 把總應力代入摩擦式會高估含水弱面強度，孔壓感測器延遲又可能漏掉峰值；試驗看似排水，真正剪切面卻仍可能累積超額孔壓。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「孔壓與有效法向力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Water pressure reduces effective contact confinement, but its distribution through infill depends on drainage and loading rate. Applied normal force is not effective normal force, and a distant water level cannot represent local undrained response. For assumed σn=1.2 MPa and u=0.4 MPa, σn′=0.8 MPa; at φ=30°, τ=0.8tan30°=0.462 MPa. Using total stress overestimates wet-joint strength, and delayed pressure sensing can miss peaks. An apparently drained test may still accumulate excess pressure directly at the shearing surface. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pore pressure and effective normal force” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「外加法向荷重除面積就是含水節理的有效法向應力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Applied normal load divided by area equals effective stress on a wet joint." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「孔壓與有效法向力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Pore pressure and effective normal force”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 孔壓與有效法向力
knowledge.titleEn: Pore pressure and effective normal force
knowledge.text: 水壓減少有效接觸約束，但充填物內的孔壓是否均勻取決於排水與載入速率。名義外加法向荷重不等於節理有效法向力，局部未排水反應也不能用遠處水位直接代替。
knowledge.textEn: Water pressure reduces effective contact confinement, but its distribution through infill depends on drainage and loading rate. Applied normal force is not effective normal force, and a distant water level cannot represent local undrained response.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：外加法向荷重除面積就是含水節理的有效法向應力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Applied normal load divided by area equals effective stress on a wet joint. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「孔壓與有效法向力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pore pressure and effective normal force" is correct?
options: 外加法向荷重除面積就是含水節理的有效法向應力。
定法向力與定法向剛度試驗必定得到同樣的曲線。
水壓減少有效接觸約束，但充填物內的孔壓是否均勻取決於排水與載入速率。
optionsEn: Applied normal load divided by area equals effective stress on a wet joint.
Constant-normal-load and constant-normal-stiffness tests necessarily produce the same curve.
Water pressure reduces effective contact confinement, but its distribution through infill depends on drainage and loading rate.
quiz.explanation: 水壓減少有效接觸約束，但充填物內的孔壓是否均勻取決於排水與載入速率。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Water pressure reduces effective contact confinement, but its distribution through infill depends on drainage and loading rate. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 孔壓與有效法向力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pore pressure and effective normal force: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「孔壓與有效法向力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pore pressure and effective normal force” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設σn=1.2 MPa、u=0.4 MPa，σn′=0.8 MPa；摩擦角φ=30°時抗剪應力τ=0.8tan30°=0.462 MPa。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed σn=1.2 MPa and u=0.4 MPa, σn′=0.8 MPa; at φ=30°, τ=0.8tan30°=0.462 MPa. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將孔壓、法向力及剪力以相同時鐘記錄，檢查排水管線與試體飽和狀態；比較不同速率試驗能否達到同一有效應力路徑，未量到界面孔壓時需明列推估限制。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize pore pressure, normal force and shear and check drainage and saturation; compare whether different rates achieve the same effective stress path, explicitly limiting results when interface pore pressure is inferred rather than measured.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設σn=1.2 MPa、u=0.4 MPa，σn′=0.8 MPa；摩擦角φ=30°時抗剪應力τ=0.8tan30°=0.462 MPa。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed σn=1.2 MPa and u=0.4 MPa, σn′=0.8 MPa; at φ=30°, τ=0.8tan30°=0.462 MPa.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「孔壓與有效法向力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pore pressure and effective normal force", which statement holds?
options: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
試驗曲線的最後一點必定已代表真正殘餘強度。
只要試驗速度很慢，就不必再檢查孔壓和排水。
optionsEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
The final point of any test curve necessarily represents true residual strength.
A sufficiently slow test never needs pore-pressure or drainage checks.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 孔壓與有效法向力：失效診斷

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「定力與定剛度邊界」與「剪脹與幾何攀升」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Constant-load and stiffness boundaries" and "Dilation and geometric climbing": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 定力與定剛度邊界：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Constant-load and stiffness boundaries: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「定力與定剛度邊界」如何影響岩體節理剪力試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Constant-load and stiffness boundaries” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rock-joint shear testing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 節理剪脹會推動法向邊界，定法向力設備容許位移而保持應力，定剛度邊界則使應力隨剪脹增加。實際圍岩介於不同約束情境，兩種試驗曲線不能直接混成同一材料定律。 假設法向剛度kn=2 MPa/mm、剪脹0.3 mm，Δσn=knΔvn=0.6 MPa；未計設備柔度。 把設備的高剛度效應當成節理本身高強度，會在低約束現地高估承載；控制迴路遲滯則可能製造不實峰值或錯誤剪脹曲線。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「定力與定剛度邊界」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Dilation moves the normal boundary. Constant-normal-load testing permits movement at fixed load, while constant-normal-stiffness testing increases stress as dilation develops. Actual surrounding rock imposes a specific constraint, so the curves are not interchangeable material laws. With assumed normal stiffness kn=2 MPa/mm and dilation 0.3 mm, Δσn=knΔvn=0.6 MPa, excluding machine compliance. Interpreting high machine confinement as intrinsic joint strength overestimates resistance under low field restraint. Controller lag can also create a spurious peak or misleading dilation curve. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Constant-load and stiffness boundaries” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「定法向力與定法向剛度試驗必定得到同樣的曲線。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Constant-normal-load and constant-normal-stiffness tests necessarily produce the same curve." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「定力與定剛度邊界」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Constant-load and stiffness boundaries”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 定力與定剛度邊界
knowledge.text: 節理剪脹會推動法向邊界，定法向力設備容許位移而保持應力，定剛度邊界則使應力隨剪脹增加。實際圍岩介於不同約束情境，兩種試驗曲線不能直接混成同一材料定律。
knowledge.textEn: Dilation moves the normal boundary. Constant-normal-load testing permits movement at fixed load, while constant-normal-stiffness testing increases stress as dilation develops.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：定法向力與定法向剛度試驗必定得到同樣的曲線。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Constant-normal-load and constant-normal-stiffness tests necessarily produce the same curve. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「定力與定剛度邊界」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Constant-load and stiffness boundaries" is correct?
options: 節理剪脹會推動法向邊界，定法向力設備容許位移而保持應力，定剛度邊界則使應力隨剪脹增加。

只用單側位移計就能完全排除試件轉動造成的假剪脹。
optionsEn: Dilation moves the normal boundary.
Constant-normal-load and constant-normal-stiffness tests necessarily produce the same curve.
One displacement gauge on one side completely excludes rocking-induced false dilation.
quiz.explanation: 節理剪脹會推動法向邊界，定法向力設備容許位移而保持應力，定剛度邊界則使應力隨剪脹增加。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. With assumed normal stiffness kn=2 MPa/mm and dilation 0.3 mm, Δσn=knΔvn=0.6 MPa, excluding machine compliance. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Controller lag can also create a spurious peak or misleading dilation curve.

steps.title: 剪脹與幾何攀升：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Dilation and geometric climbing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「剪脹與幾何攀升」如何影響岩體節理剪力試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Dilation and geometric climbing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rock-joint shear testing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 粗糙峰互相攀升造成剪脹，同時提高切向阻力；隨法向應力增加，峰體可能剪斷而減少幾何攀升。剪脹角是位移路徑斜率，不能當成所有位移階段固定的摩擦增量。 假設剪移2 mm產生法向增量0.2 mm，ψ=atan(0.2/2)=5.71°；此為該段平均角。 試件轉動可假裝成剪脹，若用此角度提高強度會造成雙重高估；剪後磨平卻仍沿用初始剪脹角，也會錯估大位移殘餘行為。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「剪脹與幾何攀升」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Asperities climb over one another, generating dilation and additional resistance. Greater confinement may shear them off and reduce climbing. Dilation angle is a displacement-path slope, not a constant friction increment throughout the test. Assume 2 mm shear displacement produces 0.2 mm normal movement; ψ=atan(0.2/2)=5.71°, averaged only over that interval. Specimen rotation can masquerade as dilation and falsely increase inferred resistance. Retaining initial dilation after the surface has polished also misrepresents large-displacement residual behavior. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Dilation and geometric climbing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One displacement gauge on one side completely excludes rocking-induced false dilation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

knowledge.textEn: Asperities climb over one another, generating dilation and additional resistance. Greater confinement may shear them off and reduce climbing.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只用單側位移計就能完全排除試件轉動造成的假剪脹。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「剪脹與幾何攀升」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

optionsEn: One displacement gauge on one side completely excludes rocking-induced false dilation.
Asperities climb over one another, generating dilation and additional resistance.
The final point of any test curve necessarily represents true residual strength.
