steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設剪移2 mm產生法向增量0.2 mm，ψ=atan(0.2/2)=5.71°；此為該段平均角。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume 2 mm shear displacement produces 0.2 mm normal movement; ψ=atan(0.2/2)=5.71°, averaged only over that interval. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 剪脹與幾何攀升：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Dilation and geometric climbing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「剪脹與幾何攀升」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Dilation and geometric climbing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 試件轉動可假裝成剪脹，若用此角度提高強度會造成雙重高估；剪後磨平卻仍沿用初始剪脹角，也會錯估大位移殘餘行為。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Specimen rotation can masquerade as dilation and falsely increase inferred resistance. Retaining initial dilation after the surface has polished also misrepresents large-displacement residual behavior. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：試件轉動可假裝成剪脹，若用此角度提高強度會造成雙重高估；剪後磨平卻仍沿用初始剪脹角，也會錯估大位移殘餘行為。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Retaining initial dilation after the surface has polished also misrepresents large-displacement residual behavior.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只用單側位移計就能完全排除試件轉動造成的假剪脹。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One displacement gauge on one side completely excludes rocking-induced false dilation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 試件轉動可假裝成剪脹，若用此角度提高強度會造成雙重高估；剪後磨平卻仍沿用初始剪脹角，也會錯估大位移殘餘行為。
knowledge.textEn: Specimen rotation can masquerade as dilation and falsely increase inferred resistance. Retaining initial dilation after the surface has polished also misrepresents large-displacement residual behavior.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「剪脹與幾何攀升」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Dilation and geometric climbing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
試件轉動可假裝成剪脹，若用此角度提高強度會造成雙重高估；剪後磨平卻仍沿用初始剪脹角，也會錯估大位移殘餘行為。
試驗曲線的最後一點必定已代表真正殘餘強度。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Specimen rotation can masquerade as dilation and falsely increase inferred resistance.
The final point of any test curve necessarily represents true residual strength.
quiz.explanation: 試件轉動可假裝成剪脹，若用此角度提高強度會造成雙重高估；剪後磨平卻仍沿用初始剪脹角，也會錯估大位移殘餘行為。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Specimen rotation can masquerade as dilation and falsely increase inferred resistance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「峰值與殘餘強度」與「剪切面積修正」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Peak and residual resistance" and "Shearing-area correction": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 峰值與殘餘強度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Peak and residual resistance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「峰值與殘餘強度」如何影響岩體節理剪力試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Peak and residual resistance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rock-joint shear testing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 峰值需要原有咬合或膠結尚未破壞，殘餘強度則對應較大位移後形成的滑動面。隧道附近若已有位移歷史，直接採首次峰值可能不適當，應先辨識設計機制需要哪一段。 假設峰值0.9 MPa、殘餘0.5 MPa，峰後降幅(0.9−0.5)/0.9=44.4%；不是安全係數。 試驗行程不足時末端值不一定是殘餘值，重複使用磨損面又會低估首次峰值；若未記錄試件歷史，兩種錯誤都可能混入同一資料庫。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「峰值與殘餘強度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Peak resistance depends on surviving interlock or bonding, while residual resistance follows development of a sliding surface. Previously displaced ground may not mobilize a first-cycle peak, so the required part of the curve depends on the design mechanism. Assumed peak and residual stresses of 0.9 and 0.5 MPa give a post-peak drop of 44.4%; this is not a factor of safety. Insufficient travel means the final reading may not be residual, while reusing a worn surface understates the first peak. Without specimen history both errors can enter one apparently consistent database. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Peak and residual resistance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「試驗曲線的最後一點必定已代表真正殘餘強度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The final point of any test curve necessarily represents true residual strength." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「峰值與殘餘強度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Peak and residual resistance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 峰值與殘餘強度
knowledge.text: 峰值需要原有咬合或膠結尚未破壞，殘餘強度則對應較大位移後形成的滑動面。隧道附近若已有位移歷史，直接採首次峰值可能不適當，應先辨識設計機制需要哪一段。
knowledge.textEn: Peak resistance depends on surviving interlock or bonding, while residual resistance follows development of a sliding surface. Previously displaced ground may not mobilize a first-cycle peak, so the required part of the curve depends on the design mechanism.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：試驗曲線的最後一點必定已代表真正殘餘強度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The final point of any test curve necessarily represents true residual strength. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「峰值與殘餘強度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Peak and residual resistance" is correct?
options: 試驗曲線的最後一點必定已代表真正殘餘強度。
剪切位移增加時，應力仍應永遠除以最初重疊面積。
峰值需要原有咬合或膠結尚未破壞，殘餘強度則對應較大位移後形成的滑動面。
optionsEn: The final point of any test curve necessarily represents true residual strength.
Shear stress should always use initial overlap area as displacement increases.
Peak resistance depends on surviving interlock or bonding, while residual resistance follows development of a sliding surface.
quiz.explanation: 峰值需要原有咬合或膠結尚未破壞，殘餘強度則對應較大位移後形成的滑動面。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Peak resistance depends on surviving interlock or bonding, while residual resistance follows development of a sliding surface. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 峰值與殘餘強度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Peak and residual resistance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「峰值與殘餘強度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Peak and residual resistance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設峰值0.9 MPa、殘餘0.5 MPa，峰後降幅(0.9−0.5)/0.9=44.4%；不是安全係數。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed peak and residual stresses of 0.9 and 0.5 MPa give a post-peak drop of 44.4%; this is not a factor of safety. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：保留足夠位移範圍的曲線並檢查是否真正進入穩定滑動，註記試件先前剪切與方向；設計參數表應分列峰值、軟化過程和殘餘，不以一個平均值替代。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Retain curves over enough displacement to assess stable sliding and document prior shearing and direction; parameter tables distinguish peak, softening and residual behavior rather than replacing all three with one average.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設峰值0.9 MPa、殘餘0.5 MPa，峰後降幅(0.9−0.5)/0.9=44.4%；不是安全係數。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed peak and residual stresses of 0.9 and 0.5 MPa give a post-peak drop of 44.4%; this is not a factor of safety.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「峰值與殘餘強度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Peak and residual resistance", which statement holds?
options: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
一條高解析表面剖面足以代表所有方向和尺度的粗糙度。
剪切曲線下面積全部是目標節理轉成熱的摩擦能。
optionsEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
One high-resolution profile represents roughness in every direction and at every scale.
All area under the shear curve is frictional heat generated at the intended joint.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 峰值與殘餘強度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Peak and residual resistance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「峰值與殘餘強度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Peak and residual resistance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 保留足夠位移範圍的曲線並檢查是否真正進入穩定滑動，註記試件先前剪切與方向；設計參數表應分列峰值、軟化過程和殘餘，不以一個平均值替代。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：試驗行程不足時末端值不一定是殘餘值，重複使用磨損面又會低估首次峰值；若未記錄試件歷史，兩種錯誤都可能混入同一資料庫。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Retain curves over enough displacement to assess stable sliding and document prior shearing and direction; parameter tables distinguish peak, softening and residual behavior rather than replacing all three with one average. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Insufficient travel means the final reading may not be residual, while reusing a worn surface understates the first peak. Without specimen history both errors can enter one apparently consistent database. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄峰值與殘餘強度的資料來源與適用條件。保留足夠位移範圍的曲線並檢查是否真正進入穩定滑動，註記試件先前剪切與方向；設計參數表應分列峰值、軟化過程和殘餘，不以一個平均值替代。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for peak and residual resistance. Retain curves over enough displacement to assess stable sliding and document prior shearing and direction; parameter tables distinguish peak, softening and residual behavior rather than replacing all three with one average.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：試驗行程不足時末端值不一定是殘餘值，重複使用磨損面又會低估首次峰值；若未記錄試件歷史，兩種錯誤都可能混入同一資料庫。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Insufficient travel means the final reading may not be residual, while reusing a worn surface understates the first peak. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 保留足夠位移範圍的曲線並檢查是否真正進入穩定滑動，註記試件先前剪切與方向；設計參數表應分列峰值、軟化過程和殘餘，不以一個平均值替代。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：試驗行程不足時末端值不一定是殘餘值，重複使用磨損面又會低估首次峰值；若未記錄試件歷史，兩種錯誤都可能混入同一資料庫。
knowledge.textEn: Retain curves over enough displacement to assess stable sliding and document prior shearing and direction; parameter tables distinguish peak, softening and residual behavior rather than replacing all three with one average. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Insufficient travel means the final reading may not be residual, while reusing a worn surface understates the first peak. Without specimen history both errors can enter one apparently consistent database.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄峰值與殘餘強度的資料來源與適用條件。保留足夠位移範圍的曲線並檢查是否真正進入穩定滑動，註記試件先前剪切與方向；設計參數表應分列峰值、軟化過程和殘餘，不以一個平均值替代。

Retain curves over enough displacement to assess stable sliding and document prior shearing and direction; parameter tables distinguish peak, softening and residual behavior rather than replacing all three with one average.

quiz.question: 要驗證「峰值與殘餘強度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Peak and residual resistance"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
保留足夠位移範圍的曲線並檢查是否真正進入穩定滑動，註記試件先前剪切與方向；設計參數表應分列峰值、軟化過程和殘餘，不以一個平均值替代。
外加法向荷重除面積就是含水節理的有效法向應力。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Retain curves over enough displacement to assess stable sliding and document prior shearing and direction.

steps.title: 峰值與殘餘強度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Peak and residual resistance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「峰值與殘餘強度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 試驗行程不足時末端值不一定是殘餘值，重複使用磨損面又會低估首次峰值；若未記錄試件歷史，兩種錯誤都可能混入同一資料庫。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

Without specimen history both errors can enter one apparently consistent database. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.instruction: 剪切位移增加會減少上下試件的重疊面積，若仍以初始面積換算應力，就把幾何變化混入材料軟化。對不規則天然節理還需考慮實際接觸區，名義重疊不等於真實接觸。 假設矩形100×100 mm試件剪移10 mm，重疊9000 mm²；剪力9 kN對應1.0 MPa，初始面積算法為0.9 MPa。 忽略面積縮小會把實際穩定阻力誤判為軟化，重複做面積修正又會高估強度；兩者在大位移段尤為嚴重並影響殘餘值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「剪切面積修正」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Irregular natural joints also have evolving contact patches; nominal overlap is not the true contact area resisting shear. Ignoring reduced area can make stable resistance appear to soften, while applying correction twice overestimates strength. steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed 100×100 mm specimen displaced 10 mm has 9000 mm² overlap; 9 kN gives 1.0 MPa instead of 0.9 MPa using initial area. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Recalculate nominal area at each measured displacement and retain corrected and uncorrected curves; if natural contact area is unknown, state the nominal definition rather than arbitrarily amplifying stress through a guessed contact fraction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「速率與排水時間」與「粗糙度與尺度差」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: 速率與排水時間：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rate and drainage time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rock-joint shear testing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 細粒充填的排水時間取決於排水距離和固結係數，剪切太快會改變孔壓而非只改變摩擦。岩石接觸面也可能有速率效應，所以速度比較必須維持相同水文與正向約束。 假設特徵排水距離5 mm、cv=10⁻⁸ m²/s，t=L²/cv=2500 s約41.7 min；此為尺度估算。 將未排水弱化歸因於表面磨耗會選錯殘餘參數，反之緩慢試驗的高阻力也不能代表快速卸荷；缺少孔壓資料時兩種機制很難分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「速率與排水時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Fine infill drainage depends on path length and consolidation coefficient; rapid shearing changes pore pressure as well as friction. Rock contacts may themselves be rate sensitive, so rate comparisons need matched hydraulic and normal boundaries. For assumed drainage length 5 mm and cv=10⁻⁸ m²/s, t=L²/cv=2500 s, about 41.7 min; this is a scaling estimate. Attributing undrained weakening to surface wear selects the wrong residual parameter, while slow-test resistance does not represent rapid unloading. Without pore-pressure records the mechanisms are difficult to distinguish. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rate and drainage time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 速率與排水時間：定量估算

steps.title: 速率與排水時間：試驗與驗證

steps.title: 粗糙度與尺度差：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設同高程差2 mm在10與100 mm基長上，平均坡度分別0.2與0.02；尺度改變使表觀坡度差10倍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed 2 mm height change over 10 and 100 mm baselines gives slopes 0.2 and 0.02, a tenfold apparent difference caused by scale. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.instruction: 沿預期剪切方向量測多條表面剖面，另以三維掃描查空間差異；報告點距、濾波與試件尺寸，使用經驗粗糙度模型時需明列其適用尺度和法向應力範圍。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：低解析掃描會抹去細峰，高解析噪訊又可能誇大粗糙度；若把不同濾波的指標混合比較，得到的強度差可能只是資料處理差異。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 量測誤差與強度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Measurement error and strength: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「量測誤差與強度」如何影響岩體節理剪力試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Measurement error and strength” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rock-joint shear testing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 力與面積的不確定性共同控制換算應力，摩擦角又透過非線性反正切求得。只報設備力計精度會漏掉天然表面尺寸、傾斜與法向控制誤差，須以完整誤差鏈說明結果。 假設力標準不確定2%、面積3%，獨立小誤差下應力相對不確定√(0.02²+0.03²)=3.61%。 只看小數位數會把統計不顯著差異解釋成地質分區，忽略相關誤差又使平方和估計過小；設計採值因此可能對不存在的差異過度反應。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「量測誤差與強度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Force and area uncertainty jointly control stress, while friction angle follows a nonlinear inverse tangent. Load-cell accuracy alone omits natural-surface dimensions, rocking and normal-control error, requiring the complete measurement chain. Assume independent small standard uncertainties of 2% in force and 3% in area; relative stress uncertainty is √(0.02²+0.03²)=3.61%. Decimal precision can make insignificant differences look like geological domains, while ignored correlation understates propagated uncertainty. Design may then respond strongly to distinctions unsupported by the measurements. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Measurement error and strength” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume independent small standard uncertainties of 2% in force and 3% in area; relative stress uncertainty is √(0.02²+0.03²)=3.61%. steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Estimate uncertainty from calibration and repeated dimensions, checking shared error sources in area and displacement; bracket strength parameters and claim material differences only when they exceed measurement uncertainty and specimen variability.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

steps.instruction: 用校準紀錄與重複尺寸量測估計不確定度，檢查面積和位移是否共享同一誤差來源；對關鍵強度參數做上下限分析，只有差異大於量測與試件散布時才主張材料確有變化。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：只看小數位數會把統計不顯著差異解釋成地質分區，忽略相關誤差又使平方和估計過小；設計採值因此可能對不存在的差異過度反應。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.instruction: 剪切曲線下的面積表示單位面積做功，包含摩擦、粗糙峰破壞和設備儲能，並非全轉成可量測的熱。試後表面和碎屑讓能量解釋有物理依據，也揭露試體是否走錯破壞面。 假設平均剪應力0.6 MPa、滑移5 mm，W/A=τδ=3000 J/m²；未分離可回復儲能。 試件在膠結座或完整岩內破壞時，做功不能歸因於目標節理；若只留下最大剪力而丟失曲線與試後照片，後人無法辨認這種失真。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「剪切功與試後證據」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

剪切曲線下的面積表示單位面積做功，包含摩擦、粗糙峰破壞和設備儲能，並非全轉成可量測的熱。
兩點擬合的線性摩擦包絡可以外推到任何法向應力。
optionsEn: All area under the shear curve is frictional heat generated at the intended joint.
Area under the shear stress-displacement curve represents work per unit area, shared among friction, asperity damage and machine energy rather than entirely measured heat.
A linear friction envelope fitted to two points applies at any normal stress.
quiz.explanation: 剪切曲線下的面積表示單位面積做功，包含摩擦、粗糙峰破壞和設備儲能，並非全轉成可量測的熱。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Area under the shear stress-displacement curve represents work per unit area, shared among friction, asperity damage and machine energy rather than entirely measured heat. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 剪切功與試後證據：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Shear work and post-test evidence: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「剪切功與試後證據」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Shear work and post-test evidence” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設平均剪應力0.6 MPa、滑移5 mm，W/A=τδ=3000 J/m²；未分離可回復儲能。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. With assumed mean shear stress 0.6 MPa and slip 5 mm, W/A=τδ=3000 J/m², without separating recoverable stored energy. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：數值積分原始曲線並核對位移零點，試後拍攝上下表面與碎屑位置；交接時把能量、峰殘值和破壞路徑一起提供，由試驗及設計負責人確認是否代表目標節理。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Integrate the original curve with a checked displacement zero and photograph both surfaces and debris; hand over work, peak-residual values and failure path together for laboratory and design leads to judge representativeness.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設平均剪應力0.6 MPa、滑移5 mm，W/A=τδ=3000 J/m²；未分離可回復儲能。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. With assumed mean shear stress 0.6 MPa and slip 5 mm, W/A=τδ=3000 J/m², without separating recoverable stored energy.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「剪切功與試後證據」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Shear work and post-test evidence", which statement holds?
options: 定法向力與定法向剛度試驗必定得到同樣的曲線。
試驗曲線的最後一點必定已代表真正殘餘強度。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: Constant-normal-load and constant-normal-stiffness tests necessarily produce the same curve.
The final point of any test curve necessarily represents true residual strength.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 剪切功與試後證據：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Shear work and post-test evidence: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「剪切功與試後證據」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Shear work and post-test evidence” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 數值積分原始曲線並核對位移零點，試後拍攝上下表面與碎屑位置；交接時把能量、峰殘值和破壞路徑一起提供，由試驗及設計負責人確認是否代表目標節理。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：試件在膠結座或完整岩內破壞時，做功不能歸因於目標節理；若只留下最大剪力而丟失曲線與試後照片，後人無法辨認這種失真。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Integrate the original curve with a checked displacement zero and photograph both surfaces and debris; hand over work, peak-residual values and failure path together for laboratory and design leads to judge representativeness. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Failure through the mounting material or intact rock invalidates attribution of work to the intended joint. Retaining only peak force and discarding curves and photographs prevents later detection of that error. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄剪切功與試後證據的資料來源與適用條件。數值積分原始曲線並核對位移零點，試後拍攝上下表面與碎屑位置；交接時把能量、峰殘值和破壞路徑一起提供，由試驗及設計負責人確認是否代表目標節理。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for shear work and post-test evidence. Integrate the original curve with a checked displacement zero and photograph both surfaces and debris; hand over work, peak-residual values and failure path together for laboratory and design leads to judge representativeness.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：試件在膠結座或完整岩內破壞時，做功不能歸因於目標節理；若只留下最大剪力而丟失曲線與試後照片，後人無法辨認這種失真。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Failure through the mounting material or intact rock invalidates attribution of work to the intended joint. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 數值積分原始曲線並核對位移零點，試後拍攝上下表面與碎屑位置；交接時把能量、峰殘值和破壞路徑一起提供，由試驗及設計負責人確認是否代表目標節理。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：試件在膠結座或完整岩內破壞時，做功不能歸因於目標節理；若只留下最大剪力而丟失曲線與試後照片，後人無法辨認這種失真。
knowledge.textEn: Integrate the original curve with a checked displacement zero and photograph both surfaces and debris; hand over work, peak-residual values and failure path together for laboratory and design leads to judge representativeness. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Failure through the mounting material or intact rock invalidates attribution of work to the intended joint. Retaining only peak force and discarding curves and photographs prevents later detection of that error.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄剪切功與試後證據的資料來源與適用條件。數值積分原始曲線並核對位移零點，試後拍攝上下表面與碎屑位置；交接時把能量、峰殘值和破壞路徑一起提供，由試驗及設計負責人確認是否代表目標節理。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for shear work and post-test evidence. Integrate the original curve with a checked displacement zero and photograph both surfaces and debris; hand over work, peak-residual values and failure path together for laboratory and design leads to judge representativeness.

quiz.question: 要驗證「剪切功與試後證據」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Shear work and post-test evidence"?
options: 數值積分原始曲線並核對位移零點，試後拍攝上下表面與碎屑位置；交接時把能量、峰殘值和破壞路徑一起提供，由試驗及設計負責人確認是否代表目標節理。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
只要試驗速度很慢，就不必再檢查孔壓和排水。
optionsEn: Integrate the original curve with a checked displacement zero and photograph both surfaces and debris.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A sufficiently slow test never needs pore-pressure or drainage checks.
quiz.explanation: 數值積分原始曲線並核對位移零點，試後拍攝上下表面與碎屑位置；交接時把能量、峰殘值和破壞路徑一起提供，由試驗及設計負責人確認是否代表目標節理。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Integrate the original curve with a checked displacement zero and photograph both surfaces and debris; hand over work, peak-residual values and failure path together for laboratory and design leads to judge representativeness. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 剪切功與試後證據：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Shear work and post-test evidence: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「剪切功與試後證據」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Shear work and post-test evidence” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 試件在膠結座或完整岩內破壞時，做功不能歸因於目標節理；若只留下最大剪力而丟失曲線與試後照片，後人無法辨認這種失真。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Failure through the mounting material or intact rock invalidates attribution of work to the intended joint. Retaining only peak force and discarding curves and photographs prevents later detection of that error. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：試件在膠結座或完整岩內破壞時，做功不能歸因於目標節理；若只留下最大剪力而丟失曲線與試後照片，後人無法辨認這種失真。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Retaining only peak force and discarding curves and photographs prevents later detection of that error.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「剪切曲線下面積全部是目標節理轉成熱的摩擦能。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All area under the shear curve is frictional heat generated at the intended joint." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 試件在膠結座或完整岩內破壞時，做功不能歸因於目標節理；若只留下最大剪力而丟失曲線與試後照片，後人無法辨認這種失真。
knowledge.textEn: Failure through the mounting material or intact rock invalidates attribution of work to the intended joint. Retaining only peak force and discarding curves and photographs prevents later detection of that error.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「剪切功與試後證據」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Shear work and post-test evidence" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
試件在膠結座或完整岩內破壞時，做功不能歸因於目標節理；若只留下最大剪力而丟失曲線與試後照片，後人無法辨認這種失真。
兩點擬合的線性摩擦包絡可以外推到任何法向應力。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Failure through the mounting material or intact rock invalidates attribution of work to the intended joint.
A linear friction envelope fitted to two points applies at any normal stress.
quiz.explanation: 試件在膠結座或完整岩內破壞時，做功不能歸因於目標節理；若只留下最大剪力而丟失曲線與試後照片，後人無法辨認這種失真。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Failure through the mounting material or intact rock invalidates attribution of work to the intended joint. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 隧道地表沉陷監測
summary: 本課聚焦以基準穩定、沉陷槽形與時間關聯區分開挖及地下水影響。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。
summaryEn: This course focuses on separate excavation and groundwater effects using stable benchmarks, trough geometry and time correlation. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設Smax=10 mm、i=5 m，x=5 m處S=10e⁻⁰·⁵=6.07 mm；假設沉陷向下為正。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設Smax=0.01 m、i=5 m，Vs=√(2π)iSmax=0.1253 m²；直徑6 m面積28.274 m²，VL=0.443%。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume Smax=10 mm and i=5 m; at x=5 m, S=10e⁻⁰·⁵=6.07 mm, taking downward settlement as positive. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume Smax=0.01 m and i=5 m; Vs=√(2π)iSmax=0.1253 m². A 6 m diameter gives area 28.274 m² and VL=0.443%. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「沉陷槽形與參數」與「體積損失換算」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Settlement-trough geometry" and "Volume-loss conversion": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 沉陷槽形與參數：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Settlement-trough geometry: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「沉陷槽形與參數」如何影響隧道地表沉陷監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Settlement-trough geometry” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Surface-settlement monitoring for tunneling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 高斯沉陷槽用最大沉陷和寬度概括橫向地表變形，適合初步描述卻未必適合淺覆土、分層或強烈建物約束。斷面不足時兩參數互相補償，應以完整測點而非只看中線峰值。 假設Smax=10 mm、i=5 m，x=5 m處S=10e⁻⁰·⁵=6.07 mm；假設沉陷向下為正。 用單點峰值推算整個沉陷槽會漏掉偏斜與多峰，擬合曲線可能穿過資料卻錯估影響範圍；鄰近建物的差異沉陷便被低估。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「沉陷槽形與參數」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A Gaussian trough summarizes transverse movement with peak settlement and width, but shallow cover, layering and structural restraint can violate it. Sparse observations allow parameters to compensate for each other, requiring a full profile rather than only the centerline. Assume Smax=10 mm and i=5 m; at x=5 m, S=10e⁻⁰·⁵=6.07 mm, taking downward settlement as positive. Inferring the entire trough from one peak misses skew and multiple lobes. A fitted curve can pass through the available data yet misrepresent the influence zone and underestimate differential building movement. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Settlement-trough geometry” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.title: 沉陷槽形與參數
knowledge.text: 高斯沉陷槽用最大沉陷和寬度概括橫向地表變形，適合初步描述卻未必適合淺覆土、分層或強烈建物約束。斷面不足時兩參數互相補償，應以完整測點而非只看中線峰值。
knowledge.textEn: A Gaussian trough summarizes transverse movement with peak settlement and width, but shallow cover, layering and structural restraint can violate it. Sparse observations allow parameters to compensate for each other, requiring a full profile rather than only the centerline.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：量到沉陷槽中央最大值就能唯一決定槽的寬度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The maximum centerline settlement uniquely determines the trough width. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「沉陷槽形與參數」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 量到沉陷槽中央最大值就能唯一決定槽的寬度。
高斯沉陷槽用最大沉陷和寬度概括橫向地表變形，適合初步描述卻未必適合淺覆土、分層或強烈建物約束。
地表體積損失百分比就是直接量得的超挖土量百分比。
optionsEn: The maximum centerline settlement uniquely determines the trough width.

quiz.explanationEn: A Gaussian trough summarizes transverse movement with peak settlement and width, but shallow cover, layering and structural restraint can violate it. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 沉陷槽形與參數：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Settlement-trough geometry: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「沉陷槽形與參數」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Settlement-trough geometry” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設Smax=10 mm、i=5 m，x=5 m處S=10e⁻⁰·⁵=6.07 mm；假設沉陷向下為正。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume Smax=10 mm and i=5 m; at x=5 m, S=10e⁻⁰·⁵=6.07 mm, taking downward settlement as positive. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同一時間窗的橫斷面測點擬合並檢查殘差是否偏向一側，與地層及建物分布對照；量測涵蓋槽外穩定點，未覆蓋兩翼的斷面不得宣稱已可靠辨識槽寬。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Fit points from one time window and inspect asymmetric residuals against geology and buildings; include stable points outside the trough and do not claim reliable width identification when both flanks are unobserved.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Settlement-trough geometry” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以同一時間窗的橫斷面測點擬合並檢查殘差是否偏向一側，與地層及建物分布對照；量測涵蓋槽外穩定點，未覆蓋兩翼的斷面不得宣稱已可靠辨識槽寬。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：用單點峰值推算整個沉陷槽會漏掉偏斜與多峰，擬合曲線可能穿過資料卻錯估影響範圍；鄰近建物的差異沉陷便被低估。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Fit points from one time window and inspect asymmetric residuals against geology and buildings; include stable points outside the trough and do not claim reliable width identification when both flanks are unobserved. steps.failure: 注意干擾：用單點峰值推算整個沉陷槽會漏掉偏斜與多峰，擬合曲線可能穿過資料卻錯估影響範圍；鄰近建物的差異沉陷便被低估。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

quiz.question: 要驗證「沉陷槽形與參數」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 沉陷槽形與參數：失效診斷

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Settlement-trough geometry” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 用單點峰值推算整個沉陷槽會漏掉偏斜與多峰，擬合曲線可能穿過資料卻錯估影響範圍；鄰近建物的差異沉陷便被低估。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Inferring the entire trough from one peak misses skew and multiple lobes. knowledge.text: 用單點峰值推算整個沉陷槽會漏掉偏斜與多峰，擬合曲線可能穿過資料卻錯估影響範圍；鄰近建物的差異沉陷便被低估。

quiz.question: 在「沉陷槽形與參數」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

用單點峰值推算整個沉陷槽會漏掉偏斜與多峰，擬合曲線可能穿過資料卻錯估影響範圍；鄰近建物的差異沉陷便被低估。

steps.title: 體積損失換算：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Volume-loss conversion: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「體積損失換算」如何影響隧道地表沉陷監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Volume-loss conversion” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Surface-settlement monitoring for tunneling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 地表沉陷面積代表每單位隧道長度的地表體積變化，與開挖面積比得到表觀體積損失。排水固結、隆起與橫向位移會改變對應關係，不能把它視為直接秤出的超挖土量。 假設Smax=0.01 m、i=5 m，Vs=√(2π)iSmax=0.1253 m²；直徑6 m面積28.274 m²，VL=0.443%。 把毫米當公尺會使體積損失放大千倍，漏掉槽翼又會系統性低估；不同時間的峰值和寬度混用，則會算出未曾存在的沉陷體積。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「體積損失換算」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Surface settlement area gives volume change per unit tunnel length, and its ratio to excavation area is apparent volume loss. Consolidation, heave and lateral movement alter the correspondence, so it is not directly weighed overexcavated soil. Assume Smax=0.01 m and i=5 m; Vs=√(2π)iSmax=0.1253 m². A 6 m diameter gives area 28.274 m² and VL=0.443%. Confusing millimetres with metres inflates volume loss a thousandfold; omitted flanks underestimate it. Combining peak and width from different epochs creates a settlement volume that never actually occurred. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Volume-loss conversion” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「地表體積損失百分比就是直接量得的超挖土量百分比。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Surface volume-loss percentage is a directly measured overexcavation percentage." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「體積損失換算」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Volume-loss conversion”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Surface settlement area gives volume change per unit tunnel length, and its ratio to excavation area is apparent volume loss. Consolidation, heave and lateral movement alter the correspondence, so it is not directly weighed overexcavated soil.

knowledge.text: 誤解：地表體積損失百分比就是直接量得的超挖土量百分比。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「體積損失換算」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 體積損失換算：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「體積損失換算」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設Smax=0.01 m、i=5 m，Vs=√(2π)iSmax=0.1253 m²；直徑6 m面積28.274 m²，VL=0.443%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume Smax=0.01 m and i=5 m; Vs=√(2π)iSmax=0.1253 m². A 6 m diameter gives area 28.274 m² and VL=0.443%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以量測斷面數值積分和高斯積分互相核對，統一沉陷單位與開挖直徑；比較施工後不同時段的面積變化，若有地下水降低，將延時固結與即時開挖損失分別討論。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

steps.instructionEn: Cross-check numerical profile integration against the Gaussian integral with consistent units and excavation diameter; compare later epochs and distinguish delayed consolidation from immediate excavation loss where groundwater has fallen. Combining peak and width from different epochs creates a settlement volume that never actually occurred. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.failure: 注意干擾：把毫米當公尺會使體積損失放大千倍，漏掉槽翼又會系統性低估；不同時間的峰值和寬度混用，則會算出未曾存在的沉陷體積。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.title: 穩定基準與閉合：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Stable benchmarks and closure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「穩定基準與閉合」如何影響隧道地表沉陷監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stable benchmarks and closure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Surface-settlement monitoring for tunneling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 沉陷是相對基準的高程變化，基準點自己移動時整個監測網會出現共同假訊號。基準需位於影響區外且有冗餘連接，水準路線閉合只能檢查內部一致，不能證明全網絕對穩定。 假設觀測點讀得下沉8 mm，基準本身下沉3 mm，真實相對外部穩定基準沉陷為11 mm。 全網基準同時沉陷可能讓所有監測點看似不動，閉合差仍然很小；若只相信內部閉合，累積沉陷會被悄悄從風險圖中扣掉。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「穩定基準與閉合」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Settlement is elevation change relative to a benchmark. A moving reference creates a common false signal. Redundant external references are required; leveling closure tests internal consistency but does not prove absolute network stability. If an assumed point appears to settle 8 mm relative to a benchmark that itself settles 3 mm, settlement relative to a stable external datum is 11 mm. Common settlement of the references can make monitored points appear stationary while closure remains small. Trusting internal closure alone silently removes accumulated movement from the risk assessment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Stable benchmarks and closure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「水準網閉合差很小，就證明所有基準點絕對穩定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A small leveling closure proves absolute stability of every benchmark." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「穩定基準與閉合」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A small leveling closure proves absolute stability of every benchmark. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「穩定基準與閉合」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Stable benchmarks and closure" is correct?

steps.title: 差異沉陷與傾斜：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Differential movement and tilt: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「差異沉陷與傾斜」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Differential movement and tilt” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將建物角點水準、傾度與裂縫計同步比較，扣除可識別剛體分量後再檢查曲率；容許值由結構型式、既有缺陷及業主要求決定，不能把教學比值當自動停工標準。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：只看最大沉陷可能忽略短距離高梯度，反之大範圍均勻沉陷也可能被誤判為嚴重彎曲；錯誤分類會讓保護措施沒有針對真正受力路徑。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize corner levels, tilt and crack gauges and examine curvature after identifiable rigid-body movement; criteria depend on structure, existing defects and owner requirements, not the teaching ratio as an automatic stop-work limit. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Maximum settlement alone misses steep local gradients, while broad uniform movement may be mistaken for severe bending. Misclassification directs protective measures away from the actual structural load path. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄差異沉陷與傾斜的資料來源與適用條件。將建物角點水準、傾度與裂縫計同步比較，扣除可識別剛體分量後再檢查曲率；容許值由結構型式、既有缺陷及業主要求決定，不能把教學比值當自動停工標準。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for differential movement and tilt. Synchronize corner levels, tilt and crack gauges and examine curvature after identifiable rigid-body movement; criteria depend on structure, existing defects and owner requirements, not the teaching ratio as an automatic stop-work limit.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只看最大沉陷可能忽略短距離高梯度，反之大範圍均勻沉陷也可能被誤判為嚴重彎曲；錯誤分類會讓保護措施沒有針對真正受力路徑。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Maximum settlement alone misses steep local gradients, while broad uniform movement may be mistaken for severe bending. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Differential movement and tilt"?
options: 將建物角點水準、傾度與裂縫計同步比較，扣除可識別剛體分量後再檢查曲率；容許值由結構型式、既有缺陷及業主要求決定，不能把教學比值當自動停工標準。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
量到沉陷槽中央最大值就能唯一決定槽的寬度。
optionsEn: Synchronize corner levels, tilt and crack gauges and examine curvature after identifiable rigid-body movement.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
The maximum centerline settlement uniquely determines the trough width.

quiz.explanationEn: Synchronize corner levels, tilt and crack gauges and examine curvature after identifiable rigid-body movement; criteria depend on structure, existing defects and owner requirements, not the teaching ratio as an automatic stop-work limit. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 差異沉陷與傾斜：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Differential movement and tilt: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「差異沉陷與傾斜」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Differential movement and tilt” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只看最大沉陷可能忽略短距離高梯度，反之大範圍均勻沉陷也可能被誤判為嚴重彎曲；錯誤分類會讓保護措施沒有針對真正受力路徑。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Maximum settlement alone misses steep local gradients, while broad uniform movement may be mistaken for severe bending. Misclassification directs protective measures away from the actual structural load path. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只看最大沉陷可能忽略短距離高梯度，反之大範圍均勻沉陷也可能被誤判為嚴重彎曲；錯誤分類會讓保護措施沒有針對真正受力路徑。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Misclassification directs protective measures away from the actual structural load path.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「建物總沉陷最大時，一定也承受最大的彎曲損傷。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The building with the largest total settlement necessarily suffers the most bending damage." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只看最大沉陷可能忽略短距離高梯度，反之大範圍均勻沉陷也可能被誤判為嚴重彎曲；錯誤分類會讓保護措施沒有針對真正受力路徑。
knowledge.textEn: Maximum settlement alone misses steep local gradients, while broad uniform movement may be mistaken for severe bending. Misclassification directs protective measures away from the actual structural load path.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「差異沉陷與傾斜」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Differential movement and tilt" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只看最大沉陷可能忽略短距離高梯度，反之大範圍均勻沉陷也可能被誤判為嚴重彎曲；錯誤分類會讓保護措施沒有針對真正受力路徑。
任何時間窗算出的平均沉陷速率都有相同工程意義。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Maximum settlement alone misses steep local gradients, while broad uniform movement may be mistaken for severe bending.
Average settlement rates from any time window have the same engineering meaning.
quiz.explanation: 只看最大沉陷可能忽略短距離高梯度，反之大範圍均勻沉陷也可能被誤判為嚴重彎曲；錯誤分類會讓保護措施沒有針對真正受力路徑。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Maximum settlement alone misses steep local gradients, while broad uniform movement may be mistaken for severe bending. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「速率與時間窗」與「精度與差值不確定」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rates and time windows" and "Precision of displacement differences": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 速率與時間窗：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rates and time windows: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「速率與時間窗」如何影響隧道地表沉陷監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rates and time windows” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Surface-settlement monitoring for tunneling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 沉陷速率是差分量，時間窗越短越容易放大量測雜訊，越長則可能抹去施工事件。必須把測讀頻率與可能變形速度相配，並將實際時間間隔保留，不能假設所有測次等間距。 假設24 h沉陷增加2 mm，平均速率0.0833 mm/h；若同變化集中在2 h則局部平均1 mm/h。 時間戳錯誤或漏測可產生假加速度，過長平均又會讓急遽變形延後被發現；將速率與累積量分開審查才能辨識兩種相反風險。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「速率與時間窗」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Settlement rate is a difference quotient: short windows amplify noise while long windows obscure events. Sampling must match possible movement speed, retaining actual timestamps rather than assuming equally spaced readings. An assumed 2 mm increase over 24 h averages 0.0833 mm/h; if concentrated within 2 h, the local average is 1 mm/h. Incorrect timestamps or missed observations create false acceleration, while excessive averaging delays recognition of rapid movement. Reviewing rate and accumulated displacement together is necessary to identify these opposite risks. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rates and time windows” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「任何時間窗算出的平均沉陷速率都有相同工程意義。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Average settlement rates from any time window have the same engineering meaning." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「速率與時間窗」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Rates and time windows”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 速率與時間窗
knowledge.text: 沉陷速率是差分量，時間窗越短越容易放大量測雜訊，越長則可能抹去施工事件。必須把測讀頻率與可能變形速度相配，並將實際時間間隔保留，不能假設所有測次等間距。
knowledge.textEn: Settlement rate is a difference quotient: short windows amplify noise while long windows obscure events. Sampling must match possible movement speed, retaining actual timestamps rather than assuming equally spaced readings.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：任何時間窗算出的平均沉陷速率都有相同工程意義。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Average settlement rates from any time window have the same engineering meaning. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「速率與時間窗」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rates and time windows" is correct?
options: 任何時間窗算出的平均沉陷速率都有相同工程意義。
儀器顯示到十分之一毫米就具有同等實際準確度。
沉陷速率是差分量，時間窗越短越容易放大量測雜訊，越長則可能抹去施工事件。
optionsEn: Average settlement rates from any time window have the same engineering meaning.
An instrument displaying tenths of a millimetre has the same actual accuracy.
Settlement rate is a difference quotient: short windows amplify noise while long windows obscure events.
quiz.explanation: 沉陷速率是差分量，時間窗越短越容易放大量測雜訊，越長則可能抹去施工事件。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Settlement rate is a difference quotient: short windows amplify noise while long windows obscure events. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 速率與時間窗：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rates and time windows: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「速率與時間窗」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rates and time windows” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設24 h沉陷增加2 mm，平均速率0.0833 mm/h；若同變化集中在2 h則局部平均1 mm/h。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed 2 mm increase over 24 h averages 0.0833 mm/h; if concentrated within 2 h, the local average is 1 mm/h. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：並列原始位移、不同窗長速率與施工事件時間，確認尖峰是否超過儀器噪音；不得平滑後刪除異常，監測負責人應先核對測點狀況，再依核准應變計畫處理持續加速。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Display raw movement, rates from several windows and construction timestamps, checking peaks against noise; do not erase anomalies through smoothing, and verify point condition before applying the approved response plan to sustained acceleration.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設24 h沉陷增加2 mm，平均速率0.0833 mm/h；若同變化集中在2 h則局部平均1 mm/h。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed 2 mm increase over 24 h averages 0.0833 mm/h; if concentrated within 2 h, the local average is 1 mm/h.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「速率與時間窗」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Rates and time windows", which statement holds?
options: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
每個監測點的變形只能由距離最近的掌子面造成。
掌子面通過後就可以立刻認定延時沉陷已經結束。
optionsEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
Movement at a monitoring point can only be caused by the nearest face.
Face passage immediately establishes that all delayed settlement has ended.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.
