knowledge.textEn: Estimate field scatter from repeated stable controls and separate instrument, staff and environmental contributions; flag unresolved small changes instead of forcing a smooth trend, with quality flags approved by the survey lead. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Claiming 0.1 mm accuracy from display resolution overinterprets noise, while choosing the largest single difference creates false alarms. Repeated false alerts can weaken the response to genuine abnormal movement.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄精度與差值不確定的資料來源與適用條件。以穩定控制點重複觀測估計實際散布，分離儀器、立尺與環境貢獻；對小於可辨識程度的變化標記不確定，而不是強制畫成平順趨勢，並由測量主管核准資料品質旗標。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for precision of displacement differences. Estimate field scatter from repeated stable controls and separate instrument, staff and environmental contributions; flag unresolved small changes instead of forcing a smooth trend, with quality flags approved by the survey lead.

quiz.question: 要驗證「精度與差值不確定」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Precision of displacement differences"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
水準網閉合差很小，就證明所有基準點絕對穩定。
以穩定控制點重複觀測估計實際散布，分離儀器、立尺與環境貢獻；對小於可辨識程度的變化標記不確定，而不是強制畫成平順趨勢，並由測量主管核准資料品質旗標。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
A small leveling closure proves absolute stability of every benchmark.
Estimate field scatter from repeated stable controls and separate instrument, staff and environmental contributions.
quiz.explanation: 以穩定控制點重複觀測估計實際散布，分離儀器、立尺與環境貢獻；對小於可辨識程度的變化標記不確定，而不是強制畫成平順趨勢，並由測量主管核准資料品質旗標。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Estimate field scatter from repeated stable controls and separate instrument, staff and environmental contributions; flag unresolved small changes instead of forcing a smooth trend, with quality flags approved by the survey lead. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 精度與差值不確定：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Precision of displacement differences: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「精度與差值不確定」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Precision of displacement differences” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以0.1 mm顯示位數宣稱0.1 mm準確度會過度解讀噪音，若只挑單次最大變化又會製造假警報；反覆誤報可能削弱團隊對真異常的反應。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Claiming 0.1 mm accuracy from display resolution overinterprets noise, while choosing the largest single difference creates false alarms. Repeated false alerts can weaken the response to genuine abnormal movement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：以0.1 mm顯示位數宣稱0.1 mm準確度會過度解讀噪音，若只挑單次最大變化又會製造假警報；反覆誤報可能削弱團隊對真異常的反應。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Repeated false alerts can weaken the response to genuine abnormal movement.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「儀器顯示到十分之一毫米就具有同等實際準確度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An instrument displaying tenths of a millimetre has the same actual accuracy." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以0.1 mm顯示位數宣稱0.1 mm準確度會過度解讀噪音，若只挑單次最大變化又會製造假警報；反覆誤報可能削弱團隊對真異常的反應。
knowledge.textEn: Claiming 0.1 mm accuracy from display resolution overinterprets noise, while choosing the largest single difference creates false alarms. Repeated false alerts can weaken the response to genuine abnormal movement.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「精度與差值不確定」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Precision of displacement differences" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 以0.1 mm顯示位數宣稱0.1 mm準確度會過度解讀噪音，若只挑單次最大變化又會製造假警報；反覆誤報可能削弱團隊對真異常的反應。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
水位下降時總應力永遠不變，可以無條件使用水頭換算。
optionsEn: Claiming 0.1 mm accuracy from display resolution overinterprets noise, while choosing the largest single difference creates false alarms.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Total stress never changes during drawdown, so head conversion applies unconditionally.
quiz.explanation: 以0.1 mm顯示位數宣稱0.1 mm準確度會過度解讀噪音，若只挑單次最大變化又會製造假警報；反覆誤報可能削弱團隊對真異常的反應。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Claiming 0.1 mm accuracy from display resolution overinterprets noise, while choosing the largest single difference creates false alarms. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「地下水下降與固結」與「施工里程與多源事件」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Drawdown and consolidation" and "Chainage and multiple events": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 地下水下降與固結：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Drawdown and consolidation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「地下水下降與固結」如何影響隧道地表沉陷監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Drawdown and consolidation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Surface-settlement monitoring for tunneling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水位降低可增加有效應力並引發延時固結，影響範圍未必與即時沉陷槽相同。必須分開孔壓下降與總應力變化，水位穿越土層改變單位重時，簡單γwΔh換算不能直接完整代表。 假設總應力不變且測點孔壓降低γwΔh，水頭降2 m使Δσ′=9.81×2=19.62 kPa；總重改變須另算。 把延時固結全歸為潛盾出土過多會選錯控制手段，反之將局部失土都當地下水效應又可能延誤處置；需要水文與施工證據共同辨識。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「地下水下降與固結」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Drawdown may increase effective stress and cause delayed consolidation beyond the immediate trough. Separate pore-pressure reduction from changing total stress; when a water table crosses layers and changes unit weight, γwΔh alone is incomplete. Assume total stress remains fixed and point pore pressure falls by γwΔh; a 2 m head drop gives Δσ′=19.62 kPa, requiring separate treatment if total weight changes. Attributing all consolidation to excess muck removal selects the wrong control, while blaming localized ground loss on groundwater can delay action. Hydraulic and construction evidence are needed together. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Drawdown and consolidation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「水位下降時總應力永遠不變，可以無條件使用水頭換算。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Total stress never changes during drawdown, so head conversion applies unconditionally." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「地下水下降與固結」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Drawdown and consolidation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 地下水下降與固結
knowledge.text: 水位降低可增加有效應力並引發延時固結，影響範圍未必與即時沉陷槽相同。必須分開孔壓下降與總應力變化，水位穿越土層改變單位重時，簡單γwΔh換算不能直接完整代表。
knowledge.textEn: Drawdown may increase effective stress and cause delayed consolidation beyond the immediate trough. Separate pore-pressure reduction from changing total stress; when a water table crosses layers and changes unit weight, γwΔh alone is incomplete.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：水位下降時總應力永遠不變，可以無條件使用水頭換算。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Total stress never changes during drawdown, so head conversion applies unconditionally. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「地下水下降與固結」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Drawdown and consolidation" is correct?
options: 水位下降時總應力永遠不變，可以無條件使用水頭換算。
水位降低可增加有效應力並引發延時固結，影響範圍未必與即時沉陷槽相同。
每個監測點的變形只能由距離最近的掌子面造成。
optionsEn: Total stress never changes during drawdown, so head conversion applies unconditionally.
Drawdown may increase effective stress and cause delayed consolidation beyond the immediate trough.
Movement at a monitoring point can only be caused by the nearest face.
quiz.explanation: 水位降低可增加有效應力並引發延時固結，影響範圍未必與即時沉陷槽相同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Drawdown may increase effective stress and cause delayed consolidation beyond the immediate trough. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 地下水下降與固結：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Drawdown and consolidation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「地下水下降與固結」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Drawdown and consolidation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設總應力不變且測點孔壓降低γwΔh，水頭降2 m使Δσ′=9.81×2=19.62 kPa；總重改變須另算。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume total stress remains fixed and point pore pressure falls by γwΔh; a 2 m head drop gives Δσ′=19.62 kPa, requiring separate treatment if total weight changes. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將多深度孔壓、地表沉陷與抽排水量同步，檢查沉陷是否在開挖通過後仍持續；以壓縮性試驗與排水邊界分析時間尺度，不能只憑兩條相似曲線宣稱因果。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize multilevel pore pressure, settlement and pumping, checking whether movement persists after passage; use compressibility tests and drainage boundaries to assess timescale rather than inferring causality from two similar curves alone.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設總應力不變且測點孔壓降低γwΔh，水頭降2 m使Δσ′=9.81×2=19.62 kPa；總重改變須另算。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume total stress remains fixed and point pore pressure falls by γwΔh; a 2 m head drop gives Δσ′=19.62 kPa, requiring separate treatment if total weight changes.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「地下水下降與固結」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Drawdown and consolidation", which statement holds?
options: 掌子面通過後就可以立刻認定延時沉陷已經結束。
地表體積損失百分比就是直接量得的超挖土量百分比。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: Face passage immediately establishes that all delayed settlement has ended.
Surface volume-loss percentage is a directly measured overexcavation percentage.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 地下水下降與固結：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Drawdown and consolidation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「地下水下降與固結」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Drawdown and consolidation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將多深度孔壓、地表沉陷與抽排水量同步，檢查沉陷是否在開挖通過後仍持續；以壓縮性試驗與排水邊界分析時間尺度，不能只憑兩條相似曲線宣稱因果。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把延時固結全歸為潛盾出土過多會選錯控制手段，反之將局部失土都當地下水效應又可能延誤處置；需要水文與施工證據共同辨識。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize multilevel pore pressure, settlement and pumping, checking whether movement persists after passage; use compressibility tests and drainage boundaries to assess timescale rather than inferring causality from two similar curves alone. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Attributing all consolidation to excess muck removal selects the wrong control, while blaming localized ground loss on groundwater can delay action. Hydraulic and construction evidence are needed together. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄地下水下降與固結的資料來源與適用條件。將多深度孔壓、地表沉陷與抽排水量同步，檢查沉陷是否在開挖通過後仍持續；以壓縮性試驗與排水邊界分析時間尺度，不能只憑兩條相似曲線宣稱因果。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for drawdown and consolidation. Synchronize multilevel pore pressure, settlement and pumping, checking whether movement persists after passage; use compressibility tests and drainage boundaries to assess timescale rather than inferring causality from two similar curves alone.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把延時固結全歸為潛盾出土過多會選錯控制手段，反之將局部失土都當地下水效應又可能延誤處置；需要水文與施工證據共同辨識。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Attributing all consolidation to excess muck removal selects the wrong control, while blaming localized ground loss on groundwater can delay action. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Attributing all consolidation to excess muck removal selects the wrong control, while blaming localized ground loss on groundwater can delay action. Hydraulic and construction evidence are needed together.

quiz.question: 要驗證「地下水下降與固結」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Drawdown and consolidation"?
options: 將多深度孔壓、地表沉陷與抽排水量同步，檢查沉陷是否在開挖通過後仍持續；以壓縮性試驗與排水邊界分析時間尺度，不能只憑兩條相似曲線宣稱因果。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
建物總沉陷最大時，一定也承受最大的彎曲損傷。
optionsEn: Synchronize multilevel pore pressure, settlement and pumping, checking whether movement persists after passage.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The building with the largest total settlement necessarily suffers the most bending damage.
quiz.explanation: 將多深度孔壓、地表沉陷與抽排水量同步，檢查沉陷是否在開挖通過後仍持續；以壓縮性試驗與排水邊界分析時間尺度，不能只憑兩條相似曲線宣稱因果。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Synchronize multilevel pore pressure, settlement and pumping, checking whether movement persists after passage; use compressibility tests and drainage boundaries to assess timescale rather than inferring causality from two similar curves alone. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 地下水下降與固結：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Drawdown and consolidation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「地下水下降與固結」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Drawdown and consolidation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把延時固結全歸為潛盾出土過多會選錯控制手段，反之將局部失土都當地下水效應又可能延誤處置；需要水文與施工證據共同辨識。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Attributing all consolidation to excess muck removal selects the wrong control, while blaming localized ground loss on groundwater can delay action. Hydraulic and construction evidence are needed together. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把延時固結全歸為潛盾出土過多會選錯控制手段，反之將局部失土都當地下水效應又可能延誤處置；需要水文與施工證據共同辨識。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Hydraulic and construction evidence are needed together.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「水位下降時總應力永遠不變，可以無條件使用水頭換算。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Total stress never changes during drawdown, so head conversion applies unconditionally." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把延時固結全歸為潛盾出土過多會選錯控制手段，反之將局部失土都當地下水效應又可能延誤處置；需要水文與施工證據共同辨識。
knowledge.textEn: Attributing all consolidation to excess muck removal selects the wrong control, while blaming localized ground loss on groundwater can delay action. Hydraulic and construction evidence are needed together.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「地下水下降與固結」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Drawdown and consolidation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把延時固結全歸為潛盾出土過多會選錯控制手段，反之將局部失土都當地下水效應又可能延誤處置；需要水文與施工證據共同辨識。
每個監測點的變形只能由距離最近的掌子面造成。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Attributing all consolidation to excess muck removal selects the wrong control, while blaming localized ground loss on groundwater can delay action.
Movement at a monitoring point can only be caused by the nearest face.
quiz.explanation: 把延時固結全歸為潛盾出土過多會選錯控制手段，反之將局部失土都當地下水效應又可能延誤處置；需要水文與施工證據共同辨識。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Attributing all consolidation to excess muck removal selects the wrong control, while blaming localized ground loss on groundwater can delay action. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 施工里程與多源事件：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Chainage and multiple events: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「施工里程與多源事件」如何影響隧道地表沉陷監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Chainage and multiple events” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Surface-settlement monitoring for tunneling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 同一監測點可能受雙線隧道、車站開挖、灌漿與外部施工影響，位移對時間曲線需要連到各事件位置。將所有變化歸給最近掌子面會忽略延時與重疊，應建立可比較的事件索引。 假設掌子面距測點30 m、隧道直徑6 m，規一化距離x/D=5；兩條線比較需同樣定義正負方向。 錯誤時區或機器里程會將沉陷峰錯配施工階段，雙線效果重疊又可能被誤當第二條線單獨造成；這會扭曲事後經驗參數與責任判斷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「施工里程與多源事件」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A point may respond to twin drives, station excavation, grouting and unrelated works. Time histories must connect to each event location. Assigning every change to the nearest face ignores delay and overlap, requiring a comparable event index. For assumed face distance 30 m and diameter 6 m, normalized distance x/D=5; comparing drives requires the same sign convention. Wrong time zones or machine chainage misassign settlement peaks to stages; overlapping twin-drive effects can be attributed entirely to the second drive, biasing empirical parameters and retrospective responsibility assessments. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Chainage and multiple events” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每個監測點的變形只能由距離最近的掌子面造成。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Movement at a monitoring point can only be caused by the nearest face." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「施工里程與多源事件」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Chainage and multiple events”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 施工里程與多源事件
knowledge.text: 同一監測點可能受雙線隧道、車站開挖、灌漿與外部施工影響，位移對時間曲線需要連到各事件位置。將所有變化歸給最近掌子面會忽略延時與重疊，應建立可比較的事件索引。
knowledge.textEn: A point may respond to twin drives, station excavation, grouting and unrelated works. Time histories must connect to each event location.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：每個監測點的變形只能由距離最近的掌子面造成。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Movement at a monitoring point can only be caused by the nearest face. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「施工里程與多源事件」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Chainage and multiple events" is correct?
options: 每個監測點的變形只能由距離最近的掌子面造成。
大部分監測點正常就能取消少數敏感建物的超限警報。
同一監測點可能受雙線隧道、車站開挖、灌漿與外部施工影響，位移對時間曲線需要連到各事件位置。
optionsEn: Movement at a monitoring point can only be caused by the nearest face.
Normal readings at most points justify canceling an exceedance at a sensitive building.
A point may respond to twin drives, station excavation, grouting and unrelated works.
quiz.explanation: 同一監測點可能受雙線隧道、車站開挖、灌漿與外部施工影響，位移對時間曲線需要連到各事件位置。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A point may respond to twin drives, station excavation, grouting and unrelated works. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 施工里程與多源事件：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Chainage and multiple events: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「施工里程與多源事件」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Chainage and multiple events” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設掌子面距測點30 m、隧道直徑6 m，規一化距離x/D=5；兩條線比較需同樣定義正負方向。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed face distance 30 m and diameter 6 m, normalized distance x/D=5; comparing drives requires the same sign convention. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把位移同時對時間與規一化掌子面距離作圖，加入灌漿及抽水日誌；多事件重疊時比較未受同一事件影響的控制點，地工主管需列出可能成因及可區分它們的證據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot movement against both time and normalized face distance, including grouting and pumping logs; use suitable control points during overlapping events and require the geotechnical lead to list competing causes and distinguishing evidence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設掌子面距測點30 m、隧道直徑6 m，規一化距離x/D=5；兩條線比較需同樣定義正負方向。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed face distance 30 m and diameter 6 m, normalized distance x/D=5; comparing drives requires the same sign convention.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「施工里程與多源事件」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Chainage and multiple events", which statement holds?
options: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
量到沉陷槽中央最大值就能唯一決定槽的寬度。
水準網閉合差很小，就證明所有基準點絕對穩定。
optionsEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
The maximum centerline settlement uniquely determines the trough width.
A small leveling closure proves absolute stability of every benchmark.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 施工里程與多源事件：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Chainage and multiple events: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「施工里程與多源事件」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Chainage and multiple events” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把位移同時對時間與規一化掌子面距離作圖，加入灌漿及抽水日誌；多事件重疊時比較未受同一事件影響的控制點，地工主管需列出可能成因及可區分它們的證據。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：錯誤時區或機器里程會將沉陷峰錯配施工階段，雙線效果重疊又可能被誤當第二條線單獨造成；這會扭曲事後經驗參數與責任判斷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot movement against both time and normalized face distance, including grouting and pumping logs; use suitable control points during overlapping events and require the geotechnical lead to list competing causes and distinguishing evidence. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Wrong time zones or machine chainage misassign settlement peaks to stages; overlapping twin-drive effects can be attributed entirely to the second drive, biasing empirical parameters and retrospective responsibility assessments. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄施工里程與多源事件的資料來源與適用條件。把位移同時對時間與規一化掌子面距離作圖，加入灌漿及抽水日誌；多事件重疊時比較未受同一事件影響的控制點，地工主管需列出可能成因及可區分它們的證據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for chainage and multiple events. Plot movement against both time and normalized face distance, including grouting and pumping logs; use suitable control points during overlapping events and require the geotechnical lead to list competing causes and distinguishing evidence.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：錯誤時區或機器里程會將沉陷峰錯配施工階段，雙線效果重疊又可能被誤當第二條線單獨造成；這會扭曲事後經驗參數與責任判斷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Wrong time zones or machine chainage misassign settlement peaks to stages; overlapping twin-drive effects can be attributed entirely to the second drive, biasing empirical parameters and retrospective responsibility assessments. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Movement at a monitoring point can only be caused by the nearest face." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.

quiz.question: 在「施工里程與多源事件」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「警戒邏輯與量測確認」與「長期追蹤與結案」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Trigger logic and measurement confirmation" and "Long-term tracking and closeout": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 警戒邏輯與量測確認：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Trigger logic and measurement confirmation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「警戒邏輯與量測確認」如何影響隧道地表沉陷監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Trigger logic and measurement confirmation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Surface-settlement monitoring for tunneling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 警戒值應連到可執行的回應與量測確認流程，而非只有紅黃綠色。位移、速率與結構症狀提供不同證據，持續超限和單點跳值需分辨，但不能以資料確認為由延誤已核准的緊急回應。 假設教學警戒比r=量測8 mm/審查值10 mm=0.8；此10 mm純為算例，現場需個案核准。 只依平均值判斷可能掩蓋單一敏感建物，儀器斷線被當成零位移更危險；若警報沒有指定接收者，即使系統正確偵測也未必產生回應。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「警戒邏輯與量測確認」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Triggers require actionable responses and measurement confirmation, not only colors. Displacement, rate and structural symptoms provide different evidence; distinguish persistent exceedance from isolated jumps without delaying an approved emergency response. An assumed teaching trigger ratio is measured 8 mm/review value 10 mm=0.8; the 10 mm value is purely illustrative and requires project-specific approval in practice. Averages can hide one sensitive building, and treating lost communication as zero movement is worse. Without a named recipient, technically correct detection may still fail to produce a response. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Trigger logic and measurement confirmation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「大部分監測點正常就能取消少數敏感建物的超限警報。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Normal readings at most points justify canceling an exceedance at a sensitive building." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「警戒邏輯與量測確認」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.text: 誤解：大部分監測點正常就能取消少數敏感建物的超限警報。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

steps.title: 警戒邏輯與量測確認：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Trigger logic and measurement confirmation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「警戒邏輯與量測確認」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Trigger logic and measurement confirmation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設教學警戒比r=量測8 mm/審查值10 mm=0.8；此10 mm純為算例，現場需個案核准。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed teaching trigger ratio is measured 8 mm/review value 10 mm=0.8; the 10 mm value is purely illustrative and requires project-specific approval in practice. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用模擬資料演練超限通知、備援讀值與責任人接收，確認通訊斷線也會被標示；工程師審查門檻的依據、延遲與可採行措施，不能把本課比值部署成現場控制表。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Rehearse notification, backup readings and acknowledgment with synthetic data, including communication loss; engineers review criteria, latency and feasible actions, and the teaching ratio must not be deployed as a field control table.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

title: 隧道收斂量測
summary: 本課聚焦用多方向位移、量測基準與支護時序辨識隧道收斂機制。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。
summaryEn: This course focuses on identify convergence mechanisms through multidirectional movement, survey references and support timing. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設原弦長8.000 m、後為7.988 m，收斂12 mm、相對應變12/8000=0.0015。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設首讀前已收斂6 mm、之後量得14 mm，總估計20 mm；缺失初期量占30%，須明列為推估。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed chord shortening from 8.000 to 7.988 m gives convergence 12 mm and relative strain 12/8000=0.0015. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume 6 mm convergence before the first reading and 14 mm afterward; estimated total is 20 mm, with 30% explicitly inferred rather than measured. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「收斂弦長與方向」與「初始讀值與已發生變形」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Convergence chords and direction" and "Initial readings and prior movement": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 收斂弦長與方向：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Convergence chords and direction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「收斂弦長與方向」如何影響隧道收斂量測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Convergence chords and direction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel convergence monitoring”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 收斂弦量到兩點間距變化，不等於每點的絕對位移。水平弦縮短可能來自側壁內移或整個斷面轉動，只有加入垂直、斜向弦與坐標才能分辨對稱擠壓及偏壓。 假設原弦長8.000 m、後為7.988 m，收斂12 mm、相對應變12/8000=0.0015。 兩端測釘一起平移時弦長不變，卻可能已發生整體偏移；測釘局部鬆脫又可製造假收斂，若沒有絕對坐標便難以辨別兩者。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「收斂弦長與方向」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A convergence chord measures separation change, not absolute movement at either endpoint. Horizontal shortening may reflect inward movement or section rotation; vertical and diagonal chords plus coordinates distinguish symmetric squeezing from asymmetric loading. An assumed chord shortening from 8.000 to 7.988 m gives convergence 12 mm and relative strain 12/8000=0.0015. Both targets can translate together with unchanged chord length despite substantial section movement. A loose target can instead create false convergence, difficult to distinguish without independent coordinates. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Convergence chords and direction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩點間弦長不變就證明兩個測點都沒有移動。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An unchanged chord proves that neither of its endpoints has moved." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「收斂弦長與方向」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Convergence chords and direction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 收斂弦長與方向
knowledge.text: 收斂弦量到兩點間距變化，不等於每點的絕對位移。水平弦縮短可能來自側壁內移或整個斷面轉動，只有加入垂直、斜向弦與坐標才能分辨對稱擠壓及偏壓。
knowledge.textEn: A convergence chord measures separation change, not absolute movement at either endpoint. Horizontal shortening may reflect inward movement or section rotation; vertical and diagonal chords plus coordinates distinguish symmetric squeezing from asymmetric loading.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩點間弦長不變就證明兩個測點都沒有移動。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An unchanged chord proves that neither of its endpoints has moved. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「收斂弦長與方向」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Convergence chords and direction" is correct?
options: 兩點間弦長不變就證明兩個測點都沒有移動。
收斂弦量到兩點間距變化，不等於每點的絕對位移。
較晚安裝的測點記錄較小收斂，就表示該斷面更穩定。
optionsEn: An unchanged chord proves that neither of its endpoints has moved.
A convergence chord measures separation change, not absolute movement at either endpoint.
Smaller convergence at a later-installed section proves that section is more stable.
quiz.explanation: 收斂弦量到兩點間距變化，不等於每點的絕對位移。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A convergence chord measures separation change, not absolute movement at either endpoint. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 收斂弦長與方向：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Convergence chords and direction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「收斂弦長與方向」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Convergence chords and direction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設原弦長8.000 m、後為7.988 m，收斂12 mm、相對應變12/8000=0.0015。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed chord shortening from 8.000 to 7.988 m gives convergence 12 mm and relative strain 12/8000=0.0015. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用多條不共線弦與全測站坐標同時檢查，核對測釘是否牢固連到代表性支護；依設計預測方向比較位移向量，不用單一水平弦直接判定整個斷面均勻收縮。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare several noncollinear chords with total-station coordinates and check that targets represent stable support locations; compare vectors with predicted directions rather than inferring uniform section shrinkage from one horizontal chord.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 依「收斂弦長與方向」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

Increasing convergence with time necessarily indicates creep unrelated to face advance.

steps.title: 收斂弦長與方向：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Convergence chords and direction: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「收斂弦長與方向」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Convergence chords and direction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用多條不共線弦與全測站坐標同時檢查，核對測釘是否牢固連到代表性支護；依設計預測方向比較位移向量，不用單一水平弦直接判定整個斷面均勻收縮。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：兩端測釘一起平移時弦長不變，卻可能已發生整體偏移；測釘局部鬆脫又可製造假收斂，若沒有絕對坐標便難以辨別兩者。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare several noncollinear chords with total-station coordinates and check that targets represent stable support locations; compare vectors with predicted directions rather than inferring uniform section shrinkage from one horizontal chord. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Both targets can translate together with unchanged chord length despite substantial section movement. A loose target can instead create false convergence, difficult to distinguish without independent coordinates. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Compare several noncollinear chords with total-station coordinates and check that targets represent stable support locations; compare vectors with predicted directions rather than inferring uniform section shrinkage from one horizontal chord.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：兩端測釘一起平移時弦長不變，卻可能已發生整體偏移；測釘局部鬆脫又可製造假收斂，若沒有絕對坐標便難以辨別兩者。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Convergence chords and direction"?
options: 用多條不共線弦與全測站坐標同時檢查，核對測釘是否牢固連到代表性支護；依設計預測方向比較位移向量，不用單一水平弦直接判定整個斷面均勻收縮。

steps.title: 收斂弦長與方向：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「收斂弦長與方向」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Convergence chords and direction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 兩端測釘一起平移時弦長不變，卻可能已發生整體偏移；測釘局部鬆脫又可製造假收斂，若沒有絕對坐標便難以辨別兩者。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「收斂弦長與方向」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Convergence chords and direction" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
兩端測釘一起平移時弦長不變，卻可能已發生整體偏移；測釘局部鬆脫又可製造假收斂，若沒有絕對坐標便難以辨別兩者。
較晚安裝的測點記錄較小收斂，就表示該斷面更穩定。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Both targets can translate together with unchanged chord length despite substantial section movement.
Smaller convergence at a later-installed section proves that section is more stable.
quiz.explanation: 兩端測釘一起平移時弦長不變，卻可能已發生整體偏移；測釘局部鬆脫又可製造假收斂，若沒有絕對坐標便難以辨別兩者。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Both targets can translate together with unchanged chord length despite substantial section movement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 初始讀值與已發生變形：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Initial readings and prior movement: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「初始讀值與已發生變形」如何影響隧道收斂量測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Initial readings and prior movement” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel convergence monitoring”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 量測只能看到首讀之後的變化，掌子面到達與裝設測點之間已發生的位移不在紀錄內。首讀里程、時間與支護狀態需一起保存，否則不同斷面會因量測起點不同而看似岩性差異。 假設首讀前已收斂6 mm、之後量得14 mm，總估計20 mm；缺失初期量占30%，須明列為推估。 晚裝測點的斷面可能看似變形最小而被判成最穩定，實際大部分已發生；以此降低支護會把量測時序偏差誤當地層改善。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「初始讀值與已發生變形」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Monitoring captures movement after the first reading, omitting displacement before installation. Preserve initial face distance, time and support state; otherwise different monitoring origins can masquerade as geological differences between sections. Assume 6 mm convergence before the first reading and 14 mm afterward; estimated total is 20 mm, with 30% explicitly inferred rather than measured. A late-installed section can appear most stable because much movement occurred before monitoring. Reducing support on that basis mistakes installation timing for improved ground conditions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Initial readings and prior movement” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「較晚安裝的測點記錄較小收斂，就表示該斷面更穩定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Smaller convergence at a later-installed section proves that section is more stable." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「初始讀值與已發生變形」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Initial readings and prior movement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 初始讀值與已發生變形
knowledge.text: 量測只能看到首讀之後的變化，掌子面到達與裝設測點之間已發生的位移不在紀錄內。首讀里程、時間與支護狀態需一起保存，否則不同斷面會因量測起點不同而看似岩性差異。
knowledge.textEn: Monitoring captures movement after the first reading, omitting displacement before installation. Preserve initial face distance, time and support state; otherwise different monitoring origins can masquerade as geological differences between sections.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：較晚安裝的測點記錄較小收斂，就表示該斷面更穩定。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Smaller convergence at a later-installed section proves that section is more stable. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「初始讀值與已發生變形」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Initial readings and prior movement" is correct?
options: 較晚安裝的測點記錄較小收斂，就表示該斷面更穩定。
全測站角度精度固定，所以位置誤差與觀測距離無關。
量測只能看到首讀之後的變化，掌子面到達與裝設測點之間已發生的位移不在紀錄內。
optionsEn: Smaller convergence at a later-installed section proves that section is more stable.
Fixed total-station angular precision makes positional error independent of sight distance.
Monitoring captures movement after the first reading, omitting displacement before installation.
quiz.explanation: 量測只能看到首讀之後的變化，掌子面到達與裝設測點之間已發生的位移不在紀錄內。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Monitoring captures movement after the first reading, omitting displacement before installation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 初始讀值與已發生變形：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Initial readings and prior movement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「初始讀值與已發生變形」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Initial readings and prior movement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設首讀前已收斂6 mm、之後量得14 mm，總估計20 mm；缺失初期量占30%，須明列為推估。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume 6 mm convergence before the first reading and 14 mm afterward; estimated total is 20 mm, with 30% explicitly inferred rather than measured. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照開挖及支護日誌記錄首讀延遲，以相同面距或模型比較斷面；初期缺失量只能用經驗或分析給區間，不能回填成實測點，主管工程師需確認這種修正的用途。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record first-reading delay against excavation and support logs and compare sections at matching face distance or through a model; missing early movement receives an inferred interval, never fabricated measured points, with engineering approval of its use.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設首讀前已收斂6 mm、之後量得14 mm，總估計20 mm；缺失初期量占30%，須明列為推估。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume 6 mm convergence before the first reading and 14 mm afterward; estimated total is 20 mm, with 30% explicitly inferred rather than measured.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「初始讀值與已發生變形」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Initial readings and prior movement", which statement holds?
options: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
所有測點共同位移時，一定可以全部扣除當作基準漂移。
支護剛度乘位移可在有空隙未接觸時直接算出反力。
optionsEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
Common movement of all targets can always be subtracted as reference drift.
Support stiffness times movement directly gives reaction even before a gap closes.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 初始讀值與已發生變形：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Initial readings and prior movement: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「初始讀值與已發生變形」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Initial readings and prior movement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照開挖及支護日誌記錄首讀延遲，以相同面距或模型比較斷面；初期缺失量只能用經驗或分析給區間，不能回填成實測點，主管工程師需確認這種修正的用途。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：晚裝測點的斷面可能看似變形最小而被判成最穩定，實際大部分已發生；以此降低支護會把量測時序偏差誤當地層改善。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record first-reading delay against excavation and support logs and compare sections at matching face distance or through a model; missing early movement receives an inferred interval, never fabricated measured points, with engineering approval of its use. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: A late-installed section can appear most stable because much movement occurred before monitoring. Reducing support on that basis mistakes installation timing for improved ground conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄初始讀值與已發生變形的資料來源與適用條件。對照開挖及支護日誌記錄首讀延遲，以相同面距或模型比較斷面；初期缺失量只能用經驗或分析給區間，不能回填成實測點，主管工程師需確認這種修正的用途。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for initial readings and prior movement. Record first-reading delay against excavation and support logs and compare sections at matching face distance or through a model; missing early movement receives an inferred interval, never fabricated measured points, with engineering approval of its use.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：晚裝測點的斷面可能看似變形最小而被判成最穩定，實際大部分已發生；以此降低支護會把量測時序偏差誤當地層改善。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A late-installed section can appear most stable because much movement occurred before monitoring. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對照開挖及支護日誌記錄首讀延遲，以相同面距或模型比較斷面；初期缺失量只能用經驗或分析給區間，不能回填成實測點，主管工程師需確認這種修正的用途。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：晚裝測點的斷面可能看似變形最小而被判成最穩定，實際大部分已發生；以此降低支護會把量測時序偏差誤當地層改善。
knowledge.textEn: Record first-reading delay against excavation and support logs and compare sections at matching face distance or through a model; missing early movement receives an inferred interval, never fabricated measured points, with engineering approval of its use. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: A late-installed section can appear most stable because much movement occurred before monitoring. Reducing support on that basis mistakes installation timing for improved ground conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄初始讀值與已發生變形的資料來源與適用條件。對照開挖及支護日誌記錄首讀延遲，以相同面距或模型比較斷面；初期缺失量只能用經驗或分析給區間，不能回填成實測點，主管工程師需確認這種修正的用途。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for initial readings and prior movement. Record first-reading delay against excavation and support logs and compare sections at matching face distance or through a model; missing early movement receives an inferred interval, never fabricated measured points, with engineering approval of its use.

quiz.question: 要驗證「初始讀值與已發生變形」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Initial readings and prior movement"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
對照開挖及支護日誌記錄首讀延遲，以相同面距或模型比較斷面；初期缺失量只能用經驗或分析給區間，不能回填成實測點，主管工程師需確認這種修正的用途。
自動監測有持續更新的畫面就代表資料必定是最新值。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Record first-reading delay against excavation and support logs and compare sections at matching face distance or through a model.

quiz.explanationEn: Record first-reading delay against excavation and support logs and compare sections at matching face distance or through a model; missing early movement receives an inferred interval, never fabricated measured points, with engineering approval of its use. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 初始讀值與已發生變形：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Initial readings and prior movement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「初始讀值與已發生變形」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Initial readings and prior movement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 晚裝測點的斷面可能看似變形最小而被判成最穩定，實際大部分已發生；以此降低支護會把量測時序偏差誤當地層改善。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A late-installed section can appear most stable because much movement occurred before monitoring. Reducing support on that basis mistakes installation timing for improved ground conditions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：晚裝測點的斷面可能看似變形最小而被判成最穩定，實際大部分已發生；以此降低支護會把量測時序偏差誤當地層改善。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Smaller convergence at a later-installed section proves that section is more stable." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 晚裝測點的斷面可能看似變形最小而被判成最穩定，實際大部分已發生；以此降低支護會把量測時序偏差誤當地層改善。

全測站角度精度固定，所以位置誤差與觀測距離無關。

Fixed total-station angular precision makes positional error independent of sight distance.

steps.title: 角度精度與觀測距離：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Angular precision and sight distance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel convergence monitoring”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 全測站角度誤差隨觀測距離轉成線性位置誤差，長視線不一定有更好的收斂精度。隧道熱流、折射與遮擋又造成非隨機偏差，必須把儀器標稱值和現場重複性分開。 假設視距100 m、角度誤差5 arcsec，線性誤差100×5/206265=0.00242 m=2.42 mm。 暖風造成的折射會讓相同方向測點共同偏移，系統可能把它解讀成斷面傾斜；只靠單一測站的內部精度指標無法發現這種偏差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「角度精度與觀測距離」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Total-station angular error becomes a distance-dependent position error. Long sights therefore need not improve convergence precision, and tunnel thermal refraction and obstruction add nonrandom bias beyond the nominal instrument rating. For assumed sight distance 100 m and angular error 5 arcsec, linear error is 100×5/206265=0.00242 m=2.42 mm. Thermal refraction can move targets coherently in one direction and mimic section tilt. Internal precision statistics from one station cannot reveal that shared directional error. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Angular precision and sight distance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.textEn: Total-station angular error becomes a distance-dependent position error. Long sights therefore need not improve convergence precision, and tunnel thermal refraction and obstruction add nonrandom bias beyond the nominal instrument rating.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Fixed total-station angular precision makes positional error independent of sight distance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「角度精度與觀測距離」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Angular precision and sight distance" is correct?
options: 全測站角度誤差隨觀測距離轉成線性位置誤差，長視線不一定有更好的收斂精度。

optionsEn: Total-station angular error becomes a distance-dependent position error.
Fixed total-station angular precision makes positional error independent of sight distance.
A steel-tape reading changes only with ground movement, never temperature or tension.
quiz.explanation: 全測站角度誤差隨觀測距離轉成線性位置誤差，長視線不一定有更好的收斂精度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Total-station angular error becomes a distance-dependent position error. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 角度精度與觀測距離：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Angular precision and sight distance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「角度精度與觀測距離」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Angular precision and sight distance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設視距100 m、角度誤差5 arcsec，線性誤差100×5/206265=0.00242 m=2.42 mm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed sight distance 100 m and angular error 5 arcsec, linear error is 100×5/206265=0.00242 m=2.42 mm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以不同設站、正倒鏡及穩定參考點重複觀測，記錄溫度梯度與可視條件；將現場重複散布和預期變形量比較，若噪音同量級則需調整測網而非增加輸出小數位。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Repeat observations from different stations and faces with stable references and document thermal and visibility conditions; compare field scatter with expected movement, redesigning the network rather than adding decimals when they are comparable.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 角度精度與觀測距離：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Angular precision and sight distance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「角度精度與觀測距離」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Angular precision and sight distance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以不同設站、正倒鏡及穩定參考點重複觀測，記錄溫度梯度與可視條件；將現場重複散布和預期變形量比較，若噪音同量級則需調整測網而非增加輸出小數位。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：暖風造成的折射會讓相同方向測點共同偏移，系統可能把它解讀成斷面傾斜；只靠單一測站的內部精度指標無法發現這種偏差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Repeat observations from different stations and faces with stable references and document thermal and visibility conditions; compare field scatter with expected movement, redesigning the network rather than adding decimals when they are comparable. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Thermal refraction can move targets coherently in one direction and mimic section tilt. Internal precision statistics from one station cannot reveal that shared directional error. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for angular precision and sight distance. Repeat observations from different stations and faces with stable references and document thermal and visibility conditions; compare field scatter with expected movement, redesigning the network rather than adding decimals when they are comparable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：暖風造成的折射會讓相同方向測點共同偏移，系統可能把它解讀成斷面傾斜；只靠單一測站的內部精度指標無法發現這種偏差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Thermal refraction can move targets coherently in one direction and mimic section tilt. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Internal precision statistics from one station cannot reveal that shared directional error.

quiz.question: 要驗證「角度精度與觀測距離」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Angular precision and sight distance"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
兩個模型同樣吻合收斂曲線，就表示其力學機制相同。
以不同設站、正倒鏡及穩定參考點重複觀測，記錄溫度梯度與可視條件；將現場重複散布和預期變形量比較，若噪音同量級則需調整測網而非增加輸出小數位。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.

steps.title: 角度精度與觀測距離：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Angular precision and sight distance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「角度精度與觀測距離」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Angular precision and sight distance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 暖風造成的折射會讓相同方向測點共同偏移，系統可能把它解讀成斷面傾斜；只靠單一測站的內部精度指標無法發現這種偏差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.observation: 連結機制：暖風造成的折射會讓相同方向測點共同偏移，系統可能把它解讀成斷面傾斜；只靠單一測站的內部精度指標無法發現這種偏差。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Internal precision statistics from one station cannot reveal that shared directional error.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.explanationEn: Thermal refraction can move targets coherently in one direction and mimic section tilt. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 鋼尺溫度與張力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Tape temperature and tension: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「鋼尺溫度與張力」如何影響隧道收斂量測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tape temperature and tension” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel convergence monitoring”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 收斂尺量長受熱膨脹、拉力及垂度影響，讀值變化不必然是岩體運動。應使用校正條件換算到共同基準，且確認標距和接頭重複定位，否則日夜溫差會形成假的週期變形。 假設鋼尺α=12×10⁻⁶/K、長10 m、溫差10 K，ΔL=αLΔT=1.2 mm；未含垂度。 溫度補償符號用反會把膨脹加倍，量測人員張力不同又可造成班次跳值；若未查校正紀錄，就可能對不存在的變形採取施工調整。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「鋼尺溫度與張力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Tape length responds to temperature, tension and sag as well as ground movement. Convert readings to a common calibration condition and verify gauge length and seating, or day-night temperature variation will mimic cyclic convergence. Assume steel-tape α=12×10⁻⁶/K, length 10 m and temperature change 10 K; ΔL=1.2 mm, excluding sag. A reversed temperature correction doubles thermal error, while inconsistent tension produces shift changes. Missing calibration review may prompt construction changes in response to movement that never occurred. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Tape temperature and tension” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼尺讀值變化只能是圍岩變形，不會受溫度和張力影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A steel-tape reading changes only with ground movement, never temperature or tension." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

knowledge.title: 鋼尺溫度與張力
knowledge.text: 收斂尺量長受熱膨脹、拉力及垂度影響，讀值變化不必然是岩體運動。應使用校正條件換算到共同基準，且確認標距和接頭重複定位，否則日夜溫差會形成假的週期變形。
knowledge.textEn: Tape length responds to temperature, tension and sag as well as ground movement. Convert readings to a common calibration condition and verify gauge length and seating, or day-night temperature variation will mimic cyclic convergence.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼尺讀值變化只能是圍岩變形，不會受溫度和張力影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A steel-tape reading changes only with ground movement, never temperature or tension. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鋼尺溫度與張力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Tape temperature and tension" is correct?
options: 鋼尺讀值變化只能是圍岩變形，不會受溫度和張力影響。

optionsEn: A steel-tape reading changes only with ground movement, never temperature or tension.
Tape length responds to temperature, tension and sag as well as ground movement.
Common movement of all targets can always be subtracted as reference drift.

steps.title: 鋼尺溫度與張力：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋼尺溫度與張力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tape temperature and tension” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設鋼尺α=12×10⁻⁶/K、長10 m、溫差10 K，ΔL=αLΔT=1.2 mm；未含垂度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume steel-tape α=12×10⁻⁶/K, length 10 m and temperature change 10 K; ΔL=1.2 mm, excluding sag. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在固定基線檢查尺長及重複張力，記錄量測時尺體溫度而非只用遠處氣溫；保留原讀值與各修正項，以獨立光學量測核對，修正後仍異常才作地工解釋。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check tape length and repeatable tension on a fixed baseline and record tape temperature rather than distant air temperature; retain raw readings and corrections and compare optical observations before interpreting persistent anomalies geotechnically.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 鋼尺溫度與張力：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鋼尺溫度與張力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tape temperature and tension” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在固定基線檢查尺長及重複張力，記錄量測時尺體溫度而非只用遠處氣溫；保留原讀值與各修正項，以獨立光學量測核對，修正後仍異常才作地工解釋。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：溫度補償符號用反會把膨脹加倍，量測人員張力不同又可造成班次跳值；若未查校正紀錄，就可能對不存在的變形採取施工調整。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check tape length and repeatable tension on a fixed baseline and record tape temperature rather than distant air temperature; retain raw readings and corrections and compare optical observations before interpreting persistent anomalies geotechnically. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: A reversed temperature correction doubles thermal error, while inconsistent tension produces shift changes. Missing calibration review may prompt construction changes in response to movement that never occurred. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 鋼尺溫度與張力：失效診斷

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tape temperature and tension” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 溫度補償符號用反會把膨脹加倍，量測人員張力不同又可造成班次跳值；若未查校正紀錄，就可能對不存在的變形採取施工調整。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 參考點穩定與共模：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Reference stability and common motion: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「參考點穩定與共模」如何影響隧道收斂量測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Reference stability and common motion” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel convergence monitoring”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 洞內設站點也可能隨開挖移動，所有測點共模位移可能來自設站而非圍岩。測網需連到影響區外控制，並利用相對弦長與絕對坐標互查，使局部變形和整體基準漂移可分辨。 假設三點皆向右5 mm且弦長不變，可能為共同平移；差分位移5−5=0 mm，不能據此宣稱絕對不動。 把設站漂移當偏壓會誤改支護，反過來將真實整體位移一律扣除也會掩蓋隧道移動；只保留校正後曲線無法查明哪種情況發生。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「參考點穩定與共模」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Underground stations can move during excavation, creating common apparent displacement. Link the network to external controls and compare relative chords with absolute coordinates to distinguish local distortion from reference drift. If three assumed targets all move 5 mm right with unchanged chords, their differential movement is zero; this does not demonstrate absolute stability. Mistaking station drift for asymmetric ground pressure misdirects support, while subtracting all common motion can hide real tunnel translation. Corrected curves alone cannot establish which situation occurred. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Reference stability and common motion” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 參考點穩定與共模：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「參考點穩定與共模」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Reference stability and common motion” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設三點皆向右5 mm且弦長不變，可能為共同平移；差分位移5−5=0 mm，不能據此宣稱絕對不動。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If three assumed targets all move 5 mm right with unchanged chords, their differential movement is zero; this does not demonstrate absolute stability. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：檢查外部控制與設站殘差，重算以不同基準約束的位移場；對共模與差分量分別報告，任何基準重設須保存轉換矩陣並經測量主管核准，避免歷程被強制歸零。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Inspect external controls and station residuals and recompute with alternative reference constraints; report common and differential motion separately and retain approved transformation matrices for any datum reset instead of forcing the history to zero.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instructionEn: Inspect external controls and station residuals and recompute with alternative reference constraints; report common and differential motion separately and retain approved transformation matrices for any datum reset instead of forcing the history to zero. steps.title: 參考點穩定與共模：失效診斷
