steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「參考點穩定與共模」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Reference stability and common motion” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把設站漂移當偏壓會誤改支護，反過來將真實整體位移一律扣除也會掩蓋隧道移動；只保留校正後曲線無法查明哪種情況發生。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mistaking station drift for asymmetric ground pressure misdirects support, while subtracting all common motion can hide real tunnel translation. Corrected curves alone cannot establish which situation occurred. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把設站漂移當偏壓會誤改支護，反過來將真實整體位移一律扣除也會掩蓋隧道移動；只保留校正後曲線無法查明哪種情況發生。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Corrected curves alone cannot establish which situation occurred.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「所有測點共同位移時，一定可以全部扣除當作基準漂移。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Common movement of all targets can always be subtracted as reference drift." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「參考點穩定與共模」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
收斂對時間增加必定代表潛變，與掌子面推進無關。
把設站漂移當偏壓會誤改支護，反過來將真實整體位移一律扣除也會掩蓋隧道移動；只保留校正後曲線無法查明哪種情況發生。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Increasing convergence with time necessarily indicates creep unrelated to face advance.
Mistaking station drift for asymmetric ground pressure misdirects support, while subtracting all common motion can hide real tunnel translation.

quiz.explanationEn: Mistaking station drift for asymmetric ground pressure misdirects support, while subtracting all common motion can hide real tunnel translation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 面距與變形速率：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Face distance and movement rate” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel convergence monitoring”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 靠近掌子面的三維支承效應隨面距消退，收斂對時間的變化也受開挖停頓影響。把位移同時對時間與面距繪圖，才能區分施工推進造成的釋放與岩體持續潛變。 假設收斂由8增至11 mm歷時6 h，平均0.5 mm/h；同期面進3 m，空間增率1 mm/m。 快速推進時密集釋放可能被誤當加速潛變，長期停工後的持續收斂又可能被低頻量測漏掉；兩者需要不同的地工解釋與審查。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「面距與變形速率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Three-dimensional face restraint diminishes with distance, while stoppages alter convergence versus time. Plotting movement against both time and face distance separates advance-related release from continuing rock creep. An assumed convergence increase from 8 to 11 mm over 6 h gives 0.5 mm/h; with 3 m advance, the spatial increment is 1 mm/m. Rapid advance-related release can be mistaken for accelerating creep, while continuing movement during long stoppages may be missed by infrequent readings. These cases require different geotechnical interpretations and review. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Face distance and movement rate” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Increasing convergence with time necessarily indicates creep unrelated to face advance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「面距與變形速率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Increasing convergence with time necessarily indicates creep unrelated to face advance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.title: 面距與變形速率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Face distance and movement rate: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「面距與變形速率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Face distance and movement rate” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步掌子面里程、支護完成時刻與位移資料，對照停工時段是否仍有變形；以多斷面比較一致面距的行為，速率變化需連到實際事件而非只用等時間插值資料。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：快速推進時密集釋放可能被誤當加速潛變，長期停工後的持續收斂又可能被低頻量測漏掉；兩者需要不同的地工解釋與審查。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize face chainage, support completion and movement and inspect behavior during stoppages; compare sections at matching face distances and relate rate changes to actual events rather than uniformly interpolated time series. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Rapid advance-related release can be mistaken for accelerating creep, while continuing movement during long stoppages may be missed by infrequent readings. These cases require different geotechnical interpretations and review. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Rapid advance-related release can be mistaken for accelerating creep, while continuing movement during long stoppages may be missed by infrequent readings. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「面距與變形速率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

quiz.explanationEn: Synchronize face chainage, support completion and movement and inspect behavior during stoppages; compare sections at matching face distances and relate rate changes to actual events rather than uniformly interpolated time series. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 面距與變形速率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Face distance and movement rate: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「面距與變形速率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Face distance and movement rate” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 快速推進時密集釋放可能被誤當加速潛變，長期停工後的持續收斂又可能被低頻量測漏掉；兩者需要不同的地工解釋與審查。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Rapid advance-related release can be mistaken for accelerating creep, while continuing movement during long stoppages may be missed by infrequent readings. These cases require different geotechnical interpretations and review. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：快速推進時密集釋放可能被誤當加速潛變，長期停工後的持續收斂又可能被低頻量測漏掉；兩者需要不同的地工解釋與審查。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: These cases require different geotechnical interpretations and review.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「收斂對時間增加必定代表潛變，與掌子面推進無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Increasing convergence with time necessarily indicates creep unrelated to face advance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 快速推進時密集釋放可能被誤當加速潛變，長期停工後的持續收斂又可能被低頻量測漏掉；兩者需要不同的地工解釋與審查。
knowledge.textEn: Rapid advance-related release can be mistaken for accelerating creep, while continuing movement during long stoppages may be missed by infrequent readings. These cases require different geotechnical interpretations and review.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「面距與變形速率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
支護剛度乘位移可在有空隙未接觸時直接算出反力。
optionsEn: Rapid advance-related release can be mistaken for accelerating creep, while continuing movement during long stoppages may be missed by infrequent readings.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Support stiffness times movement directly gives reaction even before a gap closes.
quiz.explanation: 快速推進時密集釋放可能被誤當加速潛變，長期停工後的持續收斂又可能被低頻量測漏掉；兩者需要不同的地工解釋與審查。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Rapid advance-related release can be mistaken for accelerating creep, while continuing movement during long stoppages may be missed by infrequent readings. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「支護接觸與剛度」與「斷面橢圓化模式」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Support contact and stiffness" and "Section ovalization patterns": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 支護接觸與剛度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Support contact and stiffness: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「支護接觸與剛度」如何影響隧道收斂量測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Support contact and stiffness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel convergence monitoring”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 襯砌只有與圍岩有效接觸並形成受力路徑後才提供約束，間隙閉合前的收斂未必反映材料柔弱。早齡混凝土剛度隨時間變化，收斂減慢也可能是支護成熟而非地層改善。 假設等效線性支護k=20 MN/m、接觸後位移2 mm，反力F=kδ=40 kN；接觸前不可使用此式。 有空隙時先套線性支護會高估早期反力，反之忽略成熟剛度又可能低估後期受力；收斂小也不能證明襯砌應力低。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「支護接觸與剛度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Lining restrains ground only after contact and a load path form; movement before gap closure need not indicate weak material. Early-age stiffness changes with time, so slower convergence can reflect support maturation rather than improved geology. Assume equivalent linear support stiffness k=20 MN/m and post-contact movement 2 mm; F=kδ=40 kN, inapplicable before contact. Applying linear support across a gap overestimates early reaction, while ignoring maturing stiffness can underestimate later force. Small convergence therefore does not prove low lining stress. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Support contact and stiffness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「支護剛度乘位移可在有空隙未接觸時直接算出反力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Support stiffness times movement directly gives reaction even before a gap closes." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「支護接觸與剛度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Support contact and stiffness”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 支護接觸與剛度
knowledge.text: 襯砌只有與圍岩有效接觸並形成受力路徑後才提供約束，間隙閉合前的收斂未必反映材料柔弱。早齡混凝土剛度隨時間變化，收斂減慢也可能是支護成熟而非地層改善。
knowledge.textEn: Lining restrains ground only after contact and a load path form; movement before gap closure need not indicate weak material. Early-age stiffness changes with time, so slower convergence can reflect support maturation rather than improved geology.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：支護剛度乘位移可在有空隙未接觸時直接算出反力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Support stiffness times movement directly gives reaction even before a gap closes. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「支護接觸與剛度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Support contact and stiffness" is correct?
options: 支護剛度乘位移可在有空隙未接觸時直接算出反力。
襯砌只有與圍岩有效接觸並形成受力路徑後才提供約束，間隙閉合前的收斂未必反映材料柔弱。
把斷面最佳擬合成圓就能保留全部橢圓化資訊。
optionsEn: Support stiffness times movement directly gives reaction even before a gap closes.
Lining restrains ground only after contact and a load path form; movement before gap closure need not indicate weak material.
Fitting the section to a best-fit circle preserves all ovalization information.
quiz.explanation: 襯砌只有與圍岩有效接觸並形成受力路徑後才提供約束，間隙閉合前的收斂未必反映材料柔弱。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Lining restrains ground only after contact and a load path form; movement before gap closure need not indicate weak material. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 支護接觸與剛度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Support contact and stiffness: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「支護接觸與剛度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Support contact and stiffness” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設等效線性支護k=20 MN/m、接觸後位移2 mm，反力F=kδ=40 kN；接觸前不可使用此式。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume equivalent linear support stiffness k=20 MN/m and post-contact movement 2 mm; F=kδ=40 kN, inapplicable before contact. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把收斂與支護齡期、厚度、接縫及接觸檢查相連，必要時以應變或荷重資料交叉確認；設計者需驗證剛度模型及有效受力寬度，不直接將單點位移乘任意剛度當全環載重。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Relate convergence to age, thickness, joints and contact, cross-checking strain or load where appropriate; the designer verifies stiffness and effective width instead of multiplying one displacement by arbitrary stiffness to infer whole-ring load.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設等效線性支護k=20 MN/m、接觸後位移2 mm，反力F=kδ=40 kN；接觸前不可使用此式。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume equivalent linear support stiffness k=20 MN/m and post-contact movement 2 mm; F=kδ=40 kN, inapplicable before contact.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「支護接觸與剛度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Support contact and stiffness", which statement holds?
options: 兩個模型同樣吻合收斂曲線，就表示其力學機制相同。
較晚安裝的測點記錄較小收斂，就表示該斷面更穩定。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: Two models fitting convergence equally well necessarily use the same physical mechanism.
Smaller convergence at a later-installed section proves that section is more stable.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 支護接觸與剛度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Support contact and stiffness: testing and verification

steps.instruction: 把收斂與支護齡期、厚度、接縫及接觸檢查相連，必要時以應變或荷重資料交叉確認；設計者需驗證剛度模型及有效受力寬度，不直接將單點位移乘任意剛度當全環載重。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：有空隙時先套線性支護會高估早期反力，反之忽略成熟剛度又可能低估後期受力；收斂小也不能證明襯砌應力低。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Relate convergence to age, thickness, joints and contact, cross-checking strain or load where appropriate; the designer verifies stiffness and effective width instead of multiplying one displacement by arbitrary stiffness to infer whole-ring load. Small convergence therefore does not prove low lining stress. steps.title: 斷面橢圓化模式：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Section ovalization patterns: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「斷面橢圓化模式」如何影響隧道收斂量測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Section ovalization patterns” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel convergence monitoring”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 直徑在一方向縮短而另一方向增加，可能是橢圓化而非均勻收縮。幾何模式與接縫轉動、局部載重及圍岩不均有關，需保留整圈向量，避免單點最大值掩蓋成對變化。 假設水平直徑6.000變5.990 m、垂直變6.006 m，差異橢圓化幅16 mm；定義須固定。 僅量水平弦會漏掉頂底張開，最佳擬合圓又可能平均掉橢圓化；若因此宣稱斷面尺寸正常，接縫防水及局部彎矩風險會被忽略。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「斷面橢圓化模式」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Shortening one diameter while another grows suggests ovalization rather than uniform shrinkage. The mode depends on joint rotation, local loads and uneven ground, requiring full-perimeter vectors instead of only the largest single reading. Assume horizontal diameter changes from 6.000 to 5.990 m while vertical becomes 6.006 m; the diameter difference is 16 mm under this stated ovalization definition. A horizontal chord alone misses vertical opening, and a best-fit circle averages away ovalization. Declaring normal geometry from that fit can overlook joint-waterproofing and local bending risks. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Section ovalization patterns” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「把斷面最佳擬合成圓就能保留全部橢圓化資訊。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Fitting the section to a best-fit circle preserves all ovalization information." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「斷面橢圓化模式」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume horizontal diameter changes from 6.000 to 5.990 m while vertical becomes 6.006 m; the diameter difference is 16 mm under this stated ovalization definition. steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用多方位反射鏡或掃描斷面擬合低階變形模式，與接縫張開及裂縫位置比較；同時報告剛體平移與形狀變化，掃描配準不得將真正的低階變形吸收到座標轉換。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：僅量水平弦會漏掉頂底張開，最佳擬合圓又可能平均掉橢圓化；若因此宣稱斷面尺寸正常，接縫防水及局部彎矩風險會被忽略。
knowledge.textEn: Fit low-order modes to multiple targets or scanned profiles and compare joint opening and cracks; report rigid translation separately from shape change and prevent scan registration from absorbing genuine low-order deformation. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: A horizontal chord alone misses vertical opening, and a best-fit circle averages away ovalization. Declaring normal geometry from that fit can overlook joint-waterproofing and local bending risks.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄斷面橢圓化模式的資料來源與適用條件。用多方位反射鏡或掃描斷面擬合低階變形模式，與接縫張開及裂縫位置比較；同時報告剛體平移與形狀變化，掃描配準不得將真正的低階變形吸收到座標轉換。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for section ovalization patterns. Fit low-order modes to multiple targets or scanned profiles and compare joint opening and cracks; report rigid translation separately from shape change and prevent scan registration from absorbing genuine low-order deformation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「斷面橢圓化模式」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Section ovalization patterns"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
用多方位反射鏡或掃描斷面擬合低階變形模式，與接縫張開及裂縫位置比較；同時報告剛體平移與形狀變化，掃描配準不得將真正的低階變形吸收到座標轉換。
所有測點共同位移時，一定可以全部扣除當作基準漂移。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Fit low-order modes to multiple targets or scanned profiles and compare joint opening and cracks.

quiz.explanationEn: Fit low-order modes to multiple targets or scanned profiles and compare joint opening and cracks; report rigid translation separately from shape change and prevent scan registration from absorbing genuine low-order deformation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 斷面橢圓化模式：失效診斷

A horizontal chord alone misses vertical opening, and a best-fit circle averages away ovalization.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「資料延遲與回應」與「收斂反分析與交接」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: 資料延遲與回應：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Data latency and response: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「資料延遲與回應」如何影響隧道收斂量測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Data latency and response” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel convergence monitoring”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 自動量測的價值取決於資料到達決策者的時間，感測器頻率高卻傳輸延遲仍可能錯過趨勢。資料品質、缺測與超限必須各自有狀態，不能把沒有新資料顯示成穩定綠燈。 假設採樣5 min、傳輸延遲10 min、審查15 min，最壞單次等待尺度為30 min；未含重測時間。 伺服器重送舊數據若被當新測次，曲線會看似平穩且持續更新；沒有資料新鮮度警告時，真正加速收斂可能一直無人察覺。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「資料延遲與回應」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Automated monitoring depends on time to decision, not sensor frequency alone. High-rate acquisition with delayed transmission can miss actionable trends. Quality, missing data and exceedance need distinct states rather than presenting silence as stable green status. Assume sampling interval 5 min, transmission delay 10 min and review 15 min; a worst-case single-cycle waiting scale is 30 min, excluding remeasurement. If a server retransmits old values as new readings, the trend looks stable and continuously updated. Without a freshness warning, genuine accelerating convergence can remain undetected despite an active dashboard. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Data latency and response” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「自動監測有持續更新的畫面就代表資料必定是最新值。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A continuously updating automated display necessarily contains fresh measurements." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「資料延遲與回應」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Data latency and response”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Automated monitoring depends on time to decision, not sensor frequency alone. High-rate acquisition with delayed transmission can miss actionable trends.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：自動監測有持續更新的畫面就代表資料必定是最新值。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A continuously updating automated display necessarily contains fresh measurements. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「資料延遲與回應」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

optionsEn: Automated monitoring depends on time to decision, not sensor frequency alone.
A continuously updating automated display necessarily contains fresh measurements.

steps.title: 資料延遲與回應：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Data latency and response: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「資料延遲與回應」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Data latency and response” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設採樣5 min、傳輸延遲10 min、審查15 min，最壞單次等待尺度為30 min；未含重測時間。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume sampling interval 5 min, transmission delay 10 min and review 15 min; a worst-case single-cycle waiting scale is 30 min, excluding remeasurement. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以模擬超限和斷線資料測通知、備援與責任人確認時間，核對時間戳是否使用同一時區；監測計畫需將延遲與可能變形速率比較，回應條件由主管工程師與施工團隊核准。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Test alerts, backups and acknowledgment using simulated exceedance and dropout, checking a common timestamp zone; compare latency with plausible movement rate and obtain engineering and construction approval of the response conditions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「資料延遲與回應」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Data latency and response"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
收斂對時間增加必定代表潛變，與掌子面推進無關。
以模擬超限和斷線資料測通知、備援與責任人確認時間，核對時間戳是否使用同一時區；監測計畫需將延遲與可能變形速率比較，回應條件由主管工程師與施工團隊核准。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Increasing convergence with time necessarily indicates creep unrelated to face advance.
Test alerts, backups and acknowledgment using simulated exceedance and dropout, checking a common timestamp zone.
quiz.explanation: 以模擬超限和斷線資料測通知、備援與責任人確認時間，核對時間戳是否使用同一時區；監測計畫需將延遲與可能變形速率比較，回應條件由主管工程師與施工團隊核准。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Test alerts, backups and acknowledgment using simulated exceedance and dropout, checking a common timestamp zone; compare latency with plausible movement rate and obtain engineering and construction approval of the response conditions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 資料延遲與回應：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Data latency and response: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「資料延遲與回應」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Data latency and response” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 伺服器重送舊數據若被當新測次，曲線會看似平穩且持續更新；沒有資料新鮮度警告時，真正加速收斂可能一直無人察覺。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If a server retransmits old values as new readings, the trend looks stable and continuously updated. Without a freshness warning, genuine accelerating convergence can remain undetected despite an active dashboard. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：伺服器重送舊數據若被當新測次，曲線會看似平穩且持續更新；沒有資料新鮮度警告時，真正加速收斂可能一直無人察覺。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Without a freshness warning, genuine accelerating convergence can remain undetected despite an active dashboard.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「自動監測有持續更新的畫面就代表資料必定是最新值。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A continuously updating automated display necessarily contains fresh measurements." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 伺服器重送舊數據若被當新測次，曲線會看似平穩且持續更新；沒有資料新鮮度警告時，真正加速收斂可能一直無人察覺。
knowledge.textEn: If a server retransmits old values as new readings, the trend looks stable and continuously updated. Without a freshness warning, genuine accelerating convergence can remain undetected despite an active dashboard.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「資料延遲與回應」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Data latency and response" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 伺服器重送舊數據若被當新測次，曲線會看似平穩且持續更新；沒有資料新鮮度警告時，真正加速收斂可能一直無人察覺。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
兩個模型同樣吻合收斂曲線，就表示其力學機制相同。
optionsEn: If a server retransmits old values as new readings, the trend looks stable and continuously updated.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Two models fitting convergence equally well necessarily use the same physical mechanism.
quiz.explanation: 伺服器重送舊數據若被當新測次，曲線會看似平穩且持續更新；沒有資料新鮮度警告時，真正加速收斂可能一直無人察覺。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If a server retransmits old values as new readings, the trend looks stable and continuously updated. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 收斂反分析與交接：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Convergence back-analysis and handover: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「收斂反分析與交接」如何影響隧道收斂量測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Convergence back-analysis and handover” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel convergence monitoring”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 位移反分析可能由不同剛度與荷重組合得到相似曲線，故參數不一定唯一。應結合地質、支護應變及施工時序限制解空間，交接報告保留可替代解釋，讓後續工程知道哪些推論仍需驗證。 假設模型A與B都預測10 mm但實測10.5 mm，兩者殘差皆0.5 mm；相同擬合誤差不能證明機制相同。 用同一曲線調參又宣稱驗證會高估預測力，僅靠位移擬合可能選中錯誤荷重路徑；新地層或新支護階段一出現，模型便失去可靠性。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「收斂反分析與交接」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Different stiffness-load combinations can fit similar convergence histories, making back-analysis nonunique. Geology, support strain and construction sequence constrain solutions; handover retains alternative interpretations and identifies what still requires verification. If assumed models A and B predict 10 mm against 10.5 mm observed, both residuals are 0.5 mm; equal fit error does not establish the same mechanism. Calibrating and validating on the same curve exaggerates predictive ability. Displacement-only fitting may select the wrong load path and fail as soon as geology or the support stage changes. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Convergence back-analysis and handover” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩個模型同樣吻合收斂曲線，就表示其力學機制相同。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two models fitting convergence equally well necessarily use the same physical mechanism." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「收斂反分析與交接」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Convergence back-analysis and handover”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 收斂反分析與交接
knowledge.text: 位移反分析可能由不同剛度與荷重組合得到相似曲線，故參數不一定唯一。應結合地質、支護應變及施工時序限制解空間，交接報告保留可替代解釋，讓後續工程知道哪些推論仍需驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Different stiffness-load combinations can fit similar convergence histories, making back-analysis nonunique. Geology, support strain and construction sequence constrain solutions; handover retains alternative interpretations and identifies what still requires verification.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩個模型同樣吻合收斂曲線，就表示其力學機制相同。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Two models fitting convergence equally well necessarily use the same physical mechanism. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「收斂反分析與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Convergence back-analysis and handover" is correct?
options: 兩個模型同樣吻合收斂曲線，就表示其力學機制相同。
位移反分析可能由不同剛度與荷重組合得到相似曲線，故參數不一定唯一。
兩點間弦長不變就證明兩個測點都沒有移動。
optionsEn: Two models fitting convergence equally well necessarily use the same physical mechanism.
Different stiffness-load combinations can fit similar convergence histories, making back-analysis nonunique.
An unchanged chord proves that neither of its endpoints has moved.
quiz.explanation: 位移反分析可能由不同剛度與荷重組合得到相似曲線，故參數不一定唯一。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Different stiffness-load combinations can fit similar convergence histories, making back-analysis nonunique. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 收斂反分析與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Convergence back-analysis and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「收斂反分析與交接」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Convergence back-analysis and handover” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設模型A與B都預測10 mm但實測10.5 mm，兩者殘差皆0.5 mm；相同擬合誤差不能證明機制相同。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If assumed models A and B predict 10 mm against 10.5 mm observed, both residuals are 0.5 mm; equal fit error does not establish the same mechanism. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：保留校準用與獨立驗證用斷面，檢查模型能否預測未參與擬合的時間或位置；交接量測原始檔、參數範圍與失效條件，由設計及監測負責人共同確認可外推範圍。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Separate calibration and independent validation sections and test predictions at unused times or locations; hand over raw measurements, parameter ranges and invalidation conditions for joint design and monitoring approval of extrapolation limits.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設模型A與B都預測10 mm但實測10.5 mm，兩者殘差皆0.5 mm；相同擬合誤差不能證明機制相同。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If assumed models A and B predict 10 mm against 10.5 mm observed, both residuals are 0.5 mm; equal fit error does not establish the same mechanism.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「收斂反分析與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Convergence back-analysis and handover", which statement holds?
options: 全測站角度精度固定，所以位置誤差與觀測距離無關。
所有測點共同位移時，一定可以全部扣除當作基準漂移。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: Fixed total-station angular precision makes positional error independent of sight distance.
Common movement of all targets can always be subtracted as reference drift.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 收斂反分析與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Convergence back-analysis and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「收斂反分析與交接」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Convergence back-analysis and handover” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 保留校準用與獨立驗證用斷面，檢查模型能否預測未參與擬合的時間或位置；交接量測原始檔、參數範圍與失效條件，由設計及監測負責人共同確認可外推範圍。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：用同一曲線調參又宣稱驗證會高估預測力，僅靠位移擬合可能選中錯誤荷重路徑；新地層或新支護階段一出現，模型便失去可靠性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Separate calibration and independent validation sections and test predictions at unused times or locations; hand over raw measurements, parameter ranges and invalidation conditions for joint design and monitoring approval of extrapolation limits. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Calibrating and validating on the same curve exaggerates predictive ability. Displacement-only fitting may select the wrong load path and fail as soon as geology or the support stage changes. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄收斂反分析與交接的資料來源與適用條件。保留校準用與獨立驗證用斷面，檢查模型能否預測未參與擬合的時間或位置；交接量測原始檔、參數範圍與失效條件，由設計及監測負責人共同確認可外推範圍。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for convergence back-analysis and handover. Separate calibration and independent validation sections and test predictions at unused times or locations; hand over raw measurements, parameter ranges and invalidation conditions for joint design and monitoring approval of extrapolation limits.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：用同一曲線調參又宣稱驗證會高估預測力，僅靠位移擬合可能選中錯誤荷重路徑；新地層或新支護階段一出現，模型便失去可靠性。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Calibrating and validating on the same curve exaggerates predictive ability. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instruction: 用同一曲線調參又宣稱驗證會高估預測力，僅靠位移擬合可能選中錯誤荷重路徑；新地層或新支護階段一出現，模型便失去可靠性。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrating and validating on the same curve exaggerates predictive ability. Displacement-only fitting may select the wrong load path and fail as soon as geology or the support stage changes. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：用同一曲線調參又宣稱驗證會高估預測力，僅靠位移擬合可能選中錯誤荷重路徑；新地層或新支護階段一出現，模型便失去可靠性。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Displacement-only fitting may select the wrong load path and fail as soon as geology or the support stage changes.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩個模型同樣吻合收斂曲線，就表示其力學機制相同。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Two models fitting convergence equally well necessarily use the same physical mechanism." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 用同一曲線調參又宣稱驗證會高估預測力，僅靠位移擬合可能選中錯誤荷重路徑；新地層或新支護階段一出現，模型便失去可靠性。
knowledge.textEn: Calibrating and validating on the same curve exaggerates predictive ability. Displacement-only fitting may select the wrong load path and fail as soon as geology or the support stage changes.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「收斂反分析與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Convergence back-analysis and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
用同一曲線調參又宣稱驗證會高估預測力，僅靠位移擬合可能選中錯誤荷重路徑；新地層或新支護階段一出現，模型便失去可靠性。
兩點間弦長不變就證明兩個測點都沒有移動。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Calibrating and validating on the same curve exaggerates predictive ability.
An unchanged chord proves that neither of its endpoints has moved.
quiz.explanation: 用同一曲線調參又宣稱驗證會高估預測力，僅靠位移擬合可能選中錯誤荷重路徑；新地層或新支護階段一出現，模型便失去可靠性。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Calibrating and validating on the same curve exaggerates predictive ability. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 掌子面攝影測量
summary: 本課聚焦以影像幾何、尺度控制與獨立檢核重建可追溯的掌子面模型。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。
summaryEn: This course focuses on reconstruct a traceable face model through image geometry, scale control and independent checks. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設距離5 m、像素5 μm、焦距25 mm，GSD=Zp/f=1 mm/pixel；非三維精度保證。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設Z=5 m、f=5000 pixel、B=1 m、視差誤差0.5 pixel，σZ≈Z²σd/(fB)=2.5 mm。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume range 5 m, pixel pitch 5 μm and focal length 25 mm; GSD=Zp/f=1 mm/pixel, not a guarantee of three-dimensional accuracy. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume Z=5 m, f=5000 pixels, B=1 m and disparity error 0.5 pixel; σZ≈Z²σd/(fB)=2.5 mm. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「像素尺度與可見細節」與「立體基線與深度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Pixel scale and visible detail" and "Stereo baseline and depth": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 像素尺度與可見細節：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pixel scale and visible detail: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「像素尺度與可見細節」如何影響掌子面攝影測量的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pixel scale and visible detail” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel-face photogrammetry”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 地面取樣距離由距離、像素尺寸與焦距決定，像素小不等於實際幾何精度高。鏡頭模糊、影像雜訊及岩面紋理會限制可辨特徵，裂隙寬度低於有效分辨率時只能記為未解析。 假設距離5 m、像素5 μm、焦距25 mm，GSD=Zp/f=1 mm/pixel；非三維精度保證。 放大影像或提高輸出點數不會增加原始資訊，若把插值表面當成實測細節，可能畫出不存在的薄層或誤判節理是否閉合。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「像素尺度與可見細節」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ground sampling distance depends on range, pixel size and focal length, but small pixels do not ensure accurate geometry. Blur, noise and rock texture limit discernible features, and subresolution cracks must remain unresolved. Assume range 5 m, pixel pitch 5 μm and focal length 25 mm; GSD=Zp/f=1 mm/pixel, not a guarantee of three-dimensional accuracy. Enlargement and denser output do not create source information. Treating an interpolated surface as measured detail can invent thin layers or misclassify whether a discontinuity is closed. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pixel scale and visible detail” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「增加輸出點雲數量可以創造原始照片沒有的細節。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Increasing output point count creates detail absent from the original photographs." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「像素尺度與可見細節」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Pixel scale and visible detail”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 像素尺度與可見細節
knowledge.text: 地面取樣距離由距離、像素尺寸與焦距決定，像素小不等於實際幾何精度高。鏡頭模糊、影像雜訊及岩面紋理會限制可辨特徵，裂隙寬度低於有效分辨率時只能記為未解析。
knowledge.textEn: Ground sampling distance depends on range, pixel size and focal length, but small pixels do not ensure accurate geometry. Blur, noise and rock texture limit discernible features, and subresolution cracks must remain unresolved.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：增加輸出點雲數量可以創造原始照片沒有的細節。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Increasing output point count creates detail absent from the original photographs. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「像素尺度與可見細節」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pixel scale and visible detail" is correct?
options: 增加輸出點雲數量可以創造原始照片沒有的細節。
地面取樣距離由距離、像素尺寸與焦距決定，像素小不等於實際幾何精度高。
所有照片在同一位置拍得越多，深度精度就一定越高。
optionsEn: Increasing output point count creates detail absent from the original photographs.
Ground sampling distance depends on range, pixel size and focal length, but small pixels do not ensure accurate geometry.
Taking more photographs from one position necessarily improves depth accuracy.
quiz.explanation: 地面取樣距離由距離、像素尺寸與焦距決定，像素小不等於實際幾何精度高。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Ground sampling distance depends on range, pixel size and focal length, but small pixels do not ensure accurate geometry. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 像素尺度與可見細節：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pixel scale and visible detail: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「像素尺度與可見細節」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pixel scale and visible detail” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設距離5 m、像素5 μm、焦距25 mm，GSD=Zp/f=1 mm/pixel；非三維精度保證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume range 5 m, pixel pitch 5 μm and focal length 25 mm; GSD=Zp/f=1 mm/pixel, not a guarantee of three-dimensional accuracy. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用已知尺度標記檢查影像實際取樣距離，觀察岩面細紋是否清晰；把像素尺度與獨立檢核點誤差分開報告，避免把輸出點雲密度當成可辨識裂隙寬度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check actual image scale with known targets and inspect fine surface texture; report pixel spacing separately from independent checkpoint error rather than treating point-cloud density as resolved fracture width.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設距離5 m、像素5 μm、焦距25 mm，GSD=Zp/f=1 mm/pixel；非三維精度保證。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume range 5 m, pixel pitch 5 μm and focal length 25 mm; GSD=Zp/f=1 mm/pixel, not a guarantee of three-dimensional accuracy.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「像素尺度與可見細節」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pixel scale and visible detail", which statement holds?
options: 一根比例尺就足以完全控制整個模型的三維形狀。
自動補成封閉網格就代表所有背面都已實際觀測。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: One scale bar fully constrains the entire model's three-dimensional shape.
Automatic mesh closure means every hidden back surface has actually been observed.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 像素尺度與可見細節：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pixel scale and visible detail: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「像素尺度與可見細節」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pixel scale and visible detail” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用已知尺度標記檢查影像實際取樣距離，觀察岩面細紋是否清晰；把像素尺度與獨立檢核點誤差分開報告，避免把輸出點雲密度當成可辨識裂隙寬度。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：放大影像或提高輸出點數不會增加原始資訊，若把插值表面當成實測細節，可能畫出不存在的薄層或誤判節理是否閉合。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check actual image scale with known targets and inspect fine surface texture; report pixel spacing separately from independent checkpoint error rather than treating point-cloud density as resolved fracture width. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Enlargement and denser output do not create source information. Treating an interpolated surface as measured detail can invent thin layers or misclassify whether a discontinuity is closed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄像素尺度與可見細節的資料來源與適用條件。用已知尺度標記檢查影像實際取樣距離，觀察岩面細紋是否清晰；把像素尺度與獨立檢核點誤差分開報告，避免把輸出點雲密度當成可辨識裂隙寬度。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for pixel scale and visible detail. Check actual image scale with known targets and inspect fine surface texture; report pixel spacing separately from independent checkpoint error rather than treating point-cloud density as resolved fracture width.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：放大影像或提高輸出點數不會增加原始資訊，若把插值表面當成實測細節，可能畫出不存在的薄層或誤判節理是否閉合。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Enlargement and denser output do not create source information. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用已知尺度標記檢查影像實際取樣距離，觀察岩面細紋是否清晰；把像素尺度與獨立檢核點誤差分開報告，避免把輸出點雲密度當成可辨識裂隙寬度。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：放大影像或提高輸出點數不會增加原始資訊，若把插值表面當成實測細節，可能畫出不存在的薄層或誤判節理是否閉合。
knowledge.textEn: Check actual image scale with known targets and inspect fine surface texture; report pixel spacing separately from independent checkpoint error rather than treating point-cloud density as resolved fracture width. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Enlargement and denser output do not create source information. Treating an interpolated surface as measured detail can invent thin layers or misclassify whether a discontinuity is closed.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄像素尺度與可見細節的資料來源與適用條件。用已知尺度標記檢查影像實際取樣距離，觀察岩面細紋是否清晰；把像素尺度與獨立檢核點誤差分開報告，避免把輸出點雲密度當成可辨識裂隙寬度。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for pixel scale and visible detail. Check actual image scale with known targets and inspect fine surface texture; report pixel spacing separately from independent checkpoint error rather than treating point-cloud density as resolved fracture width.

quiz.question: 要驗證「像素尺度與可見細節」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pixel scale and visible detail"?
options: 用已知尺度標記檢查影像實際取樣距離，觀察岩面細紋是否清晰；把像素尺度與獨立檢核點誤差分開報告，避免把輸出點雲密度當成可辨識裂隙寬度。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
跨越兩個節理面擬合的平均平面就是現場的真實節理。
optionsEn: Check actual image scale with known targets and inspect fine surface texture.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The average plane fitted across two joints is a real joint surface in the ground.
quiz.explanation: 用已知尺度標記檢查影像實際取樣距離，觀察岩面細紋是否清晰；把像素尺度與獨立檢核點誤差分開報告，避免把輸出點雲密度當成可辨識裂隙寬度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check actual image scale with known targets and inspect fine surface texture; report pixel spacing separately from independent checkpoint error rather than treating point-cloud density as resolved fracture width. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 像素尺度與可見細節：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pixel scale and visible detail: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「像素尺度與可見細節」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pixel scale and visible detail” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 放大影像或提高輸出點數不會增加原始資訊，若把插值表面當成實測細節，可能畫出不存在的薄層或誤判節理是否閉合。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Enlargement and denser output do not create source information. Treating an interpolated surface as measured detail can invent thin layers or misclassify whether a discontinuity is closed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：放大影像或提高輸出點數不會增加原始資訊，若把插值表面當成實測細節，可能畫出不存在的薄層或誤判節理是否閉合。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Treating an interpolated surface as measured detail can invent thin layers or misclassify whether a discontinuity is closed.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「增加輸出點雲數量可以創造原始照片沒有的細節。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Increasing output point count creates detail absent from the original photographs." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 放大影像或提高輸出點數不會增加原始資訊，若把插值表面當成實測細節，可能畫出不存在的薄層或誤判節理是否閉合。
knowledge.textEn: Enlargement and denser output do not create source information. Treating an interpolated surface as measured detail can invent thin layers or misclassify whether a discontinuity is closed.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「像素尺度與可見細節」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pixel scale and visible detail" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
放大影像或提高輸出點數不會增加原始資訊，若把插值表面當成實測細節，可能畫出不存在的薄層或誤判節理是否閉合。
所有照片在同一位置拍得越多，深度精度就一定越高。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Enlargement and denser output do not create source information.
Taking more photographs from one position necessarily improves depth accuracy.
quiz.explanation: 放大影像或提高輸出點數不會增加原始資訊，若把插值表面當成實測細節，可能畫出不存在的薄層或誤判節理是否閉合。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Enlargement and denser output do not create source information. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 立體基線與深度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Stereo baseline and depth: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「立體基線與深度」如何影響掌子面攝影測量的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stereo baseline and depth” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel-face photogrammetry”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 不同視點的視差提供深度，基線過小使深度對像點誤差非常敏感，過大則減少共同可見紋理。拍攝幾何需要兼顧角度交會與遮擋，單純增加照片數不能補救全部來自同一位置。 假設Z=5 m、f=5000 pixel、B=1 m、視差誤差0.5 pixel，σZ≈Z²σd/(fB)=2.5 mm。 低視差影像仍可產生平滑漂亮點雲，但深度可能整體漂移；若因此估算超挖或節理面方向，幾何弱點會直接轉成工程判斷偏差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「立體基線與深度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Parallax from different viewpoints yields depth. A short baseline amplifies image error, while a long one loses common texture. Geometry must balance intersection angle and occlusion; many photographs from one position do not solve the problem. Assume Z=5 m, f=5000 pixels, B=1 m and disparity error 0.5 pixel; σZ≈Z²σd/(fB)=2.5 mm. Low-parallax imagery can yield an attractive smooth cloud with biased depth. Overbreak estimates and joint orientations derived from it inherit the poorly constrained geometry rather than reliable engineering evidence. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Stereo baseline and depth” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有照片在同一位置拍得越多，深度精度就一定越高。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Taking more photographs from one position necessarily improves depth accuracy." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「立體基線與深度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Taking more photographs from one position necessarily improves depth accuracy. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「立體基線與深度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Stereo baseline and depth" is correct?

重投影誤差很低就保證鏡頭畸變和物面曲率已正確分離。
不同視點的視差提供深度，基線過小使深度對像點誤差非常敏感，過大則減少共同可見紋理。
optionsEn: Taking more photographs from one position necessarily improves depth accuracy.
Low reprojection error guarantees correct separation of lens distortion and surface curvature.
Parallax from different viewpoints yields depth.
quiz.explanation: 不同視點的視差提供深度，基線過小使深度對像點誤差非常敏感，過大則減少共同可見紋理。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 立體基線與深度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stereo baseline and depth: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「立體基線與深度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Stereo baseline and depth” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設Z=5 m、f=5000 pixel、B=1 m、視差誤差0.5 pixel，σZ≈Z²σd/(fB)=2.5 mm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume Z=5 m, f=5000 pixels, B=1 m and disparity error 0.5 pixel; σZ≈Z²σd/(fB)=2.5 mm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：繪製相機位置與連接網，檢查是否存在足夠交會角和共同特徵；以未參與解算的深度檢核點測試模型，若深度誤差顯著大於平面誤差，先查幾何而非只調演算法參數。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Inspect camera positions and tie connections for adequate intersection angles and shared features; test depth with unused checkpoints, investigating acquisition geometry before algorithm tuning when depth errors greatly exceed lateral errors.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設Z=5 m、f=5000 pixel、B=1 m、視差誤差0.5 pixel，σZ≈Z²σd/(fB)=2.5 mm。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume Z=5 m, f=5000 pixels, B=1 m and disparity error 0.5 pixel; σZ≈Z²σd/(fB)=2.5 mm.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

steps.title: 立體基線與深度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stereo baseline and depth: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「立體基線與深度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Stereo baseline and depth” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 繪製相機位置與連接網，檢查是否存在足夠交會角和共同特徵；以未參與解算的深度檢核點測試模型，若深度誤差顯著大於平面誤差，先查幾何而非只調演算法參數。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：低視差影像仍可產生平滑漂亮點雲，但深度可能整體漂移；若因此估算超挖或節理面方向，幾何弱點會直接轉成工程判斷偏差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「相機校準與畸變」與「尺度與控制點布置」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: 相機校準與畸變：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Camera calibration and distortion: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「相機校準與畸變」如何影響掌子面攝影測量的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Camera calibration and distortion” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel-face photogrammetry”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 焦距、主點與鏡頭畸變共同控制射線方向，自校準需要足夠幾何多樣性才能辨識。全部照片近似共面或相機變焦，容易讓畸變與地表彎曲互相補償，形成看似低殘差的錯誤模型。 假設徑向畸變模型Δr=k1r³，r=1000 pixel、k1=10⁻⁹ pixel⁻²，Δr=1 pixel；單位須一致。 將不同變焦狀態合成同一相機模型會扭曲比例，強行過擬合畸變又會吸收真正岩面起伏；兩者都可能在控制點附近看似準確而邊緣失真。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「相機校準與畸變」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Focal length, principal point and distortion govern rays. Self-calibration needs geometric diversity; near-planar views or changing zoom can trade lens distortion against surface curvature, producing a wrong model with low residuals. For assumed radial distortion Δr=k1r³ with r=1000 pixels and k1=10⁻⁹ pixel⁻², Δr=1 pixel; units must remain consistent. Combining zoom states under one camera model distorts scale, while overfitted distortion absorbs genuine relief. Both can look accurate near controls yet deform the edges of the face model. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Camera calibration and distortion” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「重投影誤差很低就保證鏡頭畸變和物面曲率已正確分離。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Low reprojection error guarantees correct separation of lens distortion and surface curvature." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「相機校準與畸變」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.textEn: Focal length, principal point and distortion govern rays. Self-calibration needs geometric diversity; near-planar views or changing zoom can trade lens distortion against surface curvature, producing a wrong model with low residuals.

knowledge.text: 誤解：重投影誤差很低就保證鏡頭畸變和物面曲率已正確分離。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Low reprojection error guarantees correct separation of lens distortion and surface curvature. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「相機校準與畸變」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

Low reprojection error guarantees correct separation of lens distortion and surface curvature.
One scale bar fully constrains the entire model's three-dimensional shape.

steps.title: 相機校準與畸變：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Camera calibration and distortion: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「相機校準與畸變」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Camera calibration and distortion” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設徑向畸變模型Δr=k1r³，r=1000 pixel、k1=10⁻⁹ pixel⁻²，Δr=1 pixel；單位須一致。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed radial distortion Δr=k1r³ with r=1000 pixels and k1=10⁻⁹ pixel⁻², Δr=1 pixel; units must remain consistent. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：固定焦距與對焦狀態並保留原始EXIF，對照校準板及不同方位影像；檢查像面殘差是否呈徑向系統圖樣，獨立檢核仍有曲面偏差時，不以低重投影誤差直接驗收。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Fix and document focal and focus state with original EXIF, comparing calibration targets and varied views; inspect radial residual patterns and do not accept low reprojection error when independent checks retain systematic surface curvature.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 相機校準與畸變：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Camera calibration and distortion: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「相機校準與畸變」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Camera calibration and distortion” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 固定焦距與對焦狀態並保留原始EXIF，對照校準板及不同方位影像；檢查像面殘差是否呈徑向系統圖樣，獨立檢核仍有曲面偏差時，不以低重投影誤差直接驗收。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：將不同變焦狀態合成同一相機模型會扭曲比例，強行過擬合畸變又會吸收真正岩面起伏；兩者都可能在控制點附近看似準確而邊緣失真。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Fix and document focal and focus state with original EXIF, comparing calibration targets and varied views; inspect radial residual patterns and do not accept low reprojection error when independent checks retain systematic surface curvature. Both can look accurate near controls yet deform the edges of the face model. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

options: 將不同變焦狀態合成同一相機模型會扭曲比例，強行過擬合畸變又會吸收真正岩面起伏；兩者都可能在控制點附近看似準確而邊緣失真。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
一根比例尺就足以完全控制整個模型的三維形狀。
optionsEn: Combining zoom states under one camera model distorts scale, while overfitted distortion absorbs genuine relief.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
One scale bar fully constrains the entire model's three-dimensional shape.
quiz.explanation: 將不同變焦狀態合成同一相機模型會扭曲比例，強行過擬合畸變又會吸收真正岩面起伏；兩者都可能在控制點附近看似準確而邊緣失真。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Combining zoom states under one camera model distorts scale, while overfitted distortion absorbs genuine relief. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 尺度與控制點布置：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Scale and control distribution: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「尺度與控制點布置」如何影響掌子面攝影測量的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Scale and control distribution” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel-face photogrammetry”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 影像匹配本身只決定相對幾何，實際尺寸與方向需由可靠控制資訊固定。控制點若全擠在一角，模型其他區域仍可能傾斜或彎曲，應分布於可觀測範圍並保留獨立檢核點。 假設真實標距2.000 m被重建為1.990 m，尺度修正2.000/1.990=1.00503；仍不能修正局部翹曲。 只用一根比例尺可固定尺度卻不能充分控制三維姿態，控制點錯標又可能使整個模型鏡射或扭轉；平均殘差小仍可能藏住局部大誤差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「尺度與控制點布置」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Image matching determines relative geometry; reliable control establishes dimensions and orientation. Controls clustered in one corner leave other areas free to tilt or warp, so distribute them across the observable region and reserve independent checks. An assumed true distance 2.000 m reconstructed as 1.990 m requires scale factor 1.00503; that factor cannot correct local warping. One scale bar fixes scale without fully constraining pose, and mislabeled controls may twist or mirror the model. Small average residuals can still conceal large local errors beyond the controlled region. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Scale and control distribution” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「一根比例尺就足以完全控制整個模型的三維形狀。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One scale bar fully constrains the entire model's three-dimensional shape." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「尺度與控制點布置」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Scale and control distribution”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 尺度與控制點布置
knowledge.text: 影像匹配本身只決定相對幾何，實際尺寸與方向需由可靠控制資訊固定。控制點若全擠在一角，模型其他區域仍可能傾斜或彎曲，應分布於可觀測範圍並保留獨立檢核點。
knowledge.textEn: Image matching determines relative geometry; reliable control establishes dimensions and orientation. Controls clustered in one corner leave other areas free to tilt or warp, so distribute them across the observable region and reserve independent checks.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：一根比例尺就足以完全控制整個模型的三維形狀。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One scale bar fully constrains the entire model's three-dimensional shape. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「尺度與控制點布置」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Scale and control distribution" is correct?
options: 一根比例尺就足以完全控制整個模型的三維形狀。
影像匹配本身只決定相對幾何，實際尺寸與方向需由可靠控制資訊固定。

optionsEn: One scale bar fully constrains the entire model's three-dimensional shape.
Image matching determines relative geometry; reliable control establishes dimensions and orientation.
Wet-wall highlights can be treated as fixed texture in every viewing direction.
quiz.explanation: 影像匹配本身只決定相對幾何，實際尺寸與方向需由可靠控制資訊固定。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
