Build parameter tables from stratigraphy, groundwater and drainage conditions, explicitly labeling total- or effective-stress analysis; review water accounting to ensure it appears once and test a plausible groundwater range.

quiz.question: 要驗證「總應力與有效應力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Total and effective stress"?
options: 以分層地質、地下水與試驗排水條件建立參數表，將模型採總應力或有效應力明確標示；設計審查逐項追查水壓是否只計一次，並用合理水位範圍測敏感度。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
高透水砂只占小面積，就一定只造成同等比例風險。
optionsEn: Build parameter tables from stratigraphy, groundwater and drainage conditions, explicitly labeling total- or effective-stress analysis.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A small permeable sand area necessarily contributes only that proportional share of risk.
quiz.explanation: 以分層地質、地下水與試驗排水條件建立參數表，將模型採總應力或有效應力明確標示；設計審查逐項追查水壓是否只計一次，並用合理水位範圍測敏感度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Build parameter tables from stratigraphy, groundwater and drainage conditions, explicitly labeling total- or effective-stress analysis; review water accounting to ensure it appears once and test a plausible groundwater range. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 總應力與有效應力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Total and effective stress: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「總應力與有效應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Total and effective stress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將不排水強度與排水摩擦角混在同一破壞面會失去物理一致，重複扣孔壓則低估有效約束；算式看似完整卻不能支援可靠穩定判斷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mixing undrained strength with drained friction on one failure surface breaks physical consistency. Subtracting pressure twice underestimates confinement, leaving a complete-looking calculation without a defensible stability interpretation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：將不排水強度與排水摩擦角混在同一破壞面會失去物理一致，重複扣孔壓則低估有效約束；算式看似完整卻不能支援可靠穩定判斷。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Subtracting pressure twice underestimates confinement, leaving a complete-looking calculation without a defensible stability interpretation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「不排水強度和排水摩擦角可不分條件地混在同一模型。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Undrained strength and drained friction can be mixed unconditionally in one model." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將不排水強度與排水摩擦角混在同一破壞面會失去物理一致，重複扣孔壓則低估有效約束；算式看似完整卻不能支援可靠穩定判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Mixing undrained strength with drained friction on one failure surface breaks physical consistency. Subtracting pressure twice underestimates confinement, leaving a complete-looking calculation without a defensible stability interpretation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「總應力與有效應力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Total and effective stress" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
將不排水強度與排水摩擦角混在同一破壞面會失去物理一致，重複扣孔壓則低估有效約束；算式看似完整卻不能支援可靠穩定判斷。
一個底部壓力計正常就代表整個掌子面支護都足夠。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Mixing undrained strength with drained friction on one failure surface breaks physical consistency.
A normal invert pressure reading proves adequate support over the entire face.
quiz.explanation: 將不排水強度與排水摩擦角混在同一破壞面會失去物理一致，重複扣孔壓則低估有效約束；算式看似完整卻不能支援可靠穩定判斷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Mixing undrained strength with drained friction on one failure surface breaks physical consistency. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 壓力梯度與高度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pressure gradient with height: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「壓力梯度與高度」如何影響軟土潛盾開挖面穩定分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pressure gradient with height” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Face-stability analysis for soft-ground shields”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 倉內支護介質有自重，頂部與底部壓力不同，而地層與水壓梯度也未必相同。只控制單一感測器讀值不能保證全掌子面均衡，必須把所有讀值換算到共同高度再比較分布。 假設介質密度1500 kg/m³、垂直高差6 m，Δp=ρgΔz=88.29 kPa；非整面穩定所需壓差。 以底部壓力代表頂部會高估頂拱支護，密度分層又使線性換算失準；局部失穩可能在平均壓力看似正常時開始，不能只盯總平均。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「壓力梯度與高度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Support medium has weight, creating different crown and invert pressures, while soil and groundwater gradients may differ. One sensor does not prove full-face balance; readings need a common elevation and a distribution comparison. For assumed medium density 1500 kg/m³ and vertical difference 6 m, Δp=ρgΔz=88.29 kPa; this is not the required stability-pressure range. Using invert pressure for the crown overstates crown support, while density stratification invalidates a linear conversion. Local instability can begin with a normal-looking mean pressure, making averages insufficient. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pressure gradient with height” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「一個底部壓力計正常就代表整個掌子面支護都足夠。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A normal invert pressure reading proves adequate support over the entire face." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「壓力梯度與高度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Pressure gradient with height”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 壓力梯度與高度
knowledge.text: 倉內支護介質有自重，頂部與底部壓力不同，而地層與水壓梯度也未必相同。只控制單一感測器讀值不能保證全掌子面均衡，必須把所有讀值換算到共同高度再比較分布。
knowledge.textEn: Support medium has weight, creating different crown and invert pressures, while soil and groundwater gradients may differ. One sensor does not prove full-face balance; readings need a common elevation and a distribution comparison.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：一個底部壓力計正常就代表整個掌子面支護都足夠。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A normal invert pressure reading proves adequate support over the entire face. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「壓力梯度與高度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pressure gradient with height" is correct?
options: 一個底部壓力計正常就代表整個掌子面支護都足夠。
支護壓力越高越安全，不必考慮淺覆土上舉。
倉內支護介質有自重，頂部與底部壓力不同，而地層與水壓梯度也未必相同。
optionsEn: A normal invert pressure reading proves adequate support over the entire face.
Higher support pressure is always safer without considering shallow-cover uplift.
Support medium has weight, creating different crown and invert pressures, while soil and groundwater gradients may differ.
quiz.explanation: 倉內支護介質有自重，頂部與底部壓力不同，而地層與水壓梯度也未必相同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Support medium has weight, creating different crown and invert pressures, while soil and groundwater gradients may differ. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 壓力梯度與高度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pressure gradient with height: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「壓力梯度與高度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pressure gradient with height” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設介質密度1500 kg/m³、垂直高差6 m，Δp=ρgΔz=88.29 kPa；非整面穩定所需壓差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed medium density 1500 kg/m³ and vertical difference 6 m, Δp=ρgΔz=88.29 kPa; this is not the required stability-pressure range. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對壓力計高程、零點與介質密度，將多高度讀值畫成梯度並對照理論；若梯度異常需查分層、氣泡或堵塞，經設計及設備主管評估後才可解讀成地層壓力變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check sensor elevation, zero and medium density, plotting multiheight readings against the expected gradient; investigate segregation, air or blockage before design and equipment leads interpret an anomaly as changing ground pressure.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設介質密度1500 kg/m³、垂直高差6 m，Δp=ρgΔz=88.29 kPa；非整面穩定所需壓差。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed medium density 1500 kg/m³ and vertical difference 6 m, Δp=ρgΔz=88.29 kPa; this is not the required stability-pressure range.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「壓力梯度與高度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pressure gradient with height", which statement holds?
options: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
只要土倉壓力正常，就可假設泥膜永遠完整不透水。
停止推進後土倉壓力和改良土性質會永遠保持不變。
optionsEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
Normal chamber pressure permits assuming an eternally intact impermeable filter cake.
Chamber pressure and conditioned-soil properties remain unchanged forever after advance stops.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.instruction: 以底部壓力代表頂部會高估頂拱支護，密度分層又使線性換算失準；局部失穩可能在平均壓力看似正常時開始，不能只盯總平均。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「覆土與上舉邊界」與「不排水穩定比值」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cover and uplift boundaries" and "Undrained stability index": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 覆土與上舉邊界：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cover and uplift boundaries: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「覆土與上舉邊界」如何影響軟土潛盾開挖面穩定分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cover and uplift boundaries” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Face-stability analysis for soft-ground shields”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 支護不足可能造成坍入，過大壓力也可能推動淺覆土上舉或形成逸流。穩定分析需要上下兩側機制而不是只求最低值，鄰近地面荷載與弱層會改變可行範圍。 假設均質覆土重度18 kN/m³、厚8 m，自重應力144 kPa；此量級檢查未計拱效應、黏聚或水。 只提高支護壓力來追求防坍會忽略上舉與地表噴出路徑，薄弱夾層可能先被打通；若未有上限機制分析，控制策略就缺少另一半。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「覆土與上舉邊界」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Insufficient support can cause collapse, while excessive pressure may lift shallow cover or create escape paths. Analysis needs both lower and upper mechanisms, with surface loads and weak layers affecting the feasible interval. Assumed uniform cover unit weight 18 kN/m³ over 8 m gives 144 kPa overburden; this scale check excludes arching, cohesion and water. Increasing pressure solely to prevent collapse ignores uplift and surface escape paths, which may open along weak layers. Without an upper-bound mechanism the control concept remains fundamentally incomplete. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cover and uplift boundaries” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「支護壓力越高越安全，不必考慮淺覆土上舉。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Higher support pressure is always safer without considering shallow-cover uplift." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「覆土與上舉邊界」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Cover and uplift boundaries”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 覆土與上舉邊界
knowledge.text: 支護不足可能造成坍入，過大壓力也可能推動淺覆土上舉或形成逸流。穩定分析需要上下兩側機制而不是只求最低值，鄰近地面荷載與弱層會改變可行範圍。
knowledge.textEn: Insufficient support can cause collapse, while excessive pressure may lift shallow cover or create escape paths. Analysis needs both lower and upper mechanisms, with surface loads and weak layers affecting the feasible interval.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：支護壓力越高越安全，不必考慮淺覆土上舉。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Higher support pressure is always safer without considering shallow-cover uplift. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「覆土與上舉邊界」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cover and uplift boundaries" is correct?
options: 支護不足可能造成坍入，過大壓力也可能推動淺覆土上舉或形成逸流。

optionsEn: Insufficient support can cause collapse, while excessive pressure may lift shallow cover or create escape paths.
Higher support pressure is always safer without considering shallow-cover uplift.
A critical stability index transfers between projects without considering geometry.

steps.title: 覆土與上舉邊界：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cover and uplift boundaries: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「覆土與上舉邊界」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設均質覆土重度18 kN/m³、厚8 m，自重應力144 kPa；此量級檢查未計拱效應、黏聚或水。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed uniform cover unit weight 18 kN/m³ over 8 m gives 144 kPa overburden; this scale check excludes arching, cohesion and water. steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

多數訊號正常時可以直接刪除少數異常當作離群值。
用地形、建物載重與地下管線資料檢查淺覆土區，並列坍入及上舉情境；設計者須給出場址專屬模型和審查界線，課程自重值不得當機器壓力目標。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
When most signals are normal, the remaining anomalies may simply be deleted as outliers.
Check shallow cover against terrain, building loads and utilities and analyze collapse and uplift separately.

quiz.explanationEn: Check shallow cover against terrain, building loads and utilities and analyze collapse and uplift separately; designers provide site-specific models and review boundaries, and the teaching overburden value is not a machine target. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 覆土與上舉邊界：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cover and uplift boundaries: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「覆土與上舉邊界」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cover and uplift boundaries” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只提高支護壓力來追求防坍會忽略上舉與地表噴出路徑，薄弱夾層可能先被打通；若未有上限機制分析，控制策略就缺少另一半。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Increasing pressure solely to prevent collapse ignores uplift and surface escape paths, which may open along weak layers. Without an upper-bound mechanism the control concept remains fundamentally incomplete. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只提高支護壓力來追求防坍會忽略上舉與地表噴出路徑，薄弱夾層可能先被打通；若未有上限機制分析，控制策略就缺少另一半。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「支護壓力越高越安全，不必考慮淺覆土上舉。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Higher support pressure is always safer without considering shallow-cover uplift." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 不排水穩定比值：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「不排水穩定比值」如何影響軟土潛盾開挖面穩定分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Undrained stability index” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Face-stability analysis for soft-ground shields”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 黏土短期開挖常以不排水強度描述，荷載差除以強度可形成規一化穩定指標。臨界值依幾何、覆土及破壞機制而變，不能從別案搬一個常數就直接設定支護。 假設荷載差150 kPa、su=50 kPa，示意N=150/50=3；此值未提供任何通用合格門檻。 平均強度會掩蓋薄弱層，將重塑強度或完整強度任意替換又改變意義；穩定指標小數位精細也無法補足材料代表性不足。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「不排水穩定比值」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Short-term clay excavation often uses undrained strength. Dividing a load difference by that strength produces a normalized stability index, but its critical value depends on geometry, cover and failure mechanism rather than one transferable constant. For assumed load difference 150 kPa and su=50 kPa, illustrative N=3; no universal acceptance threshold is implied. Average strength can hide a weak interbed, and substituting remolded for intact strength changes the meaning. Fine decimal precision in a stability index cannot compensate for unrepresentative material data. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Undrained stability index” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「某工程的臨界穩定指標可以不看幾何直接搬到另一工程。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A critical stability index transfers between projects without considering geometry." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「不排水穩定比值」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

Normal chamber pressure permits assuming an eternally intact impermeable filter cake.

steps.title: 不排水穩定比值：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Undrained stability index: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「不排水穩定比值」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Undrained stability index” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設荷載差150 kPa、su=50 kPa，示意N=150/50=3；此值未提供任何通用合格門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed load difference 150 kPa and su=50 kPa, illustrative N=3; no universal acceptance threshold is implied. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：由代表性取樣與應變速率資料建立su範圍，檢查軟層是否控制整個面；使用適合斷面與覆土的分析並比較敏感度，只有專業設計審查可決定實際控制界線。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Establish a representative su range with strain-rate context and identify controlling weak layers; use analysis matching geometry and cover and compare sensitivity, leaving actual control boundaries to professional design review.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 平均強度會掩蓋薄弱層，將重塑強度或完整強度任意替換又改變意義；穩定指標小數位精細也無法補足材料代表性不足。
knowledge.textEn: Average strength can hide a weak interbed, and substituting remolded for intact strength changes the meaning. Fine decimal precision in a stability index cannot compensate for unrepresentative material data.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「不排水穩定比值」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

只要土倉壓力正常，就可假設泥膜永遠完整不透水。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Average strength can hide a weak interbed, and substituting remolded for intact strength changes the meaning.
Normal chamber pressure permits assuming an eternally intact impermeable filter cake.
quiz.explanation: 平均強度會掩蓋薄弱層，將重塑強度或完整強度任意替換又改變意義；穩定指標小數位精細也無法補足材料代表性不足。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Average strength can hide a weak interbed, and substituting remolded for intact strength changes the meaning. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制

steps.title: 砂土滲流與濾膜：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Sand seepage and filter cake: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「砂土滲流與濾膜」如何影響軟土潛盾開挖面穩定分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sand seepage and filter cake” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Face-stability analysis for soft-ground shields”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 砂土中支護壓力需透過介質與土體界面傳遞，滲透太深時壓力作用範圍和有效應力路徑會改變。泥膜不是抽象的完美邊界，粒徑、滲透性和介質特性共同控制壓力傳遞。 假設孔隙比e=0.7、Gs=2.65，理想向上滲流臨界梯度ic=(Gs−1)/(1+e)=0.971；非掌子面設計門檻。 若假設完整泥膜卻實際深度滲入，名義倉壓不等於有效支護，出現細砂流失仍可能被忽略；濾膜破裂也會使原本穩定的壓力傳遞突然改變。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「砂土滲流與濾膜」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In sand, support pressure transfers through the medium-ground interface. Deep infiltration changes the loaded region and effective-stress path. A filter cake is not a perfect abstract boundary; grading, permeability and medium behavior govern transfer. Assume void ratio e=0.7 and Gs=2.65; ideal upward-seepage critical gradient ic=(Gs−1)/(1+e)=0.971, not a face-design threshold. Assuming an intact cake during deep infiltration equates chamber pressure with effective support incorrectly. Fine-sand loss may be missed, and cake rupture can abruptly change a previously stable transfer mechanism. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sand seepage and filter cake” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要土倉壓力正常，就可假設泥膜永遠完整不透水。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Normal chamber pressure permits assuming an eternally intact impermeable filter cake." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「砂土滲流與濾膜」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.textEn: In sand, support pressure transfers through the medium-ground interface. Deep infiltration changes the loaded region and effective-stress path.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設孔隙比e=0.7、Gs=2.65，理想向上滲流臨界梯度ic=(Gs−1)/(1+e)=0.971；非掌子面設計門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume void ratio e=0.7 and Gs=2.65; ideal upward-seepage critical gradient ic=(Gs−1)/(1+e)=0.971, not a face-design threshold. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以代表性砂樣做合格試驗比較滲透與濾膜形成，記錄壓差、滲流及顆粒流失；工程師需確認試驗方向、尺度與現場相符，不把一維向上滲流公式直接套到三維掌子面。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Test representative sand for infiltration and filter formation with pressure, flow and particle-loss records; engineers verify direction and scale, avoiding direct transfer of a one-dimensional upward-flow relation to a three-dimensional face.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 在「砂土滲流與濾膜」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Sand seepage and filter cake" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
濕出土重量增加就必定代表原位土被過量開挖。
若假設完整泥膜卻實際深度滲入，名義倉壓不等於有效支護，出現細砂流失仍可能被忽略；濾膜破裂也會使原本穩定的壓力傳遞突然改變。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Greater wet discharge mass necessarily means excessive excavation of in-situ soil.
Assuming an intact cake during deep infiltration equates chamber pressure with effective support incorrectly.
quiz.explanation: 若假設完整泥膜卻實際深度滲入，名義倉壓不等於有效支護，出現細砂流失仍可能被忽略；濾膜破裂也會使原本穩定的壓力傳遞突然改變。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Assuming an intact cake during deep infiltration equates chamber pressure with effective support incorrectly. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 體積平衡與失土：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Volume balance and ground loss: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「體積平衡與失土」如何影響軟土潛盾開挖面穩定分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Volume balance and ground loss” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Face-stability analysis for soft-ground shields”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 開挖體積、出土量與倉內儲量構成收支，但出土含水與改良材料會使重量和體積不直接可比。短暫收支差可能是儲量變化，持續差異才需結合沉陷與壓力評估失土。 假設直徑6 m、前進1.5 m，理論體積πD²L/4=42.41 m³；出土差額須先校正添加量與鬆脹。 把濕土重量增加當成超挖會誤調控制，反之漏計螺旋機持續出土可能掩蓋倉內減量；資料時間不同步則會製造假的短時失土。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「體積平衡與失土」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Excavated volume, discharge and chamber storage form a balance, but water and conditioning change mass-volume conversion. Temporary imbalance can reflect storage; persistent discrepancies require pressure and settlement evidence before interpreting ground loss. Assume diameter 6 m and advance 1.5 m; theoretical volume πD²L/4=42.41 m³, with discharge differences corrected for additions and bulking first. Mistaking increased wet mass for overexcavation prompts wrong adjustments, while uncounted continued discharge hides chamber depletion. Unsynchronized records can manufacture an apparent short-term ground-loss event. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Volume balance and ground loss” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「濕出土重量增加就必定代表原位土被過量開挖。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Greater wet discharge mass necessarily means excessive excavation of in-situ soil." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「體積平衡與失土」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Volume balance and ground loss”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 開挖體積、出土量與倉內儲量構成收支，但出土含水與改良材料會使重量和體積不直接可比。短暫收支差可能是儲量變化，持續差異才需結合沉陷與壓力評估失土。
knowledge.textEn: Excavated volume, discharge and chamber storage form a balance, but water and conditioning change mass-volume conversion. Temporary imbalance can reflect storage; persistent discrepancies require pressure and settlement evidence before interpreting ground loss.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：濕出土重量增加就必定代表原位土被過量開挖。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Greater wet discharge mass necessarily means excessive excavation of in-situ soil. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「體積平衡與失土」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Volume balance and ground loss" is correct?
options: 開挖體積、出土量與倉內儲量構成收支，但出土含水與改良材料會使重量和體積不直接可比。
濕出土重量增加就必定代表原位土被過量開挖。
停止推進後土倉壓力和改良土性質會永遠保持不變。
optionsEn: Excavated volume, discharge and chamber storage form a balance, but water and conditioning change mass-volume conversion.
Greater wet discharge mass necessarily means excessive excavation of in-situ soil.
Chamber pressure and conditioned-soil properties remain unchanged forever after advance stops.
quiz.explanation: 開挖體積、出土量與倉內儲量構成收支，但出土含水與改良材料會使重量和體積不直接可比。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Excavated volume, discharge and chamber storage form a balance, but water and conditioning change mass-volume conversion. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 體積平衡與失土：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Volume balance and ground loss: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「體積平衡與失土」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Volume balance and ground loss” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設直徑6 m、前進1.5 m，理論體積πD²L/4=42.41 m³；出土差額須先校正添加量與鬆脹。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume diameter 6 m and advance 1.5 m; theoretical volume πD²L/4=42.41 m³, with discharge differences corrected for additions and bulking first. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步行程、重量、含水率與添加材料紀錄，將出土量換成同一乾土或原位體積基準；比較倉壓和地表監測，未閉合收支由設備與地工人員共同查因，不能只用單環百分比判定。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize advance, mass, moisture and additions and convert discharge to a common dry-soil or in-situ basis; compare pressure and settlement and jointly investigate imbalance rather than judging one ring percentage alone.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設直徑6 m、前進1.5 m，理論體積πD²L/4=42.41 m³；出土差額須先校正添加量與鬆脹。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume diameter 6 m and advance 1.5 m; theoretical volume πD²L/4=42.41 m³, with discharge differences corrected for additions and bulking first.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「體積平衡與失土」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 敏感度分析算出的百分比就是實際失敗機率。

The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
Undrained strength and drained friction can be mixed unconditionally in one model.

steps.title: 體積平衡與失土：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Volume balance and ground loss: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「體積平衡與失土」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Volume balance and ground loss” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步行程、重量、含水率與添加材料紀錄，將出土量換成同一乾土或原位體積基準；比較倉壓和地表監測，未閉合收支由設備與地工人員共同查因，不能只用單環百分比判定。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把濕土重量增加當成超挖會誤調控制，反之漏計螺旋機持續出土可能掩蓋倉內減量；資料時間不同步則會製造假的短時失土。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize advance, mass, moisture and additions and convert discharge to a common dry-soil or in-situ basis; compare pressure and settlement and jointly investigate imbalance rather than judging one ring percentage alone. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Mistaking increased wet mass for overexcavation prompts wrong adjustments, while uncounted continued discharge hides chamber depletion. Unsynchronized records can manufacture an apparent short-term ground-loss event. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄體積平衡與失土的資料來源與適用條件。同步行程、重量、含水率與添加材料紀錄，將出土量換成同一乾土或原位體積基準；比較倉壓和地表監測，未閉合收支由設備與地工人員共同查因，不能只用單環百分比判定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for volume balance and ground loss. Synchronize advance, mass, moisture and additions and convert discharge to a common dry-soil or in-situ basis; compare pressure and settlement and jointly investigate imbalance rather than judging one ring percentage alone.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把濕土重量增加當成超挖會誤調控制，反之漏計螺旋機持續出土可能掩蓋倉內減量；資料時間不同步則會製造假的短時失土。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Mistaking increased wet mass for overexcavation prompts wrong adjustments, while uncounted continued discharge hides chamber depletion. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同步行程、重量、含水率與添加材料紀錄，將出土量換成同一乾土或原位體積基準；比較倉壓和地表監測，未閉合收支由設備與地工人員共同查因，不能只用單環百分比判定。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把濕土重量增加當成超挖會誤調控制，反之漏計螺旋機持續出土可能掩蓋倉內減量；資料時間不同步則會製造假的短時失土。
knowledge.textEn: Synchronize advance, mass, moisture and additions and convert discharge to a common dry-soil or in-situ basis; compare pressure and settlement and jointly investigate imbalance rather than judging one ring percentage alone. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Mistaking increased wet mass for overexcavation prompts wrong adjustments, while uncounted continued discharge hides chamber depletion. Unsynchronized records can manufacture an apparent short-term ground-loss event.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄體積平衡與失土的資料來源與適用條件。同步行程、重量、含水率與添加材料紀錄，將出土量換成同一乾土或原位體積基準；比較倉壓和地表監測，未閉合收支由設備與地工人員共同查因，不能只用單環百分比判定。

Synchronize advance, mass, moisture and additions and convert discharge to a common dry-soil or in-situ basis; compare pressure and settlement and jointly investigate imbalance rather than judging one ring percentage alone.

quiz.question: 要驗證「體積平衡與失土」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Volume balance and ground loss"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
支護壓力越高越安全，不必考慮淺覆土上舉。
同步行程、重量、含水率與添加材料紀錄，將出土量換成同一乾土或原位體積基準；比較倉壓和地表監測，未閉合收支由設備與地工人員共同查因，不能只用單環百分比判定。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Higher support pressure is always safer without considering shallow-cover uplift.
Synchronize advance, mass, moisture and additions and convert discharge to a common dry-soil or in-situ basis.

quiz.explanationEn: Synchronize advance, mass, moisture and additions and convert discharge to a common dry-soil or in-situ basis; compare pressure and settlement and jointly investigate imbalance rather than judging one ring percentage alone. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 體積平衡與失土：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Volume balance and ground loss: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「體積平衡與失土」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Volume balance and ground loss” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把濕土重量增加當成超挖會誤調控制，反之漏計螺旋機持續出土可能掩蓋倉內減量；資料時間不同步則會製造假的短時失土。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mistaking increased wet mass for overexcavation prompts wrong adjustments, while uncounted continued discharge hides chamber depletion. Unsynchronized records can manufacture an apparent short-term ground-loss event. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把濕土重量增加當成超挖會誤調控制，反之漏計螺旋機持續出土可能掩蓋倉內減量；資料時間不同步則會製造假的短時失土。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「濕出土重量增加就必定代表原位土被過量開挖。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Greater wet discharge mass necessarily means excessive excavation of in-situ soil." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 把濕土重量增加當成超挖會誤調控制，反之漏計螺旋機持續出土可能掩蓋倉內減量；資料時間不同步則會製造假的短時失土。

quiz.question: 在「體積平衡與失土」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Standstill and pressure evolution" and "Mixed ground across the face": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 停機與壓力演變：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Standstill and pressure evolution: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「停機與壓力演變」如何影響軟土潛盾開挖面穩定分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Standstill and pressure evolution” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Face-stability analysis for soft-ground shields”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 停機後土倉和地層仍會排水、固結或滲漏，壓力不一定維持推進時的分布。土壤改良物性也隨時間改變，因此停機情境需獨立分析，不能把推進穩態直接延長。 假設教學一階衰減p(t)=p0e^(−t/τ)，p0=200 kPa、τ=10 h，2 h後163.7 kPa；非現場預測。 只監看平均倉壓會漏掉分層或局部氣穴，長停機後介質失去可塑性也可能造成壓力傳遞不均；重新推進時風險不再等同停止前。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「停機與壓力演變」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After stopping, drainage, consolidation and leakage continue and alter pressure distribution. Conditioning properties also age, so standstill requires a separate scenario rather than indefinite extension of the advancing steady state. For an assumed teaching decay p(t)=p0e^(−t/τ), p0=200 kPa and τ=10 h give 163.7 kPa after 2 h; this is not a field prediction. Average pressure can hide stratification or local voids, while aged material loses plasticity and transfers load unevenly. Restart conditions therefore need not resemble the state immediately before stopping. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Standstill and pressure evolution” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「停止推進後土倉壓力和改良土性質會永遠保持不變。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Chamber pressure and conditioned-soil properties remain unchanged forever after advance stops." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「停機與壓力演變」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Standstill and pressure evolution”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 停機與壓力演變
knowledge.text: 停機後土倉和地層仍會排水、固結或滲漏，壓力不一定維持推進時的分布。土壤改良物性也隨時間改變，因此停機情境需獨立分析，不能把推進穩態直接延長。
knowledge.textEn: After stopping, drainage, consolidation and leakage continue and alter pressure distribution. Conditioning properties also age, so standstill requires a separate scenario rather than indefinite extension of the advancing steady state.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：停止推進後土倉壓力和改良土性質會永遠保持不變。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Chamber pressure and conditioned-soil properties remain unchanged forever after advance stops. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「停機與壓力演變」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Standstill and pressure evolution" is correct?
options: 停止推進後土倉壓力和改良土性質會永遠保持不變。
停機後土倉和地層仍會排水、固結或滲漏，壓力不一定維持推進時的分布。
高透水砂只占小面積，就一定只造成同等比例風險。
optionsEn: Chamber pressure and conditioned-soil properties remain unchanged forever after advance stops.
After stopping, drainage, consolidation and leakage continue and alter pressure distribution.
A small permeable sand area necessarily contributes only that proportional share of risk.
quiz.explanation: 停機後土倉和地層仍會排水、固結或滲漏，壓力不一定維持推進時的分布。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: After stopping, drainage, consolidation and leakage continue and alter pressure distribution. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 停機與壓力演變：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Standstill and pressure evolution: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「停機與壓力演變」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Standstill and pressure evolution” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設教學一階衰減p(t)=p0e^(−t/τ)，p0=200 kPa、τ=10 h，2 h後163.7 kPa；非現場預測。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed teaching decay p(t)=p0e^(−t/τ), p0=200 kPa and τ=10 h give 163.7 kPa after 2 h; this is not a field prediction. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較停機前後多高度壓力、出入量和地下水條件，記錄每次停機原因及持續時間；任何需重新建立支護的處置依核准程序與專業人員執行，算例衰減常數不能當現場等待時間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare multiheight pressures, inflow-outflow and groundwater before and during stops, recording cause and duration; restoring support follows approved specialist procedures, and the illustrative time constant is not a permissible waiting period.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設教學一階衰減p(t)=p0e^(−t/τ)，p0=200 kPa、τ=10 h，2 h後163.7 kPa；非現場預測。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed teaching decay p(t)=p0e^(−t/τ), p0=200 kPa and τ=10 h give 163.7 kPa after 2 h; this is not a field prediction.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「停機與壓力演變」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Standstill and pressure evolution", which statement holds?
options: 多數訊號正常時可以直接刪除少數異常當作離群值。
一個底部壓力計正常就代表整個掌子面支護都足夠。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: When most signals are normal, the remaining anomalies may simply be deleted as outliers.
A normal invert pressure reading proves adequate support over the entire face.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 停機與壓力演變：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Standstill and pressure evolution: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「停機與壓力演變」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Standstill and pressure evolution” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較停機前後多高度壓力、出入量和地下水條件，記錄每次停機原因及持續時間；任何需重新建立支護的處置依核准程序與專業人員執行，算例衰減常數不能當現場等待時間。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：只監看平均倉壓會漏掉分層或局部氣穴，長停機後介質失去可塑性也可能造成壓力傳遞不均；重新推進時風險不再等同停止前。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare multiheight pressures, inflow-outflow and groundwater before and during stops, recording cause and duration; restoring support follows approved specialist procedures, and the illustrative time constant is not a permissible waiting period. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Average pressure can hide stratification or local voids, while aged material loses plasticity and transfers load unevenly. Restart conditions therefore need not resemble the state immediately before stopping. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄停機與壓力演變的資料來源與適用條件。比較停機前後多高度壓力、出入量和地下水條件，記錄每次停機原因及持續時間；任何需重新建立支護的處置依核准程序與專業人員執行，算例衰減常數不能當現場等待時間。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for standstill and pressure evolution. Compare multiheight pressures, inflow-outflow and groundwater before and during stops, recording cause and duration; restoring support follows approved specialist procedures, and the illustrative time constant is not a permissible waiting period.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只監看平均倉壓會漏掉分層或局部氣穴，長停機後介質失去可塑性也可能造成壓力傳遞不均；重新推進時風險不再等同停止前。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Average pressure can hide stratification or local voids, while aged material loses plasticity and transfers load unevenly. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較停機前後多高度壓力、出入量和地下水條件，記錄每次停機原因及持續時間；任何需重新建立支護的處置依核准程序與專業人員執行，算例衰減常數不能當現場等待時間。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：只監看平均倉壓會漏掉分層或局部氣穴，長停機後介質失去可塑性也可能造成壓力傳遞不均；重新推進時風險不再等同停止前。
knowledge.textEn: Compare multiheight pressures, inflow-outflow and groundwater before and during stops, recording cause and duration; restoring support follows approved specialist procedures, and the illustrative time constant is not a permissible waiting period. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Average pressure can hide stratification or local voids, while aged material loses plasticity and transfers load unevenly. Restart conditions therefore need not resemble the state immediately before stopping.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄停機與壓力演變的資料來源與適用條件。比較停機前後多高度壓力、出入量和地下水條件，記錄每次停機原因及持續時間；任何需重新建立支護的處置依核准程序與專業人員執行，算例衰減常數不能當現場等待時間。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for standstill and pressure evolution. Compare multiheight pressures, inflow-outflow and groundwater before and during stops, recording cause and duration; restoring support follows approved specialist procedures, and the illustrative time constant is not a permissible waiting period.

quiz.question: 要驗證「停機與壓力演變」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Standstill and pressure evolution"?
options: 比較停機前後多高度壓力、出入量和地下水條件，記錄每次停機原因及持續時間；任何需重新建立支護的處置依核准程序與專業人員執行，算例衰減常數不能當現場等待時間。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
某工程的臨界穩定指標可以不看幾何直接搬到另一工程。
optionsEn: Compare multiheight pressures, inflow-outflow and groundwater before and during stops, recording cause and duration.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A critical stability index transfers between projects without considering geometry.
quiz.explanation: 比較停機前後多高度壓力、出入量和地下水條件，記錄每次停機原因及持續時間；任何需重新建立支護的處置依核准程序與專業人員執行，算例衰減常數不能當現場等待時間。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare multiheight pressures, inflow-outflow and groundwater before and during stops, recording cause and duration; restoring support follows approved specialist procedures, and the illustrative time constant is not a permissible waiting period. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 停機與壓力演變：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Standstill and pressure evolution: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「停機與壓力演變」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Standstill and pressure evolution” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只監看平均倉壓會漏掉分層或局部氣穴，長停機後介質失去可塑性也可能造成壓力傳遞不均；重新推進時風險不再等同停止前。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Average pressure can hide stratification or local voids, while aged material loses plasticity and transfers load unevenly. Restart conditions therefore need not resemble the state immediately before stopping. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只監看平均倉壓會漏掉分層或局部氣穴，長停機後介質失去可塑性也可能造成壓力傳遞不均；重新推進時風險不再等同停止前。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Restart conditions therefore need not resemble the state immediately before stopping.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「停止推進後土倉壓力和改良土性質會永遠保持不變。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Chamber pressure and conditioned-soil properties remain unchanged forever after advance stops." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只監看平均倉壓會漏掉分層或局部氣穴，長停機後介質失去可塑性也可能造成壓力傳遞不均；重新推進時風險不再等同停止前。
knowledge.textEn: Average pressure can hide stratification or local voids, while aged material loses plasticity and transfers load unevenly. Restart conditions therefore need not resemble the state immediately before stopping.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「停機與壓力演變」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Standstill and pressure evolution" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
只監看平均倉壓會漏掉分層或局部氣穴，長停機後介質失去可塑性也可能造成壓力傳遞不均；重新推進時風險不再等同停止前。
高透水砂只占小面積，就一定只造成同等比例風險。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Average pressure can hide stratification or local voids, while aged material loses plasticity and transfers load unevenly.
A small permeable sand area necessarily contributes only that proportional share of risk.
quiz.explanation: 只監看平均倉壓會漏掉分層或局部氣穴，長停機後介質失去可塑性也可能造成壓力傳遞不均；重新推進時風險不再等同停止前。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Average pressure can hide stratification or local voids, while aged material loses plasticity and transfers load unevenly. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 混合地層與面內差異：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Mixed ground across the face: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「混合地層與面內差異」如何影響軟土潛盾開挖面穩定分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Mixed ground across the face” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Face-stability analysis for soft-ground shields”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 掌子面同時遇到砂、黏土或硬軟界面時，各區滲透、強度與切削阻力不同。單一平均參數會抹去最不利局部機制，且刀盤擾動可能使原本隔離的水路連通。 假設面積30 m²中6 m²為高透水砂，比例20%；面積小不代表其對滲流風險只貢獻20%。 薄砂層可能主導水土流失而被平均黏土參數掩蓋，硬塊又會造成局部擾動；若只因整體倉壓正常便忽略異常出土，可能錯過局部失穩。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「混合地層與面內差異」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A face crossing sand, clay or a hard-soft interface contains contrasting permeability, strength and cutting resistance. Average parameters conceal adverse local mechanisms, and cutter disturbance can connect previously separated water pathways. If an assumed 30 m² face contains 6 m² permeable sand, its area fraction is 20%; its seepage-risk contribution is not necessarily only 20%. A thin sand layer can dominate erosion despite clay-dominated averages, while hard inclusions disturb the face locally. Normal mean chamber pressure does not justify ignoring anomalous discharge indicating localized instability. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Mixed ground across the face” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「高透水砂只占小面積，就一定只造成同等比例風險。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A small permeable sand area necessarily contributes only that proportional share of risk." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「混合地層與面內差異」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Mixed ground across the face”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 混合地層與面內差異
knowledge.text: 掌子面同時遇到砂、黏土或硬軟界面時，各區滲透、強度與切削阻力不同。單一平均參數會抹去最不利局部機制，且刀盤擾動可能使原本隔離的水路連通。
knowledge.textEn: A face crossing sand, clay or a hard-soft interface contains contrasting permeability, strength and cutting resistance. Average parameters conceal adverse local mechanisms, and cutter disturbance can connect previously separated water pathways.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：高透水砂只占小面積，就一定只造成同等比例風險。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A small permeable sand area necessarily contributes only that proportional share of risk. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「混合地層與面內差異」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Mixed ground across the face" is correct?

敏感度分析算出的百分比就是實際失敗機率。
掌子面同時遇到砂、黏土或硬軟界面時，各區滲透、強度與切削阻力不同。
optionsEn: A small permeable sand area necessarily contributes only that proportional share of risk.
A percentage from sensitivity analysis is the actual probability of failure.
A face crossing sand, clay or a hard-soft interface contains contrasting permeability, strength and cutting resistance.
quiz.explanation: 掌子面同時遇到砂、黏土或硬軟界面時，各區滲透、強度與切削阻力不同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A face crossing sand, clay or a hard-soft interface contains contrasting permeability, strength and cutting resistance. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 混合地層與面內差異：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Mixed ground across the face: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「混合地層與面內差異」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Mixed ground across the face” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設面積30 m²中6 m²為高透水砂，比例20%；面積小不代表其對滲流風險只貢獻20%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If an assumed 30 m² face contains 6 m² permeable sand, its area fraction is 20%; its seepage-risk contribution is not necessarily only 20%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：利用超前孔與地質剖面估計界面位置範圍，將面內不同區域分開分析並比對扭矩、壓力及出土變化；只在證據支持下更新混合面模型，不以平均土樣取代局部砂層。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use probing and sections to bound interface position and analyze face regions separately against torque, pressure and discharge; update mixed-face models only with evidence and do not replace a local sand layer with an average sample.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 混合地層與面內差異：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「混合地層與面內差異」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Mixed ground across the face” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 利用超前孔與地質剖面估計界面位置範圍，將面內不同區域分開分析並比對扭矩、壓力及出土變化；只在證據支持下更新混合面模型，不以平均土樣取代局部砂層。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：薄砂層可能主導水土流失而被平均黏土參數掩蓋，硬塊又會造成局部擾動；若只因整體倉壓正常便忽略異常出土，可能錯過局部失穩。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Normal mean chamber pressure does not justify ignoring anomalous discharge indicating localized instability. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

利用超前孔與地質剖面估計界面位置範圍，將面內不同區域分開分析並比對扭矩、壓力及出土變化；只在證據支持下更新混合面模型，不以平均土樣取代局部砂層。

steps.title: 混合地層與面內差異：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Mixed ground across the face: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「混合地層與面內差異」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Mixed ground across the face” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 薄砂層可能主導水土流失而被平均黏土參數掩蓋，硬塊又會造成局部擾動；若只因整體倉壓正常便忽略異常出土，可能錯過局部失穩。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A thin sand layer can dominate erosion despite clay-dominated averages, while hard inclusions disturb the face locally. Normal mean chamber pressure does not justify ignoring anomalous discharge indicating localized instability. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：薄砂層可能主導水土流失而被平均黏土參數掩蓋，硬塊又會造成局部擾動；若只因整體倉壓正常便忽略異常出土，可能錯過局部失穩。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「高透水砂只占小面積，就一定只造成同等比例風險。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A small permeable sand area necessarily contributes only that proportional share of risk." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

knowledge.text: 薄砂層可能主導水土流失而被平均黏土參數掩蓋，硬塊又會造成局部擾動；若只因整體倉壓正常便忽略異常出土，可能錯過局部失穩。

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Model sensitivity and reliability" and "Evidence integration and review boundaries": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 模型敏感度與可靠性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Model sensitivity and reliability: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「模型敏感度與可靠性」如何影響軟土潛盾開挖面穩定分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Model sensitivity and reliability” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Face-stability analysis for soft-ground shields”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 面穩定結果受土強度、水位與覆土等輸入共同影響，最敏感參數不一定是變異最大的參數。應將物理模型誤差與量測不確定分開，不用單一名義計算掩蓋不利組合。 假設示意指標N=150/su，su由50降40 kPa時N由3增至3.75，增加25%；不是失敗機率。 獨立亂抽實際相關參數可能製造不可能的情境或漏掉共同不利狀態，把敏感度當機率又會給出虛假的可靠度，誤導支護與監測資源配置。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「模型敏感度與可靠性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Face-stability results depend on strength, water and cover jointly. The most sensitive parameter need not be the most variable. Separate model error from measurement uncertainty and examine adverse combinations rather than one nominal calculation. For assumed illustrative N=150/su, lowering su from 50 to 40 kPa increases N from 3 to 3.75, or 25%; this is not a failure probability. Independently sampling correlated parameters creates impossible combinations or misses jointly adverse states. Treating sensitivity as probability invents numerical reliability and misdirects support and monitoring resources. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Model sensitivity and reliability” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「敏感度分析算出的百分比就是實際失敗機率。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A percentage from sensitivity analysis is the actual probability of failure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「模型敏感度與可靠性」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.textEn: Face-stability results depend on strength, water and cover jointly. The most sensitive parameter need not be the most variable.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：敏感度分析算出的百分比就是實際失敗機率。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A percentage from sensitivity analysis is the actual probability of failure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「模型敏感度與可靠性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Model sensitivity and reliability" is correct?
options: 面穩定結果受土強度、水位與覆土等輸入共同影響，最敏感參數不一定是變異最大的參數。
敏感度分析算出的百分比就是實際失敗機率。

steps.title: 模型敏感度與可靠性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Model sensitivity and reliability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「模型敏感度與可靠性」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Model sensitivity and reliability” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設示意指標N=150/su，su由50降40 kPa時N由3增至3.75，增加25%；不是失敗機率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed illustrative N=150/su, lowering su from 50 to 40 kPa increases N from 3 to 3.75, or 25%; this is not a failure probability. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：針對地質資料支持的上下限做組合分析，記錄參數相關性與模型適用範圍；設計審查應說明哪一種新調查最能縮小決策不確定性，而非只列很多沒有物理依據的模擬案例。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Analyze combinations supported by geological bounds with documented correlations and model scope; review which additional investigation most reduces decision uncertainty rather than listing many simulations without physical justification.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「模型敏感度與可靠性」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Model sensitivity and reliability", which statement holds?

The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
A critical stability index transfers between projects without considering geometry.

steps.title: 模型敏感度與可靠性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Model sensitivity and reliability: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「模型敏感度與可靠性」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Model sensitivity and reliability” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 針對地質資料支持的上下限做組合分析，記錄參數相關性與模型適用範圍；設計審查應說明哪一種新調查最能縮小決策不確定性，而非只列很多沒有物理依據的模擬案例。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：獨立亂抽實際相關參數可能製造不可能的情境或漏掉共同不利狀態，把敏感度當機率又會給出虛假的可靠度，誤導支護與監測資源配置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Analyze combinations supported by geological bounds with documented correlations and model scope; review which additional investigation most reduces decision uncertainty rather than listing many simulations without physical justification. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Independently sampling correlated parameters creates impossible combinations or misses jointly adverse states. Treating sensitivity as probability invents numerical reliability and misdirects support and monitoring resources. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄模型敏感度與可靠性的資料來源與適用條件。針對地質資料支持的上下限做組合分析，記錄參數相關性與模型適用範圍；設計審查應說明哪一種新調查最能縮小決策不確定性，而非只列很多沒有物理依據的模擬案例。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for model sensitivity and reliability. Analyze combinations supported by geological bounds with documented correlations and model scope; review which additional investigation most reduces decision uncertainty rather than listing many simulations without physical justification.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：獨立亂抽實際相關參數可能製造不可能的情境或漏掉共同不利狀態，把敏感度當機率又會給出虛假的可靠度，誤導支護與監測資源配置。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Independently sampling correlated parameters creates impossible combinations or misses jointly adverse states. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
