quiz.question: 要驗證「模型敏感度與可靠性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Model sensitivity and reliability"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
濕出土重量增加就必定代表原位土被過量開挖。
針對地質資料支持的上下限做組合分析，記錄參數相關性與模型適用範圍；設計審查應說明哪一種新調查最能縮小決策不確定性，而非只列很多沒有物理依據的模擬案例。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Greater wet discharge mass necessarily means excessive excavation of in-situ soil.
Analyze combinations supported by geological bounds with documented correlations and model scope.
quiz.explanation: 針對地質資料支持的上下限做組合分析，記錄參數相關性與模型適用範圍；設計審查應說明哪一種新調查最能縮小決策不確定性，而非只列很多沒有物理依據的模擬案例。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Analyze combinations supported by geological bounds with documented correlations and model scope; review which additional investigation most reduces decision uncertainty rather than listing many simulations without physical justification. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 模型敏感度與可靠性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Model sensitivity and reliability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「模型敏感度與可靠性」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Model sensitivity and reliability” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 獨立亂抽實際相關參數可能製造不可能的情境或漏掉共同不利狀態，把敏感度當機率又會給出虛假的可靠度，誤導支護與監測資源配置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Independently sampling correlated parameters creates impossible combinations or misses jointly adverse states. Treating sensitivity as probability invents numerical reliability and misdirects support and monitoring resources. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：獨立亂抽實際相關參數可能製造不可能的情境或漏掉共同不利狀態，把敏感度當機率又會給出虛假的可靠度，誤導支護與監測資源配置。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Treating sensitivity as probability invents numerical reliability and misdirects support and monitoring resources.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「敏感度分析算出的百分比就是實際失敗機率。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A percentage from sensitivity analysis is the actual probability of failure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 獨立亂抽實際相關參數可能製造不可能的情境或漏掉共同不利狀態，把敏感度當機率又會給出虛假的可靠度，誤導支護與監測資源配置。
knowledge.textEn: Independently sampling correlated parameters creates impossible combinations or misses jointly adverse states. Treating sensitivity as probability invents numerical reliability and misdirects support and monitoring resources.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「模型敏感度與可靠性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Model sensitivity and reliability" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 獨立亂抽實際相關參數可能製造不可能的情境或漏掉共同不利狀態，把敏感度當機率又會給出虛假的可靠度，誤導支護與監測資源配置。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
多數訊號正常時可以直接刪除少數異常當作離群值。
optionsEn: Independently sampling correlated parameters creates impossible combinations or misses jointly adverse states.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
When most signals are normal, the remaining anomalies may simply be deleted as outliers.
quiz.explanation: 獨立亂抽實際相關參數可能製造不可能的情境或漏掉共同不利狀態，把敏感度當機率又會給出虛假的可靠度，誤導支護與監測資源配置。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Independently sampling correlated parameters creates impossible combinations or misses jointly adverse states. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 證據整合與審查界線：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Evidence integration and review boundaries: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「證據整合與審查界線」如何影響軟土潛盾開挖面穩定分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Evidence integration and review boundaries” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Face-stability analysis for soft-ground shields”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 面穩定不能僅由倉壓正常判定，還需出土、沉陷、地質與設備狀態相互支持。控制文件應指出哪種偏離會使模型失效及誰負責審查，讓學徒理解數學結果與操作授權之間的界線。 假設5類證據中4類正常、1類持續異常，正常比例80%；不得以多數決取消異常的獨立調查。 多數訊號正常可能只是共享同一失效感測器或延遲資料，若把異常當離群刪除，最早的局部失穩證據會消失；報告必須保留不一致與處置。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「證據整合與審查界線」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Normal chamber pressure alone does not establish stability; discharge, settlement, geology and equipment condition must agree. Control documents identify deviations invalidating the model and responsible reviewers, separating mathematical interpretation from operational authorization. If 4 of an assumed 5 evidence streams appear normal and 1 remains abnormal, 80% normality cannot overrule independent investigation of the anomaly. Several normal indicators may share a failed sensor or delayed data. Deleting the dissenting signal as an outlier can erase the earliest localized-instability evidence, so discrepancies and responses must remain recorded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Evidence integration and review boundaries” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「多數訊號正常時可以直接刪除少數異常當作離群值。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "When most signals are normal, the remaining anomalies may simply be deleted as outliers." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「證據整合與審查界線」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Evidence integration and review boundaries”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 證據整合與審查界線
knowledge.text: 面穩定不能僅由倉壓正常判定，還需出土、沉陷、地質與設備狀態相互支持。控制文件應指出哪種偏離會使模型失效及誰負責審查，讓學徒理解數學結果與操作授權之間的界線。
knowledge.textEn: Normal chamber pressure alone does not establish stability; discharge, settlement, geology and equipment condition must agree. Control documents identify deviations invalidating the model and responsible reviewers, separating mathematical interpretation from operational authorization.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：多數訊號正常時可以直接刪除少數異常當作離群值。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: When most signals are normal, the remaining anomalies may simply be deleted as outliers. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「證據整合與審查界線」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Evidence integration and review boundaries" is correct?
options: 多數訊號正常時可以直接刪除少數異常當作離群值。
面穩定不能僅由倉壓正常判定，還需出土、沉陷、地質與設備狀態相互支持。
不排水強度和排水摩擦角可不分條件地混在同一模型。
optionsEn: When most signals are normal, the remaining anomalies may simply be deleted as outliers.
Normal chamber pressure alone does not establish stability; discharge, settlement, geology and equipment condition must agree.
Undrained strength and drained friction can be mixed unconditionally in one model.
quiz.explanation: 面穩定不能僅由倉壓正常判定，還需出土、沉陷、地質與設備狀態相互支持。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Normal chamber pressure alone does not establish stability; discharge, settlement, geology and equipment condition must agree. The other options are common misconceptions.

title: 土壓平衡潛盾土壤改良
summary: 本課聚焦用流變、含水與體積收支評估土壓平衡潛盾改良土的功能。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。
summaryEn: This course focuses on assess EPB conditioned-ground function through rheology, moisture and volume accounting. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設螺旋機長8 m、兩端壓差160 kPa，平均梯度20 kPa/m；僅描述量測，不是允許設定。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設乾土1000 kg、水250 kg，w=25%；水占濕土1250 kg的比例為20%，兩者不可混用。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume an 8 m screw with a 160 kPa end-to-end pressure difference; the mean gradient is 20 kPa/m, describing a measurement rather than an operating setting. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume dry soil 1000 kg and water 250 kg; moisture content is 25%, while water is 20% of the 1250 kg wet mass. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。

steps.title: 塑性土塞的功能：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Function of the plastic soil plug: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「塑性土塞的功能」如何影響土壓平衡潛盾土壤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Function of the plastic soil plug” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ground conditioning for EPB tunneling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 土壓平衡依靠倉內改良土傳遞支護並容許受控出土，材料同時需要可塑性與低滲透。過乾會難以攪拌，過稀則難形成壓降，因此不能把流動性越高當成越好的改良。 假設螺旋機長8 m、兩端壓差160 kPa，平均梯度20 kPa/m；僅描述量測，不是允許設定。 過度液化可能出現壓力快速流失，乾硬土團則造成間歇堵塞和扭矩跳升；兩種相反狀態都可能以平均出土量正常掩蓋，需看時間歷程。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「塑性土塞的功能」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: EPB chamber material must transmit support while permitting controlled extraction, requiring plasticity and limited permeability together. Dry material resists mixing while overly fluid material may not sustain a pressure drop, so maximum flowability is not the objective. Assume an 8 m screw with a 160 kPa end-to-end pressure difference; the mean gradient is 20 kPa/m, describing a measurement rather than an operating setting. Overfluid material can lose pressure rapidly, while stiff lumps cause intermittent blockage and torque spikes. Both can hide behind a normal average discharge, requiring time-resolved interpretation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Function of the plastic soil plug” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「改良土越稀越容易流動，就一定越有利於穩定支護。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "More fluid conditioned soil is necessarily better for stable face support." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.titleEn: Function of the plastic soil plug: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「塑性土塞的功能」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Function of the plastic soil plug” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設螺旋機長8 m、兩端壓差160 kPa，平均梯度20 kPa/m；僅描述量測，不是允許設定。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume an 8 m screw with a 160 kPa end-to-end pressure difference; the mean gradient is 20 kPa/m, describing a measurement rather than an operating setting. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將代表性土樣的流動性、滲透與螺旋機壓力分布一起比較，記錄含水及粒徑；只有可維持壓力傳遞且出土穩定的試驗組合才供工程審查，不能靠單一坍度值認定合格。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare workability and permeability of representative samples with screw pressure distribution, recording moisture and grading; engineering review needs stable pressure transmission and extraction rather than acceptance from slump alone.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume an 8 m screw with a 160 kPa end-to-end pressure difference; the mean gradient is 20 kPa/m, describing a measurement rather than an operating setting.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「塑性土塞的功能」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

Lower cutterhead power proves successful conditioning without checking advance or geology.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.

steps.title: 塑性土塞的功能：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Function of the plastic soil plug: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「塑性土塞的功能」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Function of the plastic soil plug” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將代表性土樣的流動性、滲透與螺旋機壓力分布一起比較，記錄含水及粒徑；只有可維持壓力傳遞且出土穩定的試驗組合才供工程審查，不能靠單一坍度值認定合格。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：過度液化可能出現壓力快速流失，乾硬土團則造成間歇堵塞和扭矩跳升；兩種相反狀態都可能以平均出土量正常掩蓋，需看時間歷程。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare workability and permeability of representative samples with screw pressure distribution, recording moisture and grading; engineering review needs stable pressure transmission and extraction rather than acceptance from slump alone. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Overfluid material can lose pressure rapidly, while stiff lumps cause intermittent blockage and torque spikes. Both can hide behind a normal average discharge, requiring time-resolved interpretation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for function of the plastic soil plug. Compare workability and permeability of representative samples with screw pressure distribution, recording moisture and grading; engineering review needs stable pressure transmission and extraction rather than acceptance from slump alone.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：過度液化可能出現壓力快速流失，乾硬土團則造成間歇堵塞和扭矩跳升；兩種相反狀態都可能以平均出土量正常掩蓋，需看時間歷程。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Overfluid material can lose pressure rapidly, while stiff lumps cause intermittent blockage and torque spikes. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Function of the plastic soil plug” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 過度液化可能出現壓力快速流失，乾硬土團則造成間歇堵塞和扭矩跳升；兩種相反狀態都可能以平均出土量正常掩蓋，需看時間歷程。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Overfluid material can lose pressure rapidly, while stiff lumps cause intermittent blockage and torque spikes. Both can hide behind a normal average discharge, requiring time-resolved interpretation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：過度液化可能出現壓力快速流失，乾硬土團則造成間歇堵塞和扭矩跳升；兩種相反狀態都可能以平均出土量正常掩蓋，需看時間歷程。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Both can hide behind a normal average discharge, requiring time-resolved interpretation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「改良土越稀越容易流動，就一定越有利於穩定支護。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "More fluid conditioned soil is necessarily better for stable face support." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 過度液化可能出現壓力快速流失，乾硬土團則造成間歇堵塞和扭矩跳升；兩種相反狀態都可能以平均出土量正常掩蓋，需看時間歷程。
knowledge.textEn: Overfluid material can lose pressure rapidly, while stiff lumps cause intermittent blockage and torque spikes. Both can hide behind a normal average discharge, requiring time-resolved interpretation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

quiz.question: 在「塑性土塞的功能」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

乾基含水率與水占濕土重量比例永遠可以互換。

Overfluid material can lose pressure rapidly, while stiff lumps cause intermittent blockage and torque spikes.
Dry-basis moisture content and water fraction of wet mass are always interchangeable.

quiz.explanationEn: Overfluid material can lose pressure rapidly, while stiff lumps cause intermittent blockage and torque spikes. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 含水率基準轉換：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Moisture-basis conversion: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「含水率基準轉換」如何影響土壓平衡潛盾土壤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Moisture-basis conversion” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ground conditioning for EPB tunneling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 土壤含水率通常以水重除乾土重，與水占濕土總重比例不同。改良效果與黏土礦物及原水量有關，必須先統一質量基準再比較添加量，否則看似相同百分比其實不是同一材料。 假設乾土1000 kg、水250 kg，w=25%；水占濕土1250 kg的比例為20%，兩者不可混用。 把濕基百分比當乾基會錯估改良水量，倉內土與皮帶土失水程度不同又造成比較偏差；誤差可能被錯怪為添加劑性能不穩定。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「含水率基準轉換」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Geotechnical moisture content divides water mass by dry soil mass, unlike wet-mass fraction. Conditioning depends on mineralogy and initial water, requiring a consistent mass basis before comparing addition percentages or material behavior. Assume dry soil 1000 kg and water 250 kg; moisture content is 25%, while water is 20% of the 1250 kg wet mass. Confusing wet and dry bases misstates conditioning water, while chamber and belt samples may lose different amounts. The resulting inconsistency can be wrongly attributed to unstable additive performance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Moisture-basis conversion” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「乾基含水率與水占濕土重量比例永遠可以互換。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Dry-basis moisture content and water fraction of wet mass are always interchangeable." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「含水率基準轉換」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Moisture-basis conversion”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Geotechnical moisture content divides water mass by dry soil mass, unlike wet-mass fraction. Conditioning depends on mineralogy and initial water, requiring a consistent mass basis before comparing addition percentages or material behavior.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：乾基含水率與水占濕土重量比例永遠可以互換。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Dry-basis moisture content and water fraction of wet mass are always interchangeable. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「含水率基準轉換」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Moisture-basis conversion" is correct?
options: 乾基含水率與水占濕土重量比例永遠可以互換。
常壓泡沫體積就是進入加壓土倉後的有效氣體體積。
土壤含水率通常以水重除乾土重，與水占濕土總重比例不同。
optionsEn: Dry-basis moisture content and water fraction of wet mass are always interchangeable.
Atmospheric foam volume equals its effective gas volume inside the pressurized chamber.
Geotechnical moisture content divides water mass by dry soil mass, unlike wet-mass fraction.
quiz.explanation: 土壤含水率通常以水重除乾土重，與水占濕土總重比例不同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Geotechnical moisture content divides water mass by dry soil mass, unlike wet-mass fraction. The other options are common misconceptions.

knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume dry soil 1000 kg and water 250 kg; moisture content is 25%, while water is 20% of the 1250 kg wet mass.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「含水率基準轉換」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Moisture-basis conversion", which statement holds?
options: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
單一剪切速率的黏度足以代表停放和重啟流變行為。
添加總量達標就證明各區材料分布一定均勻。
optionsEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
Viscosity at one shear rate fully represents rest and restart rheology.
Meeting the total addition quantity proves uniform distribution throughout the chamber.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 含水率基準轉換：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Moisture-basis conversion: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「含水率基準轉換」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Moisture-basis conversion” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以烘乾或適用快速方法核對水量，將原土含水、加水和其他液體分欄；抽樣位置與時間需對齊出土資料，設計者只有在基準和代表性清楚後才比較不同配比試驗。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把濕基百分比當乾基會錯估改良水量，倉內土與皮帶土失水程度不同又造成比較偏差；誤差可能被錯怪為添加劑性能不穩定。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check water using drying or an appropriate rapid method and separate original moisture, added water and other liquids; align sampling location and time with discharge before designers compare trial mixtures on a common representative basis. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Confusing wet and dry bases misstates conditioning water, while chamber and belt samples may lose different amounts. The resulting inconsistency can be wrongly attributed to unstable additive performance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄含水率基準轉換的資料來源與適用條件。以烘乾或適用快速方法核對水量，將原土含水、加水和其他液體分欄；抽樣位置與時間需對齊出土資料，設計者只有在基準和代表性清楚後才比較不同配比試驗。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for moisture-basis conversion. Check water using drying or an appropriate rapid method and separate original moisture, added water and other liquids; align sampling location and time with discharge before designers compare trial mixtures on a common representative basis.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把濕基百分比當乾基會錯估改良水量，倉內土與皮帶土失水程度不同又造成比較偏差；誤差可能被錯怪為添加劑性能不穩定。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Confusing wet and dry bases misstates conditioning water, while chamber and belt samples may lose different amounts. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Confusing wet and dry bases misstates conditioning water, while chamber and belt samples may lose different amounts. The resulting inconsistency can be wrongly attributed to unstable additive performance.

quiz.question: 要驗證「含水率基準轉換」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Moisture-basis conversion"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以烘乾或適用快速方法核對水量，將原土含水、加水和其他液體分欄；抽樣位置與時間需對齊出土資料，設計者只有在基準和代表性清楚後才比較不同配比試驗。
材料短時試驗合格就保證任何溫度和停放時間都相容。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Check water using drying or an appropriate rapid method and separate original moisture, added water and other liquids.
Passing a short trial guarantees compatibility at every temperature and storage duration.
quiz.explanation: 以烘乾或適用快速方法核對水量，將原土含水、加水和其他液體分欄；抽樣位置與時間需對齊出土資料，設計者只有在基準和代表性清楚後才比較不同配比試驗。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check water using drying or an appropriate rapid method and separate original moisture, added water and other liquids; align sampling location and time with discharge before designers compare trial mixtures on a common representative basis. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 含水率基準轉換：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Moisture-basis conversion: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「含水率基準轉換」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Moisture-basis conversion” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把濕基百分比當乾基會錯估改良水量，倉內土與皮帶土失水程度不同又造成比較偏差；誤差可能被錯怪為添加劑性能不穩定。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Confusing wet and dry bases misstates conditioning water, while chamber and belt samples may lose different amounts. The resulting inconsistency can be wrongly attributed to unstable additive performance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把濕基百分比當乾基會錯估改良水量，倉內土與皮帶土失水程度不同又造成比較偏差；誤差可能被錯怪為添加劑性能不穩定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The resulting inconsistency can be wrongly attributed to unstable additive performance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「乾基含水率與水占濕土重量比例永遠可以互換。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Dry-basis moisture content and water fraction of wet mass are always interchangeable." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把濕基百分比當乾基會錯估改良水量，倉內土與皮帶土失水程度不同又造成比較偏差；誤差可能被錯怪為添加劑性能不穩定。
knowledge.textEn: Confusing wet and dry bases misstates conditioning water, while chamber and belt samples may lose different amounts. The resulting inconsistency can be wrongly attributed to unstable additive performance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「含水率基準轉換」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Moisture-basis conversion" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
常壓泡沫體積就是進入加壓土倉後的有效氣體體積。
把濕基百分比當乾基會錯估改良水量，倉內土與皮帶土失水程度不同又造成比較偏差；誤差可能被錯怪為添加劑性能不穩定。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Atmospheric foam volume equals its effective gas volume inside the pressurized chamber.
Confusing wet and dry bases misstates conditioning water, while chamber and belt samples may lose different amounts.
quiz.explanation: 把濕基百分比當乾基會錯估改良水量，倉內土與皮帶土失水程度不同又造成比較偏差；誤差可能被錯怪為添加劑性能不穩定。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Confusing wet and dry bases misstates conditioning water, while chamber and belt samples may lose different amounts. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「泡沫體積與壓縮」與「粒徑與細料作用」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Foam volume and compression" and "Grading and fines behavior": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 泡沫體積與壓縮：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Foam volume and compression: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「泡沫體積與壓縮」如何影響土壓平衡潛盾土壤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Foam volume and compression” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ground conditioning for EPB tunneling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 泡沫含大量可壓縮氣體，地面量測體積進入加壓土倉後會縮小，故體積比需說明壓力基準。氣泡穩定性和土粒吸附另會改變時間行為，理想氣體換算只提供第一層量級檢查。 假設等溫理想氣體由絕對壓100增至300 kPa，初始氣體3 m³縮至1 m³；液相體積未計。 使用表壓代替絕對壓會造成嚴重壓縮換算錯誤，忽略破泡又會高估可用氣泡；控制系統以錯誤體積基準比較時可能誤判材料不足或過量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「泡沫體積與壓縮」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Foam contains compressible gas, so atmospheric volume shrinks in a pressurized chamber and every volumetric ratio needs a pressure reference. Stability and particle interaction add time effects beyond a first-order ideal-gas check. Assume isothermal ideal gas compressed from absolute 100 to 300 kPa; 3 m³ becomes 1 m³, excluding liquid volume. Using gauge instead of absolute pressure corrupts compression calculations, while ignored collapse overstates available bubbles. A control comparison on the wrong volume basis can falsely indicate shortage or excess conditioning. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Foam volume and compression” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「常壓泡沫體積就是進入加壓土倉後的有效氣體體積。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Atmospheric foam volume equals its effective gas volume inside the pressurized chamber." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「泡沫體積與壓縮」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Foam volume and compression”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 泡沫體積與壓縮
knowledge.text: 泡沫含大量可壓縮氣體，地面量測體積進入加壓土倉後會縮小，故體積比需說明壓力基準。氣泡穩定性和土粒吸附另會改變時間行為，理想氣體換算只提供第一層量級檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Foam contains compressible gas, so atmospheric volume shrinks in a pressurized chamber and every volumetric ratio needs a pressure reference. Stability and particle interaction add time effects beyond a first-order ideal-gas check.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：常壓泡沫體積就是進入加壓土倉後的有效氣體體積。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Atmospheric foam volume equals its effective gas volume inside the pressurized chamber. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「泡沫體積與壓縮」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Foam volume and compression" is correct?
options: 泡沫含大量可壓縮氣體，地面量測體積進入加壓土倉後會縮小，故體積比需說明壓力基準。
常壓泡沫體積就是進入加壓土倉後的有效氣體體積。
細料百分比相同的土一定具有相同塑性和改良需求。
optionsEn: Foam contains compressible gas, so atmospheric volume shrinks in a pressurized chamber and every volumetric ratio needs a pressure reference.
Atmospheric foam volume equals its effective gas volume inside the pressurized chamber.
Soils with equal fines content necessarily have equal plasticity and conditioning needs.
quiz.explanation: 泡沫含大量可壓縮氣體，地面量測體積進入加壓土倉後會縮小，故體積比需說明壓力基準。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Foam contains compressible gas, so atmospheric volume shrinks in a pressurized chamber and every volumetric ratio needs a pressure reference. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 泡沫體積與壓縮：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Foam volume and compression: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「泡沫體積與壓縮」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Foam volume and compression” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設等溫理想氣體由絕對壓100增至300 kPa，初始氣體3 m³縮至1 m³；液相體積未計。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume isothermal ideal gas compressed from absolute 100 to 300 kPa; 3 m³ becomes 1 m³, excluding liquid volume. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對流量計量測位置、壓力種類及泡沫氣液比例，使用合格試驗觀察加壓後的穩定性；所有體積比附標準狀態，不能把常壓泡沫量直接當倉內有效體積。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check meter location, pressure convention and gas-liquid proportion and assess pressurized stability through qualified testing; attach reference conditions to volume ratios rather than equating atmospheric foam volume with effective chamber volume.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設等溫理想氣體由絕對壓100增至300 kPa，初始氣體3 m³縮至1 m³；液相體積未計。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume isothermal ideal gas compressed from absolute 100 to 300 kPa; 3 m³ becomes 1 m³, excluding liquid volume.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 泡沫體積與壓縮：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Foam volume and compression: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「泡沫體積與壓縮」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Foam volume and compression” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對流量計量測位置、壓力種類及泡沫氣液比例，使用合格試驗觀察加壓後的穩定性；所有體積比附標準狀態，不能把常壓泡沫量直接當倉內有效體積。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：使用表壓代替絕對壓會造成嚴重壓縮換算錯誤，忽略破泡又會高估可用氣泡；控制系統以錯誤體積基準比較時可能誤判材料不足或過量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check meter location, pressure convention and gas-liquid proportion and assess pressurized stability through qualified testing; attach reference conditions to volume ratios rather than equating atmospheric foam volume with effective chamber volume. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Using gauge instead of absolute pressure corrupts compression calculations, while ignored collapse overstates available bubbles. A control comparison on the wrong volume basis can falsely indicate shortage or excess conditioning. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Check meter location, pressure convention and gas-liquid proportion and assess pressurized stability through qualified testing; attach reference conditions to volume ratios rather than equating atmospheric foam volume with effective chamber volume.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：使用表壓代替絕對壓會造成嚴重壓縮換算錯誤，忽略破泡又會高估可用氣泡；控制系統以錯誤體積基準比較時可能誤判材料不足或過量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.title: 泡沫體積與壓縮：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Foam volume and compression: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「泡沫體積與壓縮」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Foam volume and compression” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 使用表壓代替絕對壓會造成嚴重壓縮換算錯誤，忽略破泡又會高估可用氣泡；控制系統以錯誤體積基準比較時可能誤判材料不足或過量。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using gauge instead of absolute pressure corrupts compression calculations, while ignored collapse overstates available bubbles. A control comparison on the wrong volume basis can falsely indicate shortage or excess conditioning. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用表壓代替絕對壓會造成嚴重壓縮換算錯誤，忽略破泡又會高估可用氣泡；控制系統以錯誤體積基準比較時可能誤判材料不足或過量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A control comparison on the wrong volume basis can falsely indicate shortage or excess conditioning.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「常壓泡沫體積就是進入加壓土倉後的有效氣體體積。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Atmospheric foam volume equals its effective gas volume inside the pressurized chamber." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 粒徑與細料作用：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Grading and fines behavior: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「粒徑與細料作用」如何影響土壓平衡潛盾土壤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Grading and fines behavior” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ground conditioning for EPB tunneling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 細料影響漿體連續性與滲透，大顆粒則影響攪拌和通過能力，但相同細料百分比的礦物活性可以不同。級配分析應連到塑性與磨蝕性，不能以一條粒徑曲線決定全部改良需求。 假設乾樣2 kg中通過指定篩0.6 kg，細料比例30%；篩孔尺寸必須一併註明。 只取細膩易裝袋土會漏掉粗礫與硬塊，試驗流變因此過度理想；碰到混合面時堵塞或磨耗突然增加，原先配比試驗便無法解釋。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「粒徑與細料作用」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Fines affect matrix continuity and permeability while coarse particles affect mixing and passage. Equal fines percentages can have different mineral activity, so grading must be linked to plasticity and abrasivity rather than determining conditioning alone. For an assumed 2 kg dry sample with 0.6 kg passing a specified sieve, fines content is 30%; the sieve aperture must accompany the value. Sampling only easily bagged fine soil misses gravel and blocks, producing unrealistically favorable workability. Sudden blockage or wear in mixed ground then lies outside the original trial's representation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Grading and fines behavior” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「細料百分比相同的土一定具有相同塑性和改良需求。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Soils with equal fines content necessarily have equal plasticity and conditioning needs." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「粒徑與細料作用」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Grading and fines behavior”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 粒徑與細料作用
knowledge.text: 細料影響漿體連續性與滲透，大顆粒則影響攪拌和通過能力，但相同細料百分比的礦物活性可以不同。級配分析應連到塑性與磨蝕性，不能以一條粒徑曲線決定全部改良需求。
knowledge.textEn: Fines affect matrix continuity and permeability while coarse particles affect mixing and passage. Equal fines percentages can have different mineral activity, so grading must be linked to plasticity and abrasivity rather than determining conditioning alone.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：細料百分比相同的土一定具有相同塑性和改良需求。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Soils with equal fines content necessarily have equal plasticity and conditioning needs. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「粒徑與細料作用」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Grading and fines behavior" is correct?
options: 細料百分比相同的土一定具有相同塑性和改良需求。
細料影響漿體連續性與滲透，大顆粒則影響攪拌和通過能力，但相同細料百分比的礦物活性可以不同。
單一剪切速率的黏度足以代表停放和重啟流變行為。
optionsEn: Soils with equal fines content necessarily have equal plasticity and conditioning needs.
Fines affect matrix continuity and permeability while coarse particles affect mixing and passage.
Viscosity at one shear rate fully represents rest and restart rheology.
quiz.explanation: 細料影響漿體連續性與滲透，大顆粒則影響攪拌和通過能力，但相同細料百分比的礦物活性可以不同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Fines affect matrix continuity and permeability while coarse particles affect mixing and passage. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.titleEn: Grading and fines behavior: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「粒徑與細料作用」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設乾樣2 kg中通過指定篩0.6 kg，細料比例30%；篩孔尺寸必須一併註明。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed 2 kg dry sample with 0.6 kg passing a specified sieve, fines content is 30%; the sieve aperture must accompany the value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：保存篩分、沉降與塑性試驗方法，對不同地層分別取樣並檢查粗粒是否在取樣時被排除；代表性評估需覆蓋過渡帶，試驗主管確認樣本能反映實際進倉土。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Document grading and plasticity methods, sampling layers separately and checking whether coarse particles were excluded during collection; include transition zones and obtain laboratory review of representativeness for chamber material.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.failure: 注意干擾：只取細膩易裝袋土會漏掉粗礫與硬塊，試驗流變因此過度理想；碰到混合面時堵塞或磨耗突然增加，原先配比試驗便無法解釋。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

knowledge.textEn: Document grading and plasticity methods, sampling layers separately and checking whether coarse particles were excluded during collection; include transition zones and obtain laboratory review of representativeness for chamber material. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Sampling only easily bagged fine soil misses gravel and blocks, producing unrealistically favorable workability. Sudden blockage or wear in mixed ground then lies outside the original trial's representation.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄粒徑與細料作用的資料來源與適用條件。保存篩分、沉降與塑性試驗方法，對不同地層分別取樣並檢查粗粒是否在取樣時被排除；代表性評估需覆蓋過渡帶，試驗主管確認樣本能反映實際進倉土。

Document grading and plasticity methods, sampling layers separately and checking whether coarse particles were excluded during collection; include transition zones and obtain laboratory review of representativeness for chamber material.

quiz.question: 要驗證「粒徑與細料作用」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Grading and fines behavior"?
options: 保存篩分、沉降與塑性試驗方法，對不同地層分別取樣並檢查粗粒是否在取樣時被排除；代表性評估需覆蓋過渡帶，試驗主管確認樣本能反映實際進倉土。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
改良土越稀越容易流動，就一定越有利於穩定支護。
optionsEn: Document grading and plasticity methods, sampling layers separately and checking whether coarse particles were excluded during collection.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
More fluid conditioned soil is necessarily better for stable face support.
quiz.explanation: 保存篩分、沉降與塑性試驗方法，對不同地層分別取樣並檢查粗粒是否在取樣時被排除；代表性評估需覆蓋過渡帶，試驗主管確認樣本能反映實際進倉土。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Document grading and plasticity methods, sampling layers separately and checking whether coarse particles were excluded during collection; include transition zones and obtain laboratory review of representativeness for chamber material. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 粒徑與細料作用：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Grading and fines behavior: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「粒徑與細料作用」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Grading and fines behavior” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只取細膩易裝袋土會漏掉粗礫與硬塊，試驗流變因此過度理想；碰到混合面時堵塞或磨耗突然增加，原先配比試驗便無法解釋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sampling only easily bagged fine soil misses gravel and blocks, producing unrealistically favorable workability. Sudden blockage or wear in mixed ground then lies outside the original trial's representation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只取細膩易裝袋土會漏掉粗礫與硬塊，試驗流變因此過度理想；碰到混合面時堵塞或磨耗突然增加，原先配比試驗便無法解釋。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Sudden blockage or wear in mixed ground then lies outside the original trial's representation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「細料百分比相同的土一定具有相同塑性和改良需求。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Soils with equal fines content necessarily have equal plasticity and conditioning needs." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只取細膩易裝袋土會漏掉粗礫與硬塊，試驗流變因此過度理想；碰到混合面時堵塞或磨耗突然增加，原先配比試驗便無法解釋。
knowledge.textEn: Sampling only easily bagged fine soil misses gravel and blocks, producing unrealistically favorable workability. Sudden blockage or wear in mixed ground then lies outside the original trial's representation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「粒徑與細料作用」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Grading and fines behavior" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只取細膩易裝袋土會漏掉粗礫與硬塊，試驗流變因此過度理想；碰到混合面時堵塞或磨耗突然增加，原先配比試驗便無法解釋。
單一剪切速率的黏度足以代表停放和重啟流變行為。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Sampling only easily bagged fine soil misses gravel and blocks, producing unrealistically favorable workability.
Viscosity at one shear rate fully represents rest and restart rheology.
quiz.explanation: 只取細膩易裝袋土會漏掉粗礫與硬塊，試驗流變因此過度理想；碰到混合面時堵塞或磨耗突然增加，原先配比試驗便無法解釋。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Sampling only easily bagged fine soil misses gravel and blocks, producing unrealistically favorable workability. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「流變屈服與黏度」與「扭矩功率與能耗」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Yield stress and viscosity" and "Torque power and energy": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 流變屈服與黏度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Yield stress and viscosity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「流變屈服與黏度」如何影響土壓平衡潛盾土壤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Yield stress and viscosity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ground conditioning for EPB tunneling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 改良土可能需超過屈服應力才開始流動，之後流動阻力仍隨剪切速率改變。單點黏度不能代表整條流動曲線，且停放後觸變恢復使重新啟動條件不同於持續攪拌。 假設Bingham示意τy=2 kPa、μp=0.5 kPa·s、剪率4 s⁻¹，τ=τy+μpγ̇=4 kPa。 把停放後的高屈服應力當成永久變稠會導致錯誤添加，反之持續攪拌試驗又可能低估重啟阻力；缺乏歷程的數字沒有可比較意義。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「流變屈服與黏度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Conditioned ground may require a yield stress before flowing and then resist flow differently with shear rate. One viscosity value cannot represent the curve, and thixotropic recovery during rest makes restart differ from continued mixing. For assumed Bingham values τy=2 kPa, μp=0.5 kPa·s and shear rate 4 s⁻¹, τ=τy+μpγ̇=4 kPa. Treating post-rest yield increase as permanent thickening can prompt incorrect additions, while continuously mixed tests understate restart resistance. Values without shear history are not meaningfully comparable. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Yield stress and viscosity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「單一剪切速率的黏度足以代表停放和重啟流變行為。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Viscosity at one shear rate fully represents rest and restart rheology." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「流變屈服與黏度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Yield stress and viscosity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 流變屈服與黏度
knowledge.text: 改良土可能需超過屈服應力才開始流動，之後流動阻力仍隨剪切速率改變。單點黏度不能代表整條流動曲線，且停放後觸變恢復使重新啟動條件不同於持續攪拌。
knowledge.textEn: Conditioned ground may require a yield stress before flowing and then resist flow differently with shear rate. One viscosity value cannot represent the curve, and thixotropic recovery during rest makes restart differ from continued mixing.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：單一剪切速率的黏度足以代表停放和重啟流變行為。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Viscosity at one shear rate fully represents rest and restart rheology. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「流變屈服與黏度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Yield stress and viscosity" is correct?
options: 單一剪切速率的黏度足以代表停放和重啟流變行為。
刀盤功率降低就能證明改良成功，不必看進尺和地質。
改良土可能需超過屈服應力才開始流動，之後流動阻力仍隨剪切速率改變。
optionsEn: Viscosity at one shear rate fully represents rest and restart rheology.
Lower cutterhead power proves successful conditioning without checking advance or geology.
Conditioned ground may require a yield stress before flowing and then resist flow differently with shear rate.
quiz.explanation: 改良土可能需超過屈服應力才開始流動，之後流動阻力仍隨剪切速率改變。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Conditioned ground may require a yield stress before flowing and then resist flow differently with shear rate. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 流變屈服與黏度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Yield stress and viscosity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「流變屈服與黏度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Yield stress and viscosity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設Bingham示意τy=2 kPa、μp=0.5 kPa·s、剪率4 s⁻¹，τ=τy+μpγ̇=4 kPa。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed Bingham values τy=2 kPa, μp=0.5 kPa·s and shear rate 4 s⁻¹, τ=τy+μpγ̇=4 kPa. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在適合粗粒尺度的試驗裝置量測多剪率及停放再啟動曲線，記錄溫度和歷程；比較模型殘差與重複性，只有校準範圍內才可用該式描述，不能直接換算機器扭矩指令。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure multiple shear rates and rest-restart curves in equipment appropriate to particle size, recording temperature and history; use the model only within calibrated behavior and never convert it directly into a machine torque instruction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設Bingham示意τy=2 kPa、μp=0.5 kPa·s、剪率4 s⁻¹，τ=τy+μpγ̇=4 kPa。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed Bingham values τy=2 kPa, μp=0.5 kPa·s and shear rate 4 s⁻¹, τ=τy+μpγ̇=4 kPa.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「流變屈服與黏度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Yield stress and viscosity", which statement holds?
options: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
試驗流量測不到就證明改良土真正完全不透水。
只保留最成功配比試驗就足以說明改良方案適用範圍。
optionsEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
Undetectable test flow proves that conditioned soil has exactly zero permeability.
Retaining only the most successful trial fully describes the conditioning scheme's applicability.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 流變屈服與黏度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Yield stress and viscosity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「流變屈服與黏度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Yield stress and viscosity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在適合粗粒尺度的試驗裝置量測多剪率及停放再啟動曲線，記錄溫度和歷程；比較模型殘差與重複性，只有校準範圍內才可用該式描述，不能直接換算機器扭矩指令。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把停放後的高屈服應力當成永久變稠會導致錯誤添加，反之持續攪拌試驗又可能低估重啟阻力；缺乏歷程的數字沒有可比較意義。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure multiple shear rates and rest-restart curves in equipment appropriate to particle size, recording temperature and history; use the model only within calibrated behavior and never convert it directly into a machine torque instruction. steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for yield stress and viscosity. Measure multiple shear rates and rest-restart curves in equipment appropriate to particle size, recording temperature and history; use the model only within calibrated behavior and never convert it directly into a machine torque instruction.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把停放後的高屈服應力當成永久變稠會導致錯誤添加，反之持續攪拌試驗又可能低估重啟阻力；缺乏歷程的數字沒有可比較意義。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在適合粗粒尺度的試驗裝置量測多剪率及停放再啟動曲線，記錄溫度和歷程；比較模型殘差與重複性，只有校準範圍內才可用該式描述，不能直接換算機器扭矩指令。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把停放後的高屈服應力當成永久變稠會導致錯誤添加，反之持續攪拌試驗又可能低估重啟阻力；缺乏歷程的數字沒有可比較意義。
knowledge.textEn: Measure multiple shear rates and rest-restart curves in equipment appropriate to particle size, recording temperature and history; use the model only within calibrated behavior and never convert it directly into a machine torque instruction. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Treating post-rest yield increase as permanent thickening can prompt incorrect additions, while continuously mixed tests understate restart resistance. steps.instruction: 刀盤功率等於扭矩乘角速度，能源變化可提示磨耗、黏附或材料改良差異，但也受地層強度和推進量影響。將能耗按開挖體積規一化才能做較公平的比較，仍不能單獨確定成因。 假設扭矩1 MN·m、轉速2 rpm，P=T×2πn/60=209.4 kW；非額定能力或推薦轉速。 低功率可能來自低進尺而非改良成功，高功率也可能是新硬層而非泡沫不足；若無地質和產量校正，控制調整會追逐錯誤訊號。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「扭矩功率與能耗」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cutterhead power is torque times angular speed. Changes may indicate wear, adhesion or conditioning, but also strength and penetration. Low power may reflect reduced excavation rather than successful conditioning, and high power may reflect harder ground rather than insufficient foam. Without geology and production correction, adjustments chase the wrong signal. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Torque power and energy” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

For assumed torque 1 MN·m and speed 2 rpm, P=T×2πn/60=209.4 kW; these are neither ratings nor recommended settings. steps.titleEn: Torque power and energy: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「扭矩功率與能耗」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Torque power and energy” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 低功率可能來自低進尺而非改良成功，高功率也可能是新硬層而非泡沫不足；若無地質和產量校正，控制調整會追逐錯誤訊號。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Low power may reflect reduced excavation rather than successful conditioning, and high power may reflect harder ground rather than insufficient foam. Without geology and production correction, adjustments chase the wrong signal. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：低功率可能來自低進尺而非改良成功，高功率也可能是新硬層而非泡沫不足；若無地質和產量校正，控制調整會追逐錯誤訊號。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Without geology and production correction, adjustments chase the wrong signal.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「刀盤功率降低就能證明改良成功，不必看進尺和地質。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Lower cutterhead power proves successful conditioning without checking advance or geology." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 低功率可能來自低進尺而非改良成功，高功率也可能是新硬層而非泡沫不足；若無地質和產量校正，控制調整會追逐錯誤訊號。
knowledge.textEn: Low power may reflect reduced excavation rather than successful conditioning, and high power may reflect harder ground rather than insufficient foam. Without geology and production correction, adjustments chase the wrong signal.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「扭矩功率與能耗」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Torque power and energy" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 低功率可能來自低進尺而非改良成功，高功率也可能是新硬層而非泡沫不足；若無地質和產量校正，控制調整會追逐錯誤訊號。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
添加總量達標就證明各區材料分布一定均勻。
optionsEn: Low power may reflect reduced excavation rather than successful conditioning, and high power may reflect harder ground rather than insufficient foam.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Meeting the total addition quantity proves uniform distribution throughout the chamber.
quiz.explanation: 低功率可能來自低進尺而非改良成功，高功率也可能是新硬層而非泡沫不足；若無地質和產量校正，控制調整會追逐錯誤訊號。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Low power may reflect reduced excavation rather than successful conditioning, and high power may reflect harder ground rather than insufficient foam. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「添加收支與混合均勻」與「滲透與壓力保持」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Addition balance and mixing uniformity" and "Permeability and pressure retention": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 添加收支與混合均勻：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Addition balance and mixing uniformity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「添加收支與混合均勻」如何影響土壓平衡潛盾土壤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Addition balance and mixing uniformity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ground conditioning for EPB tunneling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 添加物總量不代表全倉分布均勻，噴口阻塞或混合死角會造成局部乾團與稀漿並存。收支需按時間與原土體積對齊，並以多位置樣本檢查離散，不能只看泵浦累計量。 假設一段原土40 m³加入液體2 m³，體積比5%；此示意不指定任何材料配方。 總量達標但部分噴口失效仍會造成局部失控，時間對錯環則使每環比值失真；將差異全歸於土質可能掩蓋可修復的設備問題。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「添加收支與混合均勻」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Total additive volume does not prove uniform chamber distribution. Blocked delivery or dead zones can leave dry lumps beside dilute slurry. Align quantities with original-soil volume and time and check spatial variability, not only pump totals. An assumed 2 m³ of liquid added to 40 m³ of original ground gives a 5% ratio; this illustration specifies no material recipe. Adequate totals with failed outlets still produce local problems, and assigning delayed delivery to the wrong ring distorts ratios. Blaming all variability on soil can conceal a correctable equipment fault. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Addition balance and mixing uniformity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「添加總量達標就證明各區材料分布一定均勻。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Meeting the total addition quantity proves uniform distribution throughout the chamber." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「添加收支與混合均勻」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Addition balance and mixing uniformity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 添加收支與混合均勻
knowledge.text: 添加物總量不代表全倉分布均勻，噴口阻塞或混合死角會造成局部乾團與稀漿並存。收支需按時間與原土體積對齊，並以多位置樣本檢查離散，不能只看泵浦累計量。
knowledge.textEn: Total additive volume does not prove uniform chamber distribution. Blocked delivery or dead zones can leave dry lumps beside dilute slurry.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：添加總量達標就證明各區材料分布一定均勻。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Meeting the total addition quantity proves uniform distribution throughout the chamber. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「添加收支與混合均勻」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Addition balance and mixing uniformity" is correct?
options: 添加總量達標就證明各區材料分布一定均勻。
添加物總量不代表全倉分布均勻，噴口阻塞或混合死角會造成局部乾團與稀漿並存。
試驗流量測不到就證明改良土真正完全不透水。
optionsEn: Meeting the total addition quantity proves uniform distribution throughout the chamber.
Total additive volume does not prove uniform chamber distribution.
Undetectable test flow proves that conditioned soil has exactly zero permeability.
quiz.explanation: 添加物總量不代表全倉分布均勻，噴口阻塞或混合死角會造成局部乾團與稀漿並存。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Total additive volume does not prove uniform chamber distribution. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 添加收支與混合均勻：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Addition balance and mixing uniformity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「添加收支與混合均勻」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Addition balance and mixing uniformity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設一段原土40 m³加入液體2 m³，體積比5%；此示意不指定任何材料配方。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed 2 m³ of liquid added to 40 m³ of original ground gives a 5% ratio; this illustration specifies no material recipe. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以儲槽變化和流量計交叉核對添加量，檢查輸送延遲與管線殘留；多點抽樣比較含水和可塑性，異常分布須先查設備路徑，再由專業團隊評估試驗配比。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Cross-check additions using tank levels and meters and account for delivery delay and retained line contents; compare moisture and workability across samples, investigating delivery paths before specialists reconsider trial proportions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設一段原土40 m³加入液體2 m³，體積比5%；此示意不指定任何材料配方。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed 2 m³ of liquid added to 40 m³ of original ground gives a 5% ratio; this illustration specifies no material recipe.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「添加收支與混合均勻」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Addition balance and mixing uniformity", which statement holds?
options: 只保留最成功配比試驗就足以說明改良方案適用範圍。
乾基含水率與水占濕土重量比例永遠可以互換。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: Retaining only the most successful trial fully describes the conditioning scheme's applicability.
Dry-basis moisture content and water fraction of wet mass are always interchangeable.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 添加收支與混合均勻：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Addition balance and mixing uniformity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「添加收支與混合均勻」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Addition balance and mixing uniformity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以儲槽變化和流量計交叉核對添加量，檢查輸送延遲與管線殘留；多點抽樣比較含水和可塑性，異常分布須先查設備路徑，再由專業團隊評估試驗配比。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：總量達標但部分噴口失效仍會造成局部失控，時間對錯環則使每環比值失真；將差異全歸於土質可能掩蓋可修復的設備問題。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Cross-check additions using tank levels and meters and account for delivery delay and retained line contents; compare moisture and workability across samples, investigating delivery paths before specialists reconsider trial proportions. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Adequate totals with failed outlets still produce local problems, and assigning delayed delivery to the wrong ring distorts ratios. Blaming all variability on soil can conceal a correctable equipment fault. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄添加收支與混合均勻的資料來源與適用條件。以儲槽變化和流量計交叉核對添加量，檢查輸送延遲與管線殘留；多點抽樣比較含水和可塑性，異常分布須先查設備路徑，再由專業團隊評估試驗配比。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for addition balance and mixing uniformity. Cross-check additions using tank levels and meters and account for delivery delay and retained line contents; compare moisture and workability across samples, investigating delivery paths before specialists reconsider trial proportions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：總量達標但部分噴口失效仍會造成局部失控，時間對錯環則使每環比值失真；將差異全歸於土質可能掩蓋可修復的設備問題。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Adequate totals with failed outlets still produce local problems, and assigning delayed delivery to the wrong ring distorts ratios. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以儲槽變化和流量計交叉核對添加量，檢查輸送延遲與管線殘留；多點抽樣比較含水和可塑性，異常分布須先查設備路徑，再由專業團隊評估試驗配比。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：總量達標但部分噴口失效仍會造成局部失控，時間對錯環則使每環比值失真；將差異全歸於土質可能掩蓋可修復的設備問題。
knowledge.textEn: Cross-check additions using tank levels and meters and account for delivery delay and retained line contents; compare moisture and workability across samples, investigating delivery paths before specialists reconsider trial proportions. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Adequate totals with failed outlets still produce local problems, and assigning delayed delivery to the wrong ring distorts ratios. Blaming all variability on soil can conceal a correctable equipment fault.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄添加收支與混合均勻的資料來源與適用條件。以儲槽變化和流量計交叉核對添加量，檢查輸送延遲與管線殘留；多點抽樣比較含水和可塑性，異常分布須先查設備路徑，再由專業團隊評估試驗配比。

quiz.question: 要驗證「添加收支與混合均勻」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Addition balance and mixing uniformity"?
options: 以儲槽變化和流量計交叉核對添加量，檢查輸送延遲與管線殘留；多點抽樣比較含水和可塑性，異常分布須先查設備路徑，再由專業團隊評估試驗配比。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
細料百分比相同的土一定具有相同塑性和改良需求。
optionsEn: Cross-check additions using tank levels and meters and account for delivery delay and retained line contents.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Soils with equal fines content necessarily have equal plasticity and conditioning needs.
quiz.explanation: 以儲槽變化和流量計交叉核對添加量，檢查輸送延遲與管線殘留；多點抽樣比較含水和可塑性，異常分布須先查設備路徑，再由專業團隊評估試驗配比。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Cross-check additions using tank levels and meters and account for delivery delay and retained line contents; compare moisture and workability across samples, investigating delivery paths before specialists reconsider trial proportions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume k=10⁻⁷ m/s, area 0.01 m² and gradient 10; Q=10⁻⁸ m³/s=0.0006 L/min, requiring sufficient sensitivity. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
