stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「老化與環境相容」與「改良試驗到現場移交」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Aging and environmental compatibility" and "Conditioning trials and field handover": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 老化與環境相容：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Aging and environmental compatibility: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「老化與環境相容」如何影響土壓平衡潛盾土壤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Aging and environmental compatibility” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ground conditioning for EPB tunneling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 改良材料在土中會受時間、溫度、水質與吸附影響，短時工作性未必維持到運輸或處理。工程性能與廢土處理相互關聯，應使用經核准的相容性和環境資料，而非只追求瞬間低扭矩。 假設同法試驗初始流動指標100、2 h後80，保留比例80%；這是任意指標示例而非材料規格。 材料短期有效卻在停放後分離會使重啟困難，處理場又可能面臨不相容廢土；只記產品名稱而不記批次和水質，無法追查性能改變。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「老化與環境相容」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Time, temperature, water chemistry and adsorption change conditioned material, so immediate workability may not persist through handling or treatment. Engineering behavior and spoil management are linked and require approved compatibility and environmental evidence. An assumed identical-method flow index falling from 100 to 80 after 2 h has 80% retention; this arbitrary index is not a material specification. Material that separates during rest complicates restart and can create incompatible spoil for treatment. Product names without batch and water-chemistry records cannot trace the reason for changed performance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Aging and environmental compatibility” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「材料短時試驗合格就保證任何溫度和停放時間都相容。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Passing a short trial guarantees compatibility at every temperature and storage duration." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「老化與環境相容」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Aging and environmental compatibility”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 老化與環境相容
knowledge.text: 改良材料在土中會受時間、溫度、水質與吸附影響，短時工作性未必維持到運輸或處理。工程性能與廢土處理相互關聯，應使用經核准的相容性和環境資料，而非只追求瞬間低扭矩。
knowledge.textEn: Time, temperature, water chemistry and adsorption change conditioned material, so immediate workability may not persist through handling or treatment. Engineering behavior and spoil management are linked and require approved compatibility and environmental evidence.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：材料短時試驗合格就保證任何溫度和停放時間都相容。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Passing a short trial guarantees compatibility at every temperature and storage duration. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「老化與環境相容」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Aging and environmental compatibility" is correct?
options: 改良材料在土中會受時間、溫度、水質與吸附影響，短時工作性未必維持到運輸或處理。
材料短時試驗合格就保證任何溫度和停放時間都相容。
只保留最成功配比試驗就足以說明改良方案適用範圍。
optionsEn: Time, temperature, water chemistry and adsorption change conditioned material, so immediate workability may not persist through handling or treatment.
Passing a short trial guarantees compatibility at every temperature and storage duration.
Retaining only the most successful trial fully describes the conditioning scheme's applicability.
quiz.explanation: 改良材料在土中會受時間、溫度、水質與吸附影響，短時工作性未必維持到運輸或處理。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Time, temperature, water chemistry and adsorption change conditioned material, so immediate workability may not persist through handling or treatment. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 老化與環境相容：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Aging and environmental compatibility: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「老化與環境相容」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Aging and environmental compatibility” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設同法試驗初始流動指標100、2 h後80，保留比例80%；這是任意指標示例而非材料規格。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed identical-method flow index falling from 100 to 80 after 2 h has 80% retention; this arbitrary index is not a material specification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在代表性水質與溫度下做時間序列試驗，保留材料批號及合規文件，將土倉與廢土處理需求一起審查；任何產品使用由專業團隊依現場核准方案決定，本課不提供化學配方。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run time-series tests at representative temperature and water chemistry with batch and compliance records, reviewing chamber and spoil-treatment needs together; specialists select products under an approved site plan, without a chemical recipe from this course.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設同法試驗初始流動指標100、2 h後80，保留比例80%；這是任意指標示例而非材料規格。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed identical-method flow index falling from 100 to 80 after 2 h has 80% retention; this arbitrary index is not a material specification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「老化與環境相容」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Aging and environmental compatibility", which statement holds?
options: 乾基含水率與水占濕土重量比例永遠可以互換。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
細料百分比相同的土一定具有相同塑性和改良需求。
optionsEn: Dry-basis moisture content and water fraction of wet mass are always interchangeable.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
Soils with equal fines content necessarily have equal plasticity and conditioning needs.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 老化與環境相容：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Aging and environmental compatibility: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「老化與環境相容」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Aging and environmental compatibility” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在代表性水質與溫度下做時間序列試驗，保留材料批號及合規文件，將土倉與廢土處理需求一起審查；任何產品使用由專業團隊依現場核准方案決定，本課不提供化學配方。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：材料短期有效卻在停放後分離會使重啟困難，處理場又可能面臨不相容廢土；只記產品名稱而不記批次和水質，無法追查性能改變。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run time-series tests at representative temperature and water chemistry with batch and compliance records, reviewing chamber and spoil-treatment needs together; specialists select products under an approved site plan, without a chemical recipe from this course. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Material that separates during rest complicates restart and can create incompatible spoil for treatment. Product names without batch and water-chemistry records cannot trace the reason for changed performance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄老化與環境相容的資料來源與適用條件。在代表性水質與溫度下做時間序列試驗，保留材料批號及合規文件，將土倉與廢土處理需求一起審查；任何產品使用由專業團隊依現場核准方案決定，本課不提供化學配方。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for aging and environmental compatibility. Run time-series tests at representative temperature and water chemistry with batch and compliance records, reviewing chamber and spoil-treatment needs together; specialists select products under an approved site plan, without a chemical recipe from this course.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：材料短期有效卻在停放後分離會使重啟困難，處理場又可能面臨不相容廢土；只記產品名稱而不記批次和水質，無法追查性能改變。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Material that separates during rest complicates restart and can create incompatible spoil for treatment. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在代表性水質與溫度下做時間序列試驗，保留材料批號及合規文件，將土倉與廢土處理需求一起審查；任何產品使用由專業團隊依現場核准方案決定，本課不提供化學配方。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：材料短期有效卻在停放後分離會使重啟困難，處理場又可能面臨不相容廢土；只記產品名稱而不記批次和水質，無法追查性能改變。
knowledge.textEn: Run time-series tests at representative temperature and water chemistry with batch and compliance records, reviewing chamber and spoil-treatment needs together; specialists select products under an approved site plan, without a chemical recipe from this course. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Material that separates during rest complicates restart and can create incompatible spoil for treatment. Product names without batch and water-chemistry records cannot trace the reason for changed performance.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄老化與環境相容的資料來源與適用條件。在代表性水質與溫度下做時間序列試驗，保留材料批號及合規文件，將土倉與廢土處理需求一起審查；任何產品使用由專業團隊依現場核准方案決定，本課不提供化學配方。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for aging and environmental compatibility. Run time-series tests at representative temperature and water chemistry with batch and compliance records, reviewing chamber and spoil-treatment needs together; specialists select products under an approved site plan, without a chemical recipe from this course.

quiz.question: 要驗證「老化與環境相容」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Aging and environmental compatibility"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
刀盤功率降低就能證明改良成功，不必看進尺和地質。
在代表性水質與溫度下做時間序列試驗，保留材料批號及合規文件，將土倉與廢土處理需求一起審查；任何產品使用由專業團隊依現場核准方案決定，本課不提供化學配方。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Lower cutterhead power proves successful conditioning without checking advance or geology.
Run time-series tests at representative temperature and water chemistry with batch and compliance records, reviewing chamber and spoil-treatment needs together.
quiz.explanation: 在代表性水質與溫度下做時間序列試驗，保留材料批號及合規文件，將土倉與廢土處理需求一起審查；任何產品使用由專業團隊依現場核准方案決定，本課不提供化學配方。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Run time-series tests at representative temperature and water chemistry with batch and compliance records, reviewing chamber and spoil-treatment needs together; specialists select products under an approved site plan, without a chemical recipe from this course. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 老化與環境相容：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Aging and environmental compatibility: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「老化與環境相容」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Aging and environmental compatibility” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 材料短期有效卻在停放後分離會使重啟困難，處理場又可能面臨不相容廢土；只記產品名稱而不記批次和水質，無法追查性能改變。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Material that separates during rest complicates restart and can create incompatible spoil for treatment. Product names without batch and water-chemistry records cannot trace the reason for changed performance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：材料短期有效卻在停放後分離會使重啟困難，處理場又可能面臨不相容廢土；只記產品名稱而不記批次和水質，無法追查性能改變。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Product names without batch and water-chemistry records cannot trace the reason for changed performance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「材料短時試驗合格就保證任何溫度和停放時間都相容。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Passing a short trial guarantees compatibility at every temperature and storage duration." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 材料短期有效卻在停放後分離會使重啟困難，處理場又可能面臨不相容廢土；只記產品名稱而不記批次和水質，無法追查性能改變。
knowledge.textEn: Material that separates during rest complicates restart and can create incompatible spoil for treatment. Product names without batch and water-chemistry records cannot trace the reason for changed performance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「老化與環境相容」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Aging and environmental compatibility" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 材料短期有效卻在停放後分離會使重啟困難，處理場又可能面臨不相容廢土；只記產品名稱而不記批次和水質，無法追查性能改變。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
只保留最成功配比試驗就足以說明改良方案適用範圍。
optionsEn: Material that separates during rest complicates restart and can create incompatible spoil for treatment.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Retaining only the most successful trial fully describes the conditioning scheme's applicability.
quiz.explanation: 材料短期有效卻在停放後分離會使重啟困難，處理場又可能面臨不相容廢土；只記產品名稱而不記批次和水質，無法追查性能改變。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Material that separates during rest complicates restart and can create incompatible spoil for treatment. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 改良試驗到現場移交：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Conditioning trials and field handover: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「改良試驗到現場移交」如何影響土壓平衡潛盾土壤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Conditioning trials and field handover” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ground conditioning for EPB tunneling”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 小型試驗提供比較基礎，實際土倉有更大剪切、壓力與停留時間分布，尺度轉移須逐步驗證。交接應保留失敗組合及適用地層，不能只交最佳結果，讓下個班次知道何時原判斷不再成立。 假設12組試驗中8組符合預定雙重功能要求，比例66.7%；其餘4組仍需保留原因，不能刪除。 只挑成功試驗會掩蓋接近失效的邊界，跨地層仍沿用原方案則忽略材料變化；若沒有版本紀錄，性能異常時也無法判明採用哪一組假設。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「改良試驗到現場移交」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Small trials support comparisons, while a chamber has different shear, pressure and residence-time distributions. Scale transfer requires verification, including unsuccessful trials and applicable ground, so later shifts know when the original interpretation no longer holds. If 8 of an assumed 12 trials satisfy predefined dual-function requirements, the proportion is 66.7%; retain reasons for the other 4 rather than deleting them. Reporting only successful trials hides nearby failure boundaries, while transferring them across strata ignores changed material. Without version records, later anomalies cannot be linked to the assumptions actually in use. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Conditioning trials and field handover” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.

steps.title: 改良試驗到現場移交：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Conditioning trials and field handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「改良試驗到現場移交」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Conditioning trials and field handover” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設12組試驗中8組符合預定雙重功能要求，比例66.7%；其餘4組仍需保留原因，不能刪除。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 8 of an assumed 12 trials satisfy predefined dual-function requirements, the proportion is 66.7%; retain reasons for the other 4 rather than deleting them. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：交付土樣來源、試驗邊界、量測原檔與地層適用表，現場再核對壓力、出土與沉陷三類證據；改變方案需經地工與設備負責人共同審查，不用學徒算例直接控制機器。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Deliver sample origin, boundaries, raw measurements and applicable ground, then cross-check pressure, discharge and movement in the field; changes require joint geotechnical and equipment review, not direct control from an apprentice calculation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 改良試驗到現場移交：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Conditioning trials and field handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「改良試驗到現場移交」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Conditioning trials and field handover” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 交付土樣來源、試驗邊界、量測原檔與地層適用表，現場再核對壓力、出土與沉陷三類證據；改變方案需經地工與設備負責人共同審查，不用學徒算例直接控制機器。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：只挑成功試驗會掩蓋接近失效的邊界，跨地層仍沿用原方案則忽略材料變化；若沒有版本紀錄，性能異常時也無法判明採用哪一組假設。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Deliver sample origin, boundaries, raw measurements and applicable ground, then cross-check pressure, discharge and movement in the field; changes require joint geotechnical and equipment review, not direct control from an apprentice calculation. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Reporting only successful trials hides nearby failure boundaries, while transferring them across strata ignores changed material. Without version records, later anomalies cannot be linked to the assumptions actually in use. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for conditioning trials and field handover. Deliver sample origin, boundaries, raw measurements and applicable ground, then cross-check pressure, discharge and movement in the field; changes require joint geotechnical and equipment review, not direct control from an apprentice calculation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只挑成功試驗會掩蓋接近失效的邊界，跨地層仍沿用原方案則忽略材料變化；若沒有版本紀錄，性能異常時也無法判明採用哪一組假設。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Reporting only successful trials hides nearby failure boundaries, while transferring them across strata ignores changed material. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「改良試驗到現場移交」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Conditioning trials and field handover"?
options: 交付土樣來源、試驗邊界、量測原檔與地層適用表，現場再核對壓力、出土與沉陷三類證據；改變方案需經地工與設備負責人共同審查，不用學徒算例直接控制機器。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。

steps.title: 改良試驗到現場移交：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Conditioning trials and field handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「改良試驗到現場移交」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Conditioning trials and field handover” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只挑成功試驗會掩蓋接近失效的邊界，跨地層仍沿用原方案則忽略材料變化；若沒有版本紀錄，性能異常時也無法判明採用哪一組假設。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Reporting only successful trials hides nearby failure boundaries, while transferring them across strata ignores changed material. Without version records, later anomalies cannot be linked to the assumptions actually in use. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只挑成功試驗會掩蓋接近失效的邊界，跨地層仍沿用原方案則忽略材料變化；若沒有版本紀錄，性能異常時也無法判明採用哪一組假設。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Without version records, later anomalies cannot be linked to the assumptions actually in use.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只保留最成功配比試驗就足以說明改良方案適用範圍。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Retaining only the most successful trial fully describes the conditioning scheme's applicability." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.title: 根因確認

quiz.question: 在「改良試驗到現場移交」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

只挑成功試驗會掩蓋接近失效的邊界，跨地層仍沿用原方案則忽略材料變化；若沒有版本紀錄，性能異常時也無法判明採用哪一組假設。
改良土越稀越容易流動，就一定越有利於穩定支護。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Reporting only successful trials hides nearby failure boundaries, while transferring them across strata ignores changed material.
More fluid conditioned soil is necessarily better for stable face support.
quiz.explanation: 只挑成功試驗會掩蓋接近失效的邊界，跨地層仍沿用原方案則忽略材料變化；若沒有版本紀錄，性能異常時也無法判明採用哪一組假設。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Reporting only successful trials hides nearby failure boundaries, while transferring them across strata ignores changed material. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 泥水加壓潛盾泥漿循環
summary: 本課聚焦追蹤泥水循環的壓力、固體與能量收支以及分離設備限制。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。
summaryEn: This course focuses on track pressure, solids and energy balances and separation limits in slurry circuits. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設送流100 m³/h、回流110 m³/h且儲量不變，淨增加10 m³/h；仍須區分固體與水。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設流量0.25 m³/s、管徑0.4 m，v=4Q/(πD²)=1.989 m/s；非推薦輸送速度。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume supply 100 m³/h and return 110 m³/h at unchanged storage; net addition is 10 m³/h, still requiring separation of solids and water. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. With assumed Q=0.25 m³/s and D=0.4 m, v=4Q/(πD²)=1.989 m/s; this is not a recommended transport speed. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「循環系統與控制邊界」與「流速與顆粒輸送」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Circuit and control boundaries" and "Velocity and solids transport": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 循環系統與控制邊界：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Circuit and control boundaries: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「循環系統與控制邊界」如何影響泥水加壓潛盾泥漿循環的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Circuit and control boundaries” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Slurry-circuit control for slurry shields”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 泥水迴路把支護、輸送及分離連成系統，送回流量差不只反映開挖量，也包含管路儲存和介質補充。必須在同一時間窗閉合帳目，先界定控制體才可解釋流量異常。 假設送流100 m³/h、回流110 m³/h且儲量不變，淨增加10 m³/h；仍須區分固體與水。 把槽位下降誤當地層吸漿會錯判風險，回流漏量又可能掩蓋真正進水；只比兩個瞬時數值，無法區分管線暫態與穩態地質反應。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「循環系統與控制邊界」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A slurry circuit links support, transport and separation. Supply-return differences include storage and replenishment as well as excavation, so a common time window and defined control volume are essential before interpreting anomalies. Assume supply 100 m³/h and return 110 m³/h at unchanged storage; net addition is 10 m³/h, still requiring separation of solids and water. Mistaking falling tank storage for ground loss misclassifies risk, while unmetered returns conceal real inflow. Two instantaneous readings cannot distinguish pipeline transients from steady geological response. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Circuit and control boundaries” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「送回流量瞬時差就是地層流入量，不必考慮槽位儲存。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The instantaneous supply-return difference equals ground inflow regardless of tank storage." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「循環系統與控制邊界」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Circuit and control boundaries”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 循環系統與控制邊界
knowledge.text: 泥水迴路把支護、輸送及分離連成系統，送回流量差不只反映開挖量，也包含管路儲存和介質補充。必須在同一時間窗閉合帳目，先界定控制體才可解釋流量異常。
knowledge.textEn: A slurry circuit links support, transport and separation. Supply-return differences include storage and replenishment as well as excavation, so a common time window and defined control volume are essential before interpreting anomalies.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：送回流量瞬時差就是地層流入量，不必考慮槽位儲存。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The instantaneous supply-return difference equals ground inflow regardless of tank storage. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「循環系統與控制邊界」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Circuit and control boundaries" is correct?
options: 送回流量瞬時差就是地層流入量，不必考慮槽位儲存。
泥水迴路把支護、輸送及分離連成系統，送回流量差不只反映開挖量，也包含管路儲存和介質補充。
單一管段平均速度正常就保證所有彎頭都不會沉積。
optionsEn: The instantaneous supply-return difference equals ground inflow regardless of tank storage.
A slurry circuit links support, transport and separation.
Normal mean velocity in one pipe guarantees no deposition in any bend.
quiz.explanation: 泥水迴路把支護、輸送及分離連成系統，送回流量差不只反映開挖量，也包含管路儲存和介質補充。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A slurry circuit links support, transport and separation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 循環系統與控制邊界：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Circuit and control boundaries: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「循環系統與控制邊界」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Circuit and control boundaries” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設送流100 m³/h、回流110 m³/h且儲量不變，淨增加10 m³/h；仍須區分固體與水。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume supply 100 m³/h and return 110 m³/h at unchanged storage; net addition is 10 m³/h, still requiring separation of solids and water. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將送回流量、槽位、補水與排放量同步，使用校準流量計及容積測量互查；短期差額需先扣儲存，長期不閉合才結合地質與機器狀態查漏失或非預期流入。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize supply, return, tank levels, makeup and discharge and cross-check calibrated meters against volumes; correct short-term storage before investigating persistent imbalance with geological and machine evidence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設送流100 m³/h、回流110 m³/h且儲量不變，淨增加10 m³/h；仍須區分固體與水。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume supply 100 m³/h and return 110 m³/h at unchanged storage; net addition is 10 m³/h, still requiring separation of solids and water.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「循環系統與控制邊界」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Circuit and control boundaries", which statement holds?
options: 泥水的固體體積百分比就是固體質量百分比。
槽體幾何容積永遠等於沒有沉積影響的有效緩衝容積。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: The solids volume percentage in slurry equals its solids mass percentage.
Geometric tank volume always equals effective buffering volume regardless of deposits.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 循環系統與控制邊界：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Circuit and control boundaries: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「循環系統與控制邊界」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Circuit and control boundaries” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將送回流量、槽位、補水與排放量同步，使用校準流量計及容積測量互查；短期差額需先扣儲存，長期不閉合才結合地質與機器狀態查漏失或非預期流入。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把槽位下降誤當地層吸漿會錯判風險，回流漏量又可能掩蓋真正進水；只比兩個瞬時數值，無法區分管線暫態與穩態地質反應。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize supply, return, tank levels, makeup and discharge and cross-check calibrated meters against volumes; correct short-term storage before investigating persistent imbalance with geological and machine evidence. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Mistaking falling tank storage for ground loss misclassifies risk, while unmetered returns conceal real inflow. Two instantaneous readings cannot distinguish pipeline transients from steady geological response. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄循環系統與控制邊界的資料來源與適用條件。將送回流量、槽位、補水與排放量同步，使用校準流量計及容積測量互查；短期差額需先扣儲存，長期不閉合才結合地質與機器狀態查漏失或非預期流入。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for circuit and control boundaries. Synchronize supply, return, tank levels, makeup and discharge and cross-check calibrated meters against volumes; correct short-term storage before investigating persistent imbalance with geological and machine evidence.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把槽位下降誤當地層吸漿會錯判風險，回流漏量又可能掩蓋真正進水；只比兩個瞬時數值，無法區分管線暫態與穩態地質反應。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Mistaking falling tank storage for ground loss misclassifies risk, while unmetered returns conceal real inflow. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將送回流量、槽位、補水與排放量同步，使用校準流量計及容積測量互查；短期差額需先扣儲存，長期不閉合才結合地質與機器狀態查漏失或非預期流入。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把槽位下降誤當地層吸漿會錯判風險，回流漏量又可能掩蓋真正進水；只比兩個瞬時數值，無法區分管線暫態與穩態地質反應。
knowledge.textEn: Synchronize supply, return, tank levels, makeup and discharge and cross-check calibrated meters against volumes; correct short-term storage before investigating persistent imbalance with geological and machine evidence. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Mistaking falling tank storage for ground loss misclassifies risk, while unmetered returns conceal real inflow. Two instantaneous readings cannot distinguish pipeline transients from steady geological response.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄循環系統與控制邊界的資料來源與適用條件。將送回流量、槽位、補水與排放量同步，使用校準流量計及容積測量互查；短期差額需先扣儲存，長期不閉合才結合地質與機器狀態查漏失或非預期流入。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for circuit and control boundaries. Synchronize supply, return, tank levels, makeup and discharge and cross-check calibrated meters against volumes; correct short-term storage before investigating persistent imbalance with geological and machine evidence.

quiz.question: 要驗證「循環系統與控制邊界」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Circuit and control boundaries"?
options: 將送回流量、槽位、補水與排放量同步，使用校準流量計及容積測量互查；短期差額需先扣儲存，長期不閉合才結合地質與機器狀態查漏失或非預期流入。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
管壁平均厚度正常就證明每個局部位置都足夠厚。
optionsEn: Synchronize supply, return, tank levels, makeup and discharge and cross-check calibrated meters against volumes.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Normal mean pipe thickness proves adequate thickness at every local position.
quiz.explanation: 將送回流量、槽位、補水與排放量同步，使用校準流量計及容積測量互查；短期差額需先扣儲存，長期不閉合才結合地質與機器狀態查漏失或非預期流入。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Synchronize supply, return, tank levels, makeup and discharge and cross-check calibrated meters against volumes; correct short-term storage before investigating persistent imbalance with geological and machine evidence. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 循環系統與控制邊界：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Circuit and control boundaries: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「循環系統與控制邊界」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Circuit and control boundaries” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把槽位下降誤當地層吸漿會錯判風險，回流漏量又可能掩蓋真正進水；只比兩個瞬時數值，無法區分管線暫態與穩態地質反應。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mistaking falling tank storage for ground loss misclassifies risk, while unmetered returns conceal real inflow. Two instantaneous readings cannot distinguish pipeline transients from steady geological response. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把槽位下降誤當地層吸漿會錯判風險，回流漏量又可能掩蓋真正進水；只比兩個瞬時數值，無法區分管線暫態與穩態地質反應。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Two instantaneous readings cannot distinguish pipeline transients from steady geological response.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「送回流量瞬時差就是地層流入量，不必考慮槽位儲存。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The instantaneous supply-return difference equals ground inflow regardless of tank storage." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把槽位下降誤當地層吸漿會錯判風險，回流漏量又可能掩蓋真正進水；只比兩個瞬時數值，無法區分管線暫態與穩態地質反應。
knowledge.textEn: Mistaking falling tank storage for ground loss misclassifies risk, while unmetered returns conceal real inflow. Two instantaneous readings cannot distinguish pipeline transients from steady geological response.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「循環系統與控制邊界」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Circuit and control boundaries" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把槽位下降誤當地層吸漿會錯判風險，回流漏量又可能掩蓋真正進水；只比兩個瞬時數值，無法區分管線暫態與穩態地質反應。
單一管段平均速度正常就保證所有彎頭都不會沉積。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Mistaking falling tank storage for ground loss misclassifies risk, while unmetered returns conceal real inflow.
Normal mean velocity in one pipe guarantees no deposition in any bend.
quiz.explanation: 把槽位下降誤當地層吸漿會錯判風險，回流漏量又可能掩蓋真正進水；只比兩個瞬時數值，無法區分管線暫態與穩態地質反應。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Mistaking falling tank storage for ground loss misclassifies risk, while unmetered returns conceal real inflow. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 流速與顆粒輸送：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Velocity and solids transport: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「流速與顆粒輸送」如何影響泥水加壓潛盾泥漿循環的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Velocity and solids transport” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Slurry-circuit control for slurry shields”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 流速影響顆粒是否沉積，也控制摩擦能耗與磨耗，最佳狀態取決於粒徑、濃度及非牛頓特性。平均速度只是起點，彎頭和停流區可局部沉積，不能由一個管段速度保證整線暢通。 假設流量0.25 m³/s、管徑0.4 m，v=4Q/(πD²)=1.989 m/s；非推薦輸送速度。 速度不足可能形成沉積床而縮小有效管徑，盲目升速又加劇彎頭磨穿；壓差增加既可能是堵塞也可能是物性變化，需另有證據。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「流速與顆粒輸送」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Velocity affects deposition, energy and wear, with behavior depending on grading, concentration and non-Newtonian properties. Mean speed is only a starting point because bends and stagnant regions can deposit solids even when one pipe section appears adequate. With assumed Q=0.25 m³/s and D=0.4 m, v=4Q/(πD²)=1.989 m/s; this is not a recommended transport speed. Insufficient velocity forms a deposit bed and reduces area, while indiscriminate speed increase accelerates bend wear. Rising pressure loss can indicate blockage or changed rheology and needs independent evidence. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Velocity and solids transport” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Normal mean velocity in one pipe guarantees no deposition in any bend." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「流速與顆粒輸送」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Velocity and solids transport”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 流速與顆粒輸送
knowledge.text: 流速影響顆粒是否沉積，也控制摩擦能耗與磨耗，最佳狀態取決於粒徑、濃度及非牛頓特性。平均速度只是起點，彎頭和停流區可局部沉積，不能由一個管段速度保證整線暢通。
knowledge.textEn: Velocity affects deposition, energy and wear, with behavior depending on grading, concentration and non-Newtonian properties. Mean speed is only a starting point because bends and stagnant regions can deposit solids even when one pipe section appears adequate.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：單一管段平均速度正常就保證所有彎頭都不會沉積。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Normal mean velocity in one pipe guarantees no deposition in any bend. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「流速與顆粒輸送」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Velocity and solids transport" is correct?
options: 單一管段平均速度正常就保證所有彎頭都不會沉積。
馬達額定功率就是實際可用的液壓輸送功率。
流速影響顆粒是否沉積，也控制摩擦能耗與磨耗，最佳狀態取決於粒徑、濃度及非牛頓特性。
optionsEn: Normal mean velocity in one pipe guarantees no deposition in any bend.
Rated motor power equals the hydraulic power actually available for transport.
Velocity affects deposition, energy and wear, with behavior depending on grading, concentration and non-Newtonian properties.
quiz.explanation: 流速影響顆粒是否沉積，也控制摩擦能耗與磨耗，最佳狀態取決於粒徑、濃度及非牛頓特性。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Velocity affects deposition, energy and wear, with behavior depending on grading, concentration and non-Newtonian properties. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 流速與顆粒輸送：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Velocity and solids transport: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「流速與顆粒輸送」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Velocity and solids transport” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設流量0.25 m³/s、管徑0.4 m，v=4Q/(πD²)=1.989 m/s；非推薦輸送速度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. With assumed Q=0.25 m³/s and D=0.4 m, v=4Q/(πD²)=1.989 m/s; this is not a recommended transport speed. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照粒徑和固體濃度的合格輸送試驗，檢查彎頭、低點與停機後壓差；流速資料與實際沉積證據並列，由設備工程師評估操作範圍，不直接採用算例速度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare qualified transport trials for grading and concentration and inspect bends, low points and post-stop pressure loss; equipment engineers assess operating range using velocity and actual deposition evidence, not the illustrative speed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設流量0.25 m³/s、管徑0.4 m，v=4Q/(πD²)=1.989 m/s；非推薦輸送速度。

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「流速與顆粒輸送」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Velocity and solids transport", which statement holds?
options: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
旋流器總回收率就是每個粒徑完全相同的分離率。
不論流速改變多慢，都會產生同一個瞬時水擊壓峰。
optionsEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
Overall cyclone recovery equals the separation efficiency at every particle size.
A velocity change produces the same instantaneous water-hammer peak however slowly it occurs.

steps.title: 流速與顆粒輸送：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Velocity and solids transport: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「流速與顆粒輸送」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Velocity and solids transport” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照粒徑和固體濃度的合格輸送試驗，檢查彎頭、低點與停機後壓差；流速資料與實際沉積證據並列，由設備工程師評估操作範圍，不直接採用算例速度。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：速度不足可能形成沉積床而縮小有效管徑，盲目升速又加劇彎頭磨穿；壓差增加既可能是堵塞也可能是物性變化，需另有證據。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare qualified transport trials for grading and concentration and inspect bends, low points and post-stop pressure loss; equipment engineers assess operating range using velocity and actual deposition evidence, not the illustrative speed. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Insufficient velocity forms a deposit bed and reduces area, while indiscriminate speed increase accelerates bend wear. Rising pressure loss can indicate blockage or changed rheology and needs independent evidence. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for velocity and solids transport. Compare qualified transport trials for grading and concentration and inspect bends, low points and post-stop pressure loss; equipment engineers assess operating range using velocity and actual deposition evidence, not the illustrative speed.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：速度不足可能形成沉積床而縮小有效管徑，盲目升速又加劇彎頭磨穿；壓差增加既可能是堵塞也可能是物性變化，需另有證據。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Insufficient velocity forms a deposit bed and reduces area, while indiscriminate speed increase accelerates bend wear. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Insufficient velocity forms a deposit bed and reduces area, while indiscriminate speed increase accelerates bend wear. Rising pressure loss can indicate blockage or changed rheology and needs independent evidence.

Compare qualified transport trials for grading and concentration and inspect bends, low points and post-stop pressure loss; equipment engineers assess operating range using velocity and actual deposition evidence, not the illustrative speed.

quiz.question: 要驗證「流速與顆粒輸送」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Velocity and solids transport"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
對照粒徑和固體濃度的合格輸送試驗，檢查彎頭、低點與停機後壓差；流速資料與實際沉積證據並列，由設備工程師評估操作範圍，不直接採用算例速度。
兩台泵即使共用電源，也能當作完全獨立的備援。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Compare qualified transport trials for grading and concentration and inspect bends, low points and post-stop pressure loss.
Two pumps remain completely independent backups even with a shared power supply.
quiz.explanation: 對照粒徑和固體濃度的合格輸送試驗，檢查彎頭、低點與停機後壓差；流速資料與實際沉積證據並列，由設備工程師評估操作範圍，不直接採用算例速度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。

Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 流速與顆粒輸送：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Velocity and solids transport: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「流速與顆粒輸送」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Velocity and solids transport” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 速度不足可能形成沉積床而縮小有效管徑，盲目升速又加劇彎頭磨穿；壓差增加既可能是堵塞也可能是物性變化，需另有證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Insufficient velocity forms a deposit bed and reduces area, while indiscriminate speed increase accelerates bend wear. Rising pressure loss can indicate blockage or changed rheology and needs independent evidence. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：速度不足可能形成沉積床而縮小有效管徑，盲目升速又加劇彎頭磨穿；壓差增加既可能是堵塞也可能是物性變化，需另有證據。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Rising pressure loss can indicate blockage or changed rheology and needs independent evidence.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「單一管段平均速度正常就保證所有彎頭都不會沉積。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Normal mean velocity in one pipe guarantees no deposition in any bend." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 速度不足可能形成沉積床而縮小有效管徑，盲目升速又加劇彎頭磨穿；壓差增加既可能是堵塞也可能是物性變化，需另有證據。
knowledge.textEn: Insufficient velocity forms a deposit bed and reduces area, while indiscriminate speed increase accelerates bend wear. Rising pressure loss can indicate blockage or changed rheology and needs independent evidence.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「流速與顆粒輸送」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Velocity and solids transport" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
馬達額定功率就是實際可用的液壓輸送功率。
速度不足可能形成沉積床而縮小有效管徑，盲目升速又加劇彎頭磨穿；壓差增加既可能是堵塞也可能是物性變化，需另有證據。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Rated motor power equals the hydraulic power actually available for transport.
Insufficient velocity forms a deposit bed and reduces area, while indiscriminate speed increase accelerates bend wear.
quiz.explanation: 速度不足可能形成沉積床而縮小有效管徑，盲目升速又加劇彎頭磨穿；壓差增加既可能是堵塞也可能是物性變化，需另有證據。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Insufficient velocity forms a deposit bed and reduces area, while indiscriminate speed increase accelerates bend wear. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「壓差與泵浦功率」與「固體質量濃度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Pressure loss and pump power" and "Solids mass concentration": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 壓差與泵浦功率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pressure loss and pump power: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「壓差與泵浦功率」如何影響泥水加壓潛盾泥漿循環的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pressure loss and pump power” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Slurry-circuit control for slurry shields”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 泵浦提供克服高程與管路損失的能量，效率把液壓功率轉為軸功率需求。泥水密度與黏度改變會移動工作點，不能只用清水泵曲線推定實際效率或最大可輸送量。 假設Q=0.2 m³/s、Δp=500 kPa、效率0.75，軸功率QΔp/η=133.3 kW；未含馬達損失。 忽略效率會低估驅動需求，磨損葉輪可能仍耗電卻輸送不足；若只看馬達運轉，可能錯過流量下降與後續顆粒沉積的連鎖反應。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「壓差與泵浦功率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pumps supply elevation and friction energy, with efficiency relating hydraulic and shaft power. Slurry density and viscosity shift the operating point, so a clear-water curve alone cannot establish actual efficiency or transport capacity. Assume Q=0.2 m³/s, Δp=500 kPa and efficiency 0.75; shaft power QΔp/η=133.3 kW, excluding motor losses. Ignoring efficiency understates drive demand, and a worn impeller may consume power without adequate transport. Monitoring only motor operation misses declining flow and the resulting chain of solids deposition. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pressure loss and pump power” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「馬達額定功率就是實際可用的液壓輸送功率。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Rated motor power equals the hydraulic power actually available for transport." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

knowledge.textEn: Pumps supply elevation and friction energy, with efficiency relating hydraulic and shaft power. Slurry density and viscosity shift the operating point, so a clear-water curve alone cannot establish actual efficiency or transport capacity.

quiz.question: 關於「壓差與泵浦功率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 壓差與泵浦功率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pressure loss and pump power: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「壓差與泵浦功率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pressure loss and pump power” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設Q=0.2 m³/s、Δp=500 kPa、效率0.75，軸功率QΔp/η=133.3 kW；未含馬達損失。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume Q=0.2 m³/s, Δp=500 kPa and efficiency 0.75; shaft power QΔp/η=133.3 kW, excluding motor losses. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步測流量、吸排壓及電力，核對效率定義與密度，再比較適用泥水條件的性能資料；異常能耗先查磨耗、沉積及物性，不把泵浦額定功率直接等同可用液壓功率。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize flow, suction-discharge pressure and electricity, checking efficiency definition and density against appropriate slurry performance data; investigate wear, deposits and rheology rather than equating motor rating with available hydraulic power.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 泥水密度可估固體體積比例，但須知道液相與顆粒密度且無顯著氣體。質量濃度與體積濃度不同，分離效率與出土量換算使用不同基準時必須明確轉換。 假設ρm=1200、ρw=1000、ρs=2600 kg/m³，Cv=(1200−1000)/(2600−1000)=0.125；質量分率0.271。 把體積濃度當質量濃度會大幅錯估固體產出，含氣又使密度偏低而看似稀漿；錯誤可能導致分離設備負荷及廢土量預估失準。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「固體質量濃度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Assume ρm=1200, ρw=1000 and ρs=2600 kg/m³; Cv=0.125 and solids mass fraction Cvρs/ρm=0.271. steps.title: 固體質量濃度：失效診斷

steps.instruction: 把體積濃度當質量濃度會大幅錯估固體產出，含氣又使密度偏低而看似稀漿；錯誤可能導致分離設備負荷及廢土量預估失準。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

The error propagates into separator loading and spoil-quantity forecasts. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 旋流分離與分級：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cyclone separation and grading: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「旋流分離與分級」如何影響泥水加壓潛盾泥漿循環的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cyclone separation and grading” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Slurry-circuit control for slurry shields”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 旋流器利用顆粒慣性與流場分級，切割粒徑不是一道所有顆粒都服從的硬邊界。細顆粒仍可能隨底流走，粗粒也可能旁通，需用完整粒徑分配和質量收支描述效率。 假設進料乾固體100 t/h、底流回收80 t/h，總質量回收80%；不等於所有粒徑皆有80%分離率。 進料波動時非同步取樣會製造不可能的效率，細料累積於回用漿又使流變漸變；只追求粗粒回收可能忽略整個循環介質已偏離需求。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「旋流分離與分級」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cyclones classify through particle inertia and flow, but cut size is not a perfect boundary. Fines can report to underflow and coarse particles can bypass, requiring size distributions and mass balance rather than one headline efficiency. For assumed dry-solids feed 100 t/h and underflow recovery 80 t/h, overall recovery is 80%; this does not mean 80% capture at every size. Unsynchronized samples during feed changes create impossible efficiency estimates, while recirculating fines progressively alter rheology. Coarse recovery alone can miss a circuit medium drifting away from its required behavior. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cyclone separation and grading” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Overall cyclone recovery equals the separation efficiency at every particle size." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 旋流分離與分級：試驗與驗證

steps.instruction: 同時取進料、溢流與底流樣，做流量、濃度和粒徑收支，將粒徑分級效率分開；設備審查需確認採樣時間對齊及濕乾基準，不能只看一側看似乾淨。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：進料波動時非同步取樣會製造不可能的效率，細料累積於回用漿又使流變漸變；只追求粗粒回收可能忽略整個循環介質已偏離需求。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.instruction: 進料波動時非同步取樣會製造不可能的效率，細料累積於回用漿又使流變漸變；只追求粗粒回收可能忽略整個循環介質已偏離需求。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

槽體幾何容積永遠等於沒有沉積影響的有效緩衝容積。
進料波動時非同步取樣會製造不可能的效率，細料累積於回用漿又使流變漸變；只追求粗粒回收可能忽略整個循環介質已偏離需求。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Geometric tank volume always equals effective buffering volume regardless of deposits.
Unsynchronized samples during feed changes create impossible efficiency estimates, while recirculating fines progressively alter rheology.
quiz.explanation: 進料波動時非同步取樣會製造不可能的效率，細料累積於回用漿又使流變漸變；只追求粗粒回收可能忽略整個循環介質已偏離需求。 需以量測區分可能原因。

steps.title: 槽位與停留時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Tank levels and residence time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「槽位與停留時間」如何影響泥水加壓潛盾泥漿循環的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tank levels and residence time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Slurry-circuit control for slurry shields”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 槽體提供緩衝與混合，但理想平均停留時間不代表每個顆粒停留相同。短流與死區使部分介質很快返回、部分長期沉積，槽位正常也可能掩蓋有效容積減少。 假設有效槽容60 m³、流量120 m³/h，名義停留0.5 h=30 min；非完整停留時間分布。 沉積使有效容積縮小但液位仍正常，遇到流量突變時緩衝不足；短流又讓未充分處理的細料立即返回，造成看似難解的循環品質波動。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「槽位與停留時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Tanks buffer and mix, but average residence time does not apply to every particle. Short circuits return some material rapidly while dead zones retain deposits, so normal level can conceal loss of effective volume. With assumed effective volume 60 m³ and flow 120 m³/h, nominal residence time is 0.5 h=30 min, not the full residence-time distribution. Deposits reduce effective volume without changing normal level, weakening transient buffering. Short-circuiting rapidly returns insufficiently treated fines and creates apparently inexplicable variation in circulating slurry quality. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Tank levels and residence time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「槽體幾何容積永遠等於沒有沉積影響的有效緩衝容積。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Geometric tank volume always equals effective buffering volume regardless of deposits." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「槽位與停留時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Tank levels and residence time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 槽位與停留時間

knowledge.textEn: Tanks buffer and mix, but average residence time does not apply to every particle. Short circuits return some material rapidly while dead zones retain deposits, so normal level can conceal loss of effective volume.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：槽體幾何容積永遠等於沒有沉積影響的有效緩衝容積。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Geometric tank volume always equals effective buffering volume regardless of deposits. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「槽位與停留時間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Tank levels and residence time" is correct?
options: 槽體提供緩衝與混合，但理想平均停留時間不代表每個顆粒停留相同。
槽體幾何容積永遠等於沒有沉積影響的有效緩衝容積。
不論流速改變多慢，都會產生同一個瞬時水擊壓峰。
optionsEn: Tanks buffer and mix, but average residence time does not apply to every particle.
Geometric tank volume always equals effective buffering volume regardless of deposits.
A velocity change produces the same instantaneous water-hammer peak however slowly it occurs.
quiz.explanation: 槽體提供緩衝與混合，但理想平均停留時間不代表每個顆粒停留相同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設有效槽容60 m³、流量120 m³/h，名義停留0.5 h=30 min；非完整停留時間分布。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用槽位校準、沉積檢查及合適示蹤試驗評估有效容積，對照進出密度變化的延遲；維護人員記錄清槽前後差異，不能把幾何容積直接當長期可用緩衝量。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 用槽位校準、沉積檢查及合適示蹤試驗評估有效容積，對照進出密度變化的延遲；維護人員記錄清槽前後差異，不能把幾何容積直接當長期可用緩衝量。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：沉積使有效容積縮小但液位仍正常，遇到流量突變時緩衝不足；短流又讓未充分處理的細料立即返回，造成看似難解的循環品質波動。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Assess effective volume through calibrated level, deposit inspection and suitable tracer work, comparing density-change delays; record before-after cleaning behavior instead of treating geometric tank volume as permanently available buffering. Short-circuiting rapidly returns insufficiently treated fines and creates apparently inexplicable variation in circulating slurry quality. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.title: 槽位與停留時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Tank levels and residence time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「槽位與停留時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tank levels and residence time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 沉積使有效容積縮小但液位仍正常，遇到流量突變時緩衝不足；短流又讓未充分處理的細料立即返回，造成看似難解的循環品質波動。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Deposits reduce effective volume without changing normal level, weakening transient buffering. Short-circuiting rapidly returns insufficiently treated fines and creates apparently inexplicable variation in circulating slurry quality. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：沉積使有效容積縮小但液位仍正常，遇到流量突變時緩衝不足；短流又讓未充分處理的細料立即返回，造成看似難解的循環品質波動。

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「槽位與停留時間」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
不論流速改變多慢，都會產生同一個瞬時水擊壓峰。
optionsEn: Deposits reduce effective volume without changing normal level, weakening transient buffering.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A velocity change produces the same instantaneous water-hammer peak however slowly it occurs.
quiz.explanation: 沉積使有效容積縮小但液位仍正常，遇到流量突變時緩衝不足；短流又讓未充分處理的細料立即返回，造成看似難解的循環品質波動。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Deposits reduce effective volume without changing normal level, weakening transient buffering. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「壓力暫態與管路彈性」與「磨耗與剩餘厚度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Pressure transients and pipe elasticity" and "Wear and remaining thickness": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 壓力暫態與管路彈性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pressure transients and pipe elasticity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「壓力暫態與管路彈性」如何影響泥水加壓潛盾泥漿循環的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pressure transients and pipe elasticity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Slurry-circuit control for slurry shields”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 快速流速變化會與流體可壓縮性及管壁彈性耦合，產生暫態壓力波。含氣、非牛頓介質和支管使簡化水擊關係偏離實際，需分析整個系統而非單一閥前讀值。 假設變速時間比往返波傳時間2L/a短，示意ρ=1200 kg/m³、a=300 m/s、Δv=0.5 m/s，Δp=ρaΔv=180 kPa；慢變速不直接適用。 低頻取樣可能完全漏掉短壓峰，管路疲勞卻仍累積；把所有尖峰當電噪音刪除會失去重要證據，反之未校驗感測器也可能製造假水擊。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「壓力暫態與管路彈性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Rapid velocity change couples fluid compressibility with pipe-wall elasticity, producing pressure waves. Entrained gas, non-Newtonian behavior and branches complicate a simple water-hammer relation, requiring a system analysis rather than one valve-side reading. Assume velocity changes faster than the round-trip wave time 2L/a; illustrative ρ=1200 kg/m³, a=300 m/s and Δv=0.5 m/s give Δp=180 kPa. Slow changes do not directly satisfy this relation. Slow sampling may miss short peaks while fatigue accumulates. Deleting every spike as electrical noise loses evidence, although unverified sensors can also manufacture false transient events requiring independent checks. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pressure transients and pipe elasticity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「不論流速改變多慢，都會產生同一個瞬時水擊壓峰。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A velocity change produces the same instantaneous water-hammer peak however slowly it occurs." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「壓力暫態與管路彈性」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Pressure transients and pipe elasticity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 壓力暫態與管路彈性
knowledge.text: 快速流速變化會與流體可壓縮性及管壁彈性耦合，產生暫態壓力波。含氣、非牛頓介質和支管使簡化水擊關係偏離實際，需分析整個系統而非單一閥前讀值。
knowledge.textEn: Rapid velocity change couples fluid compressibility with pipe-wall elasticity, producing pressure waves. Entrained gas, non-Newtonian behavior and branches complicate a simple water-hammer relation, requiring a system analysis rather than one valve-side reading.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：不論流速改變多慢，都會產生同一個瞬時水擊壓峰。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A velocity change produces the same instantaneous water-hammer peak however slowly it occurs. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「壓力暫態與管路彈性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pressure transients and pipe elasticity" is correct?
options: 不論流速改變多慢，都會產生同一個瞬時水擊壓峰。
快速流速變化會與流體可壓縮性及管壁彈性耦合，產生暫態壓力波。
管壁平均厚度正常就證明每個局部位置都足夠厚。
optionsEn: A velocity change produces the same instantaneous water-hammer peak however slowly it occurs.
Rapid velocity change couples fluid compressibility with pipe-wall elasticity, producing pressure waves.
Normal mean pipe thickness proves adequate thickness at every local position.
quiz.explanation: 快速流速變化會與流體可壓縮性及管壁彈性耦合，產生暫態壓力波。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Rapid velocity change couples fluid compressibility with pipe-wall elasticity, producing pressure waves. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 壓力暫態與管路彈性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pressure transients and pipe elasticity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「壓力暫態與管路彈性」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pressure transients and pipe elasticity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設變速時間比往返波傳時間2L/a短，示意ρ=1200 kg/m³、a=300 m/s、Δv=0.5 m/s，Δp=ρaΔv=180 kPa；慢變速不直接適用。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume velocity changes faster than the round-trip wave time 2L/a; illustrative ρ=1200 kg/m³, a=300 m/s and Δv=0.5 m/s give Δp=180 kPa. Slow changes do not directly satisfy this relation. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以足夠頻率壓力紀錄對照流量事件，將實際管材、支承、含氣及閥件時序帶入專業暫態分析；任何控制變更由設備工程師核准，本課算式不得用來自行操作閥件。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare sufficiently fast pressure records with flow events and analyze actual pipe, supports, gas and valve timing professionally; equipment engineers approve changes, and this relation does not authorize valve operation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設變速時間比往返波傳時間2L/a短，示意ρ=1200 kg/m³、a=300 m/s、Δv=0.5 m/s，Δp=ρaΔv=180 kPa；慢變速不直接適用。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume velocity changes faster than the round-trip wave time 2L/a; illustrative ρ=1200 kg/m³, a=300 m/s and Δv=0.5 m/s give Δp=180 kPa. Slow changes do not directly satisfy this relation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「壓力暫態與管路彈性」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pressure transients and pipe elasticity", which statement holds?
options: 每班平均報表足以取代所有原始流量與壓力時間序列。
單一管段平均速度正常就保證所有彎頭都不會沉積。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: Shift-average reports adequately replace all original flow and pressure time series.
Normal mean velocity in one pipe guarantees no deposition in any bend.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
