steps.instruction: 固體顆粒撞擊與滑磨使管壁損失，彎頭外側和局部高速區可能先變薄。平均厚度不能代表最低剩餘壁厚，磨耗速率又隨粒徑與流況變化，必須把位置與歷程一起記錄。 假設某點厚度由12降10 mm歷時1000 h，平均磨耗0.002 mm/h；線性外推只在同工況下作情境比較。 量到不同點位會造成假增厚或假加速磨耗，腐蝕與局部沖蝕又可能集中在未量區；只用平均厚度安排維護可能錯過最薄部位。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「磨耗與剩餘厚度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Particle impact and abrasion remove wall material, often fastest on outer bends or local high-speed zones. Mean thickness does not represent minimum wall, and changing grading and flow make wear rates time dependent. An assumed point thinning from 12 to 10 mm over 1000 h averages 0.002 mm/h; linear extrapolation is only a same-condition scenario. Changing measurement positions creates false thickening or acceleration, while corrosion and erosion can concentrate outside the sampled grid. Maintenance based on average thickness may miss the limiting local section. knowledge.text: 在固定位置做經校準的超音波厚度網格，對照顆粒、速度與更換紀錄，特別保留局部最低值；剩餘可用性由設備工程師依材料、壓力及缺陷規範判定，不能由平均磨耗獨自決定。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：量到不同點位會造成假增厚或假加速磨耗，腐蝕與局部沖蝕又可能集中在未量區；只用平均厚度安排維護可能錯過最薄部位。
knowledge.textEn: Repeat calibrated ultrasonic grids at fixed locations with grading, velocity and replacement records, retaining local minima; equipment engineers assess fitness using material, pressure and defect criteria rather than average wear alone. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Changing measurement positions creates false thickening or acceleration, while corrosion and erosion can concentrate outside the sampled grid. Maintenance based on average thickness may miss the limiting local section.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄磨耗與剩餘厚度的資料來源與適用條件。在固定位置做經校準的超音波厚度網格，對照顆粒、速度與更換紀錄，特別保留局部最低值；剩餘可用性由設備工程師依材料、壓力及缺陷規範判定，不能由平均磨耗獨自決定。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for wear and remaining thickness. Repeat calibrated ultrasonic grids at fixed locations with grading, velocity and replacement records, retaining local minima; equipment engineers assess fitness using material, pressure and defect criteria rather than average wear alone.

quiz.question: 要驗證「磨耗與剩餘厚度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Wear and remaining thickness"?

在固定位置做經校準的超音波厚度網格，對照顆粒、速度與更換紀錄，特別保留局部最低值；剩餘可用性由設備工程師依材料、壓力及缺陷規範判定，不能由平均磨耗獨自決定。
旋流器總回收率就是每個粒徑完全相同的分離率。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Repeat calibrated ultrasonic grids at fixed locations with grading, velocity and replacement records, retaining local minima.
Overall cyclone recovery equals the separation efficiency at every particle size.

quiz.explanationEn: Repeat calibrated ultrasonic grids at fixed locations with grading, velocity and replacement records, retaining local minima; equipment engineers assess fitness using material, pressure and defect criteria rather than average wear alone. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 磨耗與剩餘厚度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wear and remaining thickness: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「磨耗與剩餘厚度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Wear and remaining thickness” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 量到不同點位會造成假增厚或假加速磨耗，腐蝕與局部沖蝕又可能集中在未量區；只用平均厚度安排維護可能錯過最薄部位。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Changing measurement positions creates false thickening or acceleration, while corrosion and erosion can concentrate outside the sampled grid. Maintenance based on average thickness may miss the limiting local section. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：量到不同點位會造成假增厚或假加速磨耗，腐蝕與局部沖蝕又可能集中在未量區；只用平均厚度安排維護可能錯過最薄部位。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Maintenance based on average thickness may miss the limiting local section.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「管壁平均厚度正常就證明每個局部位置都足夠厚。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Normal mean pipe thickness proves adequate thickness at every local position." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 量到不同點位會造成假增厚或假加速磨耗，腐蝕與局部沖蝕又可能集中在未量區；只用平均厚度安排維護可能錯過最薄部位。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「磨耗與剩餘厚度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Wear and remaining thickness" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
兩台泵即使共用電源，也能當作完全獨立的備援。
量到不同點位會造成假增厚或假加速磨耗，腐蝕與局部沖蝕又可能集中在未量區；只用平均厚度安排維護可能錯過最薄部位。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Two pumps remain completely independent backups even with a shared power supply.
Changing measurement positions creates false thickening or acceleration, while corrosion and erosion can concentrate outside the sampled grid.
quiz.explanation: 量到不同點位會造成假增厚或假加速磨耗，腐蝕與局部沖蝕又可能集中在未量區；只用平均厚度安排維護可能錯過最薄部位。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Changing measurement positions creates false thickening or acceleration, while corrosion and erosion can concentrate outside the sampled grid. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「循環可靠度與備援」與「泥水資料與工程結案」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Circuit availability and redundancy" and "Slurry-data engineering closeout": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 循環可靠度與備援：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Circuit availability and redundancy: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「循環可靠度與備援」如何影響泥水加壓潛盾泥漿循環的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Circuit availability and redundancy” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Slurry-circuit control for slurry shields”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 串聯系統任何關鍵設備失效都可能中斷循環，備用泵存在也不代表可立即切換。可靠度需考慮共用電力、閥件和分離容量，時間利用率則受預防維護與故障停機共同影響。 假設運轉160 h、停機10 h，利用率160/170=94.12%；不是單一元件固有可靠度。 兩台泵共用同一電源時不能當完全獨立備援，分離廠滿載也會使多泵無法增加產能；若只加總銘牌流量，系統可用性被高估。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「循環可靠度與備援」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Any critical series component can interrupt circulation, and a spare pump does not guarantee immediate recovery. Shared power, valves and separation capacity limit redundancy, while planned and unplanned downtime both affect availability. With assumed operation 160 h and downtime 10 h, availability is 160/170=94.12%; it is not an intrinsic component reliability. Two pumps on one supply are not fully independent backups, and a saturated separation plant limits additional pumping. Adding nameplate capacities therefore overstates achievable system availability and transport capacity. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Circuit availability and redundancy” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩台泵即使共用電源，也能當作完全獨立的備援。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two pumps remain completely independent backups even with a shared power supply." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「循環可靠度與備援」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Circuit availability and redundancy”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 循環可靠度與備援
knowledge.text: 串聯系統任何關鍵設備失效都可能中斷循環，備用泵存在也不代表可立即切換。可靠度需考慮共用電力、閥件和分離容量，時間利用率則受預防維護與故障停機共同影響。
knowledge.textEn: Any critical series component can interrupt circulation, and a spare pump does not guarantee immediate recovery. Shared power, valves and separation capacity limit redundancy, while planned and unplanned downtime both affect availability.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩台泵即使共用電源，也能當作完全獨立的備援。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Two pumps remain completely independent backups even with a shared power supply. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「循環可靠度與備援」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Circuit availability and redundancy" is correct?
options: 串聯系統任何關鍵設備失效都可能中斷循環，備用泵存在也不代表可立即切換。

每班平均報表足以取代所有原始流量與壓力時間序列。
optionsEn: Any critical series component can interrupt circulation, and a spare pump does not guarantee immediate recovery.
Two pumps remain completely independent backups even with a shared power supply.

steps.title: 循環可靠度與備援：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Circuit availability and redundancy: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「循環可靠度與備援」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Circuit availability and redundancy” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設運轉160 h、停機10 h，利用率160/170=94.12%；不是單一元件固有可靠度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. With assumed operation 160 h and downtime 10 h, availability is 160/170=94.12%; it is not an intrinsic component reliability. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以故障樹或系統圖檢查共因失效，測試核准的備援切換與資料紀錄，統計停機原因而不只總時數；維護與施工團隊共同確認失去循環時的既定回應。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Review common-cause failure through a system diagram and test approved backup transitions and logging; classify downtime causes rather than only total duration, with maintenance and construction teams confirming the response to lost circulation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「循環可靠度與備援」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 以故障樹或系統圖檢查共因失效，測試核准的備援切換與資料紀錄，統計停機原因而不只總時數；維護與施工團隊共同確認失去循環時的既定回應。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：兩台泵共用同一電源時不能當完全獨立備援，分離廠滿載也會使多泵無法增加產能；若只加總銘牌流量，系統可用性被高估。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 循環可靠度與備援：失效診斷

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Circuit availability and redundancy” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 兩台泵共用同一電源時不能當完全獨立備援，分離廠滿載也會使多泵無法增加產能；若只加總銘牌流量，系統可用性被高估。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Two pumps on one supply are not fully independent backups, and a saturated separation plant limits additional pumping. Adding nameplate capacities therefore overstates achievable system availability and transport capacity. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Two pumps remain completely independent backups even with a shared power supply." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

title: 盾尾刷與密封脂系統
titleEn: Shield-tail brushes and sealing grease systems
summary: 本課聚焦以盾尾間隙、密封介質與壓力證據診斷盾尾漏水路徑。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。
summaryEn: This course focuses on diagnose tail-seal leakage through clearance, sealing medium and pressure evidence. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設3道獨立密封各失效機率0.01，同時失效為10⁻⁶；真實共因失效會使獨立假設失效。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設名義徑向間隙40 mm、偏心15 mm，兩側示意間隙25與55 mm；未含橢圓化。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume 3 independent barriers each with failure probability 0.01; simultaneous failure is 10⁻⁶, but real common causes invalidate independence. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed nominal radial clearance 40 mm and eccentricity 15 mm, opposite clearances are 25 and 55 mm, excluding ovalization. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「多道刷列的阻水機制」與「尾隙與偏心分布」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Multiple brush-row sealing" and "Tail clearance and eccentricity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 多道刷列的阻水機制：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Multiple brush-row sealing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「多道刷列的阻水機制」如何影響盾尾刷與密封脂系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Multiple brush-row sealing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shield-tail brushes and sealing grease systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 盾尾刷列與密封介質共同填住移動盾殼和環片之間的間隙，刷毛本身不是完整防水膜。多道密封提供分段阻力，但共用供應失效或同一幾何缺陷可能同時破壞多列。 假設3道獨立密封各失效機率0.01，同時失效為10⁻⁶；真實共因失效會使獨立假設失效。 三道刷列若共用堵塞管線可同時失去密封介質，計算出的極低機率便毫無依據；只強調道數會掩蓋真正脆弱的共用節點。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「多道刷列的阻水機制」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Tail brushes and sealing medium fill the moving gap between shield and lining; brushes alone are not an impermeable membrane. Multiple rows add barriers, but shared supply failure or a common geometric defect can defeat them together. Assume 3 independent barriers each with failure probability 0.01; simultaneous failure is 10⁻⁶, but real common causes invalidate independence. Three rows sharing a blocked supply can lose sealing medium together, invalidating the tiny calculated probability. Emphasizing row count conceals the shared node that actually limits the system. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Multiple brush-row sealing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「多道密封即使共用失效供應，也能直接按獨立機率相乘。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Multiple seals sharing a failed supply still justify multiplying independent failure probabilities." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「多道刷列的阻水機制」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Multiple brush-row sealing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 多道刷列的阻水機制
knowledge.text: 盾尾刷列與密封介質共同填住移動盾殼和環片之間的間隙，刷毛本身不是完整防水膜。多道密封提供分段阻力，但共用供應失效或同一幾何缺陷可能同時破壞多列。
knowledge.textEn: Tail brushes and sealing medium fill the moving gap between shield and lining; brushes alone are not an impermeable membrane. Multiple rows add barriers, but shared supply failure or a common geometric defect can defeat them together.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：多道密封即使共用失效供應，也能直接按獨立機率相乘。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Multiple seals sharing a failed supply still justify multiplying independent failure probabilities. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「多道刷列的阻水機制」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Multiple brush-row sealing" is correct?
options: 多道密封即使共用失效供應，也能直接按獨立機率相乘。
盾尾刷列與密封介質共同填住移動盾殼和環片之間的間隙，刷毛本身不是完整防水膜。
盾尾平均間隙正常就保證整圈刷毛接觸都正常。
optionsEn: Multiple seals sharing a failed supply still justify multiplying independent failure probabilities.
Tail brushes and sealing medium fill the moving gap between shield and lining; brushes alone are not an impermeable membrane.
Normal mean tail clearance guarantees adequate brush contact around the entire circumference.
quiz.explanation: 盾尾刷列與密封介質共同填住移動盾殼和環片之間的間隙，刷毛本身不是完整防水膜。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Tail brushes and sealing medium fill the moving gap between shield and lining; brushes alone are not an impermeable membrane. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 多道刷列的阻水機制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Multiple brush-row sealing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「多道刷列的阻水機制」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Multiple brush-row sealing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設3道獨立密封各失效機率0.01，同時失效為10⁻⁶；真實共因失效會使獨立假設失效。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume 3 independent barriers each with failure probability 0.01; simultaneous failure is 10⁻⁶, but real common causes invalidate independence. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以系統圖標示刷列、供應線、壓力感測與共用設備，檢查失效是否真正獨立；比對各區消耗及漏水位置，設備主管需審查共因情境，不把多道數量直接換成可靠度保證。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Map rows, supply lines, sensors and shared equipment and test whether failures are independent; compare zone consumption and leakage location, with equipment review of common causes rather than reliability guaranteed by barrier count.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設3道獨立密封各失效機率0.01，同時失效為10⁻⁶；真實共因失效會使獨立假設失效。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume 3 independent barriers each with failure probability 0.01; simultaneous failure is 10⁻⁶, but real common causes invalidate independence.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「多道刷列的阻水機制」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 密封材料消耗越大就代表實際阻水性能必定越好。

A small segment exterior defect cannot damage multiple tail-brush rows.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.

steps.title: 多道刷列的阻水機制：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Multiple brush-row sealing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「多道刷列的阻水機制」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Multiple brush-row sealing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以系統圖標示刷列、供應線、壓力感測與共用設備，檢查失效是否真正獨立；比對各區消耗及漏水位置，設備主管需審查共因情境，不把多道數量直接換成可靠度保證。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：三道刷列若共用堵塞管線可同時失去密封介質，計算出的極低機率便毫無依據；只強調道數會掩蓋真正脆弱的共用節點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map rows, supply lines, sensors and shared equipment and test whether failures are independent; compare zone consumption and leakage location, with equipment review of common causes rather than reliability guaranteed by barrier count. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Three rows sharing a blocked supply can lose sealing medium together, invalidating the tiny calculated probability. Emphasizing row count conceals the shared node that actually limits the system. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄多道刷列的阻水機制的資料來源與適用條件。以系統圖標示刷列、供應線、壓力感測與共用設備，檢查失效是否真正獨立；比對各區消耗及漏水位置，設備主管需審查共因情境，不把多道數量直接換成可靠度保證。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for multiple brush-row sealing. Map rows, supply lines, sensors and shared equipment and test whether failures are independent; compare zone consumption and leakage location, with equipment review of common causes rather than reliability guaranteed by barrier count.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：三道刷列若共用堵塞管線可同時失去密封介質，計算出的極低機率便毫無依據；只強調道數會掩蓋真正脆弱的共用節點。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Three rows sharing a blocked supply can lose sealing medium together, invalidating the tiny calculated probability. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Three rows sharing a blocked supply can lose sealing medium together, invalidating the tiny calculated probability. Emphasizing row count conceals the shared node that actually limits the system.

steps.instruction: 三道刷列若共用堵塞管線可同時失去密封介質，計算出的極低機率便毫無依據；只強調道數會掩蓋真正脆弱的共用節點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 尾隙與偏心分布：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「尾隙與偏心分布」如何影響盾尾刷與密封脂系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tail clearance and eccentricity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shield-tail brushes and sealing grease systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 盾尾環隙沿圓周不均，盾體偏心使一側壓縮而另一側放大。密封需求由最不利局部間隙控制，平均環隙相同不代表刷毛接觸相同，組環姿態和盾體運動需共同考慮。 假設名義徑向間隙40 mm、偏心15 mm，兩側示意間隙25與55 mm；未含橢圓化。 偏心大時一側刷毛過度擠壓磨耗、另一側接觸不足，平均值卻可能正常；若只增加密封介質而不查幾何，漏水根因仍保留。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「尾隙與偏心分布」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Tail clearance varies around the circumference. Eccentricity compresses one side and opens the other, so local extremes govern brush contact even with unchanged mean clearance. Ring attitude and shield movement must be considered together. For assumed nominal radial clearance 40 mm and eccentricity 15 mm, opposite clearances are 25 and 55 mm, excluding ovalization. Large eccentricity overcompresses and wears one side while reducing contact on the other, despite a normal mean. Adding medium without checking geometry leaves the cause of leakage unresolved. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Tail clearance and eccentricity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「盾尾平均間隙正常就保證整圈刷毛接觸都正常。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Normal mean tail clearance guarantees adequate brush contact around the entire circumference." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設名義徑向間隙40 mm、偏心15 mm，兩側示意間隙25與55 mm；未含橢圓化。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed nominal radial clearance 40 mm and eccentricity 15 mm, opposite clearances are 25 and 55 mm, excluding ovalization. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot clearance, ring pose and shield pose in one angular convention, focusing on maxima and minima; review against approved equipment and lining geometry rather than accepting only an average or one measurement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計

steps.title: 密封壓差與高程：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Seal differential pressure and elevation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shield-tail brushes and sealing grease systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 密封面承受外部水與灌漿壓力，內部感測值需修正高程和管線損失才可比較。量到供應端高壓不表示刷列間實際壓力足夠，因為堵塞或黏性損失可消耗大部分壓差。 假設淡水高差30 m，靜水壓差ρgh=294.3 kPa；它不含灌漿暫態且非密封供壓指令。 供應管堵塞可呈現高壓但沒有材料到達刷列，若把儀表高值當成功密封，外部水土可能逐步侵入；漏水初期未必伴隨供應壓力降低。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「密封壓差與高程」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The seal resists external water and grout, while internal readings require elevation and line-loss correction. High supply-end pressure does not establish cavity pressure because blockage and viscous losses can consume much of the differential. An assumed fresh-water elevation difference of 30 m gives 294.3 kPa hydrostatic pressure, excluding grout transients and not prescribing seal supply pressure. A blocked line shows high pressure without delivering medium. Mistaking that reading for successful sealing permits progressive ingress, which need not initially reduce measured supply pressure at all. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Seal differential pressure and elevation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「供應端壓力很高就證明材料已經到達每道刷列。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設淡水高差30 m，靜水壓差ρgh=294.3 kPa；它不含灌漿暫態且非密封供壓指令。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed fresh-water elevation difference of 30 m gives 294.3 kPa hydrostatic pressure, excluding grout transients and not prescribing seal supply pressure. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
密封材料消耗越大就代表實際阻水性能必定越好。
optionsEn: A blocked line shows high pressure without delivering medium.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Higher seal-medium consumption necessarily means better actual water resistance.

steps.title: 密封消耗與有效補充：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Consumption and effective replenishment: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「密封消耗與有效補充」如何影響盾尾刷與密封脂系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Consumption and effective replenishment” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shield-tail brushes and sealing grease systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 密封介質消耗包含隨盾體運動帶走、外漏和填補空隙，單位進尺消耗能作趨勢但不直接證明效果。停機期間的消耗與推進期間意義不同，應區分時間基準與距離基準。 假設一段消耗120 kg、前進8 m，單位消耗15 kg/m；另一停機時段不能以零進尺計此比值。 密封材料大量流入外部空隙可能消耗很高卻未建立連續阻水，計量器空打又會虛增用量；只用採購量推估性能會把損失當成功。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「密封消耗與有效補充」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Seal consumption includes movement losses, leakage and filling of voids. Consumption per advance supports trending without proving performance. Standstill consumption differs physically from advancing consumption, requiring both time and distance references. Assumed consumption 120 kg over 8 m gives 15 kg/m; the same ratio is undefined for a zero-advance standstill. Material escaping into external voids can produce high consumption without a continuous barrier, while empty pumping inflates metered use. Procurement quantities alone can confuse material loss with effective sealing. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Consumption and effective replenishment” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「密封材料消耗越大就代表實際阻水性能必定越好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Higher seal-medium consumption necessarily means better actual water resistance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「密封消耗與有效補充」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Consumption and effective replenishment”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 密封消耗與有效補充
knowledge.text: 密封介質消耗包含隨盾體運動帶走、外漏和填補空隙，單位進尺消耗能作趨勢但不直接證明效果。停機期間的消耗與推進期間意義不同，應區分時間基準與距離基準。
knowledge.textEn: Seal consumption includes movement losses, leakage and filling of voids. Consumption per advance supports trending without proving performance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：密封材料消耗越大就代表實際阻水性能必定越好。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Higher seal-medium consumption necessarily means better actual water resistance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「密封消耗與有效補充」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Consumption and effective replenishment" is correct?
options: 密封材料消耗越大就代表實際阻水性能必定越好。
密封介質消耗包含隨盾體運動帶走、外漏和填補空隙，單位進尺消耗能作趨勢但不直接證明效果。
常溫黏度較高的材料在所有工況都一定較適合密封。
optionsEn: Higher seal-medium consumption necessarily means better actual water resistance.
Seal consumption includes movement losses, leakage and filling of voids.
Higher ambient viscosity necessarily makes a material the better seal under every condition.
quiz.explanation: 密封介質消耗包含隨盾體運動帶走、外漏和填補空隙，單位進尺消耗能作趨勢但不直接證明效果。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Seal consumption includes movement losses, leakage and filling of voids. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 密封消耗與有效補充：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Consumption and effective replenishment: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「密封消耗與有效補充」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Consumption and effective replenishment” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設一段消耗120 kg、前進8 m，單位消耗15 kg/m；另一停機時段不能以零進尺計此比值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed consumption 120 kg over 8 m gives 15 kg/m; the same ratio is undefined for a zero-advance standstill. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以儲桶重量及計量器互核，按刷列分區記錄並對照盾體行程、停機和漏水；異常增加需判斷幾何變化或外漏，不能僅因材料用量高就宣稱密封較可靠。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Cross-check containers and meters by zone against advance, stops and leakage; investigate geometric change or external loss when consumption rises rather than assuming greater material use means greater sealing reliability.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設一段消耗120 kg、前進8 m，單位消耗15 kg/m；另一停機時段不能以零進尺計此比值。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed consumption 120 kg over 8 m gives 15 kg/m; the same ratio is undefined for a zero-advance standstill.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「密封消耗與有效補充」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Consumption and effective replenishment", which statement holds?
options: 灌漿和密封各自儀表正常就不必檢查彼此介面。
停機前不漏水就保證任何停留時間後仍有相同性能。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: Normal separate grout and seal readings eliminate the need to examine their interface.
No leakage before stopping guarantees identical performance after any standstill duration.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.

steps.title: 密封消耗與有效補充：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Consumption and effective replenishment: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「密封消耗與有效補充」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Consumption and effective replenishment” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以儲桶重量及計量器互核，按刷列分區記錄並對照盾體行程、停機和漏水；異常增加需判斷幾何變化或外漏，不能僅因材料用量高就宣稱密封較可靠。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：密封材料大量流入外部空隙可能消耗很高卻未建立連續阻水，計量器空打又會虛增用量；只用採購量推估性能會把損失當成功。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Cross-check containers and meters by zone against advance, stops and leakage; investigate geometric change or external loss when consumption rises rather than assuming greater material use means greater sealing reliability. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Material escaping into external voids can produce high consumption without a continuous barrier, while empty pumping inflates metered use. Procurement quantities alone can confuse material loss with effective sealing. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄密封消耗與有效補充的資料來源與適用條件。以儲桶重量及計量器互核，按刷列分區記錄並對照盾體行程、停機和漏水；異常增加需判斷幾何變化或外漏，不能僅因材料用量高就宣稱密封較可靠。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for consumption and effective replenishment. Cross-check containers and meters by zone against advance, stops and leakage; investigate geometric change or external loss when consumption rises rather than assuming greater material use means greater sealing reliability.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：密封材料大量流入外部空隙可能消耗很高卻未建立連續阻水，計量器空打又會虛增用量；只用採購量推估性能會把損失當成功。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Material escaping into external voids can produce high consumption without a continuous barrier, while empty pumping inflates metered use. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以儲桶重量及計量器互核，按刷列分區記錄並對照盾體行程、停機和漏水；異常增加需判斷幾何變化或外漏，不能僅因材料用量高就宣稱密封較可靠。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：密封材料大量流入外部空隙可能消耗很高卻未建立連續阻水，計量器空打又會虛增用量；只用採購量推估性能會把損失當成功。
knowledge.textEn: Cross-check containers and meters by zone against advance, stops and leakage; investigate geometric change or external loss when consumption rises rather than assuming greater material use means greater sealing reliability. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Material escaping into external voids can produce high consumption without a continuous barrier, while empty pumping inflates metered use. Procurement quantities alone can confuse material loss with effective sealing.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄密封消耗與有效補充的資料來源與適用條件。以儲桶重量及計量器互核，按刷列分區記錄並對照盾體行程、停機和漏水；異常增加需判斷幾何變化或外漏，不能僅因材料用量高就宣稱密封較可靠。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for consumption and effective replenishment. Cross-check containers and meters by zone against advance, stops and leakage; investigate geometric change or external loss when consumption rises rather than assuming greater material use means greater sealing reliability.

quiz.question: 要驗證「密封消耗與有效補充」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Consumption and effective replenishment"?
options: 以儲桶重量及計量器互核，按刷列分區記錄並對照盾體行程、停機和漏水；異常增加需判斷幾何變化或外漏，不能僅因材料用量高就宣稱密封較可靠。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
多道密封即使共用失效供應，也能直接按獨立機率相乘。
optionsEn: Cross-check containers and meters by zone against advance, stops and leakage.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Multiple seals sharing a failed supply still justify multiplying independent failure probabilities.

quiz.explanationEn: Cross-check containers and meters by zone against advance, stops and leakage; investigate geometric change or external loss when consumption rises rather than assuming greater material use means greater sealing reliability. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 密封消耗與有效補充：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Consumption and effective replenishment: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「密封消耗與有效補充」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Consumption and effective replenishment” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 密封材料大量流入外部空隙可能消耗很高卻未建立連續阻水，計量器空打又會虛增用量；只用採購量推估性能會把損失當成功。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Material escaping into external voids can produce high consumption without a continuous barrier, while empty pumping inflates metered use. steps.observation: 連結機制：密封材料大量流入外部空隙可能消耗很高卻未建立連續阻水，計量器空打又會虛增用量；只用採購量推估性能會把損失當成功。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Procurement quantities alone can confuse material loss with effective sealing.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「密封材料消耗越大就代表實際阻水性能必定越好。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Higher seal-medium consumption necessarily means better actual water resistance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 密封材料大量流入外部空隙可能消耗很高卻未建立連續阻水，計量器空打又會虛增用量；只用採購量推估性能會把損失當成功。

密封材料大量流入外部空隙可能消耗很高卻未建立連續阻水，計量器空打又會虛增用量；只用採購量推估性能會把損失當成功。
常溫黏度較高的材料在所有工況都一定較適合密封。

Material escaping into external voids can produce high consumption without a continuous barrier, while empty pumping inflates metered use.
Higher ambient viscosity necessarily makes a material the better seal under every condition.

steps.title: 流變與輸送相容：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rheology and delivery compatibility: mechanism and system paths

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rheology and delivery compatibility” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shield-tail brushes and sealing grease systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 密封介質需兼顧可泵送、黏附及抗水沖，溫度改變會同時影響輸送阻力與保持能力。只以黏度高低排序忽略剪切與時間效應，產品相容性及設備適用範圍需由正式試驗確認。 假設管線同流量下壓降由1.0增1.5 MPa，比值1.5；不能直接斷定密封能力也增加50%。 低溫變稠可能讓管線壓高而刷列缺料，高溫過軟又可能被水沖失；用同一常溫試驗概括全部工況，會忽略性能的兩端限制。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「流變與輸送相容」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Sealing medium balances pumpability, adhesion and washout resistance. If assumed line loss rises from 1.0 to 1.5 MPa at equal flow, the ratio is 1.5; sealing ability has not thereby increased by 50%. Cold thickening can raise line pressure while starving the seal, whereas excessive softening in heat permits washout. quiz.question: 關於「流變與輸送相容」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 流變與輸送相容：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設管線同流量下壓降由1.0增1.5 MPa，比值1.5；不能直接斷定密封能力也增加50%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If assumed line loss rises from 1.0 to 1.5 MPa at equal flow, the ratio is 1.5; sealing ability has not thereby increased by 50%. steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Segment surface and contact” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shield-tail brushes and sealing grease systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 刷列沿環片外表面滑動，局部缺角、凸起或附著砂漿會改變接觸並磨損刷毛。防水問題因此不僅是密封材料，也包含環片製造與組裝品質，缺陷位置要能追到環號方位。 假設周長20 m中有0.5 m表面缺陷帶，占2.5%；局部連續缺陷不能按面積比例平均風險。 未清除的凸塊可連續損傷多道刷列，缺角又形成局部水路；只處理可見內側漏水而不追外表面缺陷，問題可能在後續環持續出現。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「環片表面與接觸」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Brushes slide along segment exteriors, where chips, protrusions and adhered mortar alter contact and wear. Sealing therefore depends on manufacturing and assembly quality as well as medium, requiring defects to be traceable by ring and angle. An assumed 0.5 m defect band along a 20 m circumference is 2.5%; a continuous local defect cannot have its risk averaged by that fraction. A protrusion may damage several brush rows in sequence, while a chip forms a local path. Treating visible internal leakage without tracing exterior defects can allow the problem to recur on subsequent rings. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Segment surface and contact” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A small segment exterior defect cannot damage multiple tail-brush rows." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Segment surface and contact”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 刷列沿環片外表面滑動，局部缺角、凸起或附著砂漿會改變接觸並磨損刷毛。防水問題因此不僅是密封材料，也包含環片製造與組裝品質，缺陷位置要能追到環號方位。
knowledge.textEn: Brushes slide along segment exteriors, where chips, protrusions and adhered mortar alter contact and wear. Sealing therefore depends on manufacturing and assembly quality as well as medium, requiring defects to be traceable by ring and angle.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：環片外表面缺陷很小就不可能損傷多道盾尾刷列。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A small segment exterior defect cannot damage multiple tail-brush rows. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「環片表面與接觸」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Segment surface and contact" is correct?
options: 刷列沿環片外表面滑動，局部缺角、凸起或附著砂漿會改變接觸並磨損刷毛。
環片外表面缺陷很小就不可能損傷多道盾尾刷列。
灌漿和密封各自儀表正常就不必檢查彼此介面。
optionsEn: Brushes slide along segment exteriors, where chips, protrusions and adhered mortar alter contact and wear.
A small segment exterior defect cannot damage multiple tail-brush rows.
Normal separate grout and seal readings eliminate the need to examine their interface.
quiz.explanation: 刷列沿環片外表面滑動，局部缺角、凸起或附著砂漿會改變接觸並磨損刷毛。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Brushes slide along segment exteriors, where chips, protrusions and adhered mortar alter contact and wear. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 環片表面與接觸：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Segment surface and contact: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「環片表面與接觸」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Segment surface and contact” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設周長20 m中有0.5 m表面缺陷帶，占2.5%；局部連續缺陷不能按面積比例平均風險。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed 0.5 m defect band along a 20 m circumference is 2.5%; a continuous local defect cannot have its risk averaged by that fraction. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在核准可接近位置查外觀及製造記錄，將缺陷方位與尾隙、漏水及消耗對照；任何修補須符合環片及設備要求，不能讓未審查修補凸起穿過密封刷列。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Inspect accessible surfaces and manufacturing records under approved access, correlating defects with clearance, leakage and consumption; repairs must meet segment and machine requirements before an unreviewed protrusion passes through brushes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 環片表面與接觸：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「環片表面與接觸」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Segment surface and contact” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在核准可接近位置查外觀及製造記錄，將缺陷方位與尾隙、漏水及消耗對照；任何修補須符合環片及設備要求，不能讓未審查修補凸起穿過密封刷列。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：未清除的凸塊可連續損傷多道刷列，缺角又形成局部水路；只處理可見內側漏水而不追外表面缺陷，問題可能在後續環持續出現。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Inspect accessible surfaces and manufacturing records under approved access, correlating defects with clearance, leakage and consumption; repairs must meet segment and machine requirements before an unreviewed protrusion passes through brushes. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: A protrusion may damage several brush rows in sequence, while a chip forms a local path. Treating visible internal leakage without tracing exterior defects can allow the problem to recur on subsequent rings. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄環片表面與接觸的資料來源與適用條件。在核准可接近位置查外觀及製造記錄，將缺陷方位與尾隙、漏水及消耗對照；任何修補須符合環片及設備要求，不能讓未審查修補凸起穿過密封刷列。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for segment surface and contact. Inspect accessible surfaces and manufacturing records under approved access, correlating defects with clearance, leakage and consumption; repairs must meet segment and machine requirements before an unreviewed protrusion passes through brushes.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未清除的凸塊可連續損傷多道刷列，缺角又形成局部水路；只處理可見內側漏水而不追外表面缺陷，問題可能在後續環持續出現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A protrusion may damage several brush rows in sequence, while a chip forms a local path. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: A protrusion may damage several brush rows in sequence, while a chip forms a local path. Treating visible internal leakage without tracing exterior defects can allow the problem to recur on subsequent rings.

quiz.question: 要驗證「環片表面與接觸」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

供應端壓力很高就證明材料已經到達每道刷列。

optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
High supply-end pressure proves material has reached every brush row.
Inspect accessible surfaces and manufacturing records under approved access, correlating defects with clearance, leakage and consumption.

quiz.explanationEn: Inspect accessible surfaces and manufacturing records under approved access, correlating defects with clearance, leakage and consumption; repairs must meet segment and machine requirements before an unreviewed protrusion passes through brushes. steps.title: 環片表面與接觸：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Segment surface and contact: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「環片表面與接觸」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Segment surface and contact” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未清除的凸塊可連續損傷多道刷列，缺角又形成局部水路；只處理可見內側漏水而不追外表面缺陷，問題可能在後續環持續出現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A protrusion may damage several brush rows in sequence, while a chip forms a local path. Treating visible internal leakage without tracing exterior defects can allow the problem to recur on subsequent rings. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：未清除的凸塊可連續損傷多道刷列，缺角又形成局部水路；只處理可見內側漏水而不追外表面缺陷，問題可能在後續環持續出現。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「環片外表面缺陷很小就不可能損傷多道盾尾刷列。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A small segment exterior defect cannot damage multiple tail-brush rows." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 未清除的凸塊可連續損傷多道刷列，缺角又形成局部水路；只處理可見內側漏水而不追外表面缺陷，問題可能在後續環持續出現。

Normal separate grout and seal readings eliminate the need to examine their interface.

steps.title: 灌漿與密封交互作用：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Grouting and seal interaction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「灌漿與密封交互作用」如何影響盾尾刷與密封脂系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Grouting and seal interaction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shield-tail brushes and sealing grease systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 盾尾外的灌漿填補環隙，也可能對密封施加暫態壓力或讓硬化材料侵入刷列。灌漿與密封系統應協調時間、位置與壓力證據，不能各自看儀表正常就假定介面無問題。 假設外部灌漿壓力250 kPa、局部密封腔讀值230 kPa，差20 kPa；此差值只供診斷，非容許界線。 灌漿倒入刷列後硬化會降低柔順接觸，表面暫時止漏卻可能造成後續破壞；不同系統時鐘不一致又會掩蓋兩者的因果關聯。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「灌漿與密封交互作用」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Backfill outside the tail closes the annulus but can load seals transiently or introduce hardening material into brushes. Grout and seal systems need coordinated time, location and pressure evidence rather than isolated normal readings. Assumed external grout pressure 250 kPa and local cavity reading 230 kPa differ by 20 kPa; the difference is diagnostic, not an allowable boundary. Grout hardening in brushes reduces compliant contact; temporary apparent sealing can precede later damage. Unsynchronized system clocks further conceal the causal link between grout events and seal deterioration. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Grouting and seal interaction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Grouting and seal interaction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設外部灌漿壓力250 kPa、局部密封腔讀值230 kPa，差20 kPa；此差值只供診斷，非容許界線。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed external grout pressure 250 kPa and local cavity reading 230 kPa differ by 20 kPa; the difference is diagnostic, not an allowable boundary. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步灌漿口與密封分區資料，核對高程與感測位置並追蹤材料硬化時間；漏水或消耗變化需查是否與特定灌漿事件重合，由灌漿及設備負責人共同審查介面。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize grout-port and seal-zone records with elevation, sensor location and setting time; investigate whether leakage or consumption changes coincide with specific grouting events, with joint grout and equipment review.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instructionEn: Synchronize grout-port and seal-zone records with elevation, sensor location and setting time; investigate whether leakage or consumption changes coincide with specific grouting events, with joint grout and equipment review. steps.instruction: 灌漿倒入刷列後硬化會降低柔順接觸，表面暫時止漏卻可能造成後續破壞；不同系統時鐘不一致又會掩蓋兩者的因果關聯。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Grout hardening in brushes reduces compliant contact; temporary apparent sealing can precede later damage. Unsynchronized system clocks further conceal the causal link between grout events and seal deterioration. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：灌漿倒入刷列後硬化會降低柔順接觸，表面暫時止漏卻可能造成後續破壞；不同系統時鐘不一致又會掩蓋兩者的因果關聯。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 漏水量與趨勢判讀：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「漏水量與趨勢判讀」如何影響盾尾刷與密封脂系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。

steps.instruction: 可見漏水量受收集範圍、排水混流與壓差影響，不能把排水泵總量全歸盾尾。持續上升或混入細土比單次清水滴漏更需追查，量測應將來源和時間分開。 假設專用收集槽5 min增加30 L，平均漏量6 L/min=0.1 L/s；未分流總排水不適用。 排水槽混入洗滌水可製造假漏水趨勢，細土沉積又可能使流量看似下降但侵蝕仍在；只有水量而無來源與固體證據，不能判斷惡化是否停止。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「漏水量與趨勢判讀」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Observed leakage depends on collection area, mixed drainage and pressure difference; total sump pumping is not all tail leakage. Rising flow or fines warrants distinct investigation, with sources and time explicitly separated. An assumed dedicated tank gaining 30 L in 5 min indicates 6 L/min=0.1 L/s; mixed drainage cannot support the same attribution. Wash water creates false leakage trends, while deposited fines can reduce collected flow despite continuing erosion. Flow alone without source and solids evidence cannot establish that deterioration has stopped. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Leakage rate and trend interpretation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All sump-pump discharge can be attributed directly to tail-seal leakage." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「漏水量與趨勢判讀」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

quiz.question: 關於「漏水量與趨勢判讀」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

停機前不漏水就保證任何停留時間後仍有相同性能。

No leakage before stopping guarantees identical performance after any standstill duration.

steps.title: 漏水量與趨勢判讀：試驗與驗證

steps.instruction: 採核准安全方式辨識收集來源，使用計量槽或流量計並記錄濁度與壓差；比對分區密封和施工事件，任何異常依既定應變計畫由負責人處理，不能靠學徒自行追入受壓區。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：排水槽混入洗滌水可製造假漏水趨勢，細土沉積又可能使流量看似下降但侵蝕仍在；只有水量而無來源與固體證據，不能判斷惡化是否停止。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 漏水量與趨勢判讀：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Leakage rate and trend interpretation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「漏水量與趨勢判讀」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Leakage rate and trend interpretation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 排水槽混入洗滌水可製造假漏水趨勢，細土沉積又可能使流量看似下降但侵蝕仍在；只有水量而無來源與固體證據，不能判斷惡化是否停止。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Wash water creates false leakage trends, while deposited fines can reduce collected flow despite continuing erosion. Flow alone without source and solids evidence cannot establish that deterioration has stopped. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：排水槽混入洗滌水可製造假漏水趨勢，細土沉積又可能使流量看似下降但侵蝕仍在；只有水量而無來源與固體證據，不能判斷惡化是否停止。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Flow alone without source and solids evidence cannot establish that deterioration has stopped.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「排水泵總量可以全部直接歸因於盾尾密封漏水。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All sump-pump discharge can be attributed directly to tail-seal leakage." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「漏水量與趨勢判讀」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
No leakage before stopping guarantees identical performance after any standstill duration.
Wash water creates false leakage trends, while deposited fines can reduce collected flow despite continuing erosion.
quiz.explanation: 排水槽混入洗滌水可製造假漏水趨勢，細土沉積又可能使流量看似下降但侵蝕仍在；只有水量而無來源與固體證據，不能判斷惡化是否停止。 需以量測區分可能原因。

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「停機保存與劣化」與「密封狀態工程移交」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Standstill preservation and deterioration" and "Seal-condition engineering handover": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 停機保存與劣化：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Standstill preservation and deterioration: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「停機保存與劣化」如何影響盾尾刷與密封脂系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Standstill preservation and deterioration” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shield-tail brushes and sealing grease systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 停機時盾尾仍承受外壓，介質可能被沖失、沉降或隨溫度變化，刷毛也可能被硬化漿體固定。停止前正常不能保證重啟前正常，狀態確認需要看整段停機歷程。 假設停機24 h消耗36 kg，平均1.5 kg/h；此觀測不能轉成通用補充週期或允許停機時限。 供應中斷若被平均耗量掩蓋，密封可能已局部失水，硬化漿體又使刷毛無法跟隨環片；重啟後漏水才暴露，已錯過較早的異常證據。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「停機保存與劣化」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: External loading persists during stoppage while medium washes out, settles or changes with temperature, and grout may immobilize brushes. A normal pre-stop state does not guarantee a normal restart state; the complete standstill history matters. Assumed 36 kg consumption during a 24 h standstill averages 1.5 kg/h; it does not prescribe a universal replenishment interval or allowable stop duration. Average consumption can hide an interruption that dries part of the barrier, while hardened grout prevents brushes following segments. Leakage on restart then reveals damage whose earlier evidence was missed. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Standstill preservation and deterioration” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「停機前不漏水就保證任何停留時間後仍有相同性能。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "No leakage before stopping guarantees identical performance after any standstill duration." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「停機保存與劣化」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Standstill preservation and deterioration”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: External loading persists during stoppage while medium washes out, settles or changes with temperature, and grout may immobilize brushes. A normal pre-stop state does not guarantee a normal restart state; the complete standstill history matters.

knowledge.text: 誤解：停機前不漏水就保證任何停留時間後仍有相同性能。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: No leakage before stopping guarantees identical performance after any standstill duration. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「停機保存與劣化」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Standstill preservation and deterioration" is correct?
options: 停機時盾尾仍承受外壓，介質可能被沖失、沉降或隨溫度變化，刷毛也可能被硬化漿體固定。

optionsEn: External loading persists during stoppage while medium washes out, settles or changes with temperature, and grout may immobilize brushes.
No leakage before stopping guarantees identical performance after any standstill duration.

steps.title: 停機保存與劣化：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Standstill preservation and deterioration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「停機保存與劣化」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Standstill preservation and deterioration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設停機24 h消耗36 kg，平均1.5 kg/h；此觀測不能轉成通用補充週期或允許停機時限。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed 36 kg consumption during a 24 h standstill averages 1.5 kg/h; it does not prescribe a universal replenishment interval or allowable stop duration. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：按設備核准計畫檢查停機期間壓力、消耗與漏水，保留供應中斷及溫度事件；重啟前由設備及施工主管確認幾何和密封證據，不能僅因泵浦可運轉就視為已恢復功能。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Review pressure, consumption and leakage through the approved standstill plan, retaining interruptions and temperature events; equipment and construction leads verify geometry and seal evidence before restart rather than relying on pump operation alone.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 停機保存與劣化：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Standstill preservation and deterioration: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「停機保存與劣化」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Standstill preservation and deterioration” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 按設備核准計畫檢查停機期間壓力、消耗與漏水，保留供應中斷及溫度事件；重啟前由設備及施工主管確認幾何和密封證據，不能僅因泵浦可運轉就視為已恢復功能。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：供應中斷若被平均耗量掩蓋，密封可能已局部失水，硬化漿體又使刷毛無法跟隨環片；重啟後漏水才暴露，已錯過較早的異常證據。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Review pressure, consumption and leakage through the approved standstill plan, retaining interruptions and temperature events; equipment and construction leads verify geometry and seal evidence before restart rather than relying on pump operation alone. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Average consumption can hide an interruption that dries part of the barrier, while hardened grout prevents brushes following segments. Leakage on restart then reveals damage whose earlier evidence was missed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄停機保存與劣化的資料來源與適用條件。按設備核准計畫檢查停機期間壓力、消耗與漏水，保留供應中斷及溫度事件；重啟前由設備及施工主管確認幾何和密封證據，不能僅因泵浦可運轉就視為已恢復功能。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for standstill preservation and deterioration. Review pressure, consumption and leakage through the approved standstill plan, retaining interruptions and temperature events; equipment and construction leads verify geometry and seal evidence before restart rather than relying on pump operation alone.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：供應中斷若被平均耗量掩蓋，密封可能已局部失水，硬化漿體又使刷毛無法跟隨環片；重啟後漏水才暴露，已錯過較早的異常證據。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Average consumption can hide an interruption that dries part of the barrier, while hardened grout prevents brushes following segments. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
