quiz.question: 在「磨耗率與地層分段」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

steps.title: 刀環磨耗與軸承故障：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 刀環磨耗是接觸表面的漸進損失，軸承故障則可能使刀具停止滾動並產生滑磨，兩者症狀不同。溫度、聲振和磨耗形態需要合併，不能只量剩餘直徑就判斷可用性。 假設正常溫度40°C、觀測65°C，升幅25 K；此差只供教學診斷，不是通用軸承警戒值。 卡死刀具會由滾動變滑動，局部發熱和刀環損失加速，總扭矩初期卻未必明顯；只靠平均刀盤訊號可能漏掉早期單刀故障。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「刀環磨耗與軸承故障」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ring wear is gradual surface loss, whereas bearing failure can stop rotation and create sliding abrasion. Temperature, vibration and wear shape are complementary, and remaining diameter alone cannot establish tool condition. Assume normal temperature 40°C and observation 65°C; the rise is 25 K, a diagnostic illustration rather than a universal bearing alarm. A seized tool slides rather than rolls, accelerating heat and local wear while total torque may initially change little. Average cutterhead signals can therefore miss the early failure of one cutter. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ring wear and bearing failure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adequate remaining ring diameter proves that bearings and rotation are also healthy." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「刀環磨耗與軸承故障」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume normal temperature 40°C and observation 65°C; the rise is 25 K, a diagnostic illustration rather than a universal bearing alarm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較同工況刀具的溫度與振動基線，檢查平磨面、偏磨及轉動狀態的核准檢查紀錄；設備主管需區分散熱環境和軸承異常，所有接近刀盤檢查遵守專業安全程序。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 比較同工況刀具的溫度與振動基線，檢查平磨面、偏磨及轉動狀態的核准檢查紀錄；設備主管需區分散熱環境和軸承異常，所有接近刀盤檢查遵守專業安全程序。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：卡死刀具會由滾動變滑動，局部發熱和刀環損失加速，總扭矩初期卻未必明顯；只靠平均刀盤訊號可能漏掉早期單刀故障。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 卡死刀具會由滾動變滑動，局部發熱和刀環損失加速，總扭矩初期卻未必明顯；只靠平均刀盤訊號可能漏掉早期單刀故障。
knowledge.textEn: A seized tool slides rather than rolls, accelerating heat and local wear while total torque may initially change little. Average cutterhead signals can therefore miss the early failure of one cutter.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Normal shift-average torque means no localized cutter impact fatigue is occurring.

quiz.explanationEn: A seized tool slides rather than rolls, accelerating heat and local wear while total torque may initially change little. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證

steps.title: 衝擊與混合面循環：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「衝擊與混合面循環」如何影響潛盾機刀具磨耗管理的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Impact and mixed-face cycling” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “TBM cutter-wear management”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 刀具每轉穿越硬軟界面會反覆載入卸載，平均力無法代表疲勞與衝擊。界面位置、硬塊尺寸和旋轉速度共同控制循環數與幅值，需把事件和刀位路徑對齊。 假設每轉有2次硬軟轉換、轉速3 rpm、持續100 h，轉換次數2×3×60×100=36000次。 取樣頻率不足會把衝擊平均掉，刀具卻持續承受疲勞；只統計轉數又忽略硬軟界面轉換，可能誤把局部崩裂當成偶然製造缺陷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「衝擊與混合面循環」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Crossing a hard-soft interface repeatedly loads and unloads a tool. Mean force cannot represent fatigue and impact; interface position, inclusion size and rotation together control cycling, requiring events to be aligned with cutter trajectories. Assume 2 transitions per revolution at 3 rpm over 100 h; transition count is 2×3×60×100=36000. Slow sampling averages impacts away while fatigue continues. Counting revolutions without interface crossings may wrongly classify localized chipping as a random manufacturing defect rather than repeated loading. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Impact and mixed-face cycling” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「班平均扭矩正常就表示沒有局部刀具衝擊疲勞。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Normal shift-average torque means no localized cutter impact fatigue is occurring." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設每轉有2次硬軟轉換、轉速3 rpm、持續100 h，轉換次數2×3×60×100=36000次。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume 2 transitions per revolution at 3 rpm over 100 h; transition count is 2×3×60×100=36000. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：利用地質面形與旋轉訊號對照週期性衝擊，保留高頻資料而非僅班平均；刀具工程師依實際載荷幅和材料資料評估損傷，循環數本身不能換成未經驗證的剩餘壽命。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare face geometry with rotation-synchronized impacts and retain high-frequency records rather than shift means; specialists assess damage using actual amplitudes and material data, not cycle count alone as an unvalidated remaining-life prediction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Slow sampling averages impacts away while fatigue continues.
The same spacing-penetration ratio gives identical optimum cutting in every rock type.

steps.title: 刀間距與碴片形成：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 相鄰刀槽之間的裂縫若能連通，岩石以較大碴片剝離；間距、貫入與岩性不匹配時會變成重複研磨。幾何比只描述相對尺度，不能不經試驗就轉成通用最佳刀間距。 假設刀間距80 mm、貫入10 mm，比值s/p=8；相同比值在不同岩性不保證相同比能。 粉碴增加可能表示研磨、磨鈍或岩性改變，不能一律歸於間距不當；若只追求大碴片也可能忽略排碴能力和混合面衝擊的限制。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「刀間距與碴片形成」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Connected cracks between neighboring tracks release larger chips, while mismatched spacing, penetration and rock behavior promote regrinding. A geometry ratio describes relative scale without establishing a universal optimum spacing absent testing. For assumed spacing 80 mm and penetration 10 mm, s/p=8; the same ratio in different rocks does not guarantee equal specific energy. More fines may indicate regrinding, blunt tools or changed geology rather than spacing alone. Maximizing chip size can also neglect muck-handling capacity and impact limitations in mixed ground. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cutter spacing and chip formation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The same spacing-penetration ratio gives identical optimum cutting in every rock type." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「刀間距與碴片形成」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed spacing 80 mm and penetration 10 mm, s/p=8; the same ratio in different rocks does not guarantee equal specific energy. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume a ring is replaced after 400 h while its bearing already had 200 h; an unchanged bearing has accumulated 600 h, not 400 h or zero. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.instruction: 抽查刀位圖與序號、維修單、照片和量測紀錄能否互相連接，重建組件累積里程；資料負責人與維修主管共同確認重置規則，缺失歷程需標示不確定而非補寫理想值。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：序號抄錯會把早期故障歸到另一批次，更換整刀與只換刀環未區分則誇大或低估壽命；供應比較和備件計畫都會被錯誤歷程影響。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.instruction: 序號抄錯會把早期故障歸到另一批次，更換整刀與只換刀環未區分則誇大或低估壽命；供應比較和備件計畫都會被錯誤歷程影響。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：序號抄錯會把早期故障歸到另一批次，更換整刀與只換刀環未區分則誇大或低估壽命；供應比較和備件計畫都會被錯誤歷程影響。

steps.title: 維護決策與檢查界線：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Maintenance decisions and access boundaries: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「維護決策與檢查界線」如何影響潛盾機刀具磨耗管理的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Maintenance decisions and access boundaries” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “TBM cutter-wear management”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 刀具維護需整合剩餘厚度、軸承狀態、預測地層與可檢查窗口，不能由單一磨耗率自動決定。資料驅動判讀只支持專業決策，刀盤或加壓艙的接近仍是獨立的高風險核准工作。 假設40刀中36刀有最新有效狀態，覆蓋90%；其餘4刀若位於同一高負荷區，不能以整體比例忽略。 只按平均磨耗安排檢查可能漏掉一顆卡死刀具，預測模型若未更新新岩層也會過度樂觀；忽略這些限制會讓規劃數字被誤當現場許可。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「維護決策與檢查界線」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Maintenance combines remaining section, bearing condition, predicted ground and inspection opportunities rather than one wear rate. Data supports professional decisions, while access to a cutterhead or pressurized chamber remains a separately approved specialist task. If 36 of an assumed 40 cutters have current valid condition records, coverage is 90%; 4 missing tools in a high-load zone cannot be dismissed by the overall percentage. Average-wear scheduling can miss one seized tool, and an unupdated ground model gives optimistic forecasts. Ignoring these limits can turn planning numbers into mistakenly assumed authorization for field work. title: 隧道管片預鑄與養護
summary: 本課聚焦把環片永久受力、製造品質與暫態施工荷載連成完整驗證鏈。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。
summaryEn: This course focuses on connect permanent segment behavior, manufacturing quality and temporary construction loads. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設薄環均勻外壓p=0.3 MPa、半徑3 m，環向膜力N=pR=0.9 MN/m；不含彎矩及接縫。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設三個抗壓試值48、50、52 MPa，平均50 MPa；此小樣本平均不是規範特徵強度。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume uniform pressure p=0.3 MPa on a thin ring of radius 3 m; membrane force N=pR=0.9 MN/m, excluding bending and joints. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed compressive results 48,50 and 52 MPa average 50 MPa; this small-sample mean is not a code-defined characteristic strength. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「全環與局部荷載」與「材料批次與強度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ring and local load cases" and "Material batches and strength": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 全環與局部荷載：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ring and local load cases: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「全環與局部荷載」如何影響隧道管片預鑄與養護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ring and local load cases” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel-segment precasting and curing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 預鑄環片完成閉環後承受土水載重，運輸、組裝與推進時卻有不同邊界和集中力。永久環分析不能包辦所有階段，需建立從工廠到受力成環的荷載路徑清單，逐項確認最不利狀態。 假設薄環均勻外壓p=0.3 MPa、半徑3 m，環向膜力N=pR=0.9 MN/m；不含彎矩及接縫。 環片在工廠完好卻可能於運輸支點附近開裂，之後裂縫影響水密與耐久；若只審查成環土壓，這種施工階段損傷沒有被設計覆蓋。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「全環與局部荷載」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A closed segmental ring carries ground and water loads, while transport, assembly and thrust impose different restraints and concentrated forces. Permanent-ring analysis cannot cover every stage; trace load paths from factory to completed ring. Assume uniform pressure p=0.3 MPa on a thin ring of radius 3 m; membrane force N=pR=0.9 MN/m, excluding bending and joints. Segments sound at the factory may crack near transport supports and later lose watertightness or durability. Reviewing only completed-ring earth pressure leaves that construction-stage damage outside the design assessment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ring and local load cases” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「永久成環荷載合格就代表運輸和吊運階段必定合格。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adequate permanent-ring capacity necessarily proves adequate transport and handling performance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「全環與局部荷載」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Ring and local load cases”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 全環與局部荷載
knowledge.text: 預鑄環片完成閉環後承受土水載重，運輸、組裝與推進時卻有不同邊界和集中力。永久環分析不能包辦所有階段，需建立從工廠到受力成環的荷載路徑清單，逐項確認最不利狀態。
knowledge.textEn: A closed segmental ring carries ground and water loads, while transport, assembly and thrust impose different restraints and concentrated forces. Permanent-ring analysis cannot cover every stage; trace load paths from factory to completed ring.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：永久成環荷載合格就代表運輸和吊運階段必定合格。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adequate permanent-ring capacity necessarily proves adequate transport and handling performance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「全環與局部荷載」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ring and local load cases" is correct?
options: 永久成環荷載合格就代表運輸和吊運階段必定合格。
預鑄環片完成閉環後承受土水載重，運輸、組裝與推進時卻有不同邊界和集中力。
少量試塊平均強度就是整批環片的特徵設計強度。
optionsEn: Adequate permanent-ring capacity necessarily proves adequate transport and handling performance.
A closed segmental ring carries ground and water loads, while transport, assembly and thrust impose different restraints and concentrated forces.
The mean of a few specimens is the characteristic design strength of the whole batch.
quiz.explanation: 預鑄環片完成閉環後承受土水載重，運輸、組裝與推進時卻有不同邊界和集中力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A closed segmental ring carries ground and water loads, while transport, assembly and thrust impose different restraints and concentrated forces. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 全環與局部荷載：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ring and local load cases: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「全環與局部荷載」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ring and local load cases” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設薄環均勻外壓p=0.3 MPa、半徑3 m，環向膜力N=pR=0.9 MN/m；不含彎矩及接縫。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume uniform pressure p=0.3 MPa on a thin ring of radius 3 m; membrane force N=pR=0.9 MN/m, excluding bending and joints. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將永久、堆放、運輸與推進荷載分列計算工況，檢查支承位置與實際程序一致；以代表性構件試驗或核准分析驗證，任何暫態工況不能因永久承載合格而省略。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: List permanent, storage, transport and thrust cases with supports matching actual arrangements; verify through appropriate component tests or approved analysis, retaining temporary cases even when permanent capacity is adequate.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設薄環均勻外壓p=0.3 MPa、半徑3 m，環向膜力N=pR=0.9 MN/m；不含彎矩及接縫。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume uniform pressure p=0.3 MPa on a thin ring of radius 3 m; membrane force N=pR=0.9 MN/m, excluding bending and joints.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「全環與局部荷載」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ring and local load cases", which statement holds?
options: 同向尺寸偏差可以和獨立隨機誤差一樣平方根加總。
同一環片的吊運支點移動不會改變暫態彎矩。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: Same-direction dimensional biases can be combined like independent random errors by root-sum-square.
Moving handling support points cannot change transient bending in the same segment.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 全環與局部荷載：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ring and local load cases: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「全環與局部荷載」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ring and local load cases” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將永久、堆放、運輸與推進荷載分列計算工況，檢查支承位置與實際程序一致；以代表性構件試驗或核准分析驗證，任何暫態工況不能因永久承載合格而省略。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：環片在工廠完好卻可能於運輸支點附近開裂，之後裂縫影響水密與耐久；若只審查成環土壓，這種施工階段損傷沒有被設計覆蓋。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: List permanent, storage, transport and thrust cases with supports matching actual arrangements; verify through appropriate component tests or approved analysis, retaining temporary cases even when permanent capacity is adequate. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Segments sound at the factory may crack near transport supports and later lose watertightness or durability. Reviewing only completed-ring earth pressure leaves that construction-stage damage outside the design assessment. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄全環與局部荷載的資料來源與適用條件。將永久、堆放、運輸與推進荷載分列計算工況，檢查支承位置與實際程序一致；以代表性構件試驗或核准分析驗證，任何暫態工況不能因永久承載合格而省略。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for ring and local load cases. List permanent, storage, transport and thrust cases with supports matching actual arrangements; verify through appropriate component tests or approved analysis, retaining temporary cases even when permanent capacity is adequate.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：環片在工廠完好卻可能於運輸支點附近開裂，之後裂縫影響水密與耐久；若只審查成環土壓，這種施工階段損傷沒有被設計覆蓋。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Segments sound at the factory may crack near transport supports and later lose watertightness or durability. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將永久、堆放、運輸與推進荷載分列計算工況，檢查支承位置與實際程序一致；以代表性構件試驗或核准分析驗證，任何暫態工況不能因永久承載合格而省略。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：環片在工廠完好卻可能於運輸支點附近開裂，之後裂縫影響水密與耐久；若只審查成環土壓，這種施工階段損傷沒有被設計覆蓋。
knowledge.textEn: List permanent, storage, transport and thrust cases with supports matching actual arrangements; verify through appropriate component tests or approved analysis, retaining temporary cases even when permanent capacity is adequate. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Segments sound at the factory may crack near transport supports and later lose watertightness or durability. Reviewing only completed-ring earth pressure leaves that construction-stage damage outside the design assessment.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時逐項記錄全環與局部荷載的資料來源與適用條件。將永久、堆放、運輸與推進荷載分列計算工況，檢查支承位置與實際程序一致；以代表性構件試驗或核准分析驗證，任何暫態工況不能因永久承載合格而省略。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for ring and local load cases. List permanent, storage, transport and thrust cases with supports matching actual arrangements; verify through appropriate component tests or approved analysis, retaining temporary cases even when permanent capacity is adequate.

quiz.question: 要驗證「全環與局部荷載」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ring and local load cases"?
options: 將永久、堆放、運輸與推進荷載分列計算工況，檢查支承位置與實際程序一致；以代表性構件試驗或核准分析驗證，任何暫態工況不能因永久承載合格而省略。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
熱擴散尺度就是實際爆裂深度和必需耐火厚度。
optionsEn: List permanent, storage, transport and thrust cases with supports matching actual arrangements.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Thermal diffusion scale equals actual spalling depth and required fire-protection thickness.
quiz.explanation: 將永久、堆放、運輸與推進荷載分列計算工況，檢查支承位置與實際程序一致；以代表性構件試驗或核准分析驗證，任何暫態工況不能因永久承載合格而省略。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: List permanent, storage, transport and thrust cases with supports matching actual arrangements; verify through appropriate component tests or approved analysis, retaining temporary cases even when permanent capacity is adequate. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 全環與局部荷載：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ring and local load cases: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「全環與局部荷載」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Ring and local load cases” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 環片在工廠完好卻可能於運輸支點附近開裂，之後裂縫影響水密與耐久；若只審查成環土壓，這種施工階段損傷沒有被設計覆蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Segments sound at the factory may crack near transport supports and later lose watertightness or durability. Reviewing only completed-ring earth pressure leaves that construction-stage damage outside the design assessment. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：環片在工廠完好卻可能於運輸支點附近開裂，之後裂縫影響水密與耐久；若只審查成環土壓，這種施工階段損傷沒有被設計覆蓋。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Reviewing only completed-ring earth pressure leaves that construction-stage damage outside the design assessment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「永久成環荷載合格就代表運輸和吊運階段必定合格。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adequate permanent-ring capacity necessarily proves adequate transport and handling performance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 環片在工廠完好卻可能於運輸支點附近開裂，之後裂縫影響水密與耐久；若只審查成環土壓，這種施工階段損傷沒有被設計覆蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Segments sound at the factory may crack near transport supports and later lose watertightness or durability. Reviewing only completed-ring earth pressure leaves that construction-stage damage outside the design assessment.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「全環與局部荷載」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ring and local load cases" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
環片在工廠完好卻可能於運輸支點附近開裂，之後裂縫影響水密與耐久；若只審查成環土壓，這種施工階段損傷沒有被設計覆蓋。
少量試塊平均強度就是整批環片的特徵設計強度。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Segments sound at the factory may crack near transport supports and later lose watertightness or durability.
The mean of a few specimens is the characteristic design strength of the whole batch.
quiz.explanation: 環片在工廠完好卻可能於運輸支點附近開裂，之後裂縫影響水密與耐久；若只審查成環土壓，這種施工階段損傷沒有被設計覆蓋。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Segments sound at the factory may crack near transport supports and later lose watertightness or durability. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 材料批次與強度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Material batches and strength: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「材料批次與強度」如何影響隧道管片預鑄與養護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Material batches and strength” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel-segment precasting and curing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 混凝土強度受配料、含氣、養護和試體代表性影響，單一高強度試塊不代表整批均勻。環片還需控制韌性、密實與尺寸，強度數字只是品質鏈的一部分而非全部驗收證據。 假設三個抗壓試值48、50、52 MPa，平均50 MPa；此小樣本平均不是規範特徵強度。 試塊養護優於環片會高估實際早齡能力，批號混淆又使低強度件無法追溯；即使平均合格，局部蜂窩和裂縫仍可能控制使用性。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「材料批次與強度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Concrete strength depends on batching, air, curing and specimen representativeness. One high result does not prove a uniform batch, and toughness, compaction and dimensions remain separate parts of segment quality. Assumed compressive results 48,50 and 52 MPa average 50 MPa; this small-sample mean is not a code-defined characteristic strength. Better specimen curing than segment curing overstates early capacity, while batch confusion prevents tracing weak pieces. A satisfactory mean does not rule out local honeycombing or cracking governing serviceability. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Material batches and strength” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「少量試塊平均強度就是整批環片的特徵設計強度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The mean of a few specimens is the characteristic design strength of the whole batch." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「材料批次與強度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Material batches and strength”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 材料批次與強度
knowledge.text: 混凝土強度受配料、含氣、養護和試體代表性影響，單一高強度試塊不代表整批均勻。環片還需控制韌性、密實與尺寸，強度數字只是品質鏈的一部分而非全部驗收證據。
knowledge.textEn: Concrete strength depends on batching, air, curing and specimen representativeness. One high result does not prove a uniform batch, and toughness, compaction and dimensions remain separate parts of segment quality.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：少量試塊平均強度就是整批環片的特徵設計強度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The mean of a few specimens is the characteristic design strength of the whole batch. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「材料批次與強度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Material batches and strength" is correct?
options: 少量試塊平均強度就是整批環片的特徵設計強度。
纖維添加重量相同就一定產生相同方向的殘餘拉力。
混凝土強度受配料、含氣、養護和試體代表性影響，單一高強度試塊不代表整批均勻。
optionsEn: The mean of a few specimens is the characteristic design strength of the whole batch.
Equal fibre dosage necessarily produces equal residual tensile resistance in every direction.
Concrete strength depends on batching, air, curing and specimen representativeness.
quiz.explanation: 混凝土強度受配料、含氣、養護和試體代表性影響，單一高強度試塊不代表整批均勻。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Concrete strength depends on batching, air, curing and specimen representativeness. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 材料批次與強度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Material batches and strength: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「材料批次與強度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Material batches and strength” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設三個抗壓試值48、50、52 MPa，平均50 MPa；此小樣本平均不是規範特徵強度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed compressive results 48,50 and 52 MPa average 50 MPa; this small-sample mean is not a code-defined characteristic strength. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對材料批號、拌合與養護紀錄，將試體時間和對應環片連結；依合約試驗方法評估批次分布，異常值須查成因而非直接刪除，製造及品質主管共同確認處置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Link material, mixing and curing records to specimens and segments by time; evaluate batch distributions under the contract test method and investigate anomalies rather than deleting them, with joint production and quality review.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設三個抗壓試值48、50、52 MPa，平均50 MPa；此小樣本平均不是規範特徵強度。

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「材料批次與強度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

High early compressive strength guarantees absence of thermal shrinkage cracking.

steps.title: 材料批次與強度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Material batches and strength: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「材料批次與強度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Material batches and strength” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對材料批號、拌合與養護紀錄，將試體時間和對應環片連結；依合約試驗方法評估批次分布，異常值須查成因而非直接刪除，製造及品質主管共同確認處置。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：試塊養護優於環片會高估實際早齡能力，批號混淆又使低強度件無法追溯；即使平均合格，局部蜂窩和裂縫仍可能控制使用性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Link material, mixing and curing records to specimens and segments by time; evaluate batch distributions under the contract test method and investigate anomalies rather than deleting them, with joint production and quality review. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Better specimen curing than segment curing overstates early capacity, while batch confusion prevents tracing weak pieces. A satisfactory mean does not rule out local honeycombing or cracking governing serviceability. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for material batches and strength. Link material, mixing and curing records to specimens and segments by time; evaluate batch distributions under the contract test method and investigate anomalies rather than deleting them, with joint production and quality review.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：試塊養護優於環片會高估實際早齡能力，批號混淆又使低強度件無法追溯；即使平均合格，局部蜂窩和裂縫仍可能控制使用性。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Better specimen curing than segment curing overstates early capacity, while batch confusion prevents tracing weak pieces. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

A satisfactory mean does not rule out local honeycombing or cracking governing serviceability.

steps.title: 材料批次與強度：失效診斷

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Material batches and strength” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 試塊養護優於環片會高估實際早齡能力，批號混淆又使低強度件無法追溯；即使平均合格，局部蜂窩和裂縫仍可能控制使用性。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Better specimen curing than segment curing overstates early capacity, while batch confusion prevents tracing weak pieces. A satisfactory mean does not rule out local honeycombing or cracking governing serviceability. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：試塊養護優於環片會高估實際早齡能力，批號混淆又使低強度件無法追溯；即使平均合格，局部蜂窩和裂縫仍可能控制使用性。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

stages.title: 機制、材料與定量設計
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「纖維與殘餘韌性」與「模具與幾何公差」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Fibres and residual toughness" and "Moulds and geometric tolerances": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 纖維與殘餘韌性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Fibres and residual toughness: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「纖維與殘餘韌性」如何影響隧道管片預鑄與養護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fibres and residual toughness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel-segment precasting and curing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 纖維跨越裂縫後提供殘餘拉力，但效果取決於取向、分布與錨定，不能只由每立方米重量推定。鋼筋和纖維的角色需依設計分清，局部集中力與接縫區仍可能需要專門細節。 假設中央單點載重的三點彎曲缺口梁，殘餘荷重12 kN、跨距0.5 m、寬0.15 m、有效韌帶0.125 m，fR=3FL/(2bh²)=3.84 MPa。 澆置流向造成纖維取向偏差時，標準梁可能比環片不利方向更強；局部纖維團聚又會留下弱區，只看總添加重量無法發現。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「纖維與殘餘韌性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Fibres bridge cracks with residual resistance governed by orientation, distribution and anchorage, not dosage alone. Their role relative to reinforcement must be designed, with concentrated loads and joint zones requiring specific detailing. Assume a notched beam under three-point centre loading with residual load 12 kN, span 0.5 m, width 0.15 m and ligament 0.125 m; fR=3FL/(2bh²)=3.84 MPa. Casting-induced fibre orientation can make test beams stronger than the unfavorable segment direction. Local clustering also leaves weak zones that total dosage records alone cannot reveal reliably. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fibres and residual toughness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 環片尺寸決定成環形狀、接縫接觸與止水墊壓縮，累積偏差可能在最後一塊才暴露。模具磨耗及溫度使尺寸隨批次變化，應分辨單件誤差與系統性偏差，不能只檢查能否拼上。 假設一環6片各有同向弧長偏差0.5 mm，總偏差3 mm；獨立隨機誤差才可用平方根加總。 同向公差若誤當隨機抵消，閉合片可能被迫擠入而造成邊角裂損；反覆修磨又會改變止水墊溝槽，組裝成功仍不代表水密合格。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「模具與幾何公差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Dimensions control ring shape, joint contact and gasket compression. Accumulated error may appear only at the final piece, while mould wear and temperature introduce batch drift. Distinguish individual and systematic error rather than accepting mere assembly fit. Treating systematic tolerances as canceling random errors can force the closing piece and crack edges. Repeated grinding may alter gasket grooves, so successful assembly still does not establish watertightness. 環片尺寸決定成環形狀、接縫接觸與止水墊壓縮，累積偏差可能在最後一塊才暴露。
早齡抗壓強度高就代表不會發生溫差收縮裂縫。
optionsEn: Same-direction dimensional biases can be combined like independent random errors by root-sum-square.
Dimensions control ring shape, joint contact and gasket compression.
High early compressive strength guarantees absence of thermal shrinkage cracking.
quiz.explanation: 環片尺寸決定成環形狀、接縫接觸與止水墊壓縮，累積偏差可能在最後一塊才暴露。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Dimensions control ring shape, joint contact and gasket compression. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 模具與幾何公差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Moulds and geometric tolerances: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「模具與幾何公差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Moulds and geometric tolerances” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設一環6片各有同向弧長偏差0.5 mm，總偏差3 mm；獨立隨機誤差才可用平方根加總。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If an assumed ring has 6 segments each with a same-direction arc-length bias of 0.5 mm, total bias is 3 mm; root-sum-square applies only to independent random errors. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以校準量具或三維量測檢查模具和成品，繪製尺寸隨批次的趨勢並做核准試拼；品質主管須辨識共同偏差，止水溝槽和接觸面公差需與環片設計一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Survey moulds and products with calibrated gauges or three-dimensional methods, chart batch trends and perform approved trial assembly; quality review identifies common bias and aligns groove and bearing-face tolerances with design.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設一環6片各有同向弧長偏差0.5 mm，總偏差3 mm；獨立隨機誤差才可用平方根加總。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If an assumed ring has 6 segments each with a same-direction arc-length bias of 0.5 mm, total bias is 3 mm; root-sum-square applies only to independent random errors.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「模具與幾何公差」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Moulds and geometric tolerances", which statement holds?
options: 千斤頂總推力除總接觸面積足以排除所有局部劈裂。
完好混凝土擴散係數可以完整代表貫穿裂縫的傳輸。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: Total jack force divided by total contact area excludes all local splitting.
An intact-concrete diffusion coefficient fully represents transport through a through-crack.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 模具與幾何公差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Moulds and geometric tolerances: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「模具與幾何公差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Moulds and geometric tolerances” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以校準量具或三維量測檢查模具和成品，繪製尺寸隨批次的趨勢並做核准試拼；品質主管須辨識共同偏差，止水溝槽和接觸面公差需與環片設計一致。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：同向公差若誤當隨機抵消，閉合片可能被迫擠入而造成邊角裂損；反覆修磨又會改變止水墊溝槽，組裝成功仍不代表水密合格。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Survey moulds and products with calibrated gauges or three-dimensional methods, chart batch trends and perform approved trial assembly; quality review identifies common bias and aligns groove and bearing-face tolerances with design. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Treating systematic tolerances as canceling random errors can force the closing piece and crack edges. Repeated grinding may alter gasket grooves, so successful assembly still does not establish watertightness. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄模具與幾何公差的資料來源與適用條件。以校準量具或三維量測檢查模具和成品，繪製尺寸隨批次的趨勢並做核准試拼；品質主管須辨識共同偏差，止水溝槽和接觸面公差需與環片設計一致。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for moulds and geometric tolerances. Survey moulds and products with calibrated gauges or three-dimensional methods, chart batch trends and perform approved trial assembly; quality review identifies common bias and aligns groove and bearing-face tolerances with design.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：同向公差若誤當隨機抵消，閉合片可能被迫擠入而造成邊角裂損；反覆修磨又會改變止水墊溝槽，組裝成功仍不代表水密合格。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating systematic tolerances as canceling random errors can force the closing piece and crack edges. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Treating systematic tolerances as canceling random errors can force the closing piece and crack edges. Repeated grinding may alter gasket grooves, so successful assembly still does not establish watertightness.

Survey moulds and products with calibrated gauges or three-dimensional methods, chart batch trends and perform approved trial assembly; quality review identifies common bias and aligns groove and bearing-face tolerances with design.

quiz.question: 要驗證「模具與幾何公差」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Moulds and geometric tolerances"?
options: 以校準量具或三維量測檢查模具和成品，繪製尺寸隨批次的趨勢並做核准試拼；品質主管須辨識共同偏差，止水溝槽和接觸面公差需與環片設計一致。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
永久成環荷載合格就代表運輸和吊運階段必定合格。
optionsEn: Survey moulds and products with calibrated gauges or three-dimensional methods, chart batch trends and perform approved trial assembly.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Adequate permanent-ring capacity necessarily proves adequate transport and handling performance.
quiz.explanation: 以校準量具或三維量測檢查模具和成品，繪製尺寸隨批次的趨勢並做核准試拼；品質主管須辨識共同偏差，止水溝槽和接觸面公差需與環片設計一致。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Survey moulds and products with calibrated gauges or three-dimensional methods, chart batch trends and perform approved trial assembly; quality review identifies common bias and aligns groove and bearing-face tolerances with design. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 模具與幾何公差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Moulds and geometric tolerances: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「模具與幾何公差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Moulds and geometric tolerances” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 同向公差若誤當隨機抵消，閉合片可能被迫擠入而造成邊角裂損；反覆修磨又會改變止水墊溝槽，組裝成功仍不代表水密合格。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating systematic tolerances as canceling random errors can force the closing piece and crack edges. Repeated grinding may alter gasket grooves, so successful assembly still does not establish watertightness. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：同向公差若誤當隨機抵消，閉合片可能被迫擠入而造成邊角裂損；反覆修磨又會改變止水墊溝槽，組裝成功仍不代表水密合格。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Repeated grinding may alter gasket grooves, so successful assembly still does not establish watertightness.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「同向尺寸偏差可以和獨立隨機誤差一樣平方根加總。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Same-direction dimensional biases can be combined like independent random errors by root-sum-square." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 同向公差若誤當隨機抵消，閉合片可能被迫擠入而造成邊角裂損；反覆修磨又會改變止水墊溝槽，組裝成功仍不代表水密合格。
knowledge.textEn: Treating systematic tolerances as canceling random errors can force the closing piece and crack edges. Repeated grinding may alter gasket grooves, so successful assembly still does not establish watertightness.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「模具與幾何公差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Moulds and geometric tolerances" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
同向公差若誤當隨機抵消，閉合片可能被迫擠入而造成邊角裂損；反覆修磨又會改變止水墊溝槽，組裝成功仍不代表水密合格。
早齡抗壓強度高就代表不會發生溫差收縮裂縫。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Treating systematic tolerances as canceling random errors can force the closing piece and crack edges.
High early compressive strength guarantees absence of thermal shrinkage cracking.
quiz.explanation: 同向公差若誤當隨機抵消，閉合片可能被迫擠入而造成邊角裂損；反覆修磨又會改變止水墊溝槽，組裝成功仍不代表水密合格。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating systematic tolerances as canceling random errors can force the closing piece and crack edges. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「早齡溫差與養護」與「吊運支點與裂縫」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Early-age temperature and curing" and "Handling supports and cracking": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 早齡溫差與養護：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Early-age temperature and curing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「早齡溫差與養護」如何影響隧道管片預鑄與養護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Early-age temperature and curing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel-segment precasting and curing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水化升溫與外界冷卻形成溫度梯度，受約束收縮可在強度尚低時引起裂縫。高早強不代表低熱裂風險，需同時看溫度歷程、拘束和濕度，避免把養護只等同抗壓數字。 假設α=10⁻⁵/K、E=20 GPa、全約束降溫20 K，彈性拉應力EαΔT=4 MPa；實際徐變會改變結果。 快速冷卻可使表面先收縮開裂，脫模後乾燥又可能疊加收縮；若只看試塊強度達標便結束養護，耐久缺陷可能在交貨後才明顯。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「早齡溫差與養護」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Hydration and cooling create gradients whose restrained contraction can crack young concrete. High early strength does not eliminate thermal risk; temperature history, restraint and moisture must be reviewed alongside compressive results. Assume α=10⁻⁵/K, E=20 GPa and fully restrained cooling of 20 K; elastic tensile stress EαΔT=4 MPa, modified in reality by creep. Rapid cooling contracts the surface first, and post-demoulding drying adds shrinkage. Ending curing solely because specimen strength is reached can leave durability defects that become visible only after delivery. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Early-age temperature and curing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「早齡抗壓強度高就代表不會發生溫差收縮裂縫。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High early compressive strength guarantees absence of thermal shrinkage cracking." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「早齡溫差與養護」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Early-age temperature and curing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 早齡溫差與養護
knowledge.text: 水化升溫與外界冷卻形成溫度梯度，受約束收縮可在強度尚低時引起裂縫。高早強不代表低熱裂風險，需同時看溫度歷程、拘束和濕度，避免把養護只等同抗壓數字。
knowledge.textEn: Hydration and cooling create gradients whose restrained contraction can crack young concrete. High early strength does not eliminate thermal risk; temperature history, restraint and moisture must be reviewed alongside compressive results.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：早齡抗壓強度高就代表不會發生溫差收縮裂縫。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: High early compressive strength guarantees absence of thermal shrinkage cracking. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「早齡溫差與養護」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Early-age temperature and curing" is correct?
options: 早齡抗壓強度高就代表不會發生溫差收縮裂縫。
同一環片的吊運支點移動不會改變暫態彎矩。
水化升溫與外界冷卻形成溫度梯度，受約束收縮可在強度尚低時引起裂縫。
optionsEn: High early compressive strength guarantees absence of thermal shrinkage cracking.
Moving handling support points cannot change transient bending in the same segment.
Hydration and cooling create gradients whose restrained contraction can crack young concrete.
quiz.explanation: 水化升溫與外界冷卻形成溫度梯度，受約束收縮可在強度尚低時引起裂縫。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Hydration and cooling create gradients whose restrained contraction can crack young concrete. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 早齡溫差與養護：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Early-age temperature and curing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「早齡溫差與養護」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Early-age temperature and curing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設α=10⁻⁵/K、E=20 GPa、全約束降溫20 K，彈性拉應力EαΔT=4 MPa；實際徐變會改變結果。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume α=10⁻⁵/K, E=20 GPa and fully restrained cooling of 20 K; elastic tensile stress EαΔT=4 MPa, modified in reality by creep. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：記錄環片核心和表面溫度、養護濕度及脫模時刻，對照早齡裂縫分布；製造工程師需評估實際拘束與徐變，不能用全約束算例直接判定裂縫一定發生或不發生。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record core-surface temperature, curing moisture and demoulding time and compare early crack patterns; production engineers assess real restraint and creep rather than treating the fully restrained illustration as a definite crack prediction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 早齡溫差與養護：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Early-age temperature and curing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「早齡溫差與養護」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Early-age temperature and curing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 記錄環片核心和表面溫度、養護濕度及脫模時刻，對照早齡裂縫分布；製造工程師需評估實際拘束與徐變，不能用全約束算例直接判定裂縫一定發生或不發生。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：快速冷卻可使表面先收縮開裂，脫模後乾燥又可能疊加收縮；若只看試塊強度達標便結束養護，耐久缺陷可能在交貨後才明顯。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record core-surface temperature, curing moisture and demoulding time and compare early crack patterns; production engineers assess real restraint and creep rather than treating the fully restrained illustration as a definite crack prediction. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Rapid cooling contracts the surface first, and post-demoulding drying adds shrinkage. Ending curing solely because specimen strength is reached can leave durability defects that become visible only after delivery. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時逐項記錄早齡溫差與養護的資料來源與適用條件。記錄環片核心和表面溫度、養護濕度及脫模時刻，對照早齡裂縫分布；製造工程師需評估實際拘束與徐變，不能用全約束算例直接判定裂縫一定發生或不發生。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for early-age temperature and curing. Record core-surface temperature, curing moisture and demoulding time and compare early crack patterns; production engineers assess real restraint and creep rather than treating the fully restrained illustration as a definite crack prediction.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：快速冷卻可使表面先收縮開裂，脫模後乾燥又可能疊加收縮；若只看試塊強度達標便結束養護，耐久缺陷可能在交貨後才明顯。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Rapid cooling contracts the surface first, and post-demoulding drying adds shrinkage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「早齡溫差與養護」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Early-age temperature and curing"?

記錄環片核心和表面溫度、養護濕度及脫模時刻，對照早齡裂縫分布；製造工程師需評估實際拘束與徐變，不能用全約束算例直接判定裂縫一定發生或不發生。
少量試塊平均強度就是整批環片的特徵設計強度。

Record core-surface temperature, curing moisture and demoulding time and compare early crack patterns.
The mean of a few specimens is the characteristic design strength of the whole batch.

quiz.explanationEn: Record core-surface temperature, curing moisture and demoulding time and compare early crack patterns; production engineers assess real restraint and creep rather than treating the fully restrained illustration as a definite crack prediction. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 早齡溫差與養護：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Early-age temperature and curing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「早齡溫差與養護」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Early-age temperature and curing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 快速冷卻可使表面先收縮開裂，脫模後乾燥又可能疊加收縮；若只看試塊強度達標便結束養護，耐久缺陷可能在交貨後才明顯。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Rapid cooling contracts the surface first, and post-demoulding drying adds shrinkage. Ending curing solely because specimen strength is reached can leave durability defects that become visible only after delivery. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：快速冷卻可使表面先收縮開裂，脫模後乾燥又可能疊加收縮；若只看試塊強度達標便結束養護，耐久缺陷可能在交貨後才明顯。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Ending curing solely because specimen strength is reached can leave durability defects that become visible only after delivery.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「早齡抗壓強度高就代表不會發生溫差收縮裂縫。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "High early compressive strength guarantees absence of thermal shrinkage cracking." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 快速冷卻可使表面先收縮開裂，脫模後乾燥又可能疊加收縮；若只看試塊強度達標便結束養護，耐久缺陷可能在交貨後才明顯。
knowledge.textEn: Rapid cooling contracts the surface first, and post-demoulding drying adds shrinkage. Ending curing solely because specimen strength is reached can leave durability defects that become visible only after delivery.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「早齡溫差與養護」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Early-age temperature and curing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
同一環片的吊運支點移動不會改變暫態彎矩。
快速冷卻可使表面先收縮開裂，脫模後乾燥又可能疊加收縮；若只看試塊強度達標便結束養護，耐久缺陷可能在交貨後才明顯。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Moving handling support points cannot change transient bending in the same segment.
Rapid cooling contracts the surface first, and post-demoulding drying adds shrinkage.
quiz.explanation: 快速冷卻可使表面先收縮開裂，脫模後乾燥又可能疊加收縮；若只看試塊強度達標便結束養護，耐久缺陷可能在交貨後才明顯。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Rapid cooling contracts the surface first, and post-demoulding drying adds shrinkage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 吊運支點與裂縫：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Handling supports and cracking: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「吊運支點與裂縫」如何影響隧道管片預鑄與養護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Handling supports and cracking” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel-segment precasting and curing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 吊運和堆放的支點控制環片暫態彎矩，位置偏差可比重量誤差更敏感。吊點、墊木和構件方向需要由核准方案決定，教學力學只解釋為何同一環片在不同支承下會有不同應力。 假設簡支示意梁總均布載重20 kN、跨2 m，Mmax=WL/8=5 kN·m；曲面環片需專門分析。 墊木錯位可能在外觀未立即開裂時已形成微裂縫，之後推進荷載使其擴展；無交貨前照片時，很難區分製造、運輸與組裝損傷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「吊運支點與裂縫」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Handling and storage supports control transient bending, sometimes more sensitively than weight error. Approved plans govern lifting points, dunnage and orientation; mechanics explains why the same segment develops different stresses under different support arrangements. For an assumed simply supported illustrative beam with total distributed load 20 kN over 2 m, Mmax=WL/8=5 kN·m; curved segments require specific analysis. Misplaced dunnage can create microcracking before visible damage, later extended by thrust. Without pre-delivery photographs, manufacturing, transport and assembly damage become difficult to distinguish and address. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Handling supports and cracking” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「同一環片的吊運支點移動不會改變暫態彎矩。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Moving handling support points cannot change transient bending in the same segment." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「吊運支點與裂縫」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Handling supports and cracking”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 吊運支點與裂縫
knowledge.text: 吊運和堆放的支點控制環片暫態彎矩，位置偏差可比重量誤差更敏感。吊點、墊木和構件方向需要由核准方案決定，教學力學只解釋為何同一環片在不同支承下會有不同應力。
knowledge.textEn: Handling and storage supports control transient bending, sometimes more sensitively than weight error. Approved plans govern lifting points, dunnage and orientation; mechanics explains why the same segment develops different stresses under different support arrangements.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：同一環片的吊運支點移動不會改變暫態彎矩。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Moving handling support points cannot change transient bending in the same segment. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「吊運支點與裂縫」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Handling supports and cracking" is correct?
options: 吊運和堆放的支點控制環片暫態彎矩，位置偏差可比重量誤差更敏感。
同一環片的吊運支點移動不會改變暫態彎矩。
千斤頂總推力除總接觸面積足以排除所有局部劈裂。
optionsEn: Handling and storage supports control transient bending, sometimes more sensitively than weight error.
Moving handling support points cannot change transient bending in the same segment.
Total jack force divided by total contact area excludes all local splitting.
quiz.explanation: 吊運和堆放的支點控制環片暫態彎矩，位置偏差可比重量誤差更敏感。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 吊運支點與裂縫：失效診斷

steps.instruction: 墊木錯位可能在外觀未立即開裂時已形成微裂縫，之後推進荷載使其擴展；無交貨前照片時，很難區分製造、運輸與組裝損傷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Misplaced dunnage can create microcracking before visible damage, later extended by thrust. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「同一環片的吊運支點移動不會改變暫態彎矩。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Moving handling support points cannot change transient bending in the same segment." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「推進千斤頂局部承壓」與「防火與爆裂驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Local jack bearing" and "Fire and spalling verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 推進千斤頂局部承壓：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Local jack bearing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「推進千斤頂局部承壓」如何影響隧道管片預鑄與養護的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Local jack bearing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tunnel-segment precasting and curing”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 推進反力透過千斤頂墊板進入環片，局部承壓與劈裂不等同全環均勻軸力。墊板位置、接觸面和平整度決定擴散路徑，偏載可能讓邊緣先損壞而平均壓力仍合理。 假設墊板力1 MN、面積0.1 m²，平均承壓10 MPa；不能代替局部劈裂與邊距檢核。 墊板只接觸一角會集中壓力並誘發劈裂，總推力除總面積卻可能看似安全；若把裂縫歸於混凝土批次，會漏掉真正的幾何原因。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「推進千斤頂局部承壓」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Thrust enters through jack pads, creating local bearing and splitting unlike uniform ring compression. Pad location, contact and flatness govern spreading, and eccentricity can damage an edge despite an acceptable mean pressure. An assumed pad force 1 MN over 0.1 m² gives mean bearing 10 MPa; splitting and edge-distance checks remain separate. Corner-only pad contact concentrates pressure and causes splitting while total force divided by total area looks acceptable. Blaming the concrete batch can miss the actual geometric cause of damage. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Local jack bearing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「千斤頂總推力除總接觸面積足以排除所有局部劈裂。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Total jack force divided by total contact area excludes all local splitting." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「推進千斤頂局部承壓」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 推進千斤頂局部承壓：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「推進千斤頂局部承壓」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Local jack bearing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把千斤頂實際接觸位置與環片配筋模型比較，檢查接觸痕跡及邊緣裂縫；依核准分析或試驗檢核局部荷載路徑，設備與結構負責人共同審查不均勻推力。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：墊板只接觸一角會集中壓力並誘發劈裂，總推力除總面積卻可能看似安全；若把裂縫歸於混凝土批次，會漏掉真正的幾何原因。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare actual pad positions with reinforcement and analysis, inspecting contact marks and edge cracks; verify local load paths by approved analysis or tests, with joint equipment and structural review of uneven thrust. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Corner-only pad contact concentrates pressure and causes splitting while total force divided by total area looks acceptable. Blaming the concrete batch can miss the actual geometric cause of damage. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.failure: 注意干擾：墊板只接觸一角會集中壓力並誘發劈裂，總推力除總面積卻可能看似安全；若把裂縫歸於混凝土批次，會漏掉真正的幾何原因。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.title: 推進千斤頂局部承壓：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Local jack bearing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「推進千斤頂局部承壓」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Local jack bearing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 墊板只接觸一角會集中壓力並誘發劈裂，總推力除總面積卻可能看似安全；若把裂縫歸於混凝土批次，會漏掉真正的幾何原因。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Corner-only pad contact concentrates pressure and causes splitting while total force divided by total area looks acceptable. Blaming the concrete batch can miss the actual geometric cause of damage. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：墊板只接觸一角會集中壓力並誘發劈裂，總推力除總面積卻可能看似安全；若把裂縫歸於混凝土批次，會漏掉真正的幾何原因。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Blaming the concrete batch can miss the actual geometric cause of damage.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「千斤頂總推力除總接觸面積足以排除所有局部劈裂。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Total jack force divided by total contact area excludes all local splitting." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.
